Humanoid robots show significant potential in daily tasks. However, reinforcement learning-based motion policies often suffer from robustness degradation due to the sim-to-real dynamics gap, thereby affecting the agility of real robots. In this work, we propose a novel robust adversarial training paradigm designed to enhance the robustness of humanoid motion policies in real worlds. The paradigm introduces a learnable adversarial attack network that precisely identifies vulnerabilities in motion policies and applies targeted perturbations, forcing the motion policy to enhance its robustness against perturbations through dynamic adversarial training. We conduct experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot for both perceptive locomotion and whole-body control tasks. The results demonstrate that our proposed method significantly enhances the robot's motion robustness in real world environments, enabling successful traversal of challenging terrains and highly agile whole-body trajectory tracking.
53. ULC: A Unified and Fine-Grained Controller for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
ULC：面向仿人机器人移动 - 操作的统一精细化控制器
仿人机器人的移动 - 操作（Loco-Manipulation）旨在使机器人将移动能力与上身跟踪能力相结合。现有多数方法采用分层架构，将控制分解为独立的上身（操作）和下身（移动）策略。这种分解虽降低了训练复杂度，但本质上限制了子系统间的协同，与人类所展现的统一全身控制模式相悖。
本文证明，单一统一策略能够实现仿人机器人移动 - 操作的跟踪精度、大工作空间与鲁棒性的结合。我们提出了统一移动 - 操作控制器（Unified Loco-Manipulation Controller，ULC）—— 这是一种单策略框架，能够以端到端方式同时跟踪根节点速度、根节点高度、躯干旋转和双臂关节位置，证明了在不牺牲性能的前提下实现统一控制的可行性。
我们通过多项关键技术实现这种统一控制：用于渐进式学习复杂度的序列技能获取、用于精细化控制调整的残余动作建模、用于平滑运动过渡的指令多项式插值、用于增强部署鲁棒性的随机延迟释放、用于泛化外部干扰的负载随机化，以及用于提供明确策略梯度以维持稳定性的重心跟踪。
我们在具有 3 自由度腰部的宇树 G1 仿人机器人上验证了该方法。与强基准方法相比，ULC 在解耦方法上表现出更优的跟踪性能，并展现出更大的工作空间覆盖范围。这种统一的双臂跟踪能力使机器人在承受外部负载时仍能进行精确操作，同时在复杂移动 - 操作任务中维持协调的全身控制。
Loco-Manipulation for humanoid robots aims to enable robots to integrate mobility with upper-body tracking capabilities. Most existing approaches adopt hierarchical architectures that decompose control into isolated upper-body (manipulation) and lower-body (locomotion) policies. While this decomposition reduces training complexity, it inherently limits coordination between subsystems and contradicts the unified whole-body control exhibited by humans. We demonstrate that a single unified policy can achieve a combination of tracking accuracy, large workspace, and robustness for humanoid loco-manipulation. We propose the Unified Loco-Manipulation Controller (ULC), a single-policy framework that simultaneously tracks root velocity, root height, torso rotation, and dual-arm joint positions in an end-to-end manner, proving the feasibility of unified control without sacrificing performance. We achieve this unified control through key technologies: sequence skill acquisition for progressive learning complexity, residual action modeling for fine-grained control adjustments, command polynomial interpolation for smooth motion transitions, random delay release for robustness to deploy variations, load randomization for generalization to external disturbances, and center-of-gravity tracking for providing explicit policy gradients to maintain stability. We validate our method on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot with 3-DOF (degrees-of-freedom) waist. Compared with strong baselines, ULC shows better tracking performance to disentangled methods and demonstrating larger workspace coverage. The unified dual-arm tracking enables precise manipulation under external loads while maintaining coordinated whole-body control for complex loco-manipulation tasks.
54. Learning Whole-body Motion Control through Instruction Learning and Human Motion Data
通过关键对抗攻击学习人形机器人的稳健运动技能

与其他模仿学习方法相比，由于采用了前馈动作，所提方法能显著提高训练效率。此外，由于运动模仿能力主要由前馈动作决定，而神经网络仅起到稳定器的作用，因此该方法能够通过单一神经网络实现对多种运动技能的控制。通过在宇树H1机器人上执行的多项仿真任务，验证了所提方法在全身运动模仿学习中的有效性。
This paper proposes a novel imitation learning approach for the whole - body motion control of humanoid robots. Based on the instruction learning framework proposed in our prior work, we integrate human motion capture data as a feedforward action in this paper, which is combined with a feedback action driven by reinforcement learning to achieve human - like whole - body movements. Compared to other imitation learning methods, the proposed method can significantly enhance the training efficiency due to the application of a feedforward action. Furthermore, since the motion - mimic capability is mainly determined by the feedforward action while the neural network only plays a role as a stabilizer, it enables the control of multiple motion skills using a single neural network. The effectiveness of the proposed method in whole - body motion imitation learning is verified through several simulation tasks performed on the Unitree H1 robot.
55. Online Energy-efficient Push Recovery Control for Biped Robot Using a Variational-based Stepping Approach
基于变分步长法的双足机器人在线节能抗推控制
本文提出了一种新型抗推恢复控制方案，用于抵消外部扰动对运动稳定性的不利影响，该方案融合了单步和多步控制策略。在这一全新开发的控制方案下，我们设计了高效的步足规划方法和基于变分法的步长算法，以实现双足机器人的稳健抗推恢复。
为解决运动稳定性与控制性能之间的权衡问题，首先将步长优化问题构建为非线性规划（NLP）问题，随后通过构造目标函数，在遭遇突发扰动时生成合适的下一步落足位置。此外，通过设计基于倒立摆模型（IPM）的状态估计方法，实时检测质心（CoM）变化并估计机器人行走状态，该新型控制方案在维持运动稳定性方面表现出良好性能。
最后，分别在双足机器人 Jet-hr5 和宇树 H1 上进行了仿真与硬件实验，充分验证了所提控制方案的有效性。
In this paper, a new push recovery control scheme is presented to counteract the adverse effects of external disturbances on locomotion stability, where the control strategies of one-step and multi-steps are incorporated. Under the newly developed control scheme, an efficient footstep planning approach and a variational-based stepping algorithm are proposed to achieve the robust push recovery of biped robots. To tackle the trade-off problem between locomotion stability and control performance, the step-size optimization problem is firstly formulated as a nonlinear programming (NLP) problem, and then an objective function is constructed to generate the appropriate next-step landing location under unexpected disturbances. Moreover, by designing an inverted-pendulum-model (IPM)-based state estimation method to detect center of mass (CoM) changes and estimate robot’s walking status in real time, the newly developed control scheme exhibits a good performance in maintaining locomotion stability. Finally, simulation and hardware experiments are carried out based on biped robots Jet-hr5 and Unitree-H1, respectively, which well illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.
56. Traversing the Narrow Path A Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning Framework for Humanoid Beam Walking
行走于狭窄路径：一种适用于仿人机器人过梁行走的两阶段强化学习框架
仿人机器人在狭窄横梁上行走面临诸多挑战，主要源于稀疏且对安全性至关重要的接触（指机器人与横梁间的支撑接触），以及纯学习型策略（仅依赖模型训练生成的控制策略）的不稳定性。本文提出一种基于物理规律的两阶段框架，将 XCoM/LIPM（扩展质心 / 线性倒立摆模型）步点模板与轻量化残差规划器、简易低层级跟踪器相结合。
第一阶段在平坦地面上训练：跟踪器通过对启发式步点添加小幅随机扰动，学习稳定跟踪步点目标，全程无需人工设计的中心线锁定机制，从而掌握稳定的接触时序调度能力与强大的目标跟踪鲁棒性。
第二阶段在仿真环境的横梁场景中训练：高层级规划器仅针对摆动脚预测机体坐标系下的残差，通过优化模板步点，在保证可解释性的同时，优先实现狭窄支撑面下安全、精准的落足定位。
为降低部署难度，系统采用极简感知方案，且仿真与硬件环境的感知方式保持一致：规划器仅需输入紧凑的前向高程信息（用于感知前方路径高度变化），以及机器人自身的惯性测量单元（IMU）数据与关节信号。在宇树 G1 仿人机器人上的实验表明，该系统可稳定通过宽 0.2 米、长 3 米的横梁。
无论是仿真实验还是真实场景测试，残差优化策略在成功率、中心线贴合度与安全余量方面，均持续优于 “仅依赖模板” 和 “一体化（无阶段划分）” 的基准方案；同时，结构化的步点交互接口不仅支持透明化分析，还实现了低难度的 “仿真到实物” 迁移（即仿真环境中训练的模型可直接适配真实硬件，无需大量二次调试）。
  Traversing narrow beams is challenging for humanoids due to sparse, safety-critical contacts and the fragility of purely learned policies. We propose a physically grounded, two-stage framework that couples an XCoM/LIPM footstep template with a lightweight residual planner and a simple low-level tracker. Stage-1 is trained on flat ground: the tracker learns to robustly follow footstep targets by adding small random perturbations to heuristic footsteps, without any hand-crafted centerline locking, so it acquires stable contact scheduling and strong target-tracking robustness. Stage-2 is trained in simulation on a beam: a high-level planner predicts a body-frame residual (Delta x, Delta y, Delta psi) for the swing foot only, refining the template step to prioritize safe, precise placement under narrow support while preserving interpretability. To ease deployment, sensing is kept minimal and consistent between simulation and hardware: the planner consumes compact, forward-facing elevation cues together with onboard IMU and joint signals. On a Unitree G1, our system reliably traverses a 0.2 m-wide, 3 m-long beam. Across simulation and real-world studies, residual refinement consistently outperforms template-only and monolithic baselines in success rate, centerline adherence, and safety margins, while the structured footstep interface enables transparent analysis and low-friction sim-to-real transfer.
57. Switch4EAI: Leveraging Console Game Platform for Benchmarking Robotic Athletics
Switch4EAI：利用主机游戏平台实现机器人竞技性能基准测试
近年来，机器人全身控制技术取得显著进展，已能让仿人机器人与足式机器人完成愈发灵活且协调的动作。然而，目前仍缺乏标准化基准测试方法，难以在真实场景中评估机器人的竞技性能，也无法将其与人类的竞技表现进行直接对比。
本文提出Switch4EAI（面向具身智能的 Switch 平台，Switch-for-Embodied-AI）—— 这是一套低成本、易部署的技术流程，通过利用动作感应主机游戏，实现对机器人全身控制策略的评估。以任天堂 Switch 平台上的《舞力全开》（Just Dance）游戏为典型案例，该系统可完成以下核心操作：捕捉游戏内的舞蹈动作、重建动作数据，并将动作重定向至机器人，使其能够执行对应舞蹈动作。
研究人员在搭载开源全身控制器的宇树 G1 仿人机器人上对该系统进行了验证，建立了机器人与人类玩家性能对比的量化基准。论文中详细探讨了相关实验结果，不仅证实了将商业游戏平台用作 “基于物理规律的基准测试工具” 的可行性，也为未来具身智能基准测试研究提供了方向与动力。
Recent advances in whole-body robot control have enabled humanoid and legged robots to execute increasingly agile and coordinated movements. However, standardized benchmarks for evaluating robotic athletic performance in real-world settings and in direct comparison to humans remain scarce. We present Switch4EAI(Switch-for-Embodied-AI), a low-cost and easily deployable pipeline that leverages motion-sensing console games to evaluate whole-body robot control policies. Using Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch as a representative example, our system captures, reconstructs, and retargets in-game choreography for robotic execution. We validate the system on a Unitree G1 humanoid with an open-source whole-body controller, establishing a quantitative baseline for the robot's performance against a human player. In the paper, we discuss these results, which demonstrate the feasibility of using commercial games platform as physically grounded benchmarks and motivate future work to for benchmarking embodied AI.
58. CLF-RL: Control Lyapunov Function Guided Reinforcement Learning
CLF-RL：基于控制李雅普诺夫函数引导的强化学习
强化学习（RL）在双足机器人鲁棒运动策略生成方面已展现出潜力，但该方法常面临奖励函数设计繁琐、对不合理目标函数敏感等问题。为解决这些挑战，本文提出一种结构化奖励塑造框架，通过结合基于模型的轨迹生成与控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF） 引导策略学习。
研究中探索了两种用于生成参考轨迹的基于模型规划器：
降阶线性倒立摆（LIP）模型：适用于速度条件下的运动规划，可生成符合速度需求的基础运动轨迹；
基于混合零动态（HZD）的预计算步态库：利用全阶动力学模型构建，包含预先计算的多种步态轨迹，为机器人提供更贴合实际动力学特性的参考。
上述规划器定义了期望的末端执行器（如足部）与关节轨迹，基于这些轨迹构建的 CLF 奖励函数，既能惩罚轨迹跟踪误差，又能激励系统快速收敛至期望状态。这种奖励设计方式可提供具有实际意义的中间奖励，且一旦获取参考轨迹，实现过程十分简便。
需注意的是，参考轨迹与 CLF 奖励塑造仅在训练阶段使用，因此部署时的策略模型轻量化程度高，不额外增加硬件计算负担。
该方法已通过仿真实验及在宇树 G1 机器人上开展的大量真实环境实验验证：相较于基准强化学习策略，CLF-RL 展现出显著更优的鲁棒性；同时，其性能也优于采用传统轨迹跟踪奖励设计的强化学习方案。
Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise in generating robust locomotion policies for bipedal robots, but often suffers from tedious reward design and sensitivity to poorly shaped objectives. In this work, we propose a structured reward shaping framework that leverages model-based trajectory generation and control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) to guide policy learning. We explore two model-based planners for generating reference trajectories: a reduced-order linear inverted pendulum (LIP) model for velocity-conditioned motion planning, and a precomputed gait library based on hybrid zero dynamics (HZD) using full-order dynamics. These planners define desired end-effector and joint trajectories, which are used to construct CLF-based rewards that penalize tracking error and encourage rapid convergence. This formulation provides meaningful intermediate rewards, and is straightforward to implement once a reference is available. Both the reference trajectories and CLF shaping are used only during training, resulting in a lightweight policy at deployment. We validate our method both in simulation and through extensive real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 robot. CLF-RL demonstrates significantly improved robustness relative to the baseline RL policy and better performance than a classic tracking reward RL formulation.
59. Coordinated Humanoid Robot Locomotion with Symmetry Equivariant Reinforcement Learning Policy
基于对称等变强化学习策略的仿人机器人协调运动控制
人类神经系统具有双侧对称性，这一特性使其能够完成协调且平衡的动作。然而，现有针对仿人机器人的深度强化学习（DRL）方法往往忽略了机器人自身的形态对称性，导致机器人出现动作不协调、性能欠佳的问题。
受人类运动控制机制启发，本文提出对称等变策略（SE-Policy）—— 这是一种新型深度强化学习框架，无需额外超参数，即可在 “演员网络（Actor）” 中嵌入严格的对称等变性，在 “评论员网络（Critic）” 中嵌入对称不变性。SE-Policy 通过强制机器人对 “对称观测信息” 做出一致性动作响应，能够生成时空维度上均协调的运动，同时提升任务性能。
研究人员在速度跟踪任务中开展了大量实验，涵盖仿真环境与基于宇树 G1 仿人机器人的真实部署场景。结果表明：与当前主流基准方法相比，SE-Policy 将跟踪精度提升了高达 40%，同时实现了更优的时空协调性。这些实验结果验证了 SE-Policy 的有效性，也证明其对仿人机器人具有广泛的适用性。
The human nervous system exhibits bilateral symmetry, enabling coordinated and balanced movements. However, existing Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) methods for humanoid robots neglect morphological symmetry of the robot, leading to uncoordinated and suboptimal behaviors. Inspired by human motor control, we propose Symmetry Equivariant Policy (SE-Policy), a new DRL framework that embeds strict symmetry equivariance in the actor and symmetry invariance in the critic without additional hyperparameters. SE-Policy enforces consistent behaviors across symmetric observations, producing temporally and spatially coordinated motions with higher task performance. Extensive experiments on velocity tracking tasks, conducted in both simulation and real-world deployment with the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, demonstrate that SE-Policy improves tracking accuracy by up to 40% compared to state-of-the-art baselines, while achieving superior spatial-temporal coordination. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SE-Policy and its broad applicability to humanoid robots.
60. HITTER: A HumanoId Table TEnnis Robot via Hierarchical Planning and Learning
HITTER：基于分层规划与学习的仿人乒乓球机器人
近年来，仿人机器人在运动控制与全身控制领域取得显著进展，但在需要通过操作与动态环境进行快速交互的任务中，其能力仍受局限。乒乓球运动正是这类挑战性任务的典型代表：乒乓球飞行速度超过 5 米 / 秒，运动者需在亚秒级（小于 1 秒）反应时间内完成感知、预测与动作，对敏捷性与精度均提出极高要求。
为应对这一挑战，本文提出一种面向仿人乒乓球运动的分层框架，将 “基于模型的规划器” 与 “基于强化学习的全身控制器” 相结合：
基于模型的规划器：负责乒乓球轨迹预测与球拍目标规划，确定击球位置、速度及时机；
基于强化学习的全身控制器：生成协调的手臂与腿部动作，既模仿人类击球姿态，又能在连续回合中维持机器人的稳定性与敏捷性。
此外，为使机器人动作更贴近人类自然运动模式，在控制器训练过程中融入了人类运动参考数据。
研究人员在一款通用仿人机器人上对该系统进行了验证：实验中，机器人与人类对手实现了最多 106 次连续击球，并能与另一台仿人机器人持续进行回合对抗。这些结果证实，该系统可实现真实场景下亚秒级反应控制的仿人乒乓球运动，为研发具备敏捷性与交互能力的仿人机器人行为迈出了重要一步。
Humanoid robots have recently achieved impressive progress in locomotion and whole-body control, yet they remain constrained in tasks that demand rapid interaction with dynamic environments through manipulation. Table tennis exemplifies such a challenge: with ball speeds exceeding 5 m/s, players must perceive, predict, and act within sub-second reaction times, requiring both agility and precision. To address this, we present a hierarchical framework for humanoid table tennis that integrates a model-based planner for ball trajectory prediction and racket target planning with a reinforcement learning-based whole-body controller. The planner determines striking position, velocity and timing, while the controller generates coordinated arm and leg motions that mimic human strikes and maintain stability and agility across consecutive rallies. Moreover, to encourage natural movements, human motion references are incorporated during training. We validate our system on a general-purpose humanoid robot, achieving up to 106 consecutive shots with a human opponent and sustained exchanges against another humanoid. These results demonstrate real-world humanoid table tennis with sub-second reactive control, marking a step toward agile and interactive humanoid behaviors.
61. BeyondMimic: From Motion Tracking to Versatile Humanoid Control via Guided Diffusion
BeyondMimic：从运动跟踪到通用仿人机器人控制 —— 基于引导扩散模型的方法
从人类运动中学习技能，为构建具备通用性的仿人机器人全身控制策略提供了极具潜力的方向，但目前仍存在两个关键瓶颈：（1）缺乏高质量运动跟踪框架，难以将大规模运动学参考数据（人类运动数据）可靠转化为真实硬件上鲁棒且高动态的机器人运动；（2）缺乏有效的蒸馏方法，无法高效学习这些运动基元（基础运动单元）并将其组合以解决下游任务。
为填补这些空白，本文提出BeyondMimic 框架—— 这是一套面向真实场景的技术框架，通过引导扩散模型（guided diffusion）从人类运动中学习，实现仿人机器人的通用化、自然化全身控制。
该框架的核心功能包括：
1、高性能运动跟踪流水线：能够实现跳跃旋转、冲刺、侧手翻等挑战性技能的跟踪，且运动质量达到当前最优水平，可将人类高动态运动精准复现到机器人上；
2、突破单纯模仿局限的扩散策略：提出统一的扩散策略（diffusion policy），无需针对特定任务预先训练（即 “零样本”，zero-shot），在测试阶段仅通过简单成本函数即可实现任务专属控制。
在硬件部署中，BeyondMimic 在测试阶段完成了多样化任务，包括路径点导航、操纵杆遥操作、避障等。该框架成功连接了 “仿真到实物” 的运动跟踪与人类运动基元的灵活合成，为仿人机器人全身控制提供了一体化解决方案。
Learning skills from human motions offers a promising path toward generalizable policies for versatile humanoid whole-body control, yet two key cornerstones are missing: (1) a high-quality motion tracking framework that faithfully transforms large-scale kinematic references into robust and extremely dynamic motions on real hardware, and (2) a distillation approach that can effectively learn these motion primitives and compose them to solve downstream tasks. We address these gaps with BeyondMimic, a real-world framework to learn from human motions for versatile and naturalistic humanoid control via guided diffusion. Our framework provides a motion tracking pipeline capable of challenging skills such as jumping spins, sprinting, and cartwheels with state-of-the-art motion quality. Moving beyond simply mimicking existing motions, we further introduce a unified diffusion policy that enables zero-shot task-specific control at test time using simple cost functions. Deployed on hardware, BeyondMimic performs diverse tasks at test time, including waypoint navigation, joystick teleoperation, and obstacle avoidance, bridging sim-to-real motion tracking and flexible synthesis of human motion primitives for whole-body control.
62. MoRE: Mixture of Residual Experts for Humanoid Lifelike Gaits Learning on Complex Terrains
MoRE：用于复杂地形上类人逼真步态学习的残差专家混合模型
类人机器人已通过基于强化学习（RL）的方法展现出强大的移动能力。此外，为了获得类似人类的行为，现有方法将人体运动跟踪或运动先验整合到强化学习框架中。然而，这些方法仅局限于使用本体感受的平坦地形，限制了它们以类似人类的步态穿越具有挑战性地形的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架使用具有多个判别器的潜在残差专家混合模型来训练强化学习策略，该策略能够利用外部感受以可控的逼真步态穿越复杂地形。我们的两阶段训练流程首先使用深度相机教导策略穿越复杂地形，然后实现类似人类步态模式之间的步态命令切换。我们还设计了步态奖励来调整类似人类的行为，如机器人基座高度。仿真和实际实验表明，我们的框架在穿越复杂地形时表现出卓越的性能，并在多种类似人类的步态模式之间实现了无缝过渡。
Humanoid robots have demonstrated robust locomotion capabilities using Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based approaches. Further, to obtain human-like behaviors, existing methods integrate human motion-tracking or motion prior in the RL framework. However, these methods are limited in flat terrains with proprioception only, restricting their abilities to traverse challenging terrains with human-like gaits. In this work, we propose a novel framework using a mixture of latent residual experts with multi-discriminators to train an RL policy, which is capable of traversing complex terrains in controllable lifelike gaits with exteroception. Our two-stage training pipeline first teaches the policy to traverse complex terrains using a depth camera, and then enables gait-commanded switching between human-like gait patterns. We also design gait rewards to adjust human-like behaviors like robot base height. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that our framework exhibits exceptional performance in traversing complex terrains, and achieves seamless transitions between multiple human-like gait patterns.
63.UniTracker: Learning Universal Whole-Body Motion Tracker for Humanoid Robots
UniTracker：面向仿人机器人的通用全身运动跟踪器学习
实现具有表现力与泛化性的全身运动控制，是仿人机器人在真实环境中部署的核心前提。本文提出UniTracker 框架—— 这是一套三阶段训练框架，能够对各类人类行为实现鲁棒且可扩展的运动跟踪。
UniTracker 的三阶段训练流程具体如下：
第一阶段（教师策略训练）：利用特权观测（privileged observations，指训练阶段可获取、但部署阶段无法获取的完整环境 / 状态信息，如全局运动数据）训练教师策略，使其能够生成高质量动作，为后续学生策略提供可靠参考；
第二阶段（通用学生策略建模）：引入条件变分自编码器（CVAE）构建可直接部署于真实硬件的通用学生策略。CVAE 结构使策略能够学习运动的全局 latent 表示（潜在特征），一方面提升对 “未见过的行为”（unseen behaviors）的泛化能力，另一方面解决传统基于多层感知器（MLP）的策略在 “部分观测”（partial observations，指部署阶段仅能获取的局部状态信息）下的性能局限。与易在 “姿态朝向” 等全局属性上出现漂移的纯 MLP 策略不同，本文的 CVAE 学生策略通过 “将部分观测先验与完整观测编码器对齐”，在训练过程中融入全局意图，有效避免全局属性漂移；
第三阶段（快速适配模块训练）：引入快速适配模块，针对 “难以直接跟踪的复杂运动序列” 对通用策略进行微调。该适配模块支持两种模式：单序列适配与批量适配，充分体现了方法的灵活性与可扩展性。
研究人员在仿真环境与真实场景中，基于宇树 G1 仿人机器人对 UniTracker 进行了评估。结果表明，该框架在运动多样性、跟踪精度与部署鲁棒性三方面均展现出优异性能。
Achieving expressive and generalizable whole-body motion control is essential for deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments. In this work, we propose UniTracker, a three-stage training framework that enables robust and scalable motion tracking across a wide range of human behaviors. In the first stage, we train a teacher policy with privileged observations to generate high-quality actions. In the second stage, we introduce a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) to model a universal student policy that can be deployed directly on real hardware. The CVAE structure allows the policy to learn a global latent representation of motion, enhancing generalization to unseen behaviors and addressing the limitations of standard MLP-based policies under partial observations. Unlike pure MLPs that suffer from drift in global attributes like orientation, our CVAE-student policy incorporates global intent during training by aligning a partial-observation prior to the full-observation encoder. In the third stage, we introduce a fast adaptation module that fine-tunes the universal policy on harder motion sequences that are difficult to track directly. This adaptation can be performed both for single sequences and in batch mode, further showcasing the flexibility and scalability of our approach. We evaluate UniTracker in both simulation and real-world settings using a Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating strong performance in motion diversity, tracking accuracy, and deployment robustness.
64. CHILD (Controller for Humanoid Imitation and Live Demonstration): a Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation System
CHILD（仿人机器人模仿与实时演示控制器）：一套仿人机器人全身遥操作系统
近年来，遥操作技术已取得显著进展，能够让机器人完成复杂的操作任务。然而，现有研究成果很少支持对仿人机器人进行全身关节级遥操作—— 这一局限导致机器人可完成的任务类型受限。
本文提出CHILD（Controller for Humanoid Imitation and Live Demonstration，仿人机器人模仿与实时演示控制器），这是一套紧凑且可重构的遥操作系统，可实现对仿人机器人的关节级控制。CHILD 系统可集成于标准婴儿背带中，使操作者能够控制机器人的四肢；同时支持两种核心控制模式：一是用于全身控制的直接关节映射，二是用于移动 - 操作复合任务（loco-manipulation）的控制。
为提升操作者体验并防止机器人出现不安全的关节运动，系统还融入了自适应力反馈功能。研究人员通过在一台仿人机器人与多台双臂机器人上开展 “移动 - 操作任务” 及 “全身控制” 示例实验，验证了该系统的功能有效性。最后，研究团队将该系统的硬件设计开源，以提升技术的可获取性与实验可复现性。
Recent advances in teleoperation have demonstrated robots performing complex manipulation tasks. However, existing works rarely support whole-body joint-level teleoperation for humanoid robots, limiting the diversity of tasks that can be accomplished. This work presents Controller for Humanoid Imitation and Live Demonstration (CHILD), a compact reconfigurable teleoperation system that enables joint level control over humanoid robots. CHILD fits within a standard baby carrier, allowing the operator control over all four limbs, and supports both direct joint mapping for full-body control and loco-manipulation. Adaptive force feedback is incorporated to enhance operator experience and prevent unsafe joint movements. We validate the capabilities of this system by conducting loco-manipulation and full-body control examples on a humanoid robot and multiple dual-arm systems. Lastly, we open-source the design of the hardware promoting accessibility and reproducibility.
65. RL from Physical Feedback: Aligning Large Motion Models with Humanoid Control
基于物理反馈的强化学习：实现大型运动模型与仿人机器人控制的对齐
本文聚焦机器人领域的一项关键挑战：将文本驱动生成的人类运动转化为仿人机器人可执行的动作，从而实现新行为的高效、低成本学习。现有文本 - 运动生成方法虽能实现语言与运动的语义对齐，但往往会生成运动学或物理上不可行的动作，无法适用于真实场景部署。
为弥合这一 “仿真到实物” 的差距，本文提出基于物理反馈的强化学习（RLPF）—— 这是一种新型框架，将 “物理感知运动评估” 与 “文本条件运动生成” 相融合。RLPF 的核心设计如下：
运动跟踪策略：在物理仿真环境中评估生成运动的可行性，通过生成奖励信号微调运动生成器，确保生成动作符合物理规律；
对齐验证模块：引入该模块以保留文本指令的语义真实性，避免因优化物理可行性而偏离原始文本意图。
这种联合优化机制可同时保证生成动作的物理合理性与指令对齐性。大量实验表明，RLPF 在生成物理可行运动方面显著优于基准方法，同时能维持与文本指令的语义对应关系，最终实现了在真实仿人机器人上的成功部署。
This paper focuses on a critical challenge in robotics: translating text-driven human motions into executable actions for humanoid robots, enabling efficient and cost-effective learning of new behaviors. While existing text-to-motion generation methods achieve semantic alignment between language and motion, they often produce kinematically or physically infeasible motions unsuitable for real-world deployment. To bridge this sim-to-real gap, we propose Reinforcement Learning from Physical Feedback (RLPF), a novel framework that integrates physics-aware motion evaluation with text-conditioned motion generation. RLPF employs a motion tracking policy to assess feasibility in a physics simulator, generating rewards for fine-tuning the motion generator. Furthermore, RLPF introduces an alignment verification module to preserve semantic fidelity to text instructions. This joint optimization ensures both physical plausibility and instruction alignment. Extensive experiments show that RLPF greatly outperforms baseline methods in generating physically feasible motions while maintaining semantic correspondence with text instruction, enabling successful deployment on real humanoid robots.
66.RobotDancing: Residual-Action Reinforcement Learning Enables Robust Long-Horizon Humanoid Motion Tracking
RobotDancing：残差动作强化学习实现稳健的长视界人形运动追踪
类人机器人的长视界高动态运动追踪仍然脆弱，因为绝对关节指令无法补偿模型与目标的不匹配，从而导致误差累积。
为此，来自慕尼黑工业大学和北京人工智能研究院以及清华大学和南京大学的学者们提出了 RobotDancing，这是一个简单、可扩展的框架，可以预测残差关节目标，从而明确纠正动态差异。该流程是端到端的——包括训练、模拟到模拟验证和零样本模拟到真实——并使用单阶段强化学习 (RL) 设置，并采用统一的观察、奖励和超参数配置。学者们主要在 Unitree G1 上进行评估，其中包含重新定位的 LAFAN1 舞蹈序列，并在 H1/H1-2 上验证迁移。RobotDancing 可以追踪持续数分钟的高能量行为（跳跃、旋转、侧手翻），并将零样本部署到具有高质量运动追踪的硬件上。
Tracking long-field, high-dynamic motion in humanoid robots remains fragile because absolute joint commands cannot compensate for model-target mismatches, leading to error accumulation.
To this end, researchers from the Technical University of Munich and the Beijing Institute of Artificial Intelligence, along with Tsinghua University and Nanjing University, proposed RobotDancing, a simple, scalable framework that predicts residual joint targets to explicitly correct for dynamic discrepancies. The pipeline is end-to-end—including training, simulation-to-simulation validation, and zero-shot simulation-to-real—and uses a single-stage reinforcement learning (RL) setting with unified observation, reward, and hyperparameter configurations. The researchers primarily evaluate on Unitree G1, which contains relocalized LAFAN1 dance sequences, and validate transfer on H1/H1-2. RobotDancing can track high-energy behaviors (jumps, spins, cartwheels) lasting for minutes and enables zero-shot deployment on hardware with high-quality motion tracking.
67.RuN: Residual Policy for Natural Humanoid Locomotion
RuN：自然人形运动的残差策略
要使人形机器人能够在各种速度范围内实现自然、动态的运动（包括从步行到跑步的平滑过渡）是一项重大挑战。现有的深度强化学习方法通常要求策略直接跟踪参考运动，从而迫使单个策略同时学习运动模仿、速度跟踪和稳定性维护。
为了解决这个问题，来自浙江大学和中国机械装备研究发展研究院的学者们提出了一种新颖的解耦残差学习框架 RuN。
RuN 通过将预训练的条件运动生成器（提供运动学上自然的运动先验）与强化学习策略配对来分解控制任务，该策略学习轻量级残差校正以处理动态相互作用。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的模拟和实际实验表明，RuN 在较宽的速度范围（0-2.5 米/秒）内实现了稳定、自然的步态和平滑的步行-跑步过渡，在训练效率和最终性能方面均优于最先进的方法。
The required puppet equipment human ability exists in each type of speed, the actual nature, and the dynamic movement (comprehensive movement to smooth movement) is a serious challenge. Currently, the depth and strength of chemical learning methods are usually required, the strategy is direct and the reference movement is direct.

In Unitree G1 puppet machine human progress model Japanese practice, RuN in the speed range (0-2.5 US/Second) The internal reality is decided, the natural walking is smooth, the walking is smooth, the efficiency is the most advanced, and the final performance is uniform.
68.RoMoCo: Robotic Motion Control Toolbox for Reduced-Order Model-Based Locomotion on Bipedal and Humanoid Robots
RoMoCo：用于双足机器人和人形机器人降阶模型运动的机器人运动控制工具箱
来自加州理工的学者们推出了 RoMoCo，这是一个开源 C++ 工具箱，用于综合和评估基于降阶模型的双足和人形机器人规划器和全身控制器。
RoMoCo 的模块化架构将最先进的规划器和全身运动控制器统一在一个一致的 API 下，从而实现快速原型设计和可重复的基准测试。通过利用降阶模型进行平台无关的步态生成，RoMoCo 能够跨各种机器人灵活地设计控制器。
学者们通过在 Cassie、Unitree H1 和 G1 机器人上进行大量仿真，展示了其多功能性和性能，并通过在 Cassie 和 G1 人形机器人上进行的硬件实验验证了其在现实世界中的有效性。
Researchers from Caltech have introduced RoMoCo, an open-source C++ toolbox for synthesizing and evaluating reduced-order model-based planners and whole-body controllers for bipedal and humanoid robots.
RoMoCo's modular architecture unifies state-of-the-art planners and whole-body motion controllers under a consistent API, enabling rapid prototyping and reproducible benchmarking. By leveraging reduced-order models for platform-independent gait generation, RoMoCo enables flexible controller design across a wide range of robots.
The researchers demonstrated its versatility and performance through extensive simulations on the Cassie, Unitree H1, and G1 robots, and verified its real-world effectiveness through hardware experiments on the Cassie and G1 humanoid robots.
69.HDMI: Learning Interactive Humanoid Whole-Body Control from Human Videos
HDMI：学习交互式人形机器人通过人体视频实现全身控制
由于运动数据稀缺且接触频繁，实现稳健的全身人形机器人与物体交互 (HOI) 仍然具有挑战性。
来自卡内基梅隆大学的学者门提出了 HDMI（HumanoiD iMitation for Interaction），这是一个简单通用的框架，可直接从单目 RGB 视频中学习全身人形机器人与物体交互技能。学者们从不受约束的视频中提取并重新定位人和物体的轨迹，以构建结构化运动数据集；训练强化学习 (RL) 策略，通过三个关键设计共同跟踪机器人和物体的状态：统一的物体表征、残差动作空间和通用交互奖励；以及在真实的人形机器人上进行零样本部署 RL 策略。
同时，学者们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的大量模拟到真实实验证明了他们方法的稳健性和通用性：HDMI 实现了 67 次连续的门遍历，并在现实世界中成功执行了 6 个不同的位置操作任务，在模拟中成功执行了 14 个任务。这个研究结果将 HDMI 确立为一个从人类视频中获取交互式人形技能的简单通用框架。
Due to the scarcity of motion data and frequent contact, achieving robust full-body humanoid robot-object interaction (HOI) remains challenging.
Researchers from Carnegie Mellon University proposed HDMI (Humanoid Imitation for Interaction), a simple and general framework for learning full-body humanoid robot-object interaction skills directly from monocular RGB videos. They extracted and relocalized human and object trajectories from unconstrained videos to construct a structured motion dataset. They trained a reinforcement learning (RL) policy to jointly track the robot and object states through three key designs: a unified object representation, a residual action space, and a universal interaction reward. Finally, they performed zero-shot deployment of the RL policy on a real humanoid robot.
Extensive simulation-to-real experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot demonstrated the robustness and generalizability of their approach: HDMI achieved 67 consecutive gate traversals and successfully executed six different position manipulation tasks in the real world and 14 tasks in simulation. This finding establishes HDMI as a simple and general framework for acquiring interactive humanoid skills from human videos.
70.DreamControl: Human-Inspired Whole-Body Humanoid Control for Scene Interaction via Guided Diffusion
DreamControl：受人类启发的全身类人控制，通过引导扩散实现场景交互
来自加州大学伯克利分校和布朗大学的学者们推出了 DreamControl，这是一种用于学习自主全身类人技能的全新方法。
DreamControl 充分利用了扩散模型和强化学习 (RL) 的优势，学者们的核心创新在于使用基于人体运动数据训练的扩散先验，然后引导模拟中的强化学习策略完成感兴趣的特定任务（例如，打开抽屉或拿起一个物体）。学者们证明了这种基于人体运动的先验能够使强化学习发现直接强化学习无法实现的解决方案，并且扩散模型本身能够促进自然的运动，从而有助于从模拟到现实的迁移。他们验证了 DreamControl 在 Unitree G1 机器人上执行一系列具有挑战性的任务的有效性，这些任务包括同时进行上下肢控制和物体交互。
Researchers from the University of California, Berkeley, and Brown University have introduced DreamControl, a novel approach for learning autonomous, full-body humanlike skills.
DreamControl leverages the strengths of diffusion models and reinforcement learning (RL). Their core innovation lies in using a diffusion prior trained on human motion data to guide a reinforcement learning policy in simulation to achieve a specific task of interest (e.g., opening a drawer or picking up an object). They demonstrate that this human motion prior enables reinforcement learning to discover solutions that are inaccessible to direct reinforcement learning, and that the diffusion model itself promotes natural movements, facilitating transfer from simulation to reality. They demonstrated the effectiveness of DreamControl on a Unitree G1 robot performing a series of challenging tasks, including simultaneous upper and lower limb control and object interaction.
71.Cybersecurity AI: Humanoid Robots as Attack Vectors
网络安全人工智能：人形机器人作为攻击媒介
学者们对 Unitree G1 人形机器人进行了系统的安全评估，表明它同时充当隐蔽监视节点和主动网络操作平台。初始访问可以通过利用 BLE 配置协议实现，该协议包含一个关键的命令注入漏洞，允许通过畸形的 Wi-Fi 凭据进行 root 访问，可使用所有单元共享的硬编码 AES 密钥进行利用。
通过对 Unitree 专有的 FMX 加密进行部分逆向工程，学者们发现了一个静态的 Blowfish-ECB 层和一个可预测的 LCG 掩码启用检查，可以检查系统原本复杂的安全架构，这是他们在商业机器人领域观察到的最成熟的安全架构。
这两个实证案例研究揭示了这种人形机器人的关键风险：(a) 该机器人充当特洛伊木马，每 300 秒不断将多模式传感器和服务状态遥测数据泄露到 43.175.228.18:17883 和 43.175.229.18:17883，而无需操作员通知，违反了 GDPR 第 6 条和第 13 条； (b) 驻留网络安全人工智能 (CAI) 代理可以从侦察转向针对任何目标（例如制造商的云控制平面）的进攻准备，展现出从被动监控到主动反制的升级能力。这些发现为人形机器人进入关键基础设施提供了基于自适应 CAI 的防御机制，为塑造物理-网络融合系统的未来安全标准提供了必要的实证证据。
Academics conducted a systematic security assessment of the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, demonstrating that it functions as both a covert surveillance node and an active network operations platform. Initial access can be achieved by exploiting the BLE configuration protocol, which contains a critical command injection vulnerability that allows root access via malformed Wi-Fi credentials, exploitable using a hardcoded AES key shared by all units.
By partially reverse engineering Unitree's proprietary FMX encryption, the academics discovered a static Blowfish-ECB layer and a predictable LCG mask enablement check, allowing them to examine the system's otherwise complex security architecture—the most sophisticated they observed in the commercial robotics sector. These two empirical case studies reveal key risks of this humanoid robot: (a) the robot acts as a Trojan horse, continuously exfiltrating multimodal sensor and service status telemetry data to 43.175.228.18:17883 and 43.175.229.18:17883 every 300 seconds without operator notification, violating Articles 6 and 13 of the GDPR; and (b) the resident Cybersecurity Artificial Intelligence (CAI) agent can shift from reconnaissance to offensive preparation against any target, such as a manufacturer's cloud control plane, demonstrating scalability from passive monitoring to active countermeasures. These findings provide an adaptive CAI-based defense mechanism against humanoid robots entering critical infrastructure, providing essential empirical evidence to shape future security standards for converged physical-cyber systems.
72.The Cybersecurity of a Humanoid Robot
人形机器人的网络安全
人形机器人技术的快速发展带来了前所未有的网络安全挑战，而现有的理论框架未能充分应对这些挑战。本报告对一个量产人形机器人平台进行了全面的安全评估，旨在弥合抽象安全模型与操作漏洞之间的差距。通过系统的静态分析、运行时观察和密码学检查，学者们发现了一个复杂的安全格局，其特点是既有复杂的防御机制，又存在严重的漏洞。
这一研究结果揭示了一个双层专有加密系统（称为“FMX”），虽然设计创新，但却存在一些根本性的实现缺陷，包括使用静态加密密钥，从而导致离线配置解密。更重要的是，学者们记录了持续的遥测连接，这些连接在未经用户明确同意或通知机制的情况下，将详细的机器人状态信息（包括音频、视频、空间和执行器数据）传输到外部服务器。这些发现验证了关于跨层漏洞传播的理论预测，同时也揭示了仅通过建模无法预测的、特定于实现的漏洞。
评估表明，尽管当前的人形机器人平台采用了纵深防御原则和分层服务架构，但仍然容易受到传统网络攻击和新型机器人特定攻击向量的攻击。除了记录被动监控风险外，学者们还在Unitree G1上部署了一个网络安全AI代理，用于映射和准备利用其制造商的云基础设施，并展示了受攻击的人形机器人如何从秘密数据收集升级到主动反攻行动。保护人形机器人的安全需要实现范式转变，转向能够适应物理-网络融合独特挑战的网络安全AI (CAI) 框架。这项工作提供了实证证据，对于在人形机器人从研究好奇心向关键领域操作系统转型的过程中制定强大的安全标准至关重要。
The rapid development of humanoid robotics technology presents unprecedented cybersecurity challenges, which existing theoretical frameworks have failed to adequately address. This report presents a comprehensive security assessment of a production humanoid robot platform, aiming to bridge the gap between abstract security models and operational vulnerabilities. Through systematic static analysis, runtime observations, and cryptographic examinations, researchers uncover a complex security landscape characterized by both sophisticated defenses and severe vulnerabilities.
The findings reveal a two-layered proprietary encryption system (called "FMX") that, while innovative in design, suffers from fundamental implementation flaws, including the use of static encryption keys that allow offline configuration decryption. Importantly, researchers documented persistent telemetry connections that transmit detailed robot state information (including audio, video, spatial, and actuator data) to external servers without explicit user consent or notification mechanisms. These findings validate theoretical predictions regarding cross-layer vulnerability propagation while also revealing implementation-specific vulnerabilities that could not be predicted through modeling alone.
The assessment demonstrates that despite employing defense-in-depth principles and a layered service architecture, current humanoid robot platforms remain vulnerable to both traditional cyberattacks and novel robot-specific attack vectors. In addition to documenting the risks of passive surveillance, the scholars deployed a cybersecurity AI agent on the Unitree G1 to map and prepare for exploitation of its manufacturer's cloud infrastructure, demonstrating how a compromised humanoid robot can escalate from covert data collection to active counter-offensive actions. Securing humanoid robots requires a paradigm shift toward a cybersecurity AI (CAI) framework that adapts to the unique challenges of physical-cyber convergence. This work provides empirical evidence that is crucial for developing robust security standards as humanoid robots transition from research curiosities to critical field-operating systems.
73.PhysicalAgent: Towards General Cognitive Robotics with Foundation World Models
PhysicalAgent：基于基础世界模型的通用认知机器人
来自斯科尔科沃智能机器人实验室的学者们引入了 PhysicalAgent，这是一个用于机器人操作的代理框架，它集成了迭代推理、基于扩散的视频生成和闭环执行。
给定文本指令，这个方法会生成候选轨迹的简短视频演示，在机器人上执行这些轨迹，并针对故障以迭代方式重新规划。这种方法能够实现从执行错误中稳健地恢复。
学者们评估了 PhysicalAgent 在多种感知模态（自我中心、第三人称和模拟）和机器人实例（双手 UR3、Unitree G1 人形机器人和模拟 GR1）中的性能，并与最先进的特定任务基准进行了比较。实验表明，学者们的方法始终优于先前的方法，在人类熟悉的任务中成功率高达 83%。物理试验表明，首次尝试的成功率有限（20-30%），但迭代校正可将跨平台的总体成功率提高到 80%。这些结果凸显了基于视频的生成推理在通用机器人操作中的潜力，并强调了迭代执行对于从初始故障中恢复的重要性。学者们的框架为可扩展、适应性强且鲁棒的机器人控制铺平了道路。
Researchers from the Skolkovo Intelligent Robotics Laboratory introduced PhysicalAgent, an agent framework for robotic manipulation that integrates iterative reasoning, diffusion-based video generation, and closed-loop execution.
Given textual instructions, this approach generates short video demonstrations of candidate trajectories, executes these trajectories on a robot, and iteratively replans for failures. This approach robustly recovers from execution errors.
The researchers evaluated the performance of PhysicalAgent across multiple perception modalities (egocentric, third-person, and simulated) and robot instances (the two-handed UR3, the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and the simulated GR1), comparing it to state-of-the-art task-specific benchmarks. Experiments demonstrate that their approach consistently outperforms previous methods, achieving a success rate of up to 83% on tasks familiar to humans. Physical experiments revealed limited success on first attempts (20-30%), but iterative corrections increased the overall success rate to 80% across platforms. These results highlight the potential of video-based generative reasoning for general robotic manipulation and emphasize the importance of iterative execution for recovering from initial failures. The scholars' framework paves the way for scalable, adaptable, and robust robot control.
74.Track Any Motions under Any Disturbances
追踪任何干扰下的任何运动
基础的人形运动追踪器需要能够追踪多样化、高度动态且接触丰富的运动。更重要的是，为了实现通用性，它需要在现实世界场景中稳定运行，以应对各种动态干扰，包括地形、外力和物理属性变化。
为了实现这一目标，来自清华大学，北京大学，Galbot和上海启智研究所的学者们提出了 Any2Track（Track Any motions under Any disturbs），这是一个两阶段强化学习框架，用于追踪现实世界中多种干扰下的各种运动。
Any2Track 将动态自适应能力重新定义为基本动作执行之上的附加能力，并包含两个关键组件：AnyTracker 和 AnyAdapter。AnyTrack 是一个通用的运动追踪器，经过一系列精心设计，可在单一策略内追踪各种运动。AnyAdapter 是一个基于历史的自适应模块，赋予追踪器在线动态自适应能力，以克服 sim2real 之间的差距和多种现实世界干扰。学者们在 Unitree G1 上部署了 Any2Track，并以零样本方式成功实现了 sim2real 迁移。 Any2Track 在现实世界的多种干扰下跟踪各种运动方面表现出色。
Basic humanoid motion trackers must be able to track diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions. More importantly, to achieve generalizability, they must operate stably in real-world scenarios and cope with various dynamic disturbances, including terrain, external forces, and physical property variations.
To achieve this goal, researchers from Tsinghua University, Peking University, Galbot, and the Shanghai Institute for Advanced Study proposed Any2Track (Track Any Motions Under Any Disturbs), a two-stage reinforcement learning framework for tracking diverse motions under diverse real-world disturbances.
Any2Track redefines dynamic adaptability as an additional capability beyond basic motion execution and consists of two key components: AnyTracker and AnyAdapter. AnyTrack is a general motion tracker that, through a series of careful design steps, can track a wide range of motions within a single policy. AnyAdapter is a history-based adaptation module that empowers the tracker with online dynamic adaptability to overcome the gap between sim2real and real-world disturbances. The researchers deployed Any2Track on Unitree G1 and successfully achieved zero-shot sim2real transfer. Any2Track excels at tracking a wide range of motion in the presence of multiple real-world interferences.
75.FSR-VLN: Fast and Slow Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation with Hierarchical Multi-modal Scene Graph
FSR-VLN：基于分层多模态场景图的视觉语言导航快速和慢速推理
视觉语言导航 (VLN) 是机器人系统面临的一项基本挑战，在现实世界环境中部署具身智能体方面有着广泛的应用。尽管近年来取得了一些进展，但现有方法在长距离空间推理方面仍存在局限性，尤其是在长距离导航任务中，通常表现出较低的成功率和较高的推理延迟，
为了突破这些限制，来自地平线机器人的学者们提出了 FSR-VLN，这是一个视觉语言导航系统，它将分层多模态场景图 (HMSG) 与快到慢导航推理 (FSR) 相结合。HMSG 提供了一种多模态地图表征，支持渐进式检索，从粗略的房间级定位到细粒度的目标视图和物体识别。基于 HMSG，FSR 首先进行快速匹配以高效地选择候选房间、视图和物体，然后应用 VLM 驱动的细化方法进行最终目标选择。
学者们在人形机器人收集的四个综合室内数据集上评估了 FSR-VLN，使用了 87 条涵盖各种物体类别的指令。 FSR-VLN 在所有数据集上均达到了最佳 (SOTA) 性能（以检索成功率 (RSR) 衡量），同时通过仅在快速直觉失效时激活慢速推理，与基于 VLM 的方法相比，在旅游视频上的响应时间缩短了 82%。此外，学者们将 FSR-VLN 与 Unitree-G1 人形机器人上的语音交互、规划和控制模块集成，实现了自然语言交互和实时导航。
Vision-language navigation (VLN) is a fundamental challenge for robotic systems, with widespread applications in deploying embodied agents in real-world environments. Despite recent progress, existing methods still have limitations in long-range spatial reasoning, particularly in long-distance navigation tasks, often exhibiting low success rates and high inference latency.
To overcome these limitations, researchers from Horizon Robotics proposed FSR-VLN, a vision-language navigation system that combines a hierarchical multimodal scene graph (HMSG) with fast-to-slow navigation reasoning (FSR). HMSG provides a multimodal map representation that supports progressive retrieval, from coarse room-level localization to fine-grained target view and object recognition. Based on HMSG, FSR first performs fast matching to efficiently select candidate rooms, views, and objects, and then applies a VLM-driven refinement method for final target selection.
The researchers evaluated FSR-VLN on four comprehensive indoor datasets collected for humanoid robots, using 87 instructions covering a wide range of object categories. FSR-VLN achieves state-of-the-art performance (measured by retrieval success rate (RSR)) on all datasets, while also reducing response time by 82% on travel videos compared to VLM-based methods by activating slow reasoning only when fast intuition fails. Furthermore, the researchers integrated FSR-VLN with the voice interaction, planning, and control modules of the Unitree-G1 humanoid robot, enabling natural language interaction and real-time navigation.
76.TrajBooster: Boosting Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation via Trajectory-Centric Learning
TrajBooster：通过以轨迹为中心的学习促进人形机器人全身操控
“视觉-语言-动作”模型展现出跨具体化演绎的潜力，但在高质量演示稀缺的情况下，难以快速与新机器人的动作空间匹配，尤其是对于双足类人机器人而言。
来自浙江大学，西湖大学以及上海交通大学的学者们提出了 TrajBooster，这是一个跨具体化演绎的框架，它利用丰富的轮式类人机器人数据来提升双足类人机器人的 VLA 性能。学者们的核心理念是将末端执行器轨迹用作与形态无关的接口。
TrajBooster  从现实世界的轮式人形机器人中提取 6D 双臂末端执行器轨迹； 在模拟中将它们重新定位到 Unitree G1，并使用通过启发式增强型协调在线 DAgger 训练的全身控制器，将低维轨迹参考提升为可行的高维全身动作；形成异构三元组，将源视觉/语言与目标人形机器人兼容的动作耦合，对 VLA 进行预训练，之后仅需 10 分钟即可在目标人形机器人领域进行远程操作数据收集。学者们的策略部署在 Unitree G1 上，实现了超越桌面的家务任务，支持下蹲、跨高度操作和协调的全身运动，并显著提高了鲁棒性和泛化能力。结果表明，TrajBooster 能够利用现有的轮式类人机器人数据有效增强双足类人机器人 VLA 性能，减少对成本高昂的同体化数据的依赖，同时增强动作空间理解和零样本技能迁移能力。
Vision-language-action models show promise for cross-embodiment interpretation, but struggle to quickly adapt to the motion space of new robots, particularly bipedal humanoids, when high-quality demonstrations are scarce.
Researchers from Zhejiang University, Westlake University, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University proposed TrajBooster, a cross-embodiment interpretation framework that leverages abundant wheeled humanoid data to improve the performance of VLAs for bipedal humanoids. Their core concept is to use end-effector trajectories as a morphology-independent interface.
TrajBooster extracts 6D dual-arm end-effector trajectories from real-world wheeled humanoids; relocalizes them to Unitree G1 in simulation; and uses a full-body controller trained via heuristically enhanced coordinated online DAgger to boost low-dimensional trajectory references into feasible high-dimensional full-body motions. Furthermore, they form heterogeneous triplets, coupling source vision/language with compatible motions for the target humanoid, to pre-train the VLA. This allows for teleoperation data collection in the target humanoid domain in just 10 minutes. The researchers' strategy, deployed on the Unitree G1, achieved household tasks beyond desktop capabilities, supporting squatting, height-crossing manipulation, and coordinated full-body movements, while significantly improving robustness and generalization. Results demonstrate that TrajBooster can effectively enhance the performance of bipedal humanoid VLAs by leveraging existing wheeled humanoid robot data, reducing reliance on costly homogenized data while enhancing action space understanding and zero-shot skill transfer capabilities.
77.Hierarchical Reduced-Order Model Predictive Control for Robust Locomotion on Humanoid Robots
人形机器人稳健运动的分层降阶模型预测控制
随着人形机器人进入现实世界，确保在不同环境中实现稳健的运动至关重要,来自加州理工大学的学者们提出了一种基于降阶模型的计算高效的人形机器人运动分层控制框架。该框架能够实现灵活的步进规划，并结合手臂和躯干动力学，从而更好地稳定行走。
在高层级，学者们利用 ALIP 模型的步进动力学，通过非线性模型预测控制 (MPC) 同时优化步长、步长和踝关节力矩。ALIP 轨迹被用作线性模型预测控制 (MPC) 框架的参考，该框架扩展了标准 SRB-MPC，并包含简化的手臂和躯干动力学。他们通过在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行仿真和硬件实验，验证了该方法的性能。在这个框架中，高级步进规划器以 40 Hz 运行，中级 MPC 使用板载微型 PC 以 500 Hz 运行。自适应步进计时将推起恢复成功率提高了 36%，而上肢控制则改善了偏航干扰抑制。学者们还展示了在各种室内和室外地形（包括草地、石板路面和不平坦的健身垫）上的稳健运动。
As humanoid robots enter the real world, ensuring robust motion in diverse environments is crucial. Researchers from California Institute of Technology (Caltech) have proposed a computationally efficient hierarchical control framework for humanoid robot motion based on reduced-order models. This framework enables flexible step planning and incorporates arm and torso dynamics for better walking stability.
At a high level, the researchers leveraged the stepping dynamics of the ALIP model to simultaneously optimize step length, step length, and ankle torque via nonlinear model predictive control (MPC). The ALIP trajectory was used as a reference for a linear MPC framework that extends the standard SRB-MPC and incorporates simplified arm and torso dynamics. The performance of this approach was validated through simulation and hardware experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. In this framework, the high-level step planner runs at 40 Hz, while the mid-level MPC runs at 500 Hz using an onboard micro PC. Adaptive step timing improves push-off recovery success by 36%, while upper limb control improves yaw disturbance rejection. The scholars also demonstrated robust movement on a variety of indoor and outdoor terrains, including grass, flagstone pavement, and uneven gym mats.
78.Traversing Narrow Paths: A Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust and Safe Humanoid Walking
穿越狭窄路径：实现稳健且安全的类人机器人行走的两阶段强化学习框架
对于类人机器人来说，在狭窄的道路上行走是一项挑战，因为狭窄的道路上需要稀疏且安全至关重要的立足点。纯粹基于模板或端到端强化学习的方法在如此恶劣的地形条件下难以奏效。
在本文中，来自中国科学技术大学的学者们提出了一个针对此类狭窄路径行走任务的两阶段训练框架，将基于模板的立足点规划器与第一阶段训练中的低级立足点追踪器以及第二阶段训练中的轻量级感知辅助立足点修改器相结合。通过跨阶段从平地到狭窄道路的课程设置，最终的控制器反过来学习稳健地追踪并安全地修改立足点目标，以确保在狭窄道路上精确定位。该框架保留了基于物理的模板的可解释性，并利用了强化学习的泛化能力，从而实现了轻松的模拟到现实的迁移。所学习到的策略在成功率、中心线遵循度和安全裕度方面均优于纯粹基于模板或基于强化学习的基线策略。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的验证显示，机器人在 20 次试验中成功穿越了 0.2 米宽、3 米长的横梁，没有出现任何故障。
Navigating narrow paths is challenging for humanoid robots, as they require sparse and safety-critical footholds. Purely template-based or end-to-end reinforcement learning approaches struggle to cope with such challenging terrain.
In this paper, researchers from the University of Science and Technology of China propose a two-stage training framework for such narrow path walking tasks, combining a template-based foothold planner with a low-level foothold tracker in the first training stage and a lightweight, perception-assisted foothold modifier in the second training stage. Through a multi-stage curriculum from flat land to narrow paths, the final controller in turn learns to robustly track and safely modify foothold targets to ensure accurate localization on narrow paths. This framework preserves the interpretability of physics-based templates and leverages the generalization capabilities of reinforcement learning, enabling easy simulation-to-real-world transfer. The learned policy outperforms purely template-based or reinforcement learning-based baselines in terms of success rate, centerline following, and safety margin. Validation on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot showed that the robot successfully crossed a 0.2-meter-wide and 3-meter-long beam in 20 trials without any failures.
79.Switch4EAI: Leveraging Console Game Platform for Benchmarking Robotic Athletics
Switch4EAI：利用控制台游戏平台对机器人运动进行基准测试
全身机器人控制领域的最新进展使得人形机器人和腿式机器人能够执行越来越敏捷、协调的动作。然而，用于评估机器人在现实环境中的运动表现并与人类进行直接比较的标准化基准仍然匮乏。
来自佐治亚理工的学者们提出了 Switch4EAI（Switch-for-Embodied-AI），这是一种低成本且易于部署的流程，它利用动作感应主机游戏来评估全身机器人的控制策略。以任天堂 Switch 上的《舞力全开》（Just Dance）为代表，学者们的系统可以捕捉、重建并重新定位游戏中的舞蹈动作，以供机器人执行。他们在配备开源全身控制器的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了该系统，为机器人与人类玩家的表现建立了量化基准。本文讨论了这些结果，证明了使用商业游戏平台作为物理基准的可行性，并启发了未来对具身人工智能进行基准测试的研究。
Recent advances in whole-body robotic control have enabled humanoid and legged robots to perform increasingly agile and coordinated movements. However, standardized benchmarks for evaluating robot locomotion performance in real-world environments and directly comparing it to humans remain lacking.
Scholars from Georgia Tech have proposed Switch4EAI (Switch-for-Embodied-AI), a low-cost and easily deployable process that leverages motion-sensing console games to evaluate control policies for whole-body robots. Using the game "Just Dance" on the Nintendo Switch as an example, their system can capture, reconstruct, and retarget dance moves from the game for robot execution. They validated the system on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot equipped with an open-source whole-body controller, establishing a quantitative benchmark for robot performance against human players. These results, discussed in this paper, demonstrate the feasibility of using commercial gaming platforms as physical benchmarks and inspire future research on benchmarking embodied AI.
80.Visual Imitation Enables Contextual Humanoid Control
视觉模仿实现情境人形控制
如何教会类人机器人利用周围环境情境爬楼梯和坐在椅子上？或许最简单的方法就是直接展示——随意捕捉一段人体运动视频，然后将其输入给类人机器人。
来自加州大学伯克利分校的学者们推出了 VIDEOMIMIC，这是一个从真实到模拟再到真实的流程，它挖掘日常视频，联合重建人类和环境，并为执行相应技能的类人机器人生成全身控制策略。学者们在真实的类人机器人上展示了该流程的成果，展示了稳健、可重复的情境控制，例如上下楼梯、在椅子和长凳上坐下和站立，以及其他动态全身技能——所有这些都基于一个策略，并以环境和全局根命令为条件。VIDEOMIMIC 提供了一种可扩展的途径，可以教会类人机器人在各种真实环境中进行操作。
How can you teach a humanoid robot to use the context of its environment to climb stairs and sit on a chair? Perhaps the simplest approach is to show it—capture a random video of a human in motion and feed it to the humanoid robot.
Researchers from the University of California, Berkeley, have introduced VIDEOMIMIC, a real-to-simulation-to-real pipeline that mines everyday videos, jointly reconstructs the human and the environment, and generates a full-body control policy for a humanoid robot to perform the corresponding skills. The researchers demonstrated the results of this pipeline on a real humanoid robot, demonstrating robust and repeatable contextual control of movements such as climbing stairs, sitting and standing on chairs and benches, and other dynamic full-body skills—all based on a single policy conditioned on the environment and a global root command. VIDEOMIMIC provides a scalable approach to teaching humanoid robots to operate in a variety of real-world environments.
81.Towards Adaptable Humanoid Control via Adaptive Motion Tracking
通过自适应运动追踪实现自适应人形机器人控制
人形机器人的设想是将演示的动作适应各种现实世界条件，同时精确地保留运动模式。现有的运动先验方法可以通过少量动作实现良好的适应性，但通常会牺牲模仿精度；而运动追踪方法虽然能够实现精确的模仿，但需要大量的训练动作和一个测试时的目标动作来适应。
为了结合它们的优势，来自上海人工智能实验室和上海交通大学的学者们引入了 AdaMimic，这是一种新颖的运动追踪算法，它能够通过单一参考动作实现自适应的人形机器人控制。为了在确保适应性的同时减少数据依赖，学者们的方法首先通过将单一参考动作稀疏化为关键帧，并在最少的物理假设下进行少量编辑来创建一个增强数据集。然后，通过追踪这些稀疏的关键帧来初始化策略，生成密集的中间动作，随后训练适配器根据调整后的跟踪速度并优化低级动作，从而实现灵活的时间规整，进一步提高模仿精度和适应性。学者们在模拟和现实世界的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，在多种适应条件下的多个任务中验证了他们方法的显著改进。
The goal of humanoid robots is to adapt demonstrated motions to various real-world conditions while accurately preserving movement patterns. Existing motion prior methods achieve good adaptability with a small number of motions, but often sacrifice imitation accuracy. Motion tracking methods, while capable of accurate imitation, require a large number of training motions and a single target motion at test time to adapt.
To combine their strengths, researchers from the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and Shanghai Jiao Tong University introduced AdaMimic, a novel motion tracking algorithm that enables adaptive humanoid robot control from a single reference motion. To ensure adaptability while reducing data dependency, their approach first creates an augmented dataset by sparsifying the single reference motion into keyframes and performing minor edits with minimal physical assumptions. They then initialize the policy by tracking these sparse keyframes, generating dense intermediate motions. Subsequently, an adapter is trained to achieve flexible temporal regularization based on the adjusted tracking speed and optimize low-level motions, further improving imitation accuracy and adaptability. Their approach demonstrates significant improvements across multiple tasks under various adaptation conditions, both in simulation and in the real world, on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
82.CBF-RL: Safety Filtering Reinforcement Learning in Training with Control Barrier Functions
CBF-RL：具有控制屏障功能的训练中的安全过滤强化学习
强化学习 (RL) 虽然功能强大且富有表现力，但往往会以牺牲安全性为代价来优先考虑性能。然而，在实际部署中，违反安全规定可能会导致灾难性的后果。控制屏障函数 (CBF) 提供了一种原则性的方法来强制执行动态安全性——传统上是通过安全过滤器在线部署的。虽然结果是安全的行为，但由于 RL 策略不了解 CBF，这可能会导致保守的行为。
在本文中，来自加州理工学院的学者们提出了 CBF-RL，这是一个通过在训练中强制执行 CBF 来使用 RL 生成安全行为的框架。CBF-RL 具有两个关键属性：(1) 对名义 RL 策略进行最小程度的修改，通过 CBF 项对安全约束进行编码；(2) 在训练中对策略部署进行安全过滤。
从理论上讲，学者们证明了连续时间安全过滤器可以通过离散时间部署的闭式表达式进行部署。在实践中，学者们证明了 CBF-RL 将安全约束内化到学习到的策略中——既强制执行更安全的操作，又偏向更安全的奖励——从而能够在无需在线安全过滤器的情况下实现安全部署。学者们通过导航任务和 Unitree G1 人形机器人的消融研究验证了他们的框架。其中，CBF-RL 能够实现更安全的探索、更快的收敛速度以及在不确定环境下的稳健性能，使人形机器人能够在现实世界中无需运行时安全过滤器即可安全避开障碍物并爬楼梯。
While powerful and expressive, reinforcement learning (RL) often prioritizes performance at the expense of safety. However, in real-world deployments, safety violations can have catastrophic consequences. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled approach to enforcing dynamic safety, traditionally deployed online via safety filters. While the result is safe behavior, it can lead to conservative behavior because the RL policy is unaware of the CBF.
In this paper, researchers from Caltech propose CBF-RL, a framework for generating safe behavior using RL by enforcing the CBF during training. CBF-RL has two key properties: (1) minimal modification of the nominal RL policy is required to encode safety constraints via the CBF term; and (2) safety filtering is applied to policy deployments during training.
Theoretically, we show that continuous-time safety filters can be deployed via closed-form expressions for discrete-time deployments. In practice, the researchers demonstrated that CBF-RL internalizes safety constraints into the learned policy—both enforcing safer actions and biasing safer rewards—enabling safe deployment without the need for an online safety filter. They validated their framework through a navigation task and ablation studies on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. CBF-RL achieves safer exploration, faster convergence, and robust performance in uncertain environments, enabling the humanoid robot to safely avoid obstacles and climb stairs in the real world without the need for a runtime safety filter.
83.Architecture Is All You Need: Diversity-Enabled Sweet Spots for Robust Humanoid Locomotion
架构就是你所需要的：实现稳健人形运动的多样性最佳点
如果想要在非结构化环境中实现稳健的人形运动，就需要能够在快速的低级稳定和较慢的感知决策之间取得平衡的架构。
在本文中，来自加州理工学院的学者们证明了一个简单的分层控制架构 (LCA)，即一个高速率运行的本体感受稳定器，结合一个紧凑的低速率感知策略，即使在使用最少的感知编码器的情况下，也能实现比单片端到端设计更稳健的性能。通过两阶段训练课程（先进行盲稳定器预训练，然后进行感知微调），学者们证明了分层策略在模拟和硬件方面均始终优于单阶段替代方案。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，学者们的方法在单阶段感知策略失效的楼梯和壁架任务中取得了成功。这些结果强调，时间尺度的架构分离，而非网络规模或复杂性，才是实现稳健感知调节运动的关键因素。
Achieving robust humanoid locomotion in unstructured environments requires architectures that balance fast low-level stabilization with slower perceptual decision-making.
In this paper, researchers from Caltech demonstrate that a simple hierarchical control architecture (LCA)—a high-rate proprioceptive stabilizer combined with a compact, low-rate perception policy—can achieve more robust performance than monolithic end-to-end designs, even with minimal perceptual encoders. Using a two-stage training process (blind stabilizer pre-training followed by perceptual fine-tuning), the researchers demonstrate that the hierarchical policy consistently outperforms single-stage alternatives in both simulation and hardware. On the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, their approach achieves success on stair and ledge climbing tasks, where single-stage perceptual policies fail. These results emphasize that architectural separation of timescales, rather than network size or complexity, is the key factor in achieving robust perceptually regulated locomotion.
84.ResMimic: From General Motion Tracking to Humanoid Whole-body Loco-Manipulation via Residual Learning
ResMimic：通过残差学习实现从一般运动追踪到人形全身局部操控
类人机器人全身操控有望为日常服务和仓库任务带来变革性的能力。虽然通用运动追踪 (GMT) 的最新进展使类人机器人能够重现各种人体运动，但这些策略缺乏操控所需的精度和物体感知能力。
为此，来自南加州大学,斯坦福大学,加州大学伯克利分校以及卡内基梅隆大学的学者们引入了 ResMimic，这是一个两阶段残差学习框架，用于基于人体运动数据进行精准且富有表现力的类人机器人控制。首先，基于大规模纯人体运动训练的 GMT 策略，作为生成类人全身运动的任务无关基础。然后，学习一个高效且精确的残差策略来优化 GMT 输出，从而改进运动并融入物体交互。为了进一步促进高效训练，学者们设计了 (i) 基于点云的物体追踪奖励，以实现更平滑的优化；(ii) 接触奖励，以鼓励类人机器人与物体进行精准的交互；以及 (iii) 基于课程的虚拟物体控制器，以稳定早期训练。学者们在模拟和真实的 Unitree G1 类人机器人上对 ResMimic 进行了评估。结果表明，任务成功率、训练效率和稳健性均比强基线有显著提高。
Humanoid robot full-body manipulation promises transformative capabilities for everyday service and warehouse tasks. While recent advances in general motion tracking (GMT) have enabled humanoid robots to reproduce a wide range of human motions, these policies lack the precision and object perception required for manipulation.
To this end, researchers from the University of Southern California, Stanford University, the University of California, Berkeley, and Carnegie Mellon University introduce ResMimic, a two-stage residual learning framework for accurate and expressive humanoid robot control based on human motion data. First, a GMT policy trained on large-scale pure human motions serves as a task-independent basis for generating humanoid full-body motions. Then, an efficient and accurate residual policy is learned to optimize the GMT output, improving motion and incorporating object interactions. To further promote efficient training, the researchers design (i) a point cloud-based object tracking reward for smoother optimization; (ii) a contact reward to encourage accurate object interactions; and (iii) a curriculum-based virtual object controller to stabilize early training. The researchers evaluated ResMimic on both simulated and real-world Unitree G1 humanoid robots, demonstrating significant improvements in task success rate, training efficiency, and robustness over strong baselines.
85.OmniRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Data Generation for Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation and Scene Interaction
OmniRetarget：用于人形全身运动和场景交互的交互保持数据生成
目前，教授人形机器人复杂技能的主流范式是将人类运动作为运动学参考，用于训练强化学习（RL）策略。然而，现有的重定向流程往往难以克服人类与机器人之间显著的具身差异，导致产生诸如滑冰和穿透等不符合物理规律的动作。更重要的是，常见的重定向方法忽略了丰富的人-物和人-环境交互，而这些交互对于富有表现力的运动和操控至关重要。
为了解决这个问题，来自亚马逊 FOR，麻省理工学院，加州大学伯克利分校以及斯坦福大学的学者们提出了 OmniRetarget，这是一个基于交互网格的交互保持数据生成引擎。该交互网格能够显式地建模并保留智能体、地形和被操控物体之间关键的空间和接触关系。OmniRetarget 通过最小化人机网格之间的拉普拉斯形变并强制执行运动学约束，生成运动学上可行的轨迹。此外，保留与任务相关的交互能够实现高效的数据增强，从单一演示扩展到不同的机器人具身、地形和物体配置。学者们通过对来自 OMOMO、LAFAN1 和他们内部 MoCap 数据集的运动进行重定向，对 OmniRetarget 进行了全面评估。生成的超过 8 小时的轨迹在运动学约束满足度和接触保持方面均优于广泛使用的基线方法。如此高质量的数据使得本体感受强化学习策略能够在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上成功执行长达 30 秒的跑酷和移动操控技能。该机器人仅使用 5 个奖励项和所有任务共享的简单域随机化进行训练，无需任何学习课程。
Currently, the mainstream paradigm for teaching complex skills to humanoid robots is to use human motion as a kinematic reference for training reinforcement learning (RL) policies. However, existing redirection processes often struggle to overcome the significant embodied differences between humans and robots, resulting in actions that defy the laws of physics, such as skating and traversing. More importantly, common redirection methods neglect rich human-object and human-environment interactions, which are crucial for expressive movement and manipulation.
To address this issue, researchers from Amazon FOR, MIT, UC Berkeley, and Stanford University proposed OmniRetarget, an interaction-preserving data generation engine based on an interaction mesh. This interaction mesh explicitly models and preserves key spatial and contact relationships between the agent, terrain, and manipulated objects. OmniRetarget generates kinematically feasible trajectories by minimizing the Laplace deformation between the human and robot meshes and enforcing kinematic constraints. Furthermore, preserving task-related interactions enables efficient data augmentation, scaling from single demonstrations to different robot embodied, terrain, and object configurations. Researchers comprehensively evaluated OmniRetarget by retargeting motion from OMOMO, LAFAN1, and their internal MoCap datasets. The generated trajectories, exceeding 8 hours in length, outperformed widely used baseline methods in both kinematic constraint satisfaction and contact maintenance. This high-quality data enabled proprioceptive reinforcement learning strategies to successfully execute up to 30 seconds of parkour and motion manipulation skills on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. The robot was trained using only 5 reward terms and simple domain randomization shared across all tasks, without any pre-defined learning courses.
86.VisualMimic: Visual Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Motion Tracking and Generation
VisualMimic：基于运动追踪和生成的视觉人形物体移动操控
在非结构化环境中进行人形机器人的运动操作需要将以自我为中心的感知和全身控制紧密结合。然而，现有方法要么依赖于外部运动捕捉系统，要么无法泛化到各种不同的任务。
在本文中，来自斯坦福大学的学者们提出了 VisualMimic，一个将以自我为中心的视觉与分层全身控制相结合的视觉模拟到真实环境框架，用于人形机器人。VisualMimic 结合了一个与任务无关的底层关键点跟踪器（通过师生模型从人体运动数据中训练得到）和一个特定于任务的高层策略，该策略根据视觉和本体感觉输入生成关键点指令。为了确保训练的稳定性，学者们向底层策略中注入噪声，并使用人体运动统计数据对高层动作进行裁剪。
VisualMimic 能够将模拟环境中训练的视觉运动策略零样本迁移到真实的人形机器人，从而完成各种运动操作任务，例如搬运箱子、推动物体、运球和踢球。除了受控的实验室环境外，学者们的策略还能稳健地泛化到户外环境中。
Motion manipulation of humanoid robots in unstructured environments requires a tight integration of egocentric perception and full-body control. However, existing methods either rely on external motion capture systems or fail to generalize to a wide range of tasks.
In this paper, researchers from Stanford University propose VisualMimic, a framework for humanoid robots that combines egocentric vision with hierarchical full-body control to simulate real-world environments. VisualMimic combines a task-agnostic low-level keypoint tracker (trained from human motion data using a teacher-student model) with a task-specific high-level policy that generates keypoint instructions based on visual and proprioceptive inputs. To ensure training stability, noise is injected into the low-level policy, and high-level actions are pruned using human motion statistics. VisualMimic enables zero-shot transfer of visual-motor policies trained in simulated environments to real humanoid robots, allowing them to perform various motion manipulation tasks, such as carrying boxes, pushing objects, dribbling, and kicking a ball. In addition to controlled laboratory environments, the policy also robustly generalizes to outdoor environments.
87.Thor: Towards Human-Level Whole-Body Reactions for Intense Contact-Rich Environments
Thor：迈向高强度接触环境下的人类水平全身反应
人形机器人在服务、工业和救援应用领域具有巨大的潜力，在这些应用中，机器人必须在与环境进行高强度、高接触交互的同时保持全身稳定性。然而，如何使人形机器人在这样的条件下产生类似人类的自适应反应仍然是一个巨大的挑战。
为了解决这个问题，来自作北京理工大学和北京人工智能研究院的学者们提出了 Thor，一个用于在高接触环境中实现类人全身反应的人形机器人框架。
基于机器人的力学分析，学者设计了一种力自适应躯干倾斜（FAT2）奖励函数，以鼓励人形机器人在力交互任务中展现出类似人类的反应。为了缓解人形机器人控制的高维挑战，Thor 引入了一种强化学习架构，将上半身、腰部和下半身解耦。每个组件共享全身的全局观测数据，并联合更新其参数。最后，学者们们将 Thor 部署在 Unitree G1 机器人上，结果表明其在力交互任务中显著优于基线模型。具体而言，该机器人向后移动时可达到 167.7 N 的峰值拉力（约占 G1 体重的 48%），向前移动时可达到 145.5 N，与性能最佳的基准机器人相比，分别提升了 68.9% 和 74.7%。此外，Thor 能够拉动一个装满货物的货架（130 N）并单手打开防火门（60 N）。这些结果凸显了 Thor 在增强人形机器人力交互能力方面的有效性。
Humanoid robots hold immense potential in service, industrial, and rescue applications, where they must maintain full-body stability while engaging in high-intensity, high-contact interactions with their environment. However, enabling humanoid robots to exhibit human-like adaptive responses under such conditions remains a significant challenge.
To address this issue, researchers from Beijing Institute of Technology and the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence proposed Thor, a humanoid robot framework for achieving human-like full-body responses in high-contact environments.
Based on robot mechanics analysis, the researchers designed a force-adaptive torso tilt (FAT2) reward function to encourage humanoid robots to exhibit human-like responses in force interaction tasks. To alleviate the high-dimensional challenges of humanoid robot control, Thor introduces a reinforcement learning architecture that decouples the upper body, waist, and lower body. Each component shares global observation data of the entire body and jointly updates its parameters. Finally, the researchers deployed Thor on the Unitree G1 robot, demonstrating that it significantly outperforms baseline models in force interaction tasks. Specifically, the robot achieves a peak pulling force of 167.7 N when moving backward (approximately 48% of G1's body weight) and 145.5 N when moving forward, representing improvements of 68.9% and 74.7% respectively compared to the best-performing benchmark robot. Furthermore, Thor was able to pull a fully loaded shelf (130 N) and open a fire door with one hand (60 N). These results highlight Thor's effectiveness in enhancing the force interaction capabilities of humanoid robots.
88.PolySim: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap for Humanoid Control via Multi-Simulator Dynamics Randomization
PolySim：通过多模拟器动力学随机化弥合人形机器人控制的仿真与现实差距
在仿真环境中训练的人形全身控制（WBC）策略常常面临仿真与真实世界之间的差距，这本质上源于仿真器归纳偏差，即任何单个仿真器固有的假设和局限性。这些偏差会导致不同仿真器之间以及仿真与真实世界之间存在显著差异。为了缓解仿真器归纳偏差的影响，关键思想是跨多个仿真器联合训练策略，从而促使学习到的控制器捕捉到超越任何单个仿真器假设的通用动力学特征。
因此，来自上海交通大学和中关村学院以及Nerv.ai 的学者们提出了 PolySim，一个集成了多个异构仿真器的 WBC 训练平台。PolySim 可以在单次训练运行中同时启动来自不同引擎的并行环境，从而实现动力学层面的域随机化。理论上，学者们证明 PolySim 比单仿真器训练能给出更紧的仿真器归纳偏差上限。实验表明，PolySim 显著降低了仿真间评估中的运动跟踪误差；例如，在 MuJoCo 数据集上，PolySim 的执行成功率比 IsaacSim 基线提高了 52.8%。此外，PolySim 还支持在真实的 Unitree G1 上进行零样本部署，无需额外的微调，从而有效地实现了从仿真到实际应用的迁移。
Humanoid whole-body control (WBC) strategies trained in simulation environments often face a gap between simulation and the real world. This essentially stems from simulator induction bias, the inherent assumptions and limitations of any single simulator. These biases lead to significant differences between different simulators and between simulation and the real world. To mitigate the impact of simulator induction bias, a key idea is to jointly train the strategy across multiple simulators, thereby enabling the learned controller to capture general dynamic characteristics that transcend the assumptions of any single simulator.
Therefore, researchers from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhongguancun Academy, and Nerv.ai proposed PolySim, a WBC training platform integrating multiple heterogeneous simulators. PolySim can simultaneously launch parallel environments from different engines in a single training run, thereby achieving domain randomization at the dynamics level. Theoretically, researchers have shown that PolySim provides a tighter upper bound on simulator induction bias than single-simulator training. Experiments show that PolySim significantly reduces motion tracking errors in inter-simulation evaluations; for example, on the MuJoCo dataset, PolySim's execution success rate is 52.8% higher than the IsaacSim baseline. Furthermore, PolySim supports zero-shot deployment on real Unitree G1 without additional fine-tuning, effectively enabling the migration from simulation to real-world applications.
89.SafeFall: Learning Protective Control for Humanoid Robots
SafeFall学习型人形机器人保护控制系统
双足机器人在运动过程中天生容易发生跌倒，这使得全尺寸人形机器人极易对昂贵的传感器、执行器以及结构部件造成灾难性损伤。为了解决这一现实部署中的关键障碍，我们提出 SafeFall —— 一个能够预测即将发生且无法避免的跌倒，并主动执行保护性动作以最大程度减少硬件损坏的框架。
SafeFall 被设计为可与现有的常规控制器无缝协作，在正常运行期间完全不干扰机器人控制。该框架由两部分协同组成：一个轻量级、基于 GRU 的跌倒预测器，用于持续监测机器人的状态；以及一个用于损伤缓解的强化学习策略。当预测器判断跌倒已不可避免时，原本休眠的保护策略会立即激活，接管控制并执行减轻损伤的动作。
该保护策略通过一种全新的、面向损伤的奖励函数进行训练，该奖励不只是简单地减少外部碰撞冲击，还显式考虑了机器人不同部件的差异化脆弱性——例如重点保护头部等敏感区域。同时，它会限制关节内部的扭矩和载荷，以避免机械过载及关节电机的电气饱和。
我们在全尺寸 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了 SafeFall 的有效性。与未受保护的跌倒相比，SafeFall 将峰值接触力降低了 68.3%，峰值关节力矩降低了 78.4%，并将对易损部件的碰撞减少了 99.3%。通过让机器人能够“安全地失败”，SafeFall 为人形机器人的发展提供了一张关键的安全网，使得更激进的实验成为可能，并加速它们在复杂真实环境中的部署。
Bipedal locomotion makes humanoid robots inherently prone to falls, causing catastrophic damage to the expensive sensors, actuators, and structural components of full-scale robots. To address this critical barrier to real-world deployment, we present SafeFall, a framework that learns to predict imminent, unavoidable falls and execute protective maneuvers to minimize hardware damage. SafeFall is designed to operate seamlessly alongside existing nominal controller, ensuring no interference during normal operation. It combines two synergistic components: a lightweight, GRU-based fall predictor that continuously monitors the robot’s states, and a reinforcement learning policy for damage mitigation. The protective policy remains dormant until the predictor identifies a fall as unavoidable, at which point it activates to take control and execute a damage-minimizing response. This policy is trained with a novel, damage-aware reward function that goes beyond minimizing external impacts. It explicitly models component heterogeneity to shield vulnerable areas like the head, while simultaneously constraining internal joint wrenches to prevent mechanical overload and electrical saturation of joint actuators. Validated on a full-scale Unitree G1 humanoid, SafeFall demonstrated significant performance improvements over unprotected falls. It reduced peak contact forces by 68.3%, peak joint torques by 78.4%, and eliminated 99.3% of collisions with vulnerable components. By enabling humanoids to fail safely, SafeFall provides a crucial safety net that allows for more aggressive experiments and accelerates the deployment of these robots in complex, real-world environments.
Robotic world model: A neural network simulator for robust policy optimization in robotics 机器人世界模型：用于机器人领域鲁棒策略优化的神经网络模拟器
在真实环境中实现高效且可扩展的机器人控制，关键在于学习具备稳健性与泛化能力的世界模型。本研究提出了一种全新的框架，用于学习能够精准刻画复杂、部分可观测且具有随机性的动力学模型。该方法采用双自回归机制与自监督训练策略，在不依赖特定领域归纳偏置的前提下，实现可靠的长时域预测，从而具备在多样化机器人任务中的适应能力。
此外，我们提出了一种策略优化框架，可借助世界模型在“想象”环境中进行高效训练，并可以无缝迁移至真实系统中部署。该研究通过应对长时域预测、误差累积以及仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）等关键挑战，推动了基于模型的强化学习的发展。通过提供一个可扩展且稳健的整体方法，本工作为构建具有自适应能力和高效率的真实世界机器人系统铺平了道路。具体而言，对于 ANYmal D 四足机器人和 Unitree G1 人形机器人，该框架通过 MBPO-PPO 实现了稳健的策略优化，使得策略能够在硬件上实现零样本部署。
Learning robust and generalizable world models is crucial for enabling efficient and scalable robotic control in real-world environments. In this work, we introduce a novel framework for learning world models that accurately capture complex, partially observable, and stochastic dynamics. The proposed method employs a dual-autoregressive mechanism and self-supervised training to achieve reliable long-horizon predictions without relying on domain-specific inductive biases, ensuring adaptability across diverse robotic tasks. We further propose a policy optimization framework that leverages world models for efficient training in imagined environments and seamless deployment in real-world systems. This work advances model-based reinforcement learning by addressing the challenges of long-horizon prediction, error accumulation, and sim-to-real transfer. By providing a scalable and robust framework, the introduced methods pave the way for adaptive and efficient robotic systems in real-world applications. Specifically for the ANYmal D quadruped and Unitree G1 humanoid, the framework achieves robust policy optimization through MBPO-PPO, enabling zero-shot deployment on hardware.
DemoHLM: From One Demonstration to Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
DemoHLM：从一次演示到可推广的人形机器人移动操控
Loco-manipulation 是人形机器人在复杂人类环境中实现多样化交互的核心挑战。尽管近年来在人形机器人全身控制方面取得了显著进展，但针对移动操作的研究仍然较少，且通常依赖硬编码任务定义或代价高昂的真实数据采集，这限制了机器人系统的自主性和泛化能力。
本文提出 DemoHLM，一种支持人形机器人移动操作的框架，可通过单次仿真演示实现真实人形机器人的可泛化移动操作。DemoHLM 采用分层结构，将低层的通用全身控制器与高层的多任务操作策略结合起来。全身控制器将全身运动指令映射为关节力矩，为机器人提供全向移动能力；操作策略则通过我们设计的数据生成与模仿学习管线在仿真中训练，通过闭环视觉反馈指挥全身控制器执行复杂的移动操作任务。
实验结果显示，合成数据量与策略性能呈正相关，充分证明了数据生成管线的有效性以及本方法的数据高效性。在真实环境中，我们将 DemoHLM 部署在 搭载 RGBD 相机的 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上，验证了其仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移能力，并在十项移动操作任务中展现了在空间变化下的稳健性能。
Loco-manipulation is a fundamental challenge for humanoid robots to achieve versatile interactions in human environments. Although recent studies have made significant progress in humanoid whole-body control, loco-manipulation remains underexplored and often relies on hard-coded task definitions or costly real-world data collection, which limits autonomy and generalization. We present DemoHLM, a framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that enables generalizable loco-manipulation on a real humanoid robot from a single demonstration in simulation. DemoHLM adopts a hierarchy that integrates a low-level universal whole-body controller with high-level manipulation policies for multiple tasks. The whole-body controller maps whole-body motion commands to joint torques and provides omnidirectional mobility for the humanoid robot. The manipulation policies, learned in simulation via our data generation and imitation learning pipeline, command the whole-body controller with closed-loop visual feedback to execute challenging loco-manipulation tasks. Experiments show a positive correlation between the amount of synthetic data and policy performance, underscoring the effectiveness of our data generation pipeline and the data efficiency of our approach. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 robot equipped with an RGBD camera validate the sim-to-real transferability of DemoHLM, demonstrating robust performance under spatial variations across ten loco-manipulation tasks.
A Comparative Study of Floating-Base Space Parameterizations for Agile Whole-Body Motion Planning 基于浮动基座空间参数化的敏捷全身运动规划比较研究
自动生成灵活的全身运动对于足式和人形机器人仍然是机器人学中的核心挑战。尽管已有大量轨迹优化方法被提出，但关于浮动基座空间参数化的选择如何影响性能，尤其是在涉及复杂接触动力学的灵活动作中，目前尚无明确指导。
本文对基于直接转录（direct transcription）的轨迹优化中，不同浮动基座参数化在足式系统灵活动作生成中的性能进行了比较研究。我们在相同优化设置下系统性地评估了几种常见参数化方式，以确保比较的公平性。
此外，本文提出了一种基于 SE(3) 切空间（tangent space）的新型浮动基座姿态表示方法，据我们所知，文献中尚未对此进行探讨。该方法使得研究者可以直接使用成熟的现成数值求解器，而无需依赖特殊的流形优化技术。我们希望，通过实验和分析，能够为灵活全身运动生成中浮动基座表示的选择提供有价值的参考与指导。
在实验中，论文使用了三种机器人平台进行验证：PAL Robotics Talos 人形机器人、Unitree G1 人形机器人以及 Unitree Go2 四足机器人，在六种灵活动作场景下进行了五种浮动基座表示方法的优化测试，总计 30 次实验。
Automatically generating agile whole-body motions for legged and humanoid robots remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. While numerous trajectory optimization approaches have been proposed, there is no clear guideline on how the choice of floating-base space parameterization affects performance, especially for agile behaviors involving complex contact dynamics. In this paper, we present a comparative study of different parameterizations for direct transcriptionbased trajectory optimization of agile motions in legged systems. We systematically evaluate several common choices under identical optimization settings to ensure a fair comparison. Furthermore, we introduce a novel formulation based on the tangent space of SE(3) for representing the robot’s floating-base pose, which, to our knowledge, has not received attention from the literature. This approach enables the use of mature off-theshelf numerical solvers without requiring specialized manifold optimization techniques. We hope that our experiments and analysis will provide meaningful insights for selecting the appropriate floating-based representation for agile whole-body motion generation.
In the experiments, three robot platforms were used for validation: the PAL Robotics Talos humanoid, the Unitree G1 humanoid, and the Unitree Go2 quadruped, testing five floating-base representations across six agile motion scenarios for a total of 30 optimization runs.
Unified Humanoid Fall-Safety Policy from a Few Demonstrations
从几个演示案例中得出统一的人形机器人防坠落安全策略
跌倒是人形机器人运动固有的风险。因此，维持稳定性一直是机器人控制与学习中的安全核心。然而，目前尚无方法能够完全避免失衡。一旦发生不稳定，现有研究仅针对跌倒的单一环节进行处理：避免跌倒、控制性下落，或在跌倒后重新站起。因此，人形机器人缺乏针对真实跌倒情境的综合策略来缓冲冲击并迅速恢复。
我们的目标不仅是保持平衡，更是使整个跌倒与恢复过程安全且自主：在可能的情况下防止跌倒，在不可避免时减轻冲击，并在跌倒后迅速站起。通过融合稀疏的人类示范、强化学习以及基于扩散的自适应安全反应记忆，我们学习了自适应全身行为，将防跌、冲击缓解和快速恢复统一到单一策略中。
在仿真和 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上的实验表明，该方法能够实现稳健的仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）、降低冲击力，并在多种扰动下保持快速恢复，为现实环境中更安全、更具韧性的人形机器人提供了可能。相关视频可见：https://firm2025.github.io/
Falling is an inherent risk of humanoid mobility. Maintaining stability is thus a primary safety focus in robot control and learning, yet no existing approach fully averts loss of balance. When instability does occur, prior work addresses only isolated aspects of falling: avoiding falls, choreographing a controlled descent, or standing up afterward. Consequently, humanoid robots lack integrated strategies for impact mitigation and prompt recovery when real falls defy these scripts. We aim to go beyond keeping balance to make the entire falland-recovery process safe and autonomous: prevent falls when possible, reduce impact when unavoidable, and stand up when fallen. By fusing sparse human demonstrations with reinforcement learning and an adaptive diffusion-based memory of safe reactions, we learn adaptive whole-body behaviors that unify fall prevention, impact mitigation, and rapid recovery in one policy. Experiments in simulation and on a Unitree G1 demonstrate robust sim-to-real transfer, lower impact forces, and consistently fast recovery across diverse disturbances, pointing toward safer, more resilient humanoids in real environments. Videos are available at https://firm2025.github.io/.
Agility Meets Stability: Versatile Humanoid Control with Heterogeneous Data
敏捷性与稳定性兼备：基于异构数据的多功能人形机器人控制
人形机器人被期望在以人为中心的环境中执行各种任务，这要求控制器既具备灵活性又能保持稳健的平衡。近年来，运动控制与全身跟踪技术的发展，使机器人在灵活动态技能或对稳定性要求极高的行为方面取得了显著进展，但现有方法往往各自为战：专注于某一能力，而牺牲了另一项性能。
本文提出 AMS（Agility Meets Stability），这是首个将动态运动跟踪与极限平衡维持统一到单一策略中的框架。我们的核心思想是利用异质数据源：一方面是提供丰富灵活动作的人体动作捕捉数据集，另一方面是捕捉稳定性配置的受物理约束的合成平衡动作。为协调灵活性与稳定性之间的优化目标，我们设计了混合奖励机制：在所有数据上应用通用跟踪目标，同时仅对合成平衡动作注入平衡先验。
此外，我们引入自适应学习策略，通过基于表现的采样与动作特定的奖励塑形，实现对多样化动作分布的高效训练。
我们在仿真环境以及真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上对 AMS 进行了广泛验证。实验结果表明，单一策略能够执行舞蹈和奔跑等灵活技能，同时也能完成零样本极限平衡动作，如“叶问式下蹲”，突显 AMS 作为未来人形机器人通用控制范式的潜力。
Humanoid robots are envisioned to perform a wide range of tasks in human-centered environments, requiring controllers that combine agility with robust balance. Recent advances in locomotion and whole-body tracking have enabled impressive progress in either agile dynamic skills or stabilitycritical behaviors, but existing methods remain specialized, focusing on one capability while compromising the other. In this work, we introduce AMS (Agility Meets Stability), the first framework that unifies both dynamic motion tracking and extreme balance maintenance in a single policy. Our key insight is to leverage heterogeneous data sources: human motion capture datasets that provide rich, agile behaviors, and physically constrained synthetic balance motions that capture stability configurations. To reconcile the divergent optimization goals of agility and stability, we design a hybrid reward scheme that applies general tracking objectives across all data while injecting balance-specific priors only into synthetic motions. Further, an adaptive learning strategy with performance-driven sampling and motion-specific reward shaping enables efficient training across diverse motion distributions.
