We validate AMS extensively in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Experiments demonstrate that a single policy can execute agile skills such as dancing and running, while also performing zero-shot extreme balance motions like Ip Man’s Squat, highlighting AMS as a versatile control paradigm for future humanoid applications.
Learning Adaptive Neural Teleoperation for Humanoid Robots: From Inverse Kinematics to End-to-End Control
面向人形机器人的自适应神经遥操作学习：从逆运动学到端到端控制
虚拟现实（VR）远程操控已成为控制人形机器人执行复杂操作任务的一种有前景的方法。然而，传统远程操控系统依赖逆向运动学（IK）求解器和手工调节的 PD 控制器，这些方法在处理外力作用、适应不同用户以及在动态条件下生成自然动作方面存在困难。
本文提出了一种基于学习的神经远程操控框架，通过强化学习训练策略，取代传统的 IK+PD 管线。该方法能够直接将 VR 控制器输入映射为机器人关节命令，同时隐式应对力扰动，生成平滑轨迹，并适应用户偏好。我们在仿真中使用基于 IK 的演示数据进行策略初始化训练，并通过力扰动随机化和轨迹平滑奖励进行微调。
在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上的实验表明，学习得到的策略相比 IK 基线实现了 34% 更低的跟踪误差、45% 更平滑的动作，并在力适应性上表现更优，同时保持实时性能（50 Hz 控制频率）。我们在抓取放置、开门以及双手协调等操作任务中验证了该方法。实验结果表明，基于学习的方法能够显著提升人形机器人远程操控系统的自然性与鲁棒性。
Virtual reality (VR) teleoperation has emerged as a promising approach for controlling humanoid robots in complex manipulation tasks. However, traditional teleoperation systems rely on inverse kinematics (IK) solvers and hand-tuned PD controllers, which struggle to handle external forces, adapt to different users, and produce natural motions under dynamic conditions. In this work, we propose a learning-based neural teleoperation framework that replaces the conventional IK+PD pipeline with learned policies trained via reinforcement learning. Our approach learns to directly map VR controller inputs to robot joint commands while implicitly handling force disturbances, producing smooth trajectories, and adapting to user preferences. We train our policies in simulation using demonstrations collected from IK-based teleoperation as initialization, then fine-tune them with force randomization and trajectory smoothness rewards. Experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot demonstrate that our learned policies achieve 34% lower tracking error, 45% smoother motions, and superior force adaptation compared to the IK baseline, while maintaining real-time performance (50Hz control frequency). We validate our approach on manipulation tasks including object pick-andplace, door opening, and bimanual coordination. These results suggest that learning-based approaches can significantly improve the naturalness and robustness of humanoid teleoperation systems.
VIRAL: Visual Sim-to-Real at Scale for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
VIRAL：用于人形机器人运动操控的大规模可视化模拟与现实转换
人形机器人在真实环境中部署的一个关键障碍是缺乏自主的移动操作（loco-manipulation）技能。本文提出 VIRAL，一个视觉仿真到现实（sim-to-real）框架，能够在完全仿真环境中学习人形机器人的移动操作，并实现零样本部署到真实硬件。
VIRAL 采用教师-学生（teacher-student）设计：一名特权强化学习教师（privileged RL teacher）基于全状态信息，利用增量动作空间（delta action space）和参考状态初始化（reference state initialization）学习长时域移动操作；随后，通过大规模仿真（tiled rendering）结合在线 DAgger 与行为克隆（behavior cloning）混合训练，将视觉学生策略（vision-based student policy）从教师策略中蒸馏出来。实验发现，计算规模至关重要：将仿真扩展到数十张 GPU（最多 64 张）可以保证教师和学生训练的可靠性，而低算力环境通常难以成功训练。
为缩小仿真与现实的差距，VIRAL 将大规模视觉域随机化（lighting、材料、相机参数、图像质量及传感器延迟）与真实到仿真的手部与相机对齐（real-to-sim alignment）结合使用。部署在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上后，生成的基于 RGB 的策略能够连续执行移动操作任务，最长可达 54 个循环，并能在不同空间位置与外观条件下泛化，无需任何真实世界微调，其表现接近专家级远程操控。
大量消融实验分析了实现基于 RGB 的人形机器人移动操作所需的关键设计选择。
A key barrier to the real-world deployment of humanoid robots is the lack of autonomous loco-manipulation skills. We introduce VIRAL, a visual sim-to-real framework that learns humanoid loco-manipulation entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot to real hardware. VIRAL follows a teacher-student design: a privileged RL teacher, operating on full state, learns long-horizon loco-manipulation using a delta action space and reference state initialization. A vision-based student policy is then distilled from the teacher via large-scale simulation with tiled rendering, trained with a mixture of online DAgger and behavior cloning. We find that compute scale is critical: scaling simulation to tens of GPUs (up to 64) makes both teacher and student training reliable, while low-compute regimes often fail. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, VIRAL combines large-scale visual domain randomization over lighting, materials, camera parameters, image quality, and sensor delays—with real-tosim alignment of the dexterous hands and cameras. Deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid, the resulting RGB-based policy performs continuous loco-manipulation for up to 54 cycles, generalizing to diverse spatial and appearance variations without any real-world fine-tuning, and approaching expert-level teleoperation performance. Extensive ablations dissect the key design choices required to make RGBbased humanoid loco-manipulation work in practice.
Kinematics-Aware Multi-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Force-Capable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
面向力感知人形机器人的运动学感知多策略强化学习
人形机器人因其类人体结构，在工业应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，现有的移动操作（loco-manipulation）方法主要关注灵巧操作，在高负载工业场景下往往无法同时满足灵巧性与主动力交互的需求。
为弥补这一空白，本文提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，采用解耦的三阶段训练管线，包括上身策略、下身策略以及增量指令（delta-command）策略。为了加速上身训练，我们设计了启发式奖励函数，通过隐式嵌入前向运动学先验，使策略能够更快收敛并达到优异性能。对于下身动作，我们引入了基于力的课程学习策略，使机器人能够主动施加并调节与环境的交互力。为了保证全身协调性，还采用了增量指令策略，用于抵消下身运动在世界坐标系中引起的末端执行器垂直位移。
在仿真和真实环境中，我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上对所提出的框架进行了广泛验证。实验结果显示，该框架能够完成高负载任务，例如携带 4 kg 物体行走，以及推动或拉动总重量达 112.8 kg 的手推车，展示了其在复杂工业场景下的可行性与鲁棒性。
Humanoid robots, with their human-like morphology, hold great potential for industrial applications. However, existing loco-manipulation methods primarily focus on dexterous manipulation, falling short of the combined requirements for dexterity and proactive force interaction in high-load industrial scenarios. To bridge this gap, we propose a reinforcement learning-based framework with a decoupled three-stage training pipeline, consisting of an upper-body policy, a lower-body policy, and a delta-command policy. To accelerate upper-body training, a heuristic reward function is designed. By implicitly embedding forward kinematics priors, it enables the policy to converge faster and achieve superior performance. For the lower body, a forcebased curriculum learning strategy is developed, enabling the robot to actively exert and regulate interaction forces with the environment. To ensure robust whole-body coordination, a deltacommand policy is employed to counteract vertical end-effector displacements in the world frame resulting from lower-body motion. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot validate the proposed framework, showcasing its capability to accomplish high-payload tasks such as walking while carrying a 4 kg object and pushing or pulling a cart with a total load of 112.8 kg.
HumanoidExo: Scalable Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Wearable Exoskeleton
HumanoidExo：通过可穿戴外骨骼实现可扩展的全身人形机器人操控
在人形机器人策略学习中，一个关键瓶颈是难以获取大规模且多样化的数据集，因为收集高质量的真实机器人数据既困难又成本高昂。为解决这一问题，我们提出 HumanoidExo，一种将人类动作迁移为人形机器人全身数据的新型系统。HumanoidExo 能够有效缩小人类示教者与机器人之间的“体态差距（embodiment gap）”，从而缓解人形机器人全身数据稀缺的问题。通过促进更大规模、更高多样性的示教数据采集，该方法显著提升了人形机器人在动态真实场景中的表现。
我们在三项具有挑战性的真实任务中评估了该方法：桌面操作、结合站立-下蹲动作的操作以及全身操作任务。实验结果表明，HumanoidExo 是真实机器人数据的重要补充，不仅使人形机器人策略能够泛化至新环境，还能在仅使用 五条真实示教数据 的情况下学习复杂的全身控制，甚至能够 仅依赖 HumanoidExo 数据习得新的技能（如行走）。所有真实机器人实验均在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上完成，验证了该系统在真实场景下的有效性与实用价值。
A significant bottleneck in humanoid policy learning is the acquisition of large-scale, diverse datasets, as collecting reliable real-world data remains both difficult and costprohibitive. To address this limitation, we introduce HumanoidExo, a novel system that transfers human motion to whole-body humanoid data. HumanoidExo offers a highefficiency solution that minimizes the embodiment gap between the human demonstrator and the robot, thereby tackling the scarcity of whole-body humanoid data. By facilitating the collection of more voluminous and diverse datasets, our approach significantly enhances the performance of humanoid robots in dynamic, real-world scenarios. We evaluated our method across three challenging real-world tasks: table-top manipulation, manipulation integrated with stand-squat motions, and whole-body manipulation. Our results empirically demonstrate that HumanoidExo is a crucial addition to real-robot data, as it enables the humanoid policy to generalize to novel environments, learn complex whole-body control from only five real-robot demonstrations, and even acquire new skills (i.e., walking) solely from HumanoidExo data. All real-world robot experiments were conducted on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, verifying the system's effectiveness and practical value in real-world scenarios.
GentleHumanoid Learning Upper-body Compliance for Contact-rich Human and Object Interaction
GentleHumanoid 学习上半身顺应性，适用于接触丰富的人机交互
人形机器人通常需要在以人为中心的环境中工作，因此安全且自然的物理交互至关重要。然而，当前大多数强化学习（RL）策略都强调刚性跟踪，并倾向于抑制外部作用力。现有的阻抗增强方法通常仅局限于基座或末端执行器控制，并主要关注抵抗较大外力，而非实现柔顺交互。
为解决这一问题，我们提出 GentleHumanoid，一个将阻抗控制融入全身运动跟踪策略的框架，用于实现上半身的柔顺性。该框架的核心是一种统一的弹簧模型，可同时模拟两类接触：抵抗性接触（如按压表面时的恢复力）和引导性接触（来源于人类运动数据的推拉力）。这一建模方式使肩、肘、腕关节间的受力保持运动学一致性，同时让策略在训练过程中接触多样化的交互场景。此外，我们引入了可根据任务需求调整的力阈值以进一步提升安全性。
我们在仿真环境和 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上对该方法进行了评估，涵盖多类对柔顺性要求不同的任务，包括轻柔拥抱、坐-站辅助以及安全的物体操作。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，我们的策略在保持任务成功的同时，显著降低了接触力峰值，使交互过程更加平滑、自然。这些成果表明，该方法为实现能在真实环境中安全、高效地与人类协作并执行物体操作的人形机器人迈出了重要一步。
Humanoid robots are expected to operate in human-centered environments where safe and natural physical interaction is essential. However, most recent reinforcement learning (RL) policies emphasize rigid tracking and suppress external forces. Existing impedance-augmented approaches are typically restricted to base or end-effector control and focus on resisting extreme forces rather than enabling compliance. We introduce GentleHumanoid, a framework that integrates impedance control into a whole-body motion tracking policy to achieve upper-body compliance. At its core is a unified springbased formulation that models both resistive contacts (restoring forces when pressing against surfaces) and guiding contacts (pushes or pulls sampled from human motion data). This formulation ensures kinematically consistent forces across the shoulder, elbow, and wrist, while exposing the policy to diverse interaction scenarios. Safety is further supported through taskadjustable force thresholds. We evaluate our approach in both simulation and on the Unitree G1 humanoid across tasks requiring different levels of compliance, including gentle hugging, sit-to-stand assistance, and safe object manipulation. Compared to baselines, our policy consistently reduces peak contact forces while maintaining task success, resulting in smoother and more natural interactions. These results highlight a step toward humanoid robots that can safely and effectively collaborate with humans and handle objects in real-world environments.
Gallant: Voxel Grid-based Humanoid Locomotion and Local-navigation across 3D Constrained Terrains
Gallant：基于体素网格的人形机器人在三维受限地形上的运动和局部导航
实现稳健的人形机器人步行，需要对周围三维环境进行准确且全局一致的感知。然而，现有的感知模块主要依赖深度图像或高度图（elevation maps），只能提供局部且被压平的环境视图，无法完整反映三维结构。为此，本文提出 Gallant——一个基于体素网格（voxel grid）的三维受限地形下的人形机器人行走与局部导航框架。
Gallant 使用体素化的 LiDAR 数据作为轻量且结构化的环境表示，并通过 z 分组二维卷积网络（z-grouped 2D CNN） 将该表示映射到控制策略，实现端到端优化。为支持可扩展的 LiDAR-based 训练并确保仿真到现实（sim-to-real）一致性，我们构建了一个高保真 LiDAR 仿真系统，用于动态生成逼真的传感观测。
我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上对 Gallant 进行了系统评估。实验结果表明，相较于以往仅限地面障碍的视觉或高度图方法，Gallant 更广的感知覆盖能力使其单一策略即可处理侧向杂物、头顶约束、多层结构以及狭窄通道等复杂三维场景。此外，通过强化端到端优化过程，Gallant 在爬楼梯与跨上高台等高难度任务中首次实现接近 100% 的成功率。更多信息参见 Gallant 项目网站。
Robust humanoid locomotion requires accurate and globally consistent perception of the surrounding 3D environment. However, existing perception modules, mainly based on depth images or elevation maps, offer only partial and locally flattened views of the environment, failing to capture the full 3D structure. This paper presents Gallant, a voxel-grid–based framework for humanoid locomotion and local navigation in 3D constrained terrains. It leverages voxelized LiDAR data as a lightweight and structured perceptual representation, and employs a z-grouped 2D CNN to map this representation to the control policy, enabling fully end-to-end optimization. A high-fidelity LiDAR simulation that dynamically generates realistic observations is developed to support scalable, LiDAR-based training and ensure sim-to-real consistency. Experimental results on Unitree G1 show that Gallant’s broader perceptual coverage facilitates the use of a single policy that goes beyond the limitations of previous methods confined to ground-level obstacles, extending to lateral clutter, overhead constraints, multi-level structures, and narrow passages. Gallant also firstly achieves near-100% success rates in challenging scenarios such as stair climbing and stepping onto elevated platforms through improved end-to-end optimization. Website: Gallant.
TWIST2 Scalable, Portable, and Holistic Humanoid Data Collection System
TWIST2 可扩展、便携且全面的类人生物数据采集系统
大规模数据已经推动了机器人领域的诸多突破，从语言模型到双臂操作中的视觉-语言-动作模型。然而，人形机器人领域仍缺乏同样高效的数据采集框架。现有的人形机器人遥操作系统要么采用解耦控制，要么依赖昂贵的动作捕捉设备。
为此，我们提出 TWIST2，一个便携、无需动作捕捉的人形机器人遥操作与数据采集系统，在提升可扩展性的同时保持整机全身控制能力。我们的系统利用 PICO4U VR 捕获人体全身实时动作，并配备自制的双自由度机器人“脖子”（成本约 250 美元）实现第一视角视觉，从而实现完整的人到人形机器人的控制映射。
我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上展示了长时域的灵巧与移动技能，并证明该系统可以在 15 分钟内采集 100 条示范数据，成功率接近 100%。在此基础上，我们提出了一个分层视觉运动控制框架，使机器人能够基于第一视角视觉自主控制全身。该视觉运动控制策略成功实现了全身灵巧操作和动态踢球任务。整个系统已完全开源，网址为：https://yanjieze.com/TWIST2；同时，我们采集的数据集也已公开发布，网址为：https://twistdata.github.io。
Large-scale data has driven breakthroughs in robotics, from language models to vision-language-action models in bimanual manipulation. However, humanoid robotics lacks equally effective data collection frameworks. Existing humanoid teleoperation systems either use decoupled control or depend on expensive motion capture setups. We introduce TWIST2, a portable, mocap-free humanoid teleoperation and data collection system that preserves full whole-body control while advancing scalability. Our system leverages PICO4U VR for obtaining real-time whole-body human motions, with a custom 2-DoF robot neck (cost around $250) for egocentric vision, enabling holistic human-to-humanoid control. We demonstrate long-horizon dexterous and mobile humanoid skills on Unitree G1 and we can collect 100 demonstrations in 15 minutes with an almost 100% success rate. Building on this pipeline, we propose a hierarchical visuomotor policy framework that autonomously controls the full humanoid body based on egocentric vision. Our visuomotor policy successfully demonstrates whole-body dexterous manipulation and dynamic kicking tasks. The entire system is fully reproducible and open-sourced at https://yanjieze.com/TWIST2
Our collected dataset is also open-sourced at https://twistdata.github.io
SENTINEL A Fully End-to-End Language-Action Model for Humanoid Whole Body Control
SENTINEL：用于人形机器人全身控制的端到端语言动作模型
现有的人形机器人控制系统通常依赖于遥操作或模块化生成流程，将语言理解与物理执行分离。然而，前者完全依赖人工操作，而后者则缺乏语言指令与物理行为之间的紧密对齐。
本文提出 SENTINEL，一个面向人形机器人全身控制的端到端语言-动作模型。我们通过在仿真环境中使用预训练的全身控制器追踪人类动作，并结合文本注释，构建了大规模的数据集。该模型能够直接将语言指令和本体感知输入映射到低层动作，无需任何中间表示。模型通过流匹配（flow matching）生成动作片段，并可通过残差动作头（residual action head）进行后续优化，以支持在真实环境中的部署。
实验结果表明，SENTINEL 在仿真和真实人形机器人Unitree G1上均展现了出色的语义理解能力和稳定的执行效果。同时，该方法还支持多模态扩展，可将其他类型输入转换为文本，以实现更广泛的指令控制
Existing humanoid control systems often rely on teleoperation or modular generation pipelines that separate language understanding from physical execution. However, the former is entirely human-driven, and the latter lacks tight alignment between language commands and physical behaviors. In this paper, we present SENTINEL, a fully end-to-end language–action model for humanoid whole-body control. We construct a large-scale dataset by tracking human motions in simulation using a pretrained whole body controller, combined with their text annotations. The model directly maps language commands and proprioceptive inputs to low-level actions without any intermediate representation. The model generates action chunks using flow matching, which can be subsequently refined by a residual action head for real-world deployment. Our method exhibits strong semantic understanding and stable execution on humanoid robots Unitree G1 in both simulation and real-world deployment, and also supports multi-modal extensions by converting inputs into texts.
Towards Adaptive Humanoid Control via Multi-Behavior Distillation and Reinforced Fine-Tuning
通过多行为提炼和强化微调实现自适应人形机器人控制
人形机器人有潜力学习多样的人类步态行为，包括站立、行走、奔跑和跳跃。然而，现有方法通常需要为每项技能单独训练策略，从而生成行为特定的控制器。这类控制器在不规则地形或多样环境下的泛化能力有限，执行性能脆弱。
为解决这一问题，我们提出 Adaptive Humanoid Control (AHC)，采用两阶段框架学习适应多种技能和地形的人形机器人步态控制器。具体而言，首先训练若干基础步态策略，并通过多行为蒸馏（multi-behavior distillation）获得一个基础多行为控制器，从而实现基于环境的自适应行为切换。随后，通过在更多样化地形上执行自适应行为并收集在线反馈进行强化微调，进一步增强控制器的地形适应能力。
我们在仿真环境和 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上进行了实验。结果表明，该方法在多种环境和地形下均展现出强大的适应性和稳健性能。
Humanoid robots are promising to learn a diverse set of human-like locomotion behaviors, including standing up, walking, running, and jumping. However, existing methods predominantly require training independent policies for each skill, yielding behavior-specific controllers that exhibit limited generalization and brittle performance when deployed on irregular terrains and in diverse situations. To address this challenge, we propose Adaptive Humanoid Control (AHC) that adopts a two-stage framework to learn an adaptive humanoid locomotion controller across different skills and terrains. Specifically, we first train several primary locomotion policies and perform a multi-behavior distillation process to obtain a basic multi-behavior controller, facilitating adaptive behavior switching based on the environment. Then, we perform reinforced fine-tuning by collecting online feedback in performing adaptive behaviors on more diverse terrains, enhancing terrain adaptability for the controller. We conduct experiments in both simulation and real-world experiments in Unitree G1 robots. The results show that our method exhibits strong adaptability across various situations and terrains.
Humanoid Everyday: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset for Open-World Humanoid Manipulation
Humanoid Everyday：用于开放世界人形机器人操作的综合机器人数据集
从基础步态到灵巧操作，人形机器人在展示复杂全身能力方面取得了显著进展。然而，当前大多数机器人学习数据集和基准主要关注静止的机械臂，而现有的人形机器人数据集要么局限于固定环境，要么任务多样性有限，通常缺乏人-人形机器人交互及下肢步态动作。此外，针对基于学习的策略在人形机器人数据上的标准化评测也较为缺乏。
为此，本文提出 Humanoid Everyday，一个大规模、多样化的人形机器人操作数据集。该数据集涵盖丰富任务类型，包括灵巧物体操作、人-人形机器人交互、步态整合操作等。通过高效的人类监督遥操作流程，Humanoid Everyday 聚合了高质量的多模态感知数据，包括 RGB、深度图、LiDAR 以及触觉信息，并结合自然语言注释，生成 10,300 条轨迹，超过 300 万帧数据，涵盖 260 个任务，分属于 7 大类别。
我们还对数据集上的代表性策略学习方法进行了分析，揭示其在不同任务类别中的优势与局限性。为实现标准化评测，我们构建了基于云端的评测平台，使研究人员能够在可控环境中无缝部署策略并获取性能反馈。通过发布 Humanoid Everyday 数据集、策略学习分析结果及标准化的云端评测平台，我们旨在推动通用人形机器人操作的研究，并为具备更高能力与实体感的机器人智能体在真实环境中的应用奠定基础。
我们的数据采集使用了两款 Unitree 人形机器人：G1（29 自由度，配备 7 自由度三指灵巧手 Dex3-1）和 H1（27 自由度，配备 6 自由度 INSPIRE 手）。G1 与 H1 均配备 Intel RealSense RGB-D 相机和 Livox LiDAR 系统。此外，G1 的 Dex3-1 灵巧手带有触觉传感器，进一步增强了数据集的多模态特性。
数据集、数据采集代码及云评测网站已公开，项目网址为：https://humanoideveryday.github.io
From loco-motion to dextrous manipulation, humanoid robots have made remarkable strides in demonstrating complex full-body capabilities. However, the majority of current robot learning datasets and benchmarks mainly focus on stationary robot arms, and the few existing humanoid datasets are either confined to fixed environments or limited in task diversity, often lacking human-humanoid interaction and lowerbody locomotion. Moreover, there are a few standardized evaluation platforms for benchmarking learning-based policies on humanoid data. In this work, we present Humanoid Everyday, a large-scale and diverse humanoid manipulation dataset characterized by extensive task variety involving dextrous object manipulation, human-humanoid interaction, locomotionintegrated actions, and more. Leveraging a highly efficient human-supervised teleoperation pipeline, Humanoid Everyday aggregates high-quality multimodal sensory data—including RGB, depth, LiDAR, and tactile inputs—together with natural language annotations, comprising 10.3k trajectories and over 3 million frames of data across 260 tasks across 7 broad categories In addition, we conduct an analysis of representative policy learning methods on our dataset, providing insights into their strengths and limitations across different task categories. For standardized evaluation, we introduce a cloud-based evaluation platform that allows researchers to seamlessly deploy their policies in our controlled setting and receive performance feedback. By releasing Humanoid Everyday along with our policy learning analysis and a standardized cloud-based evaluation platform, we intend to advance research in general-purpose humanoid manipulation and lay the groundwork for more capable and embodied robotic agents in real-world scenarios. Our dataset, data collection code, and cloud evaluation website are made publicly available on our project website: https: //humanoideveryday.github.io
We gather data with two Unitree humanoid robots: the 29-degrees of freedom (DoF) G1 with 7-DoF three-fingered dexterous hands (Dex3-1) and the 27-DoF H1 with 6-DoF INSPIRE hands. Both the H1 and G1 humanoid robots are equipped with Intel RealSense RGB-D cameras and a Livox LiDAR system. In addition, the G1’s Dex3-1 hands possess tactile sensors, which further enhances the multimodality of our dataset.
SPIDER: Scalable Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
SPIDER：可扩展的基于物理的灵巧重定向
学习用于人形机器人及灵巧手控制的灵巧与敏捷策略，需要大量示范数据，但收集针对特定机器人的数据成本极高。相比之下，丰富的人类动作数据可以通过动作捕捉、视频以及虚拟现实轻松获得。然而，由于人类与机器人在形态上的差异（embodiment gap）以及缺失如力和扭矩等动态信息，这些示范数据无法直接在机器人上执行。
为此，我们提出 Scalable Physics-Informed DExterous Retargeting（SPIDER），一种基于物理的重定向框架，用于将仅包含运动学信息的人类示范大规模转化为动态可行的机器人轨迹，并进行增强。我们的核心理念是：人类示范应提供全局任务结构和目标，而大规模基于物理的采样结合课程式虚拟接触引导（curriculum-style virtual contact guidance）则用于精炼轨迹，以确保动态可行性和正确的接触顺序。
SPIDER 可扩展至 9 种不同的人形/灵巧手机器人形态 和 6 个数据集，与标准采样方法相比，成功率提升 18%，同时速度比强化学习（RL）基线快 10 倍。该方法能够生成一个包含 240 万帧的动态可行机器人数据集，用于策略学习。通过在大规模上对齐人类动作与机器人可行性，SPIDER 为人形机器人及灵巧手控制提供了通用、与具体机器人形态无关的基础。
作为一种通用重定向方法，SPIDER 可处理多种质量水平的数据，包括单 RGB 摄像头的视频，同时可应用于真实机器人部署以及其他下游学习方法（如 RL），从而实现高效的闭环策略学习。
Learning dexterous and agile policy for humanoid and dexterous hand control requires large-scale demonstrations, but collecting robot-specific data is prohibitively expensive. In contrast, abundant human motion data is readily available from motion capture, videos, and virtual reality. Due to the embodiment gap and missing dynamic information like force and torque, these demonstrations cannot be directly executed on robots. We propose Scalable Physics-Informed DExterous Retargeting (SPIDER), a physics-based retargeting framework to transform and augment kinematic-only human demonstrations to dynamically feasible robot trajectories at scale. Our key insight is that human demonstrations should provide global task structure and objective, while large-scale physics-based sampling with curriculum-style virtual contact guidance should refine trajectories to ensure dynamical feasibility and correct contact sequences. SPIDER scales across diverse 9 humanoid/dexterous hand embodiments and 6 datasets, improving success rates by 18% compared to standard sampling, while being 10× faster than reinforcement learning (RL) baselines, and enabling the generation of a 2.4M frames dynamic-feasible robot dataset for policy learning. By aligning human motion and robot feasibility at scale, SPIDER offers a general, embodiment-agnostic foundation for humanoid and dexterous hand control. As a universal retargeting method, SPIDER can work with diverse quality data, including single RGB camera video and can be applied to real robot deployment and other downstream learning methods like RL to enable efficient closed-loop policy learning.
BFM-Zero: A Promptable Behavioral Foundation Model for Humanoid Control Using Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
BFM-Zero：一种基于无监督强化学习的人形机器人控制的可提示行为基础模型
为人形机器人构建 行为基础模型（Behavioral Foundation Models, BFMs） 有望将多样化的控制任务统一在单一、可提示的通用策略下。然而，现有方法要么仅在仿真人形角色中部署，要么专注于特定任务（如动作追踪）。
我们提出 BFM-Zero，一个学习共享潜在表示的框架，将动作、目标与奖励嵌入到统一空间中，使单一策略能够通过提示执行多种下游任务，而无需重新训练。BFM-Zero 的这种结构化潜在空间，使得机器人能够在真实环境中展示多样化、稳健的全身技能。具体而言，在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上，BFM-Zero 可通过多种推理方法实现零样本动作追踪、目标达成、奖励推断，以及少量样本的基于优化的适应。
与传统的基于策略的强化学习框架不同，BFM-Zero 基于最新的无监督强化学习与前向-后向（Forward-Backward, FB）模型，为全身动作提供目标导向、可解释且平滑的潜在表示。我们进一步通过关键的奖励塑形、域随机化以及历史依赖的不对称学习策略来缩小仿真到真实的差距。这些设计选择在仿真环境中进行了定量消融分析。
作为首个此类模型，BFM-Zero 为可扩展、可提示的全身人形机器人行为基础模型奠定了重要基础。
Building Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) for humanoid robots has the potential to unify diverse control tasks under a single, promptable generalist policy. However, existing approaches are either exclusively deployed on simulated humanoid characters, or specialized to specific tasks such as tracking. We propose BFM-Zero, a framework that learns an effective shared latent representation that embeds motions, goals, and rewards into a common space, enabling a single policy to be prompted for multiple downstream tasks without retraining. This well-structured latent space in BFM-Zero enables versatile and robust whole-body skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid in the real world, via diverse inference methods, including zero-shot motion tracking, goal reaching, and reward inference, and few-shot optimization-based adaptation. Unlike prior on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) frameworks, BFM-Zero builds upon recent advancements in unsupervised RL and Forward-Backward (FB) models, which offer an objective-centric, explainable, and smooth latent representation of whole-body motions. We further extend BFM-Zero with critical reward shaping, domain randomization, and history-dependent asymmetric learning to bridge the sim-to-real gap. Those key design choices are quantitatively ablated in simulation. A first-of-its-kind model, BFM-Zero establishes a step toward scalable, promptable behavioral foundation models for wholebody humanoid control.
In-N-On: Scaling Egocentric Manipulation with in-the-wild and on-task Data
In-N-On：利用自然情境和任务中数据评估以自我为中心的操纵行为
第一人称视角视频是学习机器人操作策略的一类宝贵且具可扩展性的数据来源。然而，由于其高度异质性，现有方法往往只将人类数据用于简单的预训练，无法充分挖掘其潜力。本文提出了一套可扩展的第一人称视角数据采集与使用流程，将人类数据系统性划分为 真实环境中的 in-the-wild 数据 与 任务相关的 on-task 数据，并详细分析如何有效利用这些数据。
我们构建了 PHSD 数据集，其中包含超过 1000 小时的多样化 in-the-wild 视频以及超过 20 小时与目标操作任务直接对应的 on-task 数据。基于该数据集，我们训练了一个以语言指令为条件的大规模第一人称视角流匹配策略模型——Human0。通过领域自适应技术，Human0 有效缩小了人类与人形机器人之间的差异。
实验结果表明，Human0 在大规模人类数据的支持下具备多项新能力，包括：从纯人类数据中学习执行语言指令、少样本学习能力，以及通过 on-task 数据提升的鲁棒性。此外，我们还在真实的 Unitree H1 人形机器人以及配备 五指灵巧手的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上对 Human0 进行了评估，验证了模型在真实场景中的有效性。
Egocentric videos are a valuable and scalable data source to learn manipulation policies. However, due to significant data heterogeneity, most existing approaches utilize human data for simple pre-training, which does not unlock its full potential. This paper first provides a scalable recipe for collecting and using egocentric data by categorizing human data into two categories: in-the-wild and on-task alongside with systematic analysis on how to use the data. We first curate a dataset, PHSD, which contains over 1,000 hours of diverse in-the-wild egocentric data and over 20 hours of on-task data directly aligned to the target manipulation tasks. This enables learning a large egocentric language-conditioned flow matching policy, Human0. With domain adaptation techniques, Human0 minimizes the gap between humans and humanoids. Empirically, we show Human0 achieves several novel properties from scaling human data, including language following of instructions from only human data, few-shot learning, and improved robustness using on-task data. We evaluate Human0 on a real Unitree H1 humanoid and a Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with 5-fingered dexterous hands.
ToggleMimic: A Two-Stage Policy for Text-Driven Humanoid Whole-Body Control
ToggleMimic：一种基于文本驱动的人形全身控制的两阶段策略
为了让人形机器人能够更自然地与人类互动并无缝融入日常生活，自然语言是一种至关重要的交流媒介。尽管近年来的模仿学习研究使机器人能够通过专家示范学习复杂动作，但传统方法往往依赖严格的任务描述或单一模态输入，限制了机器人理解高层语义指令（如自然语言命令）以及动态切换动作的能力。如何将自然语言直接转化为可执行的控制指令仍然是一大挑战。
为此，我们提出 ToggleMimic ——一种从文本指令直接生成机器人动作的端到端模仿学习框架，实现了基于语言的多任务控制。与难以泛化的端到端方法或缺乏灵活性的单动作模型不同，ToggleMimic 的核心优势体现在以下三点：
两阶段策略蒸馏，有效缩小模拟与真实之间的差距；
轻量级跨注意力机制，实现可解释的文本到动作映射；
门控网络机制，增强模型对语言表达变化的鲁棒性。
大量的仿真与真实机器人实验验证了该框架的有效性、泛化能力及其稳健的文本驱动控制性能。实验测试平台为 23 自由度的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。本研究为跨模态语义驱动的自主机器人控制提供了一种高效、可解释且具备良好可扩展性的学习范式。
For humanoid robots to interact naturally with humans and seamlessly integrate into daily life, natural language serves as an essential communication medium. While recent advances in imitation learning have enabled robots to acquire complex motions through expert demonstration, traditional approaches often rely on rigid task specifications or single-modal inputs, limiting their ability to interpret high-level semantic instructions (e.g., natural language commands) or dynamically switch between actions. Directly translating natural language into executable control commands remains a significant challenge. To address this, we propose ToggleMimic, an end-to-end imitation learning framework that generates robotic motions from textual instructions, enabling language-driven multi-task control. In contrast to end-to-end methods that struggle with generalization or single-action models that lack flexibility, our ToggleMimic framework uniquely combines the following: (1) a two-stage policy distillation that efficiently bridges the sim-to-real gap, (2) a lightweight cross-attention mechanism for interpretable text-to-action mapping, and (3) a gating network that enhances robustness to linguistic variations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the framework’s effectiveness, generalization capability, and robust text-guided control performance. The testing device was a 23-DOF Unitree G1. This work establishes an efficient, interpretable, and scalable learning paradigm for cross-modal semantic-driven autonomous robot control.
SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
SONIC：超大尺寸动作追踪，实现自然的人形全身控制
尽管当下已有规模达到数十亿参数、在成千上万张 GPU 上训练的基础模型，但在人形机器人控制领域，尚未出现类似的可扩展性提升。当前用于人形机器人的神经控制器规模仍然有限，只能覆盖少量行为模式，并且通常只能在少数 GPU 上训练数天。我们展示了：通过同时扩大模型容量、数据规模与计算量，可以构建出能够生成自然且稳健全身动作的通用人形机器人控制器。
具体而言，我们将 动作追踪（motion tracking） 视为一种自然且可扩展的人形控制任务，利用多样化动作捕捉数据中的稠密监督信号，无需手工设计奖励，即可获取人类动作先验。我们通过三个方向扩大规模来构建动作追踪基础模型：网络规模（从 120 万到 4200 万参数）、数据量（超过 1 亿帧、700 小时的高质量动作数据）、以及计算量（9000 GPU 小时）。
在验证可扩展性带来的收益之外，我们通过两个机制展示模型的实际价值：（1）一个实时的通用运动学规划器，将动作追踪无缝连接至下游任务执行，实现自然、交互式的控制；（2）一个统一的 token 空间，可支持多种动作输入接口，包括 VR 远程操控设备、人类视频，以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，且均可使用同一策略进行控制。
在大规模下进行动作追踪表现出良好的性质：性能会随计算量与数据多样性的提升而稳定提高，所学习的表征也能够泛化至未见过的动作。这说明 大规模动作追踪 是构建人形机器人控制基础模型的一条切实可行的路径。我们使用 Unitree G1 人形机器人（Unitree, 2024） 展示了我们提出的大规模人形动作追踪框架 SONIC 的效果。
Despite the rise of billion-parameter foundation models trained across thousands of GPUs, similar scaling gains have not been shown for humanoid control. Current neural controllers for humanoids remain modest in size, target a limited behavior set, and are trained on a handful of GPUs over several days. We show that scaling up model capacity, data, and compute yields a generalist humanoid controller capable of creating natural and robust whole-body movements. Specifically, we posit motion tracking as a natural and scalable task for humanoid control, leverageing dense supervision from diverse motion-capture data to acquire human motion priors without manual reward engineering. We build a foundation model for motion tracking by scaling along three axes: network size (from 1.2M to 42M parameters), dataset volume (over 100M frames, 700 hours of high-quality motion data), and compute (9k GPU hours). Beyond demonstrating the benefits of scale, we show the practical utility of our model through two mechanisms: (1) a real-time universal kinematic planner that bridges motion tracking to downstream task execution, enabling natural and interactive control, and (2) a unified token space that supports various motion input interfaces, such as VR teleoperation devices, human videos, and vision-language-action (VLA) models, all using the same policy. Scaling motion tracking exhibits favorable properties: performance improves steadily with increased compute and data diversity, and learned representations generalize to unseen motions, establishing motion tracking at scale as a practical foundation for humanoid control. We use the Unitree G1 humanoid (Unitree, 2024) to demonstrate our supersizing humanoid motion tracking framework, SONIC.
Switch-JustDance: Benchmarking Whole-Body Motion Tracking Policies Using a Commercial Console Game
Switch-JustDance：使用商业主机游戏对全身动作追踪策略进行基准测试
随着全身控制技术的快速发展，人形机器人和足式机器人已经能够执行越来越灵活且协调的动作。然而，在真实环境中对这些能力进行标准化评测，并与人类进行直接对比的基准仍然十分匮乏。现有评估通常依赖预采集的人体动作数据或纯模拟实验，这不仅限制了可重复性，也忽视了硬件差异，并妨碍了公平的人机比较。
我们提出 Switch-JustDance，一种低成本且可重复的基准评测流程，利用任天堂 Switch 平台上的体感游戏 Just Dance 来评估机器人全身控制性能。以 Just Dance 为代表平台，Switch-JustDance 将游戏中的舞蹈动作通过流式传输、动作重建与动作重定向模块转化为机器人可执行的运动，并允许用户使用游戏内置的评分系统来评估控制器表现。
我们首先验证了 Just Dance 的评估属性，包括其可靠性、效度、敏感性以及潜在偏差来源。结果表明，该平台能够提供一致且易解释的性能指标，使其成为具备代表性的 embodied AI 基准工具。基于此，我们在真实硬件上对三种最先进的人形全身控制器进行基准评测，并分析其相对优势与局限性。
依托任天堂 Switch 上的 Just Dance，我们的系统不仅能够通过游戏评分直接实现人机性能对比，还可结合开源动作捕捉与动作重定向模块，在 Unitree G1 上实现实时执行。
Recent advances in whole-body robot control have enabled humanoid and legged robots to perform increasingly agile and coordinated motions. However, standardized benchmarks for evaluating these capabilities in realworld settings, and in direct comparison to humans, remain scarce. Existing evaluations often rely on pre-collected human motion datasets or simulation-based experiments, which limit reproducibility, overlook hardware factors, and hinder fair human–robot comparisons. We present SwitchJustDance, a low-cost and reproducible benchmarking pipeline that leverages motion-sensing console games, Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch, to evaluate robot wholebody control. Using Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch as a representative platform, Switch-JustDance converts ingame choreography into robot-executable motions through streaming, motion reconstruction, and motion retargeting modules and enables users to evaluate controller performance through the game’s built-in scoring system. We first validate the evaluation properties of Just Dance, analyzing its reliability, validity, sensitivity, and potential sources of bias. Our results show that the platform provides consistent and interpretable performance measures, making it a suitable tool for benchmarking embodied AI. Building on this foundation, we benchmark three state-of-the-art humanoid whole-body controllers on hardware and provide insights into their relative strengths and limitations. Using Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch, our system enables direct comparison between robots and humans through in-game scores while integrating open-source motion capture and retargeting modules for real-time execution on a Unitree G1.
HMC: Learning Heterogeneous Meta-Control for Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation
HMC：学习用于接触丰富的运动操作的异构元控制
从真实世界的机器人演示中学习，为机器人在复杂环境中进行交互带来了巨大潜力。然而，由于交互动态具有高度复杂性和多变性，仅依赖位置控制的策略往往难以在接触场景或负载变化中保持稳定表现。为了解决这一问题，我们提出 Heterogeneous Meta-Control (HMC) 异构元控制框架，用于整合运动—操作（loco-manipulation）任务中的多种控制方式：位置控制、阻抗控制以及混合力-位控制，并能够在执行过程中自适应切换。
我们首先提出 HMC-Controller 接口，用于在力矩空间中连续融合来自不同控制模式的动作。该接口同时支持远程操作与策略部署。为了学习一个具备力觉感知能力的鲁棒策略，我们进一步提出 HMC-Policy，将多种控制器统一进一个异构架构中。该策略采用类似“专家混合（mixture-of-experts）”的路由机制，使其既能从大规模仅位置数据中学习，又能有效吸收精细的力觉示范数据。
我们在 Unitree G1（优特机器人 G1） 上进行了实验，该机器人配备两条 7 自由度机械臂，用于执行运动-操作任务。实物实验表明，在诸如柔顺擦桌子、拉开抽屉等具有高接触依赖性的挑战任务中，HMC 取得了 超过 50% 的相对性能提升，验证了框架的有效性。
Learning from real-world robot demonstrations holds promise for interacting with complex real-world environments. However, the complexity and variability of interaction dynamics often cause purely positional controllers to struggle with contacts or varying payloads. To address this, we propose a Heterogeneous Meta-Control (HMC) framework for Loco-Manipulation that adaptively stitches multiple control modalities: position, impedance, and hybrid force-position. We first introduce an interface, HMC-Controller, for blending actions from different control profiles continuously in the torque space. HMC-Controller facilitates both teleoperation and policy deployment. Then, to learn a robust force-aware policy, we propose HMC-Policy to unify different controllers into a heterogeneous architecture. We adopt a mixture-ofexperts style routing to learn from large-scale position-only data and fine-grained force-aware demonstrations. We conduct experiments using the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, equipped with two 7-DoF arms for locomanipulation tasks. Experiments on a real humanoid robot show over 50% relative improvement vs. baselines on challenging tasks such as compliant table wiping and drawer opening, demonstrating the efficacy of HMC.
RoboCOIN: An Open-Sourced Bimanual Robotic Data COllection for INtegrated Manipulation
RoboCOIN：用于集成操作的开源双手动机器人数据采集系统
双臂操作（Bimanual manipulation）对于实现类人机器人的灵巧性至关重要，但由于不同机器人平台之间的硬件差异，大规模且多样化的双臂机器人数据集依然十分匮乏。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出 RoboCOIN —— 一个涵盖多种机器人形态的大规模双臂操作数据集，包含超过 18 万条示范数据，来自 15 种不同机器人平台。该数据集覆盖 16 种真实场景（包括家居、商业与工作环境），并包含 421 项任务，这些任务按照双臂协作模式与物体属性进行系统化组织。
我们的核心创新是构建了一个 分层能力金字塔（hierarchical capability pyramid），提供多层级标注信息，涵盖：
轨迹级概念（trajectory-level concepts）
片段级子任务（segment-level subtasks）
帧级运动学信息（frame-level kinematics）
此外，我们提出 CoRobot —— 一个完整的数据处理框架，包含：
基于 RTML（Robot Trajectory Markup Language）的质量评估
自动化标注生成
多机器人形态的一体化管理
大量实验表明，RoboCOIN 在多机器人平台的双臂学习中具有高度可靠性和有效性，并能在不同模型架构和机器人设备上取得显著性能提升。该数据集及其配套框架均已开源，向研究社区全面开放，用于推动未来研究。
Bimanual manipulation is essential for achieving human-like dexterity in robots, but the large-scale and diverse bimanual robot datasets remain scarce due to hardware heterogeneity across robotic platforms. To address the challenge, we present RoboCOIN, a comprehensive multi-embodiment bimanual manipulation dataset with over 180,000 demonstrations collected from 15 distinct robotic platforms. The dataset covers 16 scenarios, including residential, commercial, and working environments, with 421 tasks systematically organized by bimanual coordination patterns and object properties. Our key innovation is a hierarchical capability pyramid that provides multi-level annotations, spanning trajectory-level concepts, segment-level subtasks, and frame-level kinematics. We further develop CoRobot, a comprehensive processing framework featuring Robot Trajectory Markup Language (RTML) for quality assessment, automated annotation generation, and unified multi-embodiment management. Extensive experiments demonstrate the reliability and effectiveness of RoboCOIN in multi-embodiment bimanual learning, with significant performance improvements across various model architectures and robotic platforms. The complete dataset and framework are open-sourced and publicly available for further research purposes.
From Power to Precision: Learning Fine-grained Dexterity for Multi-fingered Robotic Hands
从力量到精准：学习多指机器人手的精细灵巧性
人类的抓取方式大致可以分为两类：包络式抓取（power grasps） 与 精细抓取（precision grasps）。精细抓取是实现工具使用的关键能力，被认为在人类进化中发挥了重要作用。尽管如今的多指灵巧手在执行包络式抓取方面表现出色，但在需要高精度操作的任务中，并行夹爪（parallel grippers）仍然更常被采用。这一现象凸显出现有机器人手设计中的核心局限：难以在同一套硬件中兼具稳固的力量抓取与高精度、细粒度操控能力。
在本工作中，我们通过联合优化控制策略与硬件设计，弥合这一能力鸿沟，使多指灵巧手同时具备力量抓取与精细操作能力。与其重新设计整个机械手，我们提出一种轻量化的指尖几何结构改进方法，将其抽象为一个可调的接触平面，并对其几何参数与对应控制策略进行联合优化。
在控制方面，我们提出了一种能够在力量抓取与精细操作之间动态切换的控制策略，并将精细操作简化为“拇指–食指的平行对指”动作，使其在现实场景中具备更强的鲁棒性并更容易进行 sim-to-real 迁移。
在设计方面，我们基于大规模仿真，通过**可微神经物理代理模型（differentiable neural-physics surrogate model）**优化指尖几何结构，以提升精细操控性能。
我们在仿真到现实（sim-to-real）和现实到现实（real-to-real）两种环境中进行了全面验证。本方法在两套平台上进行测试：
XArm 机械臂 + XHand 灵巧手（7+12 自由度，简称 xArm）
Unitree G1 人形机器人 + Inspire 灵巧手（7+6 自由度，简称 G1）
在 sim-to-real 精细抓取任务中，我们的系统在未见过的物体上达到了 82.5% 的零样本成功率，并在面包夹取等具有挑战性的真实任务中取得了 93.3% 的成功率。
这些结果表明，我们提出的协同设计框架能够显著提升多指灵巧手的精细操控能力，同时保持其原有的力量抓取能力，使其具备更加通用且实用的操作性能。
Human grasps can be roughly categorized into two types: power grasps and precision grasps. Precision grasping enables tool use and is believed to have influenced human evolution. Today’s multi-fingered robotic hands are effective in power grasps, but for tasks requiring precision, parallel grippers are still more widely adopted. This contrast highlights a key limitation in current robotic hand design: the difficulty of achieving both stable power grasps and precise, fine-grained manipulation within a single, versatile system. In this work, we bridge this gap by jointly optimizing the control and hardware design of a multi-fingered dexterous hand, enabling both power and precision manipulation. Rather than redesigning the entire hand, we introduce a lightweight fingertip geometry modification, represent it as a contact plane, and jointly optimize its parameters along with the corresponding control. Our control strategy dynamically switches between power and precision manipulation and simplifies precision control into parallel thumb–index motions, which proves robust for sim-to-real transfer. On the design side, we leverage largescale simulation to optimize the fingertip geometry using a differentiable neural-physics surrogate model. We validate our approach through extensive experiments in both sim-to-real and real-to-real settings. Our method is validated on two platforms: XArm robotic arm + XHand dexterous hand (7+12 DOFs, referred to as xArm below), as well as Unitree G1 Humanoid + Inspire dexterous hand (7+6 DOFs, referred to as G1 below). Our method achieves an 82.5% zeroshot success rate on unseen objects in sim-to-real precision grasping, and a 93.3% success rate in challenging real-world tasks involving bread pinching. These results demonstrate that our co-design framework can significantly enhance the fine- grained manipulation ability of multi-fingered hands without reducing their ability for power grasps.
CLONE: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation for Long-Horizon Tasks
CLONE：用于长时程任务的闭环全身人形机器人远程操控
人形机器人远程操控在展示复杂的人形体–场景交互以及采集相关数据中具有关键作用。然而，现有的远程操控系统仍面临核心瓶颈：为了保证稳定性，它们通常将上半身与下半身控制解耦，限制了自然的全身协调；并且缺乏闭环位姿反馈，导致控制呈现开环特性，使用过程中会不断累积位置漂移。根本挑战在于：如何在保持全局位置精确性的同时，实现精确、协调且可长时间维持的全身远程操控。
本研究提出 CLONE，一种基于专家混合（MoE）的闭环远程操控系统，通过引入实时误差校正机制，显著提升全身操控的精确性与稳定性，仅依赖混合现实（MR）头显的头部与手部跟踪即可在长时间任务中保持极低的位姿漂移。与以往方法相比，CLONE 既不会为稳定性牺牲协调性，也不会因缺乏反馈而导致漂移无界积累。它能够学习多样化的全身运动技能，并通过实时反馈有效抑制跟踪误差，使系统能够完成如“从地面拾取物体”等复杂协调动作。
我们在 Unitree G1 实体人形机器人上对 CLONE 进行了系统性评估，实验结果表明其在全身运动逼真度与精确位置跟踪方面均达到了前所未有的水平，为面向长时人形体–场景交互任务的全身远程操控设立了新的基准。
Humanoid teleoperation plays a vital role in demonstrating and collecting data for complex humanoid-scene interactions. However, current teleoperation systems face critical limitations: they decouple upper- and lower-body control to maintain stability, restricting natural coordination, and operate open-loop without real-time position feedback, leading to accumulated drift. The fundamental challenge is achieving precise, coordinated whole-body teleoperation over extended durations while maintaining accurate global positioning. Here we show that an MoE-based teleoperation system, CLONE, with closed-loop error correction enables unprecedented whole-body teleoperation fidelity, maintaining minimal positional drift over long-range trajectories using only head and hand tracking from an MR headset. Unlike previous methods that either sacrifice coordination for stability or suffer from unbounded drift, CLONE learns diverse motion skills while preventing tracking error accumulation through real-time feedback, enabling complex coordinated movements such as “picking up objects from the ground.” These results establish a new milestone for whole-body humanoid teleoperation for longhorizon humanoid-scene interaction tasks. We evaluated CLONE on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid through comprehensive experiments demonstrating exceptional whole-body motion fidelity and precise position tracking.
Humanoid Goalkeeper: Learning from Position Conditioned Task-Motion Constraints
人形守门员：从位置条件任务运动约束中学习
我们提出了一种用于真实场景中类人机器人自主守门的强化学习框架。尽管以往研究已经在四足机器人上展示了类似能力，但类人机器人守门面临两个关键挑战：（1）如何生成自然、类人的全身动作；（2）在相同反应时间内覆盖更宽的防守范围。与依赖分离式遥操作或固定动作跟踪的传统方法不同，我们的方法学习一个端到端的单一强化学习策略，使机器人能够完全自主地执行高度动态且自然的机器人–物体交互。
为实现这一点，我们通过对抗式训练，将多个基于感知输入的人体动作先验融入强化学习过程。真实世界实验表明，类人机器人能够敏捷、自主且自然地拦截高速飞行的球体。除了守门，我们还展示了方法在“避球”“抓球”等任务中的泛化能力。
本工作为实现机器人与动态物体间的高动态交互提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，推动机器人行为更具适应性和生命感。更多细节（包括视频与代码实现）请参见我们的项目主页与 GitHub 仓库。
我们所有的真实机器人实验均在 Unitree G1 类人机器人上完成。
We present a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous goalkeeping with humanoid robots in real-world scenarios. While prior work has demonstrated similar capabilities on quadrupedal platforms, humanoid goalkeeping introduces two critical challenges: (1) generating natural, human-like whole-body motions, and (2) covering a wider guarding range with an equivalent response time. Unlike existing approaches that rely on separate teleoperation or fixed motion tracking for whole-body control, our method learns a single end-to-end RL policy, enabling fully autonomous, highly dynamic, and human-like robot-object interactions. To achieve this, we integrate multiple human motion priors conditioned on perceptual inputs into the RL training via an adversarial scheme. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through real-world experiments, where the humanoid robot successfully performs agile, autonomous, and naturalistic interceptions of fast-moving balls. In addition to goalkeeping, we demonstrate the generalization of our approach through tasks such as ball escaping and grabbing. Our work presents a practical and scalable solution for enabling highly dynamic interactions between robots and moving objects, advancing the field toward more adaptive and lifelike robotic behaviors. More details, including videos and implementation, are available on our project website and GitHub repository.
We conduct all real-world experiments using the Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
METIS: Multi-Source Egocentric Training for Integrated Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Model
METIS：多源自我中心训练，用于整合灵巧视觉-语言-动作模型
构建一类能够在多种任务中进行感知、推理与行动的通用机器人仍然是一项未解难题，尤其是在灵巧操作领域。其主要瓶颈在于：用于训练灵巧技能的大规模、带动作标注的数据极其稀缺，而远程操作（teleoperation）本身又困难且成本高昂。相比之下，人类数据拥有海量规模与多样化的操作行为，为学习机器人动作提供了丰富的先验。尽管已有研究尝试利用人类示范数据，但通常受限于场景单一，以及人与机器人在视觉上的巨大差异。
为突破这些限制，我们提出 METIS —— 一种面向灵巧操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，基于多来源的第一视角（egocentric）数据进行预训练。我们首先构建 EgoAtlas，整合来自多种来源的大规模人类与机器人数据，并将其统一到一致的动作空间中。进一步地，我们提取 运动感知动力学（motion-aware dynamics），这是一种紧凑且离散化的运动表征，可为 VLA 训练提供高效且具表现力的监督信号。
在此基础上，METIS 将推理与行动整合入统一框架，从而能够高效部署到各类下游灵巧操作任务中。硬件方面，我们采用 Unitree G1 类人机器人，并配备一对 Inspire 六自由度灵巧手以实现精细操作。
我们的方法在六项真实世界任务中均取得了最高的平均成功率，展现出卓越的灵巧操作能力。实验结果还表明，METIS 在处理分布外场景时具有更强的泛化性与鲁棒性。上述成果表明，METIS 是迈向灵巧操作通用模型的重要一步。
Building a generalist robot that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse tasks remains an open challenge, especially for dexterous manipulation. A major bottleneck lies in the scarcity of large-scale, action-annotated data for dexterous skills, as teleoperation is difficult and costly. Human data, with its vast scale and diverse manipulation behaviors, provides rich priors for learning robotic actions. While prior works have explored leveraging human demonstrations, they are often constrained by limited scenarios and a large visual gap between human and robots. To eliminate these limitations, we propose METIS, a vision-language-action (VLA) model for dexterous manipulation pretrained on multi-source egocentric datasets. We first construct EgoAtlas, which integrates large-scale human and robotic data from multiple sources, all unified under a consistent action space. We further extract motion-aware dynamics, a compact and discretized motion representation, which provides efficient and expressive supervision for VLA training. Built upon them, METIS integrates reasoning and acting into a unified framework, enabling effective deployment to downstream dexterous manipulation tasks. For hardware platform, we use a Unitree G1 humanoid robot equipped with a pair of Inspire 6-DoF dexterous hands for fine-grained manipulation.Our method demonstrates exceptional dexterous manipulation capabilities, achieving highest average success rate in six real-world tasks. Experimental results also highlight the superior generalization and robustness to out-of-distribution scenarios. These findings emphasize METIS as a promising step toward a generalist model for dexterous manipulation.
Unveiling the Impact of Data and Model Scaling on High-Level Control for Humanoid Robots
揭示数据和模型扩展对人形机器人高级控制的影响
数据规模长期以来一直是机器人学习的关键瓶颈。对于类人机器人而言，人类视频与动作数据数量庞大且获取便利，为学习提供了免费且大规模的数据来源。此外，与动作相关的语义信息有助于不同模态之间的对齐，并推动高层次机器人控制的学习。然而，如何高效挖掘原始视频、提取机器人可学习的表征，并将其用于可扩展的学习，仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。
为此，我们提出 Humanoid-Union，这是一个通过自主构建的数据生成流水线得到的大规模数据集，包含超过 260 小时多样且高质量的类人机器人运动数据，并从人类动作视频中自动生成语义标注。该数据集可通过相同管线进一步扩展。
在此数据资源基础上，我们提出 SCHUR，一个可扩展的学习框架，旨在系统研究大规模数据对于类人机器人高层控制的影响。我们所有实验均在 29 自由度版本的 Unitree G1 上进行。
实验结果表明，在数据与模型规模扩展的情况下，SCHUR 在机器人运动生成质量和文本-动作对齐方面均取得显著提升：相比先前方法，平均关节位置误差（MPJPE）重建性能提升 37%，弗里歇特距离（FID）对齐指标提升 25%。此外，我们还在真实的类人机器人上部署验证了 SCHUR 的有效性。
Data scaling has long remained a critical bottleneck in robot learning. For humanoid robots, human videos and motion data are abundant and widely available, offering a free and large-scale data source. Besides, the semantics related to the motions enable modality alignment and high-level robot control learning. However, how to effectively mine raw video, extract robot-learnable representations, and leverage them for scalable learning remains an open problem. To address this, we introduce Humanoid-Union, a large-scale dataset generated through an autonomous pipeline, comprising over 260 hours of diverse, high-quality humanoid robot motion data with semantic annotations derived from human motion videos. The dataset can be further expanded via the same pipeline. Building on this data resource, we propose SCHUR, a scalable learning framework designed to explore the impact of large-scale data on high-level control in humanoid robots.All our experiments are conducted on the 29-DoF version of the Unitree G1. Experimental results demonstrate that SCHUR achieves high robot motion generation quality and strong text-motion alignment under data and model scaling, with 37% reconstruction improvement under MPJPE and 25% alignment improvement under FID comparing with previous methods. Its effectiveness is further validated through deployment in real-world humanoid robot.
HAFO: Humanoid Force-Adaptive Control for Intense External Force Interaction Environments
HAFO：用于强外部力交互环境的人形体力自适应控制
强化学习（RL）控制器在类人机器人行走和轻载操作方面已取得显著进展。然而，在强力交互条件下实现稳健且高精度的动作控制仍然面临巨大挑战。基于上述局限性，本文提出 HAFO——一种双智能体强化学习控制框架，通过在外部力交互环境下的耦合训练，同时优化稳健的行走策略与精确的上半身操作策略。
同时，我们通过弹簧—阻尼系统显式建模外部牵引扰动，并通过操控虚拟弹簧实现细粒度的力控制。在这一过程中，强化学习策略能够利用环境反馈，自主生成抗扰响应。此外，HAFO 引入一种非对称 Actor-Critic 架构：Critic 网络能够访问包含特权信息的弹簧阻尼力，从而指导 Actor 网络学习在外部扰动下具备良好泛化能力与鲁棒性的策略。
我们将 HAFO 策略部署于真实的 Unitree G1 类人机器人上，并进行了多组硬件实验。实验结果表明，HAFO 能够在人与环境的多种强力交互条件下实现稳定控制，在执行负载任务时表现优异，并能在绳索张力扰动下保持机器人的稳健运行。
Reinforcement learning (RL) controllers have made impressive progress in humanoid locomotion and light load manipulation. However, achieving robust and precise motion with strong force interaction remains a significant challenge. Based on the above limitations, this paper proposes HAFO, a dual-agent reinforcement learning control framework that simultaneously optimizes both a robust locomotion strategy and a precise upper-body manipulation strategy through coupled training under external force interaction environments. Simultaneously, we explicitly model the external pulling disturbances through a spring-damper system and achieve fine-grained force control by manipulating the virtual spring. During this process, the reinforcement-learning policy spontaneously generates disturbance-rejection response by exploiting environmental feedback. Moreover, HAFO employs an asymmetric Actor-Critic framework in which the Critic-network access to privileged spring-damping forces guides the actor-network to learn a generalizable, robust policy for resisting external disturbances.We deployed the HAFO strategy on physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot and conducted a series of hardware experiments. The experimental results demonstrate that HAFO achieves stable control of humanoid robot under various strong force interactions, showing remarkable performance in load tasks while ensuring stable robot operation under rope tension disturbances.
Stylized Locomotion Control for Bipedal Humanoid Robots with Adversarial Motion Priors
基于对抗性运动先验的双足人形机器人风格化运动控制
获得能够生成具有人类风格的全身双足运动控制器仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。为了实现类人的步态，机器人不仅需要在运动过程中保持稳定，还需能够执行复杂的全身动作，这些动作虽未必直接提升稳定性，却能增强运动的表现力与能量效率。强化学习在学习动态运动的步态控制器方面已展现出巨大潜力，但如何让控制器学习具备风格化的运动，并成功迁移到真实硬件上，仍是一个尚未完全解决的问题。
在本研究中，我们提出一种利用 对抗运动先验（AMP） 来学习此类控制器的框架。与其他风格化步态方法不同，AMP 能够方便地融合多种运动风格，但其常见问题是易出现模式崩塌，仅生成单一类型的运动。为解决这一问题，我们采用**多任务强化学习（Multi-Task RL）**设置，并展示了学习多技能对于策略鲁棒性所带来的额外益处。
我们通过在多种双足类人模型上的广泛基准测试验证了方法的有效性，并使用 Unitree G1 作为真实硬件实验平台。此外，我们的控制器无需显式优化能耗，即可自然地产生更高能效的运动，并能在不同动作之间实现平滑切换，且可成功部署于真实的类人机器人上。这标志着首次实现能够应对多种风格化类人动作的多技能步态控制策略。
Obtaining whole-body bipedal locomotion controllers that produce motions in the style of a human remains a challenging problem. To produce human-like locomotion, the robot must not only stabilize itself during movement but also execute complex whole-body motions that, while not necessarily aiding stability, enhance the expressiveness and energy efficiency of motion. Reinforcement learning has shown promise in learning locomotion controllers for dynamic motions, however, developing locomotion controllers for these stylized motions and transferring them to real hardware remains an open challenge. In this work, we introduce a framework for learning such a controller by leveraging Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP). Unlike other methods for stylized locomotion, AMP has the benefit of easily allowing for multiple motions, but often suffers from mode collapse to a single motion To address this challenge, we adopt a Multi-Task RL setup, and demonstrate the added benefit of learning multiple skills for policy robustness. We validate the effectiveness of our method through extensive benchmarking on multiple bipedal humanoid models， We use G1 as the testbed for hardware experiments Moreover, our controller generates energy-efficient motions without explicit optimization for energy consumption, transitions smoothly between different motions, and is deployable on real humanoid robots, demonstrating the first multi-skill locomotion control policy capable of handling diverse stylized humanoid motions.
Being-0: A Humanoid Robotic Agent with Vision-Language Models and Modular Skills
Being-0：一款具备视觉语言模型和模块化技能的人形机器人智能体
构建能够在真实世界具身任务中达到类人水平表现的自主机器人体系统，是人形机器人研究的终极目标之一。近年来，基础模型（Foundation Models, FMs）在高层认知方面取得了显著进展，同时人形机器人在低层技能开发方面也不断突破。然而，将这些组件直接结合常常会导致鲁棒性与效率不足，其根源在于长时序任务中的误差累积，以及各模块运行延迟不一致所带来的协同困难。
为此，我们提出 Being-0 ——一种将基础模型与模块化技能库集成的分层智能体框架。FM 负责指令理解、任务规划与推理等高层认知任务，而技能库则为底层控制提供稳定的运动与灵巧操作能力。为弥合高层决策与低层执行之间的鸿沟，我们进一步引入一个由轻量级视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的创新模块 Connector。Connector 通过将基于语言的计划转化为可执行的技能指令，并动态协调移动与操作行为，显著增强了 FM 的具身能力，从而提高任务成功率。
除 FM 外，所有模块均可在低成本的板载计算设备上部署，使 Being-0 能够在配备灵巧手与主动视觉系统的全尺寸人形机器人上实现高效、实时的控制。我们在大规模室内环境中进行了大量实验，结果表明 Being-0 能够有效完成包含复杂导航与操作子任务的长时序任务，展现出卓越的性能。
本研究的实验平台为 Unitree H1-2 人形机器人，搭载两只 Inspire 灵巧手用于操作、两台 Dynamixel 电机用于颈部运动，以及安装在颈部的 ZED-mini 摄像头实现主动视觉。轻量化 Connector 模块及所有技能模块均部署在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX 板载设备上。更多细节与演示视频请参见我们的项目页面。
Building autonomous robotic agents capable of achieving human-level performance in real-world embodied tasks is an ultimate goal in humanoid robot research. Recent advances have made significant progress in high-level cognition with Foundation Models (FMs) and low-level skill development for humanoid robots. However, directly combining these components often results in poor robustness and efficiency due to compounding errors in long-horizon tasks and the varied latency of different modules. We introduce Being-0, a hierarchical agent framework that integrates an FM with a modular skill library. The FM handles high-level cognitive tasks such as instruction understanding, task planning, and reasoning, while the skill library provides stable locomotion and dexterous manipulation for low-level control. To bridge the gap between these levels, we propose a novel Connector module, powered by a lightweight vision-language model (VLM). The Connector enhances the FM’s embodied capabilities by translating language-based plans into actionable skill commands and dynamically coordinating locomotion and manipulation to improve task success. With all components, except the FM, deployable on low-cost onboard computation devices, Being-0 achieves efficient, real-time performance on a full-sized humanoid robot equipped with dexterous hands and active vision. Extensive experiments in large indoor environments demonstrate Being-0’s effectiveness in solving complex, long-horizon tasks that require challenging navigation and manipulation subtasks. For further details and videos, visit our project page. We conduct experiments on a Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot equipped with two Inspire hands for manipulation, two Dynamixel motors for neck movement, and a ZED-mini camera mounted on the neck for active vision. The NVIDIA Jetson AGX onboard device is used to deploy the Connector and all modular skills.
Commanding Humanoid by Free-form Language: A Large Language Action Model with Unified Motion Vocabulary
利用自由语言指挥人形机器人：一种具有统一运动词汇的大型语言动作模型
使人形机器人能够执行自由形式的语言指令，对于实现无缝的人机交互、协作任务执行以及通用具身智能至关重要。尽管近期在低级人形机器人运动和操控方面取得了显著进展，但基于语言的全身控制仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法通常仅限于处理简单指令，且往往在运动多样性或物理合理性上存在权衡。
为此，我们提出 Humanoid-LLA，一种大型语言动作模型（Large Language Action Model），能够将表达丰富的语言指令映射为人形机器人可物理执行的全身动作。我们的方法整合了三个核心模块：
统一动作词汇（Unified Motion Vocabulary）：将人类动作与人形机器人动作原语对齐到共享的离散空间；
词汇指导控制器（Vocabulary-Directed Controller）：从特权策略中蒸馏而来，确保动作的物理可行性；
物理感知微调（Physics-Informed Fine-Tuning）：通过基于动力学的奖励函数进行强化学习，提高动作的稳健性与稳定性。
在仿真环境及真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人 上的广泛评估表明，Humanoid-LLA 在保持高度物理保真性的同时，实现了强大的语言泛化能力，在动作自然性、稳定性和执行成功率方面均优于现有的语言驱动控制方法。
项目主页： https://humanoidlla.github.io/
Enabling humanoid robots to follow free-form language commands is critical for seamless human-robot interaction, collaborative task execution, and general-purpose embodied intelligence. While recent advances have improved low-level humanoid locomotion and robot manipulation, language-conditioned whole-body control remains a significant challenge. Existing methods are often limited to simple instructions and sacrifice either motion diversity or physical plausibility. To address this, we introduce HumanoidLLA, a Large Language Action Model that maps expressive language commands to physically executable wholebody actions for humanoid robots. Our approach integrates three core components: a unified motion vocabulary that aligns human and humanoid motion primitives into a shared discrete space; a vocabulary-directed controller distilled from a privileged policy to ensure physical feasibility; and a physics-informed fine-tuning stage using reinforcement learning with dynamics-aware rewards to enhance robustness and stability. Extensive evaluations in simulation and on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Humanoid-LLA delivers strong language generalization while maintaining high physical fidelity, outperforming existing language-conditioned controllers in motion naturalness, stability, and execution success rate. Homepage: https://humanoidlla.github.io/.
Semantic Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis and Real-Time Control for Humanoid Robots
人形机器人的语义协同语音手势合成与实时控制
我们提出了一种端到端的创新框架，用于合成具有语义一致性的伴随语音手势（co-speech gestures），并将其实时部署到人形机器人上。该系统通过将先进的手势生成方法与高鲁棒性的物理控制相结合，有效解决了机器人在实现自然、富有表现力的非语言交互方面所面临的挑战。
本工作的核心创新在于对语义感知手势合成模块的精细化集成。该模块以语音输入为条件，借助基于大语言模型（LLMs）的生成式检索机制与自回归 Motion-GPT 模型，生成富有表达力的参考动作序列。同时，我们引入了一种高保真的模仿学习控制策略 MotionTracker，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够在保持动态平衡的前提下，准确执行这些复杂动作。
为确保动作在真实机器人上的可行性，我们采用了一种鲁棒的通用动作重定向（General Motion Retargeting, GMR）方法，有效弥合了人体运动数据与机器人本体之间的差异。通过全面的实验评估，我们验证了该系统能够生成语义恰当、节奏连贯的伴随语音手势，并由物理机器人实现高精度的跟踪与执行。
据我们所知，本研究首次提供了一条完整的端到端流程，实现了自动化、语义感知的伴随语音手势生成与人形机器人上的实时同步物理部署，为该技术在真实世界中的广泛应用迈出了重要一步。
We present an innovative end-to-end framework for synthesizing semantically meaningful co-speech gestures and deploying them in real-time on a humanoid robot. This system addresses the challenge of creating natural, expressive non-verbal communication for robots by integrating advanced gesture generation techniques with robust physical control. Our core innovation lies in the meticulous integration of a semantics-aware gesture synthesis module, which derives expressive reference motions from speech input by leveraging a generative retrieval mechanism based on large language models (LLMs) and an autoregressive Motion-GPT model. This is coupled with a high-fidelity imitation learning control policy, the MotionTracker, which enables the Unitree G1 humanoid robot to execute these complex motions dynamically and maintain balance. To ensure feasibility, we employ a robust General Motion Retargeting (GMR) method to bridge the embodiment gap between human motion data and the robot platform. Through comprehensive evaluation, we demonstrate that our combined system produces semantically appropriate and rhythmically coherent gestures that are accurately tracked and executed by the physical robot. To our knowledge, this work represents a significant step toward general real-world use by providing a complete pipeline for automatic, semantic-aware, co-speech gesture generation and synchronized real-time physical deployment on a humanoid robot.
Learning Sim-to-Real Humanoid Locomotion in 15 Minutes
15分钟学会模拟到真实的类人生物运动
大规模并行仿真已将机器人强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）的训练时间从数天显著缩短至数分钟。然而，由于高维状态空间和域随机化等因素带来的挑战，实现快速且可靠的人形机器人仿真到现实（sim-to-real）强化学习控制仍然十分困难。
在本工作中，我们提出了一种简单且实用的训练方案，基于离策略强化学习算法——FastSAC 与 FastTD3，仅使用一张 RTX 4090 GPU，即可在15 分钟内完成高质量的人形机器人行走策略训练。该方法通过一系列精心调节的设计选择与极简奖励函数，在数千个并行环境下有效稳定了离策略强化学习算法的大规模训练过程。
我们在 Unitree G1 和 Booster T1 人形机器人平台上验证了该方法的有效性，在强域随机化条件下（包括动力学随机化、复杂地形和外力扰动），实现了人形机器人行走控制策略的快速端到端学习。此外，该方法同样支持全身人体动作跟踪策略的高效训练。
相关演示视频及开源实现已发布，详见：https://younggyo.me/fastsac-humanoid
Massively parallel simulation has reduced reinforcement learning (RL) training time for robots from days to minutes. However, achieving fast and reliable sim-toreal RL for humanoid control remains difficult due to the challenges introduced by factors such as high dimensionality and domain randomization. In this work, we introduce a simple and practical recipe based on off-policy RL algorithms, i.e., FastSAC and FastTD3, that enables rapid training of humanoid locomotion policies in just 15 minutes with a single RTX 4090 GPU. Our simple recipe stabilizes off-policy RL algorithms at massive scale with thousands of parallel environments through carefully tuned design choices and minimalist reward functions. We demonstrate rapid end-to-end learning of humanoid locomotion controllers on Unitree G1 and Booster T1 robots under strong domain randomization, e.g., randomized dynamics, rough terrain, and push perturbations, as well as fast training of whole-body human-motion tracking policies. We provide videos and open-source implementation at: https://younggyo.me/fastsac-humanoid.
SafeHumanoid: VLM-RAG-driven Control of Upper Body Impedance for Humanoid Robot
SafeHumanoid：基于VLM-RAG的人形机器人上半身阻抗控制
安全且可信的人机交互（Human–Robot Interaction, HRI） 不仅要求机器人完成任务本身，还需要其根据场景语义与人类接近程度，动态调节阻抗参数与运动速度。本文提出 SafeHumanoid，一种基于第一视角视觉（egocentric vision）的控制管线，通过将视觉–语言模型（Vision–Language Models, VLMs）与检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）相结合，实现对人形机器人阻抗与速度参数的语义化调度。
在该方法中，第一视角图像首先通过结构化的 VLM 提示词进行解析，并被嵌入到语义空间中，与一个经过人工验证的场景数据库进行匹配；随后，匹配结果通过逆运动学映射为关节级阻抗控制指令。我们在多种桌面操作任务中对该系统进行了评估，涵盖有人与无人参与两种场景，包括表面擦拭、物体递交以及液体倾倒等典型人机协作任务。
实验结果表明，该管线能够以场景感知的方式自适应调整刚度、阻尼和运动速度曲线，在保持任务成功率的同时显著提升了交互安全性。尽管当前系统的推理延迟最高可达 1.4 秒，在高度动态的交互场景中仍对响应性构成一定限制，SafeHumanoid 依然验证了：将语义理解与阻抗控制相结合，是一条实现更安全、符合交互标准的人形机器人协作的可行路径。
在系统架构上，SafeHumanoid 采用模块化设计，在 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上实现了高层语义推理与底层阻抗控制之间的有效衔接，从而保证了系统的可扩展性、可解释性与工程可部署性。
Safe and trustworthy Human–Robot Interaction (HRI) requires robots not only to complete tasks but also to regulate impedance and speed according to scene context and human proximity. We present SafeHumanoid, an egocentric vision pipeline that links Vision–Language Models (VLMs) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to schedule impedance and velocity parameters for a humanoid robot. Egocentric frames are processed by a structured VLM prompt, embedded and matched against a curated database of validated scenarios, and mapped to joint-level impedance commands via inverse kinematics. We evaluate the system on tabletop manipulation tasks with and without human presence, including wiping, object handovers, and liquid pouring. The results show that the pipeline adapts stiffness, damping, and speed profiles in a context-aware manner, maintaining task success while improving safety. Although current inference latency (up to 1.4 s) limits responsiveness in highly dynamic settings, SafeHumanoid demonstrates that semantic grounding of impedance control is a viable path toward safer, standard-compliant humanoid collaboration. The pipeline SafeHumanoid is organized as a modular architecture that links high-level semantic reasoning with low-level impedance control on the Unitree G1.
From Generated Human Videos to Physically Plausible Robot Trajectories
从生成的人类视频到物理上合理的机器人轨迹
视频生成模型在合成人类动作的新场景表现方面取得了快速进展，显示出其作为上下文感知机器人高层规划器的潜力。然而，要实现这一目标，一个核心研究问题仍待解决：人形机器人如何在零样本（zero-shot）条件下执行从生成视频中提取的人类动作？
这一挑战的根源在于，生成视频往往存在噪声并伴有形态扭曲，相比真实视频，直接模仿更加困难。为此，本文提出了一种两阶段管线。首先，将视频像素提升为4D 人体表示，并映射到人形机器人形态；其次，引入 GenMimic——一种物理感知强化学习策略，以3D 关键点为条件输入，并结合对称性正则化与关键点加权跟踪奖励进行训练。通过该方法，GenMimic 能够从噪声较大的生成视频中有效模仿人类动作。
此外，我们整理了 GenMimicBench，一个涵盖多种动作和场景的合成人体动作数据集，数据由两种视频生成模型生成，用于评估零样本泛化能力和策略鲁棒性。大量实验结果显示，本方法在仿真中相较于强基线策略取得了显著提升，并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了动作连贯、物理稳定的跟踪效果，且无需额外微调。
本工作为将视频生成模型作为机器人高层控制策略提供了可行路径，展示了在零样本条件下实现上下文感知动作模仿的潜力。
Video generation models are rapidly improving in their ability to synthesize human actions in novel contexts, holding the potential to serve as high-level planners for contextual robot control. To realize this potential, a key research question remains open: how can a humanoid execute the human actions from generated videos in a zero-shot manner? This challenge arises because generated videos are often noisy and exhibit morphological distortions that make direct imitation difficult compared to real video. To address this, we introduce a two-stage pipeline. First, we lift video pixels into a 4D human representation and then retarget to the humanoid morphology. Second, we propose GenMimic—a physics-aware reinforcement learning policy conditioned on 3D keypoints, and trained with symmetry regularization and keypoint-weighted tracking rewards. As a result, GenMimic can mimic human actions from noisy, generated videos. We curate GenMimicBench, a synthetic human-motion dataset generated using two video generation models across a spectrum of actions and contexts, establishing a benchmark for assessing zero-shot generalization and policy robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate improvements over strong baselines in simulation and confirm coherent, physically stable motion tracking on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot without fine-tuning. This work offers a promising path to realizing the potential of video generation models as high-level policies for robot control.
H-Zero Cross-Humanoid Locomotion Pretraining Enables Few-shot Novel Embodiment Transfer
H-Zero：跨类人机器人运动预训练实现少样本新型具身迁移
随着人形机器人技术的快速发展，对稳健且可适应的控制器的需求愈发迫切，以实现跨平台的稳定高效行走。然而，现有控制方法通常针对特定机器人设计，需要对奖励函数、物理参数及训练超参数进行大量调节，使得在不同本体之间迁移十分困难。
为解决这一问题，本文提出 H-Zero，一种跨人形机器人行走预训练管线，旨在学习可泛化的人形基础策略。实验表明，通过在有限数量的机器人本体上进行预训练，该策略能够在零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）条件下迁移至新的人形机器人，并仅需最少微调即可适应新环境。
仿真评估显示，预训练策略在未见过的机器人上仍可维持高达 81% 的完整任务时长，并能够在仅 30 分钟微调后，实现对未见过的人形机器人及直立四足机器人的少样本迁移。此外，我们在多种硬件平台上对微调后的策略进行了真实世界定性评估，包括 Unitree Aliengo 与 H1-2 机器人，验证了策略的跨平台适应性与实际可行性。
The rapid advancement of humanoid robotics has intensified the need for robust and adaptable controllers to enable stable and efficient locomotion across diverse platforms. However, developing such controllers remains a significant challenge because existing solutions are tailored to specific robot designs, requiring extensive tuning of reward functions, physical parameters, and training hyperparameters for each embodiment. To address this challenge, we introduce H-Zero, a cross-humanoid locomotion pretraining pipeline that learns a generalizable humanoid base policy. We show that pretraining on a limited set of embodiments enables zero-shot and few-shot transfer to novel humanoid robots with minimal fine-tuning. Evaluations show that the pretrained policy maintains up to 81% of the full episode duration on unseen robots in simulation while enabling few-shot transfer to unseen humanoids and upright quadrupeds within 30 minutes of fine-tuning. We evaluate the qualitative performance of the fine-tuned policies in the real world on multiple hardware platforms, including Unitree Aliengo and H1-2 robot.
Arcadia: Toward a Full-Lifecycle Framework for Embodied Lifelong Learning
Arcadia：迈向具身终身学习的全生命周期框架
我们认为，具身学习（Embodied Learning）本质上是一个生命周期问题，而非单阶段优化。仅优化单一环节（如数据收集、仿真、学习或部署）的系统，往往难以持续改进，也难以在狭窄环境之外实现泛化。
为此，本文提出 Arcadia，一个闭环的具身终身学习框架，通过紧密耦合四个阶段实现端到端持续改进：
自演化探索与落地（Self-evolving Exploration and Grounding）：在物理环境中自主采集数据；
生成式场景重建与增强（Generative Scene Reconstruction and Augmentation）：创建逼真且可扩展的训练场景；
共享具身表示架构（Shared Embodied Representation）：在单一多模态骨干网络中统一导航与操作能力；
仿真自真实评估与演化（Sim-from-Real Evaluation and Evolution）：通过基于仿真的适应闭环反馈持续优化策略。
该耦合关系不可分解：移除任一阶段都会打破改进循环，使系统退回到一次性训练模式。
实验结果显示，Arcadia 在导航与操作基准任务中均实现稳定性能提升，并能够在物理机器人平台上鲁棒迁移。这一成果表明，紧密耦合的生命周期流程——连续真实世界数据采集、生成式仿真更新以及共享表示学习——能够支持终身改进与端到端泛化。
所有实验均使用 配备 Dex-3 操作臂的 Unitree G1 机器人进行。我们同时提供了标准化接口，以便在可复用环境中进行可重复评估与跨模型比较，将 Arcadia 构建为可扩展的通用具身智能基础框架。
We contend that embodied learning is fundamentally a lifecycle problem rather than a single-stage optimization. Systems that optimize only one link (data collection, simulation, learning, or deployment) rarely sustain improvement or generalize beyond narrow settings. We introduce Arcadia, a closed-loop framework that operationalizes embodied lifelong learning by tightly coupling four stages: (1) Self-evolving exploration and grounding for autonomous data acquisition in physical environments, (2) Generative scene reconstruction and augmentation for realistic and extensible scene creation, (3) a Shared embodied representation architecture that unifies navigation and manipulation within a single multimodal backbone, and (4) Sim-from-real evaluation and evolution that closes the feedback loop through simulation-based adaptation. This coupling is non-decomposable: removing any stage breaks the improvement loop and reverts to one-shot training. Arcadia delivers consistent gains on navigation and manipulation benchmarks and transfers robustly to physical robots, indicating that a tightly coupled lifecycle: continuous real-world data acquisition, generative simulation update, and shared-representation learning, supports lifelong improvement and end-to-end generalization. We release standardized interfaces enabling reproducible evaluation and cross-model comparison in reusable environments, positioning Arcadia as a scalable foundation for generalpurpose embodied agents. Experiments were performed using a Unitree G1 robot equipped with a Dex-3 manipulator.
LoGoPlanner: Localization Grounded Navigation Policy with Metric-aware Visual Geometry
LoGoPlanner：基于度量感知视觉几何的本地化导航策略
在非结构化环境中进行轨迹规划是移动机器人面临的一项基础且具有挑战性的能力。传统模块化管线在感知、定位、建图和规划环节容易出现延迟与级联误差。近年来，端到端学习方法通过将原始视觉观测直接映射到控制信号或轨迹，显示出在开放世界场景中提升性能与效率的潜力。然而，大多数现有端到端方法仍依赖独立定位模块，并需要精确的传感器外参校准进行自身状态估计，这限制了方法在不同机器人本体和环境中的泛化能力。
为解决上述问题，本文提出 LoGoPlanner，一个基于定位的端到端导航框架，通过以下方式克服这些局限：
微调长时域视觉-几何骨干网络，利用绝对度量尺度对预测结果进行定位约束，从而提供隐式状态估计以实现精确定位；基于历史观测重建周围场景几何信息，提供稠密且精细的环境感知，用于可靠避障；策略条件化于上述辅助任务生成的隐式几何信息，降低误差传播。
我们在仿真和真实环境中对 LoGoPlanner 进行了评测，其全端到端设计显著减少累积误差，而度量感知几何记忆增强了规划一致性和避障能力，实现了相比使用完美定位的基线超过 27.3% 的性能提升，并在不同机器人本体与环境中表现出强泛化能力。
在真实场景的定量评测中，我们测试了：
TurtleBot 在有结构化障碍物的办公室场景；Unitree Go2 在包含任意形状障碍物的杂乱家庭环境；Unitree G1 在工业场景中遇到路障障碍物，评估了 20 条轨迹。
相关代码和模型已在项目主页公开，以支持可复现研究和进一步实验。
Trajectory planning in unstructured environments is a fundamental and challenging capability for mobile robots. Traditional modular pipelines suffer from latency and cascading errors across perception, localization, mapping, and planning modules. Recent end-to-end learning methods map raw visual observations directly to control signals or trajectories, promising greater performance and efficiency in open-world settings. However, most prior end-to-end approaches still rely on separate localization modules that depend on accurate sensor extrinsic calibration for self-state estimation, thereby limiting generalization across embodiments and environments. We introduce LoGoPlanner, a localization-grounded, end-to-end navigation framework that addresses these limitations by: (1) finetuning a long-horizon visual-geometry backbone to ground predictions with absolute metric scale, thereby providing implicit state estimation for accurate localization; (2) reconstructing surrounding scene geometry from historical observations to supply dense, fine-grained environmental awareness for reliable obstacle avoidance; and (3) conditioning the policy on implicit geometry bootstrapped by the aforementioned auxiliary tasks, thereby reducing error propagation. We evaluate LoGoPlanner in both simulation and real-world settings, where its fully endto-end design reduces cumulative error while metric-aware geometry memory enhances planning consistency and obstacle avoidance, leading to more than a 27.3% improvement over oracle-localization baselines and strong generalization across embodiments and environments. The code and models have been made publicly available on the project page. For quantitative evaluation of vision-based navigation methods in real-world scenarios, we test a TurtleBot in an office scene with structured obstacles, a Unitree Go2 in a cluttered home scene containing arbitrarily shaped obstacles, and a Unitree G1 in an industrial scene with road-block obstacles, evaluating 20 trajectories.
Robots Watching Robots – Human Pose Estimation Applied to Humanoid Robots
机器人观察机器人——将人体姿态估计应用于人形机器人
本文针对将人体姿态估计（Human Pose Estimation, HPE）框架适配至人形机器人的问题展开研究。尽管 HPE 已被广泛研究，但其直接应用于人形机器人仍不可靠，主要原因在于机器人形态、对称性及外观与人类存在显著差异。
本文主要有两项贡献：
验证了 OpenPose 在人形机器人上的局限性，确认未经过适配的模型迁移性能较差；
提出首个针对 Unitree G1 的人形机器人姿态估计（HuPE）基线模型。该模型在一个自建数据集上进行训练，该数据集包含 8,410 张图像，其中 500 张带有 21 个关键点的骨架标注。模型基于 YOLOv8 构建，在试点验证集上取得了高性能指标，包括 99.7% 精确率和 99.5% mAP@50。定性分析显示，模型在中心关键点检测上表现稳健，但对末端关节及背向视角仍存在一定挑战。
本工作建立了针对 Unitree G1 的 HuPE 数据集与基线模型，为后续的数据集扩展、严格基准评测以及在安全监控、碰撞规避和协作操作等实际应用提供了基础。
This paper addresses the challenge of adapting human pose estimation (HPE) frameworks to humanoid robots. While HPE has been extensively studied, its direct application to humanoids has proven unreliable due to differences in morphology, symmetry, and appearance. This study makes two contributions. First, it demonstrates the limitations of applying OpenPose to humanoid robots, confirming poor transferability without adaptation. Second, it introduces the first baseline humanoid pose estimation (HuPE) model for the Unitree G1 robot, trained on a custom dataset of 8,410 images, of which 500 were annotated with a 21-keypoint skeleton. The model, developed using YOLOv8, achieves high validation scores on a pilot dataset, including 99.7% precision and 99.5% mAP@50. Qualitative analysis confirms robustness for central landmarks, though appendages and rear-facing views remained challenging. This work establishes a proof-of-concept dataset and model for Unitree G1 HuPE, providing a foundation for expanded datasets, rigorous benchmarking, and practical applications in safety monitoring, collision avoidance, and cooperative manipulation.
CHIP Adaptive Compliance for Humanoid Control through Hindsight Perturbation
CHIP：基于后见之明扰动的人形机器人自适应顺应控制
近年来，人形机器人在敏捷运动能力方面取得了显著进展，包括后空翻、奔跑和爬行等。然而，对于诸如搬动物体、擦拭表面或推拉手推车等需要施加力的操作任务，人形机器人仍面临较大挑战。
为此，本文提出 CHIP（adaptive Compliance Humanoid control through hIsight Perturbation），一个即插即用的模块化控制方案，能够在保持动态参考动作敏捷跟踪的同时，实现可调节的末端执行器刚度。CHIP 实现简单，无需额外的数据增强或奖励函数调优。
实验显示，使用 CHIP 训练的通用运动跟踪控制器能够执行多种需要不同末端刚度的力操作任务，包括多机器人协作、表面擦拭、箱子搬运和开门等，展现出高度适应性与多功能性。我们使用 Unitree G1 作为测试平台，并在机器人头部安装 OAK-D W 相机 提供第一视角双目视觉。更多详情请访问：https://nvlabs.github.io/CHIP/
Recent progress in humanoid robots has unlocked agile locomotion skills, including backflipping, running, and crawling. Yet it remains challenging for a humanoid robot to perform forceful manipulation tasks such as moving objects, wiping, and pushing a cart. We propose adaptive Compliance Humanoid control through hIsight Perturbation (CHIP), a plug-and-play module that enables controllable end-effector stiffness while preserving agile tracking of dynamic reference motions. CHIP is easy to implement and requires neither data augmentation nor additional reward tuning. We show that a generalist motiontracking controller trained with CHIP can perform a diverse set of forceful manipulation tasks that require different endeffector compliance, such as multi-robot collaboration, wiping, box delivery, and door opening.We used Unitree G1 as our testing platform, and an OAKD W camera was mounted on the robot head to provide egocentric binocular vision. For more details, please visit our website: https://nvlabs.github.io/CHIP/
GROUND SLOW, MOVE FAST: A DUAL-SYSTEM FOUNDATION MODEL FOR GENERALIZABLE VISION-AND-LANGUAGE NAVIGATION
地面缓慢，移动快速：一种通用的视觉和语言导航双系统基础模型
尽管近期大型视觉–语言模型（Vision–Language Models, VLMs）在视觉–语言导航（VLN）中的泛化能力有所提升，现有方法通常依赖将视觉–语言输入直接映射到短期离散动作的端到端管线。这种设计往往导致动作碎片化、延迟高，并在应对如动态障碍物避让等现实环境挑战时表现不佳。
为此，本文提出 DualVLN，首个双系统 VLN 基础模型，通过高层推理与低层动作执行的协同实现鲁棒导航：
System 2：基于 VLM 的全局规划器，通过图像感知推理预测中期航点目标，实现“慢速落地”高层推理；
System 1：轻量多模态条件扩散 Transformer 策略，利用 System 2 提供的显式像素目标和潜在特征生成平滑且精确的轨迹，实现“快速移动”的低层控制。
该双系统设计支持复杂动态环境下的实时控制与自适应局部决策。通过训练解耦，VLM 保持强泛化能力，而 System 1 实现可解释且高效的局部导航。
我们在三类真实机器人平台上进行了验证：轮式（TurtleBot4）、四足（Unitree Go2）和人形（Unitree G1）。实验结果显示，DualVLN 在所有 VLN 基准测试中均优于现有方法，并且在真实场景中展现了长时航迹规划能力与动态环境下的实时适应性。
While recent large vision-language models (VLMs) have improved generalization in vision-language navigation (VLN), existing methods typically rely on end-toend pipelines that map vision-language inputs directly to short-horizon discrete actions. Such designs often produce fragmented motions, incur high latency, and struggle with real-world challenges like dynamic obstacle avoidance. We propose DualVLN, the first dual-system VLN foundation model that synergistically integrates high-level reasoning with low-level action execution. System 2, a VLMbased global planner, “grounds slowly” by predicting mid-term waypoint goals via image-grounded reasoning. System 1, a lightweight, multi-modal conditioning Diffusion Transformer policy, “moves fast” by leveraging both explicit pixel goals and latent features from System 2 to generate smooth and accurate trajectories. The dual-system design enables robust real-time control and adaptive local decision-making in complex, dynamic environments. By decoupling training, the VLM retains its generalization, while System 1 achieves interpretable and effective local navigation. We perform real-world experiments on wheeled (Turtlebot4), quadruped (Unitree Go2) and humanoid (Unitree G1) robots. DualVLN outperforms prior methods across all VLN benchmarks and real-world experiments demonstrate robust long-horizon planning and real-time adaptability in dynamic environments.
Discovering Self-Protective Falling Policy for Humanoid Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning
基于深度强化学习的人形机器人防跌倒自保护策略探索
近年来，人形机器人在研究领域中受到了广泛关注，并取得了显著进展。然而，受限于其形态结构、复杂动力学特性以及现有控制策略的局限性，人形机器人相比四足或轮式机器人更容易发生跌倒。一旦发生非受控跌倒，其较大的整体质量、较高的质心位置以及高自由度结构往往会对机器人自身及周围环境造成严重的硬件损伤。
现有相关研究主要依赖基于控制的方法，这类方法在应对多样化跌倒场景时往往适应性不足，且可能引入不适合机器人自身结构特性的人工先验。相比之下，大规模深度强化学习与课程学习为该问题提供了一种更具潜力的解决思路，能够激励人形机器人自主探索符合其自身物理属性与动力学特性的跌倒防护策略。
在本文中，我们通过精心设计的奖励函数与多样化的领域随机化课程训练策略，成功训练人形机器人学习有效的跌倒防护行为。实验结果表明，机器人在跌倒过程中通过构建“三角支撑”结构，能够显著降低刚性机体所承受的冲击损伤。通过全面的评价指标与对比实验，我们定量分析了所提出方法相较于现有方法的性能优势，对学习到的跌倒行为进行了可视化展示，并成功将该策略迁移部署至真实世界的 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上。
Humanoid robots have received significant research interests and advancements in recent years. Despite many successes, due to their morphology, dynamics and limitation of control policy, humanoid robots are prone to fall as compared to other embodiments like quadruped or wheeled robots. And its large weight, tall Center of Mass, high Degreeof-Freedom would cause serious hardware damages when falling uncontrolled, to both itself and surrounding objects. Existing researches in this field mostly focus on using control based methods that struggle to cater diverse falling scenarios and may introduce unsuitable human prior.
