On the other hand, large-scale Deep Reinforcement Learning and Curriculum Learning could be employed to incentivize humanoid agent discovering falling protection policy that fits its own nature and property. In this work, with carefully designed reward functions and domain diversification curriculum, we successfully train humanoid agent to explore falling protection behaviors and discover that by forming a ‘triangle’ structure, the falling damages could be significantly reduced with its rigidmaterial body. With comprehensive metrics and experiments, we quantify its performance with comparison to other methods, visualize its falling behaviors and successfully transfer it to real world platform on an Unitree G1 robot.
CycleManip: Enabling Cyclic Task Manipulation via Effective Historical Perception and Understanding
CycleManip：通过有效的历史感知和理解实现循环任务操控
本文探讨了一类重要但尚未得到充分研究的机器人操作任务——基于周期的操作任务（cycle-based manipulation）。该类任务要求机器人在给定的终止时间内完成具有周期性或重复性的动作，在日常生活中具有广泛应用场景，例如摇晃瓶子或敲打钉子等。然而，现有研究对该问题关注较少，主要面临以下两方面挑战：（1）现有模仿学习方法由于对历史信息利用不足，往往难以在期望的终止时间内完成周期性任务；（2）缺乏包含充足数据并配备自动化评估工具的标准化基准，制约了该领域有效方法的开发与系统性评估。
为解决上述问题，本文首先提出了 CycleManip 框架，以端到端模仿学习的方式实现周期性任务操作，无需引入额外模型、层级控制结构或显著的计算开销。其核心思想在于：通过一种代价感知的采样策略增强对有效历史信息的感知能力，并结合多任务学习机制提升模型对历史时序信息的理解能力。其次，我们构建了一个周期性操作任务基准，涵盖多种具有代表性的周期性任务，并提供了相应的自动化评估方法。
在仿真环境和真实机器人平台上的大量实验结果表明，所提出的方法在周期性操作任务中取得了较高的成功率。同时，实验还显示该方法在通用操作任务中具备良好的适应能力，并能够以即插即用的方式应用于现有模仿学习策略，包括视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型。此外，结果表明该方法具有良好的跨平台泛化能力，可适用于多种机器人形态，包括双臂夹爪机器人、灵巧手以及人形机器人G1。
In this paper, we explore an important yet underexplored task in robot manipulation: cycle-based manipulation, where robots need to perform cyclic or repetitive actions with an expected terminal time. These tasks are crucial in daily life, such as shaking a bottle or knocking a nail. However, few prior works have explored this task, leading to two main challenges: 1) the imitation methods often fail to complete these tasks within the expected terminal time due to the ineffective utilization of history; 2) the absence of a benchmark with sufficient data and automatic evaluation tools hinders development of effective solutions in this area. To address these challenges, we first propose the CycleManip framework to achieve cycle-based task ma-nipulation in an end-to-end imitation manner without requiring any extra models, hierarchical structure or significant computational overhead. The core insight is to enhance effective history perception by a cost-aware sampling strategy and to improve historical understanding by multitask learning. Second, we introduce a cycle-based task manipulation benchmark, which provides diverse cycle-based tasks, and an automatic evaluation method. Extensive experiments conducted in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that our method achieves high success rates in cycle-based task manipulation. The results further show strong adaptability performance in general manipulation, and the plug-and-play ability on imitation policies such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. Moreover, the results show that our approach can be applied across diverse robotic platforms, including bi-arm grippers, dexterous hands, and humanoid robots.
Opening the Sim-to-Real Door for Humanoid Pixel-to-Action Policy Transfer
为类人像素到动作的策略转移打开模拟到现实的大门
近年来，GPU 加速的高真实感物理仿真为机器人学习开辟了一条可扩展的数据生成路径，其中大规模的物理与视觉随机化使得策略能够泛化到超出人工构建场景的环境中。在此基础上，本文提出了一种用于视觉驱动人形机器人移动操作的教师–学生–自举学习框架，并以关节物体交互作为代表性的高难度基准任务。该方法引入了一种分阶段重置的探索策略，以稳定长时序特权策略的训练，并提出了一种基于 GRPO 的微调流程，以缓解部分可观测性问题并提升仿真到现实强化学习中的闭环一致性。该策略完全基于仿真数据进行训练，在多种门型任务中实现了稳健的零样本性能，并在相同的全身控制框架下，其任务完成时间相较人类遥操作员最高提升 31.7%。所学习的策略被部署并评估于 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上。
该工作代表了首个仅依赖纯 RGB 感知即可实现多样化关节物体移动操作的人形机器人仿真到现实策略。
Recent progress in GPU-accelerated, photorealistic simulation has opened a scalable data-generation path for robot learning, where massive physics and visual randomization allow policies to generalize beyond curated environments. Building on these advances, we develop a teacher-student-bootstrap learning framework for vision-based humanoid loco-manipulation, using articulated-object interaction as a representative high-difficulty benchmark. Our approach introduces a staged-reset exploration strategy that stabilizes long-horizon privileged-policy training, and a GRPO-based fine-tuning procedure that mitigates partial observability and improves closed-loop consistency in sim-to-real RL. Trained entirely on simulation data, the resulting policy achieves robust zero-shot performance across diverse door types and outperforms human teleoperators by up to 31.7% in task completion time under the same whole-body control stack. The learned policy is deployed and evaluated on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. This represents the first humanoid sim-to-real policy capable of diverse articulated loco-manipulation using pure RGB perception.
HUMANOID-LLA: OPEN-VOCABULARY HUMANOID WHOLE-BODY CONTROL WITH LARGE LANGUAGE ACTION MODEL
人形机器人-LLA：基于大型语言动作模型的开放词汇人形机器人全身控制
使人形机器人能够理解并执行开放词汇的语言指令，对于实现自然的人机交互、协作任务执行以及通用的具身智能至关重要。尽管近期在低层次的人形机器人行走和操作控制方面取得了显著进展，基于语言的全身控制仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法在处理组合式指令时常常失败，并且在运动多样性与物理合理性之间难以兼顾。
为此，本文提出 Humanoid-LLA——一种大型语言动作模型（Large Language Action Model），能够将自然语言指令映射为人形机器人可物理执行的全身动作。我们的方法包含三大核心组件：
统一运动词汇（Unified Motion Vocabulary）：将人类与人形机器人的动作原语对齐到共享的离散空间中；
词汇引导控制器（Vocabulary-Directed Controller）：通过蒸馏特权策略保证动作的物理可行性；
物理感知微调阶段（Physics-Informed Fine-Tuning）：利用带有动力学感知奖励的强化学习提升策略的稳健性与稳定性。
在仿真环境和真实人形机器人平台上的大量评估表明，Humanoid-LLA 在开放词汇泛化能力方面表现优异，同时保持高度的物理逼真性。在运动自然性、稳定性和执行成功率上均优于现有基于语言的控制器。我们的真实人形机器人硬件基于 Unitree G1 平台构建。
Enabling humanoid robots to follow open-vocabulary language instructions is critical for seamless human-robot interaction, collaborative task execution, and general-purpose embodied intelligence. While recent advances have improved low-level humanoid locomotion and robot manipulation, language-conditioned whole-body control remains a significant challenge. Existing methods often fail on compositional instructions and sacrifice either motion diversity or physical plausibility. To address this, we introduce Humanoid-LLA, a Large Language Action Model that maps natural language commands to physically executable whole-body motions for humanoid robots. Our approach integrates three core components: a unified motion vocabulary that aligns human and humanoid motion primitives into a shared discrete space; a vocabulary-directed controller distilled from a privileged policy to ensure physical feasibility; and a physics-informed fine-tuning stage using reinforcement learning with dynamics-aware rewards to enhance robustness and stability. Extensive evaluations in simulation and on a real humanoid platform show that Humanoid-LLA delivers strong open-vocabulary generalization while maintaining high physical fidelity, outperforming existing language-conditioned controllers in motion naturalness, stability, and execution success. Our real humanoid hardware is built on the Unitree G1 humanoid platform.
World-Coordinate Human Motion Retargeting via SAM 3D Body
基于SAM 3D人体模型的世界坐标系人体运动重定向
从单目视频中恢复世界坐标系下的人体运动，并将其重定向到类人机器人，对于具身智能与机器人领域具有重要意义。为避免复杂的 SLAM 流水线 [11–13] 或计算开销较大的时序模型 [4]，我们提出了一种轻量级、工程导向的框架。该框架以 SAM 3D Body（3DB）[14] 作为冻结的感知骨干网络，并采用 Momentum Human Rig（MHR）[2] 表示作为对机器人友好的中间表示。
具体而言，我们的方法包括以下三个关键步骤：(i) 对每个跟踪到的个体锁定其身份参数和骨架尺度参数，以保证时间上的骨骼长度一致性；(ii) 在低维的 MHR [2] 潜在空间中，通过高效的滑动窗口优化对逐帧预测结果进行平滑；(iii) 借助可微的软足–地接触模型以及接触感知的全局优化，恢复物理上合理的全局根节点轨迹。
最后，我们通过一个具备运动学约束的两阶段逆运动学流水线，将重建得到的人体运动重定向到 Unitree G1 类人机器人上。
在真实单目视频上的实验结果表明，我们的方法能够生成稳定的世界坐标轨迹，并实现可靠的机器人运动重定向。这说明，结合轻量级物理约束的结构化人体表示，能够从单目输入中有效地产生可直接用于机器人的运动数据。
Recovering world-coordinate human motion from monocular videos with humanoid robot retargeting is significant for embodied intelligence and robotics. To avoid complex SLAM pipelines [11–13] or heavy temporal models [4], we propose a lightweight, engineeringoriented framework that leverages SAM 3D Body (3DB) [14] as a frozen perception backbone and uses the Momentum Human Rig (MHR) [2] representation as a robot-friendly intermediate. Our method (i) locks the identity and skeleton-scale parameters of per tracked subject to enforce temporally consistent bone lengths, (ii) smooths per-frame predictions via efficient sliding-window optimization in the low-dimensional MHR [2] latent space, and (iii) recovers physically plausible global root trajectories with a differentiable soft foot–ground contact model and contact-aware global optimization. Finally, we retarget the reconstructed motion to the Unitree G1 humanoid using a kinematics-aware two-stage inverse kinematics pipeline. Results on real monocular videos show that our method has stable world trajectories and reliable robot retargeting, indicating that structured human representations with lightweight physical constraints can yield robot-ready motion from monocular input.
Do You Have Freestyle? Expressive Humanoid Locomotion via Audio Control
你有 Freestyle 功能吗？通过音频控制实现富有表现力的人形移动
人类能够直觉性地随声音而动，但现有的类人机器人缺乏富有表现力的即兴运动能力，通常受限于预定义动作或稀疏的控制指令。传统的“音频生成动作再重定向至机器人”的方法依赖显式的人体运动重建，容易引入级联误差，导致系统延迟较高，并且声学信息与执行动作之间的映射不够连贯。
为此，我们提出 RoboPerform——首个统一的端到端音频到机器人运动（audio-to-locomotion）框架，能够直接从音频生成由音乐驱动的舞蹈动作以及由语音驱动的伴随手势（co-speech gestures）。该框架遵循“运动 = 内容 + 风格”这一核心原则，将音频视为隐式的风格信号，从而避免了显式运动重建过程。
RoboPerform 融合了两类策略：一是用于适应多样化运动模式的 ResMoE 教师策略，二是用于注入音频风格信息的 基于扩散模型的学生策略。这种无需运动重定向的设计显著降低了系统延迟，并提升了动作生成的保真度。
实验结果表明，RoboPerform 在物理可行性与音频对齐方面均取得了令人鼓舞的效果，成功将机器人转变为能够对音频做出即时反应的“表演者”。在实验设置中，教师策略与学生策略均在 Isaac Gym 仿真环境中完成训练，而学生策略则被直接部署到 Unitree G1 类人机器人上，用于真实世界的验证。
Humans intuitively move to sound, but current humanoid robots lack expressive improvisational capabilities, confined to predefined motions or sparse commands. Generating motion from audio and then retargeting it to robots relies on explicit motion reconstruction, leading to cascaded errors, high latency, and disjointed acoustic-actuation mapping. We propose RoboPerform, the first unified audio-to-locomotion framework that can directly generate music-driven dance and speech-driven co-speech gestures from audio. Guided by the core principle of “motion = content + style”, the framework treats audio as implicit style signals and eliminates the need for explicit motion reconstruction. RoboPerform integrates a ResMoE teacher policy for adapting to diverse motion patterns and a diffusion-based student policy for audio style injection. This retargeting-free design ensures low latency and high fidelity. Experimental validation shows that RoboPerform achieves promising results in physical plausibility and audio alignment, successfully transforming robots into responsive performers capable of reacting to audio. In our experiments, both the teacher and student policies are trained in the IsaacGym simulation environment, and the student policy is directly deployed on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot for real-world validation.
RoboMirror: Understand Before You Imitate for Video to Humanoid Locomotion
RoboMirror：在模仿视频到人形运动之前先了解其原理
人类通过视觉观察学习运动，往往先理解视觉内容，再对动作进行模仿。然而，当前最先进的类人机器人运动控制系统主要依赖精心采集的动作捕捉轨迹或稀疏的文本指令，导致视觉理解与运动控制之间仍存在关键鸿沟。基于文本生成运动的方法受限于语义信息稀疏以及分阶段流水线所带来的误差累积；而基于视频的方法通常仅进行机械式的姿态模仿，缺乏真正的视觉语义理解。
为此，我们提出 RoboMirror——首个无需运动重定向（retargeting-free）的视频到机器人运动（video-to-locomotion）框架，体现了“先理解，再模仿”的核心理念。该方法借助视觉-语言模型（VLM），将原始的第一人称或第三人称视频蒸馏为高层次的视觉运动意图，并直接用于条件化一个基于扩散模型的策略网络，在无需显式姿态重建或运动重定向的情况下，生成在物理上可行且在语义上高度一致的机器人运动。
大量实验验证了 RoboMirror 的有效性：该方法支持通过第一人称视频实现远程临场控制（telepresence），将第三人称视频控制的系统延迟降低了 80%，并在任务成功率上相比基线方法提升了 3.7%。通过以视频理解为核心重新定义类人机器人控制范式，我们有效弥合了视觉理解与动作执行之间的鸿沟。
在实验设置中，教师策略与学生策略均在 Isaac Gym 仿真环境中进行训练，学生策略随后被直接部署到 Unitree G1 类人机器人上，以完成真实世界测试。
Humans learn locomotion through visual observation, interpreting visual content first before imitating actions. However, state-of-the-art humanoid locomotion systems rely on either curated motion capture trajectories or sparse text commands, leaving a critical gap between visual understanding and control. Text-to-motion methods suffer from semantic sparsity and staged pipeline errors, while video-based approaches only perform mechanical pose mimicry without genuine visual understanding. We propose RoboMirror, the first retargeting-free video-to-locomotion framework embodying “understand before you imitate”. Leveraging VLMs, it distills raw egocentric/third-person videos into visual motion intents, which directly condition a diffusion-based policy to generate physically plausible, semantically aligned locomotion without explicit pose reconstruction or retargeting. Extensive experiments validate RoboMirror’s effectiveness, it enables telepresence via egocentric videos, drastically reduces third-person control latency by 80%, and achieves a 3.7% higher task success rate than baselines. By reframing humanoid control around video understanding, we bridge the visual understanding and action gap. In the experiments, we train the teacher policy and student policy in the IsaacGym simulation environment, and directly deploy the student policy on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot for real-world testing.
RANGER: A Monocular Zero-Shot Semantic Navigation Framework through Contextual Adaptation
RANGER：一种基于情境适应的单目零样本语义导航框架
在复杂环境中高效地寻找目标，是现实世界具身智能应用中的一项基础能力。尽管近年来多模态基础模型的发展推动了零样本目标导航（zero-shot object goal navigation）的进步，使机器人无需微调即可搜索任意目标物体，但现有方法仍面临两个关键局限：（1）高度依赖仿真器提供的精确深度与位姿信息，限制了其在真实环境中的适用性；（2）缺乏上下文学习（in-context learning，ICL）能力，难以快速适应新环境，例如无法有效利用短视频等上下文信息。
为解决上述问题，我们提出 RANGER——一种新颖的零样本、开放词汇（open-vocabulary）语义导航框架，仅依赖单目相机即可运行。RANGER 借助强大的三维基础模型，彻底消除了对深度和位姿信息的依赖，同时展现出优异的上下文学习能力。系统只需观察一段新环境的短视频，便可在无需结构修改或模型微调的情况下，显著提升任务执行效率。
该框架集成了多个关键模块，包括：基于关键帧的三维重建、语义点云生成、由视觉—语言模型（VLM）驱动的探索价值评估、高层自适应航点选择，以及底层动作执行控制。在 HM3D 基准测试和真实世界环境中的实验结果表明，RANGER 在导航成功率与探索效率方面均取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时在无需事先构建环境三维地图的前提下，展现出显著优于现有方法的 ICL 适应能力。
我们进一步在真实机器人平台上验证了 RANGER 的实用性：实验采用 Unitree G1 类人机器人，其头部安装了一个自定义的 2 自由度云台，并在 1.29 米高度配备 Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D 相机。值得强调的是，系统在感知与导航过程中仅使用 RGB 图像流，完全符合我们“无深度假设”的设计初衷。
Efficiently finding targets in complex environments is fundamental to real-world embodied applications. While recent advances in multimodal foundation models have enabled zero-shot object goal navigation, allowing robots to search for arbitrary objects without fine-tuning, existing methods face two key limitations: (1) heavy reliance on precise depth and pose information provided by simulators, which restricts applicability in real-world scenarios; and (2) lack of incontext learning (ICL) capability, making it difficult to quickly adapt to new environments, as in leveraging short videos. To address these challenges, we propose RANGER, a novel zero-shot, open-vocabulary semantic navigation framework that operates using only a monocular camera. Leveraging powerful 3D foundation models, RANGER eliminates the dependency on depth and pose while exhibiting strong ICL capability. By simply observing a short video of a new environment, the system can also significantly improve task efficiency without requiring architectural modifications or fine-tuning. The framework integrates several key components: keyframe-based 3D reconstruction, semantic point cloud generation, visionlanguage model (VLM)-driven exploration value estimation, high-level adaptive waypoint selection, and low-level action execution. Experiments on the HM3D benchmark and real-world environments demonstrate that RANGER achieves competitive performance in terms of navigation success rate and exploration efficiency, while showing superior ICL adaptability, with no previous 3D mapping of the environment required. We validate the practicality of RANGER through real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D camera mounted at a height of 1.29 m on a custom 2 DoF head. Importantly, only the RGB stream is used for sensing and navigation, consistent with our depth-free assumption.
A Hierarchical Framework for Humanoid Locomotion with Supernumerary Limbs
一种具有额外肢体的类人生物运动分层框架
在类人机器人上集成超冗余肢体（Supernumerary Limbs，SLs）会由于其引入的动态扰动而对系统稳定性提出严峻挑战。本文针对这一问题，设计了一种新颖的分层控制架构，以提升配备 SLs 的类人机器人在行走过程中的稳定性。该框架的核心是一种解耦式控制策略，将基于学习的行走控制与基于模型的平衡控制相结合。
在低层控制中，我们通过模仿学习与课程学习相结合的方法，为 Unitree H1 类人机器人训练了一套稳定的行走步态；在高层控制中，系统主动利用超冗余肢体实现动态平衡调节，从而抵消其自身质量与运动所带来的内部扰动。
我们在基于物理的仿真环境中对该系统进行了系统评估，涵盖三种工况：无负载类人机器人的基线行走（baseline walking）、携带静态 SL 负载的行走（static payload），以及启用主动动态平衡控制的行走（dynamic balancing）。实验结果表明，动态平衡控制器能够显著提升系统稳定性。与静态负载工况相比，该平衡策略生成的步态更加接近基线步态，并使质心（CoM）轨迹的动态时间规整（Dynamic Time Warping，DTW）距离降低了 47%。
此外，该平衡控制器还能在步态周期内更快地实现再稳定（re-stabilization），并促使地面反作用力（Ground Reaction Forces，GRF）呈现出更加协调的反相（anti-phase）模式。实验结果充分表明，采用解耦的分层控制设计，能够有效缓解由超冗余肢体的质量与运动所引入的内部动态扰动，使配备功能性附加肢体的类人机器人实现稳定行走。
The integration of Supernumerary Limbs (SLs) on humanoid robots poses a significant stability challenge due to the dynamic perturbations they introduce. This thesis addresses this issue by designing a novel hierarchical control architecture to improve humanoid locomotion stability with SLs. The core of this framework is a decoupled strategy that combines learning-based locomotion with model-based balancing. The low-level component consists of a walking gait for a Unitree H1 humanoid through imitation learning and curriculum learning. The high-level component actively utilizes the SLs for dynamic balancing. The effectiveness of the system is evaluated in a physics-based simulation under three conditions: baseline gait for an unladen humanoid (baseline walking), walking with a static SL payload (static payload), and walking with the active dynamic balancing controller (dynamic balancing). Our evaluation shows that the dynamic balancing controller improves stability. Compared to the static payload condition, the balancing strategy yields a gait pattern closer to the baseline and decreases the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) distance of the CoM trajectory by 47%. The balancing controller also improves the re-stabilization within gait cycles and achieves a more coordinated anti-phase pattern of Ground Reaction Forces (GRF). The results demonstrate that a decoupled, hierarchical design can effectively mitigate the internal dynamic disturbances arising from the mass and movement of the SLs, enabling stable locomotion for humanoids equipped with functional limbs. Code and videos are available here: https://github.com/heyzbw/HuSLs.
Mobile-TeleVision: Predictive Motion Priors for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
Mobile-TeleVision：用于人形机器人全身控制的预测运动先验
类人机器人既需要稳健的下肢运动能力，又需要精确的上肢操作能力。虽然近期的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）方法可以生成全身运动控制策略（loco-manipulation policies），但在高自由度机械臂的精确操作上仍存在不足。
本文提出上肢控制与下肢运动解耦的方法：使用**逆运动学（Inverse Kinematics, IK）**和运动重定向（motion retargeting）实现精确的上肢操作，而 RL 主要专注于稳健的下肢运动控制。为此，我们引入 PMP（Predictive Motion Priors），通过条件变分自编码器（Conditional Variational Autoencoder, CVAE）进行训练，有效表示上肢动作。下肢运动策略以该上肢动作表示作为条件输入，从而确保系统在兼顾操作与运动的同时仍保持稳健性。
实验表明，CVAE 特征对于系统稳定性与鲁棒性至关重要，在精确操作任务中显著优于基于 RL 的全身控制方法。结合精确的上肢动作与稳健的下肢运动控制，操作者能够远程控制类人机器人在不同环境中自由移动，同时完成多样化的操作任务。实验平台采用 Unitree H1 类人机器人。
Humanoid robots require both robust lower-body locomotion and precise upper-body manipulation. While recent Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches provide whole-body loco-manipulation policies, they lack precise manipulation with high DoF arms. In this paper, we propose decoupling upperbody control from locomotion, using inverse kinematics (IK) and motion retargeting for precise manipulation, while RL focuses on robust lower-body locomotion. We introduce PMP (Predictive Motion Priors), trained with Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) to effectively represent upper-body motions. The locomotion policy is trained conditioned on this upper-body motion representation, ensuring that the system remains robust with both manipulation and locomotion. We show that CVAE features are crucial for stability and robustness, and significantly outperforms RL-based whole-body control in precise manipulation. With precise upper-body motion and robust lower-body locomotion control, operators can remotely control the humanoid to walk around and explore different environments, while performing diverse manipulation tasks. Using a Unitree H1 robot.
UniAct: Unified Motion Generation and Action Streaming for Humanoid Robots
UniAct：人形机器人的统一动作生成和动作流传输
类人机器人长期以来的目标之一，是实现能够遵循多模态指令、具有人类级灵活性的通用智能体。尽管类人机器人控制技术已有显著进展，但将高层多模态感知与全身动作执行有效衔接仍是一个重要瓶颈。现有方法在将异构指令（如语言、音乐、轨迹）转化为稳定的实时动作方面仍存在困难。
本文提出 UniAct——一个两阶段框架，将微调的多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model, MLLM）与因果流式（causal streaming）管道相结合，使类人机器人能够以 500 ms 以下的延迟执行多模态指令。UniAct 通过有限标量量化（Finite Scalar Quantization, FSQ）将输入统一映射到共享的离散码本（discrete codebook），在实现跨模态对齐的同时，将动作约束在物理合理的流形上。该方法在零样本追踪不完美参考动作的任务中，将成功率提升了 19%。
我们在 UA-Net——一个 20 小时的类人机器人动作基准上验证了 UniAct，结果显示其在多样化真实场景中具备强大的泛化能力。实验平台采用 Unitree G1 类人机器人。研究成果标志着向能够通过统一感知与控制实现无缝交互的通用类人机器人助手迈出了关键一步。
A long-standing objective in humanoid robotics is the realization of versatile agents capable of following diverse multimodal instructions with human-level flexibility. Despite advances in humanoid control, bridging high-level multimodal perception with whole-body execution remains a significant bottleneck. Existing methods often struggle to translate heterogeneous instructions—such as language, music, and trajectories—into stable, real-time actions. Here we show that UniAct, a two-stage framework integrating a finetuned Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) with a causal streaming pipeline, enables humanoid robots to execute multimodal instructions with sub-500 ms latency. By unifying inputs through a shared discrete codebook via Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ), UniAct ensures crossmodal alignment while constraining motions to a physically grounded manifold. This approach yields a 19% improvement in the success rate of zero-shot tracking of imperfect reference motions. We validate UniAct on UA-Net, our 20-hour humanoid motion benchmark, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse real-world scenarios. Our results mark a critical step toward responsive, generalpurpose humanoid assistants capable of seamless interaction through unified perception and control. Using the Unitree G1 robot.
Humanoid Robot Control by Nonlinear ModelPredictive Controller with Adaptive Weight Whole Body Controller
基于非线性模型预测控制器和自适应权重全身控制器的类人机器人控制
基于模型的人形机器人运动控制随着多种建模方法的发展不断得到完善。其中，全身动力学模型无疑是最为全面的一种方式，因为它包含了机器人动力学的全部信息。然而，基于全身动力学的模型预测控制（MPC）通常计算量巨大，对高性能计算平台依赖较强，因此在实际应用中更常采用混合建模方法。本文提出了一种人形机器人控制框架：首先基于质心动力学构建非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），用于规划未来运动轨迹并求解执行这些轨迹所需的关节变量；随后在当前时刻利用全身动力学模型计算关节力矩，并引入自适应加权的全身控制器，以实现在不同地形条件下的动态轨迹切换。通过在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验验证了该控制框架的可行性与有效性。
Model-based locomotion control for humanoid robots has been continuously refined with the development of various modeling approaches. Undoubtedly, the whole-body dynamics model represents the most comprehensive approach, as it encompasses complete information about the robot’s dynamics. However, Model Predictive Control (MPC) based whole-body dynamics often encounters significant computational burden and requires high-performance computing platforms. Therefore, hybrid approaches are more commonly employed in practice. This paper presents a control framework for humanoid robots that integrates the centroidal dynamics for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) to plan future trajectories and solve the required joint variables to execute these trajectories. Then, whole-body dynamics is used to compute joint torques at the current time step and employs an adaptive weighted whole-body controller to achieve dynamic trajectory switches for different terrains. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control framework are validated on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
FRoM-W1: Towards General Humanoid Whole-Body Control with Language Instructions
FRoM-W1：面向通用人形全身控制的语言指令
人形机器人能够完成诸如打招呼、跳舞甚至后空翻等多种动作，但这些动作往往依赖人工编写或针对特定任务进行训练，因而在通用性方面受到限制。本文提出了 FRoM-W1，一个开源框架，旨在通过自然语言实现通用的人形机器人全身运动控制。为实现对自然语言的普适理解并生成相应的动作，同时使不同类型的人形机器人能够在重力作用下稳定地在真实物理环境中执行这些动作，FRoM-W1 采用两阶段架构：（a）H-GPT：利用大规模人体运动数据，训练一个由语言驱动的人体全身运动生成大模型，用于生成多样化的自然行为，并进一步引入思维链（Chain-of-Thought）技术，以提升模型在指令理解方面的泛化能力；（b）H-ACT：将生成的人体全身运动重定向为机器人特定动作后，通过在物理仿真中预训练并结合强化学习进一步微调的运动控制器，使人形机器人能够准确、稳定地执行相应动作，随后通过模块化的仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）机制部署到真实机器人上。我们在 Unitree H1 和 G1 人形机器人上对 FRoM-W1 进行了广泛评估，结果表明该方法在 HumanML3D-X 人体全身运动生成基准上取得了优异性能，同时所引入的强化学习微调在运动跟踪精度和任务成功率方面均带来了持续提升。我们已将完整的 FRoM-W1 框架开源，希望推动人形机器人智能的发展。
Humanoid robots are capable of performing various actions such as greeting, dancing and even backflipping. However, these motions are often hard-coded or specifically trained, which limits their versatility. In this work, we present FRoM-W1, an open-source framework designed to achieve general humanoid whole-body motion control using natural language. To universally understand natural language and generate corresponding motions, as well as enable various humanoid robots to stably execute these motions in the physical world under gravity, FRoM-W1 operates in two stages: (a) H-GPT: utilizing massive human data, a large-scale language-driven human whole-body motion generation model is trained to generate diverse natural behaviors. We further leverage the Chain-of-Thought technique to improve the model’s generalization in instruction understanding. (b) H-ACT: After retargeting generated human whole-body motions into robot-specific actions, a motion controller that is pretrained and further fine-tuned through reinforcement learning in physical simulation enables humanoid robots to accurately and stably perform corresponding actions. It is then deployed on real robots via a modular simulation-to-reality module. We extensively evaluate FRoM-W1 on Unitree H1 and G1 robots. Results demonstrate superior performance on the HumanML3D-X benchmark for human whole-body motion generation, and our introduced reinforcement learning fine-tuning consistently improves both motion tracking accuracy and task success rates of these humanoid robots. We open-source the entire FRoM-W1 framework and hope it will advance the development of humanoid intelligence.
UniCon: A Unified System for Efficient Robot Learning Transfers
UniCon：用于高效机器人学习迁移的统一系统
由于不同机器人平台在硬件结构、接口规范以及中间件效率等方面存在差异，将基于学习的控制器部署到异构机器人上面临诸多挑战。为此，本文提出了 UniCon，一种轻量级框架，用于在不同平台之间统一状态表示、控制流程和系统监测。UniCon 将整体工作流程拆解为由可复用组件构成的执行图，并将系统状态与控制逻辑解耦，从而实现面向不同机器人形态的即插即用式部署。与传统中间件不同，UniCon 通过批处理和向量化的数据流设计优先保证运行效率，有效降低通信开销并提升推理延迟性能。这种模块化、数据驱动的设计方式使仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）的迁移过程更加顺畅，且几乎无需重新工程化。实验结果表明，UniCon 在跨平台迁移控制流程时显著减少了代码冗余，并在推理效率上优于基于 ROS 的系统。目前，UniCon 已成功部署在来自 7 家厂商的 12 种以上机器人模型上，并被集成到多个在研项目中，验证了其在真实应用场景中的有效性。
Deploying learning-based controllers across heterogeneous robots is challenging due to platform differences, inconsistent interfaces, and inefficient middleware. To address these issues, we present UniCon, a lightweight framework that standardizes states, control flow, and instrumentation across platforms. It decomposes workflows into execution graphs with reusable components, separating system states from control logic to enable plug-and-play deployment across various robot morphologies. Unlike traditional middleware, it prioritizes efficiency through batched, vectorized data flow, minimizing communication overhead and improving inference latency. This modular, data-oriented approach enables seamless sim-to-real transfer with minimal re-engineering. We demonstrate that UniCon reduces code redundancy when transferring workflows and achieves higher inference efficiency compared to ROS-based systems. Deployed on over 12 robot models from 7 manufacturers, it has been successfully integrated into ongoing research projects, proving its effectiveness in real-world scenarios.
PILOT: A Perceptive Integrated Low-level Controller for Loco-manipulation over Unstructured Scenes
PILOT：一种用于在非结构化场景中进行位置操控的感知型集成底层控制器
人形机器人在以人为中心的环境中执行多样化交互与日常服务任务方面具有巨大潜力，这对控制器提出了将精确行走与灵巧操作无缝融合的更高要求。然而，现有的大多数全身控制器缺乏对外界环境的感知能力，难以在复杂、非结构化场景中实现稳定的任务执行。为此，本文提出 PILOT，一种面向感知型行走–操作的一体化单阶段强化学习（RL）框架，在单一策略中协同实现感知行走与大范围全身控制。为增强地形感知能力并保证精确落足，我们设计了一种跨模态上下文编码器，将基于预测的本体感知特征与基于注意力机制的环境感知表示进行融合。此外，引入专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）策略架构以协调多种运动技能，从而在不同运动模式之间实现更好的专业化。我们在仿真环境以及真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了大量实验，验证了该框架的有效性。结果表明，PILOT 在稳定性、指令跟踪精度以及复杂地形通过能力方面均显著优于现有基线方法，展现了其作为非结构化场景中行走–操作任务稳健底层控制器的潜力。
Humanoid robots hold great potential for diverse interactions and daily service tasks within human-centered environments, necessitating controllers that seamlessly integrate precise locomotion with dexterous manipulation. However, most existing whole-body controllers lack exteroceptive awareness of the surrounding environment, rendering them insufficient for stable task execution in complex, unstructured scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose PILOT, a unified single-stage reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for perceptive loco-manipulation, which synergizes perceptive locomotion and expansive whole-body control within a single policy. To enhance terrain awareness and ensure precise foot placement, we design a cross-modal context encoder that fuses prediction-based proprioceptive features with attention-based perceptive representations. Furthermore, we introduce a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) policy architecture to coordinate diverse motor skills, facilitating better specialization across distinct motion patterns. Extensive experiments in both simulation and on the physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot validate the efficacy of our framework. PILOT demonstrates superior stability, command tracking precision, and terrain traversability compared to existing baselines. These results highlight its potential to serve as a robust, foundational low-level controller for loco-manipulation in unstructured scenes.
Deep Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Humanoid Robot Locomotion Control with Automatic Reward Learning
基于深度强化学习的真实世界人形机器人运动控制与自动奖励学习
人形机器人在多样化环境中解决复杂问题具有巨大潜力，例如核污染区、疫情影响区域以及外太空任务。然而，人形机器人本身是一个高度复杂的系统，融合了感知、机械设计、材料科学与运动控制等多个学科，每个领域都需要深入且系统的研究。其中，运动控制尤为关键，因为它直接决定了机器人运动的精度、稳定性和灵活性。近年来，随着基于 GPU 的并行计算能力快速发展以及高保真仿真环境的建立，基于深度强化学习（DRL）的多种方法被提出，用于实现精确且稳健的运动控制，这得益于其在不确定与动态环境中的灵活性与适应性。然而，真实世界任务的复杂性和不确定性使得为 DRL 代理设计有效的奖励函数成为一大挑战。目前大多数方法仍依赖人工设计或外部调参的奖励信号，这不仅需要丰富的领域知识，还伴随大量的人力投入和长时间收敛过程，甚至可能导致任务失败。
为解决这一问题，本工作提出了一种自动奖励学习方法，用于为人形机器人运动控制的 DRL 自动生成奖励函数。具体而言，我们构建了一个双层优化框架：上层通过奖励学习机制自适应构建并优化奖励函数，下层则利用学习到的奖励函数训练 DRL 控制策略。为验证该方法的有效性，我们设计了三组实验：在 MuJoCo 环境中训练 SAC 与 PPO 代理；在基于 Isaac Lab 构建的人形机器人仿真环境中训练 PPO 代理；通过 Sim-to-Real 将代理迁移到真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。实验结果表明，该自动奖励学习方法显著提高了学习效率，在仿真与真实部署中均优于人工设计的奖励函数。通过提升从仿真到真实机器人的控制策略迁移成功率，该方法为加速稳定且自适应的人形机器人在实际应用中的部署提供了有前景的解决方案。
Humanoid robots possess the potential to solve complex problems across diverse environments, such as nuclear-contaminated zones, epidemic-affected areas, and extraterrestrial missions. However, a humanoid robot is an inherently complex system that integrates multiple disciplines, including perception, mechanical design, materials science, and motion control, each of which requires comprehensive and in-depth investigation. Among these aspects, motion control plays a crucial role, as it directly determines the robot’s motion accuracy, stability, and flexibility. In recent years, with the rapid evolution of GPU-based parallel computing and highfidelity simulation environments, various deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based approaches have been proposed to achieve precise and robust motion control due to its flexibility and adaptability in uncertain and dynamic environments. However, the inherent complexity and uncertainty of real-world tasks pose significant challenges when designing effective reward functions for DRL agents. Most current methods typically rely on manually engineered or externally tuned reward signals, and therefore require significant domain expertise, associated with considerable human efforts and a long convergence time; these issues may even trigger mission failure. This work proposes an automatic reward learning method to derive reward functions for DRL in humanoid robot locomotion control. Specifically, a bilevel optimization framework is developed to enable automatic reward learning during policy learning. The reward learning mechanism in the upper level adaptively constructs and optimizes the reward function. The DRL framework in the lower level learns the locomotion control policy using the learned reward function. Three sets of experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach: training SAC and PPO agents in the MuJoCo environments; training the PPO agent in the humanoid robot environment built with Isaac Lab; and transferring the agent to the real-world Unitree G1 humanoid robot through Sim-to-Real. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed automatic reward learning method substantially improves learning efficiency and achieves superior performance to manually designed reward functions in both simulation and real-world deployment. By enhancing the success rate of transferring control policies from simulation to real-world humanoid robots, this approach provides a promising pathway toward accelerating the deployment of stable and adaptive humanoid robots in practical applications.
VDoF-MPC: Variable Degrees-of-Freedom Whole-Body Model Predictive Control
VDoF-MPC：可变自由度全身模型预测控制
模型预测控制（MPC）因能够实现人形机器人的动态行为而备受关注。尤其是全身模型预测控制（WBMPC），能够在单一框架下生成完整的全身运动序列。然而，人形机器人的全身模型具有高维的状态与动作空间，计算开销极大，同时不断变化的足–地面接触模式也增加了控制的复杂性。尽管已有多种求解器用于缓解这一复杂性，高计算成本仍然限制了 WBMPC 在实际人形机器人中的应用。一种直观的解决方案是根据任务启发式地降低模型自由度（DoF），但这种简化可能会削弱 WBMPC 的性能。为此，本文提出了一种可变自由度 WBMPC 框架：根据具体任务评估每个关节的重要性，自适应地锁定与任务无关的关节，从而提升计算速度。通过仿真分析，该方法不仅加快了计算速度，还提升了求解性能。此外，我们通过仿真与硬件实验全面验证了该方法的可行性。
Model predictive control has been attracting attention as a method for realizing dynamic behaviors in humanoid robots. Especially, whole-body model predictive control (WBMPC) generates wholebody motion sequences within a single framework. However, the whole-body model of humanoid robots has large state and action dimensions, requiring high computational cost. The changing foot–ground contact pattern also imposes complexity. Although various solvers have been proposed to relax the complexity, the high computational cost still limits the use of WBMPC for humanoid robots. A straightforward solution is to heuristically reduce the model’s degrees-of-freedom (DoF) to be task-specific, but such simplification risks impairing WBMPC’s performance. In response, we propose a variable-DoF WBMPC framework, which evaluates the importance of each joint based on the faced task and adaptively locks task-irrelevant joints to improve the calculation speed. The proposed method was analyzed in detail on simulations, and the results show that it improves the calculation speed and also improves the solution-finding performance. Furthermore, the feasibility of the proposed method was comprehensively confirmed by both simulations and hardware experiments.
Vision-Language Models on the Edge for Real-Time Robotic Perception
面向实时机器人感知的边缘视觉语言模型
视觉–语言模型（VLMs）能够实现机器人感知与交互的多模态推理，但在现实系统中的部署仍受限于延迟、有限的机载计算资源以及将计算任务外包到云端带来的隐私风险。6G 网络下的边缘智能，尤其是开放无线接入网（Open RAN）与多接入边缘计算（MEC），为解决这些问题提供了可行途径——将计算能力更靠近数据源。本研究以 Unitree G1 人形机器人为实体测试平台，探索在 ORAN/MEC 基础设施上部署 VLMs 的方法。我们设计了基于 WebRTC 的数据流管道，将多模态数据实时传输到边缘节点，并比较了在边缘与云端部署 LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct 的性能。结果表明，边缘部署在保持接近云端的推理精度的同时，将端到端延迟降低了约 5%。此外，我们还评估了针对资源受限环境优化的轻量级模型 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct，其响应时间低于一秒，延迟减少一半以上，但精度有所下降。
Vision–Language Models (VLMs) enable multimodal reasoning for robotic perception and interaction, but their deployment in real-world systems remains constrained by latency, limited onboard resources, and privacy risks of cloud offloading. Edge intelligence within 6G, particularly Open RAN and Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC), offers a pathway to address these challenges by bringing computation closer to the data source. This work investigates the deployment of VLMs on ORAN/MEC infrastructure using the Unitree G1 humanoid robot as an embodied testbed. We design a WebRTC-based pipeline that streams multimodal data to an edge node and evaluate LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct deployed at the edge versus in the cloud under real-time conditions. Our results show that edge deployment preserves near-cloud accuracy while reducing end-to-end latency by 5%. We further evaluate Qwen2-VL-2BInstruct, a compact model optimized for resource-constrained environments, which achieves sub-second responsiveness, cutting latency by more than half but at the cost of accuracy.
HumanoidVLM: Vision–Language–Guided Impedance Control for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation
HumanoidVLM：面向接触密集型人形机器人操作的视觉-语言引导阻抗控制
人形机器人需要根据不同对象和任务调整接触行为，但大多数控制器仍依赖固定的手工调节阻抗增益和夹爪设置。本文提出 HumanoidVLM，一个基于视觉–语言的检索框架，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够直接从自我中心视角的 RGB 图像中选择适合任务的笛卡尔阻抗参数和夹爪配置。该系统将用于语义任务推理的视觉–语言模型与基于 FAISS 的检索增强生成（RAG）模块结合，能够从两个自定义数据库中检索经过实验验证的刚度–阻尼对及对象特定的抓取角度，并通过任务空间阻抗控制器执行，实现柔顺操作。我们在 14 个视觉场景下对 HumanoidVLM 进行了评估，检索准确率达到 93%。真实环境实验显示交互动态稳定，𝑧 轴跟踪误差通常在 1–3.5 cm 之间，虚拟力与任务相关阻抗设置一致。这些结果表明，将语义感知与基于检索的控制相结合，为实现可解释且自适应的人形机器人操作提供了可行路径。
Humanoid robots must adapt their contact behavior to diverse objects and tasks, yet most controllers rely on fixed, hand-tuned impedance gains and gripper settings. This paper introduces HumanoidVLM, a vision–language driven retrieval framework that enables the Unitree G1 humanoid to select task-appropriate cartesian impedance parameters and gripper configurations directly from an ego-centric RGB image. The system couples a vision–language model for semantic task inference with a FAISS-based RetrievalAugmented Generation (RAG) module that retrieves experimentally validated stiffness–damping pairs and object-specific grasp angles from two custom databases, and executes them through a task-space impedance controller for compliant manipulation. We evaluate HumanoidVLM on 14 visual scenarios and achieve a retrieval accuracy of 93%. Real-world experiments show stable interaction dynamics, with 𝑧-axis tracking errors typically within 1–3.5 cm and virtual forces consistent with task-dependent impedance settings. These results demonstrate the feasibility of linking semantic perception with retrieval-based control as an interpretable path toward adaptive humanoid manipulation.
FocusNav: Spatial Selective Attention with Waypoint Guidance for Humanoid Local Navigation
FocusNav：基于航点引导的空间选择性注意力，用于人形机器人的局部导航
在非结构化且动态变化的环境中，实现人形机器人的稳健局部导航仍是一大挑战，这需要在长程导航目标与即时运动稳定性之间取得精细平衡。本文提出 FocusNav，一种空间选择性注意力框架，能够根据导航意图和实时稳定性自适应调节机器人的感知范围。FocusNav 引入了**路径点引导的空间交叉注意力（WGSCA）机制，将环境特征聚合锚定于预测的无碰撞路径点序列，确保沿规划轨迹获取与任务相关的感知信息。为了提升在复杂地形下的稳健性，还设计了稳定性感知选择门控（SASG）**模块，当检测到不稳定时自动截断远端信息，使策略优先保障即时落足安全。大量在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验表明，FocusNav 在复杂场景下显著提高了导航成功率，在避障能力和运动稳定性方面均优于基线方法，实现了动态复杂环境中的稳健导航。
Robust local navigation in unstructured and dynamic environments remains a significant challenge for humanoid robots, requiring a delicate balance between long-range navigation targets and immediate motion stability. In this paper, we propose FocusNav, a spatial selective attention framework that adaptively modulates the robot’s perceptual field based on navigational intent and real-time stability. FocusNav features a Waypoint-Guided Spatial Cross-Attention (WGSCA) mechanism that anchors environmental feature aggregation to a sequence of predicted collision-free waypoints, ensuring task-relevant perception along the planned trajectory. To enhance robustness in complex terrains, the Stability-Aware Selective Gating (SASG) module autonomously truncates distal information when detecting instability, compelling the policy to prioritize immediate foothold safety. Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot demonstrate that FocusNav significantly improves navigation success rates in challenging scenarios, outperforming baselines in both collision avoidance and motion stability, achieving robust navigation in dynamic and complex environments.
AdaMorph Unified Motion Retargeting via Embodiment-Aware Adaptive Transformers
AdaMorph：基于具身感知自适应变换器的统一运动重定向
将人体运动迁移到异构机器人是一项基础且具有挑战性的任务，主要由于不同机器人形态之间存在显著的运动学与动力学差异。现有方法通常依赖于为每种机器人单独训练模型，这种方式不仅扩展性差，也难以利用共享的运动语义。为此，本文提出 AdaMorph，一种统一的神经网络运动重定向框架，使单一模型能够将人体运动适配到多种机器人形态。我们将重定向问题视为条件生成任务，将人体运动映射到与形态无关的潜在意图空间，并利用双重提示机制（dual-purpose prompting）对生成过程进行条件控制。不同于简单的输入拼接方法，我们引入 自适应层归一化（AdaLN），根据机器人形态约束动态调制解码器的特征空间。此外，我们通过基于课程的训练目标强制保证物理合理性，确保通过积分保持方向和轨迹一致性。针对 12 种不同的人形机器人进行的实验结果表明，AdaMorph 有效实现了异构拓扑的统一控制，对未见过的复杂运动展现出强大的零样本泛化能力，同时保持了源动作的动态特征。
Retargeting human motion to heterogeneous robots is a fundamental challenge in robotics, primarily due to the severe kinematic and dynamic discrepancies between varying embodiments. Existing solutions typically resort to training embodimentspecific models, which scales poorly and fails to exploit shared motion semantics. To address this, we present AdaMorph, a unified neural retargeting framework that enables a single model to adapt human motion to diverse robot morphologies. Our approach treats retargeting as a conditional generation task. We map human motion into a morphology-agnostic latent intent space and utilize a dual-purpose prompting mechanism to condition the generation. Instead of simple input concatenation, we leverage Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN) to dynamically modulate the decoder’s feature space based on embodiment constraints. Furthermore, we enforce physical plausibility through a curriculum-based training objective that ensures orientation and trajectory consistency via integration. Experimental results on 12 distinct humanoid robots demonstrate that AdaMorph effectively unifies control across heterogeneous topologies, exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization to unseen complex motions while preserving the dynamic essence of the source behaviors.
Deep Whole-body Parkour
深度全身跑酷
当前人形机器人控制方法主要分为两类：一类是感知行走控制，能够较好地适应复杂地形，但通常局限于以步行为主的踏步式运动；另一类是通用运动跟踪控制，可以复现复杂技能，却往往忽略环境感知能力。本文将这两种范式加以融合，实现具备环境感知的通用运动控制。我们提出了一种将外感知信息引入全身运动跟踪的控制框架，使人形机器人能够在不平整地形上执行高度动态的非行走类任务。通过训练单一策略在多样地形特征上完成多种不同动作，我们展示了将感知融入控制回路所带来的显著优势。基于 Unitree G1 机器人的实验结果表明，该框架能够在非结构化地形上实现稳健且高度动态的多接触运动，例如撑越和翻滚等动作，显著拓展了机器人超越简单行走或奔跑的环境通行与运动能力。
Current approaches to humanoid control generally fall into two paradigms: perceptive locomotion, which handles terrain well but is limited to pedal gaits, and general motion tracking, which reproduces complex skills but ignores environmental capabilities. This work unites these paradigms to achieve perceptive general motion control. We present a framework where exteroceptive sensing is integrated into wholebody motion tracking, permitting a humanoid to perform highly dynamic, non-locomotion tasks on uneven terrain. By training a single policy to perform multiple distinct motions across varied terrestrial features, we demonstrate the non-trivial benefit of integrating perception into the control loop. Our results on unitree G1 robot show that this framework enables robust, highly dynamic multi-contact motions—such as vaulting and dive-rolling—on unstructured terrain, significantly expanding the robot’s traversability beyond simple walking or running.
Learning Whole-Body Human-Humanoid Interaction from Human-Human Demonstrations
从人与人之间的演示中学习全身人机交互
使人形机器人能够与人类进行真实的物理交互是机器人领域的重要前沿方向，但相关研究进展受到高质量人–人形机器人交互（HHoI）数据稀缺的严重制约。尽管利用数量丰富的人–人交互（HHI）数据是一种可扩展的替代方案，我们首先表明，传统的运动重定向方法会破坏关键接触关系，因而难以胜任这一任务。为此，本文提出 PAIR（Physics-Aware Interaction Retargeting），一种以接触为中心的两阶段处理流程，能够在不同形态之间保持接触语义一致性，从而生成物理一致的 HHoI 数据。然而，高质量数据的引入又暴露出第二个问题：传统模仿学习策略往往只复现轨迹，缺乏对交互本质的理解。针对这一不足，我们进一步提出 D-STAR（Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Action Reasoner），一种分层策略架构，将“何时行动”与“在何处行动”解耦建模。在 D-STAR 中，通过阶段注意力模块（负责时间维度）与多尺度空间模块（负责空间维度），并由扩散式决策头进行融合，从而生成超越简单模仿的同步全身行为。通过解耦时空推理过程，模型能够在不受空间噪声干扰的情况下学习稳健的时间阶段结构，实现灵敏且协调的人机协作。我们通过大量严格的仿真实验验证了该框架，相较基线方法取得了显著性能提升，并构建了一条从 HHI 数据学习复杂全身交互行为的完整有效流程。最终，该策略在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上、结合标准全身控制器成功部署，可通过文本指令执行拥抱、握手和击掌等交互动作。
Enabling humanoid robots to physically interact with humans is a critical frontier, but progress is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHoI) data. While leveraging abundant Human-Human Interaction (HHI) data presents a scalable alternative, we first demonstrate that standard retargeting fails by breaking the essential contacts. We address this with PAIR (Physics-Aware Interaction Retargeting), a contact-centric, two-stage pipeline that preserves contact semantics across morphology differences to generate physically consistent HHoI data. This high-quality data, however, exposes a second failure: conventional imitation learning policies merely mimic trajectories and lack interactive understanding. We therefore introduce D-STAR (Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Action Reasoner), a hierarchical policy that disentangles when to act from where to act. In D-STAR, Phase Attention (when) and a Multi-Scale Spatial module (where) are fused by the diffusion head to produce synchronized wholebody behaviors beyond mimicry. By decoupling these reasoning streams, our model learns robust temporal phases without being distracted by spatial noise, leading to responsive, synchronized collaboration. We validate our framework through extensive and rigorous simulations, demonstrating significant performance gains over baseline approaches and a complete, effective pipeline for learning complex whole-body interactions from HHI data. Deployment on a Unitree G1 under a standard whole-body controller; the policy executes Hug, Handshake, and High-Five selected via text commands.
Walk the PLANC: Physics-Guided RL for Agile Humanoid Locomotion on Constrained Footholds
行走在PLANC上：基于物理的强化学习在受限落脚点上实现敏捷人形机器人的运动
双足人形机器人在踏石、窄梁或木板等受限落足区域行走时，必须对平衡、时序以及接触决策进行精确协调，哪怕是微小误差也可能导致灾难性失败。传统的优化与控制方法能够较好地处理此类约束，但高度依赖对地形几何的精确建模，在感知存在噪声或不完整时容易失效。另一方面，强化学习在应对扰动和建模误差方面表现出较强的鲁棒性，但端到端策略往往难以自主学到离散地形所需的精确落足位置与步态时序。这两类方法的局限性促使我们探索一种以物理结构引导学习、而非单纯依赖奖励设计的方案。为此，本文提出了一种新的行走控制框架：通过降阶踏步规划器生成动力学一致的运动目标，并利用控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励引导强化学习训练过程。该方法将结构化的落足规划与数据驱动的自适应能力相结合，使人形机器人在踏石场景中实现了精确、敏捷且经过硬件验证的行走表现，相比传统的无模型强化学习基线方法显著提升了可靠性。完整的开源代码已发布，补充视频亦同步提供。
Bipedal humanoid robots must precisely coordinate balance, timing, and contact decisions when locomoting on constrained footholds such as stepping stones, beams, and planks— even minor errors can lead to catastrophic failure. Classical optimization and control pipelines handle these constraints well but depend on highly accurate mathematical representations of terrain geometry, making them prone to error when perception is noisy or incomplete. Meanwhile, reinforcement learning has shown strong resilience to disturbances and modeling errors, yet end-to-end policies rarely discover the precise foothold placement and step sequencing required for discontinuous terrain. These contrasting limitations motivate approaches that guide learning with physics-based structure rather than relying purely on reward shaping. In this work, we introduce a locomotion framework in which a reduced-order stepping planner supplies dynamically consistent motion targets that steer the RL training process via Control Lyapunov Function (CLF) rewards. This combination of structured footstep planning and data-driven adaptation produces accurate, agile, and hardware-validated stepping-stone locomotion on a humanoid robot, substantially improving reliability compared to conventional model-free reinforcement-learning baselines. The entire open-sourced code base is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/robot rl-E4FF, and the supplementary video is provided at https://youtu.be/D CZ FRYjtc.
NAVIDA Vision-Language Navigation with Inverse Dynamics Augmentation
NAVIDA视觉语言导航与逆动力学增强
视觉—语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在视觉信息丰富的环境中理解自然语言指令并做出连贯的行动。然而，现有大多数方法依赖于反应式的状态–动作映射，未能显式建模动作如何因果性地改变后续视觉观测。由于缺乏这种视觉–动作因果关系，智能体无法预判自身动作所引发的视觉变化，进而导致行为不稳定、泛化能力不足以及轨迹执行过程中的误差累积。为解决上述问题，本文提出 NAVIDA（Navigation with Inverse Dynamics Augmentation），一种将策略学习与动作驱动的视觉动力学及自适应执行相结合的统一 VLN 框架。NAVIDA 在训练过程中引入基于片段的逆动力学监督，以学习视觉变化与对应动作之间的因果关系；同时提出分层概率动作分块（HPAC）机制，将轨迹组织为多步动作块，为模型提供更具判别性的、长时程的视觉变化线索，从而扩展有效规划范围。为进一步抑制误差累积并在推理阶段提升行为稳定性，我们设计了一种熵引导的自适应执行机制，用于动态设定动作块的执行步长。大量实验结果表明，在参数规模更小的情况下（3B 对比 8B），NAVIDA 依然显著优于当前最先进的方法。此外，在 Unitree G1 等真实机器人平台上的实验验证了该方法在实际应用中的可行性与有效性。代码和数据将在论文接收后公开。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to interpret natural language instructions and act coherently in visually rich environments. However, most existing methods rely on reactive state–action mappings without explicitly modeling how actions causally transform subsequent visual observations. Lacking such vision–action causality, agents cannot anticipate the visual changes induced by its own actions, leading to unstable behaviors, weak generalization, and cumulative error along trajectory. To address these issues, we introduce NAVIDA (Navigation with Inverse Dynamics Augmentation), a unified VLN framework that couples policy learning with action-grounded visual dynamics and adaptive execution. NAVIDA augments training with chunk-based inverse-dynamics supervision to learn causal relationship between visual changes and corresponding actions. To structure this supervision and extend the effective planning range, NAVIDA employs hierarchical probabilistic action chunking (HPAC), which organizes trajectories into multi-step chunks and provides discriminative, longer-range visual-change cues. To further curb error accumulation and stabilize behavior at inference, an entropy-guided mechanism adaptively sets the execution horizon of action chunks. Extensive experiments show that NAVIDA achieves superior navigation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods with fewer parameters (3B vs. 8B). Real-world robot evaluations on Unitree G1 and other robot further validate the practical feasibility and effectiveness of our approach. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.
WaveMan: mmWave-Based Room-Scale Human Interaction Perception for Humanoid Robots
WaveMan：基于毫米波的房间级人机交互感知技术，适用于人形机器人
在家庭环境中实现可靠的人形机器人交互（HRI）受到两项基本需求的制约：一是对用户任意、非受限位置的鲁棒适应能力，二是对用户隐私的有效保护。毫米波（mmWave）感知天然具备隐私友好的特性，使其成为面向室内尺度人机交互的有前景方案，但现有基于毫米波的交互感知系统在面对未见过的距离或视角时往往缺乏良好的空间泛化能力。为解决这一问题，本文提出 WaveMan，一种空间自适应的室内尺度感知系统，可在任意用户位置下恢复稳定可靠的人机交互感知。WaveMan 通过引入视角对齐与频谱增强来实现空间一致性，并结合双通道注意力机制以提升特征提取的鲁棒性。所有实验均在一个集成了商用 FMCW 毫米波雷达与 Unitree G1 人形机器人的交互平台上完成。针对五名参与者的实验结果表明，在固定位置评测中，WaveMan 仅使用基线方法五分之一的训练位置数量，即可达到相同的跨位置识别精度；在随机自由位置测试中，识别准确率由 33.00% 显著提升至 94.33%。这些结果验证了在家庭场景下，基于毫米波的隐私保护型人形机器人交互在任意用户位置条件下实现可靠感知的可行性。
Reliable humanoid-robot interaction (HRI) in household environments is constrained by two fundamental requirements, namely robustness to unconstrained user positions and preservation of user privacy. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) sensing inherently supports privacy-preserving interaction, making it a promising modality for room-scale HRI. However, existing mmWave-based interaction-sensing systems exhibit poor spatial generalization at unseen distances or viewpoints. To address this challenge, we introduce WaveMan, a spatially adaptive roomscale perception system that restores reliable human interaction sensing across arbitrary user positions. WaveMan integrates viewpoint alignment and spectrogram enhancement for spatial consistency, with dual-channel attention for robust feature extraction. All experiments are conducted on a robotic interaction platform that integrates a commercial FMCW mmWave radar and a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Experiments across five participants show that, under fixed-position evaluation, WaveMan achieves the same crossposition accuracy as the baseline with five times fewer training positions. In random free-position testing, accuracy increases from 33.00% to 94.33%, enabled by the proposed method. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reliable, privacy-preserving interaction for household humanoid robots across unconstrained user positions.
Hiking in the Wild: A Scalable Perceptive Parkour Framework for Humanoids
野外徒步：面向人形机器人的可扩展感知跑酷框架
在复杂、非结构化环境中实现稳健的人形机器人徒步行走，需要从被动的本体感知转向主动的环境感知。然而，将外感知有效融入控制仍面临巨大挑战：基于建图的方法容易受到状态估计漂移的影响，例如基于 LiDAR 的方法难以应对躯干抖动；而现有端到端方法在可扩展性和训练复杂度方面也存在不足，尤其是一些依赖虚拟障碍物的工作往往需要针对具体场景逐一设计。为此，本文提出 Hiking in the Wild，一种可扩展的端到端跑酷式感知框架，旨在实现人形机器人在真实复杂环境中的稳健徒步行走。为保障训练稳定性与运动安全，我们引入了两项关键机制：其一是落足安全机制，通过可扩展的地形边缘检测与足部体积点相结合，有效防止机器人在边缘区域发生灾难性打滑；其二是平坦区域采样策略，通过生成可行的导航目标，缓解强化学习中的奖励投机问题。该方法采用单阶段强化学习方案，直接将原始深度感知与本体感知信息映射为关节动作，不依赖任何外部状态估计。我们在一款全尺寸人形机器人上开展了大量真实环境实验，结果表明所学习到的策略能够以最高 2.5 m/s 的速度稳健穿越复杂地形。为促进可复现研究与实际部署，训练与部署代码已全部开源；在真实机器人实验中，我们直接使用 Unitree G1 出厂自带的 Intel RealSense D435i 深度相机，无需任何硬件改动即可完成部署。
Achieving robust humanoid hiking in complex, unstructured environments requires transitioning from reactive proprioception to proactive perception. However, integrating exteroception remains a significant challenge: mapping-based methods suffer from state estimation drift; for instance, LiDARbased methods do not handle torso jitter well. Existing end-to-end approaches often struggle with scalability and training complexity; specifically, some previous works using virtual obstacles are implemented case-by-case. In this work, we present Hiking in the Wild, a scalable, end-to-end parkour perceptive framework designed for robust humanoid hiking. To ensure safety and training stability, we introduce two key mechanisms: a foothold safety mechanism combining scalable Terrain Edge Detection with Foot Volume Points to prevent catastrophic slippage on edges, and a Flat Patch Sampling strategy that mitigates reward hacking by generating feasible navigation targets. Our approach utilizes a single-stage reinforcement learning scheme, mapping raw depth inputs and proprioception directly to joint actions, without relying on external state estimation. Extensive field experiments on a full-size humanoid demonstrate that our policy enables robust traversal of complex terrains at speeds up to 2.5 m/s. The training and deployment code is open-sourced to facilitate reproducible research and deployment on real robots with minimal hardware modifications. For real-world deployment, we utilize the factory-integrated Intel RealSense D435i depth camera that comes standard with the Unitree G1 without any hardware modification.
Being-H0.5: Scaling Human-Centric Robot Learning for Cross-Embodiment Generalization
Being-H0.5：扩展以人为中心的机器人学习以实现跨具身泛化
我们提出 Being-H0.5，一种基础性的视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）模型，旨在实现跨多种机器人平台的稳健跨形态泛化。现有 VLA 方法往往受限于机器人形态差异大、可用数据稀缺等问题，而我们提出了一种以人为中心的学习范式，将人类交互轨迹视为物理交互的通用“母语”。为支撑这一理念，我们构建了 UniHand-2.0，这是目前规模最大的具身预训练方案，包含来自 30 种不同机器人形态、超过 3.5 万小时的多模态数据。进一步地，我们提出 统一动作空间（Unified Action Space），将异构机器人的控制指令映射到语义对齐的动作槽位，使资源受限的机器人能够从人类数据和高资源平台中快速迁移与引导技能。在此人类中心基础之上，我们设计了统一的序列建模与多任务预训练范式，有效衔接人类示范与机器人执行。在模型结构上，Being-H0.5 采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 设计，并引入新颖的 Mixture-of-Flow（MoF） 框架，将共享的运动原语与形态相关的专家模块进行解耦。为确保跨形态策略在真实世界中的稳定性，我们进一步提出 保持流形的门控机制（Manifold-Preserving Gating），以增强在感知分布变化下的鲁棒性，并引入 通用异步分块控制（Universal Async Chunking），以统一不同机器人在时延与控制频率差异下的分块控制方式。实验结果表明，Being-H0.5 在 LIBERO（98.9%）和 RoboCasa（53.9%）等仿真基准上取得了当前最优性能，并在五种不同机器人平台上展现出强大的跨形态能力。
We introduce Being-H0.5, a foundational Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model designed for robust cross-embodiment generalization across diverse robotic platforms. While existing VLAs often struggle with morphological heterogeneity and data scarcity, we propose a human-centric learning paradigm that treats human interaction traces as a universal “mother tongue” for physical interaction. To support this, we present UniHand-2.0, the largest embodied pre-training recipe to date, comprising over 35,000 hours of multimodal data across 30 distinct robotic embodiments. Our approach introduces a Unified Action Space that maps heterogeneous robot controls into semantically aligned slots, enabling low-resource robots to bootstrap skills from human data and high-resource platforms. Built upon this human-centric foundation, we design a unified sequential modeling and multi-task pre-training paradigm to bridge human demonstrations and robotic execution. Architecturally, Being-H0.5 utilizes a Mixture-of-Transformers design featuring a novel Mixture-of-Flow (MoF) framework to decouple shared motor primitives from specialized embodiment-specific experts. Finally, to make cross-embodiment policies stable in the real world, we introduce Manifold-Preserving Gating for robustness under sensory shift and Universal Async Chunking to universalize chunked control across embodiments with different latency and control profiles. We empirically demonstrate that Being-H0.5 achieves state-of-the-art results on simulated benchmarks such as LIBERO (98.9%) and RoboCasa (53.9%), meanwhile performing strong cross-embodiment capabilities on five robotic platforms.
Off-Policy Actor-Critic with Sigmoid-Bounded Entropy for Real-World Robot Learning
具有 Sigmoid 有界熵的离策略 Actor-Critic 算法在真实世界机器人学习中的应用
将强化学习部署到真实世界仍面临诸多挑战，包括样本效率低、奖励信号稀疏以及视觉观测噪声较大等问题。已有研究通过引入示范数据或人类反馈来提升学习效率与鲁棒性，但离线到在线的方法通常需要大规模数据且训练过程不稳定，而依赖 VLA 的强化学习又高度依赖大规模预训练与微调。因此，一种数据需求低、成本可控的真实世界强化学习方法仍然缺乏。为此，本文提出 SigEnt-SAC，一种离策略的 actor–critic 方法，能够仅依赖单条专家轨迹从零开始学习。其核心设计在于引入Sigmoid 有界熵项，有效避免由负熵驱动的优化过程将策略推向分布外动作，同时显著缓解 Q 函数振荡问题。我们在 D4RL 基准任务上对 SigEnt-SAC 与多种代表性方法进行了对比实验，结果表明该方法能够显著降低 Q 函数振荡，并以更快速度达到 100% 的任务成功率。进一步地，我们在多种真实机器人平台上验证了 SigEnt-SAC 的有效性，涵盖四类真实世界任务，智能体直接基于原始图像输入和稀疏奖励进行学习。实验结果显示，SigEnt-SAC 仅需少量真实交互即可学得成功策略，展示了一条低成本、具备实际可行性的真实世界强化学习部署路径。实验所使用的硬件平台包括：用于基于视觉的取球并射门任务的 AgileX LIMO Pro 与 TurtleBot3 Waffle；用于视觉操纵任务的 RealMan RM65-B 机械臂；以及用于基于视觉的运动控制任务的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人和 Unitree G1 人形机器人。
Deploying reinforcement learning in the real world remains challenging due to sample inefficiency, sparse rewards, and noisy visual observations. Prior work leverages demonstrations and human feedback to improve learning efficiency and robustness. However, offline-to-online methods need large datasets and can be unstable, while VLAassisted RL relies on large-scale pretraining and fine-tuning. As a result, a low-cost real-world RL method with minimal data requirements has yet to emerge. We introduce SigEnt-SAC, an offpolicy actor-critic method that learns from scratch using a single expert trajectory. Our key design is a sigmoid-bounded entropy term that prevents negative-entropy-driven optimization toward outof-distribution actions and reduces Q-function oscillations. We benchmark SigEnt-SAC on D4RL tasks against representative baselines. Experiments show that SigEnt-SAC substantially alleviates Qfunction oscillations and reaches a 100% success rate faster than prior methods. Finally, we validate SigEnt-SAC on four real-world robotic tasks across multiple embodiments, where agents learn from raw images and sparse rewards; results demonstrate that SigEnt-SAC can learn successful policies with only a small number of real-world interactions, suggesting a low-cost and practical pathway for real-world RL deployment. The hardware platforms include: an AgileX LIMO Pro and a TurtleBot3 Waffle (for automated ball pickup) for visionbased ball-to-goal scoring; a RealMan RM65-B manipulator for vision-based manipulation; and a Unitree Go2 quadruped as well as a Unitree G1 humanoid for vision-based locomotion.
Collision-Free Humanoid Traversal in Cluttered Indoor Scenes
在杂乱的室内场景中实现人形无碰撞移动
我们研究了人形机器人在室内复杂杂乱环境中的无碰撞穿越问题，例如跨越地面散落的障碍物、从低垂障碍物下方弯腰通过，或在狭窄通道中侧身挤行。为实现上述目标，人形机器人需要将对周围障碍物多样空间布局与几何形态的感知映射为相应的穿越技能。然而，由于缺乏一种能够有效刻画人形机器人—障碍物关系的表示方式，直接学习用于避碰的映射关系面临较大困难。为此，本文提出 Humanoid Potential Field（HumanoidPF），将人形机器人与障碍物之间的关系编码为无碰撞的运动方向，从而显著促进基于强化学习的穿越技能学习。我们还发现，HumanoidPF 作为一种感知表示在仿真到现实迁移中表现出极小的差距。为进一步提升在多样且具有挑战性的室内杂乱场景中的泛化能力，我们提出了一种混合场景生成方法，结合真实 3D 室内场景裁剪与程序化合成障碍物。最终，我们成功将所学策略迁移至真实世界，并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了验证，同时开发了一套遥操作系统，使用户仅需一次点击即可指挥机器人在室内复杂环境中完成穿越任务。大量仿真与真实环境实验验证了该方法的有效性。相关演示与代码已发布于：https://axian12138.github.io/CAT/
We study the problem of collision-free humanoid traversal in cluttered indoor scenes, such as hurdling over objects scattered on the floor, crouching under low-hanging obstacles, or squeezing through narrow passages. To achieve this goal, the humanoid needs to map its perception of surrounding obstacles with diverse spatial layouts and geometries to the corresponding traversal skills. However, the lack of an effective representation that captures humanoid–obstacle relationships during collision avoidance makes directly learning such mappings difficult. We therefore propose Humanoid Potential Field (HumanoidPF), which encodes these relationships as collision-free motion directions, significantly facilitating RLbased traversal skill learning. We also find that HumanoidPF exhibits a surprisingly negligible sim-to-real gap as a perceptual representation. To further enable generalizable traversal skills through diverse and challenging cluttered indoor scenes, we further propose a hybrid scene generation method, incorporating crops of realistic 3D indoor scenes and procedurally synthesized obstacles. We successfully transfer our policy to the real world on a Unitree G1 robot and develop a teleoperation system where users could command the humanoid to traverse in cluttered indoor scenes with just a single click. Extensive experiments are conducted in both simulation and the real world to validate the effectiveness of our method. Demos and code can be found in our website: https://axian12138.github.io/CAT/.
Making Infeasible Tasks Feasible: Planning to Reconfigure Disconnected 3D Environments with Movable Objects
化不可能为可能：规划如何重新配置具有可移动对象的非连接 3D 环境
许多路径规划方法旨在计算从初始位置到目标位置的动态可行且无碰撞的机器人路径。这些方法通常假设目标区域可达，但在实际环境中，这一假设经常不成立，尤其是在环境存在不连续区域时。针对这一问题，我们考虑已知的三维环境，其中由物体（blocks）构成的可导航支撑面（planes）可能是固定的（如桌子）或可移动的（如箱子），这些支撑面可能由于高度差、孔洞或水平间隔而相互不连通。我们关注的任务是机器人必须到达位于高处不可达平面上的目标区域。与其将此类任务判定为不可行，一种有效策略是使机器人能够与环境交互，通过重新排列可移动物体来建立新的可通行连接，这就是所谓的**可移动物体导航（Navigation Among Movable Objects, NAMO）**问题。现有 NAMO 规划器通常针对二维环境，仅通过推开障碍物清理路径，无法直接应对三维环境中的不连续性，此时障碍物需要被策略性地放置以桥接这些空间断裂。
为解决这一挑战，本文提出 BRiDGE（Block-based Reconfiguration in Disconnected 3D Geometric Environments），一种基于采样的规划方法，通过在机器人和物体配置空间上逐步构建树状结构，生成可行规划，明确哪些物体需要移动、放置位置及操作顺序，同时考虑可移动物体数量有限的约束。为加速规划，我们引入了非均匀采样策略。理论分析表明，该方法具有概率完备性。我们通过大量数值仿真和硬件实验验证了其有效性，并在真实机器人平台上展示了如何将这些能力分布于两种机器人：Unitree Go2 四足机器人与 Unitree G1 人形机器人，实现协同操作与三维复杂环境导航。
Several planners have been developed to compute dynamically feasible, collision-free robot paths from an initial to a goal configuration. A key assumption in these works is that the goal region is reachable; an assumption that often fails in practice when environments are disconnected. Motivated by this limitation, we consider known 3D environments comprising objects, also called blocks, that form distinct navigable support surfaces (planes), and that are either non-movable (e.g., tables) or movable (e.g., boxes). These surfaces may be mutually disconnected due to height differences, holes, or lateral separations. Our focus is on tasks where the robot must reach a goal region residing on an elevated plane that is unreachable. Rather than declaring such tasks infeasible, an effective strategy is to enable the robot to interact with the environment, rearranging movable objects to create new traversable connections; a problem known as Navigation Among Movable Objects (NAMO). Existing NAMO planners typically address 2D environments, where obstacles are pushed aside to clear a path. These methods cannot directly handle the considered 3D setting; in such cases, obstacles must be placed strategically to bridge these physical disconnections. We address this challenge by developing BRiDGE (Block-based Reconfiguration in Disconnected 3D Geometric Environments), a sampling-based planner that incrementally builds trees over robot and object configurations to compute feasible plans specifying which objects to move, where to place them, and in what order, while accounting for a limited number of movable objects. To accelerate planning, we introduce non-uniform sampling strategies. We show that our method is probabilistically complete and we provide extensive numerical and hardware experiments validating its effectiveness. We demonstrate, via hardware experiments, how these capabilities can be split across two robots: a Unitree Go2 quadruped and a Unitree G1 humanoid.
Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Humanoid Dynamics via Learned Nonlinear Operators
通过学习非线性算子弥合人形动力学中仿真与现实的差距
人形机器人控制的一个核心挑战在于缩小仿真与真实物理之间的差距以提升机器人学习效果。这一差距通常会导致执行失败，原因包括动力学差异、执行器行为不一致以及未建模的扰动。这种差异在单个电机层面表现为非线性变化，当人形机器人与不同重量的物体交互时，这种不确定性会进一步增强。为更好地对齐仿真与真实物理，我们构建了 SimLifter，这是首个专门用于缩小仿真到现实差距的数据集，即便在多样负载交互带来的高度可变条件下也适用。SimLifter 包含 257,493 帧数据，系统地采集了多模态信号——包括关节位置、速度、力矩、电机温度及等效力矩——覆盖四种标准负载、三台 Unitree H1-2 人形机器人以及两种驱动频率，同时涵盖单关节运动与全上肢协调动作。
基于此，我们提出 GAPONet，一种新颖的强化学习框架，用于实现策略从仿真到现实的稳健迁移。GAPONet 结合了 Unstacked Deep Operator Network（DeepONet） 与强化学习，通过学习多模态力信号上的非线性算子，估计同一策略在仿真与真实执行间的差异，同时展现出对未见机器人和零-shot 动作的强泛化能力。在未见过的人形机器人上，GAPONet 在零-shot 动作跟踪中表现显著优于默认参数下的 PD 控制，平均提升了所有关节精度 40% 以上，在最大负载下甚至达到 50%。在目标导向的物体搬运任务中，GAPONet 相比直接执行目标动作，在最大负载条件下将精度提升了 70%。
A central challenge in humanoid robotic control is bridging the gap between simulated and real-world physics to enhance robot learning. This gap often leads to execution failures due to discrepancies in dynamics, actuator behavior, and un modeled perturbations. This gap manifests as nonlinear variations at the level of each individual motor, and becomes even more unpredictable when the humanoid interacts with objects of varying weights. To better align simulation and real-world physics for robot learning, we curate SimLifter, the first dataset specifically designed to bridge the sim-to-real gap, even under the increased variability in troduced by diverse payload interactions. SimLifter contains 257,493 frames, and systematically captures multimodal signals—including joint positions, velocities, torques, motor temperatures, and equivalent torques—across four standard payloads, three Unitree H1-2 humanoid robots, and two actuation frequencies, covering both isolated joint movements and full upper-body coordination. We further introduce GAPONet, a novel reinforcement learning framework designed to enable robust policy transfer from simulation to the real world. Based on Unstacked Deep Opera tor Network (DeepONet) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), GAPONet estimates the discrepancies between simulation and real-world executions of the same policy by learning a nonlinear operator over multiple force modalities. It also demonstrates strong extrapolative generalization to unseen robots and zero-shot actions. On previously unseen humanoid robots, GAPONet shows substantial gains in zero-shot motion tracking, improving accuracy across all joints by over 40% on average compared to PD control with default hyperparameters, and up to 50% under maximum payload. In the goal-directed object delivery task, GAPONet improves accuracy by 70% under maximum payload over direct target action execution.
Task-Centric Policy Optimization from Misaligned Motion Priors
基于错位运动先验的任务中心策略优化
人形机器人控制通常利用来自人类示范的运动先验，以促使机器人产生更自然的运动行为。然而，由于人机形态差异、动作重定向误差以及与任务无关的变化，人类示范往往并非最优，甚至与机器人任务目标不一致，直接进行模仿反而可能削弱任务性能。相比之下，仅以任务为目标的强化学习虽然能够获得多种任务最优解，却常常导致动作不自然或稳定性不足。这一矛盾揭示了对抗模仿学习中线性奖励混合机制的根本性局限。为此，本文提出了一种以任务为中心的运动先验方法（Task-Centric Motion Priors，TCMP），这是一种任务优先的对抗模仿学习框架，将模仿视为条件正则项而非与任务目标同等的重要目标。TCMP 在最大化任务性能提升的同时，仅在模仿信号与任务进展相一致时才加以引入，从而实现一种自适应、具备几何感知能力的更新机制，既保证了任务可行方向上的有效下降，又能在不一致情况下抑制有害的模仿行为。我们从理论上分析了梯度冲突与任务优先的驻点特性，并通过一系列人形机器人控制实验验证了该方法的有效性。实验结果表明，即使在示范数据存在噪声的情况下，TCMP 仍能在保持一致运动风格的同时，实现稳健的任务性能。本文在 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上设计并验证了八类控制任务，且所有任务均具备真实硬件部署可行性。
Humanoid control often leverages motion priors from human demonstrations to encourage natural behaviors. However, such demonstrations are frequently suboptimal or misaligned with robotic tasks due to embodiment differences, retargeting errors, and task-irrelevant variations, causing na¨ıve imitation to degrade task performance. Conversely, task-only reinforcement learning admits many task-optimal solutions, often resulting in unnatural or unstable motions. This exposes a fundamental limitation of linear reward mixing in adversarial imitation learning. We propose TaskCentric Motion Priors (TCMP), a task-priority adversarial imitation framework that treats imitation as a conditional regularizer rather than a co-equal objective. TCMP maximizes task improvement while incorporating imitation signals only when they are compatible with task progress, yielding an adaptive, geometry-aware update that preserves task-feasible descent and suppresses harmful imitation under misalignment. We provide theoretical analysis of gradient conflict and task-priority stationary points, and validate our claims through humanoid control experiments demonstrating robust task performance with consistent motion style under noisy demonstrations. We consider eight humanoid control tasks instantiated on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, all designed to be deployable on real hardware.
HumanoidTurk: Expanding VR Haptics with Humanoids for Driving Simulations
HumanoidTurk：利用人形机器人扩展虚拟现实触觉技术，用于驾驶模拟
我们探索了将人形机器人重新定位为触觉媒介的可能性，使其功能超越传统的社交、辅助和协作型智能体角色。为展示这一理念，我们实现了 HumanoidTurk 系统，迈出了构建基于人形机器人的触觉反馈系统的第一步，该系统能够将虚拟现实（VR）驾驶游戏中的加速度（g-force）信号转化为同步的运动反馈。在一项包含六名参与者的先导实验中，我们比较了两种反馈合成方法，最终选择了基于滤波的方案，以获得更加平滑且真实的触觉体验。随后开展的一项包含十六名参与者的实验评估了四种条件：无反馈、控制器反馈、人形机器人+控制器反馈以及人类+控制器反馈。实验结果表明，人形机器人反馈显著提升了沉浸感、真实感和娱乐性，但在舒适性和模拟眩晕方面也引入了一定程度的代价。访谈结果进一步指出，相较于人类反馈的高度适应性，机器人反馈在一致性和可预测性方面表现更为突出。基于上述发现，我们总结出保真度、适应性和多样性三大关键主题，将人形机器人定位为一种独特且有潜力的沉浸式 VR 触觉交互媒介。HumanoidTurk 系统基于 Unitree G1 人形机器人实现，并配备了 Inspire Robots 的 RH56DFTP 灵巧手。
We explore how humanoid robots can be repurposed as haptic media, extending beyond their conventional role as social, assistive, collaborative agents. To illustrate this approach, we implemented HumanoidTurk, taking a first step toward a humanoid-based haptic system that translates in-game g-force signals into synchronized motion feedback in VR driving. A pilot study involving six participants compared two synthesis methods, leading us to adopt a filterbased approach for smoother and more realistic feedback. A subsequent study with sixteen participants evaluated four conditions: nofeedback, controller, humanoid+controller, and human+controller. Results showed that humanoid feedback enhanced immersion, realism, and enjoyment, while introducing moderate costs in terms of comfort and simulation sickness. Interviews further highlighted the robot’s consistency and predictability in contrast to the adaptability of human feedback. From these findings, we identify fidelity, adaptability, and versatility as emerging themes, positioning humanoids as a distinct haptic modality for immersive VR. We implemented HumanoidTurk using the Unitree G1 humanoid robot equipped with Inspire Robots’ RH56DFTP hands.
Olaf: Bringing an Animated Character to Life in the Physical World
奥拉夫：将动画角色带入现实世界
动画角色往往以不符合物理规律的方式运动，其身体比例也与典型的行走机器人相去甚远，这为机械结构设计与风格化运动控制的创新提供了理想平台。本文将动画角色 Olaf 带入现实世界，采用由动画参考引导的强化学习方法实现其运动控制。为营造 Olaf 的双脚沿身体移动的视觉错觉，我们在柔软的泡沫裙下隐藏了两条非对称的机械腿；为将执行器集成进角色内部，在手臂、嘴部和眼睛等部位采用了球面与平面连杆机构。由于行走周期会产生明显的接触冲击噪声，我们在训练过程中引入了额外的奖励项，以有效降低落地冲击声。与此同时，巨大的头部由细长颈部内的小型执行器驱动，再加上服装包覆，容易引发过热风险。为防止执行器过热，我们将温度作为额外输入引入控制策略，并设计相应奖励机制，使其保持在安全范围内。我们在仿真与真实硬件平台上验证了所建模方法的有效性，展示了一种前所未有的、极具真实感的穿戴式机器人角色表现。该系统使用了 Unitree 的电机组件。
Animated characters often move in non-physical ways and have proportions that are far from a typical walking robot. This provides an ideal platform for innovation in both mechanical design and stylized motion control. In this paper, we bring Olaf to life in the physical world, relying on reinforcement learning guided by animation references for control. To create the illusion of Olaf’s feet moving along his body, we hide two asymmetric legs under a soft foam skirt. To fit actuators inside the character, we use spherical and planar linkages in the arms, mouth, and eyes. Because the walk cycle results in harsh contact sounds, we introduce additional rewards that noticeably reduce impact noise. The large head, driven by small actuators in the character’s slim neck, creates a risk of overheating, amplified by the costume. To keep actuators from overheating, we feed temperature values as additional inputs to policies, introducing new rewards to keep them within bounds. We validate the efficacy of our modeling in simulation and on hardware, demonstrating an unmatched level of believability for a costumed robotic character. Using Unitree motors.
HumanX Toward Agile and Generalizable Humanoid Interaction Skills from Human Videos
HumanX：从人类视频中构建敏捷且通用的人形机器人交互技能
让人形机器人具备敏捷且自适应的交互能力一直是机器人领域的核心挑战之一。现有方法要么受限于真实交互数据的稀缺性，要么依赖精细且任务特定的奖励设计，从而严重限制了方法的可扩展性。为弥补这一差距，本文提出了 HumanX，一个端到端框架，能够在无需任务特定奖励的情况下，将人类视频直接编译为可泛化、可部署于真实世界的人形机器人交互技能。HumanX 由两个协同设计的核心组件构成：XGen，一种数据生成流水线，可从视频中合成多样且符合物理规律的机器人交互数据，并支持大规模数据增强；以及 XMimic，一个统一的模仿学习框架，用于学习具有良好泛化能力的交互技能。我们在篮球、足球、羽毛球、货物拾取和反应式对抗五个不同领域对 HumanX 进行了评估，结果表明该系统成功学习了 10 种不同技能，并以零样本方式迁移到真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。所学习的能力既包括无需外部感知即可完成的复杂动作（如假动作转身后仰跳投），也包括高度交互性的任务，例如基于单段视频示范学习并实现连续 10 个回合的人机传球协作。实验结果显示，HumanX 在泛化成功率上相比现有方法提升超过 8 倍，展示了一条可扩展、与任务无关的路径，用于学习多样化且实用的真实世界机器人交互技能。
Enabling humanoid robots to perform agile and adaptive interactive tasks has long been a core challenge in robotics. Current approaches are bottlenecked by either the scarcity of realistic interaction data or the need for meticulous, task-specific reward engineering, which limits their scalability. To narrow this gap, we present HumanX, a full-stack framework that compiles human video into generalizable, real-world interaction skills for humanoids, without task-specific rewards. HumanX integrates two co‑designed components: XGen, a data generation pipeline that synthesizes diverse and physically plausible robot interaction data from video while supporting scalable data augmentation; and XMimic, a unified imitation learning framework that learns generalizable interaction skills. Evaluated across five distinct domains—basketball, football, badminton, cargo pickup, and reactive fighting—HumanX successfully acquires 10 different skills and transfers them zero‑shot to a physical Unitree G1 humanoid. The learned capabilities include complex maneuvers such as pump‑fake turnaround fadeaway jumpshots without any external perception, as well as interactive tasks like sustained human‑robot passing sequences over 10 consecutive cycles—learned from a single video demonstration. Our experiments show that HumanX achieves over 8× higher generalization success than prior methods, demonstrating a scalable and task‑agnostic pathway for learning versatile, real‑world robot interactive skills.
AgentRob: From Virtual Forum Agents to Hijacked Physical Robots
AgentRob：从虚拟论坛客服到被劫持的实体机器人
由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主智能体已在虚拟环境中展现出显著能力，但其与物理世界的融合仍主要局限于直接控制接口。本文提出 AgentRob 框架，通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）将在线社区论坛、LLM 驱动的智能体与实体机器人连接起来，构建起三者之间的桥梁。AgentRob 提出一种全新的交互范式，使自主智能体能够参与在线论坛：读取帖子内容、解析其中的自然语言指令、调度实体机器人执行相应动作，并将执行结果反馈至社区。系统整体由三层结构构成：论坛层提供异步、持久化的多智能体交互环境；智能体层包含论坛智能体，轮询并响应以 @mention 方式定向触发的指令；机器人层则由基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的控制器以及 Unitree Go2 / Unitree G1 硬件组成，通过迭代式工具调用机制将高层指令转化为机器人基础动作。该框架支持多个具备不同身份与物理载体的智能体在同一论坛中并发运行，验证了基于论坛媒介实现多智能体机器人协同调度的可行性。
Large Language Model (LLM)-powered autonomous agents have demonstrated significant capabilities in virtual environments, yet their integration with the physical world remains narrowly confined to direct control interfaces. We present AgentRob, a framework that bridges online community forums, LLM-powered agents, and physical robots through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). AgentRob enables a novel paradigm where autonomous agents participate in online forums—reading posts, extracting natural language commands, dispatching physical robot actions, and reporting results back to the community. The system comprises three layers: a Forum Layer providing asynchronous, persistent, multiagent interaction; an Agent Layer with forum agents that poll for @mention-targeted commands; and a Robot Layer with VLMdriven controllers and Unitree Go2/G1 hardware that translate commands into robot primitives via iterative tool calling. The framework supports multiple concurrent agents with distinct identities and physical embodiments coexisting in the same forum, establishing the feasibility of forum-mediated multi-agent robot orchestration.
Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control
机器人控制中的流策略梯度
基于似然的策略梯度方法是目前从奖励中训练机器人控制策略的主流范式。这类方法依赖可微的动作似然函数，因此通常将策略输出约束为高斯等简单分布，从而限制了策略表达能力。针对这一问题，本文展示如何将流匹配策略梯度（flow matching policy gradients）——一种无需显式计算似然的新型框架——有效应用于复杂机器人控制场景中，以训练和微调更具表达能力的策略。我们提出一种改进目标函数，使其能够在足式运动控制、人形运动跟踪以及操作任务中取得良好效果，并实现两种人形机器人平台上的稳定仿真到现实迁移。我们进一步通过消融实验与训练动态分析，验证策略如何在从头训练阶段利用流表示提升探索能力，以及在微调阶段相比基线方法具备更强的鲁棒性。项目网页见 hongsukchoi.github.io/fpo-control。我们将流策略应用于运动控制任务，在 Booster T1 上部署用于行走控制的策略，并在 Unitree G1 上部署用于运动跟踪的策略。
Likelihood-based policy gradient methods are the dominant approach for training robot control policies from rewards. These methods rely on differentiable action likelihoods, which constrain policy outputs to simple distributions like Gaussians. In this work, we show how flow matching policy gradients—a recent framework that bypasses likelihood computation—can be made effective for training and fine-tuning more expressive policies in challenging robot control settings. We introduce an improved objective that enables success in legged locomotion, humanoid motion tracking, and manipulation tasks, as well as robust sim-to-real transfer on two humanoid robots. We then present ablations and analysis on training dynamics. Results show how policies can exploit the flow representation for exploration when training from scratch, as well as improved fine-tuning robustness over baselines. Project webpage: hongsukchoi.github.io/fpo-control. We deploy flow policies for locomotion to a Booster T1 and motion tracking to a Unitree G1.
APEX Learning Adaptive High-Platform Traversal for Humanoid Robots
机器人控制中的流策略梯度
随着深度强化学习（DRL）的快速发展，人形机器人已能够实现基于足部的复杂地形稳健行走。然而，对于高度超过腿长的平台，现有方法仍然受限，因为传统RL训练范式往往收敛到类似跳跃的解决方案，这类动作冲击大、受扭矩限制且难以安全部署于真实环境。为此，本文提出 APEX，一种基于感知的攀爬式高平台通过系统，通过组合多种地形条件行为实现越障能力，包括在垂直边缘执行爬上与爬下、在平台上行走或匍匐，以及通过站起与卧倒实现姿态重构。核心创新在于一种通用的“棘轮式进展奖励”（ratchet progress reward），用于学习富含接触的目标到达动作。该奖励机制持续跟踪历史最佳任务进展，并惩罚未取得改进的步骤，在无需显式速度奖励的情况下提供稠密监督，从而在强安全约束下实现高效探索。基于该机制，作者训练了基于激光雷达（LiDAR）的全身机动策略，并通过双重策略缩小仿真到现实的感知差距：训练阶段对建图伪影进行建模，部署阶段对高程图进行滤波与修补（inpainting）。最终，六种技能被蒸馏进单一统一策略中，使机器人能够根据局部几何结构与任务指令自主选择行为并平滑切换。实验在 29 自由度的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行，实现了对 0.8 米高平台（超过腿长 114%）的零样本仿真到现实迁移，表现出对不同平台高度与初始姿态的良好适应性，以及多技能间平滑稳定的过渡能力。
Humanoid locomotion has advanced rapidly with deep reinforcement learning (DRL), enabling robust feet-based traversal over uneven terrain. Yet platforms beyond leg length remain largely out of reach because current RL training paradigms often converge to jumping-like solutions that are high-impact, torque-limited, and unsafe for real-world deployment. To address this gap, we propose APEX, a system for perceptive, climbing-based high-platform traversal that composes terrain-conditioned behaviors: climb-up and climb-down at vertical edges, walking or crawling on the platform, and stand-up and lie-down for posture reconfiguration. Central to our approach is a generalized ratchet progress reward for learning contact-rich, goal-reaching maneuvers. It tracks best-so-far task progress and penalizes non-improving steps, which provides dense yet velocity-free supervision, enabling efficient exploration under strong safety regularization. Based on it, we train LiDAR-based full-body maneuver policies and reduce the sim-to-real perception gap via a dual strategy: training-time modeling of mapping artifacts and deployment-time filtering and inpainting of elevation maps. Finally, we distill all six skills into a single policy that autonomously selects behaviors and transitions from local geometry and commands. Experiments on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real traversal of 0.8m platforms (over 114% of leg length), with robust adaptation to platform height and initial pose and smooth, stable multi-skill transitions.
Perceptive Humanoid Parkour Chaining Dynamic Human Skills via Motion Matching
通过动作匹配实现感知型人形跑酷动作的动态人类技能串联
尽管近年来人形机器人在多地形稳定行走方面取得显著进展，但要实现高度动态的人类敏捷运动（如跑酷）仍然面临挑战。复杂环境中的敏捷跑酷不仅需要底层控制的鲁棒性，还要求具有人类般的动作表现力、长时序技能组合能力以及基于感知的决策能力。本文提出 Perceptive Humanoid Parkour（PHP），一个模块化框架，使人形机器人能够基于视觉自主完成长时序、高难度障碍跑酷任务。首先，方法通过动作匹配（motion matching）机制，在特征空间中执行最近邻搜索，将重定向的人类原子技能组合为长时序运动学轨迹，从而实现复杂技能链的灵活拼接与平滑过渡，同时保留动态人类运动的流畅性与优雅性。随后，作者为这些组合动作训练运动跟踪强化学习专家策略，并结合 DAgger 与强化学习，将其蒸馏为单一的、基于深度感知的多技能学生策略。关键在于，感知与技能组合的融合使机器人能够实现自主且情境感知的决策：仅依赖机载深度传感器与离散二维速度指令，机器人即可根据不同几何形状与高度的障碍，自主选择跨越、攀爬、腾跃或翻滚下落等动作。该框架在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了大量真实实验验证，实现了高度动态的跑酷能力，包括攀爬最高达 1.25 米（约为机器人身高的 96%）的高障碍，以及在多障碍长时序任务中实现闭环自适应，应对实时障碍扰动。
While recent advances in humanoid locomotion have achieved stable walking on varied terrains, capturing the agility and adaptivity of highly dynamic human motions remains an open challenge.
