HALyPO: Heterogeneous-Agent Lyapunov Policy Optimization for Human-Robot Collaboration
HALyPO：用于人机协作的异构智能体李雅普诺夫策略优化
为了提高人机协作（HRC）的泛化能力和鲁棒性，机器人必须能够处理人类行为和场景的组合多样性，这激发了对多智能体强化学习（MARL）的研究。然而，机器人与人类之间固有的异质性在学习过程中产生了一个理性差距（Rationality Gap, RG）——即去中心化最优响应动力学与中心化协同上升之间的变分失配。由此产生的学习问题是一个通用和微分博弈，因此在缺乏额外结构约束的情况下，独立的策略梯度更新可能会产生震荡或发散。我们提出了异质智能体 Lyapunov 策略优化（HALyPO），通过对参数空间不一致性度量强制执行每步 Lyapunov 下降条件，直接在策略参数空间内建立形式化稳定性。与针对受限马尔可夫决策过程中状态/轨迹约束的 Lyapunov 安全强化学习不同，HALyPO 利用 Lyapunov 认证来稳定去中心化策略学习。HALyPO 通过最优二次投影纠正去中心化梯度，确保理性差距的单调收缩，并实现在开放式交互空间中的有效探索。大量的仿真和真实世界类人机器人实验表明，这种经过认证的稳定性提高了协作极端情况下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
To improve generalization and resilience in human-robot collaboration (HRC), robots must handle the combinatorial diversity of human behaviors and contexts, motivating multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, inherent heterogeneity between robots and humans creates a rationality gap (RG) in the learning process-a variational mismatch between decentralized best-response dynamics and centralized cooperative ascent. The resulting learning problem is a general-sum differentiable game, so independent policy-gradient updates can oscillate or diverge without added structure. We propose heterogeneous-agent Lyapunov policy optimization (HALyPO), which establishes formal stability directly in the policy-parameter space by enforcing a per-step Lyapunov decrease condition on a parameter-space disagreement metric. Unlike Lyapunov-based safe RL, which targets state/trajectory constraints in constrained Markov decision processes, HALyPO uses Lyapunov certification to stabilize decentralized policy learning. HALyPO rectifies decentralized gradients via optimal quadratic projections, ensuring monotonic contraction of RG and enabling effective exploration of open-ended interaction spaces. Extensive simulations and real-world humanoid-robot experiments show that this certified stability improves generalization and robustness in collaborative corner cases.
Embedding Classical Balance Control Principles in Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Recovery
将经典平衡控制原理嵌入强化学习以进行人形机器人恢复
类人机器人仍然容易受到跌倒和不可恢复故障状态的影响，这限制了它们在非结构化环境中的实际应用。虽然强化学习已经展示了起身行为，但现有方法将恢复视为纯粹的任务奖励问题，缺乏对平衡状态的显式表示。我们提出了一种统一的强化学习策略，通过将经典的平衡指标——捕捉点（Capture Point）、质心状态和质心动量——嵌入为特权评论员（Critic）输入，并在训练期间直接围绕这些量进行奖励塑造，从而解决了这一局限性，而行动者（Actor）仅依赖本体感受以实现零样本硬件迁移。该策略无需参考轨迹或预设接触脚本，即可覆盖完整的恢复频谱：针对小扰动的踝关节和髋关节策略、在大推力下的校正步法，以及利用手、肘、膝盖进行多点接触起身的顺应性跌倒恢复。该策略在 Isaac Lab 中基于 Unitree H1-2 进行训练，在随机初始姿态和非预设跌倒配置下实现了 93.4% 的恢复成功率。消减实验表明，移除平衡感知结构会导致起身学习完全失败，这证实了这些指标提供了极具意义的学习信号，而非偶然的结构增益。在 MuJoCo 上的仿真到仿真（Sim-to-sim）迁移以及初步的硬件实验进一步证明了跨环境的泛化能力。这些结果表明，将可解释的平衡结构嵌入学习框架可以显著减少处于故障状态的时间，并扩大自主恢复的覆盖范围。
Humanoid robots remain vulnerable to falls and unrecoverable failure states, limiting their practical utility in unstructured environments. While reinforcement learning has demonstrated stand-up behaviors, existing approaches treat recovery as a pure task-reward problem without an explicit representation of the balance state. We present a unified RL policy that addresses this limitation by embedding classical balance metrics: capture point, center-of-mass state, and centroidal momentum, as privileged critic inputs and shaping rewards directly around these quantities during training, while the actor relies solely on proprioception for zero-shot hardware transfer. Without reference trajectories or scripted contacts, a single policy spans the full recovery spectrum: ankle and hip strategies for small disturbances, corrective stepping under large pushes, and compliant falling with multi-contact stand-up using the hands, elbows, and knees. Trained on the Unitree H1-2 in Isaac Lab, the policy achieves a 93.4% recovery rate across randomized initial poses and unscripted fall configurations. An ablation study shows that removing the balance-informed structure causes stand-up learning to fail entirely, confirming that these metrics provide a meaningful learning signal rather than incidental structure. Sim-to-sim transfer to MuJoCo and preliminary hardware experiments further demonstrate cross-environment generalization. These results show that embedding interpretable balance structure into the learning framework substantially reduces time spent in failure states and broadens the envelope of autonomous recovery.
Expert-Guided Imitation for Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Motion Capture
专家指导模仿法在动作捕捉中学习人形机器人移动操作
尽管双足运动取得了显著进展，但使类人机器人能够通过与环境的有效交互来执行通用的全身任务，仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。虽然深度强化学习（RL）近期在动态行走方面——甚至在复杂且不可预测的地形上——展示了令人印象深刻的结果，但现实世界的实用性要求类人机器人超越单纯的运动，去执行以任务为导向的行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个框架，通过训练跟踪人类运动参考的策略，教类人机器人模仿人类执行有用的任务。我们的方法利用高质量的内部动作捕捉（MoCap）数据，并从中进行运动学重定向，将人类轨迹投影到类人机器人平台上。至关重要的是，我们采用了一种混合学习范式：策略被训练用于跟踪来自动作捕捉数据的上半身和根部运动，并接受来自预训练全向行走专家的额外监督。通过行为克隆（BC）目标实现的专家引导，确保了腿部运动遵循类人机器人的动力学和运动学约束。我们完全在仿真中训练策略，并成功将其迁移到真实的 Unitree H1 类人机器人上。我们在箱子搬运运动操纵任务中验证了我们的方法，展示了有效的仿真到现实（Sim-to-real）迁移，标志着向更强大、任务驱动的类人机器人行为迈出了一步。
Despite significant advances in bipedal locomotion, enabling humanoid robots to perform general whole-body tasks through meaningful interaction with their environments remains a challenging open problem. While deep reinforcement learning (RL) has recently demonstrated impressive results in dynamic walking — even on complex and unpredictable terrain — real-world utility demands that humanoids go beyond locomotion to execute task-oriented behaviors.In this work, we propose a framework for teaching humanoid robots to imitate humans doing useful tasks by training policies for tracking human motion references. Our approach leverages high-quality in-house motion capture (MoCap) data, from which we perform kinematic retargeting to project human trajectories onto a humanoid platform. Crucially, we adopt a hybrid learning paradigm: the policy is trained to track upper-body and root motions from the MoCap data, and receives additional supervision from a pre-trained omnidirectional walking expert. This expert guidance, implemented via a Behavior Cloning (BC) objective, ensures that leg motion respects dynamics and kinematic constraints of the humanoid. We train policies entirely in simulation and successfully transfer them to a real Unitree H1 humanoid robot. We validate our method on a box loco-manipulation task, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer and marking a step toward more capable, task-driven humanoid behavior.
Jointly Modeling Video Dynamics and Actions for Generalizable Robot Control
联合建模视频动力学和动作以实现通用机器人控制
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人学习领域一个极具前景的范式，但其表征仍然主要继承自静态图像-文本预训练，导致物理动力学只能从相对有限的动作数据中学习。相比之下，生成式视频模型编码了丰富的时空结构和隐式物理信息，使其成为机器人操作的有力基础。然而，其潜力尚未在文献中得到充分挖掘。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了DiT4DiT，一种端到端的视频动作模型，它将视频扩散变换器与动作扩散变换器耦合在一个统一的级联框架中。DiT4DiT并非依赖于重建的未来帧，而是从视频生成过程中提取中间去噪特征，并将其用作动作预测的时间基础条件。我们进一步提出了一种双流匹配目标，该目标采用解耦的时间步长和噪声尺度，用于视频预测、隐藏状态提取和动作推理，从而实现两个模块的协同训练。在仿真和真实世界基准测试中，DiT4DiT 均取得了最先进的结果，在 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa GR1 上分别达到了平均 98.6% 和 50.8% 的成功率，同时使用的训练数据量显著减少。在 Unitree G1 机器人上，它也展现出了卓越的真实世界性能和强大的零样本泛化能力。重要的是，DiT4DiT 将样本效率提高了 10 倍以上，并将收敛速度提高了 7 倍，这表明视频生成可以作为机器人策略学习的有效尺度代理。
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, but their representations are still largely inherited from static image-text pretraining, leaving physical dynamics to be learned from comparatively limited action data. Generative video models, by contrast, encode rich spatiotemporal structure and implicit physics, making them a compelling foundation for robotic manipulation. But their potentials are not fully explored in the literature. To bridge the gap, we introduce DiT4DiT, an end-to-end VideoAction Model that couples a video Diffusion Transformer with an action Diffusion Transformer in a unified cascaded framework. Instead of relying on reconstructed future frames, DiT4DiT extracts intermediate denoising features from the video generation process and uses them as temporally grounded conditions for action prediction. We further propose a dual flow-matching objective with decoupled timesteps and noise scales for video prediction, hidden-state extraction, and action inference, enabling coherent joint training of both modules. Across simulation and real-world benchmarks, DiT4DiT achieves state-of-the-art results, reaching average success rates of 98.6% on LIBERO and 50.8% on RoboCasa GR1 while using substantially less training data. On the Unitree G1 robot, it also delivers superior real-world performance and strong zero-shot generalization. Importantly, DiT4DiT improves sample efficiency by over 10× and speeds up convergence by up to 7×, demonstrating that video generation can serve as an effective scaling proxy for robot policy learning.
FlashSAC: Fast and Stable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for High-Dimensional Robot Control
FlashSAC：用于高维机器人控制的快速稳定的离策略强化学习
当缺乏专家示范数据时，强化学习（RL）是实现机器人控制的核心方法之一。以近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO）为代表的在线（on-policy）方法因其稳定性而被广泛采用，但其高度依赖分布较窄的在线采样数据，这限制了其在高维状态与动作空间中的策略评估能力。相比之下，离线（off-policy）方法能够利用更广泛的状态—动作分布进行学习，从而克服上述局限；然而，由于需要在多样化数据上拟合价值函数，这类方法通常需要大量梯度更新，进而导致通过自举（bootstrapping）传播的价值估计误差不断累积，最终带来收敛缓慢与训练不稳定的问题。为此，我们提出了FlashSAC——一种基于软演员—评论家（Soft Actor-Critic, SAC）的快速且稳定的离线强化学习算法。受监督学习中尺度定律（scaling laws）的启发，FlashSAC大幅减少了梯度更新次数，同时通过更大的模型规模与更高的数据吞吐量进行补偿。为在大规模训练条件下维持稳定性，FlashSAC显式约束了网络权重、特征表示以及梯度的范数，从而有效抑制评论家网络误差的累积。在10个仿真平台上的60余项任务中，FlashSAC在最终性能与训练效率方面均持续优于PPO及多种强基线离线强化学习方法，尤其在灵巧操作等高维任务上表现出最显著的优势。在基于宇树（Unitree）G1平台的人形机器人“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）运动控制实验中，FlashSAC将训练时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，展现了离线强化学习在跨现实迁移中的巨大潜力。
Reinforcement learning (RL) is a core approach for robot control when expert demonstrations are unavailable. On-policy methods such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) are widely used for their stability, but their reliance on narrowly distributed on-policy data limits accurate policy evaluation in high-dimensional state and action spaces. Off-policy methods can overcome this limitation by learning from a broader state-action distribution, yet suffer from slow convergence and instability, as fitting a value function over diverse data requires many gradient updates, causing critic errors to accumulate through bootstrapping. We present FlashSAC, a fast and stable off-policy RL algorithm built on Soft Actor-Critic. Motivated by scaling laws observed in supervised learning, FlashSAC sharply reduces gradient updates while compensating with larger models and higher data throughput. To maintain stability at increased scale, FlashSAC explicitly bounds weight, feature, and gradient norms, curbing critic error accumulation. Across over 60 tasks in 10 simulators, FlashSAC consistently outperforms PPO and strong off-policy baselines in both final performance and training efficiency, with the largest gains on high-dimensional tasks such as dexterous manipulation. In sim-to-real humanoid locomotion on Unitree G1 platform, FlashSAC reduces training time from hours to minutes, demonstrating the promise of off-policy RL for sim-to-real transfer.
ABot-Claw: A Foundation for Persistent, Cooperative, and Self-Evolving Robotic Agents
ABot-Claw：持久、协作和自我进化机器人代理的基础
当前具身智能系统在开放世界环境中，仍然面临高层推理能力与底层物理执行之间的显著鸿沟。尽管视觉—语言—动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型已具备较强的感知能力与直观响应能力，但其开放环（open-loop）特性限制了其在长时序任务中的表现。引入“系统2”认知机制的智能体虽然提升了规划能力，但大多仍运行于封闭沙盒环境中，依赖预定义工具集，且缺乏对真实系统的充分控制能力。OpenClaw 提供了具备完整系统权限的本地化运行时环境，但尚缺少支持长时程、多机器人执行任务所需的具身控制架构。为此，我们提出了 ABot-Claw——一种面向具身智能场景的 OpenClaw 扩展系统，其核心集成了以下三项关键机制：（1）统一的具身接口与基于能力驱动的调度机制，用于实现异构机器人之间的协同控制；（2）以视觉为中心、跨具身形态的多模态记忆系统，用于实现持久化上下文保持与具身语义检索；以及（3）基于评论家（critic）的闭环反馈机制与通用奖励模型，用于在线任务进度评估、局部纠错与动态重规划。ABot-Claw 采用由 OpenClaw 层、共享服务层以及机器人具身层组成的解耦式架构，从而实现了现实世界中的真实交互，打通了从自然语言意图到物理动作执行的完整闭环，并支持机器人智能体在开放、动态环境中的渐进式自演化能力。为验证所提出 ABot-Claw 系统的有效性与通用性，我们在三种异构机器人平台上开展了实验，包括宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人、宇树（Unitree）Go2 四足机器人以及 AgileX Piper 机械臂平台。
Current embodied intelligent systems still face a substantial gap between high-level reasoning and low-level physical execution in open-world environments. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong perception and intuitive responses, their open-loop nature limits long-horizon performance. Agents incorporating System 2 cognitive mechanisms improve planning, but usually operate in closed sandboxes with predefined toolkits and limited real-system control. OpenClaw provides a localized runtime with full system privileges, but lacks the embodied control architecture required for long-duration, multi-robot execution. We therefore propose ABot-Claw, an embodied extension of OpenClaw that integrates: 1) a unified embodiment interface with capability-driven scheduling for heterogeneous robot coordination; 2) a visual-centric cross-embodiment multimodal memory for persistent context retention and grounded retrieval; and 3) a critic-based closed-loop feedback mechanism with a generalist reward model for online progress evaluation, local correction, and replanning. With a decoupled architecture spanning the OpenClaw layer, shared service layer, and robot embodiment layer, ABot-Claw enables real-world interaction, closes the loop from natural language intent to physical action, and supports progressively self-evolving robotic agents in open, dynamic environments. To validate the effectiveness and generality of the proposed ABot-Claw system, experiments are conducted on three heterogeneous robotic platforms, including the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, the Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, and the Agilex Piper robotic arm.
Learning Model Predictive Control for a Humanoid Robotic Arm via Neural Approximation of Optimal Trajectories
基于神经网络逼近最优轨迹的人形机械臂学习模型预测控制
本文提出了一种面向人形机器人机械臂的分层运动规划与控制框架，该框架融合了最优轨迹生成、非线性模型预测控制（Model Predictive Control, MPC）以及对MPC策略进行神经网络近似的方法，以实现高速实时执行。第一阶段将轨迹生成问题建模为离线最优控制任务，在满足关节约束与避碰约束的条件下，生成动态一致的关节轨迹，并以最小化运动时间为目标。第二阶段采用非线性MPC进行在线运动跟踪，结合人形机器人机载RGB-D相机与基于YOLO的视觉感知流水线，实现对运动目标的实时检测与跟踪，同时保持安全距离约束。尽管非线性MPC能够实现高精度且满足约束条件的运动控制，但其较高的计算开销限制了系统在高频更新场景下的实时性能。为解决这一问题，本文进一步基于闭环MPC运行数据训练前馈神经网络，以学习从感知目标状态到最优关节轨迹之间的映射关系。最终得到的神经网络控制器能够以显著更低的计算成本复现非线性MPC的控制行为，从而支持在真实人形机器人平台上的实时部署。基于 MATLAB/Simscape 仿真与真实硬件实验的对比评估结果表明，所提出的神经网络控制器在轨迹跟踪精度与安全性能方面与非线性MPC几乎一致，同时具备更高的执行频率。该框架通过融合最优控制、预测调节与神经学习机制，为实现实时、具备约束感知能力且数据高效的人形机器人机械臂控制提供了一条切实可行的技术路径。
This paper presents a hierarchical motion planning and control framework for a humanoid robotic arm that integrates optimal trajectory generation, nonlinear model predictive control, and a neural approximation of the MPC policy for high-speed execution. The first stage formulates the trajectory generation problem as an offline optimal control task, producing dynamically consistent joint trajectories that minimize motion time while satisfying joint and collision-avoidance constraints. The second stage employs a nonlinear MPC for online motion tracking, using real-time object detection from the humanoid’s onboard RGB-D camera and YOLO-based vision pipeline to follow moving targets while maintaining safety margins. Although the nonlinear MPC achieves accurate, constraint-compliant motion, its computational load limits real-time performance at high update rates. To overcome this limitation, a feedforward neural network is trained on the closed-loop MPC data to learn the mapping between perceived target states and optimal joint trajectories. The resulting NN controller replicates the nonlinear behavior of the MPC with significantly reduced computation time, enabling real-time deployment on the physical humanoid. Comparative evaluations using MATLAB/Simscape simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the NN-based controller achieves near-identical tracking accuracy and safety performance as the nonlinear MPC, with higher execution rates. This hierarchical combination of optimal control, predictive regulation, and neural learning provides a practical pathway toward real-time, constraint-aware, and data-efficient humanoid arm control.
Learn Weightlessness: Imitate Non-Self-Stabilizing Motions on Humanoid Robot
学习失重状态：在人形机器人上模仿非自稳定运动
模仿学习与强化学习的结合，推动了人形机器人全身控制领域的显著进展，使机器人能够实现多种类人行为。然而，针对“环境依赖型动作”（environment-dependent motions）的研究仍然相对有限。现有方法通常强调严格的轨迹跟踪，却忽视了机器人与环境之间的物理交互。我们观察到，人类在执行非自稳定（Non-Self-Stabilizing, NSS）动作时，会自然利用一种“失重状态（weightless state）”机制——即有选择地放松特定关节，使身体能够被动地与环境接触，从而借助环境支撑完成身体稳定与动作执行。受这一生物学机制启发，本文设计了一种“失重状态自动标注”策略，用于数据集标注；并进一步提出“失重机制”（Weightlessness Mechanism, WM），该方法能够动态决定应放松哪些关节以及放松程度，从而在执行目标动作时实现有效的人体—环境交互。我们在三类具有代表性的NSS任务上对方法进行了验证，包括：坐在不同高度的椅子上、躺到不同倾角的床上，以及通过肩部或肘部倚靠墙面。大量仿真与宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人实验结果表明，WM 方法仅基于单动作示范数据训练、且无需任何任务特定调参，即可在多种环境配置下展现出良好的泛化能力，同时保持运动稳定性。本文工作在精确轨迹跟踪与自适应环境交互之间建立了联系，为接触密集型（contact-rich）的人形机器人控制提供了一种受生物机制启发的新思路。
The integration of imitation and reinforcement learning has enabled remarkable advances in humanoid whole-body control, facilitating diverse human-like behaviors. However, research on environment-dependent motions remains limited. Existing methods typically enforce rigid trajectory tracking while neglecting physical interactions with the environment. We observe that humans naturally exploit a "weightless" state during non-self-stabilizing (NSS) motions--selectively relaxing specific joints to allow passive body--environment contact, thereby stabilizing the body and completing the motion. Inspired by this biological mechanism, we design a weightlessness-state auto-labeling strategy for dataset annotation; and we propose the Weightlessness Mechanism (WM), a method that dynamically determines which joints to relax and to what level, together enabling effective environmental interaction while executing target motions. We evaluate our approach on 3 representative NSS tasks: sitting on chairs of varying heights, lying down on beds with different inclinations, and leaning against walls via shoulder or elbow. Extensive experiments in simulation and on the Unitree G1 robot demonstrate that our WM method, trained on single-action demonstrations without any task-specific tuning, achieves strong generalization across diverse environmental configurations while maintaining motion stability. Our work bridges the gap between precise trajectory tracking and adaptive environmental interaction, offering a biologically-inspired solution for contact-rich humanoid control.
Humanoid Robot Control by Nonlinear Model Predictive Controller with Adaptive Weight Whole Body Controller
基于非线性模型预测控制器和自适应权重全身控制器的类人机器人控制
随着各类建模方法的发展，基于模型的人形机器人运动控制持续得到优化与完善。其中，全身动力学模型（whole-body dynamics model）无疑是最全面的方法，因为它包含了机器人完整的动力学信息。然而，基于全身动力学的模型预测控制（Model Predictive Control, MPC）通常面临巨大的计算负担，并依赖高性能计算平台，因此在实际应用中更常采用混合式控制方案。本文提出了一种面向人形机器人的控制框架，该框架融合了质心动力学（centroidal dynamics）与全身动力学模型：首先，利用质心动力学构建非线性模型预测控制（Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, NMPC），用于规划未来运动轨迹，并求解执行这些轨迹所需的关节变量；随后，在当前时刻采用全身动力学模型计算关节力矩，并结合一种自适应加权全身控制器，实现机器人在不同地形之间的动态轨迹切换。最后，本文在宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人平台上验证了所提出控制框架的可行性与有效性。
Model-based locomotion control for humanoid robots has been continuously refined with the development of various modeling approaches. Undoubtedly, the whole-body dynamics model represents the most comprehensive approach, as it encompasses complete information about the robot’s dynamics. However, Model Predictive Control (MPC) based whole-body dynamics often encounters significant computational burden and requires high-performance computing platforms. Therefore, hybrid approaches are more commonly employed in practice. This paper presents a control framework for humanoid robots that integrates the centroidal dynamics for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) to plan future trajectories and solve the required joint variables to execute these trajectories. Then, whole-body dynamics is used to compute joint torques at the current time step and employs an adaptive weighted whole-body controller to achieve dynamic trajectory switches for different terrains. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control framework are validated on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot.
A Rapid Deployment Pipeline for Autonomous Humanoid Grasping Based on Foundation Models
基于基础模型的自主人形机器人抓取快速部署流程
传统上，为人形机器人部署一个新的操作对象通常需要耗费一到两天时间，包括数据采集、人工标注、三维模型获取以及模型训练等多个环节。本文提出了一种端到端快速部署流水线，通过集成三类基础模型（foundation models），将新对象的部署周期缩短至约30分钟。该系统主要包括：（i）基于 Roboflow 的自动标注模块，用于辅助训练 YOLOv8 目标检测器；（ii）基于 Meta SAM 3D 的三维重建模块，从而无需依赖专用激光扫描设备；以及（iii）基于 FoundationPose 的零样本（zero-shot）六自由度（6-DoF）位姿跟踪模块，能够直接使用 SAM 3D 生成的网格模型作为模板进行位姿估计。估计得到的目标位姿随后驱动基于 Unity 的逆运动学规划器，其生成的关节指令通过 UDP 流式传输至宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人，并通过 Unitree SDK 执行。实验结果表明，该系统在目标检测任务中实现了 mAP@0.5 = 0.995 的检测精度，并在真实机器人平台上于工作空间内五个不同位置成功完成抓取任务，同时实现了毫米级位姿跟踪精度。此外，我们还在汽车车窗涂胶任务中验证了该流水线的通用性。研究结果表明，将基础模型感知能力与日常成像设备（如智能手机）结合，可以显著降低人形机器人操作任务的部署门槛。
Deploying a humanoid robot to manipulate a new object has traditionally required one to two days of effort: data collection, manual annotation, 3D model acquisition, and model training. This paper presents an end-to-end rapid deployment pipeline that integrates three foundation-model components to shorten the onboarding cycle for a new object to approximately 30 minutes: (i) Roboflow-based automatic annotation to assist in training a YOLOv8 object detector; (ii) 3D reconstruction based on Meta SAM 3D, which eliminates the need for a dedicated laser scanner; and (iii) zero-shot 6-DoF pose tracking based on FoundationPose, using the SAM~3D-generated mesh directly as the template. The estimated pose drives a Unity-based inverse kinematics planner, whose joint commands are streamed via UDP to a Unitree~G1 humanoid and executed through the Unitree SDK. We demonstrate detection accuracy of mAP@0.5 = 0.995, pose tracking precision of  mm, and successful grasping on a real robot at five positions within the workspace. We further verify the generality of the pipeline on an automobile-window glue-application task. The results show that combining foundation models for perception with everyday imaging devices (e.g., smartphones) can substantially lower the deployment barrier for humanoid manipulation tasks.
Learning Whole-Body Humanoid Locomotion via Motion Generation and Motion Tracking
通过运动生成和运动追踪学习全身人形机器人的运动
全身人形机器人运动控制（whole-body humanoid locomotion）具有高度挑战性，其难点主要来源于高维控制空间、机器人形态本身的不稳定性，以及依赖机载感知实现对复杂地形的实时适应能力。直接利用带有奖励塑形（reward shaping）的强化学习（RL）进行人形机器人运动控制，往往容易产生“下肢主导”的运动行为；相比之下，基于模仿学习的强化学习虽然能够学习更加协调的全身动作技能，但通常局限于对参考动作的重放，缺乏一种能够基于实时感知在线调整动作、以适应复杂地形的机制。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种融合参考动作学习与地形感知自适应能力的全身人形机器人运动控制框架。首先，我们基于重定向后的人类运动数据训练扩散模型（diffusion model），用于实时生成具备地形感知能力的参考动作；与此同时，我们利用这些动作数据，通过强化学习训练全身动作跟踪器（reference tracker）。为增强系统在参考动作生成不完美情况下的鲁棒性，我们进一步在闭环控制设置下，固定动作生成器并对动作跟踪器进行微调。最终得到的系统不仅能够实现面向目标方向的运动控制，还具备基于地形感知的全身自适应能力，并能够部署于具备机载感知与计算能力的宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人平台。真实硬件实验表明，该系统能够成功穿越箱体、跨栏、楼梯以及多种复杂混合地形。定量实验结果进一步验证了在线动作生成与动作跟踪器微调在提升系统泛化能力与鲁棒性方面的有效性。
Whole-body humanoid locomotion is challenging due to high-dimensional control, morphological instability, and the need for real-time adaptation to various terrains using onboard perception. Directly applying reinforcement learning (RL) with reward shaping to humanoid locomotion often leads to lower-body-dominated behaviors, whereas imitation-based RL can learn more coordinated whole-body skills but is typically limited to replaying reference motions without a mechanism to adapt them online from perception for terrain-aware locomotion. To address this gap, we propose a whole-body humanoid locomotion framework that combines skills learned from reference motions with terrain-aware adaptation. We first train a diffusion model on retargeted human motions for real-time prediction of terrain-aware reference motions. Concurrently, we train a whole-body reference tracker with RL using this motion data. To improve robustness under imperfectly generated references, we further fine-tune the tracker with a frozen motion generator in a closed-loop setting. The resulting system supports directional goal-reaching control with terrain-aware whole-body adaptation, and can be deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot with onboard perception and computation. The hardware experiments demonstrate successful traversal over boxes, hurdles, stairs, and mixed terrain combinations. Quantitative results further show the benefits of incorporating online motion generation and fine-tuning the motion tracker for improved generalization and robustness.
Deep Reinforcement Learning for Real-World Humanoid Robot Locomotion Control with Automatic Reward Learning
基于深度强化学习的真实世界人形机器人运动控制与自动奖励学习
人形机器人具备在多种复杂环境中解决问题的巨大潜力，例如核污染区域、疫情灾害区域以及外星探索任务等。然而，人形机器人本质上是一个高度复杂的系统，融合了感知、机械设计、材料科学以及运动控制等多个学科领域，每一部分都需要深入且系统的研究。其中，运动控制尤为关键，因为它直接决定了机器人的运动精度、稳定性与灵活性。近年来，随着基于GPU的并行计算能力快速提升以及高保真仿真环境的不断发展，深度强化学习（Deep Reinforcement Learning, DRL）被广泛应用于人形机器人运动控制任务中，其优势在于能够在不确定与动态环境中展现良好的灵活性与适应性。然而，真实任务的复杂性与不确定性使得为DRL智能体设计有效奖励函数成为一项重要挑战。目前，大多数方法依赖人工设计或外部调参的奖励信号，不仅需要较强的领域专业知识，还伴随着较高的人力成本与较长的收敛时间，甚至可能导致任务失败。针对这一问题，本文提出一种用于人形机器人运动控制的自动奖励学习方法，用以自动推导DRL中的奖励函数。具体而言，我们构建了一种双层优化框架（bilevel optimization），以在策略学习过程中实现奖励函数的自动学习。其中，上层奖励学习机制负责自适应构建与优化奖励函数；下层DRL框架则基于学习得到的奖励函数进行运动控制策略的训练。我们通过三组实验验证所提出方法的有效性：在MuJoCo环境中训练Soft Actor-Critic与Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）智能体；在基于Isaac Lab构建的人形机器人仿真环境中训练PPO策略；以及通过仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移，将策略部署到真实的宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人平台上。实验结果表明，所提出的自动奖励学习方法显著提升了学习效率，并在仿真与真实环境中均优于人工设计奖励函数的基线方法。此外，该方法有效提高了控制策略从仿真环境向真实人形机器人的迁移成功率，为加速稳定、自适应人形机器人在实际应用中的部署提供了一条具有重要潜力的技术路径。
Humanoid robots possess the potential to solve complex problems across diverse environments, such as nuclear-contaminated zones, epidemic-affected areas, and extraterrestrial missions. However, a humanoid robot is an inherently complex system that integrates multiple disciplines, including perception, mechanical design, materials science, and motion control, each of which requires comprehensive and in-depth investigation. Among these aspects, motion control plays a crucial role, as it directly determines the robot’s motion accuracy, stability, and flexibility. In recent years, with the rapid evolution of graphics-processing-unit-based parallel computing and high-fidelity simulation environments, various deep-reinforcement-learning (DRL)-based approaches have been proposed to achieve precise and robust motion control due to its flexibility and adaptability in uncertain and dynamic environments. However, the inherent complexity and uncertainty of real-world tasks pose substantial challenges when designing effective reward functions for DRL agents. Most current methods typically rely on manually engineered or externally tuned reward signals and therefore require considerable domain expertise, associated with considerable human efforts and a long convergence time; these issues may even trigger mission failure. This work proposes an automatic reward learning method to derive reward functions for DRL in humanoid robot locomotion control. Specifically, a bilevel optimization framework is developed to enable automatic reward learning during policy learning. The reward learning mechanism in the upper level adaptively constructs and optimizes the reward function. The DRL framework in the lower level learns the locomotion control policy using the learned reward function. Three sets of experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach: training soft actor-critic and proximal policy optimization agents in MuJoCo environments, training the proximal policy optimization agent in a humanoid robot environment built with Isaac Lab, and transferring the agent to the real-world Unitree G1 humanoid robot through sim-to-real. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed automatic reward learning method substantially improves learning efficiency and achieves superior performance to manually designed reward functions in both simulation and real-world deployment. By enhancing the success rate of transferring control policies from simulation to real-world humanoid robots, this approach provides a promising pathway toward accelerating the deployment of stable and adaptive humanoid robots in practical applications.
Humanoid Robot Navigation in Shared Care Spaces: A Human-Aware Navigation Framework and Implementation
共享医疗空间中人形机器人导航：一种以人为本的导航框架及其实现
全球范围内，劳动力短缺与人口老龄化正在持续加剧医疗系统的压力，这促使人们开始关注人形机器人作为医疗支持领域潜在的技术解决方案。本文提出了一种概念验证（proof-of-concept）系统，基于宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人，在动态类医院环境中实现可靠导航。系统采用融合多模态传感器（如LiDAR与深度相机）的高级SLAM方法，以提升在复杂环境中的定位与导航能力。不同于传统方法仅将人类建模为需要规避的障碍物，我们的系统引入了“人类感知导航”（human-aware navigation）机制，在导航过程中综合考虑人际距离（proxemics）、社会情境以及可变空间边界，将人视为协作伙伴而非纯粹障碍，从而实现在人群密集的病房与走廊中安全且具可理解性的协同移动。通过展示机器人在物流与患者支持任务中的自主、目标导向运动能力，本研究为利用具备适应性的以人为中心机器人技术来增强医疗服务能力、减轻医护人员负担以及提升患者护理质量提供了一条可行路径。
Labor shortages and aging populations are straining hospital systems globally, prompting interest in humanoid robots as a viable technology solution for healthcare support. This paper presents a proof-of-concept deployment of a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using advanced SLAM with multi-modal sensors (LiDAR, depth cameras) for reliable navigation in dynamic hospital-like environments. Unlike conventional approaches that model humans solely as obstacles to avoid, our system implements human-aware navigation. Respecting proxemics, social context, and malleable spatial boundaries to treat people as collaborative partners, enabling safe, legible co-navigation in crowded wards and corridors. By demonstrating autonomous, purposeful movement for logistics and patient-support tasks, this research illustrates a pathway to augment healthcare delivery, worker support, and patient care outcomes through adaptable, human-centered robotics.
Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors
认知模型作为人形因素中的评估基元
基础模型正在不断拓展人形机器人能够执行的任务范围，但与此同时，也进一步拉大了“任务完成能力”与“符合人类行为方式的可兼容性”之间的差距。在人类环境中，人们通过一系列认知规律进行协调，例如可预测的时间节奏与具备可解释性的运动轨迹，使彼此能够进行预期性理解与协同。基于超越单纯任务完成的评估视角，本文提出了更广泛的“人形机器人因素”（Humanoid Factors, HoF）框架中的“认知支柱”（Cognitive Pillar）部分，该框架强调以显式认知模型作为具身推理与控制的可解释评估基本单元。作为案例研究，我们评估了在宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人上，通过行为克隆神经网络训练的“到达任务”（reaching task）是否符合费茨定律（Fitts’ Law）。该定律是经典的人类运动控制心理物理模型，用于描述运动时间与任务难度之间的关系。在仿真环境中，仅从任务完成率等指标来看，策略表现似乎是可接受的；然而在真实机器人部署中，该系统未能满足费茨定律所预期的关系，表现出明显的犹豫与时间节奏不稳定，而这些问题往往无法通过传统机器人指标被有效捕捉。
Foundation models are expanding what humanoid robots can do, but they also widen the gap between task completion and human-compatible behavior. In human environments, people coordinate using cognitive regularities---for instance, predictable timing and legible motion---that they can anticipate. Advocating for metrics beyond task completion, in this paper, we introduce several aspects of the Cognitive Pillar of our broader Humanoid Factors (HoF) framework, a cognitively grounded perspective in which explicit cognitive models serve as evaluation primitives for embodied reasoning and control. As a case study, we evaluate if a reaching task trained with a behavior cloning neural network on a Unitree G1 humanoid follows Fitts' Law, a classic human psychophysics model for motor control, relating movement time to task difficulty. In simulation, rollouts can appear acceptable under completion-centric metrics; in real-robot deployment, the expected Fitts relationship breaks, revealing hesitation and timing irregularity that standard robotics metrics often miss. Overall, these preliminary results motivate our broader goal of incorporating compact cognitive models as interpretable evaluation primitives for humanoids, with the longer-term aim of applying these principles to foundation model–driven control policies, where human-compatibility failures may be even harder to detect.
RPG: Robust Policy Gating for Smooth Multi-Skill Transitions in Humanoid Fighting
RPG：人形战斗中实现流畅多技能切换的稳健策略门控
人形机器人在多种任务中已经展现出令人印象深刻的运动能力，但实现具备人类风格的长时序动态格斗等全身控制任务仍然极具挑战性，主要原因在于这类任务对敏捷性与稳定性提出了极为严格的要求。尽管模仿学习能够使机器人执行一定的人类格斗动作，但现有方法通常依赖在多个单一技能策略之间切换，或使用统一策略直接模仿输入的参考动作。这类策略在技能切换过程中容易出现不稳定问题，因为不同技能或参考动作之间的初始与终止状态往往存在不匹配，从而引入分布外扰动，导致动作不平滑甚至不稳定。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种混合专家策略框架 RPG（Hybrid Expert Policy Framework），用于实现平滑且稳定的人形机器人多技能过渡。该方法引入运动过渡随机化与时间维度随机化，从而训练出一个统一策略，使其在技能切换过程中能够生成兼具敏捷性与稳定性的格斗动作。此外，我们设计了一套控制管线，将步行/奔跑等基础移动能力与格斗技能进行统一融合，使机器人能够实现人类风格的长时间连续对抗任务，并支持在任意时刻无缝中断或切换动作策略。大量仿真实验验证了该方法的有效性，同时在宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人上的真实部署结果进一步证明了该框架在现实环境中的鲁棒性与应用可行性。
Humanoid robots have demonstrated impressive motor skills in a wide range of tasks, yet whole-body control for humanlike long-time, dynamic fighting remains particularly challenging due to the stringent requirements on agility and stability. While imitation learning enables robots to execute human-like fighting skills, existing approaches often rely on switching among multiple single-skill policies or employing a general policy to imitate input reference motions. These strategies suffer from instability when transitioning between skills, as the mismatch of initial and terminal states across skills or reference motions introduces out-of-domain disturbances, resulting in unsmooth or unstable behaviors. In this work, we propose RPG, a hybrid expert policy framework, for smooth and stable humanoid multi-skills transition. Our approach incorporates motion transition randomization and temporal randomization to train a unified policy that generates agile fighting actions with stability and smoothness during skill transitions. Furthermore, we design a control pipeline that integrates walking/running locomotion with fighting skills, allowing humanlike long-time combat of arbitrary duration that can be seamlessly interrupted or transit action policies at any time. Extensive experiments in simulation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, and real-world deployment on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot further validates its robustness and applicability.
Action Agent: Agentic Video Generation Meets Flow-Constrained Diffusion
动作代理：智能视频生成与流约束扩散的结合
我们提出 Action Agent，一个将智能体式导航视频生成与流约束扩散控制统一起来的两阶段框架，用于多具身机器人导航。在第一阶段中，大语言模型（LLM）作为编排模块，负责选择视频扩散模型，通过迭代验证优化提示词，并积累跨任务记忆，从语言与图像输入中合成符合物理规律的第一视角导航视频。这一过程显著提升了视频生成成功率，在50个导航任务中由单次生成的35%提升至86%。在第二阶段中，我们提出 FlowDiT，一种流约束扩散Transformer，通过动作空间去噪扩散机制，将优化后的目标视频与语言指令转化为连续速度控制指令。FlowDiT融合了DINOv2视觉特征用于场景感知、基于光流学习的自运动表征，以及CLIP语言嵌入用于语义停止判断。我们在RECON户外导航数据集上进行预训练，并在Isaac Sim中采集的203条宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人轨迹上进行微调，以校准速度动力学特性。最终，一个43M参数的模型在仿真中实现73.2%的导航成功率，并在未见室内环境中于真实宇树G1机器人上达到64.7%的任务完成率，同时保持40–47 Hz的运行频率。我们在三种具身平台上评估Action Agent，包括真实宇树G1人形机器人、无人机以及轮式移动机器人（Isaac Sim），结果表明，将轨迹“想象”与执行解耦能够形成一种可扩展且具备具身适配性的语言引导导航范式。
We present Action Agent, a two-stage framework that unifies agentic navigation video generation with flow-constrained diffusion control for multi-embodiment robot navigation. In Stage I, a large language model (LLM) acts as an orchestration module that selects video diffusion models, refines prompts through iterative validation, and accumulates cross-task memory to synthesize physically plausible first-person navigation videos from language and image inputs. This increases video generation success from 35% (single-shot) to 86% across 50 navigation tasks. In Stage II, we introduce FlowDiT, a Flow-Constrained Diffusion Transformer that converts optimized goal videos and language instructions into continuous velocity commands using action-space denoising diffusion. FlowDiT integrates DINOv2 visual features, learned optical flow for ego-motion representation, and CLIP language embeddings for semantic stopping. We pretrain on the RECON outdoor navigation dataset and fine-tune on 203 Unitree G1 humanoid episodes collected in Isaac Sim to calibrate velocity dynamics. A single 43M-parameter checkpoint achieves 73.2% navigation success in simulation and 64.7% task completion on a real Unitree G1 in unseen indoor environments under open-loop execution, while operating at 40--47 Hz. We evaluate Action Agent across three embodiments: a Unitree G1 humanoid (real hardware), a drone, and a wheeled mobile robot (Isaac Sim), demonstrating that decoupling trajectory imagination from execution yields a scalable and embodiment-aware paradigm for language-guided navigation.
Yet Another Humanoid Motion Tracking Policyl
又一项人形机器人运动追踪策略
我们提出 YAHMP（Yet Another Humanoid Motion Tracking Policy），一种面向人形机器人的全身控制策略。该方法基于强化学习，在大规模重定向运动数据集上进行训练，并通过并行MuJoCo仿真实现高效学习。我们将YAHMP与TWIST2进行对比评估，结果表明该方法在运动轨迹跟踪精度以及对手部扰动的鲁棒性方面均有提升。最后，我们在宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人上验证了其仿真到现实的迁移能力。代码与实验视频已开源于：https://github.com/hucebot/yahmp
We present YAHMP (Yet Another Humanoid Motion tracking Policy), a whole-body controller for humanoid robots trained with RL on a large retargeted motion dataset using parallel MuJoCo simulations. We evaluate YAHMP against TWIST2 and show improved tracking performance and greater robustness to hand perturbations. Finally, we validate sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree G1 robot. Code and experiment videos are available at https://github.com/hucebot/yahmp.
LiveVLN: Breaking the Stop-and-Go Loop in Vision-Language Navigation
LiveVLN：打破视觉语言导航中的走走停停的恶性循环
现有导航系统在标准基准测试中已经取得较强性能，但在真实世界部署时往往仍表现为明显的“停走式”（stop-and-go）运行。这一瓶颈主要源于感知—推理—执行闭环仍然是阻塞式的：在每一次新观测到来后，控制器都必须等待感知、传输与推理完成才能继续动作执行。因此，仅降低动作生成计算开销并不能消除系统中不必要的等待时间。针对这一问题，本文提出 LiveVLN，一个无需额外训练的框架，通过引入多步动作延续机制，对预训练的视觉语言导航（VLM）模型进行增强，从而实现更连续的具身导航能力。与传统在每一轮完整感知与推理后暂停不同，LiveVLN在执行过程中与新观测的处理进行重叠，使得在当前可执行动作尚未耗尽之前即可提前交付更新后的未来动作，从而保证运动过程中动作持续可用，减少空闲等待并实现更平滑的在线执行。该框架可在运行时直接部署，并能够与兼容的预训练VLM导航模型无缝集成。在R2R与RxR基准测试中，LiveVLN在保持性能不变的同时显著降低等待时间并提升动作可用性。在真实世界部署中，其在StreamVLN任务中平均回合等待时间最多降低，在NaVIDA任务中将整体回合墙钟时间分别缩短，从而实现更加连贯的执行表现。诊断性实验基于宇树（Unitree）G1机器人在受控NaVIDA环境中进行，使用前视Intel RealSense D455f相机以及单目RGB输入进行测试。
Recent navigation systems achieve strong benchmark results, yet real-world deployment often remains visibly stop-and-go. This bottleneck arises because the sense-inference-execution loop is still blocking: after each new observation, the controller must wait for sensing, transmission, and inference before motion can continue. Reducing action-generation cost alone therefore does not remove redundant waiting. To address this issue, we present LiveVLN, a training-free framework for more continuous embodied navigation by augmenting pretrained VLM navigators with multi-step action continuation. Instead of pausing for each full sense-and-inference round, LiveVLN overlaps execution with the processing of newly arrived observations, allowing refreshed future actions to be handed off before the current executable prefix is exhausted. This design keeps actions continuously available during motion, reducing idle waiting and enabling smoother online execution. The framework operates at runtime and can be integrated with compatible pretrained VLM navigators. Across R2R and RxR, LiveVLN preserves benchmark performance while reducing waiting time and improving action availability. In real-world deployments, it cuts average episode waiting time by up to and shortens wall-clock episode time by on StreamVLN and on NaVIDA, yielding more coherent execution during deployment. The diagnostic study uses a controlled NaVIDA deployment on a Unitree G1 robot with a front-facing Intel RealSense D455f camera and monocular RGB input.
ExoActor: Exocentric Video Generation as Generalizable Interactive Humanoid Control
ExoActor：以外部视角生成视频，作为可通用的交互式人形控制
近年来人形控制系统取得了显著进展，但如何在机器人、其周围环境以及任务相关物体之间建模流畅且交互丰富的行为，仍然是一个根本性挑战。这一困难主要源于需要在大规模条件下同时捕捉空间上下文、时间动态、机器人动作以及任务意图，而这一需求与传统监督学习范式并不匹配。为此，我们提出 ExoActor，一种利用大规模视频生成模型泛化能力的新型框架。ExoActor 的核心思想是将第三视角视频生成作为统一接口，用于建模交互动态。在给定任务指令与场景上下文的条件下，ExoActor 能够合成具有合理性的执行过程，从而隐式编码机器人、环境与物体之间的协同交互关系。随后，这些视频输出通过一个管线被转化为可执行的人形机器人行为，该管线包括人体运动估计以及通用运动控制器执行，从而生成任务条件化的行为序列。为验证该框架的有效性，我们将其实现为端到端系统，并展示其在无需额外真实数据采集的情况下对新场景的良好泛化能力。此外，我们还讨论了当前实现的局限性，并展望了未来的研究方向，表明 ExoActor 为建模交互丰富的人形机器人行为提供了一种可扩展路径，并可能为生成式模型推动通用人形智能发展开辟新的方向。
Humanoid control systems have made significant progress in recent years, yet modeling fluent interaction-rich behavior between a robot, its surrounding environment, and task-relevant objects remains a fundamental challenge. This difficulty arises from the need to jointly capture spatial context, temporal dynamics, robot actions, and task intent at scale, which is a poor match to conventional supervision. We propose ExoActor, a novel framework that leverages the generalization capabilities of large-scale video generation models to address this problem. The key insight in ExoActor is to use third-person video generation as a unified interface for modeling interaction dynamics. Given a task instruction and scene context, ExoActor synthesizes plausible execution processes that implicitly encode coordinated interactions between robot, environment, and objects. Such video output is then transformed into executable humanoid behaviors through a pipeline that estimates human motion and executes it via a general motion controller, yielding a task-conditioned behavior sequence. To validate the proposed framework, we implement it as an end-to-end system and demonstrate its generalization to new scenarios without additional real-world data collection. Furthermore, we conclude by discussing limitations of the current implementation and outlining promising directions for future research, illustrating how ExoActor provides a scalable approach to modeling interaction-rich humanoid behaviors, potentially opening a new avenue for generative models to advance general-purpose humanoid intelligence.
GazeVLA: Learning Human Intention for Robotic Manipulation
GazeVLA：学习人类意图以进行机器人操作
具身基础模型（embodied foundation models）在机器人操作领域取得了显著突破，但其性能仍高度依赖大规模机器人示教数据。尽管近期已有工作尝试利用人类数据来缓解这一依赖问题，但由于人类与机器人之间固有的具身差异，如何有效提取可迁移知识仍然是一个关键挑战。我们认为，人类动作背后的“意图”可以作为一种强有力的中间表示，用于弥合这一差距。基于此，本文提出一种新的框架，显式建模并迁移人类意图，以促进机器人操作能力的提升。具体而言，我们通过“注视（gaze）”来建模人类意图，因为注视通常先于实际动作发生，并可作为人类意图的可观测代理信号。模型首先在大规模第一视角人类数据集上进行预训练，以学习人类意图及其与动作之间的协同关系，随后在少量机器人与人类混合数据上进行微调。在推理阶段，模型采用思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理范式，先预测意图，再执行具体动作，从而实现分阶段决策。我们在仿真与真实环境中进行了大量评估，涵盖长时序任务与精细操作任务，并在少样本学习与鲁棒性测试中进行验证。实验结果表明，该方法在多个强基线对比中始终表现更优，具备更强的泛化能力，并达到了当前最优性能。我们在两种真实机器人平台上进行了验证，包括双臂ALOHA机器人以及宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人。
Embodied foundation models have achieved significant breakthroughs in robotic manipulation, yet they still depend heavily on large-scale robot demonstrations. Although recent works have explored leveraging human data to alleviate this dependency, effectively extracting transferable knowledge remains a significant challenge due to the inherent embodiment gap between human and robot. We argue that the intention underlying human actions can serve as a powerful intermediate representation for bridging this gap. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework that explicitly learns and transfers human intention to facilitate robotic manipulation. Specifically, we model intention through gaze, as it naturally precedes physical actions and serves as an observable proxy for human intent. Our model is first pretrained on a large-scale egocentric human dataset to capture human intention and its synergy with action, followed by finetuning on a small set of robot and human data. During inference, the model adopts a Chain-of-Thought reasoning paradigm, sequentially predicting intention before executing the action. Extensive evaluations in simulation and real-world settings, across long-horizon and fine-grained tasks, and under few-shot and robustness benchmarks, show that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines, generalizes better, and achieves state-of-the-art performance.  two different real-world robotic platforms: a bimanual ALOHA robot and the Unitree G1.

Humanoid robots are entering our physical world at scale, yet as oversized toys--good at singing and dancing, but short on force-interaction capabilities for practical tasks. Bridging this gap necessitates prioritizing reliable contact perception as a fundamental requirement. Estimating external wrenches in humanoids is complicated by floating-base dynamics and indeterminate contact locations. Existing analytical frameworks require idealistic assumptions and hard-to-obtain measurements, which are often unavailable in practice. To bridge this gap, we propose SixthSense, a task-agnostic approach that infers whole-body contact timing, location, and wrenches from proprioception and IMU data alone. To capture the multi-modal dynamics between unstructured contact inputs and the uncertain motion outputs, we employ conditional flow matching to tokenize proprioceptive histories and estimate a spatiotemporally sparse contact-event flow. SixthSense serves as a plug-and-play perception module for applications including collision detection, physical human-robot interaction, and force-feedback teleoperation. Experiments across standing, walking, and whole-body motion-tracking policies showcased unprecedented performance in diverse behaviors. RoSHI: A Versatile Robot-oriented Suit for Human Data In-the-Wild
RoSHI：一款面向人类野外数据的多功能机器人防护服
要想规模化提升机器人学习能力，很可能需要来自真实人类在野外环境中具有丰富交互与长时序结构的数据。然而，现有用于采集此类数据的方法往往在可穿戴便携性、遮挡鲁棒性以及全局一致性之间存在明显权衡。为此，我们提出 RoSHI，一种混合式可穿戴系统，通过融合低成本稀疏IMU与Project Aria眼镜，实现从第一视角感知中估计佩戴者在度量全局坐标系下的完整三维姿态与人体形状。该系统的设计动机来自两类传感器的互补性：IMU能够在遮挡和高速运动情况下保持鲁棒性，而第一视角SLAM则提供长时序运动约束，并稳定上半身姿态估计。我们构建了一个包含高动态行为的数据集用于评估RoSHI，在该数据集上，该方法整体优于其他第一视角基线方法，并与最先进的第三视角方法SAM3D表现相当。最后，我们验证了该系统采集的运动数据适用于真实人形机器人的策略学习任务：我们将RoSHI记录的运动进行重定向，并在宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人上训练运动模仿的跟踪策略。
Scaling up robot learning will likely require human data containing rich and long-horizon interactions in the wild. Existing approaches for collecting such data trade off portability, robustness to occlusion, and global consistency. We introduce RoSHI, a hybrid wearable that fuses low-cost sparse IMUs with the Project Aria glasses to estimate the full 3D pose and body shape of the wearer in a metric global coordinate frame from egocentric perception. This system is motivated by the complementarity of the two sensors: IMUs provide robustness to occlusions and high-speed motions, while egocentric SLAM anchors long-horizon motion and stabilizes upper body pose. We collect a dataset of agile activities to evaluate RoSHI. On this dataset, we generally outperform other egocentric baselines and perform comparably to a state-of-the-art exocentric baseline (SAM3D). Finally, we demonstrate that the motion data recorded from our system are suitable for real-world humanoid policy learning. We retarget RoSHI motion data to a Unitree G1 humanoid and train motion-mimic tracking policies.
Switch: Learning Agile Skills Switching for Humanoid Robots
Switch：学习敏捷技能，为人形机器人切换
近年来，基于深度强化学习的全身控制方法在现实复杂地形的人形机器人运动技能上取得了显著进展。然而，现有方法在不同技能之间的灵活切换方面仍存在困难，这不仅限制了实际应用的灵活性，也带来了潜在的安全隐患与工程约束。为解决这一问题，本文提出一种分层多技能系统 Switch，使机器人能够在任意时刻实现平滑且连续的技能切换。该方法主要由三个核心模块构成：（1）技能图（Skill Graph, SG），基于多技能运动数据中的运动学相似性构建不同技能之间的潜在转移关系；（2）基于该技能图训练得到的全身运动跟踪策略，通过深度强化学习实现稳定的动作执行与技能表达；（3）在线技能调度器，用于驱动跟踪策略实现鲁棒执行与平滑切换。当发生技能切换需求或出现较大跟踪偏差时，调度器会在技能图上进行在线路径搜索，以找到最优且可行的技能转换路径，从而保证多样化运动技能的高效、稳定与实时执行。大量实验表明，Switch能够使人形机器人实现高成功率的敏捷技能切换，同时保持良好的动作模仿性能。在宇树（Unitree）G1人形机器人上的真实部署结果进一步验证了该系统能够在现实环境中实现连续且稳定的技能过渡。
Recent advancements in whole-body control through deep reinforcement learning have enabled humanoid robots to achieve remarkable progress in real-world chal lenging locomotion skills. However, existing approaches often struggle with flexible transitions between distinct skills, cre ating safety concerns and practical limitations. To address this challenge, we introduce a hierarchical multi-skill system, Switch, enabling seamless skill transitions at any moment. Our approach comprises three key components: (1) a Skill Graph (SG) that establishes potential cross-skill transitions based on kinematic similarity within multi-skill motion data, (2) a whole-body tracking policy trained on this skill graph through deep reinforcement learning, and (3) an online skill scheduler to drive the tracking policy for robust skill execution and smooth transitions. For skill switching or significant tracking deviations, the scheduler performs online graph search to find the optimal feasible path, which ensures efficient, stable, and real-time execution of diverse locomotion skills. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Switch empowers humanoid to execute agile skill transitions with high success rates while maintaining strong motion imitation performance. Experimental results on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that our system can be successfully deployed in the real world to achieve continuous transitions
HALO: Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion with Learned Latent Dynamics, Poincaré Maps, and Regions of Attraction
HALO：一种结合学习到的潜在动力学、庞加莱映射和吸引域的混合自编码运动算法
降阶模型在分析与控制高维动力系统中具有重要作用，但对于复杂的混杂系统（如足式机器人）而言，构建此类模型仍然具有挑战性。经典方法通常依赖人工设计的模板模型（如LIP、SLIP），尽管具有一定物理直觉与解释性，但本质上仍只是对真实动力学的近似。相比之下，数据驱动方法能够学习更精确的低维表示，但一个关键问题在于：在潜在空间中观察到的稳定性与安全性性质，是否能够可靠地迁移回原始高维系统仍不明确。为解决这一问题，本文提出 HALO（Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion），一种从轨迹数据中直接学习周期性混合动力系统低维降阶模型的框架。HALO通过自编码器学习低维潜在状态表示，并结合学习得到的潜在Poincaré映射来刻画逐步（step-to-step）的运动动力学，从而实现对步态周期动态的建模。这使得可以在潜在空间中进行Lyapunov稳定性分析，并构造相应的吸引域区域，同时这些结果可以通过解码器映射回全状态空间。我们在仿真跳跃机器人以及全身人形机器人运动任务上进行了实验，结果表明HALO能够学习到具有稳定结构意义的低维模型，并能够有效预测全状态系统中的吸引域边界。
Reduced-order models are powerful for analyzing and controlling high-dimensional dynamical systems. Yet constructing these models for complex hybrid systems such as legged robots remains challenging. Classical approaches rely on hand-designed template models (e.g., LIP, SLIP), which, though insightful, only approximate the underlying dynamics. In contrast, data-driven methods can extract more accurate low-dimensional representations, but it remains unclear when stability and safety properties observed in the latent space meaningfully transfer back to the full-order system. To bridge this gap, we introduce HALO (Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion), a framework for learning latent reduced-order models of periodic hybrid dynamics directly from trajectory data. HALO employs an autoencoder to identify a low-dimensional latent state together with a learned latent Poincaré map that captures step-to-step locomotion dynamics. This enables Lyapunov analysis and the construction of an associated region of attraction in the latent space, both of which can be lifted back to the full-order state space through the decoder. Experiments on a simulated hopping robot and full-body humanoid locomotion demonstrate that HALO yields low-dimensional models that retain meaningful stability structure and predict full-order region-of-attraction boundaries.

Interviews further highlighted the robot’s consistency and predictability in contrast to the adaptability of human feedback. From these findings, we identify fidelity, adaptability, and versatility as emerging themes, positioning humanoids as a distinct haptic modality for immersive VR. Toward next-generation autonomous structural health monitoring and inspection with humanoid robots
迈向下一代基于人形机器人的自主结构健康监测与检测
近年来，类人机器人因其拟人化形态、较高的自由度以及集成的多模态感知能力而受到广泛关注，并已在多种机器人与工程应用中展开探索。然而，其在结构健康监测（SHM）领域的潜在应用仍然缺乏系统研究。当前室内结构健康监测实践主要依赖人工巡检或适应性与灵活性有限的移动机器人平台，这在复杂室内环境中制约了巡检效率与覆盖范围。针对这一研究空白，本文提出RoboInspect，一种基于类人机器人的端到端自主巡检框架，用于室内结构检测任务。RoboInspect由三个核心模块组成：（i）基于强化学习训练并部署于类人机器人硬件上的运动控制器；（ii）结合先验地图与机载感知的自主导航与路径规划系统；（iii）面向室内巡检场景的基于视觉的结构裂缝检测模块。这些模块协同工作，以支持重复性、目标驱动的室内巡检任务。本文通过在一栋大学建筑内开展的两个典型案例研究对该框架进行验证，覆盖一楼公共区域以及楼梯平台及相邻走廊。在受控实验条件下，系统能够稳定沿预设巡检路径实现自主导航，并有效完成裂缝检测，其最小可可靠识别裂缝宽度约为0.2 mm。实验结果初步证明了类人机器人作为土木工程基础设施巡检载体的可行性。
Humanoid robots have recently drawn increasing attention due to their anthropomorphic morphology, high degrees of freedom, and integrated multimodal sensing capabilities, and they have been explored in a range of robotics and engineering applications. However, their potential for structural health monitoring (SHM) remains largely unexplored. Current indoor SHM practices still rely primarily on manual inspection or on mobile robotic platforms with limited adaptability and flexibility, which constrains inspection efficiency and operational coverage in complex indoor environments. Motivated by this gap, this study proposes RoboInspect, an end-to-end autonomous inspection framework that employs a humanoid robot for indoor inspection. RoboInspect comprises three key modules: (i) a reinforcement learning-based locomotion controller trained and deployed on humanoid hardware, (ii) an autonomous navigation and path-planning pipeline that leverages prior maps together with onboard perception, and (iii) a vision-based perception module for structural crack detection in indoor inspection scenarios. These modules are designed to operate in coordination to support repeated, goal-driven indoor inspection tasks. The framework is evaluated through two representative case studies conducted in a university building, covering first-floor common areas and a stair landing with an adjacent corridor. Under controlled experimental conditions, the system demonstrates reliable autonomous navigation along predefined inspection routes and effective crack detection, with a minimum reliably detectable crack width of approximately 0.2 mm. These results provide preliminary evidence supporting the feasibility of humanoid robots as inspection agents for civil engineering infrastructure.
EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World
EgoVerse：一个来自世界各地的以自我为中心的机器人学习人类数据集
机器人学习越来越依赖大规模且多样化的数据，但机器人数据采集成本高昂且难以规模化扩展。第一视角（egocentric）人类数据通过记录日常环境中的丰富操作行为，为机器人学习提供了一种具有潜力的替代来源。然而，现有的人类数据集往往覆盖范围有限、难以持续扩展，并且分散在不同机构之间，缺乏统一标准。为此，我们提出 EgoVerse，一个面向人类数据驱动机器人学习的协作平台，通过统一的数据采集、处理与访问框架，将个人研究者、学术实验室以及工业合作伙伴纳入同一生态系统，从而支持开放式数据贡献与共享。当前版本的数据集包含1362小时（约8万条轨迹）的示范数据，覆盖1965个任务、240个场景以及2087名不同示范者，并提供标准化数据格式、面向操作任务的标注信息以及用于下游学习的工具链。除数据集本身外，我们还开展了一项大规模人类到机器人迁移研究，在多个实验室、任务与机器人形态上基于统一协议进行了复现实验。结果表明，随着人类数据规模的增加，策略性能整体呈现提升趋势，但有效的规模化依赖于人类数据与机器人学习目标之间的对齐程度。总体而言，该数据集、平台与系统性研究共同为可复现的人类数据驱动机器人学习奠定了基础。在实验中，我们使用配备 Inspire 6DoF 灵巧手的宇树（Unitree）G1机器人进行验证。
Robot learning increasingly depends on large and diverse data, yet robot data collection remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric human data offer a promising alternative by capturing rich manipulation behavior across everyday environments. However, existing human datasets are often limited in scope, difficult to extend, and fragmented across institutions. We introduce EgoVerse, a collaborative platform for human data-driven robot learning that unifies data collection, processing, and access under a shared framework, enabling contributions from individual researchers, academic labs, and industry partners. The current release includes 1,362 hours (80k episodes) of human demonstrations spanning 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, and 2,087 unique demonstrators, with standardized formats, manipulation-relevant annotations, and tooling for downstream learning. Beyond the dataset, we conduct a large-scale study of human-to-robot transfer with experiments replicated across multiple labs, tasks, and robot embodiments under shared protocols. We find that policy performance generally improves with increased human data, but that effective scaling depends on alignment between human data and robot learning objectives. Together, the dataset, platform, and study establish a foundation for reproducible progress in human data-driven robot learning. We use a Unitree G1 robot equipped with Inspire 6dof hands for experiments.
QuietWalk: Physics-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Ground Reaction Force-Aware Humanoid Locomotion Under Diverse Footwear
QuietWalk：基于物理信息的强化学习，用于感知地面反作用力的人形机器人在不同鞋底环境下的运动
在人类中心环境（如家庭、医院和办公室）中运行的类人机器人必须有效抑制足–地接触冲击瞬态，因为冲击引起的振动与噪声会显著降低用户体验，而反复冲击还会加速硬件磨损。然而，现有的低噪声步态训练方法通常依赖运动学代理目标或脆弱的力传感器，同时鞋履引起的接触动力学变化会带来分布偏移，从而削弱策略的泛化能力。为此，我们提出QuietWalk，一种面向多种鞋履条件、具备地面反作用力感知能力的物理信息强化学习框架，用于类人机器人低冲击步态控制。QuietWalk引入了一个基于逆动力学约束的物理信息神经网络（PINN），用于从本体感知信号中估计双足的垂直地面反作用力（GRF），并将该冻结预测器嵌入强化学习训练过程，以在无需部署力传感器的情况下对预测冲击力进行惩罚约束。在真实机器人留出数据集上，相较于纯监督学习预测器，加入逆动力学一致性约束可使垂直GRF预测误差降低82–86%，并将左右脚的决定系数从0.39/0.67提升至0.99/0.99。在硬件实验中，以1.2 m/s速度（赤足条件，在四种地面材料上取平均），QuietWalk在一致的录音设置下将A计权平均噪声降低7.17 dB，峰值噪声降低4.98 dB。跨鞋履实验（赤足、滑板鞋、运动鞋及高跟鞋）在多种地面条件下进一步验证了该方法对鞋履引起的接触变化具有稳健的适应能力。基于Unitree G1足部模型，我们构建了三种鞋履资产（滑板鞋、运动鞋、高跟鞋），并将其与足部连杆结构进行融合。
Humanoid robots operating in human-centered environments (e.g., homes, hospitals, and offices) must mitigate foot–ground impact transients, as impact-induced vibration and noise degrade user experience and repeated impacts accelerate hardware wear. However, existing low-noise locomotion training often relies on kinematic proxy objectives or fragile force sensors, and footwear-induced changes in contact dynamics introduce distribution shifts that hinder policy generalization. We present QuietWalk, a physics-informed reinforcement learning framework for ground-reaction-force-aware humanoid locomotion under diverse footwear conditions. QuietWalk employs an inverse-dynamics-constrained physics-informed neural network (PINN) to estimate per-foot vertical ground reaction forces (GRFs) from proprioceptive signals, and integrates the frozen predictor into the RL training loop to penalize predicted impact forces without requiring force sensors at deployment. On a heldout real-robot dataset, enforcing inverse-dynamics consistency reduces vertical GRF prediction errors by 82–86% compared with a purely supervised predictor and improves the coefficient of determination from 0.39/0.67 to 0.99/0.99 for the left/right feet. On hardware at 1.2 m/s (barefoot; averaged over four floor materials), QuietWalk reduces mean A-weighted noise level by 7.17 dB and peak noise level by 4.98 dB under a consistent recording setup. Cross-footwear experiments (barefoot, skate shoes, athletic sneakers, and high heels) across multiple surfaces further demonstrate robust adaptation to footwear-induced contact variations. Based on the Unitree G1 foot model, we construct three footwear assets (Skate shoes, Athletic sneakers, High-heeled shoes), and merge them with the foot link
A Rapid Instrument Exchange System for Humanoid Robots in Minimally Invasive Surgery
用于微创手术的人形机器人快速器械更换系统
类人机器人技术在微创手术（MIS）领域展现出巨大的应用潜力。与专用的多机械臂手术平台不同，类人机器人固有的双臂结构需要具备高效的器械交换能力，以完成复杂手术流程，从而模拟外科医生手动更换器械的自然操作模式。针对这一需求，本文提出了一种沉浸式遥操作的快速器械交换系统。该系统基于单轴柔顺对接与环境约束释放机制，实现低延迟的对接过程，并结合头戴式显示器（HMD）的第一人称视角（FPV）实时感知，从而显著降低操作复杂度与认知负担。通过对专家与新手的对比评估结果表明，该系统具有较高的操作鲁棒性，并呈现快速收敛的学习曲线；新手在器械装配与拆卸任务中的表现经过短时间训练后显著提升。尽管在长距离空间对准方面仍存在时间成本较高及协同稳定性不足的问题，本研究仍成功验证了类人机器人在受限临床环境中执行稳定器械交换操作的技术可行性。本研究采用Unitree Robotics的G1类人机器人作为主从控制架构中的从端执行平台。
Humanoid robot technologies have demonstrated immense potential for minimally invasive surgery (MIS). Unlike dedicated multi-arm surgical platforms, the inherent dual-arm configuration of humanoid robots necessitates an efficient instrument exchange capability to perform complex procedures, mimicking the natural workflow where surgeons manually switch instruments. To address this, this paper proposes an immersive teleoperated rapid instrument exchange system. The system utilizes a low-latency mechanism based on single-axis compliant docking and environmental constraint release. Integrated with real-time first-person view (FPV) perception via a head-mounted display (HMD), this framework significantly reduces operational complexity and cognitive load during the docking process. Comparative evaluations between experts and novices demonstrate high operational robustness and a rapidly converging learning curve; novice performance in instrument attachment and detachment improved substantially after brief training. While long-distance spatial alignment still presents challenges in time cost and collaborative stability, this study successfully validates the technical feasibility of humanoid robots executing stable instrument exchanges within constrained clinical environments. This study employs the G1 humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics as the slave execution platform within the master-slave control architecture.
BiDexGrasp: Coordinated Bimanual Dexterous Grasps across Object Geometries and Sizes
BiDexGrasp：协调的双手灵巧抓握，适用于各种物体几何形状和尺寸
双手灵巧抓取是机器人学中的一个基础且具有重要潜力的研究方向，但其发展受到高质量数据集匮乏以及高性能生成模型不足的制约。为此，我们提出BiDexGrasp，一个由大规模双手灵巧抓取数据集与新型生成模型组成的整体框架。在数据集构建方面，我们设计了一种新的双手抓取合成流程，用于高效标注物理可行的数据，从而支持数据集的构建。该流程通过两阶段合成策略解决高维双手抓取建模难题，包括基于区域的高效抓取初始化以及解耦的力闭合抓取优化。依托该方法，我们构建了一个大规模双手灵巧抓取数据集，涵盖6351个尺寸在30至80 cm之间的多样化物体，并包含970万条标注抓取数据。在此基础上，我们进一步提出一种双手协同与几何尺寸自适应的灵巧抓取生成框架，其核心由双手协同模块以及几何—尺度自适应抓取生成策略组成，能够在未见物体上生成协调且高质量的抓取方案。大量仿真与真实环境实验结果表明，所提出的数据合成管线与学习式生成框架均展现出优越性能与良好的泛化能力。
Bimanual dexterous grasping is a fundamental and promising area in robotics, yet its progress is constrained by the lack of comprehensive datasets and powerful generation models. In this work, we propose BiDexGrasp, consists of a large-scale bimanual dexterous grasp dataset and a novel generation model. For dataset, we propose a novel bimanual grasp synthesis pipeline to efficiently annotate physically feasible data for dataset construction. This pipeline addresses the challenges of high-dimensional bimanual grasping through a two-stage synthesis strategy of efficient region-based grasp initialization and decoupled force-closure grasp optimization. Powered by this pipeline, we construct a large-scale bimanual dexterous grasp dataset, comprising 6351 diverse objects with sizes ranging from 30 to 80 cm, along with 9.7 million annotated grasp data. Based on this dataset, we further introduce a bimanual-coordinated and geometry-size-adaptive dexterous grasping generation framework. The framework lies in two key designs: a bimanual coordination module and a geometry-size-adaptive grasp generation strategy to generate coordinated and high-quality grasps on unseen objects. Extensive experiments conducted in both simulation and real world demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed data synthesis pipeline and learned generative framework.
MuGen: Multi-Skill Generative Locomotion Controller for Humanoid Robots
MuGen：仿人机器人的多技能生成式运动控制器
本文提出了一种名为 MuGen 的数据驱动框架，用于在仿人机器人上学习并部署多技能运动控制。MuGen 框架使机器人能够在示例运动序列的引导下，展现出如人类般富有表现力的动作。为实现这一目标，我们采用了基于模型的强化学习方法来训练向量量化自编码器（VQ-VAE）；由此构建的运动生成式表征，能够从长达数小时的异质人类动作数据中捕捉并提炼出关键的人体运动模式。此外，我们引入了“教师-学生”学习框架，并开发了一种全新的策略蒸馏策略，从而使可部署的“学生策略”能够高效地习得并利用上述潜在表征。凭借这一策略，机器人不仅能够追踪并模仿此前未曾见过的各类人类动作，还能进一步复用已习得的潜在空间来执行其他任务。通过展示一系列多样化的动作以及精准的执行效果，我们充分验证了该框架的有效性。
This paper presents MuGen, a data-driven framework for learning and deploying multi-skill locomotion on humanoid robots. MuGen enables a robot to perform expressive motions like humans under the guidance of example motion sequences. To achieve this, we employ vector-quantized autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) trained with model-based reinforcement learning, resulting in a generative representation of locomotion that captures key patterns of human motion from hours of heterogeneous human performance data. We employ a teacher-student learning framework and develop a new policy distillation strategy to enable a deployable student policy learning this efficient latent representation. This policy allows the robot to track and mimic unseen human motions and further enables the robot to reuse the learned latent space for other tasks. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through a diverse set of motions and accurate execution.
Direct Dynamic Retargeting for Humanoid Imitation Learning from Videos
基于视频的人形模仿学习的直接动态重定向
基于单目视频演示的模仿学习，为向人形机器人传授复杂技能提供了一种可扩展的方法。然而，将人类动作迁移至人形机器人身上，需要克服显著的形态差异问题。现有的标准方法通常依赖于“几何重定向”或“间接动态重定向”流程。我们发现，这些中间运动学投影会引入一种“几何偏差”，从而限制了搜索空间，并导致生成的动态行为并非最优。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“直接动态重定向”（DDR）的新型单阶段框架，该框架能够直接从专家演示视频中生成高保真且在动力学上可行的运动轨迹。通过在任务空间中构建问题，并在物理仿真环境中利用基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）求解器，DDR能够原生且高效地对复杂的接触序列进行优化，同时有效抑制输入漂移现象。实验结果表明，得益于消除了几何偏差的影响，DDR在演示轨迹跟踪精度方面显著优于现有的最先进基线方法。此外，我们还证实，若能为强化学习（RL）智能体提供此类在物理上可行的参考轨迹，不仅能加速训练收敛过程，还能显著提升智能体在执行敏捷动作及平衡控制任务时的最终表现。具体而言，我们针对每一种特定的动作模式训练一个独立的策略，旨在使仿人机器人 Unitree H1-2 能够精准地模仿其对应的重定向参考轨迹。
Imitation Learning from monocular video demonstrations provides a scalable approach for teaching complex skills to humanoid robots. However, translating human motion to humanoids requires overcoming significant morphological mismatches. Standard approaches rely on Geometric Retargeting or Indirect Dynamic Retargeting pipelines. We identify that these intermediate kinematic projections introduce a geometric bias, restricting the search space and yielding suboptimal dynamic behaviors. In this paper, we propose Direct Dynamic Retargeting (DDR), a novel single-stage framework that generates high-fidelity, dynamically feasible trajectories directly from expert videos. By formulating the problem in the task space and leveraging a sampling-based Model Predictive Control solver within a physics simulator, DDR natively optimizes over complex contact sequences while mitigating input drift. Our experiments demonstrate that bypassing the geometric bias allows DDR to outperform state-of-the-art baselines in demonstration tracking accuracy. Furthermore, we establish that providing such physically viable references to RL agents accelerates training convergence and enhances the final execution of agile and balancing behaviors. Specifically, we train one policy per motion to imitate its retargeted reference on the Unitree H1-2 humanoid.
HAML: Humanoid Adversarial Multi-Skill Learning via a Single Policy
HAML：基于单一策略的人形对抗式多技能学习
将大规模运动数据集转化为鲁棒且可部署的人形机器人控制器，是工程信息学领域面临的一项关键挑战；其主要难点在于高质量标注数据的稀缺性、条件生成过程中潜在的模式坍塌风险，以及机载计算硬件的严格限制。本文提出了一种可部署的两阶段学习系统，该系统能够将片段级（clip-level）运动数据集映射为单一策略的多技能控制器及其可部署的对应版本。我们采用粗粒度的独热（one-hot）技能标签，这些标签可在片段级别自动分配，几乎无需人工干预，从而实现了数据集构建的可扩展性。为了防止条件判别器忽略技能条件，我们注入了不匹配的（状态转移，标签）配对，并引入了一种“条件感知损失”函数，该函数能够显式惩罚错误的状态转移与标签关联，从而提升了控制的可控性并缓解了模式坍塌问题。针对实际部署场景，我们进一步提出了一种两阶段训练策略：首先在仿真环境中训练一个具备“特权”的教师策略，随后将其知识蒸馏至一个学生策略中；该学生策略仅依赖于堆叠的历史本体感知观测数据，从而在不依赖外部状态估计的情况下，确保了对感知噪声和延迟的鲁棒性。在仿真环境及真实硬件上进行的大量评估结果表明，该系统在异构机器人体型上均实现了技能覆盖率、状态转移覆盖率、动作逼真度以及训练效率的全面提升。在宇树（Unitree）G1 机器人的机载计算机上，经过蒸馏的学生策略能够以 100 Hz 的频率运行，且延迟仅为 15–25 ms，充分验证了该系统的工程可行性。
Translating large-scale motion datasets into robust, deployable humanoid controllers is a critical challenge in engineering informatics, primarily due to the scarcity of high-quality annotations, the risk of mode collapse in conditional generation, and the strict constraints of onboard computing hardware. This paper presents a deployable two-stage learning system that maps clip-level motion datasets to a single-policy multi-skill controller and its deployable counterpart. We adopt coarse one-hot skill labels that can be assigned automatically at the clip level with negligible manual effort, enabling scalable dataset construction. To prevent conditional discriminators from ignoring skill conditions, we inject mismatched (transition, label) pairs and introduce a condition-aware loss that explicitly penalizes incorrect transition–label associations, improving controllability and mitigating mode collapse. For real-world deployment, we further propose a two-stage training strategy: a privileged teacher policy is first trained in simulation and then distilled into a student policy that relies on stacked historical proprioceptive observations, ensuring robustness against sensing noise and latency without relying on external state estimation. Extensive evaluations in simulation and on real hardware demonstrate improved skill coverage, transition coverage, realism, and training efficiency across heterogeneous embodiments. With the onboard computer of a Unitree G1 robot, the distilled policy runs at 100 Hz with 15–25 ms latency, confirming the system’s engineering feasibility.
Nautilus: From One Prompt to Plug-and-Play Robot Learning
Nautilus：从单条指令到即插即用式机器人学习
机器人学习研究目前呈现出高度分散的局面，涉及不同的策略族、基准测试套件以及实体机器人；每一项具体实现都交织于一个复杂的组合矩阵之中，导致若想移植其中任何单一元素，都将成为一场工程上的噩梦。尽管通用型编程智能体偶尔能够打通特定的配置环境，但由于缺乏机器人学研究工作流所特有的程序性先验知识与验证实践，它们尚无法在规模化层面上彻底弥合这一鸿沟。为此，我们提出并推出了 NAUTILUS——一款开源的集成工具平台。它能够将用户输入的单条指令（例如：“使用基准测试 B 评估策略 A”）转化为一系列即开即用的工作流，涵盖代码复现、性能评估、模型微调及系统部署等全流程环节。NAUTILUS 具备以下核心特性：提供即插即用的智能体技能集，其中凝练了机器人学研究领域的核心先验知识；在策略、仿真器/基准测试环境与实体机器人之间建立起基于类型约束的契约式连接；提供统一的接口规范与执行环境；并构建了一套值得信赖的智能体辅助编程工作流，确保在每一个关键里程碑节点都能进行明确且自动化的验证与测试。NAUTILUS 不仅能够针对现有实现自动生成所需的适配器与容器，还能对新增的或由用户自行提供的策略、仿真器/基准测试环境及机器人实体进行封装与集成，并通过统一的接口将所有组件无缝连接。这一机制极大地扩展了跨组件交叉验证的覆盖范围，且无需人工编写繁琐的“胶水代码”进行粘合。正如鹦鹉螺（Nautilus）通过不断增添新的气室来扩展其外壳一样，NAUTILUS 亦通过逐层扩展其“气室式”的执行单元来实现规模化增长。这使得 NAUTILUS 成为一个旨在提升可扩展性的研究支撑平台，而非一个仅靠人工精心维护的固定式框架；其核心宗旨在于减轻工程负担，从而助力研究人员在日益壮大的机器人学习生态系统中，高效地开展跨策略族的代码复现与性能评估工作。针对宇树科技（Unitree）的 H1 机器人，我们通过同一套面向策略的接口端点以及平台侧的容器环境，成功部署了一项经强化学习（RL）训练而成的步态控制策略。
Robot learning research is fragmented across policy families, benchmark suites, and real robots; each implementation is entangled with the others in a complex combination matrix, making it an engineering nightmare to port any single element. General-purpose coding agents may occasionally bridge specific setups, but cannot close this gap at scale because they lack the procedural priors and validation practices that characterize robotics research workflows. We propose NAUTILUS, an open-source harness that turns a single user prompt -- for example, "Evaluate policy A with benchmark B" -- into ready-to-use reproduction, evaluation, fine-tuning, and deployment workflows. NAUTILUS provides: plug-and-play agent skill sets with distilled priors from robotics research; typed contracts among policies, simulators/benchmarks, and real-world robots; unified interfaces and execution environments; and a trustworthy agentic coding workflow with explicit, automated validation, and testing at each milestone. NAUTILUS can not only automatically generate the required adapters and containers for existing implementations, but also wrap and onboard new or user-provided policies, simulators/benchmarks, and robots, all connected via a uniform interface. This expands cross-validation coverage without hand-written glue code. Like a nautilus shell that grows by adding chambers, NAUTILUS scales by extending its execution in chambered units, making it a research harness for scalability rather than a hand-curated framework, and aiming to reduce the engineering burden of cross-family reproduction and evaluation in the ever-growing robot learning ecosystem. For Unitree H1, we deploy an RL-trained locomotion policy through the same policy-facing endpoint and platform-side container.
Real-Time Whole-Body Teleoperation of a Humanoid Robot Using IMU-Based Motion Capture with Sim2Sim and Sim2Real Validation
基于IMU运动捕捉的人形机器人全身实时遥操作：Sim2Sim与Sim2Real验证
实现类人机器人的稳定、低延迟全身遥操作是一项尚待解决的研究难题，其复杂性源于人与机器人形态之间的运动学不匹配、惯性传感器噪声的累积、不可忽略的控制延迟，以及持续存在的“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）迁移鸿沟。本文提出了一套完整的实时全身遥操作系统，该系统能够将通过 Virdyn 基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的全身动作捕捉服所记录的人体动作，直接映射到 Unitree G1 类人机器人上。我们引入了一套定制的动作处理、运动学重定向及控制流水线，专为实现连续、低延迟的操作而设计，且不依赖任何离线缓冲或基于学习的组件。该系统首先利用 Unitree G1 的 MuJoCo 物理模型在仿真环境中进行了验证（即 sim-to-sim 验证），随后在未经任何修改的情况下直接部署到了物理机器人平台上（即 sim-to-real 验证）。实验结果表明，该系统能够稳定且同步地复现广泛的动作序列，涵盖了行走、站立、坐下、转身、鞠躬以及协调且富有表现力的全身姿态等动作。这项工作为利用商用可穿戴动作捕捉硬件实现类人机器人的全身遥操作，建立了一个实用且具有可扩展性的框架。
Stable, low-latency whole-body teleoperation of humanoid robots is an open research challenge, complicated by kinematic mismatches between human and robot morphologies, accumulated inertial sensor noise, non-trivial control latency, and persistent sim-to-real transfer gaps. This paper presents a complete real-time whole-body teleoperation system that maps human motion, recorded with a Virdyn IMU-based full-body motion capture suit, directly onto a Unitree G1 humanoid robot. We introduce a custom motion-processing, kinematic retargeting, and control pipeline engineered for continuous, low-latency operation without any offline buffering or learning-based components. The system is first validated in simulation using the MuJoCo physics model of the Unitree G1 (sim2sim), and then deployed without modification on the physical platform (sim2real). Experimental results demonstrate stable, synchronized reproduction of a broad motion repertoire, including walking, standing, sitting, turning, bowing, and coordinated expressive full-body gestures. This work establishes a practical, scalable framework for whole-body humanoid teleoperation using commodity wearable motion capture hardware.
Contact-Staged Stand-up Learning for Humanoids under Shifted Center-of-Mass Conditions
质心偏移条件下类人机器人的接触分阶段站立学习
仿人机器人的站立恢复是一项涉及丰富接触的全全身控制问题，涵盖了支撑面的构建、接触状态的切换以及协调一致的重心转移。当定制硬件导致重心（CoM）发生偏移并改变标称质量分布时，这一挑战将变得尤为严峻。为应对此问题，我们针对重心偏置条件下的仿人机器人，提出了一种基于接触阶段划分的站立恢复框架。该方法将站立恢复动作分解为四个连续的阶段，各阶段的划分依据在于当前的接触状态与机体状态。此外，该框架为不同的奖励组别配置了专用的“评论家”（Critics），并采用了一种两阶段式的课程学习策略，旨在提升动作的流畅性与泛化迁移能力。我们在经过定制改装的 Unitree G1 机器人上开展了实验——该机器人配备了改良后的头部模组并搭载了后置负载；实验结果表明，无论是在仿真环境中还是在真实世界实验中，我们所提出的框架在性能上均显著优于其消融变体。
Humanoid robot stand-up recovery is a contact-rich whole-body control problem involving support formation, contact transition, and coordinated weight transfer. The challenge becomes more severe when customized hardware shifts the center of mass (CoM) and alters the nominal mass distribution. To address this, we propose a contact-staged stand-up framework for humanoid robots under biased CoM conditions. The proposed method decomposes the stand-up motion into four sequential stages defined by contact and body-state conditions. It further assigns dedicated critics to distinct reward groups and adopts a two-phase curriculum to improve motion smoothness and transferability. Experiments on a customized Unitree G1 with a modified head module and a rear payload demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms ablated variants in both simulation and real-world experiments.
PRIME: Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation for Legged and Humanoid Robots
PRIME：面向足式与仿人机器人的物理一致性机器人惯性与运动估计
仿人机器人和足式机器人通过间歇性接触与环境进行交互，这使得准确的运动估计从根本上依赖于对接触动力学的推理。然而，标准的感知流程——无论是基于结合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的车载本体感知，还是基于外部运动捕捉系统——通常只能恢复运动学信息，而接触力、接触时序和惯性参数等关键信息往往无法直接观测。因此，纯粹基于运动学的重建结果往往会违背刚体动力学原理，尤其是在涉及频繁接触的复杂运动过程中。为了在实际部署场景中仅凭车载运动学数据实现准确的运动估计，我们提出了一种名为 PRIME（Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation，物理一致的机器人惯性与运动估计）的方法。PRIME 采用最大后验概率（MAP）估计框架，能够将测得的运动学数据与执行器指令相结合，将其优化为一条在动力学上自洽的运动轨迹；与此同时，该方法还能联合估计摩擦接触力以及符合物理规律的惯性参数。我们的方法将可微分接触动力学理论与平滑互补约束相结合，并引入了 Anitescu 风格的摩擦模型，从而将原问题转化为一个平滑优化问题；该优化问题在面对各种复杂的接触状态切换时，依然能够保持良好的可解性。我们在四足机器人和 Unitree G1 仿人机器人上进行了大量实验，针对涉及频繁接触的复杂步态运动对 PRIME 进行了评估；实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了运动轨迹的一致性，并实现了对惯性参数的准确辨识。PRIME 的价值不仅在于通过校准后的惯性参数来提升状态估计与反馈控制的性能，更在于它能够从实际部署的机器人系统中生成带有接触力与接触状态标注的运动重建数据；这些高质量的数据可为下游的机器学习应用提供有力支持，例如大规模行为建模以及机器人基础模型（Robot Foundation Models）的构建。
Humanoid and legged robots interact with the environment through intermittent contacts, making accurate motion estimation fundamentally dependent on reasoning about contact dynamics. However, standard sensing pipelines-whether based on onboard proprioception with Extended Kalman Filters (EKFs) or external motion capture systems-recover only kinematics, while contact forces, contact timing, and inertial parameters remain unobserved. As a result, purely kinematic reconstructions often violate rigid-body dynamics, particularly during contact-rich motions. To enable accurate motion estimation from onboard kinematics in real-world deployment, we propose PRIME (Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation), a Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) formulation that refines measured kinematics and actuator commands into a dynamically consistent trajectory while jointly estimating frictional contact forces and physically consistent inertial parameters. Our approach incorporates differentiable contact dynamics with smoothed complementarity constraints and an Anitescu-style friction model, yielding a smooth optimization problem that remains tractable across versatile contact transitions. We evaluate PRIME on contact-rich locomotion with quadrupedal robots and the Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating improved trajectory consistency and accurate inertial parameter identification. Beyond improving state estimation and feedback control with calibrated inertial parameters, PRIME produces force- and contact-annotated motion reconstructions from real robots in deployment, which can be used to provide high-quality data for downstream learning applications, including large-scale behavior modeling and robot foundation models.
Unified Walking, Running, and Recovery for Humanoids via State-Dependent Adversarial Motion Priors
基于状态依赖对抗运动先验的人形机器人统一行走、奔跑与恢复
We propose a unified reinforcement learning framework that enables a single policy to perform walking, running, and fall recovery on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot, validated on physical hardware without any explicit mode-switching command at deployment. The framework extends Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP) by replacing the conventional global reference distribution with a state-dependent gate that routes each training transition to one of two discriminators: a dedicated recovery discriminator and a velocity-conditioned locomotion discriminator that jointly covers walking and running. The gate is defined by a single fixed threshold on projected gravity: the recovery discriminator is activated when body tilt exceeds approximately  from vertical (); otherwise the locomotion discriminator is used, with the normalized commanded velocity serving as a condition that selects the appropriate reference trajectory between walk and run clips. Only three LAFAN1 reference clips are required to regularize the complete behavior set. At deployment, a single frozen ONNX policy executes at 50\,Hz with no runtime mode logic; hardware experiments demonstrate successful recovery from both prone and supine falls and smooth walk-to-run transitions under the same controller.
我们提出了一种统一的强化学习框架，使单一策略能够在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上执行行走、奔跑及跌倒恢复任务；该框架已在物理硬件上得到验证，且在部署运行时无需任何显式的模式切换指令。该框架通过将传统的全局参考分布替换为一种“状态依赖型门控机制”，对“对抗运动先验”（AMP）方法进行了扩展；该门控机制负责将每一个训练过渡样本分流至两个判别器之一：一个是专用于恢复动作的判别器，另一个是基于速度条件、可同时涵盖行走与奔跑动作的运动判别器。该门控机制由一个基于“重力投影值”的单一固定阈值来定义：当机身倾斜角度相对于垂直方向的偏离度超过某一近似阈值时，即激活恢复判别器；反之，则启用运动判别器，此时，归一化后的指令速度将作为条件变量，用于在行走与奔跑的参考动作片段之间选取合适的参考轨迹。仅需三个 LAFAN1 参考动作片段，便足以对整套行为集进行规范化约束。在实际部署时，单一且固化的 ONNX 策略以 50 Hz 的频率运行，且无需任何运行时的模式逻辑；硬件实验结果表明，在同一控制器的驱动下，机器人不仅能成功实现从俯卧及仰卧跌倒状态下的恢复，还能实现从行走向奔跑的平滑过渡。
Terrain Consistent Reference-Guided RL for Humanoid Navigation Autonomy
用于类人机器人自主导航的基于地形一致性参考的强化学习
本文提出了一种用于训练人形机器人参考引导感知强化学习运动策略的方法。该方法在训练过程中对参考轨迹进行调制，使其与地形几何形状保持一致。为了将该方法部署到标准导航自主基础设施中，我们在强化学习训练循环内合成了SE(2)可控的参考轨迹，将期望的足迹投影到有效的落脚点上，并调整摆动脚和质心轨迹以匹配地形。由此得到的策略提供了一个清晰的SE(2)速度接口，与标准导航规划器兼容。仿真结果表明，与环境无关的参考轨迹相比，环境相关的参考轨迹显著提高了参考轨迹跟踪性能。在硬件方面，我们将该策略与模型预测控制（MPC）+控制障碍函数规划器集成，并在Unitree G1机器人上演示了在包含崎岖地形和连续楼梯的室外环境中，通过机载所有传感和计算，实现了长距离（>70米）闭环自主导航。
We present a method for training reference-guided, perceptive reinforcement learning locomotion policies for humanoid robots in which reference trajectories are modulated in training to be consistent with terrain geometry. Aiming to deploy our method with standard navigation autonomy infrastructure, we synthesize SE(2)-controllable reference trajectories inside the RL training loop, projecting desired footsteps onto valid footholds and adjusting swing-foot and center-of-mass trajectories to match the terrain. The resulting policy exposes a clean SE(2) velocity interface compatible with standard navigation planners. In simulation, environmentally-conditioned references significantly improve reference tracking performance compared to environment agnostic references. On hardware, we integrate the policy with an MPC + control barrier function planner and demonstrate long-horizon (>70m) closed-loop autonomous navigation on the Unitree G1 through outdoor environments containing rough terrain and consecutive flights of stairs, with all sensing and computation onboard.
A Hardware-Accelerated Stereoscopic VR Teleoperation Interface for Humanoid Robots
面向人形机器人的硬件加速立体VR远程操作界面
在目前尚无法实现完全自主的危险环境中，人形机器人的远程操控是执行复杂任务的关键解决方案。然而，传统的二维控制界面通常会限制情境感知并阻碍深度感知，从而增加认知负荷和操作风险。本文提出了一种基于 MetaQuest 3 的沉浸式虚拟现实远程操控界面，专为 Unitree G1 人形机器人设计。该框架包含一个虚拟驾驶舱，通过硬件加速的 WebRTC 流水线集成实时立体视频流。我们描述了一种渲染方法，该方法利用原生 XR 眼动追踪技术提供自然的深度线索，并配备了紧凑的 HUD 和经过停留验证的径向菜单，以实现直观的命令执行。定性验证证实了远程场景中正确的单眼立体渲染和双眼视差，表明其提供的深度线索比单眼可视化更为丰富。这项工作为使用商用现成硬件实现高保真人形机器人远程呈现提供了一个稳健且易于使用的框架。
Teleoperation of humanoid robots serves as a critical solution for performing complex tasks in hazardous environments where full autonomy is currently unattainable. However, traditional 2D control interfaces often limit situational awareness and impede depth perception, leading to increased cognitive load and operational risks. This paper presents an immersive VR teleoperation interface designed for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot using the Meta Quest 3. The proposed framework features a virtual cockpit that integrates real-time-oriented stereoscopic video streaming via a hardware-accelerated WebRTC pipeline. We describe a rendering approach that leverages native XR eye-indexing to provide natural depth cues, alongside a compact HUD and a dwell-validated radial menu designed for intuitive command execution. Qualitative validation confirms correct per-eye stereoscopic rendering and binocular disparity in the remote scene, suggesting richer depth cues than monoscopic visualization. This work provides a robust and accessible framework for high-fidelity humanoid telepresence using commercial off-the-shelf hardware.
SPRINT: Efficient Spectral Priors for Humanoid Athletic Sprints
