SPRINT：用于类人运动冲刺的高效谱先验
目前，高动态人形机器人冲刺运动的研究进展受限于人形机器人适用的运动学参考数据匮乏以及现有框架无法在冲刺过程中保持稳定性。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种名为SPRINT的新型框架，该框架基于高效的频率自适应谱先验。SPRINT框架利用包含五个离散运动序列的参考库，在频域中表征人类运动的基本周期性，从而生成跨越宽速度谱的运动学可行的关节轨迹，并成功地将预测结果外推到远超参考分布的范围。在这些预训练先验的指导下，SPRINT策略在1.3米人形机器人平台上的现场实验中实现了零样本仿真到实测的迁移，达到了6米/秒的峰值冲刺速度，并在保持仿生自然性的同时展现了流畅的步态转换。最终，这项工作确立了频率自适应谱先验作为人形机器人运动短跑数据高效基础的地位。
The pursuit of highly dynamic humanoid sprinting is currently hindered by a scarcity of humanoid-viable kinematic reference data and the inability of existing frameworks to maintain stability during sprints. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces SPRINT, a novel framework driven by highly efficient, frequency-adaptive spectral priors. By characterizing the fundamental periodicity of human locomotion in the frequency domain using a reference library of exactly five discrete motion sequences, these priors generate kinematically feasible joint trajectories across a broad velocity spectrum, successfully extrapolating far beyond the reference distribution. Guided by these pretrained priors, the SPRINT policy achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in field experiments on the 1.3 m Humanoid Robot platform, reaching a peak sprinting velocity of 6\,m/s and demonstrating seamless gait transitions while preserving biomimetic naturalness. Ultimately, this work establishes frequency-adaptive spectral priors as a highly data-efficient foundation for humanoid athletic sprints.
Explicit Stair Geometry Conditioning for Robust Humanoid Locomotion
针对稳健人形机器人运动的显式楼梯几何条件反射
由于几何不连续性、对台阶高度变化的敏感性以及真实环境中感知的不确定性，实现稳健的人形机器人爬楼梯仍然是一项挑战。现有的基于学习的运动策略通常依赖于隐式的地形表征或盲目的本体感觉反馈，这限制了它们在不同楼梯几何形状上的泛化能力以及对所需步态调整的预测能力。本文提出了一种用于实现稳健人形机器人爬楼梯的显式楼梯几何条件框架。我们没有将地形编码为高维潜在特征，而是提取了一组简洁的、可解释的几何参数，包括台阶高度、台阶深度以及相对于机器人航向的当前偏航角。这些显式楼梯参数直接对基于近端策略优化（PPO）的运动策略进行条件化，从而能够根据楼梯结构主动调节摆动脚间隙和步态特征。仿真实验表明，该方法能够更好地泛化到训练分布之外的未见过的楼梯高度。在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行的真实环境实验验证了该方法在室内和室外楼梯上的可靠性。在具有挑战性的户外场景中，该机器人成功连续攀爬 33 级台阶而未发生故障，证明了其稳健性和实际部署可行性。
Robust humanoid stair climbing remains challenging due to geometric discontinuities, sensitivity to step height variations, and perception uncertainty in real-world environments. Existing learning-based locomotion policies often rely on implicit terrain representations or blind proprioceptive feedback, limiting their ability to generalize across varying stair geometries and to anticipate required gait adjustments. This paper proposes an explicit stair geometry conditioning framework for robust humanoid stair climbing. Instead of encoding terrain as high-dimensional latent features, we extract a compact set of interpretable geometric parameters, including step height, step depth, and current yaw angle relative to the robot heading. These explicit stair parameters directly condition a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based locomotion policy, enabling proactive modulation of swing-foot clearance and stride characteristics according to stair structure. Simulation experiments demonstrate improved generalization across unseen stair heights beyond the training distribution. Real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid validate reliable indoor and outdoor stair traversal. In challenging outdoor scenarios, the robot successfully ascends 33 consecutive steps without failure, demonstrating robustness and practical deployability.
UniTracker: Learning Universal Whole-Body Motion Tracker for Humanoid Robots
UniTracker：用于人形机器人的通用全身运动追踪器
实现可泛化的全身运动控制对于在真实环境中部署人形机器人至关重要。然而，现有的基于多层感知器（MLP）的策略在部分观测数据下训练时，往往存在表达能力有限且难以保持全局一致性的问题。这些缺陷表现为运动表现力不足、方向漂移以及在不同行为间的泛化能力差。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了UniTracker，一个可扩展且自适应的三阶段运动跟踪框架。第一阶段学习一个特权教师策略，该策略能够生成高保真度的参考动作。在此基础上，第二阶段训练一个基于CVAE的通用策略，该策略能够捕获运动的全局潜在表示，从而在部分观测数据下实现稳健的性能。关键在于，我们将部分观测先验与全观测编码器对齐，从而将全局意图注入到潜在空间中。在最后阶段，一个轻量级的自适应模块在具有挑战性的序列上对学生策略进行微调，支持逐个实例和批量自适应。我们在仿真和 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了 UniTracker，结果表明，与当前基线相比，UniTracker 具有更优异的跟踪精度、运动多样性和部署鲁棒性。
Achieving generalizable whole-body motion control is essential for deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments. However, existing MLP-based policies trained under partial observations often suffer from limited expressiveness and struggle to maintain global consistency. These shortcomings manifest as less expressive motion, orientation drift, and poor generalization across diverse behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose UniTracker, a three-stage framework for scalable and adaptive motion tracking. The first stage learns a privileged teacher policy that produces high-fidelity reference actions. Building on this, the second stage trains a CVAE-based universal policy that captures a global latent representation of motion, enabling robust performance under partial observations. Crucially, we align the partial-observation prior with a full-observation encoder, injecting global intent into the latent space. In the final stage, a lightweight adaptation module fine-tunes the student policy on challenging sequences, supporting both per-instance and batch adaptation. We validate UniTracker in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, demonstrating superior tracking accuracy, motion diversity, and deployment robustness compared to current baselines.
Uni-LaViRA: Language-Vision-Robot Actions Translation for Unified Embodied Navigation
Uni-LaViRA：用于统一具身导航的语言-视觉-机器人动作转换
具身导航要求智能体将语言和视觉观察映射到一系列空间动作，从而驱动真实机器人穿越它从未见过的环境。目前主流的方法是将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型扩展到越来越大的机器人轨迹数据集上。本文认为，就导航而言，通用性可以通过结构实现，而不仅仅是通过数据规模。导航的底层决策结构可以简化为单一的语言-视觉-机器人动作转换。语言动作发出语义级的方向指令，视觉动作发出像素级的视觉目标。这两个输出都位于预训练的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的自然输出流形内，因此智能体可以推理完成这项任务，而无需从机器人数据中学习。因此，我们提出了Uni-LaViRA，一种统一的智能体架构，它将相同的理念扩展到四个任务系列（VLN-CE、ObjectNav、EQA和Aerial-VLN）以及四种异构的真实机器人（轮式机器人、四足机器人、人形机器人和我们自行搭建的无人机），并以零样本的方式实现。两种智能体循环机制使这种统一成为可能。待办事项列表记忆（TDM）在每一步都会重写待办子目标的结构化清单，并将未完成的项目重新添加到智能体最近的注意力窗口中。二次机会回溯（SCB）将机器人回滚到出错前的状态，并根据失败的子轨迹来调整智能体的下一个计划，从而将单次导航转变为一个自我纠正的过程。 Uni-LaViRA 无需任何训练，在 VLN-CE R2R 数据集上达到 60.7% 的识别率，在 VLN-CE RxR 数据集上达到 51.3% 的识别率，在 HM3D-v2 数据集上达到 77.7% 的识别率，在 HM3D-OVON 数据集上达到 60.0% 的识别率，在 MP3D-EQA 数据集上达到 54.7% 的识别率，在 OpenUAV 数据集上达到 40.0% 的识别率，与最近消耗数百万个样本和数千 GPU 小时的训练导航基础模型相比，表现相当甚至更优。
Embodied navigation requires an agent to map language and visual observations to a stream of spatial actions that drive a real robot through environments it has never seen. The dominant approach has been to scale vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models on ever-larger collections of robot trajectories. This paper argues that, for navigation specifically, generality can be obtained structurally, not only through data scale. The underlying decision structure of navigation reduces to a single Language-Vision-Robot Actions Translation. The language action emits semantic-level directional command and the vision action emits a pixel-level visual target. Both outputs lie inside the natural output manifold of pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs), so the task can be reasoned about by an agent rather than learned from robot data. Therefore, we present Uni-LaViRA, a unified agentic architecture that extends the same insight to four task families (VLN-CE, ObjectNav, EQA, and Aerial-VLN) and to four heterogeneous real robots (Wheeled, Quadruped, Humanoid robot, and a self-built UAV) in a zero-shot manner. Two agent-loop mechanisms make this unification practical. TODO List Memory (TDM) rewrites a structured checklist of pending sub-goals at every step, reciting the unfinished items back into the agent's most recent attention window. Second Chance Backtrack (SCB) rolls the robot back to the pre-error state and conditions the agent's next plan on the failed sub-trajectory, turning single-pass navigation into a self-correcting process. With zero training effort, Uni-LaViRA reaches 60.7% SR on VLN-CE R2R, 51.3% on VLN-CE RxR, 77.7% on HM3D-v2, 60.0% on HM3D-OVON, 54.7% on MP3D-EQA, and 40.0% on OpenUAV, matching or even surpassing recent training navigation foundation models that consume millions of samples and thousands of GPU-hours.
Humanoid Generative Pre-Training for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
用于零样本运动跟踪的人形生成式预训练
我们推出了 Humanoid-GPT，这是一款基于 GPT 架构的 Transformer 模型，它利用因果注意力机制，在包含十亿帧的运动语料库上进行训练，用于全身控制。与以往受限于数据稀缺和敏捷性与泛化能力权衡的浅层 MLP 跟踪器不同，Humanoid-GPT 基于一个 20 亿帧的重定向语料库进行预训练，该语料库整合了所有主流的动作捕捉数据集以及大规模的内部录制数据。通过扩展数据和模型容量，我们构建了一个能够跟踪高度动态行为的单一生成式 Transformer 模型，并实现了前所未有的零样本泛化能力，能够处理未见过的运动和控制任务。大量的实验和扩展性分析表明，我们的模型树立了新的性能标杆，在跟踪高度动态和复杂运动的同时，展现了对未见过任务的鲁棒零样本泛化能力。
We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.
HAIC: Humanoid Agile Object Interaction Control via Dynamics-Aware World Model
HAIC：基于动态感知世界模型的人形敏捷对象交互控制
人形机器人展现出在非结构化环境中执行复杂全身任务的巨大潜力。尽管人机交互（HOI）技术已取得进展，但大多数方法仍侧重于与机器人刚性耦合的完全驱动物体，而忽略了具有独立动力学和非完整约束的欠驱动物体。这些物体由于耦合力和遮挡等问题，带来了控制方面的挑战。我们提出了HAIC，一个无需外部状态估计即可在各种物体动力学条件下实现鲁棒交互的统一框架。我们的主要贡献在于一个动力学预测器，它仅基于本体感受历史即可估计高阶物体状态（速度、加速度）。这些预测被投影到静态几何先验上，形成一个空间相关的动态占用图，从而使策略能够推断盲区内的碰撞边界和接触可能性。我们采用非对称微调，其中世界模型会持续适应学习策略的探索，从而确保在分布变化的情况下仍能进行鲁棒的状态估计。在人形机器人上进行的实验表明，HAIC 通过主动补偿惯性扰动，在敏捷任务（滑板、在各种负载下推/拉小车）中取得了很高的成功率，并且通过预测多个物体的动力学，掌握了多对象长距离任务，例如在各种地形上搬运箱子。
Humanoid robots show promise for complex whole-body tasks in unstructured environments. Although Human-Object Interaction (HOI) has advanced, most methods focus on fully actuated objects rigidly coupled to the robot, ignoring underactuated objects with independent dynamics and non-holonomic constraints. These introduce control challenges from coupling forces and occlusions. We present HAIC, a unified framework for robust interaction across diverse object dynamics without external state estimation. Our key contribution is a dynamics predictor that estimates high-order object states (velocity, acceleration) solely from proprioceptive history. These predictions are projected onto static geometric priors to form a spatially grounded dynamic occupancy map, enabling the policy to infer collision boundaries and contact affordances in blind spots. We use asymmetric fine-tuning, where a world model continuously adapts to the student policy's exploration, ensuring robust state estimation under distribution shifts. Experiments on a humanoid robot show HAIC achieves high success rates in agile tasks (skateboarding, cart pushing/pulling under various loads) by proactively compensating for inertial perturbations, and also masters multi-object long-horizon tasks like carrying a box across varied terrain by predicting the dynamics of multiple objects.
Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation
Gaze2Act：用于交互式机器人操作的基于注视条件的视觉-语言-动作策略
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型近年来展现出强大的机器人学习潜力，能够通过遵循语言指令来实现学习。然而，在实践中，仅靠语言往往不足以精确传达人类意图。我们难以准确描述在相似的候选对象中应该与哪个对象交互，应该对对象进行哪些操作，以及目标在执行过程中可能发生的变化。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了Gaze2Act，一个新颖的VLA框架，它利用人类的注视作为动态且直观的意图信号，用于复杂的交互操作。Gaze2Act首先通过跨视角语义匹配，将第一人称视角映射到机器人的视角，从而弥合了自我视角和外部视角之间的鸿沟，生成对象掩码和注视点，用于从粗到精的目标指定。然后，通过感知层面的提示和动作层面的条件反射，将这些线索整合到策略中，使机器人能够关注相关区域，并在动态意图下执行精确的交互。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，Gaze2Act在七个任务类别和16个真实机器人任务中进行了系统评估，结果表明其在意图准确率和任务成功率方面均达到了目前最先进的水平。尤其值得一提的是，它在物体歧义消除、细粒度交互和动态意图引导方面均优于基线模型。这些结果表明，人类的目光为基于人机交互的视觉语言辅助系统（VLA）控制提供了一种自然、低负担且极具表现力的方式。
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.
Beyond Mimicry: Learning Whole-Body Human-Humanoid Interaction from Human-Human Demonstrations
超越模仿：从人与人之间的演示中学习全身人与人形机器人的互动
使人形机器人能够与人类进行物理交互是一项至关重要的前沿技术，但高质量人机交互（HHoI）数据的匮乏阻碍了这一领域的进展。尽管利用丰富的人际交互（HHI）数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但我们首先证明，标准的重定向方法会破坏关键的接触点，从而导致失败。我们提出了PAIR（物理感知交互重定向）来解决这个问题，PAIR是一个以接触点为中心的两阶段流程，它能够在形态差异的情况下保留接触语义，从而生成物理上一致的HHoI数据。然而，这些高质量的数据也暴露了第二个缺陷：传统的模仿学习策略仅仅模仿轨迹，而缺乏交互理解。因此，我们引入了D-STAR（解耦时空动作推理器），这是一种分层策略，能够将何时行动与何地行动区分开来。在D-STAR模型中，相位注意力（when）和多尺度空间模块（where）通过扩散头融合，产生超越模仿的同步全身行为。通过解耦这些推理流程，我们的模型能够学习到稳健的时间相位，而不会受到空间噪声的干扰，从而实现响应迅速且同步的协作。我们通过广泛而严谨的仿真验证了我们的框架，结果表明，与基线方法相比，该框架具有显著的性能提升，并提供了一个完整有效的流程，可以从HHI数据中学习复杂的全身交互。
Enabling humanoid robots to physically interact with humans is a critical frontier, but progress is hindered by the scarcity of high-quality Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHoI) data. While leveraging abundant Human-Human Interaction (HHI) data presents a scalable alternative, we first demonstrate that standard retargeting fails by breaking the essential contacts. We address this with PAIR (Physics-Aware Interaction Retargeting), a contact-centric, two-stage pipeline that preserves contact semantics across morphology differences to generate physically consistent HHoI data.This high-quality data, however, exposes a second failure: conventional imitation learning policies merely mimic trajectories and lack interactive understanding. We therefore introduce D-STAR (Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Action Reasoner), a hierarchical policy that disentangles when to act from where to act. In D-STAR, Phase Attention (when) and a Multi-Scale Spatial module (where) are fused by the diffusion head to produce synchronized whole-body behaviors beyond mimicry.By decoupling these reasoning streams, our model learns robust temporal phases without being distracted by spatial noise, leading to responsive, synchronized collaboration. We validate our framework through extensive and rigorous simulations, demonstrating significant performance gains over baseline approaches and a complete, effective pipeline for learning complex whole-body interactions from HHI data.
End-to-End Language-Action Model for Humanoid Whole Body Control
人形机器人全身控制的端到端语言-动作模型
现有的人形机器人控制系统通常依赖于远程操作或模块化生成流程，将语言理解与物理执行分离。然而，前者完全由人驱动，后者则缺乏语言指令与物理行为之间的紧密匹配。本文提出了一种名为SENTINEL的端到端语言-动作框架，用于人形机器人的全身控制。我们利用预训练的全身控制器在仿真环境中跟踪人体运动，并结合相应的文本标注，构建了一个大规模数据集。该模型无需任何中间表示，即可将语言指令和本体感觉输入直接映射到底层动作。模型使用流匹配生成动作块，这些动作块随后可以通过残差动作头进行细化，以用于实际部署。我们的方法在仿真和实际部署中均展现出强大的语义理解能力和稳定的执行性能，并且支持通过将输入转换为文本来实现多模态扩展。
Existing humanoid control systems often rely on teleoperation or modular generation pipelines that separate language understanding from physical execution. However, the former is entirely human-driven, and the latter lacks tight alignment between language commands and physical behaviors. In this paper, we present SENTINEL, a fully end-to-end language-action framework for humanoid whole-body control. We construct a large-scale dataset by tracking human motions in simulation using a pretrained whole body controller, combined with their text annotations. The model directly maps language commands and proprioceptive inputs to low-level actions without any intermediate representation. The model generates action chunks using flow matching, which can be subsequently refined by a residual action head for real-world deployment. Our method exhibits strong semantic understanding and stable execution on humanoid robots in both simulation and real-world deployment, and also supports multi-modal extensions by converting inputs into texts.
LiteViLNet: Lightweight Vision-LiDAR Fusion Network for Efficient Road Segmentation
LiteViLNet：用于高效道路分割的轻量级视觉-激光雷达融合网络
道路分割是自动驾驶和智能机器人系统的一项基础感知任务，它既需要高精度，也需要实时推理，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上部署时。现有的多模态道路分割方法通常依赖于基于Transformer的大型编码器来实现最先进的性能，但其巨大的计算成本限制了其在嵌入式平台上的实时部署。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了LiteViLNet，一个轻量级的多模态网络，它融合了RGB纹理信息和激光雷达几何信息，以实现高效的道路分割。具体而言，我们设计了一个双流轻量级编码器和深度可分离卷积，以最少的参数从两种模态中提取分层特征。此外，我们还提出了一个多尺度特征融合模块（MSFM）来促进不同层次的跨模态交互，以及一个大核桥接模块来以线性复杂度捕获长程依赖关系。在KITTI道路数据集和实际应用中的大量实验表明，LiteViLNet在精度和效率之间取得了良好的平衡。值得注意的是，我们的模型仅使用 1404 万个参数，就达到了 96.36% 的 MaxF 分数，在所有基于 CNN 的方法中名列前茅，并且与规模更大的基于 Transformer 的模型相媲美。在 RTX 4060 Ti 显卡上进行仅模型推理时，其帧率高达 163.79 FPS（在 Jetson Orin NX 上为 22.18 FPS）。它在推理速度方面超越了许多重量级方法，同时保持了极具竞争力的准确率，充分验证了 LiteViLNet 在自动驾驶和智能机器人等实时嵌入式部署方面的潜力。
Road segmentation is a fundamental perception task for autonomous driving and intelligent robotic systems, requiring both high accuracy and real-time inference, especially for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Existing multi-modal road segmentation methods often rely on heavy transformer-based encoders to achieve state-of-the-art performance, but their enormous computational cost prohibits real-time deployment on embedded platforms. To address this dilemma, we propose LiteViLNet, a lightweight multi-modal network that fuses RGB texture information and LiDAR geometric information for efficient road segmentation. Specifically, we design a dual-stream lightweight encoder and depth-wise separable convolutions to extract hierarchical features from both modalities with minimal parameters. We further propose a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Module (MSFM) to facilitate cross-modal interaction at different levels, and a large-kernel-bridge module to capture long-range dependencies with linear complexity. Extensive experiments on the KITTI Road dataset and real-world applications demonstrate that LiteViLNet achieves a promising balance between accuracy and efficiency. Notably, with only 14.04M parameters, our model attains a 96.36% MaxF score, ranking the best among all CNN-based methods and being comparable to larger transformer-based models, and runs at 163.79 FPS in model-only inference on RTX 4060 Ti (22.18 FPS on Jetson Orin NX). It outperforms numerous heavy-weight methods in inference speed while maintaining highly competitive accuracy, fully validating the potential of LiteViLNet for real-time embedded deployment in autonomous driving and intelligent robotics.
BifrostUMI: Bridging Robot-Free Demonstrations and Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation
BifrostUMI：连接无机器人演示和人形全身操控
高质量的数据采集是训练人形机器人全身视觉运动策略的基石。目前的数据采集范式主要依赖于机器人远程操控，但这种方式常常受到硬件可及性有限和操作效率低下的限制。受通用操作界面（UMI）的启发，我们提出了BifrostUMI，这是一个专为人形机器人设计的便携、高效且无需机器人的数据采集框架。BifrostUMI利用轻量级VR设备捕捉人类动作，将其转化为稀疏的关键点轨迹，同时记录腕部佩戴的视觉数据。这些多模态数据随后被用于训练一个高级策略网络，该网络能够根据捕捉到的视觉特征预测未来的关键点轨迹。通过一个稳健的关键点重定向流程，关键点轨迹被精确映射到机器人的形态上，并通过全身控制器执行。这种方法能够将自然人类动作中多样化且灵活的行为无缝迁移到人形机器人上。我们在两个不同的实验场景中验证了所提出框架的有效性和通用性。
High-quality data collection is a fundamental cornerstone for training humanoid whole-body visuomotor policies. Current data acquisition paradigms predominantly rely on robot teleoperation, which is often hindered by limited hardware accessibility and low operational efficiency. Inspired by the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), we propose BifrostUMI, a portable, efficient, and robot-free data collection framework tailored for humanoid robots. BifrostUMI leverages lightweight VR devices to capture human demonstrations as sparse keypoint trajectories while simultaneously recording wrist-mounted visual data. These multimodal data are subsequently utilized to train a high-level policy network that predicts future keypoint trajectories conditioned on the captured visual features. Through a robust keypoint retargeting pipeline, keypoint trajectories are precisely mapped onto the robot's morphology and executed via a whole-body controller. This approach enables the seamless transfer of diverse and agile behaviors from natural human demonstrations to humanoid embodiments. We demonstrate the efficacy and versatility of the proposed framework across two distinct experimental scenarios.
ParkourFormer: Integrating Predictive Supervision and Sequence Modeling into Parkour Locomotion
ParkourFormer：将预测监督与序列建模整合至跑酷运动中
人形机器人跑酷任务要求运动策略能够协调全身动力学，以应对楼梯、沟壑、坡道和障碍物等快速变化的地形环境。现有的强化学习策略大多属于反应式，仅将观测数据直接映射为动作，而未显式地对未来的身体状态进行建模。然而，在敏捷运动任务中，这种建模能力至关重要，因为成功的动作执行在很大程度上取决于对即将发生的接触状态切换及身体动力学的预判。为此，我们提出了一种名为 ParkourFormer 的基于 Transformer 的序列建模框架，该框架将人形机器人的运动控制问题重新构建为一种“基于未来状态条件”的决策问题。在该框架中，机器人当前的身体状态通过“交叉注意力机制”查询历史的感知运动轨迹数据；与此同时，一个轻量级的预测模块负责预测近期的未来本体感知状态。这些经由监督信号训练得到的未来状态预测结果，将与时序特征进行融合，进而生成相应的动作指令；这一机制使得运动策略能够同时结合历史运动轨迹与预期的未来动力学变化进行综合推理。我们在一个涵盖楼梯、沟壑、坡道、崎岖地面及障碍物穿越等多种地形的综合性人形机器人跑酷基准测试集上对 ParkourFormer 进行了评估。仿真实验及在真实人形机器人平台上的实测结果均表明：ParkourFormer 在极具挑战性的各类地形上取得了高达 93.85% 的平均穿越成功率；相较于基于 MLP、MoE-MLP 以及标准 Transformer 的强基线模型，其性能提升幅度最高可达 42.73%；与此同时，该框架仅需一套统一的策略即可应对所有类型的地形环境。这些实验结果有力地证明了：通过显式地对未来身体状态进行建模，能够显著提升人形机器人敏捷全身运动控制策略的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
Humanoid parkour requires locomotion policies to coordinate whole-body dynamics across rapidly changing terrains such as stairs, gaps, slopes, and obstacles. Existing reinforcement learning policies are largely reactive, mapping observations directly to actions without explicitly modeling future body states. Such modeling becomes critical in agile locomotion tasks where successful motion execution depends strongly on anticipating upcoming contact transitions and body dynamics.We present ParkourFormer, a Transformer-based sequence modeling framework that reformulates humanoid locomotion as a future-conditioned decision-making problem. The current robot state queries historical sensorimotor trajectories through cross-attention, while a lightweight prediction head forecasts short-horizon future proprioceptive states. The predicted future states, trained with supervised signals, are fused with temporal features to generate actions, enabling the policy to jointly reason over motion history and anticipated future dynamics. We evaluate ParkourFormer on a diverse multi-terrain humanoid parkour benchmark including stairs, gaps, slopes, rough terrain, and obstacle traversal. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot show that ParkourFormer achieves a 93.85% average traversal success rate on highly challenging terrains, with improvements of up to 42.73% over strong MLP, MoE-based MLP, and vanilla Transformer baselines, while maintaining a single unified policy across all terrain types. These results demonstrate that explicit future-state modeling significantly improves robustness and generalization for agile whole-body locomotion.
Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection
遥操作中的闭环机制：面向高质量演示采集的片段级数据质量评估与反馈
工业自动化正处于一个关键时刻，因为“物理AI”（Physical AI）正推动着行业从僵化、依赖人工精心设计的自动化系统，向更加灵活、自适应的系统转型。这一转变催生了对大规模、真实世界机器人演示数据的日益增长的需求，从而使得远程操控成为一种愈发重要的数据采集手段。然而，在实际应用中，获取高质量的远程操控演示数据依然充满挑战；新手操作员录制的演示片段虽然在任务结果上看似成功，却往往因动作效率低下、频繁进行重复修正，或操作逼近机器人关节极限等问题，而无法满足下游应用对数据质量的严格要求。为此，我们提出了一种“数据质量评估与反馈”（DQAF）框架。该框架通过提供基于语义级任务进度与机器人遥测数据的即时、事后反馈，从而在远程操控流程中实现了闭环优化。该框架能够提取诸如子任务完成度、动作流畅度、操作停滞情况、运动学极限逼近度等一系列与数据质量紧密相关的信号；随后，系统会将这些信号转化为结构化的质量评估报告，并生成具有实际指导意义的自然语言反馈建议。与仅提供“成功”或“失败”这种二元判断的传统反馈机制不同，本系统能够详尽阐释演示片段为何存在不足，并明确指出在下一次尝试中需要重点纠正的具体操作行为。我们通过一项诊断性验证研究和一项小规模用户试点研究，对该框架的有效性进行了全面评估。在验证研究环节中，我们在数据集筛选与整理的场景下，将本系统所生成的“拒绝理由”及“改进建议”反馈，与人工审核专家的反馈进行了横向对比。而在涉及三位新手操作员及两项具体操作任务的试点研究中，我们发现：相较于未获得系统即时、自动化事后反馈的操作员，那位获得了此类反馈的操作员其技能提升速度显著更快，并得以在更短的时间内录制出高质量的机器人演示数据。
Industrial automation is at a pivotal moment, as Physical AI is driving a transition from rigid, hand-engineered automation systems toward more flexible and adaptive systems. This shift has created a growing demand for large-scale, real-world robot demonstration data, making teleoperation an increasingly important mechanism for data collection. However, high-quality teleoperated demonstrations remain difficult to obtain in practice, as novice operators often produce episodes that are task-successful but suboptimal for downstream use due to inefficient motion, repeated corrections, or operation near robot joint limits. We present a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback (DQAF) framework that closes the loop in teleoperation by providing immediate post-episode feedback grounded in semantic task progress and robot telemetry. The framework extracts quality relevant signals such as sub-task progress, motion smoothness, stalls, kinematic limits and converts them into structured quality assessments and actionable natural-language feedback. Unlike binary success or failure feedback, the proposed system explains why an episode is suboptimal and highlights specific behaviors to correct in the next trial. We evaluate the framework through a diagnostic validation study and a pilot user study. In the validation study, the system is compared with a human reviewer during dataset curation, producing rejection reasons and actionable feedback for improvement. In the pilot study with three novice operators across two manipulation tasks, the operator who received the systems immediate, automated post-episode feedback improved faster than those who did not, producing higher-quality demonstrations sooner.
Switch-JustDance: Benchmarking Whole-Body Motion Tracking Controllers Using a Commercial Console Game
Switch-JustDance：基于商业主机游戏的全身动作追踪控制器基准测试
近年来，全身机器人控制领域的最新进展使得类人机器人和足式机器人能够执行日益敏捷且协调的动作。然而，目前仍缺乏用于在真实世界环境中评估这些能力、并能与人类表现进行直接对比的标准化基准。现有的评估方法往往依赖于预先收集的人类动作数据集或基于仿真的实验，这不仅限制了结果的可复现性，忽略了硬件层面的影响因素，还阻碍了开展公平的人机对比。为此，我们提出了一种名为 Switch-JustDance 的低成本、高可复现性基准测试流程；该流程利用体感游戏主机上的游戏——即任天堂 Switch 平台上的《舞力全开》（Just Dance）——来对机器人的全身控制能力进行评估。Switch-JustDance 以任天堂 Switch 上的《舞力全开》作为代表性平台，通过流媒体传输、动作重构及动作重定向等模块，将游戏内的舞蹈编排转化为机器人可执行的动作序列；同时，用户还可以利用该游戏内置的评分系统，对机器人控制器的性能进行量化评估。我们首先对《舞力全开》作为评估工具的各项特性进行了验证，深入分析了其在可靠性、有效性、灵敏度以及潜在偏差来源等方面的表现。实验结果表明，该平台能够提供一致且易于解读的性能衡量指标，使其成为评估“具身智能”（Embodied AI）的理想基准测试工具。在此基础上，我们进一步在实体硬件平台上对三款当前最先进的类人机器人全身控制器进行了基准测试，并针对它们各自的优势与局限性提供了独到的分析与见解。
Recent advances in whole-body robot control have enabled humanoid and legged robots to perform increasingly agile and coordinated motions. However, standardized benchmarks for evaluating these capabilities in real-world settings, and in direct comparison to humans, remain scarce. Existing evaluations often rely on pre-collected human motion datasets or simulation-based experiments, which limit reproducibility, overlook hardware factors, and hinder fair human-robot comparisons. We present Switch-JustDance, a low-cost and reproducible benchmarking pipeline that leverages motion-sensing console games, Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch, to evaluate robot whole-body control. Using Just Dance on the Nintendo Switch as a representative platform, Switch-JustDance converts in-game choreography into robot-executable motions through streaming, motion reconstruction, and motion retargeting modules and enables users to evaluate controller performance through the game's built-in scoring system. We first validate the evaluation properties of Just Dance, analyzing its reliability, validity, sensitivity, and potential sources of bias. Our results show that the platform provides consistent and interpretable performance measures, making it a suitable tool for benchmarking embodied AI. Building on this foundation, we benchmark three state-of-the-art humanoid whole-body controllers on hardware and provide insights into their relative strengths and limitations.
Towards Data-Efficient VLA Post-Training: a case study of an industrial task
迈向数据高效的 VLA 后训练：一项工业任务的案例研究
在仓储和物流环境中，刚性自动化的局限性暴露无遗——那些虽不常发生但代价高昂的“边缘案例”（如包裹错位或受损）往往难以得到妥善解决。仿人机器人正日益被视为一种灵活的解决方案，这也使得“抓取箱体”任务成为衡量其在现实世界中部署可行性的一个实用基准。在本文中，我们探讨了“视觉-语言-动作”（VLA）模型能否在数据稀缺的环境下——即工业应用早期部署阶段的典型特征——提供一种可靠且具备专业水准的仿人机器人控制策略。我们利用仅包含60个远程操控演示样本的数据集，对 NVIDIA GR00T N1.5 模型进行了针对“抓取箱体”任务的后续训练（Post-training）。我们提出了一种务实的数据采集策略，该策略侧重于对机器人行为进行清晰的拆解，并确保对每一种具体行为都有充分的覆盖度；这突显了这样一个关键点：若要实现可靠的低数据量部署，精心的数据集设计至关重要，其重要性远胜于单纯追求数据集的规模大小。尽管数据集规模有限，但由此训练出的控制策略仍取得了高达97.0%的成功率，并且展现出了良好的泛化能力，能够有效应对此前未曾见过的箱体朝向以及光照条件截然不同的场景。此外，我们将本研究提出的方法与“改进型3D扩散策略”（iDP3）进行了对比——iDP3 是一种完全从零开始构建的基于扩散模型的仿人机器人模型，且同样利用上述数据集进行了训练。结果显示，与 VLA 模型不同，iDP3 未能可靠地习得关键的行为动作；这一结果有力地印证了大规模 VLA 预训练所具备的显著优势——即在针对特定工业任务适配至新型仿人机器人硬件平台时，预训练模型能够展现出更卓越的适应与迁移能力。
Warehouse and logistics environments expose the limitations of rigid automation, where infrequent but costly edge cases, such as misaligned or damaged packages, remain unresolved. Humanoid robots are increasingly viewed as a flexible solution, motivating box picking as a practical benchmark for real-world deployment. In this work, we explore whether a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model can provide a reliable, specialist humanoid policy in the low-data regime characteristic of early industrial deployment. We post-train NVIDIA GR00T N1.5 on a box-picking task using only 60 teleoperated demonstrations. We introduce a pragmatic data collection strategy focused on clear behaviour decomposition and sufficient per-behaviour coverage, emphasising that careful dataset design, rather than size alone, is critical for reliable low-data deployment. Despite the limited dataset, the resulting policy achieves a 97.0% success rate and generalises to unseen box orientations and substantially different lighting conditions. We compare our approach to the Improved 3D Diffusion Policy (iDP3), a from-scratch diffusionbased humanoid model, trained on the same dataset. Unlike the VLA, iDP3 fails to reliably learn key behaviours, highlighting the advantage of large-scale VLA pre-training when adapting to new humanoid embodiments for bounded industrial tasks
HoloMotion-1 Technical Report
HoloMotion-1 技术报告
在本报告中，我们推出了 HoloMotion-1，这是一款专为零样本全身运动追踪而设计的人形运动基础模型。HoloMotion-1 的一项关键创新在于，它利用大规模混合运动语料库对控制策略训练进行了扩展；其中，从“野外”视频中重建的运动数据构成了运动多样性的主要来源，而经过精心筛选的动作捕捉数据及内部自研运动数据则提供了更高保真度的监督信号，并确保了模型对实际部署场景的全面覆盖。这种数据范式使 HoloMotion-1 能够突破传统仅依赖动作捕捉数据进行训练的局限，让其控制策略得以接触到远比以往广泛的行为模式、捕捉环境及运动风格。
从此类异构数据中进行学习带来了诸多新挑战，包括重建噪声、源域不匹配、运动质量参差不齐，以及在面对巨大行为差异时对时序建模能力的需求。为应对这些挑战，HoloMotion-1 集成了大容量时序建模模块、一种支持实时控制且具备 KV 缓存推理能力的稀疏激活专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）Transformer 架构，以及一种能够提升长时序运动序列学习效率的序列级训练策略。在多个未曾见过的运动基准测试集上进行的大量实验表明，HoloMotion-1 展现出极强的泛化能力，能够稳健地适应各类运动类型及捕捉环境；其追踪精度较现有方法实现了显著提升，且无需针对特定任务进行微调，即可直接迁移并应用于真实的人形机器人平台。
In this report, we present HoloMotion-1, a humanoid motion foundation model for zero-shot whole-body motion tracking. A key innovation of HoloMotion-1 is to scale control-policy training with a large-scale hybrid motion corpus, where video-reconstructed motions from in-the-wild videos provide the dominant source of motion diversity, while curated motion-capture and in-house motion data provide higher-fidelity supervision and deployment-oriented coverage. This data regime enables HoloMotion-1 to move beyond conventional MoCap-only training and exposes the policy to substantially broader behaviors, capture conditions, and motion styles.
Learning from such heterogeneous data introduces new challenges, including reconstruction noise, source-domain mismatch, uneven motion quality, and the need for temporal modeling under large behavioral variation. To address these challenges, HoloMotion-1 integrates large-capacity temporal modeling, a sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts Transformer with KV-cache inference for real-time control, and a sequence-level training strategy that improves learning efficiency on extended motion sequences. Extensive experiments on multiple unseen motion benchmarks show that HoloMotion-1 generalizes robustly across diverse motion types and capture conditions, significantly improves tracking accuracy over prior methods, and transfers directly to a real humanoid robot without task-specific fine-tuning.
Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation via Active Spatial Brain and Generalizable Action Cerebellum
基于主动空间脑与泛化动作小脑的人形机器人全身操纵
本文探讨了面向空间感知的拟人化全身操纵任务。与桌面环境下的设置相比，此类任务面临两大关键挑战：1) 在具有复杂三维结构及多样化空间关系的复杂环境中，实现空间理解极具挑战性；2) 动作生成难以泛化，因为真实机器人的数据获取受限且成本高昂，从而制约了数据驱动模型的泛化能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种可泛化的拟人化移动-操纵（loco-manipulation）框架，该框架充分利用了多智能体大模型的空间感知与动作生成能力。具体而言，我们的框架包含两大核心组件：负责主动空间感知与决策的“主动空间大脑”（Active Spatial Brain），以及负责生成可执行机器人动作的“可泛化动作小脑”（Generalizable Action Cerebellum）。其中，“主动空间大脑”组件负责主动感知空间场景，并针对任务规划与子任务拆解制定决策；而“可泛化动作小脑”组件则依据前一模块的决策生成可执行的机器人动作，且无需依赖针对特定任务的真实机器人数据。为了对本框架进行基准测试，我们设计了一系列空间操纵任务，并从两个维度进行评估：一是考察空间感知与理解能力，二是考核在真实机器人平台上的任务执行性能。实验结果表明，在涵盖多样化任务与环境的测试场景中，本框架在这两个维度上均展现出了卓越的性能。
In this paper, we explore spatial-aware humanoid whole-body manipulation task. Compared with tabletop settings, this task poses two key challenges: 1) Spatial understanding is challenging in complex 3D environments with diverse spatial relations. 2) Action generation is difficult to generalize, as limited and costly real-robot data restricts data-driven models generalization. To address these challenges, we propose a generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation framework that leverages the spatial perception and action generation capabilities of multi-agent large models. Specifically, our framework includes two components: Active Spatial Brain for active spatial perception and decision-making, and Generalizable Action Cerebellum for executable robot action generation. The first component actively perceives the spatial scene and makes decisions on task planning and subtask decomposition. The second component generate executable robot actions based on the decisions made by the first module without needs of task-specific real robot data. To benchmark our framework, we design a set of spatial manipulation tasks from two perspectives: evaluating spatial perception and understanding, and assessing real-robot task performance. The results demonstrate strong performance on both aspects across diverse tasks and environments.
AoE: Always-on Egocentric Human Video Collection for Embodied AI
AoE：面向具身 AI 的全时段第一人称视角人类视频数据集
具身基础模型（Embodied foundation models）在预训练和规模化扩展阶段，需要大规模、高质量的真实世界交互数据。然而，现有的数据采集方法往往面临基础设施成本高昂、硬件依赖复杂以及交互范围受限等问题，导致难以实现规模化扩展。事实上，人类本身就是理想的物理具身智能体。因此，从全球各地分布的“人类智能体”那里获取第一人称视角的真实世界交互数据，具有低成本和可持续性的显著优势。为此，我们提出了一种名为“Always-on Egocentric”（AoE）的数据采集框架。该框架旨在通过充分利用人类自身及其智能手机，来简化对复杂硬件的依赖；从而实现低成本、高效率且不受特定场景限制的真实世界交互数据采集，以此破解数据稀缺这一难题。具体而言，我们首先采用一种符合人体工学原理的颈挂式智能手机支架，并结合“云-边协同”架构，从而实现了低门槛、大规模的第一人称视角数据采集。其次，我们开发了一款跨平台的移动应用程序（App）：该应用利用设备端的计算能力进行实时数据处理；与此同时，云端则负责运行自动标注与筛选流水线，将原始视频转化为高质量的训练数据。最终，AoE 系统实现了分布式的第一人称视角数据采集，使得任何人都能在任何时间、任何地点参与其中。我们针对数据预处理质量及下游任务对 AoE 系统进行了综合评估，结果表明，高质量的第一人称视角数据能够显著提升模型在真实世界环境中的泛化能力。
Embodied foundation models require large-scale, high-quality real-world interaction data for pre-training and scaling. However, existing data collection methods suffer from high infrastructure costs, complex hardware dependencies, and limited interaction scope, making scalable expansion challenging. In fact, humans themselves are ideal physically embodied agents. Therefore, obtaining egocentric real-world interaction data from globally distributed "human agents" offers advantages of low cost and sustainability. To this end, we propose the Always-on Egocentric (AoE) data collection framework, which aims to simplify hardware dependencies by leveraging humans themselves and their smartphones, enabling low-cost, highly efficient, and scene-agnostic real-world interaction data collection to address the challenge of data scarcity. Specifically, we first employ an ergonomic neck-mounted smartphone holder to enable low-barrier, large-scale egocentric data collection through a cloud-edge collaborative architecture. Second, we develop a cross-platform mobile APP that leverages on-device compute for real-time processing, while the cloud hosts automated labeling and filtering pipelines that transform raw videos into high-quality training data. Finally, the AoE system supports distributed Ego data collection by anyone, anytime, and anywhere. We evaluate AoE on data preprocessing quality and downstream tasks, demonstrating that high-quality egocentric data significantly boosts real-world generalization.
CEER: Compliant End-Effector and Root Control as a Unified Interface for Hierarchical Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
CEER：作为分层类人机器人移动-操纵统一接口的柔顺末端执行器与基座控制
人形机器人已在运动控制方面取得了令人瞩目的成就，但在涉及丰富接触交互及长时程的操纵任务上，仍面临着重大的瓶颈。操纵任务本质上涉及丰富的接触交互，因此要求机器人具备柔顺的全身控制能力以实现稳定的交互；与此同时，鉴于操纵任务的多样性及长时程特性，相比于单纯的关节空间轨迹跟踪，采用模块化且易于与规划器兼容的接口显得更为适宜。为此，我们提出了一种名为 CEER 的柔顺末端执行器-基座（EE-root）控制抽象，旨在分层规划框架下实现人形机器人的模块化运动-操纵一体化控制。CEER 能够在由基座运动指令与末端执行器位姿目标所定义的、具有良好可解释性的任务空间内，实现具备柔顺感知能力的全身控制；同时，它还支持与各类异构的高层规划器进行“即插即用”式的集成。我们采用了一种“教师-学生”训练框架，将通用的运动轨迹跟踪控制器提炼（distill）为一种低层控制策略，该策略仅需接收 EE-root 指令即可驱动机器人运动。在此基础上，我们构建了一个分层控制系统，通过 EE-root 接口将各类异构规划器与任务模块有机地整合在一起，从而使机器人无需对底层的全身控制策略进行重新训练，即可执行丰富多样的操纵任务。仿真实验与硬件实机测试结果表明：与基准方法相比，该系统实现了 3.3 厘米的末端执行器跟踪精度，并显著降低了运动过程中的加加速度（jerk）；在遥控操作模式下，系统能够稳定地执行涉及丰富接触交互的操纵任务；此外，在房间尺度的仿真环境中执行单目标运动-操纵任务时，其成功率高达 70%。这些实验结果充分证明，柔顺的 EE-root 控制机制为人形机器人的运动-操纵一体化控制提供了一种切实可行的抽象范式，从而为实现各类技能的模块化与可扩展集成奠定了坚实基础。
Humanoid robots have achieved impressive loco-motion performance, yet contact-rich and long-horizon manipulation remains a major bottleneck. Manipulation is inherently contact-rich and demands compliant whole-body control for stable interaction, while its diversity and long-horizon nature favor modular, planner-compatible interfaces over joint-space tracking. We propose CEER, a compliant end-effector–root (EE-root) control abstraction for modular humanoid loco-manipulation within a hierarchical planning framework. CEER enables compliance-aware whole-body control in an interpretable task space defined by root motion commands and end-effector pose targets, and supports plug-and-play integration with heterogeneous high-level planners. A teacher–student framework is adopted to distill a general motion-tracking controller into a low-level policy that consumes only EE-root commands. We further construct a hierarchical system that integrates heterogeneous planners and task modules through the EE-root interface, enabling diverse manipulation tasks without retraining the underlying whole-body policy. Experiments in simulation and on hardware demonstrate 3.3 cm end-effector tracking accuracy with substantially reduced jerk compared to baselines, stable contact-rich manipulation under teleoperation, and up to 70% success in simulated single-object loco-manipulation tasks within a room-scale environment. These results indicate that compliant EE-root control provides a practical abstraction for humanoid loco-manipulation, enabling modular and scalable integration of diverse skills.
Imagine2Real: Towards Zero-shot Humanoid-Object Interaction via Video Generative Priors
Imagine2Real：基于视频生成先验实现零样本类人-物体交互
全身类人-物体交互（HOI）领域正受困于高保真3D数据的稀缺性这一瓶颈。尽管视频生成先验知识提供了一种极具潜力的替代方案，但现有方法仍面临两大难题：一是源于对几何先验（例如显式CAD模型）过度依赖所导致的“表征错位”（Representation Misalignment）；二是因涉及大量形变操作及形态不匹配问题而产生的“重定向复杂性”（Retargeting Complexity）。为此，我们提出 Imagine2Real——一个专为实现灵活且无需几何先验的交互而设计的零样本（zero-shot）HOI框架。为解决表征错位问题，我们将机器人与物体的运动统一建模为4D点轨迹。为克服重定向复杂性，我们设计了“关键点追踪器”（Keypoints Tracker），仅对稀疏的关键点（包括机器人基座、双手及物体）进行追踪，从而彻底绕开了那个极易导致误差累积放大的重定向环节。为了在仅依赖稀疏信号的情况下依然能保持步态的自然流畅，我们将“行为基础模型”（BFM）的潜在空间作为追踪器的搜索域。通过采用渐进式训练策略，Imagine2Real 仅凭简单的追踪奖励信号，便能习得鲁棒的行为模式，最终实现在动作捕捉（mocap）系统环境下的零样本物理部署。
Whole-body Humanoid-Object Interaction (HOI) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D data. While video generative priors offer a promising alternative, existing methods suffer from \textit{Representation Misalignment} due to their reliance on geometric priors (e.g., explicit CAD models), and \textit{Retargeting Complexity} arising from intensive morphing and morphological mismatch. We propose Imagine2Real, a zero-shot HOI framework for flexible, geometry-free interaction. To resolve misalignment, we formulate robot and object motions as unified 4D point trajectories. To overcome retargeting complexity, our Keypoints Tracker tracks only sparse critical points (base, hands, and object), entirely bypassing the error-amplifying retargeting process. To maintain natural gaits despite these sparse signals, we utilize the latent space of a Behavior Foundation Model (BFM) as the tracker's search domain. Using a progressive training strategy, Imagine2Real learns robust behaviors with simple tracking rewards, enabling zero-shot physical deployment within a motion capture(mocap) system.
Steering Generative Reinforcement Learning into Stable Robotic Controller
引导生成式强化学习构建稳定的机器人控制器
基于扩散（diffusion）和流（flow）的生成式策略通过迭代生成动作来引入丰富的随机探索，从而为强化学习提供了一类强大的策略。然而，扩散策略固有的随机性并不适用于高维机器人系统的稳定精确控制，因为微小的动作波动可能累积导致运动不一致并降低鲁棒性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SteerGenPO，这是一个潜空间强化学习框架，旨在将训练好的生成式策略转化为鲁棒的确定性机器人控制器。其核心思想是用一个学习得到的“潜空间执行器”（latent actor）来替代生成式策略中原有的随机潜变量采样；该执行器负责根据当前状态预测生成式策略所需的潜变量输入。这种方法实现了探索与控制的分离：随机生成式采样在策略学习阶段提供多样化的动作候选，而确定性潜空间引导则在部署阶段提供稳定且自适应的控制。我们在六个 Isaac Lab 基准测试任务及 Unitree G1 机器人运动任务上对 SteerGenPO 进行了评估。结果表明，SteerGenPO 优于传统的强化学习及生成式强化学习基线方法；同时，其确定性潜空间引导机制带来了更稳定的推理阶段行为以及更可靠的指令响应。
Diffusion and flow-based generative policies provide a powerful policy class for reinforcement learning by inducing rich stochastic exploration through iterative action generation. However, the stochasticity of diffusion policies is not suitable for stable and precise control in high-dimensional robotic systems, where small action variations can accumulate into inconsistent motion and reduced robustness. To address this issue, we propose SteerGenPO, a latent-space reinforcement learning framework that steers a trained generative policy into a robust deterministic robotic controller. The key idea is to replace stochastic latent sampling of the trained generative policy with a learned latent actor that predicts a state-dependent latent input for the generative policies. This separates exploration and control: stochastic generative sampling provides diverse action proposals during policy learning, while deterministic latent steering provides stable and adaptive control at deployment. We evaluate SteerGenPO on six Isaac Lab benchmarks and a Unitree G1 locomotion task. The results show SteerGenPO improves over both classical RL and generative RL baselines, while its deterministic latent steering produces more stable inference-time behaviors and more reliable command responses.
IntentNav: Learning Spatial-Visual Object Navigation from Human Demonstrations
IntentNav：从人类演示中学习空间-视觉物体导航
物体导航（ObjectNav）任务要求机器人在未知环境中，基于部分可观测信息决定下一步的探索位置，从而寻找未被观测到的目标。高效的搜索过程类似于人类的探索行为：既有选择性地探测视觉上具有潜力的“前沿区域”（frontiers），又利用空间记忆避免重复访问已探索区域。我们提出了 IntentNav，这是一个基于人类演示学习类人物体导航策略的空间-视觉模仿学习框架。为了从底层人类动作中推断高层搜索意图，我们引入了“基于前沿区域的人类意图标注”方法：该方法通过前瞻人类演示序列，标注出最能解释演示者未来搜索方向的前沿区域。我们构建了一个空间-视觉候选动作空间，其中鸟瞰图（BEV）记忆用于追踪已探索区域、未探索前沿及轨迹历史，而以自我为中心的视觉记忆则为每个候选动作提供语义线索。我们训练了一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的策略，在这些具有环境对应关系的候选动作中进行选择，并采用“意图对齐目标”来引导模型进行一致且符合人类习惯的探索。IntentNav 在 MP3D、HM3D-v1 和 HM3D-v2 物体导航基准测试中均取得了业内领先的性能。该框架提出的候选动作级导航接口具备零样本迁移能力，无需对 VLM 进行额外微调，即可直接应用于轮式、四足及人形机器人。
Object navigation requires a robot to search for an unobserved target in an unknown environment by deciding where to explore next under partial observability. Effective search resembles human-like exploration: selectively probing visually promising frontiers while relying on spatial memory to avoid redundant revisits. We propose IntentNav, a spatial-visual imitation framework that learns human-like ObjectNav policies from human demonstrations. To infer high-level search intent from low-level human actions, we introduce Frontier-based Human-Intent Labeling, which looks ahead in human demonstrations and labels the frontier that best explains the demonstrator's future search direction. We construct a spatial-visual candidate space, where BEV memory tracks explored regions, unexplored frontiers, and trajectory history, while egocentric visual memory provides semantic cues for each candidate. A VLM policy is trained to select among these grounded candidates, using Intent-Aligned Objective to encourage consistent and human-like exploration. IntentNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MP3D, HM3D-v1 and HM3D-v2 ObjectNav benchmarks. The proposed candidate-level navigation interface transfers zero-shot to wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid robots without further VLM fine-tuning.
Identification of a Physics-Based Electrical Power Consumption Model for the Unitree G1 Humanoid Arm
Unitree G1 人形机器人手臂基于物理特性的电力消耗模型辨识
对于电池供电的人形机器人而言，准确预测电力消耗对于实现能效感知运动规划、电池管理及热状态监测至关重要。本文提出了一种基于物理原理且参数呈线性关系的功耗模型，用于描述 Unitree G1 人形机器人左臂（七自由度）的电力消耗。该模型结合了执行器损耗项与基准力矩校正项，后者能够捕捉重力补偿负载的变化，从而实现对负净功率轨迹的准确预测。此外，模型引入了成对交互项，以描述多关节同时运动过程中的功率耦合效应。模型参数基于实物 Unitree G1 的实验数据进行辨识，并以机载功率测量值作为回归目标。在涵盖不同速度等级下的单关节及手臂协同运动的 897 条轨迹测试中，该模型达到了 R²=0.933 和 RMSE=1.07 W 的精度。在 46 条未曾用于训练的速度条件下执行的轨迹验证中，模型取得了 R²=0.965 的结果，展现出优异的泛化能力。对辨识参数的分析揭示了该手臂各关节独特的功耗特性：粘性摩擦在大多数关节（肩部俯仰关节及所有三个腕关节）中起主导作用；铜损在肩部偏航关节和肘关节中占主导地位；而肩部侧滚关节则呈现出由库仑摩擦主导的独特特性。
Accurate prediction of electrical power consumption is essential for energy-aware motion planning, battery management, and thermal monitoring in battery-powered humanoid robots. This letter presents a physics-based, linear-in-parameters model for the electrical power consumption of the seven-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot. The proposed formulation combines actuator loss terms with a baseline-torque correction that captures changes in gravity-compensation load and enables accurate prediction of negative net power trajectories. Pairwise interaction terms are introduced to model power coupling during simultaneous multi-joint motion. Model parameters are identified from experimental data collected on a physical Unitree~G1 using onboard power measurements as the regression target. Across 897 trajectories covering single-joint and coordinated arm motions at multiple speed levels, the identified model achieves R2=0.933 with an RMSE of 1.07 (W). Validation on 46 trajectories executed at previously unseen speeds yields R2=0.965, demonstrating strong generalisation beyond the identification dataset. Analysis of the identified parameters reveals distinct power-consumption characteristics across the arm, with viscous friction dominating most joints (shoulder pitch and all three wrist joints), copper losses dominating shoulder yaw and the elbow, and shoulder roll uniquely dominated by Coulomb friction.
From Remote Control to Vision-Language-Action: Initial Deployment of the Humanoid Robot Unitree G1 with Tactile Hands
从遥控到“视觉-语言-动作”：搭载触觉灵巧手的宇树 G1 人形机器人初步部署
本文报告了在高校科研与教学实验室中，部署两台配备 Inspire RH56DFTP 触觉五指灵巧手的 Unitree G1 EDU U6 人形机器人的初步经验。我们记录了从开箱到实现可重复科研应用的全过程，涵盖了调试、遥控与远程操作、运动控制、SDK/ROS 2 配置、第三方灵巧手集成、基于仿真的风险规避以及网络安全加固等环节。尽管相关的研究演示日益增多，但针对 G1 实际操作部署的详细技术记录依然匮乏；我们旨在通过这份侧重于系统层面的实践报告来填补这一空白。从硬件角度看，该平台基本符合预期，其平地运动表现令人信服；然而，作为一个整体系统，它在应对日常实验任务时仍显脆弱，尤其是在加装灵巧手之后。主要的挑战在于：软件版本不一致及跨供应商组件的配置管理薄弱；在“移动-操作”复合任务中，外部灵巧手线缆存在机械结构上的脆弱性；以及需要构建一个统一的“感知-动作”流水线，以便在供应商提供的基础手部动作原语之外，整合触觉感知能力。此外，我们还探讨了机载感知系统（如摄像头视角及 SLAM/导航工具的成熟度）的实际局限性，并总结了在机构基础设施内操作联网人形机器人时所需的防护措施。最后，本文总结了实践经验，并展望了利用 UniFoLM 和 GR00T 开展早期“视觉-语言-动作”（Vision-Language-Action）实验的路线图。
This paper reports initial deployment experience with two Unitree G1 EDU U6 humanoid robots equipped with Inspire RH56DFTP tactile five-finger hands in a university research-and-education lab. We document the path from unboxing to repeatable research use: commissioning, remote control and teleoperation, locomotion, SDK/ROS 2 configuration, integration of third-party dexterous hands, simulation-based de-risking, and cybersecurity hardening. Despite rapidly
growing research demonstrations, detailed operator-facing notes on real G1 manipulation deployments remain limited; we aim to narrow this gap with a practical, system-level report. From a hardware perspective the platform largely fulfils expectations and flat-ground locomotion is convincing; nevertheless, the complete system is still fragile for everyday experimental work, especially once the dexterous hands are installed. The main friction points are software version drift and weak configuration management across vendor components, mechanical vulnerability of the external hand cabling during loco-manipulation, and the need to build a unified sensorimotor pipeline that incorporates tactile perception beyond vendor-provided hand motion primitives. We also discuss practical constraints of the onboard sensing stack (camera viewpoint and the current maturity of SLAM/navigation tooling) and summarize defensive measures required when operating a network-connected humanoid on institutional infrastructure. The paper concludes with lessons learned and a roadmap toward early Vision-Language-Action experiments with UniFoLM and GR00T.
Global-Local Attention Decomposition for Terrain Encoding in Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion
面向人形机器人感知运动的地形编码：全局-局部注意力分解
尽管强化学习已显著提升了人形机器人的运动能力，但在落脚点稀疏的地形或受限环境中，基于感知的控制策略仍面临挑战。在这些场景中取得成功，既需要对地形有宏观感知，又需要精确选择落脚点；而传统的编码器往往将这两种感知任务混淆在一起。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于人形机器人运动控制的地形编码方法——全局-局部注意力分解（GLAD）。GLAD 基于以机器人为中心的高程图，采用由粗到细的编码架构，明确区分了上述两类感知目标：全局注意力分支利用注意力池化（attention pooling）来概括周围的地形环境，而状态条件化的局部注意力分支则对与落脚点相关的精确几何特征进行稀疏化处理与编码。这种显式的注意力分解机制既避免了细粒度空间信息的丢失，又降低了训练开销。实验表明，GLAD 使机器人能够可靠地穿越具有挑战性的缝隙、踏脚石和楼梯。此外，该策略展现出了对地形的自适应行为：在仅接收简单速度指令的情况下，无需显式导航规划器，机器人即可自主沿狭窄路径行进并避开障碍物。在搭载激光雷达（LiDAR）的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实地部署测试中，该方法在多种落脚点稀疏及障碍物密集的场景下，均实现了稳健的“零样本”仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移。
Although reinforcement learning has significantly advanced humanoid locomotion, perceptive policies still struggle on sparse-foothold terrain and constrained environments. Success in these scenarios requires both broad terrain awareness and precise foothold selection, two perceptual roles that conventional encoders often entangle. To address this challenge, we propose Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD) for terrain encoding in humanoid locomotion. Realized by a coarse-to-fine encoder over a robot-centric elevation map, GLAD explicitly separates these objectives: a global attention branch utilizes attention pooling to summarize the surrounding terrain context, while a state-conditioned local attention branch sparsifies and encodes precise foothold-relevant geometry. This explicit attention decomposition prevents the dilution of fine-grained spatial cues while reducing training overhead. Experiments demonstrate that GLAD enables reliable locomotion over challenging gaps, stepping stones, and stairs. Furthermore, the learned policy exhibits emergent terrain-responsive behaviors, autonomously following narrow paths and avoiding obstacles under simple velocity commands without explicit navigation planners. In real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using onboard LiDAR, the proposed method achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse sparse-foothold and obstacle-rich domains.
Energy-Efficient Arm Reaching for a Humanoid Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning with Identified Power Models
基于已辨识功率模型的深度强化学习实现人形机器人手臂节能伸展
执行田间作业任务（如苹果采摘）的人形机器人面临严峻的能源限制，这直接制约了单次充电所能完成的机械臂伸展动作次数。本文针对 Unitree G1 人形机器人的 7 自由度左臂，提出了一种端到端、具备能效感知能力的强化学习框架。该框架结合了基于物理原理且经实验辨识的电力消耗模型，以及在基于 Pinocchio 的刚体动力学仿真器中训练得到的 Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 策略。该强化学习策略基于增量式关节位置动作空间进行运作，并采用一种“混合构型奖励”（Hybrid Constellation Reward）机制进行训练，该机制综合了末端执行器的四点构型距离与表征能耗的力矩范数（torque-norm）。经过 500 万次训练后，该策略在运动学仿真中针对 1000 个随机目标达到了 69.9% 的成功率，且在成功任务中的平均能耗为 98.16 焦耳。最后，该策略在实体 Unitree G1 机器人上通过了三组独立实验（每组包含 10 个目标）的验证，结果显示平均能耗为 71.5 ± 48.3 焦耳，末端执行器位置误差为 2.64 ± 1.04 厘米，姿态误差为 6.92 ± 1.33 度——均处于训练设定的 4 厘米/8.6 度容差范围内。这些成果标志着人形机器人基于能效感知强化学习的机械臂伸展控制迈出了重要一步。
Humanoid robots performing in-field manipulation tasks, such as robotic apple harvesting, face severe energy constraints that directly limit the number of reaching motions that can be executed per battery charge. This paper presents an end-to-end, energy-aware reinforcement learning framework for the 7-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot, combining a physics-based, experimentally identified electrical power model with a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) policy trained in a Pinocchio-based rigid-body dynamics simulator. The RL policy operates on an incremental joint-position action space and is trained with a Hybrid Constellation Reward that combines a four-point end-effector constellation distance with a torque-norm energy proxy; after % 5×106 training it reaches a 69.9% success rate over 1000 random targets in kinematic simulation, at a mean energy of \SI{98.16}{\joule} on successful episodes. Finally, on the physical Unitree~G1, the policy is validated over three independent 10-target batches, achieving a mean energy of 71.5±48.3\,J, an end-effector position error of 2.64±1.04\,cm, and an orientation error of 6.92±1.33∘ -- within the \SI{4}{\centi\metre}/8.6∘ training tolerance. These results constitute a first step toward energy-aware reinforcement-learning-based arm reaching for humanoid robots.
ReactiveBFM: Reactive Closed-Loop Motion Planning Towards Universal Humanoid Whole-Body Control
ReactiveBFM：面向通用人形机器人全身控制的反应式闭环运动规划
尽管现有的行为基础模型（BFMs）为人形机器人提供了稳健的控制先验，但它们通常仅限于执行预定义的参考动作，因此难以应对环境变化，也无法实现反应式的全身协调。若简单地将这些模型与生成式运动规划器级联，则无法实现真正​​的反应能力，因为不可避免的跟踪偏差会导致致命的累积“暴露偏差”（exposure bias）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ReactiveBFM，这是一个实时闭环规划与控制框架。该框架的核心在于通过一种“预设前缀采样课程”（scheduled prefix sampling curriculum）有效缓解暴露偏差，迫使生成式规划器学习如何从不完美的物理状态（而非理想的真值轨迹）中恢复并纠正错误。在系统层面，为了协调自回归规划与高频跟踪之间巨大的延迟差异，我们引入了异步重规划机制。结合轨迹分段（trajectory chunking）技术对空间参考进行时间上的集成，该系统确保了动作执行在时空上的流畅性，且无物理抖动。ReactiveBFM 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了部署，在多种文本驱动的闭环动作任务中展现出了前所未有的物理灵活性。值得一提的是，ReactiveBFM 实现了针对移动目标的零样本（zero-shot）触达，充分展示了其精细的全身协调能力与实时重规划能力。在强扰动环境下的仿真基准测试中，ReactiveBFM 取得了 93.1% 的成功率，较级联式开环基线方案高出 28.6%。
While current Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) provide robust control priors for humanoids, they only execute pre-defined reference motions. As a result, they are vulnerable to environmental shifts and incapable of reactive whole-body coordination. Naively cascading them with generative motion planners fails to achieve true reactivity, as inevitable tracking discrepancies induce fatal cumulative exposure bias. To bridge this gap, we propose ReactiveBFM, a real-time closed-loop planning-control framework. At its core, we effectively mitigate exposure bias via a scheduled prefix sampling curriculum, forcing the generative planner to actively learn error-recovery behaviors from imperfect physical states rather than ground-truth trajectories. Systematically, to reconcile the severe latency mismatch between auto-regressive planning and high-frequency tracking, we introduce an asynchronous replanning mechanism. Combined with trajectory chunking to temporally ensemble spatial references, our system guarantees spatio-temporally fluid execution without physical jitter. Deployed on the Unitree G1 humanoid, ReactiveBFM demonstrates unprecedented physical agility across a vast repertoire of text-conditioned closed-loop motions. Notably, ReactiveBFM achieves zero-shot moving target reaching, showcasing intricate whole-body coordination and on-the-fly replanning. In sim-to-sim benchmarking under severe perturbations, ReactiveBFM achieves a 93.1% success rate, significantly outperforming cascaded open-loop baselines by 28.6%.
MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
MotionWAM：迈向用于实时人形机器人移动与操作的基础世界动作模型
世界动作模型（WAMs）将视频动力学先验与策略相结合，在桌面级操作任务中展现出了令人鼓舞的成果；然而，针对高维视频-动作潜在空间进行的迭代去噪过程计算开销巨大，导致其难以满足人形机器人实时移动-操作（loco-manipulation）的需求。这一问题因主流的分层控制范式而变得更加复杂：在该范式下，高层操作策略仅控制上半身，而底层控制器负责跟踪粗略的基座指令，这种做法导致上下半身处于不一致的动作空间，并将腿部功能局限于维持平衡的移动。为此，我们提出了 MotionWAM，这是一种能够利用单目第一人称视角（egocentric）摄像头驱动人形机器人自主进行移动-操作的实时 WAM。MotionWAM 摒弃了上下半身分离的控制方式，转而采用统一的运动潜在表示，并预测涵盖移动、躯干运动、高度调节、足部交互及手部操作的全身运动 Token，从而在单一动作空间内实现协​​同控制。我们设计了一个三阶段学习框架，使视频世界模型能够逐步适应第一人称视觉动力学特性及目标人形机器人的物理形态。在针对 Unitree G1 机器人的九项真实世界任务测试中，MotionWAM 实现了实时运行；其整体成功率较基于相同演示数据微调的“视觉-语言-动作”（VLA）基线模型高出 30% 以上，并能执行上下半身解耦策略所无法实现的、任务导向的足部交互动作。实验结果表明，经视频预训练的 WAM 能够从桌面级操作任务扩展至协同、类人的全身人形机器人控制。
World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.
Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
面向仿人机器人物理可执行全身控制的仿生人体运动风格迁移
对于在人类环境中作业的仿人机器人而言，富有表现力的全身运动至关重要；机器人既需保持运动稳定，又要呈现出易于理解且可调节的肢体行为。然而，现有的表现力运动大多源自固定的演示或人工设计的脚本，难以将演示的风格复用到不同的运动内容上。受人类通过步态节奏、姿态、摆臂及身体摇摆来传达情感与意图这一机制的启发，本文提出了一种面向仿人机器人的、基于范例驱动风格迁移的仿生“生成-控制”框架。给定一段简短的人类风格范例和目标内容运动，该框架能够生成兼具目标运动内容与演示风格特征的全身参考轨迹。文中构建了一种融合风格、内容及轨迹条件的物理感知多条件潜在扩散模型（Physics-aware Multi-condition Latent Diffusion Model），并利用无分类器引导（Classifier-free Guidance）技术，在无需重新训练的情况下调节风格强度。为提升硬件执行的可行性，模型在训练过程中对解码生成的运动施加了接触一致性与时间平滑性约束。生成的参考轨迹随后被转化为适配 Unitree G1 机器人的指令，并由基于预瞄（preview-based）的全身跟踪策略执行——该策略采用“聚类与蒸馏”（cluster-and-distill）策略进行训练。仿真及 Unitree G1 实机实验表明，该方法能将简短的人类风格范例迁移至多种机器人运动内容中；与面向动画制作的风格迁移基准方法相比，该方法显著减少了接触异常和抖动伪影，并在 125 次实机测试中取得了 96.0% 的成功率。实验结果验证了利用简短人类运动范例作为可复用仿生源，生成物理可执行且富有表现力的仿人机器人运动的可行性。
Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.
Humanoid-OmniOcc: Stereo-Based Full-View Occupancy Dataset for Embodied AI
Humanoid-OmniOcc：面向具身智能的基于双目视觉的全景占用数据集
在体素级粒度上进行占用（occupancy）预测，对于机器人复​​杂环境下的安全导航与交互至关重要。然而，现有的占用数据集主要针对自动驾驶设计，带有以车辆为中心的偏差（如前向摄像头、远场几何信息和静态道路先验），这限制了其在具身人形机器人感知任务中的适用性。我们推出了 Humanoid-OmniOcc，这是一个专为人形机器人设计的大规模全景立体视觉占用数据集。该数据集涵盖了 15 种多样化的模拟室内场景和 5 种真实世界环境，包含超过 15.5 万个样本，展现出丰富的场景与风格多样性。值得注意的是，该数据集基于“Real2Sim2Real”（真实-模拟-真实）闭环范式构建：利用真实传感器的规格参数驱动物理精确的模拟，通过模拟生成大规模标注训练数据，并将模拟训练的模型直接在真实场景数据上进行评估，从而实现“模拟到真实”（sim-to-real）流程的迭代优化。此外，我们提出了一种名为 Humanoid-OmniOcc（人形机器人环视立体视觉引导的占用预测模型）的方法，该方法利用鲁棒的深度先验信息实现精确的 2D 到 3D 空间提升（lifting）。大量实验表明，Humanoid-OmniOcc 在性能上始终优于单目视觉基线模型，并能良好地泛化至未见过的模拟测试场景及真实世界环境，从而验证了 Real2Sim2Real 设计的有效性。
Occupancy prediction at voxel-level granularity is essential for safe robotic navigation and interaction in complex environments. Existing occupancy datasets, however, are predominantly designed for autonomous driving with vehicle-centric biases -- forward-facing cameras, far-field geometry, and static road priors -- limiting their applicability to embodied humanoid perception. We present Humanoid-OmniOcc, a large-scale panoramic stereo-based occupancy dataset tailored for humanoid robots. The dataset encompasses 15 diverse simulated indoor scenes and 5 real-world environments, yielding over 155K samples with broad scene and style diversity. Importantly, the dataset is designed around a Real2Sim2Real closed-loop paradigm: real sensor specifications drive physically accurate simulation, simulation produces large-scale annotated training data, and models trained in simulation are directly evaluated on real-world captures -- enabling iterative refinement of the sim-to-real pipeline. We further propose \textbf{H}umanoid \textbf{S}urround \textbf{S}tereo-guided \textbf{Occ}upancy model (Humanoid-OmniOcc) that exploits robust depth priors for accurate 2D-to-3D lifting. Extensive experiments show that Humanoid-OmniOcc consistently outperforms monocular baselines and generalizes well to both unseen simulated test scenes and real-world environments, validating the effectiveness of the Real2Sim2Real design.
ADAPT: Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training for Humanoid Locomotion
ADAPT：面向人形机器人运动的、感知扰动的分析型策略训练
部署在以人为中心环境中的人形机器人必须应对涉及力交互的任务，在此类任务中，外部接触会引入意外干扰，从而影响运动的精确度与稳定性。现有的基于学习的方法通常依赖于广泛的域随机化、特定任务的力目标设定，或是基于运动历史的学习型力估计器；然而，这些方法往往会在精确度、任务迁移能力或分布外（OOD）鲁棒性方面做出妥协。为此，我们提出了“解析式干扰感知策略训练”（ADAPT）框架，该框架为人形机器人策略配备了基于物理原理的干扰观测器。ADAPT 的核心是一个解析式全身干扰观测器，它利用已知的机器人动力学模型在线估计残余力和力矩，而无需依赖力/力矩传感器。估计出的干扰信息被直接输入策略网络，赋予了人形机器人一种基于物理原理的、明确的外部力和力矩感知能力，使其能够泛化适应各种未见过的场景。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的实验表明，面对躯干扰动、站立状态下的推力以及非对称手部负载等情况时，ADAPT 均能实现精确的干扰预测，并展现出比仅依赖本体感知（proprioception-only）的基准方法更强的鲁棒性；即便在面对分布外（OOD）干扰时，其速度跟踪性能也得到了提升。此外，ADAPT 还支持对下肢关节处推断出的干扰进行惩罚，从而促成更轻盈的运动方式。
Humanoids deployed in human-centered environments must handle force-interactive tasks, where external contacts introduce unexpected disturbances that disrupt locomotion accuracy and stability. Existing learning-based approaches rely on broad domain randomization, task-specific force objectives, or learning-based force estimators from motion history, each of which compromises accuracy, task transferability, or out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. We present Analytical Disturbance-Aware Policy Training (ADAPT), a framework that equips humanoid policies with a physically grounded disturbance observer. The core of ADAPT is an analytical whole-body disturbance observer that estimates residual force/torque online with the accessible robot dynamics, without requiring force/torque sensors. Fed directly into the policy, the estimated disturbances give the humanoid an explicit, physics-derived sense of external force/torque that can generalize across diverse unseen scenes. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid show that ADAPT achieves accurate disturbance prediction and stronger robustness than a proprioception-only baseline under torso perturbations, standing pushes, and asymmetric hand payloads, with improved velocity tracking even on OOD disturbances. Moreover, ADAPT enables penalizing inferred disturbances at lower-body joints to encourage lighter locomotion.
GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
GRAIL：基于3D资产与视频先验生成人形机器人移动与操作能力
要实现人形机器人“移动-操作”（loco-manipulation）能力的规模化，需要涵盖多样化物体、全身动作及场景几何结构的机器人适用演示数据；然而，传统的遥操作和动作捕捉方法难以扩展，因为数据采集过程高度依赖物理环境搭建、穿戴传感设备的演员以及机器人操作。我们提出了 GRAIL，这是一个在部署前完全处于虚拟环境中的数字生成管线：它整合了 3D 资产、适配模拟器的场景以及来自视频基础模型（VFM）的先验信息，从而合成交互数据，无需重建物理环境或进行机器人遥操作。GRAIL 并非试图重建不受约束的“野外”视频，而是基于完全确定的 3D 配置——即在视频生成前已知物体几何形状、相机参数、度量尺度、环境深度及符合机器人比例的角色模型，并在重建过程中复用这些信息。这种包含特权信息的设置优化了 4D 重建过程，使得基于模型的物体追踪、人体动作估计及交互感知优化能够重建具有真实度量尺度的 4D 人-物交互（HOI）轨迹，同时降低了深度歧义和形态不匹配问题。我们将重建的动作重定向至人形机器人，并训练了互补的通用任务追踪器：用于操作任务的物体感知潜在适配器（latent adaptor）以及用于地形穿越的场景感知追踪器。GRAIL 生成了超过 20,000 个动作序列，涵盖了拾取、物体操作、坐下及地形穿越等多种行为。仅利用 GRAIL 生成的数据，我们通过“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）管线训练了以自我为中心（egocentric）的视觉策略，并将其部署在宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人上，实现了多样化物体拾取任务 84% 和楼梯攀爬任务 90% 的现实世界成功率。
Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.
LEGS: Fine-Tuning Teleop-Free VLAs for Humanoid Loco-manipulation in an Embodied Gaussian Splatting World
LEGS：在具身 Gaussian Splatting 环境中微调无需遥操作的 VLA，以实现人形机器人的移动与操作协同
针对人形机器人“移动-操作”（loco-manipulation）任务训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略时，往往受限于人类遥操作演示数据采集的高昂成本与复杂性。此前，在仿真器中微调的 VLA 策略难以有效地迁移到人形机器人的移动-操作任务中。为此，我们提出了 LEGS（Loco-manipulation via Embodied Gaussian Splatting，即基于具身 3D 高斯溅射的移动-操作），这是一种混合仿真方案：它将网格（mesh）形式的前景（包含机器人、物体及道具）与基于手持设备场景采集重建的、具有照片级真实感的 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）背景进行合成。LEGS 利用程序化运动基元生成器，无需人类遥操作即可大规模合成带有标签的演示数据；同时，它采用确定性的两阶段色彩校准方法，将渲染出的 3DGS 图像与机器人实际部署时的相机视角进行对齐。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，针对三项全身协调难度递增的“抓取-放置”任务以及三种 VLA 骨干网络（psi_0、pi_0.5、GR00T N1.6）进行的实验表明，仅使用 LEGS 数据训练出的策略，其表现与使用人类遥操作演示训练出的策略相当甚至更优。此外，LEGS 的表现也优于剔除了 3DGS 背景影响的纯网格仿真基线，这证明了照片级真实感渲染是实现合成数据迁移的关键因素。在 LEGS 中，人形机器人的运动与场景外观是独立记录的，这意味着同一组自动生成的演示数据可以在新的背景和物体网格下重新渲染——从而以低于遥操作 15 倍以上的成本覆盖新场景——进而增强策略对场景变化的鲁棒性。在物体与场景外观同时发生变化的情况下，使用重新渲染的 LEGS-AUG 数据训练出的策略仍能保持任务成功，而使用遥操作数据训练的基线策略则完全失效。
Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies for humanoid loco-manipulation is constrained by the high cost and complexity of collecting human teleoperation demonstrations. VLA policies fine-tuned in simulators have, until now, failed to transfer effectively in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. We present LEGS (Loco-manipulation via Embodied Gaussian Splatting), a hybrid simulator that composites a mesh foreground (robot, objects, props) over a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) background reconstructed from a handheld scene capture. LEGS uses a procedural motion-primitive generator to synthesize labeled demonstrations at scale without human teleoperation, and a deterministic two-stage color calibration to align the rendered 3DGS image to the robot's deployment camera. On a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, across three pick-and-place tasks of increasing whole-body difficulty and three VLA backbones (psi_0, pi_0.5, GR00T N1.6), a policy trained purely on LEGS data matches or exceeds one trained on human teleoperation demos on every experiment. It also outperforms a mesh-only simulation baseline that ablates the effect of the 3DGS background, showing that photorealistic rendering is a key enabler for synthetic data transfer. Humanoid motion is recorded independently of scene appearance in LEGS, allowing the same auto-generated demonstrations to be re-rendered under new backgrounds and object meshes--covering a new scene at more than 15x lower cost than teleoperation--to augment training data for robustness to scene variations. Under combined object-and-scene appearance shift, the policy trained on re-rendered LEGS-AUG data maintains task success while the baseline trained on teleoperation data fails entirely.
VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
VLK：基于重建场景中合成交互学习人形机器人的移动与操作能力
基于感知的类人机器人移动与操作（loco-manipulation）任务，需要将以自我为中心的观测信息及任务指令转化为全身运动。实现这种映射需要同步的自我中心视角图像、语言指令以及适用于机器人的运动学轨迹，然而目前尚无现成的数据源能大规模提供此类完整的数据元组。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出在重建场景中合成视觉-语言-运动学（VLK）监督信号的方法。我们的流程利用3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）技术重建具有真实尺度信息的室内环境，借助场景的特权信息（privileged information）合成导航及物体交互轨迹，并随后渲染出成对的自我中心视角观测数据。我们在无需人工干预的情况下生成了48,000条轨迹数据，并训练了一个VLK策略模型，用于预测短时程的全身运动学轨迹；随后，全身追踪器将这些预测结果转化为实体类人机器人的具体动作。我们在Unitree G1实体机器人上进行了导航与单物体搬运任务的评估，结果表明，在重建场景中合成的交互数据能为基于感知的类人机器人移动与操作任务提供有效的监督，从而支持从仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移。
Perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation requires connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion. Learning this mapping requires synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories, yet no existing data source provides this complete tuple at scale. We address this bottleneck by generating vision-language-kinematics (VLK) supervision synthetically in reconstructed scenes. Our pipeline leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct metric-scale indoor environments, synthesizes navigation and object-interaction trajectories using privileged scene information, and renders paired egocentric observations after the fact. We produce 48,000 paired trajectories with no human intervention and train a VLK policy that predicts short-horizon whole-body kinematic trajectories. A whole-body tracker converts these predictions into actions on the physical humanoid. We evaluate on the physical Unitree G1 performing navigation and single-object transport, demonstrating that synthesized interactions in reconstructed scenes provide effective supervision for sim-to-real perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation.
TEXEDO : Test Time Scaling for Controller-aware Language-conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
TEXEDO：面向控制器感知且基于语言条件的人形机器人动作生成的推理时缩放方法
基于文本的动作生成已成为编程人形机器人的一种极具前景的交互方式，但现有的生成模型通常是在经过重定向以适配机器人形态的人类动作数据集上进行训练的。尽管此类数据提供了丰富的语义和运动学先验信息，却无法捕捉全身追踪控制器在平衡、接触、驱动限制及特定失效模式等方面的细微特性。因此，生成的动作虽然在语义上看似合理，但机器人往往难以甚至无法实际执行。为此，我们提出了 TEXEDO——一种用于人形机器人动作生成的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）框架，旨在无需增强底层生成模型的前提下提升动作质量。给定一段文本提示，该方法会从预训练的文本条件生成模型中采样多个动作，并从中筛选出既可执行又与任务高度契合的最佳动作。其奖励模型结合了两个验证模块：一是通过全身追踪仿真过程蒸馏得到的动态可行性验证器，用于预测动作的物理可执行性；二是语义对齐验证器，用于在学习到的联合嵌入空间内衡量文本与动作的匹配程度。我们的流程将动态可行性视为硬性约束，而在满足该约束的动作集合内，将语义对齐度作为筛选目标。通过大规模仿真实验及在 Unitree G1 机器人上的实机部署，我们证明了该测试时扩展策略能持续提升追踪保真度与文本对齐效果，这表明基于物理实际的验证机制是实现可部署的语言引导人形机器人动作生成的有效途径。
Text-conditioned motion generation has become a promising interface for programming humanoid robots, but current generators are often trained on human motion datasets retargeted to robot morphology. While such data provides rich semantic and kinematic priors, it does not capture the nuances of the whole-body tracking controller, including balance, contact, actuation limits, and controller-specific failure modes. Therefore, generated motions can be semantically plausible yet difficult or impossible for the robot to execute. We propose TEXEDO, a test-time scaling framework for humanoid motion generation that improves motion quality without requiring a stronger underlying generator. Given a text prompt, our method samples multiple motions from the pre-trained text-conditioned generator and selects the best executable and task-aligned motion. The reward model combines a dynamic feasibility verifier, distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts to predict physical executability, with a semantic alignment verifier that measures text-motion alignment in a learned co-embedding space. Our pipeline treats dynamic feasibility as a hard constraint and semantic alignment as the selection objective within the feasible set. Across large-scale simulation studies and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1, we show that our test-time scaling strategy consistently improves both tracking fidelity and text alignment, demonstrating that grounded verification is an effective path toward deployable language-guided humanoid motion generation.
MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
MARCH：面向稀疏落脚点的人形机器人感知控制之模型辅助强化学习
在稀疏地形上实现具备感知能力的双足运动仍是一项艰巨挑战：基于模型的方法虽精确但对不确定性较为敏感（鲁棒性差），而无模型方法虽鲁棒，却难以习得安全攸关场景下所需的精确且受限的运动模式——在这些场景中，微小的误差即可能导致灾难性故障。为此，我们提出了一种模型辅助强化学习（RL）框架，通过三个步骤融合了上述两种方法的优势：(1) 利用简化模型生成安全参考轨迹；(2) 训练一个“特权教师策略”（privileged teacher policy），该策略由围绕安全参考轨迹构建的控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励信号进行引导；(3) 将教师策略蒸馏为基于视觉的“学生策略”。实验表明，这种模型辅助流程能生成符合物理规律的运动，不仅提高了样本效率并降低了对复杂学习课程设计的依赖，还实现了更平滑的运动行为，同时在稀疏落脚点（stepping stone）导航任务中展现出与无模型基准方法相当的性能。我们在仿真环境中验证了该方法，并成功将其部署于 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，实现了在受侧向约束的稀疏落脚点环境中的导航。
Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.
CG-MuTra: Continuously-Gated Multi-Terrain Adaptive Recovery for Unified Humanoid Fall Recovery and Locomotion
CG-MuTra：用于统一类人机器人跌倒恢复与运动的连续门控多地形自适应恢复方法
在非结构化环境中运行的人形机器人面临着跌倒的固有风险。现有的利用专家运动先验的强化学习方法，主要基于平地跌倒恢复任务进行训练，且通常依赖于恢复控制器与运动控制器之间的硬切换。因此，当部署在斜坡和碎石路面等复杂地形时，这些策略难以实现平滑且鲁棒的恢复行为。本文提出了 **CG-MuTra**，这是一个用于多地形自适应跌倒恢复的统一连续门控多尺度判别器框架。CG-MuTra 引入了一个基于本体感知推导出的连续门控机制 $\alpha=f(z_{root},s)$，该机制能够平滑融合三个在不同时间尺度上运行的判别器：帧级稳定性（$\Phi_{frame}$, $H=1$）、时间平滑性（$\Phi_{seq}$, $H=5$）以及步态周期性（$\Phi_{gait}$, $H=10$）。这种设计实现了从恢复到运动状态的无缝过渡，无需显式的模式切换。此外，我们提出了一种地形-姿态风险耦合采样器（TPRCS），在训练过程中将危险的初始边缘姿态与地形动力学显式耦合，从而与地形特权塑形项 $\Xi_\kappa$ 形成闭环协同效应。我们在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，针对草地、斜坡（10°–15°）和碎石路面等多种地形，在仿真和实机环境中对 CG-MuTra 进行了验证。实验结果表明，CG-MuTra 能够在多种地形上实现平滑且高度鲁棒的跌倒恢复与运动过渡，同时保持单一的可部署策略。
Falling is an inherent risk for humanoid robots operating in unstructured environments. Existing reinforcement learning methods that leverage expert motion priors are predominantly trained on flat-ground fall-recovery tasks and typically rely on hard switching between separate recovery and locomotion controllers. As a result, such policies struggle to achieve smooth and robust recovery behaviors when deployed on complex terrains such as slopes and gravel. This paper presents \textbf{CG-MuTra}, a unified continuously-gated multi-scale discriminator framework for multi-terrain adaptive fall recovery. CG-MuTra introduces a proprioceptively-derived continuous gate α=f(zroot,s) that softly blends three discriminators operating at different temporal horizons: frame-level stability (Φframe, H=1), temporal smoothness (Φseq, H=5), and gait periodicity (Φgait, H=10). This design enables seamless recovery-to-locomotion transitions without explicit mode switching. Furthermore, we propose a Terrain-Pose Risk Coupling Sampler (TPRCS) that explicitly couples dangerous edge initial poses with terrain dynamics during training, forming a closed-loop synergy with the terrain-privileged shaping term Ξκ. We validate CG-MuTra on a Unitree G1 humanoid across grass, slopes (10∘--15∘), and gravel in both simulation and hardware. Experimental results demonstrate that CG-MuTra achieves smooth, highly robust fall recovery and locomotion transitions across multiple terrains while maintaining a single deployable policy.
Predictive Style Matching: Natural and Robust Humanoid Locomotion
预测式风格匹配：自然且鲁棒的人形机器人运动
强化学习已成为人形机器人运动控制的主流方法：策略能够可靠地从仿真环境迁移到硬件，并能从干扰中优雅地恢复。
然而，运动质量仍然滞后：仅基于任务的奖励机制往往会导致僵硬、不对称的步态，而运动模仿方法虽然能够改善外观，但由于参考信号可能与恢复平衡所需的瞬态姿态相冲突，因此对外部干扰更加敏感。
我们提出了一种预测风格匹配方法，其中离线预测器将机器人的下半身状态历史和速度指令映射到可解释的上半身关节和步态目标，这些目标在训练过程中塑造奖励。
由于目标是基于状态而非时间索引的，并且预测器仅在训练时使用，因此部署的控制器继承了仅基于任务的强化学习基线的本体感受接口和推理成本。
在 Unitree G1 上，无论是在仿真还是硬件中，PSM 都能将上半身风格误差降低大约一个数量级，相比之下，仅任务强化学习 (RL) 还能保持其跌倒恢复率；而运动模仿基线虽然能达到最低的风格误差，但却无法从干扰中恢复，其恢复频率大约是 PSM 的五倍。
Reinforcement learning has become the prevailing approach to humanoid locomotion control: policies transfer reliably from simulation to hardware and recover gracefully from disturbances.
Motion quality, however, still lags behind: task-only rewards often converge to stiff, asymmetric gaits, while motion imitation methods improve appearance but become more sensitive to external disturbances because reference signals can oppose the transient poses needed to regain balance.
We propose Predictive Style Matching, in which an offline predictor maps the robot's lower-body state history and velocity commands to interpretable upper-body joint and gait targets that shape the rewards during training.
Because the targets are state-conditioned rather than time-indexed and the predictor is used only at training time, the deployed controller inherits the proprioceptive interface and inference cost of a task-only RL baseline.
On the Unitree G1, in both simulation and hardware, PSM reduces upper-body style error by roughly an order of magnitude over task-only RL while preserving its fall-recovery rate, whereas the motion-imitation baseline attains the lowest style error but fails to recover from disturbances about five times as often.
RoboNaldo: Accurate, Stable and Powerful Humanoid Soccer Shooting via Motion-Guided Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
RoboNaldo：基于运动引导课程强化学习的精准、稳定且强力的人形机器人足球射门
