人类到人形机器人的模仿学习（Human-to-humanoid imitation learning）利用丰富的大规模人类运动数据集，为解决机器人领域严重的数据稀缺瓶颈提供了一条前景广阔的途径。然而，扩展这一范式需要解决两大关键挑战。
第一，从视频、动作捕捉系统或生成模型中获取的人类运动数据通常包含空间噪声、抖动和帧级闪烁，这些发散特征在动作重定向（Retargeting）过程中会被放大，导致不安全或物理上不可行的机器人运动。第二，现有的运动重定向方法通常依赖于逐帧数值优化（Frame-by-frame numerical optimization），计算复杂度过高，难以用于大规模数据集的合成。
为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了隐式运动动力学重定向（Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting, IKMR）——一套具备极高可扩展性的基于神经网络的数据转换流水线。IKMR 利用基于骨骼图卷积的双自编码器（Graph convolutional dual autoencoder），将跨结构的人类与人形机器人运动学构型映射到一个共享拓扑隐空间（Shared topological latent space）中。为了确保生成数据的物理可行性，该框架结合了物理感知的精炼阶段（Physics-informed refinement phase），利用仿真物理跟踪反馈来学习鲁棒的运动先验（Motion prior）。
这一隐式公式化方法从根本上解决了上述两项挑战。通过将计算负担从在线优化转移到离线推理，IKMR 取得了超过每秒 5000 帧的前所未有的数据转换吞吐量。此外，利用学到的运动先验，该框架可作为一种内嵌的数据筛选机制，自然地滤除源数据中的高频噪声和空间抖动，从而生成确保物理硬件安全的平滑轨迹。
包括在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的真实世界全身控制（Whole-body control）部署在内的大量评估证实，IKMR 成功弥合了无约束人类运动数据集与机器人物理数据之间的断层。
Human-to-humanoid imitation learning presents a promising pathway to address the severe data scarcity bottleneck in robotics by utilizing abundant, large-scale human motion collections. However, scaling this paradigm requires addressing two key challenges. First, human motion data acquired from videos, motion capture systems, or generative models often contains spatial noise, jitter, and frame-level flickering, which can be amplified during retargeting and lead to unsafe or physically infeasible robot motions. Second, existing motion retargeting methods typically rely on frame-by-frame numerical optimization, making them too computationally expensive for large-scale dataset synthesis. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting (IKMR), a highly scalable, neural-based data transformation pipeline. IKMR leverages a skeleton-based graph convolutional dual autoencoder to map cross-structural human and humanoid kinematic configurations into a shared topological latent space. To guarantee the physical viability of the generated data, the framework incorporates a physics-informed refinement phase that utilizes simulated physical tracking feedback to learn a robust motion prior. This implicit formulation fundamentally resolves both challenges. By shifting the computational burden from online optimization to offline inference, IKMR achieves an unprecedented data conversion throughput exceeding 5000 frames per second. Furthermore, leveraging the learned motion prior, it functions as an intrinsic data curation mechanism and naturally filters out high-frequency noise and spatial jitters from source data, yielding smooth trajectories that ensure physical hardware safety. Extensive evaluations, including real-world whole-body control deployments on humanoid robot Unitree G1, confirm that IKMR successfully bridges the gap between unconstrained human motion dataset and robotic data.
GenTrack: Physical Alignment for Robot-Native Motion Generation and Zero-Shot Humanoid Tracking
GenTrack：面向机器人原生运动生成与零样本人形机器人追踪的物理对齐方法
通用人形机器人跟踪器（Humanoid trackers）能够执行多样化的参考运动，但它们的零样本（Zero-shot）覆盖范围依赖于扩充成本高昂的大规模具身数据集。文本生成运动（Text-to-motion）生成器提供了可扩展的监督信号，然而在人类运动或重定向数据上训练的模型继承了运动学可行性与机器人物理可执行性之间的断层。现有单向流水线通常要么固定生成的语料库，要么固定奖励跟踪器。
我们提出了 GenTrack——一套在线“生成器-跟踪器”（Generator--tracker）协同框架，该框架将基于执行接地的群体相对生成器对齐（Execution-grounded, group-relative generator alignment）与在新生成参考运动上的跟踪器训练交替进行；同时通过锚定（Anchoring）与复习（Rehearsal）机制抑制漂移。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，我们在 ProtoMotions 和 SONIC 骨干网络下对 GenTrack 进行评估，测试涵盖三个零样本跟踪分割集（包括公开的 AMASS 和 LAFAN 基准，以及包含 1,024 个野外提示词-运动对的私有分布外测试集）。
这种在线共同训练（Co-training）策略持续地使生成器产出具有强语义对齐且更具备机器人物理可执行性的运动，同时也赋予了跟踪器显著更广的零样本覆盖范围和更高的跟踪精度（特别是在分布外参考运动上）。这些结果表明，联合在线后训练（Joint online post-training）有效地缩小了重定向参考运动与机器人原生运动之间的可执行性差距，在无需额外收集数据且打破静态参考池限制的前提下推动了零样本人形机器人控制的发展。
General-purpose humanoid trackers can execute diverse references, but their zero-shot coverage depends on large embodied corpora that are costly to extend. Text-to-motion generators offer scalable supervision, yet models trained on human motion or retargeted data inherit a gap between kinematic plausibility and robot executability. Existing one-way pipelines fix either the generated corpus or the reward tracker. We introduce GenTrack, an online generator--tracker framework that alternates execution-grounded, group-relative generator alignment with tracker training on newly generated references; anchoring and rehearsal constrain drift. On Unitree G1, we evaluate GenTrack with ProtoMotions and SONIC backbones across three zero-shot tracking splits including public AMASS and LAFAN benchmarks, and a private out-of-distribution test set of 1,024 prompt-motion pairs in the wild. The online co-training strategy consistently produces generators that output more robot-executable motions with strong semantic alignment, and trackers with markedly broader zero-shot coverage and improved tracking accuracy, especially on out-of-distribution references. These results demonstrate that joint online post-training effectively narrows the executability gap between retargeted references and robot-native motion, advancing zero-shot humanoid control without additional data collection and beyond the limitations of a static reference pool.
StableMimic: Smooth Human-Like Recovery for Humanoid Motion Tracking - Learning Beyond the Tracking Distribution for Structured Post-Fall Behavior
StableMimic：人形机器人运动追踪中平滑且拟人的恢复动作——针对结构化跌倒后行为的学习（超越追踪分布）
人形机器人运动跟踪器（Humanoid motion trackers）在已学习的跟踪分布内表现可靠，但跌落会将机器人置于低高度、多接触的复杂状态（Contact-rich states），此时前向推进指令暂时不可达。仅依赖跟踪的策略可能会盲目追逐不可行的参考轨迹，从而产生快速、大幅度的肢体修正，增加机器人及其周边环境受损的风险。
我们提出了 StableMimic——一套在标称跟踪分布（Nominal tracking distribution）之外训练的统一跟踪器。通过在多个人类起立参考运动周围进行扰动重置（Perturbed resets），暴露俯卧、仰卧、失衡及中间地面接触状态，从而塑造出能将机器人带回可跟踪区域的结构化恢复动作。
由于跟踪与恢复占据了显著不同的状态-动作分布，StableMimic 采用了针对各自范畴的专用专家模块（Dedicated experts），并配备了一个本体感觉门控网络（Proprioceptive gate）来持续融合它们的动作。一个隐式的后继状态目标（Hidden successor-state objective）在不向部署的 Actor 暴露参考标识或相位的前提下，教授由人类参考动作塑造的恢复行为；其实机部署无需起立参考运动、恢复指令、轨迹检索或外部策略切换。
在完整的重定向 LAFAN1 舞蹈子集上，StableMimic 在 5 种对比方法中取得了所有 4 项跟踪指标的最低误差。在每种方法 100 次匹配的推倒跌落测试中，它实现了 100/100 的恢复成功率，并在 7 项跌落后运动与载荷测量指标中的 6 项上达到了最低值，在该协议下展现出更高的交互安全性。在真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的舞蹈与站立参考部署定性地证明了其具备有界的肢体运动、自主恢复以及指令恢复执行能力。
Humanoid motion trackers perform reliably within learned tracking distributions, but falls can move the robot into low-height, contact-rich states from which an advancing command is temporarily unreachable. Tracking-only policies may chase infeasible references, producing rapid, large-amplitude limb corrections that increase risk to the robot and its surroundings. We present StableMimic, a unified tracker trained beyond the nominal tracking distribution. Perturbed resets around multiple human get-up references expose prone, supine, off-balance, and intermediate ground-contact states, shaping structured recovery that returns the robot to the trackable region. Because tracking and recovery occupy markedly different state--action distributions, StableMimic uses dedicated experts for each regime and a proprioceptive gate that continuously blends their actions. A hidden successor-state objective teaches human-reference-shaped recovery without exposing reference identity or phase to the deployed Actor; deployment requires no get-up reference, recovery command, trajectory retrieval, or external policy switch. On the complete retargeted LAFAN1 dance subset, StableMimic achieves the lowest errors on all four tracking metrics among five methods. Across 100 matched push-to-fall trials per method, it recovers in 100/100 and attains the lowest values on six of seven post-fall motion and load measures, supporting improved interaction safety under this protocol. Real Unitree G1 dance and standing-reference deployments qualitatively demonstrate bounded limb motion, autonomous recovery, and command resumption.
RoboStriker: Latent-Space Strategic Games for Autonomous Humanoid Boxing
RoboStriker：面向自主类人拳击的潜在空间策略博弈
在人形机器人上实现媲美人类水平的竞技智能与物理敏捷性依然是一项巨大的挑战，特别是在像拳击这样高动态且包含密集接触（Contact-rich）的任务中。虽然多智能体强化学习（MARL）为博弈策略交互提供了一个规范的框架，但将其直接应用于无结构的原始电机动作空间（Raw motor spaces）不可避免地会导致关节层面的物理崩溃，从而阻碍任何可行对战战术的涌现。
为了解决策略探索与物理可行性之间的这一根本冲突，我们将人形机器人对战任务构建为一个全新的双人隐空间零和马尔可夫博弈（Two-player latent-space zero-sum Markov game）。在标准正则性与近似最佳应对假设下，我们证明了该隐空间公式化方法在解码器可达的动作流形上诱导出了一个等价博弈，为生成的自博弈动态（Self-play dynamics）提供了近似纳什均衡（Approximate-Nash）的解释。
为了实例化这一理论构想，我们提出了 RoboStriker——一套将高层决策推理与低层动作执行解耦的分层框架。该框架首先将预定义拳击动作的跟踪专业知识蒸馏到一个拓扑有界的隐流形（Topologically bounded latent manifold）中。随后，这一结构化的隐空间基础通过隐空间神经虚构自博弈（Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play）驱动多智能体的协同演化。
大量的实验结果表明，在这一结构化的隐空间内进行博弈显著优于直接的原始空间探索。通过借助预训练动作解码器来约束策略探索，RoboStriker 大幅减少了原始动作空间方法中常见的灾难性平衡失效，并在胜率与击打效率等战术表现上取得了优异的成绩。最后，我们在真实世界的人形机器人上成功部署并验证了所学到的对战策略。
Achieving human-level competitive intelligence and physical agility in humanoid robots remains a profound challenge, particularly in contact-rich and highly dynamic tasks such as boxing. While Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning offers a principled framework for strategic interaction, its direct application to unstructured raw motor spaces inevitably leads to joint-level physical collapse, preventing the emergence of any viable combat tactics. To resolve this fundamental conflict between strategic exploration and physical feasibility, we formulate the humanoid combat task as a novel two-player latent-space zero-sum Markov game. Under standard regularity and approximate best-response assumptions, we show that the latent formulation induces an equivalent game over the decoder-reachable action manifold, providing an approximate-Nash interpretation of the resulting self-play dynamics. To instantiate this theoretical formulation, we propose RoboStriker, a hierarchical framework that decouples high-level reasoning from low-level execution. It first distills the tracking expertise of predefined boxing motions into a topologically bounded latent manifold. This structured latent foundation subsequently drives multi-agent co-evolution via Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that gaming within this structured latent space substantially outperforms direct exploration. By constraining strategic exploration through a pretrained motion decoder, RoboStriker substantially reduces the catastrophic balance failures observed in raw action-space methods and achieves superior tactical performance in both competitive win rates and striking efficiency. Finally, we successfully deploy and validate our learned combat policies on real-world humanoid robots. Our code and video and supplementary materials are available at RoboStriker.
Shooting for Contact: Contact-Implicit Multiple Shooting for Dynamic Motion Retargeting
面向接触的射击法：用于动态运动重定向的接触隐式多重射击法
运动重定向（Motion retargeting）方法往往优先考虑运动学相似性，而忽略了全身动力学、接触一致性（Contact consistency）以及驱动极限（Actuation limits），导致生成的参考轨迹难以被强化学习（RL）策略复现，在密集接触行为中尤为明显。
我们提出了一套基于隐式接触、直接仿真多重打靶（Contact-implicit, direct simulation-based multiple shooting, DSMS）的框架，将运动学可行的参考轨迹转化为动力学可行的全身轨迹。通过将可微仿真器嵌入非线性规划（Nonlinear program）中，DSMS 在内部求解接触、摩擦、碰撞、自碰撞以及关节极限，同时在无需预先指定接触调度（Contact schedule）或引入显式接触约束的前提下，实施跟踪、驱动与任务约束。
与现有的重定向方法相比，DSMS 加速了运动模仿强化学习的训练过程，并生成了具有高成功率和低跟踪误差的策略。我们进一步在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上展示了零样本 Sim-to-Real 迁移，成功实现了指令条件下的密集接触爬行以及高动态 180 度跳跃旋转。
Motion retargeting approaches often prioritize kinematic similarity over whole-body dynamics, contact consistency, and actuation limits, yielding references that are difficult for reinforcement learning (RL) policies to reproduce, particularly for contact-rich behaviors. We present a contact-implicit, direct simulation-based multiple shooting (DSMS) framework that transforms kinematically feasible references into dynamically feasible whole-body trajectories. By embedding a differentiable simulator within a nonlinear program, DSMS resolves contact, friction, impacts, self-collision, and joint limits internally while enforcing tracking, actuation, and task constraints without prescribing a contact schedule or introducing explicit contact constraints. Compared with existing retargeting methods, DSMS accelerates motion-imitation RL training and yields policies with high success rates and low tracking error. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree G1 through command-conditioned contact-rich crawling and a highly dynamic 180-degree jump-turn.
Ludi0.1: An Agentic System for Socially Intelligent Robots
Ludi0.1：一种面向具备社交智能机器人的智能体系统
机器人基座模型（Robot foundation models）显著推动了感知与控制的发展，但自然的人机协作需要的不仅仅是执行孤立的指令。机器人必须能够识别歧义（Ambiguity）、在多轮对话中保持上下文、传达其意图，并在用户意图改变时修正正在进行的行为。
我们提出了 Ludi 0.1——一套用于社交智能机器人的智能体系统（Agentic system），它整合了交互式语音、多模态推理、记忆、导航以及学习得到的操控技能。其决策核心是一个经过微调的大视觉-语言模型（VLM），该模型基于跨越歧义请求、澄清、纠错、打断、混合社交与任务对话以及多步任务的多轮交互轨迹（Multi-turn interaction traces）训练而成。一套专用的套件（Purpose-built harness）用于管理“模型-工具”的交互环路，而专门的导航和操作策略则用于执行物理技能。
Ludi 展示了一条当前通往顺畅人机协作的实用路径，同时产生了开发更加深度集成的人与机器人基座模型所需的多模态交互轨迹。
Robot foundation models have substantially advanced perception and control, but natural human-robot collaboration requires more than executing isolated commands. A robot must recognize ambiguity, maintain context across turns, communicate its intentions, and revise ongoing behavior as the user's intent changes. We present Ludi0.1, an agentic system for socially intelligent robots that integrates interactive speech, multimodal reasoning, memory, navigation, and learned manipulation. Its decision-making core is a fine-tuned vision-language model trained on multi-turn interaction traces spanning ambiguous requests, clarifications, corrections, interruptions, mixed social and task dialogue, and multi-step tasks. A purpose-built harness manages the model-tool interaction loop, while specialized navigation and manipulation policies execute physical skills. Ludi0.1 demonstrates a practical path toward fluid human-robot collaboration today while producing the multimodal interaction traces needed to develop a more deeply integrated foundation model for robots and people.
RobotDancing: Residual-Action Reinforcement Learning Enables Robust Long-Horizon Humanoid Motion Tracking
RobotDancing：基于残差动作的强化学习实现鲁棒的长时程人形机器人运动追踪
人形机器人上的长程长时域（Long-horizon）、高动态运动跟踪依然十分脆弱：重定向的参考运动通常在运动学上合理，但在动力学上与机器人不一致，导致微小的跟踪误差不断累积，最终使控制系统失去稳定性。
我们提出了 RobotDancing——一套实用的单阶段强化学习配方，通过预测以参考为条件的残差关节目标（Reference-conditioned residual joint targets）来跟踪重定向运动。通过将动作参数化为在参考动作之上的残差修正，策略能够专注于补偿“参考-机器人”之间的动力学失配（如驱动极限、延迟、摩擦与惯性），而非重新合成运动。
我们在不同运动和平台间复用了一套通用的训练与部署配方，针对每个参考运动序列训练单独的策略。我们在宇树 Unitree G1 上的 8 个 LAFAN1 舞蹈动作中评估了 RobotDancing，并在 H1 和 H1-2 机器人上进行了跨平台实验。
最终生成的 G1 策略在无需测试阶段任何修改的条件下，成功在物理硬件上执行了长程、高能量的行为；而在 H1/H1-2 上的实验视频片段进一步展示了该方法的跨平台可行性。
Long-horizon, high-dynamic motion tracking on humanoids remains brittle: retargeted reference motions are typically kinematically plausible but dynamically inconsistent with the robot, so small tracking errors accumulate and eventually destabilize control.We present RobotDancing, a practical single-stage reinforcement learning recipe that tracks retargeted motions by predicting reference-conditioned residual joint targets. By parameterizing actions as residual corrections on top of the reference, the policy can focus on compensating reference–robot dynamics mismatch (e.g., actuation limits, latency, friction, inertia) rather than re-synthesizing the motion. We train one policy per reference sequence while reusing a common training and deployment recipe across motions and platforms. We evaluate RobotDancing on eight LAFAN1 dance motions on Unitree G1 and conduct cross-platform experiments on H1 and H1-2. The resulting G1 policies execute long-horizon, high-energy behaviors on hardware without test-time modifications, and qualitative H1/H1-2 clips further illustrate cross-platform feasibility.
Toward Certified Functional Safety for Industrial Humanoid Robots: The Fail-Passive Gap and a Feasibility Study
迈向工业人形机器人功能安全认证：故障被动（Fail-Passive）模式的缺失与可行性研究
工业人形机器人的发展受限，与其说是受制于移动或操作能力，不如说是受制于腿部平台功能安全认证（Functional safety certification）的不成熟。其根本困难在于：双足腿部机器人的安全状态（Safe state）是一种主动控制状态（Actively-controlled state），这违背了 ISO 13849-1 / EN 60204-1 所依赖的“失效被动/失效无源”（Fail-passive）假设——切断行走双足机器人的电源会导致不可控的跌落，因此传统的断电本身就构成了危险。
我们将此称为失效被动鸿沟（Fail-passive gap），并使用经认证的外置安全链（安全光幕、急停、安全输入、安全 PLC 和无线 PROFIsafe）作为工具对其进行精确定位：由于外置安全链是闭合的且可通过既有方法（PFHD, DC, CCF, PL/SILCL）进行量化，残余的不可认证元素被精准定位在机器人侧的响应链上。
利用西门子 fail-safe S7-1500 急停参考架构，我们证明了其可认证的响应子系统是基于接触器的电源切断（Stop Category 0，0 类停止）——而这恰恰是自平衡人形机器人所无法采用的。我们明确声明本研究并不主张实现端到端认证的 PL e / SIL 3。
我们在 3m x 1.5m 半封闭工作区内的宇树 Unitree G1 EDU 抓取与放置工作站（Pick-and-place cell）上验证了该方法，并贡献了针对人形机器人的主动安全状态分析（包括跌落即危险、单腿支撑停止界限、平衡策略残余风险、ISO 13855 安全距离）以及附带溯源标签的时间预算（Timing budget）。
在机器人上托管工业软件定义自动化（SDA）控制器并与平衡策略同机部署，将机器人侧的 PROFINET/PROFIsafe 接收转移到了标准化的 IEC 61131-3 接口上；由于 G1 的板载计算单元并非安全等级硬件，该端点并非认证的安全运行时，这进一步强化而非解决了失效被动鸿沟，并将其定位在 SDA 与平衡策略的接口处。
Industrial humanoid robots are constrained less by locomotion or manipulation capability than by the immaturity of functional safety certification for legged platforms. The root difficulty is that the safe state of a legged robot is an actively-controlled state, which violates the fail-passive assumption underlying ISO~13849-1 / EN~60204-1: removing power from a walking biped causes an uncontrolled fall, so classical de-energization is itself a hazard. We term this the fail-passive gap and use a certified external safety chain (light curtain, emergency stop, fail-safe input, fail-safe PLC, and wireless PROFIsafe) as an instrument to locate it precisely: because the external chain is closed and quantifiable with established methods (PFHD, DC, CCF, PL/SILCL), the residual uncertifiable element is pinpointed to the robot-side reaction chain. Using a Siemens fail-safe S7-1500 emergency-stop reference, we show its certifiable Reaction subsystem is contactor-based power removal (Stop Category~0)---exactly the element a balancing humanoid cannot have. We deliberately do not claim end-to-end certified PL~e / SIL~3. We validate the approach on a Unitree G1 EDU pick-and-place cell in a 3m x 1.5m semi-enclosed workspace, and contribute a humanoid-specific analysis of the active safe state (fall-as-hazard, single-support stop bounds, balancing-policy residual risk, ISO~13855 separation) and a provenance-labeled timing budget. Hosting an industrial software-defined automation (SDA) controller on the robot, co-located with the balancing policy, moves robot-side PROFINET/PROFIsafe reception onto a standardized IEC~61131-3 interface; because the G1's onboard compute is not safety-rated hardware, this endpoint is not a certified safety runtime, which reinforces rather than resolves the fail-passive gap and localizes it to the SDA-to-balancing-policy interface.
OpenBelief-Nav: Evidence-Preserving Object Memory for Open-Vocabulary Language-Guided Navigation
OpenBelief-Nav：面向开放词汇语言引导导航的证据保留式物体记忆
开放词汇（Open-vocabulary）3D 场景图为语言引导的导航提供了紧凑的语义记忆，但已建图的物体往往仅通过单一融合特征或既定的语义标签（Committed semantic label）进行暴露。这种过早承诺（Commitment）可能会在任务执行阶段从接口中抹去占少数但与任务相关的假说。
我们提出了 OpenBelief-Nav——一套保存证据的物体记忆系统（Evidence-preserving object memory），它在维持独立的聚合几何与视觉表示的同时，保留了观察层面的短语、可靠性线索以及帧掩码溯源信息（Frame-mask provenance）。语义相关的短语被巩固为与词汇表无关的物体信念（Vocabulary-independent object belief），任务特定的读取机制（Task-specific readouts）可从中进行固定词汇映射投影或自由式检索。
在 5 个 ScanNet200 和 8 个 Replica 场景中，全信念映射投影（Full-belief projection）达到了 0.2742 和 0.2912 的 mIoU 分数，而匹配的早期承诺读取机制（Early-commit readout）仅为 0.2393 和 0.2701。在 78 次 HM3D-YCB 导航试验中，共识检索与早期承诺检索各自取得了 60/78 的成功率，相比之下，信念加权检索为 58/78，DualMap 为 55/78。
在以 10 组匹配评估用例形式组织的 20 次宇树 Unitree G1 实机运行中，一套允许最多两次经过验证的候选尝试的纠错策略（Correction policy），将目标确认成功率从仅执行 Top-1 策略的 6/10 提升到了 8/10。
Open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs provide compact semantic memory for language-guided navigation, but mapped objects are often exposed through a single fused feature or committed semantic label. Such commitment can remove minority yet task-relevant hypotheses from the task-time interface. We present OpenBelief-Nav, an evidence-preserving object memory that retains observation-level phrases, reliability cues, and frame-mask provenance while maintaining separate aggregate geometric and visual representations. Semantically related phrases are consolidated into a vocabulary-independent object belief from which task-specific readouts perform fixed-vocabulary projection or free-form retrieval. On five ScanNet200 and eight Replica scenes, full-belief projection achieves mIoU scores of 0.2742 and 0.2912, compared with 0.2393 and 0.2701 for a matched early-commit readout. Across 78 HM3D-YCB navigation trials, consensus and early-commit retrieval each achieve 60/78 successes, compared with 58/78 for belief-weighted retrieval and 55/78 for DualMap. Across 20 Unitree G1 runs organized as 10 matched evaluation cases, a correction policy permitting at most two verified candidate attempts improves target-confirmation success from 6/10 to 8/10 relative to top-1-only execution.
WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
WarpSAC：通过重新思考探索与利用，迈向可扩展离策略强化学习的巅峰
大规模并行仿真（Massively parallel simulation）改变了离线策略强化学习（Off-policy RL）训练的数据范式（Data regime），对原本针对数据受限重放池（Data-limited replay）设计的稳定机制（Stabilizers）提出了挑战。
通过在 8 个基准测试族中进行的控制变量实验，我们证明了这些稳定机制具有数据范式依赖性（Data-regime-dependent）：参数归一化（Parameter normalization）有助于应对狭窄的重放覆盖范围，但当数据丰富时会限制价值函数拟合；而剪切双 Q 机制（Clipped double-Q）在高吞吐量的操作任务中则可以放宽。年龄偏置重放加权（Age-biased replay weighting）在各种范式下均能提高学习效率，在网络容量有限的情况下尤为明显。
基于这些发现，我们提出了 WarpSAC——一套感知数据范式的离线策略强化学习算法族。WarpSAC 采用样本权重衰减（Sample Weight Decay）来实现高效利用，并提供了两个变体：针对数据受限的 CPU 规模训练的 WarpSAC-L（开启归一化，使用剪切双 Q），以及针对数据丰富的 GPU 并行训练的 WarpSAC-A（关闭归一化，使用单 Q）。
在 9 个 CPU 规模的环境中，WarpSAC 相较于 FlashSAC 将归一化得分-步数 AUC 提高了 4.5%；在 14 个 GPU 并行的环境中提高了 23.1%。它将 UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 任务的成功率从 19.8% 提升至 96.4%，在 MuJoCo Playground 上的平均归一化挂钟时间 AUC 提高了 19.1%，并且在宇树 Unitree G1 上实现了比 FlashSAC 快 36.4% 的 Sim-to-Real 部署速度。这些结果表明，可扩展的离线策略强化学习应当根据可用的数据范式自适应调整其稳定机制。
Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighting improves learning efficiency across regimes, especially with limited network capacity.
Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.
Tac4Loco: Learning Spatiotemporal Plantar Pressure Representations for Humanoid Locomotion
Tac4Loco：学习用于人形机器人运动的时空足底压力表征
人形机器人被期望能够穿越复杂地形，在这些地形中，由于足部放置误差、地面特性以及瞬态动力学的影响，足底支撑条件可能会发生剧烈变化。为了实现鲁棒的运动控制，机器人必须适应不平整的地形以及不确定的足-地交互。
现有的运动控制策略主要依赖于本体感觉或外感知地形感知，其中前者仅能提供足底支撑的间接证据，而后者虽能在着地前预测接触条件，但无法实时观察实际的支撑状态。尽管一些研究将足底接触作为辅助感知，但它们主要依赖总结性统计量，忽略了足底压力的空间拓扑结构，而该结构能更直接地刻画已实现的接触状态。
为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Tac4Loco——一套将多阵列足底压力（Multi-array plantar pressure）作为人形机器人运动控制直接反馈的触觉感知框架。我们构建了一个保持拓扑结构的顺序表示（Topology-preserving ordinal representation），将仿真与物理传感信号映射到一个共享的观测空间中，并利用双分支编码器（Dual-branch encoder）提取其空间与时间表示。
随后，学到的时空特征与包含地形估计线索的增强本体感觉相结合，并提供给非对称 Actor-Critic 架构进行策略学习。大量的仿真与真实世界实验表明，在包含倾斜、局部、不对称以及动态变化支撑的地形上，该方法展现出了提升的跟踪性能与支撑适应能力。我们进一步展示了其在未见过的柔性及无结构地形（包括泡沫平台和碎石路面）上的零样本部署。所有代码与实验配置将作为开源发布以促进可复现性。
Humanoid robots are expected to traverse complex terrains, where the plantar support may vary dramatically due to foot placement errors, ground properties, and transient dynamics. To achieve robust locomotion, the robots are required to adapt to uneven terrain and uncertain foot– ground interactions. Existing locomotion policies rely primarily on proprioception or exteroceptive terrain perception, where the former provides only indirect evidence of plantar support, while the latter predicts contact conditions before touchdown but cannot observe the actual support in real-time. Although some studies incorporate plantar contacts as an auxiliary
perception, they rely mainly on summary statistics, overlooking the spatial topology of plantar pressure, which provides a more direct characterization of the realized contact state. To bridge this gap, we present Tac4Loco, a tactile-perceptive framework that incorporates multi-array plantar pressure as direct feedback for humanoid locomotion. We formulate a topology-preserving ordinal representation to map simulated and physical sensor signals into a shared observation space, with a dual-branch encoder for extracting their spatial and temporal representations. Subsequently, the learned spatiotemporal features are integrated with augmented proprioception including terrain estimation cues, and provided to an asymmetric actor-critic architecture for policy learning. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved tracking performance and support adaptation on terrains with
inclined, partial, asymmetric, and changing support. We further demonstrate its zero-shot deployment on unseen compliant and unstructured terrains, including a foam platform and a gravel road. All code and experimental configurations will be released as open-source to facilitate reproducibility.
CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
CLIFT：通过无创闭环迭代微调，将端侧 Gemini Robotics 转化为人形机器人专家
尽管机器人基座模型（Robot foundation models）的能力日益强大，但最出色的模型通常基于专有数据训练且维持开源受限（闭源）状态，这限制了下游用户将其适配到新任务、新具身结构（Embodiment）及新部署场景的能力。
借鉴大语言模型（LLM）社区的经验，闭源机器人基座模型的一种新兴接入范式是托管式监督微调 API（Managed supervised fine-tuning SFT API）：用户提交训练数据并获取微调后的策略，而无需接触模型权重、梯度或内部训练细节。虽然此类 API 允许下游用户充分利用强大的专有基座模型，但它们将策略改进限制在纯粹的模仿学习（Imitation）范畴内，排除了依赖内部训练信号的强化学习（RL）及其他闭环优化方法。
这一局限性在敏捷且密集接触的人形机器人操控（Contact-rich humanoid manipulation）中尤为突出，因为在新颖状态、动作跟踪动力学、时延以及控制器特有的失效模式影响下，策略输出与实际部署行为之间存在巨大差距。
我们研究了这种托管 API 范式在人形机器人适配中的有效性，以及如何在不突破 API 限制的前提下实现闭环改进以推动策略达到任务精通状态。我们在真实人形机器人上针对托管 API 适配开展了首批实证研究之一，该研究基于 Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD) 实例化展开。
我们发现，直接通过 API 进行的监督微调（SFT）显著优于在相同示范数据上训练的顶尖开源权重 VLA 模型，但在敏捷、密集接触的任务上仍未达到部署级的精通水平。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 CLIFT（Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning，闭环迭代微调框架）：该方法将部署阶段的奖励反馈转化为兼容 API 的监督数据，在完全无需访问权重、梯度、似然值或损失函数的前提下实现了闭环策略改进，仅经过两个飞轮周期（Flywheel cycles）就推动 GROD 达到了接近完美的成功率——这一切均在无需“打开模型黑盒”的情况下实现。
While robot foundation models are growing increasingly capable, the strongest models are typically trained on proprietary data and remain closed-source, limiting downstream users' ability to adapt them to new tasks, embodiments, and deployment settings. Following the LLM community, an emerging access paradigm for closed-weight robot foundation models is the managed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) API, where users submit training data and receive a tuned policy without access to model weights, gradients, or training internals. While such APIs let downstream users leverage powerful proprietary foundation models, they restrict policy improvement to pure imitation, ruling out reinforcement learning and other closed-loop methods that rely on internal training signals. This limitation is particularly acute for agile, contact-rich humanoid manipulation, where the gap between policy outputs and deployed behavior is large due to novel states, action tracking dynamics, latency, and controller-specific failure modes. We study how effective this managed-API regime is for humanoid adaptation, and how closed-loop improvement can be realized within it to push policies toward task mastery. We conduct one of the first empirical studies of managed-API adaptation on a real humanoid, instantiated on Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD). We find that direct SFT through the API substantially outperforms a leading open-weight VLA trained on the same demonstrations, yet still falls short of deployment-level mastery on agile, contact-rich tasks. To close this gap, we introduce CLIFT: Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning, which turns deployment-time reward feedback into API-compatible supervised data and enables closed-loop policy improvement without accessing weights, gradients, likelihoods, or losses-pushing GROD to near-perfect success after two flywheel cycles, all without "opening the model box."
LAC: Linear and Angular Compliance for Humanoid Whole-body Control
LAC：面向人形机器人全身控制的线性和角向柔顺性
真实世界中的人形机器人任务涉及与物体及人员的物理交互，然而已有的学习控制器要么将外力视为扰动加以拒绝，要么将柔顺性（Compliance）局限于少数接触点的线性响应上。
我们提出了 LAC——一套通用的全身控制器，能够实现对施加于上半身的力矩/力偶（Wrenches）进行指令控制的线性和角柔顺性（Linear and Angular Compliance）。该方法将采样的力和力矩事件施加到从人类交互数据中提取的接触参考系上。在每个受载连杆处，外力与从被动屈服运动学链中获得的虚拟转矩共同驱动在指令刚度（Stiffness）下的虚拟导纳（Virtual admittance），从而将全身柔顺响应合成到一个大规模增强数据集中。随后，教师-学生强化学习（Teacher–student RL）在增强数据上训练单一策略，以实现该刚度指令。
大量的仿真与实验从三个方面验证了 LAC 的有效性。在从手部到躯干施加力矩的条件下，机器人做出了现有控制器无法产生的平衡全身柔顺运动；实现的柔顺度在两种刚度指令的全范围内呈单调变化，并在真实机器人上成功复现；在线刚度调节的遥操作下，机器人能够与人类进行温和的交互、运输软质物体，并完成诸如打开带弹簧机构的门等高力矩需求任务。
Real-world humanoid tasks involve physical interaction with objects and people, yet learned controllers either reject external forces as disturbances or restrict compliance to the linear response of a few contact sites. We present LAC, a general whole-body controller that realizes commanded Linear and Angular Compliance for wrenches applied to the upper body. Sampled force and couple events are applied to contact frames extracted from human interaction data. At each loaded link, the external force and a virtual torque obtained from the passively yielding kinematic chain drive a virtual admittance under the commanded stiffness, synthesizing whole-body compliant responses into a large-scale augmented dataset. Teacher–student reinforcement learning then trains a single policy on the augmented data to realize the stiffness commands. Extensive simulation and experiments validate LAC in three aspects. Under wrenches applied from the hand to the torso, the robot responds with balanced whole-body compliant motion that existing controllers fail to produce. The realized compliance varies monotonically over the full range of both stiffness commands and is reproduced on the real robot. Under teleoperation with online stiffness adjustment, the robot gently interacts with people, transports soft objects, and completes force-demanding tasks such as opening a spring-loaded door.
LooperMuscle: Fast and Stable Learning of Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking via Structured Mixture-of-Experts
LooperMuscle：基于结构化混合专家模型的人形机器人全身追踪快速稳定学习
类 FastSAC 方法显著缩短了人形机器人运动训练的时间，但在全身跟踪任务中，相较于 PPO 往往承受显著的性能衰退。我们针对这一速度与性能之间的差距，提出了 LooperMuscle——一套组合式专家策略学习框架（Composed expert policy learning framework），在保持高训练效率的同时恢复了跟踪质量。
LooperMuscle 结合了语义结构化的混合专家（MoE）Actor、专家感知的分布式 Critic，以及带有延迟课程调度的贡献路由重放机制（Contribution-routed replay with deferred curriculum scheduling）。这三个组件形成了一个闭环训练回路：专家贡献指导数据路由，路由后的数据塑造价值学习，而价值梯度反过来精炼专家的分工演化。
实证表明，我们的方法在运动跟踪精度上显著优于原生 FastSAC。同时，它所需的挂钟时间远少于 PPO：在 FastSAC 训练仅需约 15 分钟但表现不佳、而 PPO 能达到更强性能却需要约 6 小时的场景下，LooperMuscle 在约 45 分钟内达到了与 PPO 相当的性能，为 Sim-to-Real 迭代提供了实用的高效性。
FastSAC-style methods significantly reduce humanoid motion training time but often suffer from notable performance degradation compared with PPO in whole-body tracking tasks. We target this speed–performance gap by introducing LooperMuscle, a composed expert policy learning framework that restores tracking quality while preserving high training efficiency. LooperMuscle combines a semantically structured mixture-of-experts actor, an expert-aware distributional critic, and contribution-routed replay with deferred curriculum scheduling. These three components form a closed training loop in which expert contributions guide data routing, routed data shape value learning, and value gradients in turn refine expert specialization. Empirically, our approach substantially outperforms vanilla FastSAC regarding motion tracking accuracy. While it requires far less wall-clock time than PPO: where FastSAC trains in about 15 minutes but underperforms, and PPO achieves stronger results but requires about 6 hours, LooperMuscle reaches comparable performance to PPO in roughly 45 minutes, and delivering practical efficiency for sim-to-real iteration. The code will be released to benefit the research community at: https://loopermuscle.github.io.
DyPES-VLA: Learning Shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific Control for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
DyPES-VLA：面向跨具身操作的共享动力学先验与具身特定控制学习
视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的一种强大范式，但针对异构机器人具身结构（Heterogeneous robot embodiments）训练单一通用策略（Generalist policy）依然是一个亟待解决的问题。
现有的方法未能充分利用跨多样化视觉与交互数据共享的动力学先验（Dynamics priors），并且需要大量的额外手动预处理将特定具身的动作转换为统一格式。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 DyPES-VLA——一套跨具身的 VLA 模型，它通过未来预测监督（Future-prediction supervision）学习共享动力学先验，并在每个机器人的原生动作空间（Native action space）中直接实现特定具身的控制。一个共享注意力、静态路由的混合专家（MoE）动作头在捕捉通用时间结构的同时，解耦并解决了特定具身的运动学与控制语义。
作为通用策略，DyPES-VLA 在 LIBERO 基准测试上达到了 98.0% 的成功率，在 RoboCasa-GR1 上达到了 59.25%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到了 89.02%。
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robot manipulation, but training a single generalist policy for heterogeneous robot embodiments remains an open problem. Existing methods underuse dynamics priors shared across diverse visual and interaction data and require extensive manual preprocessing to convert embodiment-specific actions into a common format. To overcome these limitations, we propose DyPES-VLA, a cross-embodiment VLA that learns shared dynamics priors through future-prediction supervision and realizes embodiment-specific control directly in each robot's native action space. A shared-attention, statically routed MoE action head captures common temporal structures while resolving embodiment-specific kinematics and control semantics. As a generalist policy, DyPES-VLA reaches 98.0% success on LIBERO, 59.25% on RoboCasa-GR1, and 89.02% on RoboTwin 2.0.
KILVO: Kinematic–Inertial–LiDAR–Visual Odometry With Robust Multimodal Adaptation for Humanoid Robots
KILVO：面向人形机器人的运动学-惯性-激光雷达-视觉里程计（具备鲁棒的多模态自适应能力）
本文提出了一套针对人形机器人的运动学-惯性-激光雷达-视觉里程计（Kinematic-Inertial-LiDAR-Visual Odometry, KILVO）。该方法紧密贴合人形机器人的平台特性、应用需求及真实环境复杂性，在异步-顺序混合误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波器（Asynchronous-sequential hybrid error-state iterated Kalman filter）中，充分利用了人形机器人普遍配备的传感器，包括关节编码器、惯性测量单元（IMU）、激光雷达和相机。
具体而言，惯性数据用于状态预测，腿部运动学信息以高频率异步处理并提供本体感觉约束；而外感知数据则以顺序形式进行更新——首先通过匹配激光雷达点云获取几何先验，随后通过光度误差更新视觉组件。此外，该框架经过精细设计，具备多模态自适应能力（Multimodal adaptation），能抵御传感器失效。
研究团队还开发了一个紧凑的接触估计模块（Contact estimation module），在无需引入额外传感器的情况下与状态估计共享信息。在多个公开数据集以及涵盖多台人形机器人、多种步态模式和多样化场景的真实世界实验中，KILVO 展现出了极具竞争力的精度、计算效率与输出频率，并且对传感器性能衰退和失效具备极强的鲁棒性，使其比现有的 SOTA 融合方法更适合应用于人形机器人平台。
This article presents a kinematic-inertial-light detection and ranging (LiDAR_-visual odometry (KILVO) for humanoid robots. Tailored to the platform features, requirements, and real-world complexity, it fully utilizes the sensors commonly equipped on humanoid robots, including joint encoders, inertial measurement unit (IMU), LiDAR, and camera, within an asynchronous-sequential hybrid error-state iterated Kalman filter. Specifically, inertial data are used for prediction, leg kinematics are processed asynchronously at a high rate and provide proprioceptive constraints, while exteroception is updated sequentially, first by registering LiDAR points for geometric priors and then by updating the visual component via photometric errors. Moreover, the framework is elaborately designed with multimodal adaptation for resilience to sensor failures. A compact contact estimation module is also developed, sharing information with state estimation without additional sensors. Extensive experiments on public datasets and in the real world across multiple humanoid robots, gait patterns, and scenarios demonstrate that KILVO achieves highly competitive accuracy, efficiency, and output rates, with strong robustness against sensor degradation and failures, making it more suitable for humanoid robots than state-of-the-art fusion methods. Our code and datasets are released on GitHub.
Walking on Ice: Adaptive Gait Control of Humanoid Robots Based on Visual Prediction and Proprioceptive Estimation for Variable Friction Environments
冰面行走：基于视觉预测与本体感知估计的变摩擦环境人形机器人自适应步态控制
人形机器人越来越多地部署于智能制造、医疗护理和农业等真实世界环境中，覆盖从室内空间到摩擦条件差异巨大的室外地形。然而，现有的方法（如领域随机化或单纯依靠状态估计）在应对低摩擦步态控制方面显得力不从心，且无法有效解决可变摩擦条件带来的挑战，导致难以保障控制系统的鲁棒性。
为了解决这些难题，我们提出了 Walking on Ice (WoI)——一套针对可变表面摩擦力的摩擦感知运动控制框架（Friction-aware locomotion framework），该框架将主动预测与被动自适应相融合。我们引入了一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的摩擦预测器，使策略能够在摩擦力发生变化之前采取前瞻性动作，从而应对可变摩擦场景。此外，我们设计了一个摩擦估计器，结合关节历史编码器（Joint history encoder）感知本体感觉状态，以处理低摩擦表面。
实验结果表明，与最先进的方法去噪世界模型学习（DWL）相比，WoI 将成功率提高了 8.5%，并将打滑率降低了 5.15%。特别是在极限案例中，WoI 实现了 98.3% 的成功率，生存率提高了 51.0%，打滑率降低了 3.20%，卡顿率降低了 46.5%，展示出了稳定且高效的步态适应能力。我们的工作为动态摩擦条件下的真实世界场景提供了鲁棒且高效的稳定运动控制框架。
Humanoid robots have been increasingly deployed in real-world environments such as intelligent manufacturing, healthcare, and agriculture, from indoor spaces to outdoor terrains where friction conditions vary significantly. However, existing approaches such as domain randomization or employing estimation struggle to handle low-friction gait control and fail to address variable friction conditions, making it difficult to ensure control robustness. To address these challenges, we propose Walking on Ice (WoI), a friction-aware locomotion framework that combines proactive prediction with reactive adaptation for varying surface friction. We introduce a VLM-based friction predictor that enables the policy to take anticipatory actions before friction changing, thereby addressing variablefriction scenarios. Additionally, we design a friction estimator combined with a joint history encoder that perceives proprioceptive states to handle low-friction surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate that WoI improves success rate by 8.5% and reduces slip rate by 5.15% over the state-of-the-art method Denoising World Model Learning (DWL). Particularly, in extreme cases, WoI achieves 98.3% success rate with 51.0% higher survival rate, 3.20% lower slip rate, and 46.5% lower stuck rate than DWL, demonstrating stable and efficient gait adaptation. Our work provides a robust and efficient gait control framework for stable locomotion in realworld scenarios with dynamic friction conditions.
C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
C2Dex：基于单目视频的灵巧操作接触一致性重建与重定向
灵巧机器人操作的高质量示范数据收集成本高昂且十分困难，而单目人类视频为多样化的操作行为提供了可扩展的数据源。然而，将此类示范迁移至灵巧手仍面临重大挑战：单目人手-物体交互（Hand-Object Interaction, HOI）重建往往会产生时间上不稳定的接触和物理上不可行的交互，而传统的重定向方法难以跨不同手部具身结构保留与任务相关的接触及局部交互几何。
我们提出了 C2Dex——一套围绕共享交互表示构建的“视频到灵巧操控”（Video-to-dexterous-manipulation）框架：在标准物体空间中，通过聚合带噪声的逐帧观测数据来恢复稳定的物体侧接触。
这些稳定接触发挥着双重作用：一方面作为轨迹层面的约束，引导重建走向时间连贯且物理合理的人类 HOI 轨迹；另一方面作为灵巧手的明确迁移目标，通过拉普拉斯交互优化（Laplacian interaction optimization）跨具身保持局部手-物几何关系，并利用残差强化学习（Residual RL）在仿真中精炼轨迹。
在 DexYCB 和 TACO 数据集上的实验表明，C2Dex 实现了 57.78% 和 26.67% 的端到端轨迹成功率，在相同的评估标准下显著优于最强的基线方法（17.78% 和 10.00%）。真实机器人重放实验进一步证明了其在多种密集接触操作任务中的物理可行性。
High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand–object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand–object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks.
From Experts to a Generalist: Toward General Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots
从专家到通用型：迈向人形机器人的通用全身控制
由于多样的运动需求和数据冲突，在人形机器人上实现通用的敏捷全身控制（General agile whole-body control）依然是一项重大挑战。尽管现有的框架在训练针对单一特定运动的策略方面表现出色，但由于控制要求的冲突和数据分布的不匹配，它们难以泛化到差异极大的各种行为上。
在这项工作中，我们提出了 BumbleBee (BB)——一套结合了运动聚类与 Sim-to-Real 自适应的“专家-通用者”（Expert-generalist）学习框架，以克服这些挑战。BB 首先利用基于自编码器的聚类方法，结合运动特征与运动描述，将行为相似的运动归类分组。随后在每个簇内训练专家策略（Expert policies），并通过迭代残差动作建模（Iterative delta action modeling）结合真实世界数据进行精炼，以弥合 Sim-to-Real 差距。最后，这些专家策略被蒸馏（Distilled）为一个统一的通用控制器（Generalist controller），在所有运动类型中保持敏捷性与鲁棒性。
在两个仿真器和真实人形机器人上的实验表明，BB 实现了最先进的通用全身控制，为真实世界中敏捷、鲁棒且具备泛化力的人形机器人控制树立了新标杆。
Achieving general agile whole-body control on humanoid robots remains a major challenge due to diverse motion demands and data conflicts. While existing frameworks excel in training single motion-specific policies, they struggle to generalize across highly varied behaviors due to conflicting control requirements and mismatched data distributions. In this work, we propose BumbleBee (BB), an expert-generalist learning framework that combines motion clustering and sim-to-real adaptation to overcome these challenges. BB first leverages an autoencoder-based clustering method to group behaviorally similar motions using motion features and motion descriptions. Expert policies are then trained within each cluster and refined with real-world data through iterative delta action modeling to bridge the sim-to-real gap. Finally, these experts are distilled into a unified generalist controller that preserves agility and robustness across all motion types. Experiments on two simulators and a real humanoid robot demonstrate that BB achieves state-of-the-art general whole-body control, setting a new benchmark for agile, robust, and generalizable humanoid control in the real world.
RoboReact: Agentic Skill Distillation from Generated Egocentric Videos for Generalizable Whole-Body Manipulation
RoboReact：基于生成式自中心视角的智能体技能蒸馏，实现可泛化的全身操作
人形机器人具备在人类环境中执行灵巧操作的巨大潜力，然而由于昂贵的硬件数据采集与高昂的人工标注成本，获取多样且具备泛化能力的技能依然极其昂贵。视频生成模型（Video generative models）的最新进展为从视觉观测中合成丰富的操作经验提供了广阔的前景，但如何将这些想象中的行为转化为可执行的人形机器人全身技能，在很大程度上仍未被深入探索。
在这项工作中，我们提出了 RoboReact——一套仅从单目第一视角 RGB-D 观测中自动合成人形机器人全身操作技能的框架。RoboReact 生成人类操作视频，通过深度感知的 3D 重建提取保持几何特征的交互关键帧（Geometry-preserving interaction keyframes），并将它们重定向到高自由度（High-DoF）人形机器人平台上，同时跨具身保留手-物交互的几何形状。为了弥合想象规划与物理执行之间的差距，RoboReact 开展在线以物体为中心的重对齐（Online object-centric re-grounding），并利用由大视觉-语言模型（VLM）引导的精炼闭环，在几何失配和执行偏差下对技能进行自适应调整。精炼后的技能通过全身控制器（Whole-body controller）执行，从而实现了协调的全身操作与灵巧交互。
在真实人形机器人上的实验表明，RoboReact 能够在多样化的物体配置下实现泛化，并在无需遥操作或人类示范的情况下，从执行扰动中鲁棒地恢复。这些结果凸显了结合生成模型、视觉-语言推理以及闭环控制在可扩展的人形机器人技能获取方面的巨大潜力。
Humanoid robots have the potential to perform dexterous manipulation in human environments, yet acquiring diverse and generalizable skills remains costly due to expensive hardware data collection and labor-intensive annotation. Recent advances in video generative models provide a promising opportunity to synthesize rich manipulation experiences from visual observations, but transferring such imagined behaviors into executable whole-body humanoid skills remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present RoboReact, a framework that automatically synthesizes whole-body humanoid manipulation skills from a single egocentric RGB-D observation. RoboReact generates human manipulation videos, extracts geometry-preserving interaction keyframes through depth-aware 3D reconstruction, and retargets them to high-DoF humanoid platforms while preserving hand-object interaction geometry. To bridge the gap between imagined plans and physical execution, RoboReact performs online object-centric re-grounding and leverages a vision-language model-guided refinement loop to adapt skills under geometric mismatch and execution deviations. The refined skills are executed through a whole-body controller, enabling coordinated whole-body manipulation and dexterous interaction. Experiments on real humanoid robots demonstrate that RoboReact generalizes across diverse object configurations and robustly recovers from execution disturbances without requiring teleoperation or human demonstrations. These results highlight the potential of combining generative models, vision-language reasoning, and closed-loop control for scalable humanoid skill acquisition.
DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot
DeepInsight II：从基准测试到机器人的全链路追踪
在物理人工智能（Physical AI）技术栈中，评估成熟度与部署风险呈现出逆向对齐的现象：基座模型（Foundation models）拥有成熟且标准化的测试套件，而真正决定部署成败的具身层（Embodied layers）却依然碎片化地分散在特定于基准测试的仿真器、具身结构和接口之中。
首篇 DeepInsight 报告（v1）在任务（Task）、资源（Resource）和结果（Result）这三种抽象概念下统一了该技术栈的评估，但其定量证据主要集中在基座模型层；导航与操控（System 1）以及全身控制（System 0）仍局限于仿真案例研究，而物理实机执行则在其实证范围之外。DeepInsight II 保持了该底层架构的稳定，并对具身层进行了定量化评估。首先，它在其原生协议下复现了跨 2 个导航基准和 4 个操控基准的已发布检查点参考结果（Released-checkpoint references）。
其次，MotionBench 将 4 个已发布的全身控制器置于统一的工作负载与指标契约（Workload and metric contract）之下，随后将一组经过资格筛选的同族控制器从并行仿真带入到匹配的真实机器人试验中——在试验中，仿真与物理轨迹共享同一个父级轨迹标识（Parent trace identity），同时保留特定于执行域的记录，从而使仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）的差距成为一种原生归约（Native reduction），而非跨工具链的强制对齐。
第三，一项组合式的 System 2–1–0 研究将轨迹定位扩展到了 5 个基于证据的接管/手力标签（Evidence-grounded handoff labels）中，每个标签都映射到了具体的修复动作，并附带测得的可修复性标准（Repairability criterion），以及在硬件可观测状态下测试相同归因的物理回合（Physical episodes）。
因此，本研究的贡献并非一种全新的评估架构，而是从基准测试执行到匹配的机器人实证证据以及面向修复诊断的实证连续性（Empirical continuity）。
Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.
Teleopit: A Full-Embodiment Humanoid Teleoperation System
Teleopit：一种全具身人形机器人遥操作系统
用于示范数据采集的人形机器人遥操作（Humanoid teleoperation）需要协调的全身运动、连续的灵巧手控制以及视角控制。现有的系统要么简化了手部指令，要么依赖专门的佩戴式传感器来实现细粒度的手部运动控制。
我们提出了 Teleopit——一套全具身遥操作系统（Full-embodiment teleoperation system），能够将来自虚拟现实（VR）的身体、手部和头部信号精准映射到人形机器人的躯干、可配置的灵巧手以及 2 自由度（2-DoF）主动视觉模块上。历史编码器（History encoder）与感知失效的重放采样（Failure-aware rewind sampling）显著提升了运动跟踪器在动作捕捉及实时 VR 参考信号上的跟踪性能。
基于优化的手部重定向器（Optimization-based hand retargeter）结合了归一化的手指方向、指尖闭合度以及拇指坐标系对齐，在无需针对特定手部微调目标函数或求解器超参数的前提下，将人类手部运动映射到不同的灵巧手上。
组件实验评估了系统的跟踪成功率与重定向行为，而真实机器人遥操作实验展示了协调的移动、操控与视角控制能力。在基于 Teleopit 采集的 96 条成功示范数据上训练的 ACT 模型与 GR00T N1.7 策略，在部署到人形机器人实机上时分别达到了 90.0% 和 95.0% 的任务成功率。
Humanoid teleoperation for demonstration collection requires coordinated whole-body motion, continuous dexterous hand control, and viewpoint control. Existing systems either simplify hand commands or depend on dedicated wearable sensors for fine-grained hand motion. We introduce Teleopit, a full-embodiment teleoperation system that maps body, hand, and head signals from VR to a humanoid body, configurable dexterous hands, and a 2-DoF active vision module. A history encoder and failure-aware rewind sampling improve the motion tracker on both motion-capture and live VR references. An optimization-based hand retargeter combines normalized finger directions, fingertip closure, and thumb-frame alignment to map human hand motion to different dexterous hands without tuning hand-specific objective or solver hyperparameters. Component experiments evaluate tracking success rate and retargeting behavior, while real-robot teleoperation demonstrates coordinated locomotion, manipulation, and viewpoint control. ACT and GR00T N1.7 policies trained on 96 successful demonstrations collected with Teleopit achieve task success rates of 90.0% and 95.0%, respectively, when deployed on the humanoid.
From Remote Control to Vision-Language-Action: Initial Deployment of the Humanoid Robot Unitree G1 with Tactile Hands
从遥控到“视觉-语言-动作”：搭载触觉灵巧手的宇树 G1 人形机器人初步部署
本文报道了在大学科研与教学实验室中部署两台配备因时（Inspire）RH56DFTP 触觉五指灵巧手的宇树 Unitree G1 EDU U6 人形机器人的初步部署经验。我们记录了从拆箱到可复现科研应用的完整路径：开箱调试、远程控制与遥操作、步态运动、SDK/ROS 2 系统配置、第三方灵巧手集成、基于仿真的风险规避以及网络安全加固。尽管相关科研演示呈现爆发式增长，但针对真实 G1 操作部署中面向操作员的详细记录机制依然有限，我们旨在通过这份实用的系统级报告弥合这一差距。
从硬件角度看，该平台在很大程度上符合预期，平地运动控制令人满意，然而整个系统对于日常实验工作而言依然较为脆弱，尤其是在安装了灵巧手之后。主要的痛点集中在：各供应商组件之间的软件版本漂移（Version drift）与配置管理薄弱、移动操控（Loco-manipulation）过程中外置手部线缆的机械脆弱性，以及构建包含触觉感知（超越供应商提供的手部运动原语）的统一感觉运动流水线（Sensorimotor pipeline）的现实需求。
我们还讨论了板载感知套件的实际局限（相机视角以及当前 SLAM/导航工具链的成熟度），并总结了在机构网络基础设施上运行联网人形机器人所需的防御性安全措施。文章最后总结了经验教训，并展望了未来基于 UniFoLM 与 GR00T 开展早期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）实验的发展路线图。
This paper reports initial deployment experience with two Unitree G1 EDU U6 humanoid robots equipped with Inspire RH56DFTP tactile five-finger hands in a university research-and-education lab. We document the path from unboxing to repeatable research use: commissioning, remote control and teleoperation, locomotion, SDK/ROS 2 configuration, integration of third-party dexterous hands, simulation-based de-risking, and cybersecurity hardening. Despite rapidly growing research demonstrations, detailed operator-facing notes on real G1 manipulation deployments remain limited; we aim to narrow this gap with a practical, system-level report. From a hardware perspective the platform largely fulfils expectations and flat-ground locomotion is convincing; nevertheless, the complete system is still fragile for everyday experimental work, especially once the dexterous hands are installed. The main friction points are software version drift and weak configuration management across vendor components, mechanical vulnerability of the external hand cabling during loco-manipulation, and the need to build a unified sensorimotor pipeline that incorporates tactile perception beyond vendor-provided hand motion primitives. We also discuss practical constraints of the onboard sensing stack (camera
viewpoint and the current maturity of SLAM/navigation tooling) and summarize defensive measures required when operating a network-connected humanoid on institutional infrastructure. The paper concludes with lessons learned and a roadmap toward early Vision-Language-Action experiments with UniFoLM and GR00T.
Feasibility-aware whole-body control for terrain-adaptive humanoid locomotion
面向地形自适应人形机器人运动的、考虑可行性的全身控制
人形机器人在复杂地形上的步态运动通常依赖于外感知（Exteroceptive perception）或人工调优的控制增益，这两者都限制了真实世界部署中的鲁棒性。本文提出了一种完全基于本体感觉的地形自适应控制方法，仅使用关节编码器和身体佩戴的惯性测量单元（IMU），在没有任何外部感知或特定地形调优的情况下，使人形机器人能够在平地、不平整地面和斜坡上平稳行走。
我们的核心思想是：连续地形无需被“看到”即可被妥善处理，其局部几何形状可以仅从本体感觉信号中推断出来，且控制行为能够持续自适应于这一估计，从而使机器人在斜坡上自动优先保障接触安全，同时在平地上保持标称性能。这种自适应过程由可行性裕度（Feasibility margin）驱动，该裕度量化了二次规划（QP）优化器中摩擦锥的剩余可用空间，并通过一个可行性感知全身控制器（FAWBC）来实时调制其代价权重。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的仿真实验表明，该方法能够实现在平地、不平整地形以及斜坡上的稳定行走，而固定权重的基线方法在斜坡上发生了跌落。该方法在物理 Unitree G1 实机上进一步得到了验证，成功穿越了平地、草地、木屑地以及斜坡，证明了其在真实世界中的可行性。
Humanoid locomotion over varying terrains typically relies on exteroceptive perception or manually tuned control gains, both of which limit robustness in real-world deployment. This paper presents a fully proprioceptive terrain-adaptive control approach that enables humanoid robots to walk across flat, uneven, and inclined surfaces using only joint encoders and a body-mounted inertial measurement unit, without any external sensing or terrain-specific tuning. Our central idea is that continuous terrain does not need to be seen to be handled: its local geometry can be inferred from proprioceptive signals alone, and control behavior can continuously adapt to this estimate so that the robot automatically prioritizes contact safety on inclines while preserving nominal performance on flat ground. This adaptation is driven by a feasibility margin that quantifies how much of the friction cone remains available to the quadratic programming optimizer, and is realized through a feasibility-aware whole-body controller (FAWBC) that modulates its cost weights accordingly. Simulation experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid demonstrate stable locomotion across flat ground, uneven terrain, and a
ramp, where a fixed-weight baseline falls. The approach is further validated on the physical Unitree G1 across flat ground, grassland, wood-chip terrain, and a
ramp, confirming its real-world feasibility.
Passive-Dynamic-Walking-Inspired Dynamics Guidance for Energy-Efficient Humanoid Locomotion
受被动动力学步行启发的节能人形机器人运动动力学引导
学习高能效的人形机器人步态控制，关键在于探索出符合机械力学经济性的全身协调运动，而非仅仅降低执行器的输出功耗。强化学习通常通过与功耗相关的奖励惩罚项来促进能效提升，但这只能间接地引导机器人每一步的行走力学机制。本文提出了一种受被动动态行走（Passive Dynamic Walking, PDW）启发的训练框架，该框架通过在训练初期临时创建等效斜坡条件，为经济型步态的探索营造有利环境，并在标称动力学优化阶段前完全撤去所有特定于 PDW 的引导机制。在训练初期，倾斜重力场（Tilted-gravity field）在平地碰撞几何体上辅助矢状面方向的前进，并辅以与课程学习耦合的奖励项；而其核心框架无需任何参考轨迹、步态相位或接触时间表。
在 29 自由度宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行的 5 组随机种子向前行走研究表明，在 0.5–2.0 m/s 的指令速度范围内，该框架将机械运输成本（Cost of Transport, CoT）降低了 6.8%–15.2%，且未降低速度跟踪精度。机械功分解表明，这一能效提升归因于正向执行器做功的减少；而通过奖励匹配的对比实验，该研究进一步区分了引导机制所带来的更快步态获取速度，以及重力倾斜对最终收敛步态经济性的额外贡献。
该框架可进一步扩展至无辅助的全向行走场景——只要引入特定于行走的运动先验（Motion Prior）来提供运动学协调，其能效优势便能持续保持，二者结合使速度匹配下的运输成本降低了 18.7%。在物理实机测试中，结合运动先验时机器人的向前运输成本降低了 16.3%，而在无运动先验时降低了 4.5%（后者处于试验间的波动范围内）。
Learning energy-efficient humanoid locomotion requires discovering mechanically economical gait coordination, not merely reducing actuator effort. Reinforcement learning promotes efficiency through effort-related reward penalties, which guide the step-to-step mechanics of walking only indirectly. This article proposes a framework inspired by passive dynamic walking (PDW) that temporarily creates slope-equivalent conditions favorable to economical gait discovery and removes all PDW-specific guidance before nominal-dynamics optimization. During early training, a tilted-gravity field assists sagittal progression on flat collision geometry, complemented by curriculum-coupled reward terms. The core framework requires no reference trajectories, gait phases, or contact schedules. In a five-seed forward-locomotion study on a 29-DoF Unitree G1, the framework reduces mechanical cost of transport by 6.8-15.2% over commanded speeds of 0.5-2.0m/s without degrading velocity tracking. Mechanical-work decomposition attributes the reduction to positive actuator work, and reward-matched comparisons separate the guided regime's faster gait acquisition from the tilt's additional benefit to converged economy. The framework extends to unassisted omnidirectional locomotion, where its benefit persists once a walking-specific motion prior supplies kinematic coordination, the combination reducing speed-matched cost of transport by 18.7%. On hardware, forward cost of transport falls by 16.3% with the motion prior and by 4.5% without it, the latter within the trial-to-trial spread.
Learning Slope-Adaptive Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoid Robots in Roofing Construction
面向屋顶施工场景的人形机器人坡度自适应全身运动学习
屋顶施工要求工人协调倾斜表面上的移动、平衡以及与工作相关的身体运动，这为人形机器人提出了极具挑战性的应用需求。然而，直接重定向（Retarget）的人类示范动作虽然能够保留运动外观，但可能导致机器人的手足相对于屋顶平面的位置发生偏转。本研究提出了一套针对宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人的任务语义与场景对齐（Task-semantic scene-grounded）框架，用于学习屋顶工风格的全身运动。研究利用跟踪系统采集人类示范动作并重定向至机器人，同时通过度量屋顶模型提供跟踪系统所缺失的空间参考。
轨迹级优化机制将推断的支撑接触与标注的工作约束关系对齐（Ground）到屋顶模型上，而执行感知的强化学习（Execution-aware RL）则促使最终策略在动态跟踪误差下依然保持这些约束关系。该框架通过多运动跟踪研究、屋顶倾角覆盖矩阵、打钉枪五方消融实验、锤击与侧向推挤的跨任务实验，以及与纯强化学习及零样本遥操作的对比进行了综合评估。
实验结果表明，我们的方法使机器人在所有评估随机种子下均满足了支撑、工作间隙（Work-clearance）以及无穿透（Nonpenetration）标准；在打钉枪、锤击和推挤任务中实现了 0.256 至 0.531 cm 的工作间隙误差，且每个任务均获得了 3/3 的成功评估；物理实机实验重现了上坡行走、打钉枪操作、锤击和弯腰动作，平均基座坐标系运动误差低于 80 mm。这些发现确立了场景对齐的人类运动学习作为面向建筑领域人形机器人运动原语（Motion primitives）的潜力。
Roofing requires workers to coordinate locomotion, balance, and work-related body motions on pitched surfaces, creating a challenging application for humanoid robots. Directly retargeted human demonstrations, however, may preserve motion appearance while placing the robot's feet or hands incorrectly relative to the roof. This study presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning roofer-style whole-body motions on a Unitree G1. Human demonstrations are captured using a tracking system and retargeted to the robot, while a metric roof model supplies the spatial reference unavailable from the tracking system. A trajectory-level optimization grounds inferred support contacts and annotated work relations to the roof, and execution-aware reinforcement learning encourages the resulting policy to preserve these relations under dynamic tracking errors. The framework is evaluated through a multi-motion tracking study, a roof-pitch coverage matrix, a five-way nailgun ablation, cross-task experiments on hammering and lateral pushing, and comparisons with pure reinforcement learning and zero-shot teleoperation. Our method enables the robot to satisfy support, work-clearance, and nonpenetration criteria across all evaluated seeds. Across nailgun, hammering, and pushing, it achieves work-clearance errors between 0.256 and 0.531 cm and 3/3 successful evaluations per task. Physical experiments reproduce uphill walking, nailgun, hammering, and bending motions with mean base-frame motion errors below 80 mm. These findings establish scene-grounded human motion learning as a promising basis for construction-oriented humanoid motion primitives.
World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion for Humanoids on Foothold-Constrained Terrain
面向落脚点受限地形的人形机器人世界模型增强视觉运动控制
落脚点受限地形（Foothold-constrained terrain）的特征在于其可行足底接触具有稀疏性、不连续性或几何局限性，例如踏脚石、跨越沟隙以及狭窄的楼梯踏板。在此类地形上，单次失误往往几乎没有挽回的余地，因此主要基于当前直观可见地形进行落脚决策的策略极易失败。我们探讨了对近期未来观测和奖励的预测性总结能否为此类场景提供所需的前瞻性信息。
我们提出了世界模型增强视觉运动控制（WM-LOCO）——一套联合训练循环世界模型（Recurrent world model）与 PPO 策略的框架。在仅依赖本体感觉和单路板载深度图像的条件下，世界模型生成预测性循环特征来引导策略，而无需任何显式的落脚点标签（Foothold labels）。
在仿真中，WM-LOCO 在对比基线彻底失效的沟隙和踏脚石地形上成功实现了穿越，并在楼梯地形上达到了与基线相当的成功率，同时提升了步幅效率并降低了骨盆加速度。我们在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上部署了相同的板载策略，仅使用板载本体感觉和单路深度流，即在所有三类地形上实现了 93.3% 的平均穿越成功率。
Foothold-constrained terrain is characterized by sparse, discontinuous, or geometrically restricted feasible foot contacts, as encountered on stepping stones, across gaps, and on narrow stair treads. On such terrain, a single misstep often leaves little room to recover, so policies that base foot-placement decisions primarily on the immediately visible terrain are prone to failure. We ask whether a learned predictive summary of near-future observations and rewards can provide the anticipatory information required in such settings. We present World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion (WM-LOCO), which jointly trains a recurrent world model and a PPO policy. Conditioned on proprioception and a single onboard depth image, the world model produces a predictive recurrent feature that guides the policy, without explicit foothold labels. In simulation, WM-LOCO succeeds on gaps and stepping stones where a matched baseline fails completely, and matches the baseline's success rate on stairs while improving stride efficiency and reducing pelvis acceleration. We deploy the same policy onboard a physical Unitree G1 humanoid using onboard proprioception and a single depth stream; it traverses all three terrain classes with an average success rate of 93.3%.
Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study
迈向建筑领域的人形机器人：遥操作可行性研究
我们展示了一套遥操作系统，该系统允许单名操作员在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上执行建筑施工任务，其结合了基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身控制与基于脚踏板的步态控制，实现了同时进行的操控与移动（Simultaneous manipulation and locomotion）。受持续的人力短缺、危险的工作环境以及人形机器人自主性挑战的驱使，我们研究了将遥操作作为一种实用的近期方案，在减少工人身体劳损的同时生成高质量的示范数据。
我们在源自 O*NET 职业数据库的两个代表性建筑任务上评估了该系统，并报告了相对于手动执行基线的任务成功率与完成时间。
该系统在工具运输任务上取得了 100% 的成功率，在表面喷涂任务上取得了 80% 的成功率，但相比于手动执行，遥操作所需的完成时间显著增加。
We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.
FootQuery: Future-Touchdown-Guided Retrieval from Depth History for Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
FootQuery：基于深度历史与未来落足点引导的感知型人形机器人运动检索
人形机器人在复杂地形上的步态运动，需要提前预判在着地瞬间可能不再可见的落脚点。由于有限的相机视角覆盖与自遮挡现象，从早期的观测数据中检索相关的地形信息显得至关重要。本文提出了 FootQuery——一套利用各足预测的下一次着地位置来查询历史深度信息的感知运动控制框架。策略通过本体感觉预测着地位置及其不确定性分布，并结合单足特征，用这些分布去检索稀疏采样的历史深度帧；在训练过程中，实际发生的接触会被投影到历史图像中，以监督对这些接触可见区域的信息检索。
检索到的单足特征与全局视觉记忆融合后生成控制动作。渐进式力量辅助课程（Progressive force-assistance curriculum）支持训练早期的探索，而事件一致的踏板中线塑造（Event-consistent tread-midline shaping）则促成了协调的楼梯接触。
实机部署仅需本体感觉与板载深度图像。在仿真中，完整框架在最具挑战性的楼梯、沟隙和平台测试中均优于其各组件消融基线；在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的真实世界实验表明，单一策略即可在户外楼梯以及结合了上下楼梯、平台与沟隙的室内路线中实现连续穿越。这些结果支持了围绕预期接触组织视觉历史以实现感知型人形机器人步态控制的路线。
Humanoid locomotion over complex terrain requires anticipating footholds that may no longer be visible at touchdown. Limited camera coverage and self-occlusion make it necessary to retrieve relevant terrain information from earlier observations. We present FootQuery, a perceptive locomotion framework that queries depth history using each foot's predicted next touchdown. The policy predicts touchdown locations and uncertainty from proprioception and uses these distributions, together with per-foot features, to query sparsely sampled historical depth frames. During training, realized contacts are projected into historical images to supervise retrieval at the regions where those contacts were visible. The retrieved per-foot features are fused with global visual memory to generate control actions. A progressive force-assistance curriculum supports early exploration, while event-consistent tread-midline shaping encourages coordinated stair contacts. Deployment requires only proprioception and onboard depth images. In simulation, the complete framework outperforms its component ablations on the most challenging tested stairs, gaps, and platforms. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 demonstrate continuous traversal with a single policy across outdoor stairs and indoor routes combining stair ascent and descent, platforms, and gaps. These results support organizing visual history around anticipated contacts for perceptive humanoid locomotion.
Introducing Humanoid Robots into Architectural Education
将人形机器人引入建筑教育
在过去二十年中，建筑学教育主要通过用于数字建造（Fabrication）的工业与协作机器人手臂（Robot arms）来引入机器人技术，并辅以成熟的参数化与可视化编程工作流。然而，近期价格亲民的通用人形机器人的普及，标志着教学重心向具身智能（Embodied AI）的转移，从而对这些既有范式发起了挑战。与固定式的机器人手臂不同，人形机器人作为具备移动能力的人尺度的智能体（Human-scale agents）运行，需要建筑学课程体系中原本较为陌生的全身控制（Whole-body control）方法。本文提出了一套教学法框架，将人形机器人作为“设计智能体”（Design agents）而非单纯的“建造工具”引入建筑学教育。
该框架在一门高级研讨课中通过原型开发和最终的交互式装置进行了测试：在该装置中，人形机器人通过自身运动来重新编排空间元素；学生们编写控制代码，在 MuJoCo 仿真器中模拟机器人行为，并将其迁移至物理实体机器人上，从而在仿真模拟、材料测试与空间设计之间建立了反馈闭环。
研究结果表明，人形机器人推动了设计范式从预设的静态几何形状向交互驱动的空间动态转换（Interaction-driven spatial transformation）演进。基于后数字时代的设计讨论（Post-digital design discourse），本文将人形机器人构建为通过具身交互生成建筑知识的新型媒介。
Over the past two decades, architectural education has integrated robotics primarily through industrial and collaborative robot arms used for fabrication, supported by established parametric and visual programming workflows. The recent availability of affordable, general-purpose humanoid robots marks a shift toward embodied AI in teaching, challenging these established models. Unlike robot arms, humanoids operate as mobile, human-scale agents and require full-body control methods unfamiliar to architectural curricula. This paper proposes a pedagogical framework that introduces humanoid robots into architectural education as design agents rather than fabrication tools. The framework is tested in an advanced seminar through prototyping and a final interactive installation, in which a humanoid robot rearranges spatial elements through movement. Students develop control code, simulate behaviours in MuJoCo, and transfer them to the physical robot, establishing a feedback loop between simulation, material testing, and spatial
design. The findings indicate that humanoid robots shift design from predefined geometry toward interaction-driven spatial transformation. Building on post-digital design discourse, the paper frames humanoid robots as generators of architectural knowledge emerging through embodied interaction.
Blind Dexterity: Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Pure Proprioception
盲操灵活性：基于纯本体感知的全身人形机器人操作
我们展示了在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上仅利用板载本体感觉（Onboard proprioception）实现的盲操全身操控技能（Blind, whole-body manipulation skills），全程无需相机、反光标记点、力矩传感器或触觉传感器。尽管感知配置如此极简，所训练的策略在多种性质截然不同的任务中展现出了惊人的能力：包括无需 IMU 反馈的抗推挤双足行走、用脚主动接捕足球、搜寻并通过提手提起行李箱，以及登上随机放置的滑板。
我们认为，这些能力源于一个关键却长期被低估的信号：在有目的的顺应性接触（Compliant contact）下关节编码器读数的演化方式，这实质上构成了一个“全身触觉通道”。通过生成密集的接触运动，训练出的策略能够主动探查环境；因此，与任务相关的物体状态（如位姿）在短暂的本体感觉历史序列中变得越来越容易被解算。我们利用与策略并行训练但完全独立的紧凑型任务特定状态估计器（Task-specific state estimators）揭示了这一信息——在产生有效接触后，其预测误差呈现出急剧下降的趋势。
我们的实验结果表明，基于关节编码器的本体感觉结合顺应性驱动（目前已在商用机器人和低成本电机上广泛普及），本身就已经是一个强大且实用的全身灵巧操控与交互式感知（Interactive perception）基底，因而是叠加更丰富传感器套件的天然基石。
We present blind, whole-body manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid using only onboard proprioception, without cameras, markers, force-torque, or tactile sensors. Despite this minimal sensing, the trained policies exhibit surprising capability across qualitatively different tasks: push-resilient bipedal walking without IMU feedback, active soccer ball trapping with a foot, seeking and lifting a suitcase by its handle, and mounting a randomly positioned skateboard.
We argue that these capabilities arise from a key underappreciated signal: the way the joint encoder readouts evolve under purposeful compliant contact, effectively forming a whole-body tactile channel. By generating contact-rich motions, the trained policies actively probe the environment; as a result, task-relevant object state (e.g. pose) becomes increasingly decodable from short proprioceptive histories. We expose this information using compact task-specific state estimators trained alongside, but fully separately from, the policies; their prediction errors decrease rapidly after informative contact.
Our results indicate that joint encoder-based proprioception, combined with compliant actuation—now widely available on commercial robots and low-cost motors—is already a strong, practical substrate for whole-body dexterous manipulation and interactive perception, and therefore a natural foundation on which richer sensing can be layered.
Keep the Flow: Continuous High-Precision Bimanual Manipulation in Constrained Spaces
保持流畅：受限空间内连续高精度双手动操作
近期的机器人数据集推动了通用策略（Generalist policies）的规模化扩展，但大多数数据集缺乏用于精准物体放置的严格度量约束（Metric constraints）。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 Keep the Flow——一个专为空间受限操控（Spatially constrained manipulation）设计的真实世界双臂人形机器人数据集。我们通过在配备了 Dex3-1 三指灵巧手的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上使用虚拟现实（VR）遥操作来采集这些示范数据，内容涵盖单排（Single-row）和多排（Multi-row）两种任务队列形态。
为了确保高精度的标注质量，一个自动化的头顶 RGB-D 校验闭环（Verification loop）会自动过滤掉最终放置误差超过 2 cm 的示范数据。
此外，我们开发了一套保持“动作-状态”一致性（Action-state-preserving）的视觉增强流水线，该流水线将基于 SAM2 的物体重新配色与工作空间网格消除技术相结合。
Recent robotic datasets have scaled generalist policies, but most lack strict metric constraints for precise object placement. To address this, we introduce Keep the Flow, a real-world bimanual humanoid dataset explicitly designed for spatially constrained manipulation. We collect these demonstrations via VR teleoperation on a Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with three-fingered Dex3-1 hands, covering both Single-row and Multi-row task formations. To ensure high-precision annotations, an automated overhead RGB-D verification loop filters out demonstrations whose final placement error exceeds 2 cm. Furthermore, we develop an action-state-preserving visual augmentation pipeline that combines SAM2-based object recoloring with workspace grid removal.
Dense Temporal Motion Retargeting for Legged Robots
面向腿式机器人的稠密时序运动重定向
足式机器人可以从人类和动物的运动中学习丰富的全身技能。然而，由于源对象与机器人之间的形态差异（Morphology gap），运动必须针对机器人的动力学特性进行定制。特别是像跳跃这样的动态运动需要仔细调整，因为它们的时序（Timing）和控制是相互依赖的。我们提出了密集时序运动重定向（DTMR），它在单个优化中联合优化时序与控制，其中“密集”意味着对每个控制步骤都调整时序。这种密集表述使 DTMR 能够仅变形（Deform）运动中需要更改时序的部分。该问题在 GPU 上通过基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）并行求解。
我们在 4 台人形机器人的 2 小时人类运动数据上将 DTMR 与基线进行了比较评估，结果表明 DTMR 优于基线方法，特别是在动态运动上；我们还表明，允许更多的时序变形可以获得更精确的重定向。
我们进一步将 DTMR 与优化时序维度的基线进行了比较，结果表明在相同的变形预算下，DTMR 的重定向更加精确，同时速度快了约 19 倍；最后，在我们的参考轨迹上训练的策略成功迁移到了真实的人形机器人上。
Legged robots can learn expressive whole-body skills from the motions of humans and animals. Due to the morphology gap between the source and the robot, however, the motion must be tailored to the dynamic properties of the robot. In particular, dynamic motions such as a jump require careful adjustment, since their timing and control are interdependent. We propose dense temporal motion retargeting (DTMR), which jointly optimizes timing and control within a single optimization, where dense means that the timing is adjusted for every control step. This dense formulation enables DTMR to deform only the parts of the motion that need a change in timing. The problem is solved with sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) in parallel on a GPU. We evaluate DTMR against baselines on two hours of human motion with four humanoid robots, where the results show that DTMR outperforms baseline methods, particularly on dynamic motions. We also show that allowing more temporal deformation yields more precise retargeting. We further compare DTMR with a baseline that optimizes the temporal dimension, where the result shows that DTMR retargets more precisely under the same deformation budget while being ~19x faster. Lastly, policies trained on our references transfer to a real humanoid robot.
GLoRI: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Tracking with Global-Local Reference Interaction for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
GLoRI：面向人形机器人移动操作的、结合全局-局部参考交互的闭环全身追踪
人形机器人的移动操控（Loco-manipulation）需要在世界坐标系中进行精确的全身运动跟踪以实现物理交互。尽管局部参考信号能够保留运动结构，但它们缺乏对绝对空间位置的显式约束，从而导致全局累积误差。现有的具备全局意识的方法虽然为遥操作策略补充了全局观测，但并未将全局纠偏与局部运动引导进行显式集成，从而限制了自主跟踪精度。本文提出了 GLoRI——一套将结构化全局参考与反馈同局部运动引导深度集成的闭环全身控制器；其核心网络 GLoRI-Net 利用全局-局部交叉注意力（GLCA）机制，使用全局目标与姿态差异特征来精炼局部关键点特征，在保持运动结构的同时纠正了世界坐标系下的位置偏差。
GLoRI 在未见过的 HuMoTo 运动数据集上实现了 100% 的完成率以及 6.44 cm 的全局每关节位置误差（g-MPJPE）。
在无需任何微调的情况下，该精度在从 Isaac Gym 到 MuJoCo 的直接物理迁移中保持了强大的鲁棒性，展现出极佳的泛化能力；此外，这种高精度与泛化能力使得单策略在真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上与多种未见过物体进行自主移动操控成为可能，超越了此前主要依赖遥操作或仅专注于单一物体交互的系统。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires accurate whole-body motion tracking in the world frame for physical interaction. While local references preserve motion structure, they lack explicit constraints on absolute spatial placement, leading to accumulated global errors. Existing globally aware approaches augment teleoperation policies with global observations but do not explicitly integrate global correction with local motion guidance, limiting autonomous tracking accuracy. We present GLoRI, a closed-loop whole-body controller that integrates structured global reference and feedback with local motion guidance. Its GLoRI-Net uses Global-Local Cross Attention(GLCA) to refine local keypoint features with global target and pose-difference features, preserving motion structure while correcting world-frame placement. GLoRI achieves 100% completion and a g-MPJPE of 6.44cm on held-out HuMoTo motions. This accuracy remains robust under direct Isaac Gym-to-MuJoCo transfer without fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization. Furthermore, such accuracy and generalization enable autonomous loco-manipulation with a single policy on a real Unitree G1 interacting with diverse unseen objects, extending beyond prior systems that primarily rely on teleoperation or focus on single-object interactions.
Generate, Track, Improve: Perceptive Multi-Skill Humanoid Locomotion with RL-Fine-Tuned Motion Generators
生成、追踪与优化：基于强化学习微调运动生成器的感知型多技能人形机器人运动
通用人形机器人需要具备多技能、具感知力、高动态且鲁棒的步态控制器，以达到能够深入人类所及之处的程度。在本文中，我们提出了一套两层步态控制架构：(1) 一个感知流匹配运动生成器（Perceptive flow matching motion generator），用于从原始深度图像中规划全身运动轨迹；(2) 一个通过控制引导强化学习（Control-guided RL）训练的感知跟踪策略，用于精确执行这些运动。这两个策略均在一个由动态优化的人类数据创建的地形一致性运动片段库上进行训练，从而能够同时提供精确的速度跟踪与符合地形特征的参考轨迹。
我们的核心贡献在于一个简单而有效的离策略强化学习（Off-policy RL）微调闭环，用于持续提升运动生成器的性能。该闭环利用结构化搜索方法从生成器中采集数据，并结合优势加权回归（Advantage Weighted Regression, AWR）进行优化；相比于在策略残差微调（On-policy residual fine-tuning），这种离策略闭环具有更高的样本效率，并显著增强了策略在未见过几何地形与技能组合上的地形一致性。实验表明，成功穿越地形的比例最高提升了 25 个百分点，技能选择的准确率最高提升了 80 个百分点。
通过直接利用原始深度图像感知环境，该框架无需依赖里程计（Odometry）或高度图（Height maps），从而使户外部署变得十分顺畅。借助双相机配置，策略能够提前观测到更远处的地形，并无视指令速度自动调整自身步态速度以顺利穿越地形。最终，仅凭单一策略对即可使宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人在户外环境中实现行走、跑步、站立、跳上跳下箱子以及上下楼梯等多重动态技能。
General purpose humanoids require locomotion controllers that are multi-skill, perceptive, dynamic, and robust enough to go anywhere humans can. In this work, we present a two layer locomotion architecture: (1) a perceptive flow matching motion generator plans whole body trajectories from raw depth images while a (2) perceptive tracking policy trained with control-guided RL follows these motions. Both policies are trained on a library of terrain consistent motion clips created with dynamically optimized human data which yields both accurate velocity tracking and terrain consistent references. Our central contribution is a simple yet effective off-policy RL fine tuning loop that improves the motion generator. A structured search method is used with the generator to gather data for advantage weighted regression. This off-policy loop is
much more sample efficient than on-policy residual fine tuning and improves terrain consistency on unseen geometries and skill compositions. We find that successful terrain traversals increased by up to 25 percentage points and skill selection improved by up to 80 percentage points. By using raw depth images to perceive the environment no odometry or height maps are needed, and outdoor deployment is easy. With two cameras, the policy can see terrain coming from further away and adjust its velocity regardless of the commanded speed so it can traverse
the terrain. A single policy pair enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to walk, run, stand, jump on and off of boxes, and traverse stairs in outdoor environments.
Smoothness as a Constraint for Stable Humanoid Locomotion
作为稳定人形机器人运动约束的平滑性
具身智能系统（尤其是在真实世界场景中部署的人形机器人）需要同时具备任务响应敏捷性与物理平顺性（Physically smooth）的全身控制策略。然而，平顺性在全身各部位并非均匀分布：下半身必须保持足够的响应度以维持动态平衡，而上半身则必须受到严格调控以保护系统稳定性。现有的强化学习方法通常通过奖励函数中的辅助项来施加平顺性约束，这不仅会与任务目标发生竞争，还会将躯干视为均匀整体，且无法直接控制决定平顺行为的物理量。
我们提出了 DeCap（解耦约束感知策略，Decoupled Constraint-aware policy）——一种约束强化学习算法，它将全身平顺性解耦为独立的上半身与下半身约束组，并将每组平顺性显式表述为对物理运动极限的约束。为了提高可选项边界附近的约束满足度，DeCap 引入了一种有界壁垒惩罚（Bounded barrier penalty），该惩罚在接近极限时主动激活，并在约束边界处保持有界。
在真实世界人形机器人全身控制任务中，相比于基于奖励的平顺性策略，DeCap 将上半身动作变化率（Action rate）降低了 2.50 倍，加速度降低了 2.18 倍，同时改善了下半身平顺性并减少了瞬态运动。我们证明了一组固定的平顺性约束可以在多种复杂地形间直接迁移，从而极大地减轻了对繁琐奖励调优的依赖。
Embodied AI systems, particularly humanoid robots deployed in real world scenarios require whole-body control policies that are both task-responsive and physically smooth. However, smoothness is not uniform across the body: lower body must remain sufficiently reactive, while the upper body must be tightly regulated to preserve stability. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically impose smoothness through auxiliary terms in the reward function, which compete with task objectives, treating the body as uniform and provide no direct control over the physical quantities responsible for smooth behavior. We introduce DeCap (Decoupled Constraint-aware policy), a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into separate upper- and lower-body constraint groups, each formulates smoothness as explicit constraints on physical motion limits. To improve constraint satisfaction near feasibility boundaries, DeCap incorporates a bounded barrier penalty that activates proactively as limits are approached and remains bounded at the constraint limit. On real-world humanoid whole-body control task, DeCap reduces upper-body action rate by 2.50x and acceleration by 2.18x relative to reward-based smoothness policies, while also improving lower-body smoothness and reducing transient motion. We demonstrate that a fixed set of smoothness constraints transfers across diverse terrains, alleviating the need of extensive reward tuning.
RoboAssist: Interactive Human-Humanoid Planning for Long-Horizon Surgical Assistance
RoboAssist：面向长时程手术辅助的人机交互式规划
长时序手术辅助（Long-horizon surgical assistance）要求人形机器人在整个规划与执行过程中，不仅能与不断演化的人类活动保持协同，还能确保物理与操作安全。我们提出了 RoboAssist——一个用于人-人形机器人交互式规划的基于 Agent 的框架，它集成了工作流推理（Workflow reasoning）、任务协调与跨层安全保障。该框架的核心是一个非对称双轨表示（Asymmetric dual-track representation），将部分可观察的人类工序状态与可执行的机器人任务序列进行解耦。通过在线更新人类工序估计、场景上下文与任务依赖关系，RoboAssist 在工作流请求发生变更时重新验证剩余任务序列，并仅对受影响的后缀任务进行重规划（Suffix replanning）。
框架引入了跨层安全架构（Cross-layer safety architecture），将预防性导航监管、近距离交付过程中的响应式监管以及独立的全身运行时监督（Whole-body runtime supervision）融为一体。这种设计将在线任务协调与整个执行过程中的安全约束紧密耦合。
我们在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上演示了该框架，测试场景涵盖多模态交互、手术器械操控、医疗物资运输、导航以及安全的人机交付等长时序、多阶段的模拟手术辅助任务。实验表明，该系统能够成功完成多阶段任务并适应工作流请求的动态变更；针对全量重规划的对比消融实验显示，残差重规划（Residual replanning）显著降低了计划更新的时延与更新后的 Token 消耗；独立的安全实验证明了系统在导航、交付和运行时监督方面的互补保护能力。
Long-horizon surgical assistance requires humanoid robots to coordinate with evolving human activities while maintaining safety across planning and execution. We present RoboAssist, an agent-based framework for interactive human-humanoid planning that integrates workflow reasoning, task coordination, and cross-layer safety. At its core is an asymmetric dual-track representation that separates partially observed human process states from executable robot task sequences. By updating human-process estimates, scene context, and task dependencies online, RoboAssist revalidates the remaining task sequence and replans only the affected suffix when workflow requests change. A cross-layer safety architecture combines preventive navigation regulation, reactive regulation during close-range handover, and independent whole-body runtime supervision. This design couples online task coordination with safety constraints throughout execution.
