We demonstrate the framework on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot in long-horizon, multi-stage simulated surgical assistance scenarios encompassing multimodal interaction, instrument handling, medical material transport, navigation, and safe human-robot handover. Experiments show multi-stage task completion and adaptation to workflow-request changes. A targeted full-replanning ablation shows that residual replanning reduces plan-update latency and post-update token usage. Separate safety experiments demonstrate complementary protection across navigation, handover, and runtime supervision.
Continual Humanoid Motion Learning
持续性人形机器人运动学习
人形机器人全身控制器（Whole-body controllers）目前已能够跟踪多种高动态运动，但这些控制器通常在离线训练完成后即被冻结；若直接向其教授新技能，往往会侵蚀其已掌握的已有技能。我们深入研究了人形机器人全身运动的持续学习（Continual learning）问题——即单个控制器必须从顺序输入的任务流中不断获取新技能，同时不得重新访问历史训练数据。为此，我们提出了 Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN：一种基于渐进式神经网络（Progressive Neural Network, PNN）的策略网络，该架构从结构设计上彻底杜绝了灾难性遗忘（Catastrophic forgetting），并通过轻量级的低秩适应（Low-Rank Adaptation, LoRA）技术实现了跨技能的知识复用。
框架核心引入了双层运动相似度度量（Two-level motion-similarity measure），该度量由结合最优传输（Optimal Transport）聚合的动态时间规整（Dynamic Time Warping, DTW）构建而成；它能够智能判定新技能应当基于哪一项已有技能进行扩展，以及需要分配多少新增网络容量，从而带来强大的正向迁移（Forward transfer）与显著的计算效率提升。
在涵盖六种顺序学习技能类别的对比实验中，我们基于相似度引导的 LoRA 策略获得了所有方法中最佳的正向迁移能力（0.125 对比 0.079）以及最高 平均准确率，同时节省了高达 94.5% 的可训练参数量和 40.8% 的训练时间。最终训练出的控制器达到了 96.13% 的仿真到仿真（Sim-to-Sim）迁移成功率，并已成功部署至物理宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人实机上。
Humanoid whole-body controllers can now track a diverse set of dynamic motions, but they are typically trained offline and then frozen, so teaching such a controller a new skill tends to erode the skills it already mastered. We study continual learning for humanoid whole-body motion, where a single controller must acquire skills from a sequential task stream without revisiting past data. We introduce Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN, a progressive neural network (PNN) policy that prevents catastrophic forgetting by construction while reusing knowledge across skills through lightweight low-rank adaptation. A two-level motion-similarity measure, built from dynamic time warping aggregated by optimal transport, decides which prior skill to build on and how much new capacity to allocate, yielding strong forward transfer and large efficiency gains. Across six sequentially learned skill categories, our similarity-guided LoRA policy attains the best forward transfer (0.125 vs. 0.079) and the highest average accuracy among all methods, while saving up to 94.5% of trainable parameters and 40.8% of training time. The resulting controller reaches 96.13% sim-to-sim transfer and is deployed on a physical Unitree G1.
GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
GAE：用于实时人形机器人遥操作的通用动作专家
人形具身分身（Humanoid avatars）拓展了人类的物理存在，使人们能够通过遥控机器人参与社交、服务与劳作活动；这需要遥控系统在保持响应敏捷的人机同步性的同时，能够实现丰富多样且高动态的全身行为。本文提出了通用动作专家（General Action Expert, GAE）——一套用于通用、低延迟人形机器人全身遥操作的统一学习框架。为了覆盖多样化的人类行为，GAE 从视频、动画及运动捕捉等异构数据源构建了大规模人类运动数据集，并进行了标准化与数据增强处理。
为了解决人类运动数据中的噪声与身体形态不匹配（Embodiment mismatch）问题，GAE 采用了一种两阶段训练范式：首先由特权生成器策略（Privileged generator policy）在仿真中跟踪人类运动参考轨迹，并推演产生物理可行的机器人轨迹；随后由可部署的执行器策略（Deployable executor policy）在课程领域随机化（Curriculum domain randomization）下学习跟踪这些生成的可行轨迹。
为了实现响应敏捷的人机同步，GAE 引入了延迟条件预判机制（Latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism），在实时遥操作过程中自适应地补偿端到端延迟。在宇树 Unitree G1 和西湖大学 Westlake O1 机器人上的仿真与真实世界实验表明，GAE 能够使人形机器人顺畅地复现多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为。
Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors
ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots
ViLoMan：为人形机器人学习视觉-本体感知全身移动与操作技能
人形机器人的移动操控（Loco-manipulation）需要自适应的全身协调，以实现步态移动与物理交互的无缝融合。尽管近期取得了长足进展，但由于缺乏多样化且物理上可执行的“机器人-物体”交互数据，以及直接从板载观测数据中学习统一全身控制的困难性，学习自主移动操控依然极具挑战。本文提出了 ViLoMan——一套用于自主人形机器人移动操控的可扩展框架；ViLoMan 首先将人类-物体交互的部分运动学示范转换为完整且物理上可执行的机器人轨迹，随后在一个“教师-学生”蒸馏框架（Teacher-student distillation framework）中利用这些轨迹，训练出一个将自我中心深度观测与本体感觉测量直接映射到关节级全身动作的统一策略；在部署期间，该策略既不需要参考运动信号，也不需要中间指令。
我们在多种门体配置及机器人初始条件下，通过关门任务在仿真与真实世界中对 ViLoMan 进行了评估。
实验结果表明，仅凭单一策略即可使宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人仅利用板载深度感知与本体感觉来完成全部任务，同时在面对任务变体时展现出强大的鲁棒泛化能力，并成功实现了高效的“仿真到现实”（Sim-to-Real）迁移。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation. ViLoMan first transforms partial kinematic demonstrations of human-object interactions into complete, physically executable robot trajectories. It then leverages these trajectories within a teacher-student distillation framework to learn a unified policy that maps egocentric depth observations and proprioceptive measurements directly to joint-level whole-body actions. During deployment, the policy requires neither reference motions nor intermediate commands. We evaluate ViLoMan on door-closing tasks across diverse door configurations and robot initial conditions in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that a single policy enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to complete the full task using only onboard depth sensing and proprioception, while generalizing robustly across task variations and transferring effectively from simulation to reality.
PGMT: Perceptive General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots
PGMT：面向人形机器人的感知型通用运动追踪
人形机器人运动跟踪器（Motion trackers）能够复现多样化的全身运动，但在地形无关的参考运动在物理上不可行（Physically infeasible）的复杂地形上，其性能会发生显著退化。本文提出了 PGMT（感知通用运动跟踪管线，Perceptive General Motion Tracking），这是一套适用于人形机器人的感知通用运动跟踪框架，能够从独立选择的参考运动与地形组合中学习地形自适应能力。PGMT 首先学习一个通用跟踪与跌倒恢复先验（Tracking and recovery prior），随后通过动作条件地形局部观测（Motion-conditioned terrain glimpses）整合地形感知信息，该机制可选择性地编码与当前运动相关的关键区域。
框架引入了地形感知跟踪放松机制（Terrain-aware tracking relaxation），该机制允许策略在保留原始运动意图的同时产生必要的轨迹偏离，以适应复杂地形。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的零样本（Zero-shot）物理部署表明，PGMT 实现了鲁棒的地形自适应步态与全身运动执行，能够穿越高达 37 cm 障碍物的真实地形，同时支持遥操作、动态运动跟踪以及跌倒恢复。PGMT 将通用人形机器人运动跟踪能力成功拓宽至平地之外，为复杂环境下的地形自适应步态、多样化全身行为及遥操作提供了统一策略。
Humanoid motion trackers can reproduce diverse whole-body motions, but their performance degrades on complex terrain where terrain-agnostic references become physically infeasible. We present PGMT, a Perceptive General Motion Tracking pipeline for humanoid robots that learns terrain adaptation from independently selected motion references and terrains. PGMT first learns a general tracking and recovery prior, then incorporates terrain perception through motion-conditioned terrain glimpses that selectively encode regions relevant to the current motion. Terrain-aware tracking relaxation allows necessary deviations from the reference while preserving its motion intent. Zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates robust terrain-adaptive locomotion and whole-body motion execution over real-world terrain with obstacles up to 37 cm high, while supporting teleoperation, dynamic motion tracking, and fall recovery. PGMT extends general humanoid motion tracking beyond flat ground, providing a unified policy for terrain-adaptive locomotion, diverse whole-body behaviors, and teleoperation in complex environments.
TactileStep: Sole Tactile Learning for Regulating Foot-Terrain Interaction in Humanoid Locomotion
TactileStep：用于调节人形机器人运动中足部与地形交互的足底触觉学习方法
人形机器人跑酷（Parkour）策略能够穿越多种复杂地形，但任务的成功完成往往掩盖了剧烈着地（Harsh landings）、边缘接触不稳以及站立接触面积不足等隐患。人类能自然地通过触觉反馈调节足底与地形的交互，并根据地形刚度实时调制接触顺应性（Contact compliance）——这揭示了人类与人形机器人之间的一个关键领域鸿沟（Domain gap）：绝大多数人形系统缺乏丰富的足底触觉感知能力。
为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 TactileStep——一套可部署的触觉学习框架，该框架将足底压力感知（Sole pressure sensing）引入人形机器人运动控制中，以实现更柔和的着地和更稳固的站立支撑。TactileStep 在物理仿真中对触觉信号进行精准对齐，使其匹配真实足底压力阵列（Pressure insole）的数据特征，从而确保策略能够在软硬件一致的接触特征下学习；在训练过程中，系统利用触觉与运动线索智能识别不同的足底接触阶段（Foot-contact phases），并施加阶段感知的奖励函数（Phase-aware rewards），以引导策略实现更安全的着地与更平稳的支撑。
在仿真环境以及宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实机评估表明，与强感知对比基线相比，TactileStep 将峰值着地冲击力（Peak touchdown force）降低了最高 48.8%，将 A 计权峰值冲击噪声（Peak A-weighted impact noise）降低了最高 30.1 dB，同时将站立接触面积提升了最高 23.8%。
Humanoid parkour policies can traverse various terrains, but task completion may mask challenges of harsh landings, edge contacts, and unstable stance contacts. Humans naturally regulate foot-terrain interaction through tactile feedback, modulating contact compliance according to terrain stiffness. This highlights a key domain gap between humans and humanoid robots: the absence of rich tactile sensing in most humanoid systems. We address this problem with TactileStep, a deployable tactile learning framework that brings sole pressure sensing into humanoid locomotion control for softer touchdowns and more stable support. TactileStep aligns tactile simulation with the real pressure insole, allowing the policy to learn from the same contact features available on hardware. During training, we use tactile and motion cues to recognize different foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards that encourage safer landing and more stable stance. Evaluated in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid across diverse terrains, TactileStep reduces peak touchdown force by up to 48.8% and peak A-weighted impact noise by up to 30.1 dB over a strong perceptive baseline, while increasing stance contact area by up to 23.8%.
Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoids with Learned Point Cloud Correspondence
基于学习型点云对应关系的仿人机器人统一运动重定向
人形机器人学习越来越依赖于将海量且多样化的人类运动数据转化为高质量的机器人参考轨迹。然而，由于人类与机器人之间在形态（Morphology）、自由度（Degrees of Freedom）、关节范围以及运动学约束方面存在巨大差异，将人类运动重定向（Retargeting）至人形机器人极具挑战性。现有的重定向方法通常通过人工设计的稀疏关键点或身体部位对（Body-part pairs）来构建人机对应关系，导致重定向质量高度依赖于手动语义设计；这限制了其在不同运动数据源与机器人形态上的可扩展性，并且只能为复现精细姿态与物理交互提供稀疏的引导。
本文提出了统一运动重定向（Unified Motion Retargeting, UMR）——一个无需人工设计人机映射关系即可学习密集点云对应关系（Dense point cloud correspondence）的框架；UMR 将外表点云视为人类运动与人形机器人之间的统一接口，从而将重定向过程与特定数据源的骨骼语义以及特定机器人的拓扑结构解耦。所学习到的密集对应关系为受约束的点云匹配优化提供了细粒度的几何锚点，从而实现了表面级别的姿态对齐（Surface-level pose alignment）以及交互接触的直接迁移。
实验表明，UMR 在异构运动数据源、不同的机器人具身形态（Robot embodiments）以及从步态行走到物理交互的下游场景中统一了运动重定向过程；相比于现有最先进（SOTA）方法，UMR 达到了更高的运动保真度（Motion fidelity）与物理合理性（Plausibility）。因此，UMR 为将大规模人类运动参考转化为机器人就绪（Robot-ready）的训练数据奠定了可扩展的基础。
Humanoid learning increasingly relies on transforming vast and diverse human motion data into high-quality robot reference trajectories. However, retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is challenging due to substantial differences in morphology, degrees of freedom, joint ranges, and kinematic constraints between humans and robots. Existing retargeting methods typically address these differences by defining human-robot correspondence through hand-crafted sparse keypoints or body-part pairs. As a result, retargeting quality depends heavily on manual semantic design, limiting scalability across motion sources and robot morphologies and providing only sparse guidance for reproducing detailed poses and interactions. In this paper, we present Unified Motion Retargeting (UMR), a framework that learns dense point cloud correspondence without requiring manually designed human-robot mappings. By treating exterior point clouds as a unified interface between human motion and humanoid robots, UMR decouples retargeting from source-specific skeletal semantics and robot-specific topology. The learned dense correspondence provides fine-grained geometric anchors for constrained point cloud matching optimization, enabling surface-level pose alignment and direct transfer of interaction contacts. Experiments demonstrate that UMR unifies retargeting across heterogeneous motion sources, robot embodiments, and downstream scenarios ranging from locomotion to interaction, while achieving higher motion fidelity and plausibility than state-of-the-art methods. UMR therefore provides a scalable foundation for transforming large-scale human motion references into robot-ready training data.
Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
基于运动控制的类人机器人足球：多向踢球动作库的任务门控强化学习
近期的人形机器人足球系统普遍将运动跟踪（Motion tracking）作为底座，并从中推导出步态运动，通常的做法是将运动参考锚点（Motion-reference anchor）引导驶向足球。这种做法虽然能取得出色的射门效果，但步态运动仅在“接近足球”所引发的狭窄且确定性的指令分布上进行训练，从未作为一项独立的能力接受过评估。
我们反转了这一控制栈结构：首先训练一个通用、基于指令条件（Command-conditioned）的步态策略作为底座，随后将 $N$ 个基于运动引导的踢球技能作为任务门控层（Task-gated layers）叠加其上；因此，机器人可达的步态空间是由步态课程（Locomotion curriculum）决定的，而非取决于任何参考运动片段。由于每个踢球技能均从这一相同的可控状态出发并最终返回该状态，步态控制同时充当了技能组合的中枢（使切换复杂度从 $O(N^2)$ 降低至 $O(N)$），并且踢球后的出球稳定性重构交还给了已训练的控制器，而非为每个动作片段逐个进行脚本化预设。
我们在拥有 29 个自由度的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实例化了该架构，配备了 7 个重定向的踢球技能，覆盖了 259.5 度的标称瞄准方向范围，包含侧向踢球、后向踢球以及弱侧脚击球等单一前向参考轨迹无法表达的动作。我们汇报了在挂载完整技能库条件下的射门精度、指令跟踪性能、地形适应力以及抗推挤恢复结果——而这一多维度的评估轴线是以往人形机器人足球系统未曾报道过的。该技能库已在硬件实机上通过前向、侧向、后向及受控接近等多种路径进行了全面验证。
Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.
HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
HumanoidToolBench：从工具选择到移动执行的人形机器人工具使用基准测试
随着机器人硬件与学习方法的不断进步，人形机器人需要借助工具来执行超越其固有物理极限的任务。成功的工具使用既需要挑选合适的工具，又需要在必要时协同手部操控（Manipulation）与步态移动（Locomotion）以完成任务；然而，现有的基准测试（Benchmarks）尚未在人形机器人上对这些能力进行联合评估。
为此，我们提出了 HumanoidToolBench——一个涵盖 3 个应用场景、3 个执行层级和 2 种工具集模式的 18 任务基准测试；同时推出了 ToolBook 数据集，包含在仿真环境及真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上采集的 3,100 条示范数据。
在仿真中对 7 种策略以及在实机上对 3 种策略的评估结果表明，在“选择合适工具”与“成功完成任务”之间仍存在巨大的性能鸿沟；进一步对 GR00T N1.7 大模型进行的探针测试（Probes）揭示：策略在面对未见过的工具时工具选择准确率会显著下降，并且在接收到无关指令时仍会盲目继续执行任务。
As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions.
HOTICE: Whole-Body Humanoid Object Transportation in Cluttered Environments
HOTICE：杂乱环境下的全身人形物体搬运
物体搬运（Object transportation）是人形机器人在以人为中心的真实环境中运行的基本能力，然而当杂乱环境（Clutter）同时限制机器人与其所携带物体的自由空间时，现有的方法往往难以应对。本文提出了 Hotice——一套用于在杂乱环境中搬运物体的全身人形机器人学习框架。首先，我们引入了人形机器人-物体解耦势场（Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields），该机制联合编码了机器人与携带物体的避障引导信息，从而实现了两者的协同与障碍物感知运动。
其次，为了解决全身移动操控（Whole-body loco-manipulation）固有的庞大动作空间问题，我们设计了一套双 Agent 强化学习架构（Dual-agent RL architecture），该架构将上下半身控制进行解耦，同时通过共享状态观测与奖励维持全身协调；为了训练出能够在多种杂乱场景中泛化的策略，我们进一步采用了“专家到通用”（Specialist-to-generalist）蒸馏策略，将具备特权信息的教师策略蒸馏为单一可部署的学生策略。
我们在 MuJoCo 仿真和真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上对 Hotice 进行了评估，展示了针对不同形状物体在杂乱场景下的高效且鲁棒的搬运能力。实验结果表明，Hotice 能够可靠地协同全身运动与物体感知的避障动作，有效泛化至未见过的杂乱环境，并在“仿真到现实”（Sim-to-Real）部署中展现出优异的性能。
Object transportation is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots operating in real-world, human-centric environments, yet existing methods struggle when clutter constrains free space around both the robot and its carried payload. We present Hotice, a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects through such cluttered environments. First, we introduce Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields, which jointly encode collision-avoidance guidance for the robot and the carried object, enabling coordinated, obstacle-aware motion for both. Second, to address the large action space inherent to whole-body loco-manipulation, we design a dual-agent reinforcement learning architecture that decouples upper- and lower-body control while preserving whole-body coordination via shared state observations and rewards. To train a policy that generalizes across diverse cluttered scenes, we further employ a specialist-to-generalist distillation strategy, in which privileged teacher policies are distilled into a single deployable student policy. We evaluate Hotice in MuJoCo simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating effective and robust object transportation across cluttered scenarios for objects of varying shapes. Our results show that Hotice reliably coordinates whole-body motion and object-aware collision avoidance, generalizing effectively to previously unseen cluttered environments while achieving strong performance in sim2real deployment.
Learning Scene-Aware Humanoid Locomotion through 3D Clutter from Immersive Human Demonstrations
通过沉浸式人类演示学习在三维杂乱环境中的场景感知人形机器人运动
通过从人类运动中学习，人形机器人已能在无障碍空间中实现如舞蹈、武术等高动态技能，但在密集杂乱环境（Densely cluttered environments）中的穿行能力依然缺乏深入探索。此类空间具有三维特征且受几何条件高度约束，要求机器人具备能够将全身运动与场景几何紧密耦合的场景感知步态（Scene-aware locomotion），以实现高精度的避障。
为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 Moving Through Clutter (MTC)——一个用于场景感知人形机器人步态控制的示范学习（Learning-from-demonstration）框架；为避开高成本的物理场景搭建，MTC 利用程序化生成的虚拟现实（VR）环境进行沉浸式数据采集；为了将这些人类运动转化为可直接用于训练的人形机器人运动，我们提出了一种场景感知运动重定向算法（Scene-aware motion retargeting algorithm），该算法在将人类示范转换为机器人轨迹的同时，严格施加“机器人-场景”安全间隙约束，以确保无碰撞穿行。
这些生成的参考轨迹随后被用于训练场景感知步态策略，并最终部署于宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。在本文提出的多障碍物穿行基准 MTC-Challenge 上进行的评估表明，该策略在多种复杂场景中实现了 70.2% 的无碰撞穿行成功率，成功通过多样化的全身技能（包括在低净空通道中匍匐爬行以及挤过狭窄缝隙等）完成了复杂环境的穿越。
While learning from human motions has enabled highly dynamic humanoid skills such as dancing and martial arts in obstacle-free space, traversal through densely cluttered environments remains underexplored. These spaces are three-dimensional and geometrically constrained, requiring scene-aware locomotion that tightly couples whole-body motion with scene geometry for obstacle avoidance. To address these challenges, we present Moving Through Clutter (MTC), a learning-from-demonstration framework for scene-aware humanoid locomotion. To bypass costly physical scene construction, MTC uses procedurally generated Virtual Reality environments for immersive data collection. To transform these human motions into training-ready humanoid motions, we propose a scene-aware motion retargeting algorithm that converts human demonstrations into humanoid trajectories while strictly enforcing robot-scene clearance to guarantee collision-free traversal. These reference trajectories are then used to train a scene-aware locomotion policy that deploys on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Evaluated on our proposed MTC-Challenge for multi-obstacle traversal, the policy demonstrates a 70.2% collision-free rate across diverse scenarios, successfully traversing complex environments through diverse whole-body skills, including crawling through low-clearance passages and squeezing through narrow gaps.
Brace Yourself: Task-Conditioned Environmental Bracing for Forceful Humanoid Manipulation
做好准备：面向强力人形机器人操作任务的条件化环境支撑策略
强力操控（Forceful manipulation）对人形机器人而言极具挑战性，因为强烈的交互作用力极易破坏机器人的全身平衡。为此，我们提出了支撑手策略（Supporting Hand Strategy, SHS）——该策略允许人形机器人用一只手抵住外部环境进行支撑借力（Bracing），同时用另一只手执行高施力的操控任务。
SHS 优化了一个基于任务条件（Task-conditioned）的支撑构型，并以此引导两个同步运行的强化学习策略（Synchronous RL policies），整个过程完全无需人类运动数据或在线全身轨迹规划。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实机实验表明，SHS 实现了高达 60 N 的有效接触力，而未采用环境借力支撑的对比组最大持续施力仅为 13.5 N；同时，相比于任务无关（Task-independent）的固定支撑构型，SHS 显著提升了力的跟踪精度。此外，相同的策略无需重新训练即可泛化迁移至不同的任务区域。因此，SHS 为大幅拓展人形机器人的强力操控能力提供了一种简单而高效的机制。
Forceful manipulation is challenging for humanoid robots because interaction forces can disturb whole-body balance. We introduce the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), which enables a humanoid to brace against the environment with one hand while performing forceful manipulation with the other. SHS optimises a task-conditioned support configuration that guides two synchronous reinforcement-learning policies, without human motion data or online whole-body trajectory planning. On a Unitree G1, SHS achieved usable contact forces up to 60 N, compared with a maximum sustained force of 13.5 N without environmental bracing, while substantially improving force tracking over a task-independent support configuration. The same policies generalised to different task regions without retraining. SHS therefore provides a simple mechanism for substantially extending humanoid forceful-manipulation capability.
DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
DexWeave：从人类演示中学习灵巧人形机器人的移动与操作
从人类示范中学习灵巧的人形机器人移动操控（Loco-manipulation），不仅需要迁移人类的运动轨迹，还需要迁移示范行为背后协调一致的交互结构（Coordinated interaction structure）。这极具挑战性，因为具身形态差异（Embodiment differences）会扭曲身体运动、手腕定位、手指关节运动与物体交互之间的耦合关系；此外，即便运动学上精准的参考轨迹，在机器人动力学限制下依然可能难以实现。
我们提出了 DexWeave——一个将交互一致性运动重定向（Interaction-consistent motion retargeting）与结构感知全身策略学习（Anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning）相结合的统一框架。DexWeave 首先采用两阶段重定向流程：先利用专用求解器初始化身体与手部运动，随后在上肢交互链上进行耦合精细化（Coupled refinement），同时保持下半身支撑；生成的参考轨迹由一个结构感知的 Transformer 策略进行跟踪，该策略将解剖学区域表示为结构化 Token，并使用定向掩码注意力（Directed masked attention）建立其依赖关系模型，其中物体信息选择性地调节上肢路径以进行灵巧交互。
该策略能够联合输出身体与灵巧手动作，并通过强化学习（RL）直接训练，完全无需预训练的跟踪策略、教师-学生蒸馏或随后的残差精细化。相比于 MLP 基线，DexWeave 提升了重定向保真度与交互一致性，同时实现了更高的操控性能和更快的策略收敛速度。我们进一步将训练好的策略部署在装备有因时灵巧手（Inspire dexterous hands）的宇树 Unitree G1 物理人形机器人上，展示了真实世界中的灵巧全身移动操控能力。
Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world.
Bundled Contact Gradients: Stabilizing Differentiable Simulation for Deployable Dynamic Tasks
捆绑接触梯度：为可部署动态任务稳定可微仿真
可微仿真（Differentiable simulation）能够提供机器人动力学的解析梯度，从而实现高效且高样本利用率的一阶策略优化（First-order policy optimization）。然而，为了通过刚体接触（Rigid-body contact）获取平滑且富含信息的梯度，通常需要对接触模型进行软化处理，这往往以牺牲物理真实度（Physical fidelity）为代价，进而导致所学策略大幅局限于仿真环境内。对于动态人形机器人运动而言，这种权衡关系尤为关键，因为精确的接触动力学对于将策略迁移至真实世界至关重要。在刚体仿真中提高接触刚度虽能增强交互的真实性，但也会使动力学对微小的状态扰动变得极度敏感，进而产生高方差的梯度，导致一阶策略学习发生失稳。
为了解决这一难题，我们提出了捆绑接触梯度（Bundled Contact Gradients, BCG）——一种用于可微策略学习的接触局部随机平滑框架（Contact-local randomized smoothing framework）。当检测到高刚度接触时，我们的方法会在高刚度接触构型附近评估一组局部的随机扰动推演（Randomized perturbation rollouts），并聚合其梯度信号，从而有效降低梯度的方差。
我们通过成功训练动态运动并将其零样本（Zero-shot）迁移部署至真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人平台上，验证了该方法的卓越有效性。
Differentiable simulation provides analytic gradients of robot dynamics, enabling fast and sample-efficient first-order policy optimization. However, obtaining smooth and informative gradients through rigid-body contact typically requires softened contact models, often at the expense of physical fidelity and thereby limiting learned policies largely to simulation. This trade-off becomes particularly consequential for dynamic humanoid motions, where accurate contact dynamics are critical for transferring policies to the real world. Increasing contact stiffness in rigid-body simulation improves the fidelity of interactions, but also makes the dynamics increasingly sensitive to small state perturbations, producing high-variance gradients that can destabilize first-order policy learning. To address this, we propose \emph{Bundled Contact Gradients (BCG)}, a contact-local randomized smoothing framework for differentiable policy learning. When stiff contact is detected, our method evaluates a local bundle of randomized perturbation rollouts around the stiff contact configuration and aggregates their gradient signal thereby reducing gradient variance. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by successfully training and transferring dynamic motions zero-shot onto a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid platform.
CoPRE: Improving Sensitivity in Proprioceptive Contact Detection for Low-Cost Robot Arms
CoPRE：提升低成本机械臂本体感觉接触检测的灵敏度
机器人操控过程中的接触检测（Contact detection）使机器人能够识别意外碰撞并相应地调整其运动；然而，在缺乏专用力传感器或触觉传感器的低成本机器人手臂上，仅凭本体感觉（Proprioception）检测微弱接触极具挑战性，因为接触引起的关节级信号变化与机器人自身运动产生的正常波动和噪声相比极其微小。我们提出了无接触本体感觉响应估计（Contact-free Proprioceptive Response Estimation, CoPRE），该方法仅利用无接触运动即可提高本体感觉接触检测的灵敏度，无需额外的力传感器、接触标签或解析动力学模型。CoPRE 根据本体感觉状态历史与指令运动推算无接触状态下的预期关节扭矩，同时剔除近期可能已包含接触信息的观测值；随后计算预期扭矩与实际观测扭矩估算值之间的残差，并通过噪声加权雅可比矩阵（Noise-weighted Jacobian）将该残差映射为接触得分。
在 ARX 机械臂和宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实机实验表明，在测试的接触试验中，CoPRE 分别达到了 74.1% 和 82.2% 的召回率（Recall），而基于学习的扭矩预测基线和逆动力学基线在 ARX 上的召回率均为 0%，在 G1 上的召回率仅为 16.3% 与 42.2%。
此外，CoPRE 在 ARX 上仅需 3.5 N、在 G1 上仅需 5.5 N 的推力即可达到 90% 的检测率。为了展示该方法在下游任务中的实用价值，我们实现了用于障碍物感知物体放置与书籍插入的信念空间操控规划（Belief-space manipulation planning）：检测到的接触可实时更新空间信念，并使机器人能够从受阻运动中退回、调整姿态并重新尝试。
Contact detection during robotic manipulation allows robots to recognize unexpected contact and adapt their motion accordingly. However, in low-cost robot arms without dedicated force or tactile sensors, detecting weak contacts from proprioception is challenging because the resulting changes in joint-level proprioceptive signals can be small compared to normal variation and noise caused by robot motion itself. We introduce Contact-free Proprioceptive Response Estimation (CoPRE), improving proprioceptive contact detection sensitivity using only contact-free motion, without additional force sensors, contact labels, or analytical dynamics models. CoPRE estimate the expected joint torques under contact-free motion from proprioceptive state history and commanded motion, while removing recent observations that may already reflect contact. It then computes the residual between the expected and observed joint torque estimates, and maps this residual to a contact score using a noise-weighted Jacobian. Real-robot experiments on ARX Arm and Unitree G1 show that CoPRE achieves 74.1% and 82.2% recall on the tested contact trials, compared with 0%/0% on ARX and 16.3%/42.2% on G1 for the learned torque-prediction and inverse-dynamics baselines. CoPRE also reaches 90% detection rate for pushing force at 3.5 N on ARX and 5.5 N on G1. To demonstrate the downstream utility of our method, we implement belief-space manipulation planning for obstacle-aware object placement and book insertion where detected contacts update the spatial belief and enable the robot to retreat from blocked motions, adjust its pose, and retry.
RoboDreamer: Anticipatory Humanoid Locomotion with Predictive State-Space Models
RoboDreamer：基于预测性状态空间模型的拟人机器人预判式运动
人形机器人步态控制（Locomotion）要求策略在不完美/噪声感知的条件下保持稳定，同时能够利用时间上下文（Temporal context）以维持连贯一致的运动。本文提出了 RoboDreamer——一套结合了下一观测一致性（Next-observation consistency）与随机连续时间掩码（Randomized continuous temporal masking）的两阶段“教师-学生”蒸馏框架（Teacher-student framework）。在第一阶段，教师策略首先在无噪声的完整观测数据上进行训练；在第二阶段，学生策略在近期观测序列被随机掩码掩蔽的条件下接受蒸馏，从而促使策略学会从历史观测中隐式推断当前缺失的感知信息。
在推理（Inference）阶段，RoboDreamer 重用了相同的掩码接口，用于隐式闭环动作精细化（Implicit closed-loop action refinement）以及可选的多步动作块输出（Multi-step action chunking）。框架采用 Mamba 作为时间骨干网络（Temporal backbone）；对齐的消融实验（Ablations）表明，掩码/蒸馏机制贡献了大部分性能提升，而 Mamba 则在满足实时低延迟的前提下带来了额外的跟踪性能增益。
在 IsaacLab、MuJoCo 仿真环境以及真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验表明，RoboDreamer 在观测掩码干扰下展现出鲁棒的运动跟踪能力，并成功实现了真实的物理实机部署。
Humanoid locomotion requires control policies that remain stable under imperfect sensing while exploiting temporal context for consistent motion. We present RoboDreamer, a two-stage teacher--student framework that combines next-observation consistency with randomized continuous temporal masking. A teacher is first trained on clean observations, and a student is then distilled under masked recent observations, encouraging the policy to infer missing current information from history. At inference, the same masking interface is reused for implicit closed-loop action refinement and optional multi-step action chunking. Mamba is used as the temporal backbone, while matched ablations show that masking/distillation provides a substantial part of the gain and Mamba contributes additional tracking improvements with real-time latency. Experiments in IsaacLab, MuJoCo, and on a Unitree G1 demonstrate robust motion tracking under observation masking and successful real-world deployment.
ForgetMimic: Motion Unlearning for Reinforcement Learning Humanoid Control
ForgetMimic：面向强化学习人形机器人控制的动作遗忘技术
通过强化学习（RL）利用人类运动示范，人形机器人控制已实现了多样、敏捷且自然的高动态步态与动作行为。尽管这一范式在物理人形机器人控制领域取得了显著成效，但如何从已学会的策略中彻底擦除/遗忘（Unlearn）特定运动行为依然缺乏深入探索。解决这一问题有着紧迫的安全性与隐私需求：例如消除恶意注入、被毒化（Poisoned）或次优的运动轨迹，以及根据 GDPR 等法规中“被遗忘权”（Right to be forgotten）的要求移除受版权保护的运动行为。
为此，我们提出了 ForgetMimic——这是首个专门针对物理世界人形机器人控制设计的运动级机器遗忘（Motion-level unlearning）方法。ForgetMimic 的核心思想在于：给定一个基于 $N$ 个运动轨迹训练好的策略 $\pi_\theta$，我们的方法可以在大幅降低策略在指定的 $K$ 个目标运动子集上的性能的同时，完好保留其余 $N-K$ 个运动行为的控制效果。此外，我们识别并解决了机器人控制训练机制中导致机器遗忘失效的两个关键瓶颈问题。
我们在宇树 Unitree G1 和 H2 人形机器人上针对包含舞蹈（Dance）、格斗（Fight）、空翻（Flip）等在内的 12 种运动行为进行了广泛实验。实验结果表明，ForgetMimic 能够有效消除对指定运动行为的“记忆”，同时完全维持所有其他运动行为的正常运行与控制稳定性。
Humanoid control, leveraging human demonstrations, has achieved diverse, agile, and natural locomotion behaviors through reinforcement learning (RL). While this paradigm has yielded remarkable performance in physical humanoid control, how to eliminate specific motions from learned policies remains insufficiently explored. Addressing this issue is motivated by pressing safety and privacy concerns: the removal of malicious, poisoned, or suboptimal motions, as well as copyright-protected motions subject to the right to be forgotten under regulations such as the GDPR, is of critical importance. To this end, we propose {ForgetMimic}, the first motion-level unlearning method designed specifically for physical-world humanoid control. The core idea of ForgetMimic is as follows: given a policy πθ trained on N motions, our method degrades performance on a target subset of K motions while preserving the effectiveness of the remaining N−K motions. Furthermore, we identify and resolve two key training mechanisms in robot control that lead to unlearning failure. We conduct extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 motions, including Dance, Fight, Flip, and others. Experimental results demonstrate that ForgetMimic effectively eliminates memory of designated motions while maintaining the normal operation of all other motions.
Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
采样、仿真、筛选：无需训练、物理闭环的人形机器人“文本转动作”方法
文本到运动（Text-to-motion）生成模型能够产生合理的人类运动轨迹，但无法对机器人的动力学进行建模；而全身跟踪控制器（Whole-body tracking controllers）虽然能可靠地执行机器人参考轨迹，却无法对物理不可行的轨迹进行重新规划。近期出现的“语言到人形机器人”（Language-to-humanoid）系统试图通过端到端训练来弥合这一鸿沟。
本文评估了在完全无需训练（No training at all）的前提下——通过直接将部署控制器置于闭环回路中——究竟能够弥合多大的性能差距。我们提出了 采样-仿真-筛选（Sample-Simulate-Select, $S^3$） 框架：针对每个文本提示（Prompt），从冻结的 Text-to-motion 模型中采样 $N$ 个运动轨迹，利用方向匹配逆运动学（Inverse kinematics）将其重定向（Retarget）至宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人，随后在预训练 SONIC 跟踪策略控制下于全刚体动力学仿真中展开（Rollout）所有轨迹，并最终保留策略执行效果最佳的候选轨迹。由于验证器即是确定性的物理仿真器本身，构造上 $S^3$ 达到了 $N$ 选 1（Any-of-$N$）的上限；我们重点测量了该上限所在的位置以及仍存在短板之处。
在含有 200 个分层 HumanML3D 测试提示（$N=8$）上，直立执行率（Upright execution）从 83.5% 提升至 89.5%，硬件门控通过数（Hardware-gate passes）从 33 个增加到 85 个；在完整的测试集（4,184 个提示）上，直立率从 80.5% 提升至 89.5%。相比之下，一个能够良好预测跌倒的运动学验证器（AUROC 0.90）仅恢复了该收益的四分之一——证明对单个提示的多个候选进行排序比对总体群体进行分类更为困难。筛选机制无法解决的唯二短板是一类“降低盆骨/低重心”的提示，而基于重定向机器人数据训练的生成器则能够执行此类动作。
我们进一步使用标准“文本-运动评估器”对执行动作的语义保真度（Semantic fidelity）进行了评分，并引入真实动捕数据作为对照，将保真度损失归因于机器人运动投影过程；消融实验将该重定向器与 GMR 进行对比（两者展现出互补的失效模式：结合两者后 Any-of-8 的上限提升至 95.0%）；最后我们在真实 Unitree G1 实机上执行了全部 177 个通过硬件门控筛选的动作片段：每一个动作均成功完成且保持直立，实机硬件的跟踪误差与仿真结果高度一致（$r = 0.94$）。
Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S3) draws N motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S3 attains the any-of-N ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with N=8, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation (r=0.94).
X-WBC: A Cross-Embodiment Foundation Model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
X-WBC：面向人形机器人全身控制的跨具身基础模型
将人形机器人全身控制（Whole-body control, WBC）扩展至通用部署，需要庞大的人类运动语料库以及跨机器人躯体共享的训练经验。然而，现有方法通常为每种机器人独立训练单一策略，导致运动经验在不同具身形态（Embodiments）之间呈孤立状态。
我们提出了 X-WBC——一个跨具身全身控制基座框架（Cross-embodiment foundation framework），该框架将相对共享的人类运动语义（Human motion semantics）与特定机器人躯体的物理执行解耦。系统通过以人类为中心的指令 Token（Human-centered command tokens）统一对齐完整人类运动、机器人参考运动以及稀疏 VR 观测数据；一个因果 Transformer（Causal Transformer）从混合的多机器人推演（Multi-robot rollouts）中学习可复用的时间序列结构，而轻量级的特定机器人模块（Robot-specific modules）则将这一共享表示映射至各个机器人的固有本体感觉与动作空间。
在 9 种仿真具身、外部运动数据集以及 4 种真实机器人平台上的实验表明：联合训练显著提升了动作跟踪性能，对齐的特征表示支持了跨指令源的强一致性控制，且学会的策略在超越训练语料库的泛化测试中依然保持了出色的竞争力。这些结果证明了异构人形机器人可以作为联合数据源，并确立了跨具身联合训练作为构建全身控制基座模型的一条可行且实用的技术路线。
Scaling humanoid whole-body control toward general-purpose deployment requires large human motion corpora and training experience shared across robot bodies. Existing methods usually train one policy per robot, leaving motion experience isolated across embodiments. We introduce X-WBC, a cross-embodiment foundation framework that separates relatively shared human motion semantics from embodiment-specific physical execution. Human-centered command tokens align full human motion, robot reference motion, and sparse VR observations. A causal Transformer learns reusable temporal structure from mixed multi-robot rollouts, while lightweight robot-specific modules map the shared representation to each robot's proprioception and action space. Across nine simulated embodiments, external motions, and four real robots, experiments show that joint training improves tracking, the aligned representation supports consistent control across command sources, and the learned policy remains competitive beyond the training corpus. These results support heterogeneous humanoids as joint data sources and establish cross-embodiment joint training as a practical route toward whole-body control foundation models.
TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
TANGO：基于全身视觉-语言-动作模型的复杂环境人形机器人导航
我们研究了人形机器人在杂乱室内环境中的导航问题。与将导航简化为二维路径规划问题的传统方法不同，人形机器人在杂乱环境中的穿行需要持续进行几何感知的全身自适应控制——包括手臂的协调放置、躯干姿态调整以及步态调制，以实现复杂三维空间中的无碰撞移动。为此，我们提出了 TANGO——首个用于语言条件限定下杂乱环境穿行的全身视觉-语言导航（Whole-body vision-language navigation）框架。给定自然语言指令与第一视角 RGB 视觉观测，TANGO 可直接预测 29 自由度的关节空间动作（29-DoF joint-space actions），下发至下游全身控制器执行。
我们完全在仿真环境中训练 TANGO：通过全局路径规划、运动学全身运动生成、障碍物感知运动编辑以及基于强化学习的轨迹跟踪，合成出多样化的无碰撞穿行行为。这一流水线（Pipeline）为学习语言条件限定的全身控制策略提供了具备动态可行性的动作监督信号。
在广泛的仿真实验中，TANGO 在视觉-语言导航任务中展现出最先进（SOTA）的性能，并在需要与障碍物进行复杂交互的挑战性场景中显著超越了强模块化基线；最后，我们将 TANGO 零样本（Zero-shot）部署于真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，在未经任何真实世界导航数据训练的前提下，观察到了在真实杂乱场景中鲁棒的语言引导穿行表现。
We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.
ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
ASENA：用于具身导航的自进化智能体
我们提出了 ASENA——一个将通用编程 Agent（Coding agents）与机器人感知、计算、受控执行以及持久化经验（Persistent experience）相连通的具身 Agent 系统。在保持模型权重固定（Fixed model weights）的前提下，Agent 能够编写并执行程序、审查记录的运行结果、修复失败指令，并复用笔记与可执行技能。
此外，我们推出了 ASENA-VLN——一个 40 亿参数（4B）的单目视觉导航策略，作为该可编程系统内的可选工具。ASENA-VLN 采用一个共享的视觉-语言解码器（Vision-language decoder），基于路径指令、视觉问答（VQA）以及全新构建的几何衍生原子导航任务数据集进行训练，能够同时预测长距离路线与短时序行为的身体坐标系轨迹（Body-frame trajectories）。作为独立策略，ASENA-VLN 在 R2R 和 RxR 基准测试中分别取得了 68.7% 和 70.2% 的最先进（SOTA）成功率；当与编程 Agent 集成时，这一 learned 导航策略使 ASENA 在两个 Agent 评估基准上的成功率均提升了 11 个百分点，同时缩短了执行时间。
通过持久化工作空间演化（Persistent workspace evolution）与仿真器反馈，在重复的 100 任务子集上进行 10 轮迭代后，R2R 的成功率从 72% 进一步提升至 98%，RxR 的成功率从 65% 提升至 89%。在具身问答（EQA）任务中，ASENA 以更少的交互步数实现了 SOTA 准确率。最后，在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的真实世界演示中，系统在无需预建地图（Pre-built map）的情况下融合了搜索、视觉检测、空间推理与合成姿态手势，展示了在线编程（Online programming）如何将机器人行为拓展至传统的路径跟随与预定义技能之外。
We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.
Assisted exploration of difficult transitions in humanoid motion tracking
人形机器人运动追踪中困难过渡的辅助探索
人形机器人运动跟踪（Humanoid motion tracking）为将运动学人类动作迁移至机器人全身控制提供了一个具备可扩展性的接口；然而，对于高动态（Highly dynamic）与丰富接触（Contact-rich）的参考轨迹而言，控制器的训练依然极具挑战，因为欠驱动（Underactuation）与不连续接触会严重限制训练期间探索到的闭环状态分布。引入外力矩/力（External wrenches）可以减轻模仿学习过程中的动力学失配，但若在最终控制器中保留此类辅助，则会损害物理真实性。
本文提出了残余力矩辅助强化学习（Residual-wrench-assisted reinforcement learning, RWARL）——一套将基座残余力矩作为临时优化支架的两阶段训练框架。RWARL 首先在残余力矩辅助下求解松弛后的跟踪问题，随后在渐进衰减（Annealing）残余力矩强度的同时，根据观察到的训练难度动态调整早期终止边界（Early-termination bounds）与片段采样策略（Segment sampling）。为了在训练分布从“有辅助动力学”向“无辅助动力学”偏移的过程中保持策略的自适应能力，RWARL 在松弛阶段引入了可塑性保持机制（Plasticity-preserving mechanisms）。
在极高动态与丰富接触轨迹上的实验表明，RWARL 显著提升了全局跟踪精度，且最大增益集中出现在标准训练易产生保守行为的困难过渡阶段（Difficult transitions）。与基线相比，最终摆脱力矩辅助的 RWARL 策略将全局身体位置跟踪误差降低了 8.6%–37.8%，并在高难度“跳跃扭转”（Jump twist）动作上实现了高达 41.8 个百分点 的成功帧率提升；闭环前置状态诊断（Predecessor-state diagnostic）进一步证明，这些性能增益源于关键阶段附近更有利的“前置状态分布”。我们最终将无辅助控制器部署于宇树 Unitree G1 物理硬件上，验证了策略在彻底移除残余辅助后依然具备出色的物理实机可执行性。
Humanoid motion tracking provides a scalable interface for transferring kinematic human motion to whole-body robot control, but highly dynamic and contact-rich references remain difficult because underactuation and discontinuous contacts can restrict the closed-loop state distributions explored during training. External wrenches can reduce dynamic mismatch during imitation, but retaining such assistance in the final controller can compromise physical realism. This paper proposes residual-wrench-assisted reinforcement learning (RWARL), a two-stage framework that uses base residual wrenches as a temporary optimization scaffold. RWARL first solves a relaxed tracking problem with residual-wrench assistance and then anneals the residual-wrench strength while adapting early-termination bounds and segment sampling to observed training difficulty. To keep the policy adaptable as the training distribution shifts from assisted to unassisted dynamics, RWARL incorporates plasticity-preserving mechanisms during relaxation. Experiments on highly dynamic and contact-rich references show that RWARL generally improves global tracking accuracy, with the largest gains near difficult transitions where standard training tends to produce conservative behavior. Compared with the baseline, the final unassisted RWARL policies reduce global body-position tracking error by 8.6%–37.8% on the highly agile and contact-rich motions examined in this work and achieve the largest successful-frame-rate gain of 41.8 percentage points on jump twist. A closed-loop predecessor-state diagnostic further links these gains to more favorable predecessor-state distributions around critical phases. We deploy the final unassisted controllers on Unitree G1 hardware, demonstrating that the learned policies remain executable after residual assistance is removed. Together, these findings suggest that RWARL uses residual wrenches to reshape learning around difficult, low-reachability transitions, allowing the final unassisted policy to inherit better tracking behavior in phases that standard training tends to underexplore.
PAMoR: Parameterized Affective Motion Generation in Real Time for Humanoid Robots
PAMoR：面向人形机器人的实时参数化情感动作生成
人在社交场景中解读人形机器人的运动时，不仅关注其执行的动作本身，还会感知其传递的情感（Affect）。迄今为止，此类带有情感色彩的运动多是为虚拟人类化身（Human avatars）生成的，其风格通常来源于参考视频片段或情感词汇，而这两者均无法进行定量参数化。
为此，我们提出了 PAMoR，该方法将情感转化为可调控的测量参数：一个直接在机器人运动学上计算出的愉悦度-激活度（Valence-Arousal, V-A）坐标系。该坐标通过姿态扩张（Postural expansion）与运动能量（Movement energy）以闭形式（Closed form）推导得出，这些测量值直接作为生成条件，无需任何人工标注。在扩散过程的每个去噪步骤中，训练于共享隐空间的 1 个动作先验与 2 个情感先验进行组合：动作先验固定“执行什么动作”，情感先验则调制“如何执行动作”。整个全身运动在拥有 29 个自由度的宇树 Unitree G1 上以自回归方式实时展开，且动作与情感均可进行实时编辑。
生成的运动在其全范围内精确跟踪下发的 V-A 指令，同时其“文本到运动”的生成保真度依然匹配纯文本基线。在感知实验研究中，评估者对指令情感的识别准确率达到了 38%，不仅超越了各类对比基线，且接近真人演员身体动作所报道的 44% 识别水平。
People read a humanoid robot's motion in social settings not only for the action performed but for the affect conveyed. Motion carrying that affect has so far been generated for human avatars, where style is taken from a reference clip or an emotion word, neither of which can be quantitatively parameterized. We present PAMoR, which turns affect into a measured control parameter: a valence-arousal (V-A) coordinate computed natively on robot kinematics. It is obtained in closed form from postural expansion and movement energy, and these measurements serve directly as generation conditions, with no human annotation. An action prior and two affect priors, trained in a shared latent space, are composed at each denoising step: the action prior fixes what is performed, the affect priors modulate how. Whole-body motion rolls out autoregressively on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 in real time, with action and affect both editable. Generated motion tracks the commanded V-A over its full range while text-to-motion fidelity still matches text-only baselines. In a perceptual study, raters identify the commanded emotion on 0.38 of trials, above both baselines and approaching the 0.44 reported for acted human bodies.
Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models
基于降阶模型学习安全的人形机器人导航
人形机器人控制研究在步态行走领域取得了迅速进展，近期成果更是进一步拓展了自主导航的边界。然而，我们证明了标准的单阶段强化学习（Single-stage RL）导航流水线难以直接扩展至多层建筑与跨楼层地形（Multi-level and multi-story terrain），其核心瓶颈在于机器人难以应对如楼梯等复杂的三维人形-地形交互。
为了攻克这一难题，我们将导航问题解耦为两个阶段：首先，我们训练一个运行于缩减阶动力学（Reduced-order dynamics）上、但接收完整 3D LiDAR 视觉/点云观测的策略，用以在复杂的跨楼层地形中进行导航；随后，我们利用该导航策略沉淀的先验知识，“冷启动”（Kickstart）训练一个运行于全阶人形机器人动力学（Full-order humanoid dynamics）之上的高阶策略，并在控制闭环中嵌入一个冻结的底层步态策略（Frozen locomotion policy）。此外，我们证明了在导航策略输出端应用泊松安全过滤器（Poisson safety filter），可以在存在分布外（OOD）障碍物时恢复系统的安全性，且完全不会降低导航成功率。
我们在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上对最终生成的 RoM-Nav 策略进行了实机验证，实现了无预建地图（Mapless）的跨楼层导航，测试覆盖了垂直落差超过 10 米、路径总长超过 100 米 的真实长时序复杂轨迹。
Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length.
Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
Rolling-WAM：具备滚动想象能力的世界动作模型
世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）将用于机器人操控的动作生成与未来视觉预测紧密耦合。然而，在每个重规划周期（Replanning cycle）中完成联合视频-动作去噪（Joint video-action denoising）过程会产生巨大的计算延迟，从而推迟动作更新并限制闭环响应速度。
为了解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了 Rolling-WAM——一种将联合去噪过程平摊分配至连续重规划周期内的全新架构。我们的方法维护了一个处于交错噪声水平（Staggered noise levels）下的视频-动作块（Video-action chunks）滑动窗口。在每个步骤中，滑动噪声调度机制（Rolling noise schedule）对即将执行的临近动作块进行完全去噪以供下发执行，同时对较远未来时域的动作块进行局部精细化（Partially refining）。随着窗口随新的摄像头观测数据向前推进，保留的未来动作块将继续其去噪过程。这一设计在时间维度上分散了计算成本，同时跨动作块边界传递并演化了视觉-动作上下文（Visual-action context）。
在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 仿真数据集以及真实宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的评估表明，Rolling-WAM 取得了极具竞争力的操控性能。通过消除从头去噪整个预测时域（Prediction horizon）的需求，Rolling-WAM 相比标准联合 WAMs 实现了 4.5 倍 的稳态重规划加速。
World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5× steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
PLAT: Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking for Humanoid Control via Privileged Latent Transition Learning
PLAT：基于特权潜在转换学习的类人机器人控制稀疏时序关键帧运动追踪
人形机器人运动跟踪策略（Motion tracking policies）高度依赖逐帧的密集的参考轨迹（Dense frame-by-frame references），这限制了它们作为高级运动控制器用于规划和交互式运动生成的能力。本文研究了稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪（Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking）问题：策略仅接收稀疏的未来关键帧及其期望到达时间，且必须执行稳定的全身运动以依次到达各个目标点。
为此，我们提出了 PLAT——一个结合特权隐空间转移学习（Privileged Latent Transition learning）的三阶段稀疏定时关键帧运动跟踪策略学习框架。PLAT 通过在训练期间将密集目标序列作为特权监督（Privileged supervision）信号，而在部署时仅需要稀疏定时关键帧指令，成功弥合了密集运动跟踪与稀疏目标条件控制（Sparse goal-conditioned control）之间的差距。在 PLAT 中，预训练的密集跟踪专家首先提供鲁棒的运动先验；随后通过 DAgger 式的模仿学习训练一个特权隐空间先验；最后采用隐空间残差强化学习（Latent residual reinforcement learning）对隐空间转移进行精细化微调，而非直接优化动作输出。
广泛的仿真实验表明，PLAT 在不同的规划时域（Planning horizons）下均能维持精确且稳定的稀疏定时关键帧跟踪能力，尤其在长时序指令下展现出强劲的性能。在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的成功实机部署，进一步证明了 PLAT 在稀疏人形机器人运动控制中的有效性与实用价值。
Humanoid motion tracking policies rely on dense frame-by-frame references, limiting their use as high-level motion controllers for planning and interactive motion generation. We study \emph{Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking}, where a policy receives only sparse future keyframes and their desired arrival times, and must execute stable whole-body motions that reach successive goals. We propose \textbf{PLAT}, a three-stage sparse timed keyframe motion tracking policy learning framework with \textbf{P}rivileged \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{T}ransition learning. PLAT bridges dense motion tracking and sparse goal-conditioned control by exploiting dense goal sequences as privileged supervision during training while requiring only sparse timed keyframe commands at deployment. A pretrained dense tracking expert first provides robust motion priors. A privileged latent prior is then learned through DAgger-style imitation, followed by latent residual reinforcement learning that refines latent transitions instead of directly optimizing actions. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that PLAT maintains accurate and stable sparse timed keyframe tracking across varying planning horizons, with particularly strong performance under long-horizon commands. Successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot further demonstrates the effectiveness and practicality of PLAT for sparse humanoid motion control.
PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
PredActor：用于可操控机载人形机器人控制的预测性动作扩散方法
扩散模型（Diffusion models）为运动生成提供了灵活的框架，但将这种灵活性转化为闭环人形机器人控制依然面临巨大挑战。分层“生成器-跟踪器”系统（Hierarchical generator-tracker systems）通过参考轨迹引导运动，但这些参考轨迹可能超出下游跟踪器的物理极限，从而将物理可行性与抗干扰恢复很大程度上留给了独立的控制模块；纯动作扩散（Action-only diffusion）直接生成可执行动作以避免这种解耦，但无法提供显式的未来状态轨迹用于测试时的运动目标引导；联合状态-动作扩散（Joint state-action diffusion）提供了一种自然的选择，但现有控制器往往依赖特权全身体态（Privileged full-body states），且已学会的行为选择与测试时运动引导（Test-time motion steering）依然缺乏有机整合。
为了解决上述瓶颈，我们提出了 PredActor——一种预测性动作扩散策略（Predictive action diffusion policy），仅利用固有本体感觉（Proprioceptive observations）即可将这些互补的引导形式统一在单一步骤直接执行的策略中。PredActor 以本体感觉历史和可选任务上下文为条件，联合预测可执行动作与未来状态的内部轨迹。这种预测性状态轨迹为控制生成的行为提供了显式接口：无分类器引导（Classifier-free guidance, CFG）用于增强文本条件的运动生成，而分类器引导（Classifier guidance）则将预测的未来状态引导至测试时目标。系统仅下发执行预测的动作，既不需要独立的运动参考跟踪器，也不依赖特权全身体态。
在仿真实验中，PredActor 在 45 个目标地点中成功到达 44 个，文本检索得分达到 0.539（对比条件动作扩散的 0.424），同时维持了相当的抗干扰生存能力。为了使引导扩散在板载控制中具备实用性，我们进一步引入了滚动去噪（Rolling denoising）与保留计算的运行时优化，将整个控制回调时间降低至在 Jetson Orin NX 上的中位数 16.790 ms 与 p95 19.383 ms，均严格控制在 20 ms 的控制周期之内。我们最终将 PredActor 部署于真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，在仿真和真实硬件中同时展示了文本条件运动、抗干扰响应行为、手柄摇杆引导以及语义插值（Semantic interpolation）等多种能力的统一闭环控制。
Diffusion models provide a flexible framework for motion generation, but turning this flexibility into closed-loop humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical generator-tracker systems steer motion through reference trajectories, yet these references may exceed the capabilities of the downstream tracker, leaving physical feasibility and disturbance recovery largely to a separate control module. Action-only diffusion avoids this separation by directly generating executable actions, but provides no explicit future-state trajectory that can be steered toward test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion offers a natural alternative, but existing controllers often rely on privileged full-body states, while learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remain only partially integrated.
We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that unifies these complementary forms of steerability within a single directly executed policy using only proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly predicts executable actions and an internal trajectory of future states. This predictive state trajectory provides an explicit interface for controlling the generated behavior: classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned motion generation, while classifier guidance steers predicted future states toward test-time objectives. Only the predicted actions are executed, requiring neither a separate motion-reference tracker nor privileged full-body states.
In simulation, PredActor reaches 44 of 45 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.539, compared with 0.424 for conditional action diffusion, while maintaining similar disturbance survival. To make guided diffusion practical for onboard control, we further introduce rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations, reducing the complete control callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both within the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1 and demonstrate, in both simulation and physical hardware, text-conditioned motion, disturbance-responsive behavior, joystick steering, and semantic interpolation within the same closed-loop policy.
How Long Until Your Robot Ignores You? A Safety Benchmark for LLM Orchestrators in Human-Humanoid Collaboration
你的机器人还要多久才会对你不理不睬？人机协作中大语言模型编排器的安全性基准
大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地用于通过自然语言接口编排机器人行为，然而目前尚无基准用来评估它们在人-人形机器人协作（Human-humanoid collaboration）中作为安全感知决策者（Safety-aware decision makers）的可靠性。与执行二元允许/拒绝决策的确定性安全系统不同，基于 LLM 的编排器展现出从过度合规（Overcompliance，即拒绝安全动作）到完全安全违规（Full safety violations）的合规光谱（Compliance spectrum）。
本文提出了首个用于评估人-人形机器人协作中 LLM 编排器安全性的基准测试环境。该环境构建于模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）架构之上，其安全不变量（Safety invariants）基于 ISO 10218-2:2025 防护措施规范构建。该基准定义了 5 个可测试的安全不变量、4 级合规分类体系（正确合规、过度合规、欠合规、完全违规）以及一个三层评估流水线（文本提示、仿真传感器-执行器回路以及在宇树 Unitree G1 EDU 人形机器人上的物理验证）。
我们报告了第一层（Layer-1）的评估结果：在全上下文（Full-context）与滑动窗口预算（Sliding-window budget）条件下，针对 3 个云端后端（Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash）和一个本地开源基线模型（qwen3:8b），在 40 个 100 轮（100-turn）会话中进行了测试（同时仿真层与物理层评估仍在持续进行中）。研究发现：模型家族决定了安全下限：Claude 和 Gemini 的违规次数保持在或接近零次，而 GPT-4o-mini 单会话违规多达 13 次；上下文管理解耦了两个失效轴：上下文管理使所有云端后端的平均行为异常减少了 42%–57%，但却使 GPT-4o-mini 的违规次数几乎翻倍（从单会话 3.8 次升至 7.2 次）；比例合规性（Proportional compliance）——即把运动速度限制在规则指定的上限而非直接拒绝——仅在 Gemini 中稳定出现；此外，初步的仿真层测试复现了上述模型排名以及 GPT-4o-mini 的失效模式反转现象。
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed to orchestrate robot behavior through natural-language interfaces, yet no benchmark exists to evaluate their reliability as safety-aware decision makers in human-humanoid collaboration. Unlike deterministic safety systems that enforce binary allow/deny decisions, LLM-based orchestrators exhibit a compliance spectrum ranging from overcompliance (refusing safe actions) to full safety violations. This paper introduces the first safety benchmarking environment for LLM orchestrators in human-humanoid collaboration, built on a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based architecture with safety invariants grounded in ISO 10218-2:2025 protective measures. The benchmark defines five testable safety invariants, a four-level compliance taxonomy (correct compliance, overcompliance, undercompliance, full violation), and a three-layer evaluation pipeline (text prompting, simulated sensor-actuator loops, and physical validation on a Unitree G1 EDU humanoid). We report Layer-1 results: three cloud backends (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash) and a local open-weights baseline (qwen3:8b) across 40 100-turn sessions under full-context and sliding-window budget conditions, while the simulation and physical layers remain ongoing. We find that (1) model family determines the safety floor, as Claude and Gemini remain at or near zero violations while GPT-4o-mini commits up to 13 per session, (2) context management dissociates two failure axes, reducing mean behavioral issues by 42-57% for every cloud backend while nearly doubling GPT-4o-mini's violations (3.8 to 7.2 per session), and (3) proportional compliance, clamping movement speed to the rule-specified maximum rather than refusing, emerges consistently only in Gemini; the preliminary simulation layer reproduces the model ranking and the GPT-4o-mini failure-mode inversion.
BeyondRetarget: Learning Executable Humanoid Motions Directly from Monocular Video
BeyondRetarget：直接从单目视频学习可执行的人形机器人动作
从人类视频中学习可执行运动，为人形机器人获取示范运动提供了一种具备可扩展性的解决方案。然而，现有流水线（Pipelines）通常先构建显式的人类运动表示（Explicit human motion representation），随后通过运动重定向（Motion retargeting）将其转换为机器人运动轨迹。尽管此类方法能够有效利用海量现有人类数据进行训练，但人类与人形机器人在步态行走机制以及关节自由度（DoF）配置上的巨大差异，使得这种“以人类表示为中心”的方法生成的运动极难在机器人上直接下发执行。此外，人类运动估计过程中引入的误差不可避免地会传递至重定向阶段，且无法通过联合优化予以消除。
为了解决这些根本局限，我们提出了 BeyondRetarget——一个将单目 RGB 视频直接映射至机器人运动轨迹的端到端框架（End-to-end framework）。该框架彻底放弃了显式的人类表示，直接从视觉观测中学习面向机器人的隐式表示（Robot-oriented implicit representations），使模型能够跨越形态结构差异捕捉运动模式。为了生成更适合机器人物理执行的动作，我们进一步设计了一种接触感知运动优化机制（Contact-aware motion optimization mechanism），以显著提升运动的时序一致性与物理合理性（Physical plausibility）。
实验表明，BeyondRetarget 极大地提升了生成的机器人运动的准确性与鲁棒性；同时在仿真平台与真实人形机器人实机部署中，均实现了更高的动作执行成功率以及更低的推理与控制延迟。
Learning executable motions from human videos offers a scalable solution for humanoid robots to acquire demonstration motions. However, existing pipelines typically first construct an explicit human motion representation and then convert it into robot motions via motion retargeting. Although such methods can effectively leverage large volumes of existing human data for training, the substantial differences between humans and humanoid robots in locomotion mechanisms and joint degree-of-freedom configurations make motions generated by this human-representation-centric approach difficult to execute on robots. Furthermore, errors introduced during human motion estimation inevitably propagate to the retargeting stage and cannot be eliminated via joint optimization. We propose BeyondRetarget, an end-to-end framework that directly maps monocular RGB videos to robot motions. Discarding the explicit human representation, this framework learns robot-oriented implicit representations directly from visual observations, enabling the model to capture cross-morphology motion structures. To generate motions more suitable for robot execution, we further design a contact-aware motion optimization mechanism to improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility. Experiments show that BeyondRetarget significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of generated robot motions, while achieving higher execution success rates and lower latency in both simulation environments and real humanoid robots.
SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
SocialVLA：一种基于人类反应进行 VLA 操作故障检测与恢复的社会感知网关
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够支持多样化的机器人操控，但在执行过程中若缺乏自我纠错能力，往往容易导致任务失败。相比之下，人类观察者能够提供互补的反思信号——在机器人发生意外行为但尚未彻底失败前，人类往往会迅速做出语音、面部表情或口头提示等自发反应。为此，我们提出了 SocialVLA，这是一种本地化且独立于特定策略的社会感知网关，能将人类的自发反应实时转化为 VLA 操控的在线干预信号。SocialVLA 整合了因果副语言音频检测、视觉反应识别、显式停止词识别以及机器人相关性估计机制。
系统采用了异步首发事件融合机制（Asynchronous First-Event Fusion），一旦捕捉到最早且置信度达标的信号，便会立即触发 VLA 挂起；同时，独立的语音通道能够捕获口头修正指令，用于指导后续的参与者导向型恢复（如继续执行、重新开始或修正指令）。我们在宇树（Unitree）G1 物理机器人操控任务中对 SocialVLA 进行了评估，实验包含 15 名参与者、238 个标注有干预需求的 Episode，以及 1.038 小时的非干预行为数据。
在冻结参数的离线重放测试中，系统实现了 54.6% 的召回率和 69.5% 的精确率；而未加过滤的音视频融合召回率达到了 64.3%。相关性估计机制将误停止 Episode 数量从 100 个降至 57 个，并将精确率从 60.5% 提升至 69.8%。在面对未见过的第 16 名参与者进行前瞻性部署测试时，冻结状态下的系统达到了 59.5% 的召回率和 91.7% 的精确率。在时延表现上，检测器到融合模块的中位数时延为 47.9 ms，VLA 网关到物理挂起时延为 336 ms，反应发生到最终挂起时延为 1.021 s。上述结果表明，该系统成功构建了一条从人类自发社会反应到物理 VLA 实时中断及参与者导向恢复的完整本地化通路。
Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.
EmoPose: Vision-Language Model Guided Emotion-Aware Gesture Generation for Humanoid Robots
EmoPose：视觉语言模型引导的人形机器人情感感知手势生成
具有社会交往能力的人形机器人必须能够通过姿态与语言共同传达情感与意图，然而，开放式的互动过程必须转化为既具表现力又可在特定躯体上执行的动作。这对在特定社会语境下的语义灵活性提出了要求，同时还需保持确定性且适应躯体特性的机器人控制。为此，我们提出了 EmoPose，这是一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的框架，通过可执行的语义接口 bridge 了这一差距。在给定语言、对话历史及可选视觉语境的前提下，VLM 可以选择一个包含表达类别、动作库变体、强度和语音锚点的有序姿态计划。一个可扩展的机器人专属动作库定义了可用的表达词汇表，并作为 14 自由度（14-DoF）关节目标的来源。
Pose Studio 支持轨迹自动生成、MuJoCo 预览，以及新动作库条目与 VLM 引导模块的自动同步；而机器人端的确定性模块则负责验证计划、构建轨迹、调度姿姿以及管理队列与中断。这种分工使得交互词汇库在应对新社会语境时得以扩展，且无需修改控制接口或将底层关节指令直接交给大模型处理。
在 EmoPose-Bench 基准测试中，基于 GPT-5.5 的结构化规划在简单层级（Easy tier）达到了 98.25±0.52% 的准确率，整体达到了 76.50±0.54%，超越了相同模型下的直接标签提示（direct-label prompting）。进一步的测试验证了对话语境的应用以及有序多动作的复合能力。该系统顺利完成了标准 MuJoCo 测试套件，并在宇树（Unitree）G1 物理机器人上实现了全部 29 种创作的变体。一个包含四个停靠点的实验室导览演示证明了系统在具备中断响应、基于相机语境的对话以及导航能力下的表达性讲解能力。
Socially competent humanoid robots must communicate affect and intent through gesture as well as speech, yet open-ended interaction must become motion that is both expressive and executable on a specific body. This demands semantic flexibility for contextual social intent while preserving deterministic, embodiment-aware robot control. We present EmoPose, a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework that bridges this gap through an executable semantic interface. Given language, dialogue history, and optional visual context, the VLM selects an ordered gesture plan containing a communicative class, library variant, intensity, and speech anchor. A scalable robot-owned motion library defines the available expressive vocabulary and the source of 14-DoF joint targets. Pose Studio supports automatic trajectory generation, MuJoCo preview, and automatic synchronization of new library entries with the VLM guide; deterministic robot-side modules validate plans, construct trajectories, schedule gestures, and manage queueing and interruption. This division lets the interaction repertoire grow for new social contexts without changing the control interface or delegating raw joint commands to the foundation model. On the EmoPose-Bench, structured GPT-5.5 planning reaches 98.25±0.52% on the Easy tier and 76.50±0.54% overall, exceeding same-model direct-label prompting. Further tests validate dialogue-context use and ordered multi-action composition. The system completes the nominal MuJoCo suite and realizes all 29 authored variants on the physical Unitree G1. A four-stop laboratory tour demonstrates expressive narration with interruption, camera-grounded dialogue, and navigation.
AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
AgenticTactileVLA：无需重训练 VLA 即可实现通用灵巧操作的接触引导式执行期监督
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够预测出具备可迁移性的操控策略，但在实际遇到的具体物体上却往往难以可靠地执行：符合同一种抓握方式的物体在几何形状和柔顺度上存在差异，且在手部遮挡下视觉反馈效能会下降。为此，我们提出了 AgenticTactileVLA，一种执行期（execution-time）监督器，它将部分针对特定物体的适应能力从预测环节转移到了物理交互环节。主干 VLA 负责提供靠近轨迹和手部目标姿态；而监督器则负责决定是保持透明（不干预）、微调手指弯曲度、保留或释放修正后的配置、将控制权交还给 VLA 以重试，还是选择柔顺的手部控制模式。该监督器利用手指位置和电机力矩反馈作为本体感觉接触依据，既不需要额外的触觉传感器，也不需要对 VLA 进行重训练。
在配备 BrainCo Revo2 灵巧手部的宇树（Unitree）G1 机器人上，针对 VLA 训练中未见过的 5 种物体进行了随机配对块评估。在相同的动作预算下，基础 VLA 的任务完成率为 61.3%，无条件闭合至堵转控制的完成率为 72.0%，而加入监督器后的完成率达到 84.0%；该提升在每种物体上均成立，且在存在适度姿态扰动的情况下依然保持。消融实验表明，这种提升无法仅用延长闭合时间来解释；同时，选择性触发机制在任务完成率无明显变化的前提下，将修正 Episode 的数量降低了 65.7%。
保持性审计表明，在未见过的测试用例中，系统接受修正对配置保持的预测准确率达到了 88.9%，而柔顺物体则揭示出了较为保守的误拒绝情况。针对薄壁杯的实验表明，系统能够上下文感知地路由至柔顺控制模式，其表现与始终采用柔顺控制的基准一致。上述结果表明，基于接触引导的执行期适应机制无需针对特定物体重新训练，即可通过调整物理执行过程，显著提升固定 VLA 对未见过物体的物体级泛化能力。
Vision-language-action policies may predict a transferable manipulation strategy yet fail to realize it reliably on the encountered object: objects compatible with the same grasp differ in geometry and compliance, and visual feedback degrades under closure occlusion. AgenticTactileVLA is presented as an execution-time supervisor that shifts part of object-specific adaptation from prediction to physical interaction. A fixed VLA provides the approach and hand targets; the supervisor decides whether to remain transparent, refine finger flexion, retain or release the corrected configuration, return control to the VLA for retry, or select a compliant hand-control regime. It uses finger-position and motor-effort feedback as proprioceptive contact evidence and requires neither tactile sensors nor VLA retraining. On a Unitree G1 with a BrainCo Revo2 hand, a randomized matched-block evaluation on five objects held out from VLA training yields 61.3% completion for the base VLA, 72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall control, and 84.0% for the supervisor under a shared budget; the gain is positive on every object and persists under moderate pose perturbations. Ablations show the gain is not explained by extended closure alone, and that selective triggering reduces correction episodes by 65.7% with no detected change in completion. A retention audit shows acceptance predicts retention in 88.9% of held-out cases, while compliant objects expose conservative false rejection. A thin-walled-cup study demonstrates contextual routing to compliant control, matching an always-compliant reference. These results suggest that contact-guided execution-time adaptation can improve the object-level generalization of a fixed VLA to held-out objects by adapting physical realization without object-specific retraining.
KINO: A Keyframe Interface for VLM Planning and Whole-Body Control in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
KINO：面向人形机器人移动操作中 VLM 规划与全身控制的关键帧接口
人形机器人的全身移动与操控（Loco-manipulation）要求机器人在执行协调的全身运动时，能够理解任务指令与场景语义。我们提出了一种层级化框架，利用运动关键帧（motion keyframes）作为视觉语言模型（VLM）规划与强化学习（RL）控制之间的中间表示。每个关键帧指定了目标的机器人全身姿态，以及在适用情况下的物体姿态。在给定语言指令、场景观察和执行反馈的前提下，VLM 会从预定义的库中选择后续与任务相关的关键帧。所选的关键帧会被重定向（retargeted）到当前场景，以适应物体的实际姿态和尺寸。随后，以关键帧为条件的全身策略将生成关节级动作以达成这些目标。
我们针对底层策略训练提出了一种基于显著性（saliency-based）的关键帧采样策略，在使用稀疏 VLM 关键帧时，该策略将端到端任务成功率从 44% 显著提升至 92%。我们在仿真环境以及宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人上，针对物体拾取、运输和放置任务对该框架进行了评估。
该系统成功执行了单手与双手操控任务，并能够泛化至超出训练参考数据范围的放置位置。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires robots to interpret task instructions and scene semantics while executing coordinated whole-body motions. We propose a hierarchical framework that uses motion keyframes as an intermediate representation between Vision-Language Model (VLM) planning and Reinforcement Learning (RL) control. Each keyframe specifies a target whole-body robot pose and, when applicable, an object pose. Given a language instruction, scene observations, and execution feedback, the VLM selects successive task-relevant keyframes from a predefined library. The selected keyframes are retargeted to the current scene to account for object poses and dimensions. A keyframe-conditioned whole-body policy then generates joint-level actions to reach these goals. We introduce a saliency-based keyframe sampling strategy for low-level policy training that improves end-to-end task success rate from 44% to 92% when using sparse VLM keyframes. We evaluate our framework on object pickup, transport, and placement tasks in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid. The system successfully performs both one- and two-handed manipulation and generalises to placement locations beyond the training reference data.
I-BFM: Reward-Conditioned Robust Humanoid Interaction via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
I-BFM：基于无监督强化学习的奖励条件鲁棒人形机器人交互
行为基础模型（BFMs）近期表明，单一的人形机器人策略能够支持多样化的全身控制，但将这种通用性扩展至物理交互依然极具挑战性。我们提出了 I-BFM，据我们所知，这是首个用于人形机器人与物体交互的行为基础模型。I-BFM 无需依赖特定任务的策略或参考轨迹跟踪，而是利用前向-后向表示（forward-backward representations）与无监督强化学习，学习人形机器人、物体及其接触面之间耦合动力学的共享表示。在给定下游任务奖励的前提下，同一个策略可直接以隐变量指令（latent command）为条件，在无需进行特定任务策略优化的情况下执行闭环交互。
为了提升跨不同时间尺度的交互控制能力，我们使用短时域（short-horizon）交互目标与长时域（longer-horizon）目标状态共同对策略进行训练。单一的 I-BFM 策略能够执行搬运、推拽和踢球，同时还支持目标到达、运动跟踪、风格化控制以及长时域任务链（task chaining）。
更重要的是，在偏离名义执行路径幅度较大的情况下，该策略依然保持有效：在搬运任务（Carry）中，I-BFM 取得了 94.3% 的名义成功率，并在机器人跌倒后仍能保持 89.3% 的恢复成功率，而基于规划的基线方法成功率仅为 1.3%。在宇树（Unitree）G1 物理机器人上的实验进一步证明了其多样化的全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）行为、应对交互失败与外部干扰时的快速恢复能力，以及无需特定任务重训练的任务链联动能力。
Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) have recently shown that a single humanoid policy can support diverse whole-body control, but extending such generality to physical interaction remains challenging. We introduce I-BFM, to our knowledge the first BFM for humanoid–object interaction. Rather than relying on task-specific policies or reference tracking, I-BFM learns a shared representation of the coupled dynamics among the humanoid, objects, and their contacts using forward-backward representations and unsupervised reinforcement learning. Given a downstream task reward, the same policy can be directly conditioned on a latent command to execute closed-loop interaction without task-specific policy optimization. To improve interaction control over different time scales, we further train the policy with both short-horizon interaction targets and longer-horizon goal targets. A single I-BFM policy performs carrying, pushing, and kicking, while also supporting goal reaching, motion tracking, stylistic control, and long-horizon task chaining. More importantly, it remains effective after large deviations from nominal execution: on Carry, I-BFM achieves 94.3% nominal success and retains 89.3% success after robot falls, compared with 1.3% for a planning-based baseline. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 further demonstrate diverse loco-manipulation behaviors, rapid recovery from interaction failures and external disturbances, and task chaining without task-specific retraining.
Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
通过谱技能学习富有表现力且具组合性的运动表征
机器人基础模型为实现通用人形机器人控制提供了一条富有前景的途径，通常采用分层架构来实现。然而，这些模型的有效性很大程度上取决于规划器与控制器之间的指令接口：该接口既需要支持精确的执行，又要易于预测，同时理想情况下还应允许从先前的行为中组合出全新的行为。
为此，我们提出了“谱技能”（Spectral Skills），这是该接口的一种隐空间表示（latent representation），通过预测性表示学习满足了上述要求。在设计上，谱技能能够紧凑地编码短时运动片段，并且是通过预测后续运动而非重构编码器输入来进行学习的。
在 29 自由度（29-DoF）的人形机器人上，以谱技能为条件的控制器相比现有最佳方法（SOTA）将全局跟踪误差降低了 62%。该冻结参数的控制器能够在无需单独转换策略（transition policy）的情况下，直接链式衔接独立编码的技能。此外，它还能通过在任何兼容的基础技能上添加正交方向来组合出新行为，生成训练数据中从未见过的组合。我们在宇树（Unitree）G1 物理机器人硬件上演示了跟踪、链式衔接与动作组合，以及通过语言条件规划器进行的自主控制。
Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. However, their effectiveness depends on the command interface between the planner and the controller, which must support accurate execution while remaining easy to predict, and ideally allow new behaviors to be composed from prior ones. In this work, we introduce spectral skills, a latent representation of this interface that meets these requirements through predictive representation learning. By design, spectral skills compactly encode short motion segments and are learned by predicting subsequent motion rather than reconstructing the encoder input. On a 29-DoF humanoid, a controller conditioned on spectral skills reduces global tracking error by 62\% relative to the state of the art. The same frozen controller chains independently encoded skills without a separate transition policy. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware.
DASH: A da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid Robots as an Accessible Platform for Surgical Robotics Research
DASH：一种面向串联链路机器人与人形机器人的达芬奇（da Vinci）适配器，作为手术机器人研究的通用平台
机器人微创手术具有明确的临床优势，但专用手术平台的昂贵成本与基础设施要求限制了其在乡村及资源匮乏医疗机构中的普及。近期研究尝试将通用机器人远程操控用于腹腔镜任务及体内手术，但大多依赖于通过无源连杆耦合的手持器械，而非机器人原生驱动。
相比之下，我们将达芬奇 Classic 和 Xi 系列手术器械适配到了可集成至临床工作流的通用机器人上。我们推出了 DASH——一种用于串联臂与人形机器人平台的达芬奇器械适配器（da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms）。DASH 包含两种类型的适配器，无需对手术器械本身进行任何修改。
每种适配器均可兼容多种不同负载能力的机器人平台，能成功锁紧器械的原生卡扣，并可通过无线方式识别插入的工具，以加载特定器械的运动学参数与耦合矩阵。远程操控实验证明了 DASH 的有效性，及其在推动学术界获取与研究手术机器人平台方面的独特优势。
Robotic minimally invasive surgery offers well-documented clinical benefits, but the cost and infrastructure requirements of purpose-built platforms limit access in rural and lower-resourced facilities. Recent work has teleoperated general-purpose robots for laparoscopic tasks and in vivo procedures, but relied on handheld instruments coupled through passive linkages rather than native robotic actuation. Instead, we adapt da Vinci Classic and Xi instruments onto general-purpose robots that can integrate in clinical workflows. We present DASH, a da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms, consisting of two types of adapters that require no modification to the instruments themselves. Each adapter is compatible with many robotic platform load capacities, engages the instrument's native latch, and wirelessly identifies inserted tools to load instrument-specific kinematics and coupling matrices. Teleoperated experiments demonstrate the efficacy of DASH and its benefits for enabling research access to surgical robotic platforms.
InterEvolve Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
InterEvolve：面向人形机器人移动与操作任务的奖励机制测试时演化
我们研究了针对人形机器人全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）的测试期演化（test-time evolution）：即通过复用已有的技能、从自身的尝试中不断改进并留存所学经验，在无需重新训练的前提下，解决控制器从未进行过训练的任务。
我们的核心见解在于：一个具备广泛能力的控制器本身就已经包含了新任务所需的大部分能力，而这种能力可以通过规划与控制之间的接口被成功调取——该接口需具备足够的表达能力以指定高接触、多阶段的交互行为，同时又需具备可执行性与可测量性，使得执行反馈能够基于经验引导规划过程。
InterEvolve 通过两个核心组件实现了这一接口。首先，我们开发了一个具备物体感知能力的前向-后向（FB）行为基础模型，该模型在冻结的躯体先验基础上的物体残差，能够在测试期将针对躯体或物体的全新奖励（reward）转化为全身移动与操控行为。其次，我们将任务形式化为奖励程序（reward programs）：即带有完成条件和可调常数的阶段化奖励。大型语言模型（LLM）智能体根据执行反馈和由已验证程序组成的技能库，在上下文（in-context）中对程序结构进行修订，同时由数值优化器对其常数进行调优。由于每个候选程序都在并行仿真场景中经过了验证，该程序能够不断探索新的方式，以诱导、复用和组合控制器现有的运动能力来完成当前任务，从而在迭代中实现性能提升。
实验表明，人类设计的奖励往往无法充分挖掘 FB 模型潜在的全身移动与操控能力，而由 InterEvolve 演化出的程序则释放了这种潜力，甚至能够产生全新的策略。此外，该方法在仿真环境中为多样化任务、复杂场景以及长时域复合任务生成了相应行为，且演化出的技能能够在宇树（Unitree）G1 物理机器人上仅依靠自顶向下的机载感知实现自主运行。
We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining.
