Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.
Understanding the Impact of Geometric Foundation Models on Vision-Language-Action Models
理解几何基础模型对视觉-语言-动作模型的影响
近期，研究人员探索了将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）与用于 3D 重建的几何基础模型（GFMs，如 VGGT）相融合的全新前景。尽管由此产生的几何 VLA 模型通常能表现出更优异的性能，但以下问题仍未得到明确解答：(i) 现代 VLA 模型本身是否已具备足够的几何理解能力？(ii) 将几何理解能力注入 VLA 的最佳架构是什么？(iii) 其他影响几何 VLA 的设计选择会带来怎样的效果？
针对这些问题，本文以特定的 VLA 模型（GR00T-N1.5）和 GFM 模型（VGGT）为例，提供了严谨的实验分析以予以解答。
我们的第一项贡献是通过基于线性探针（linear probing）的严谨分析，将此前研究中关于“现有 VLA 缺乏几何理解能力”的直觉猜想进行了形式化验证。该分析首次定量评估了 VLA 与 GFM 之间的“几何差距”（geometric gap）。我们的第二项贡献是识别并比较了连接 GFM 与 VLA 的不同策略。我们实现了三种不同的架构，它们在向 VLA 注入几何信息的方式上有所不同；同时，为了确保公平对比，我们尽量保持了低层级实现细节的统一。最后，我们分析了非架构层面选择（例如训练数据、摄像头数量、重建质量）对几何 VLA 性能的影响。
Recent work explores new opportunities at the intersection of vision-language-action models (VLAs) and geometric foundation models (GFMs) for 3D reconstruction, such as VGGT. While the resulting geometric VLAs often show improved performance, it remains unclear (i) if modern VLAs already have sufficient geometric understanding to start with, (ii) what is the best architecture to inject geometric understanding into a VLA, and (iii) what is the effect of other design choices that affect geometric VLAs. In this paper we provide a rigorous experimental analysis to shed light on these questions, for a specific choice of VLA (GR00T-N1.5) and GFM (VGGT). Our first contribution is to formalize prior work’s intuition that current VLAs lack geometric understanding, by providing a rigorous analysis based on linear probing. The analysis quantifies, for the first time, the “geometric gap” between VLAs and GFMs. Our second contribution is to identify and compare different strategies to bridge GFMs with VLAs. We implement three different architectures, which differ in the way they inject geometry in the VLA, while keeping low-level implementation details as similar as possible, to ensure a fair comparison. Finally, we analyze the impact of non-architectural choices (e.g., training data, number of cameras, reconstruction quality) on the performance of the geometric VLAs.
Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
Q-WAM：基于动作子空间保护的世界动作模型 4-bit 量化
世界动作模型（World Action Models，WAMs）通过迭代扩散机制联合生成视频与机器人动作，在机器人操控任务中展现出了出色的性能。然而，其高昂的计算与显存成本给实际部署带来了巨大挑战。后训练量化（PTQ）虽然能够降低这些成本，但现有的平滑（smoothing）与旋转（rotation）等 PTQ 方法不足以维持动作生成的精度。
为了克服这一局限，我们提出了 Q-WAM，一种针对 WAM 的全新 4 比特权重-激活量化方法，能够完整保留模型生成的动作精度。具体而言，我们引入了“动作可观测性格拉姆矩阵”（Action Observability Gramian，AOG），用于衡量某一层输入通道的加权组合在所有去噪步骤中由舍入误差引起的最终动作变化程度。同时，我们开发了“动作子空间保护”（Action-Subspace Protection，ASP）技术，将极少数对动作最敏感的通道组合保留在极小的 16 比特低秩分支中，并将其余补集权重与激活量化至 4 比特，二者均以能够高效运行于 GPU 上的密集矩阵乘法形式实现。最后，为了以最小开销保障动作质量，我们通过在每个专家的各层间聚合由 AOG 导出的“动作质量”（action mass），识别出对生成动作最为关键的专家，并仅对这些专家应用 ASP。
我们在仿真环境与真实世界部署中对 Q-WAM 在三种 WAM 模型上进行了评估。在 RoboTwin 2.0 基准测试中，Q-WAM 取得了 89.6%–93.0% 的平均成功率，与 16 比特浮点模型的差距保持在 1.1 个百分点以内，同时将量化块的显存占用降低了 3.1–3.4 倍。我们的方法在成功率上超越了最强的基线方法 SVDQuant 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人与双手 UR3 机器人的实机部署中，其成功率相比 SVDQuant 提高了 12.8–17.6 个百分点。
World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4×. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.
DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
DODGER：面向动态障碍物环境机器人导航的安全引导强化学习
在以人为中心的环境中运行的机器人必须在多个动态障碍物之间安全导航，以避免与人员及周围基础设施发生碰撞。控制屏障函数（Control Barrier Functions, CBFs）为安全过滤提供了一种有效机制，而近期基于 CBF 的强化学习（RL）方法则将此类安全信息嵌入到了学习到的策略中。然而，在训练期间仅执行经过安全过滤的动作会限制策略的探索能力，这一局限性在安全依赖于机器人与障碍物相对运动的动态场景中尤为明显。
为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DODGER——一种安全引导的强化学习框架。该框架直接执行策略生成的动作来驱动训练轨迹展开（rollouts），同时利用 CBF 过滤的参考动作和约束违反量（constraint violations）来塑造策略，使其收敛至避障行为。
我们通过杜宾斯汽车（Dubins-car）安全分析对 DODGER 进行了评估，并在全阶人形机器人仿真以及基于 激光雷达（LiDAR）感知的真实人形机器人实验中，展示了在无需运行期（runtime）安全过滤器的情况下，机器人在多个动态障碍物之间实现目标导向导航的能力。
Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.
CORNAV: Construction-Aware Reasoning for Robot Navigation on Active Worksites
CORNAV：面向动态施工现场机器人导航的施工感知推理
建筑行业长期面临着劳动力持续短缺、每年给全球经济造成超过 1.6 万亿美元损失的低生产率问题，以及主要行业中居高不下的工伤率。这些因素共同驱使人们应用自主机器人来提升生产效率并保障工人安全。然而，现有的基于语言锚定的导航系统仅依赖语义场景理解，缺乏诸如建筑图纸、动态演进的施工进度表以及安全约束等建筑领域的特定上下文信息。因此，它们无法可靠地定位永久性建筑结构特征，也难以在作业中的施工现场进行安全导航。
为此，我们提出了 CORNAV，一个基于蓝图锚定且感知施工进度的导航框架。该框架仅需 2D CAD 图纸和项目进度表，无需依赖建筑信息模型（BIM）。CORNAV 将建筑蓝图与分层开放词汇场景图（hierarchical open-vocabulary scene graphs）进行对齐以锚定物体查询，将项目进度表转化为随时间变化的导航约束，并利用基于大语言模型（LLM）的安全模块在规划前评估并升格危险区域。随后，A* 规划器会强制避开禁行区域（mandatory exclusion zones），并优先绕行高风险区域。
在室内办公室和真实施工现场的实验表明：相较于仅依靠语义检索的方法，基于蓝图锚定的机制将任务成功率从 13.0% 大幅提升至 72.2%；施工进度感知彻底消除了所有硬性违例区域（hard-zone）的闯入现象；同时，安全模块成功纠正并拒绝了由标注错误的项目进度表引发的危险请求。
The construction industry faces persistent labor shortages, low productivity that costs the global economy over $1.6 trillion annually, and one of the highest injury rates among major industries. These factors motivate the use of autonomous robots to improve efficiency and worker safety. Existing language-grounded navigation systems, however, rely on semantic scene understanding alone and lack access to construction-specific context such as architectural plans, evolving work schedules, and safety constraints. As a result, they localize permanent building features unreliably and cannot safely navigate active jobsites. We present CORNAV, a blueprint-grounded, schedule-aware navigation framework that operates from 2D CAD drawings and project schedules without requiring a Building Information Model. CORNAV aligns architectural blueprints against hierarchical open-vocabulary scene graphs to ground object queries, converts project schedules into time-varying navigation constraints, and validates requests through an LLM-based safety module that escalates hazardous zones before planning. An A* planner then enforces mandatory exclusion zones while preferentially avoiding higher-risk areas. Across an indoor office and a real construction site, blueprint grounding raises task success from 13.0% to 72.2% over semantic retrieval alone, schedule awareness eliminates all hard-zone violations, and the safety module correctly rejects hazardous requests arising from mislabeled project schedules.
ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
ECHO-G：具身伴随语音的人形机器人动作生成
为人形机器人生成全身肢体伴随演讲动作（co-speech motion）需要协调语音韵律、语言文本内容以及特定躯体（embodiment-specific）的运动控制。为此，我们提出了 ECHO-G，一个同时以语音音频与带时间戳的转录文本（timed transcripts）为条件的框架。
该框架的核心组件——语音锚定扩散 Transformer（SGDiT），将帧对齐的声学特征与 Token 级别的语言上下文相结合，在保留各自不同粒度的同时实现有效融合。利用纠正流匹配（Rectified Flow Matching）训练，SGDiT 能够直接在机器人动作空间中对“单语句对多动作”（one-to-many）的映射关系进行建模。
为了支持训练与评估，我们基于 BEAT2 数据集构建了一个衍生音频-文本-机器人数据集，并提出了包含肢体语言特征、机器人运动质量及运行效率的标杆测试集（benchmark）。对比评估表明，相比于“先生成人类动作再重定向（retargeting）到机器人”的传统管线，直接在机器人空间中生成动作具有明显优势；同时，模态消融实验强调了音频与文本联合调控带来的收益。此外，我们展示了该框架在真实物理人形机器人上的部署效果，补充的视频评估研究也表明受试者更偏好联合调控所生成的动作。
Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.
KPI: A Promptable Kernel for Physical Interaction on Humanoids
KPI：一种支持提示（Promptable）的核，用于人形机器人的物理交互
人形机器人如今在行走、平衡与伸手等动作上展现出了非凡的通用性：单一的全身跟踪策略（whole-body tracking policy）即可跟随来自于人类或端到端策略的参考轨迹。然而，这种通用性仅体现在轨迹层面，而仅凭轨迹所包含的交互信息极其有限：在发生接触时，最终由执行控制器决定机器人的行为方式。针对单一任务的策略通常通过在仿真中对轨迹和控制器进行联合优化，来达成高难度的接触交互；而通用的控制架构则通常假设控制器是预先设定或人工选定的。
为此，我们提出了 KPI，一种介于轨迹生成源与未加修改的全身跟踪器之间的提示化物理交互核（promptable kernel）。轨迹生成源发送的不再是任务前固定的控制器参数，而是一个“契约”（contract）：即在各个维度方向上指定是执行跟踪、保持柔顺，还是维持特定的力矩范围。在接触更新频率下，该交互核根据跟踪误差和力矩估计，自适应地调整双臂的刚度、阻尼、参考姿态以及前馈量。
我们通过一个智能体框架演示了 KPI 的能力：仅凭一条语言指令，视觉-语言智能体即可生成参考轨迹与交互契约，无需编写任何针对特定任务的代码。我们展示了由指令驱动的绞盘操作、开门和箱子搬运，以及脚本化的表面交互实验。在绞盘操作的演示中，人形机器人成功转动曲柄，将一台重达数十公斤的第二台机器人完全提升离开地面。
Humanoids now walk, balance and reach with remarkable generality: one whole-body tracking policy follows references from a human, or from an end-to-end policy. That generality travels in the trajectory, and a trajectory alone carries limited information about the interaction it should produce: at contact, the executing controller determines how the robot behaves. Single-task policies usually reach hard interactions by optimising trajectory and controller together in simulation; general stacks usually assume a preset or hand-chosen controller. We present KPI, a promptable kernel for physical interaction between the trajectory source and an unmodified whole-body tracker. Instead of a controller fixed before the task, the trajectory source sends a contract: per direction, track, comply, or hold a force range. From tracking error and a wrench estimate, the kernel adapts the arms' stiffness, damping, reference and feedforward toward it at contact rate. We demonstrate KPI through an agentic framework: from one instruction, a vision-language agent writes both the reference trajectory and the contract, with no task-specific code. We demonstrate instruction-driven winch operation, door opening, and box transport, alongside scripted surface-interaction experiments. In the winch demonstration, the humanoid is able to turn a crank to hoist a second robot fully off the ground.
StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
StageVLN：用于高效视觉语言导航的空间与轨迹辅助引导
视觉与语言导航（VLN）策略日益受益于大语言-视觉模型（VLMs）所提供的强语义先验。然而，标准的动作监督机制并未明确鼓励中间表示去保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局 Episode 的推进进度。虽然在推理阶段引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型能够提供此类结构信息，但这也会在部署时带来额外的计算、显存开销以及架构依赖。
为此，我们提出了 StageVLN，一种在保持原始推理路径不变的前提下，通过特权空间与轨迹引导来塑造导航表示的训练框架。在训练过程中，一个冻结参数的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导，同时相对航向与专家路线进度目标则提供互补的轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练阶段使用，在部署时均会被移除。
在 R2R-CE 未见过的验证集（validation-unseen）上，使用 4B 参数骨干网络且在推理阶段无需额外几何编码器的 StageVLN 取得了 56.3% 的成功率（SR）和 51.4% 的成功率加权路径长度（SPL）。在 RxR-CE 上，该方法在不依赖额外导航训练数据以及推理阶段无需几何编码器的条件下，实现了 54.3% 的成功率（SR）。
Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.
From Gameplay to Policy: Towards Scalable Robot Data Collection via Gamified Robot-Free Interaction
从游戏化交互到策略学习：基于无需机器人参与的游戏化交互实现可扩展的机器人数据采集
学习泛化能力强（generalizable）的机器人操控策略需要大规模且多样化的交互数据，然而在真实世界中采集示教数据的成本高昂且难以拓展。现有的数据采集方法要么依赖于特定的机器人硬件，从而限制了众包与可迁移性；要么面临标注不完整和行为多样性有限的问题。
受电子游戏如何维持人类长期参与感的启发，我们探索了一种全新的范式：将数据采集过程转化为具有吸引力的游戏体验，并将由此衍生的人类操控经验迁移至真实机器人中。我们推出了 Project Kitchen，一个基于虚拟现实（VR）的游戏化第一视角（egocentric）数据采集平台。该平台能够激发多样化且目标导向的操控行为，同时独立于具体的机器人躯体和硬件限制，使其适用于更广泛且具备大规模部署潜力的应用场景。
为了弥合游戏到真实的差距（game-to-real gap），我们进一步提出了 Game2Policy 方法。该方法从游戏轨迹中提取具备躯体不变性（embodiment-invariant）的意向性/可负担性线索（affordance cues），包括接触点和子目标状态（sub-goal states）。意向性模型首先在游戏采集的数据上进行预训练，随后仅需极少数真实机器人的示教数据，即可与下游策略进行联合微调（fine-tuning）。
实验表明，在少样本（few-shot）设定下，Game2Policy 在仿真环境中将平均成功率提升了 10.0 个百分点，在真实机器人上提升了 18.3 个百分点。用户研究与定量分析进一步表明，Project Kitchen 能够促进多样化操控行为的产生，并提供具有吸引力的采集体验。这些结果证明了游戏化虚拟环境作为操控知识可拓展来源的巨大潜力。平台与代码将在论文接收后开源。
Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse interaction data, yet collecting real-world demonstrations remains costly and difficult to scale. Existing approaches to data collection are either dependent on specific robot hardware that limits crowdsourcing and transferability, or suffer from incomplete annotation and limited behavioral diversity. Inspired by how games sustain long-term human engagement, we explore an alternative paradigm that turns data collection into an engaging gameplay experience and transfers the resulting human manipulation experience to real robots. We present Project Kitchen, a VR-based gamified egocentric data collection platform that elicits diverse, goal-directed manipulation while remaining independent of specific robot embodiments and hardware, making it applicable to broader and potentially large-scale deployment. To bridge the game-to-real gap, we further introduce Game2Policy, which extracts embodiment-invariant affordance cues, including contact points and sub-goal states, from gameplay trajectories. An affordance model is pre-trained on game-collected data and then jointly fine-tuned with downstream policies using only a handful of real-robot demonstrations. Experiments show that Game2Policy improves average success rates by 10.0 points in simulation and 18.3 points on real robots in the few-shot setting. User studies and quantitative analyses further show that Project Kitchen promotes diverse manipulation behaviors and provides an engaging data collection experience. These results demonstrate the potential of gamified virtual environments as a scalable source of manipulation knowledge. The platform and code will be released upon acceptance.
AdaGeoVLN: Selective Geometry Across Representation Depth and Navigation Time for Vision-Language Navigation
AdaGeoVLN：面向视觉-语言导航的、跨表征深度与导航时间的几何信息选择性利用
视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求将语言指令与视觉观察进行对齐，同时随着时间推移保持对空间几何的理解。几何基础模型（GFMs）在其分层架构中暴露了丰富的中间表示，但导航策略应当如何利用这些特征，以及如何保留历史几何证据，目前仍未得到很好的解决。
为此，我们提出了一个流式 VLN 框架，从表示深度与导航时间两个维度应对上述挑战。分层 GFM-VLM 融合将早期、中期和晚期的 GFM 表示依次耦合至策略的不同阶段，而非重复注入单一的末端特征。感知导航的 GFM 记忆机制在受限的单层预算下，根据指令相关性、几何置信度以及状态转移的新颖度，有选择地保留历史 VGGT 全局注意力 KV 状态。这些保留的状态在与策略融合之前，为后续观察提供了关键的几何上下文。
在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准测试中，该框架仅依靠单路 RGB 视频流且无需额外的导航专属外部数据，即可取得强劲的性能表现。对比消融实验表明：在匹配的融合位置上，多深度耦合的性能显著优于重复注入末端特征的方法；同时，受限的感知导航保留机制在大幅降低 GFM-KV 显存占用的同时，完整维持了导航性能（相比于大显存占用方案）。这些研究结果表明，有必要将暴露给策略的几何表示与为后续推理留存的历史证据结合起来进行联合考量。
Vision-language navigation requires aligning language with visual observations while maintaining spatial understanding over time. Geometry foundation models (GFMs) expose intermediate representations throughout their hierarchy, but how navigation policies should use these features and retain historical geometric evidence remains unresolved. We introduce \method{}, a streaming VLN framework that addresses these questions across \textbf{representation depth} and \textbf{navigation time}. Hierarchical GFM--VLM fusion couples earlier, intermediate, and later GFM representations to successive policy stages instead of repeatedly injecting a terminal feature. Navigation-aware GFM memory retains historical VGGT global-attention KV states according to instruction relevance, geometric confidence, and transition novelty under a bounded per-layer budget. Retained states provide geometric context for subsequent observations before fusion with the policy. Across R2R-CE and RxR-CE, \method{} achieves strong performance using a single RGB stream without additional navigation-specific external data. Controlled ablations show that multi-depth coupling substantially outperforms repeated terminal-feature injection at matched fusion locations. Bounded navigation-aware retention preserves navigation performance while considerably reducing GFM-KV memory relative to larger-memory temporal retention. These findings support jointly examining the geometric representations exposed to the policy and the historical evidence retained for future inference.
WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
WB-WAM：面向人形机器人移动-操作任务的异构身体-手部预训练
人形机器人的全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）要求身体与双手的行为高度协调，然而传统的机器人预训练数据对此类全身运动的覆盖非常有限。
为此，我们提出了 WB-WAM，一种将显式全身动作监督融入生成式视频预训练的世界动作模型（World Action Model）。该模型通过构建一个共享的物理动作空间，整合了来自异构数据源的身体、根节点（root）以及灵巧手注释，从而能够从 1880.2 小时的部分标注视频和运动数据中开展联合视频与动作学习。由此产生的先验表示通过 PICO 中期训练（mid-training）进行精炼，并在辅助正运动学（Forward Kinematics）监督下进一步适配至机器人具体任务。
为了支持这些阶段的训练，我们构建了 WB-Datasets 数据集，其中包含重定向的第一视角（egocentric）人类示教与机器人轨迹，使得任务对齐的人类运动能够有效补充有限的机器人数据。
仿真评估表明，WB-WAM 在 HumanoidArena 基准测试中取得了 81.9% 的强劲全身任务性能；真实世界实验进一步验证了其有效性，在 5 项任务中实现了 84.0% 的平均成功率。此外，任务对齐的 PICO 中期训练在提升下游任务性能的同时，降低了对真实机器人示教数据的需求。这些结果证明，异构全身预训练与人类运动迁移是实现高数据效率人形机器人全身移动与操控的一条切实可行的路径。
Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.
Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
Uni-VLaT：面向人形机器人移动与操作的 VLA 策略全身触觉适应
在全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）过程中，物理接触往往决定了人形机器人应当做出的响应；然而仅凭视觉与本体感觉（proprioception）往往难以精准表征物理交互，尤其是在接触区域受到遮挡的情况下。相比于预定义区域稀疏的力或力矩测量，分布式触觉感知能够在机器人全身保留具备空间分辨率的接触模式。
为此，我们深入研究了如何将此类全身触觉信息集成至视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，以实现高接触强度的控制。我们提出的 Uni-VLaT 方法引入了一条触觉通路，其隐状态（latent state）不仅针对动作生成进行训练，还被训练用于预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表示。这种预测性目标构建了一个以触觉为锚点的多模态上下文，促进了对物理世界更具结构化的理解。
我们在涵盖触觉触发移动、持续物理交互、人机接触以及全身移动与操控的 5 项真实机器人任务上对 Uni-VLaT 进行了评估。Uni-VLaT 取得了 75% 的平均成功率，相比无触觉输入的基线方法提升了 43 个百分点，相比无预测性监督的触觉输入基线提升了 7 个百分点。在两个预训练 VLA 骨干网络上，我们的方法将“桌面扫除”（Table Sweeping）任务的性能在两个骨干网络上均提升了 30 个百分点，并将“后背触碰行走”（Back-Tap Walking）任务提升了 85–90 个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，上下文触觉预测与绝对未来目标对性能至关重要。
这些结果表明，预测性触觉学习为将预训练 VLA 策略拓展至全身物理交互领域提供了一条极为有效的路径。
Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.
BT-Planner: A Hierarchical Task Planning Framework for Robot using Large Language Models and Behavior Trees
制定高度鲁棒且具可解释性的动作规划，对于使机器人能够可靠地在真实物理环境中执行长时域（long-horizon）任务至关重要。尽管端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型具备泛化能力，但它们存在黑盒决策与高数据依赖的问题。相反，传统的行为树（Behavior Tree, BT）方法虽然提供了可解释性，但缺乏动态适应性与自动化生成能力。
本文提出了 BT-Planner，一种将大语言模型（LLM）的高层级推理能力与行为树的结构化执行控制相结合的全新分层框架。BT-Planner 通过 LLM 规划器将复杂的自然语言指令分解为一系列子任务，随后将其映射至可复用的机器人技能库，并自动合成定义为参数化 XML 格式的可执行行为树。专用的 BT 解析与执行引擎随后将 XML 转化为运行期（runtime）实例，进而驱动机器人执行任务。
与端到端方法相比，我们的方法增强了可解释性、促进了技能复用并降低了数据依赖；而与静态行为树设计相比，则提升了自主性与灵活性。实验结果证明了该框架在动态环境中管理复杂顺序任务时的有效性。
Formulating highly robust and interpretable action plans is essential for enabling robot to reliably execute long-horizon tasks in real-world physical environments. While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer generalization, they suffer from black-box decision-making and high data dependence. Conversely, traditional Behavior Tree (BT) approaches provide interpretability but lack dynamic adaptability and automated generation capabilities. This paper presents BT-Planner, a novel hierarchical framework that synergizes the high-level reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the structured execution control of BTs. BT-Planner decomposes complex natural language instructions into a sequence of sub-tasks via an LLM-planner, which are then mapped to a reusable robot skill library and automatically synthesized into an executable BT defined in a parameterized XML format. A dedicated BT parsing and execution engine translates the XML into a runtime instance, driving the robot to execute tasks. Our method enhances explainability, facilitates skill reuse, and reduces data dependency compared to end-to-end approaches, while adding autonomy and flexibility over static BT designs. Experimental results demonstrate the framework’s effectiveness in managing complex, sequential tasks in dynamic environments.
One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
“从无限中取其一”：利用预训练世界模型将未来构想转化为机器人动作
预训练的视频世界模型能够为一个场景预测出许多合理的未来形态，但机器人必须精确实现符合特定任务要求的未来。为了将世界模型转化为可执行的机器人策略，现有的方法通常利用大规模的机器人数据和计算资源去微调庞大的世界模型骨干网络。
与这种固有范式不同，我们认为最昂贵的预训练成本在视频世界模型建立时便已支付完毕，因为其表示空间已经布局了丰富多样潜在的未来景象。在这种情况下，后续只需选择能够完成任务的未来，并解读出能将其实现的相应动作。我们讲这一任务形式化为“现实化”（actualization）——即在冻结的世界模型所提供的先验基础之上，学习任务调控下的未来选择与动作实现。该任务仅需一个极小的“现实化器”（actualizer）模型即可解决。
我们实现了 RoboActualizer，在冻结的世界模型编码器之上仅构建了 60M 参数。该现实化器由两个轻量级扩散 Transformer（DiT）专家组成，通过流匹配（flow matching）联合预测未来隐变量（latents）与动作。整个模型完全可以在单张 peak 显存为 32 GB 的 GPU 上完成训练。相比于现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs），RoboActualizer 的可训练参数减少了高达 100 倍，但在包括 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 仿真基准测试以及两个真实平台上的 5 项任务中均取得了优异性能，同时具备仅 39 ms 的低延迟，完全满足实时控制需求。
A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.
ResSafe: Learning Safety Filtering with Residual Reinforcement Learning for Humanoids
ResSafe：面向人形机器人的基于残差强化学习的安全过滤学习
由于高维动力学、高强度接触交互以及对扰动的高度敏感性，人形机器人的安全控制一直是一项极具挑战性的任务。尽管强化学习使机器人具备了出色的移动与运动跟踪能力，但学习到的策略仍有可能生成不安全动作，进而导致系统失稳或倒塌。
在本文中，我们提出了将残差强化学习（residual reinforcement learning）作为一种隐式安全过滤机制，用于人形机器人的安全控制。我们没有依赖单一的名义策略（nominal policy）来同时平衡性能、安全性与鲁棒性，而是将性能与安全性进行了解耦。
名义策略仅专注于任务性能的优化，而残差策略则专门学习安全修正动作。这种解耦机制带来了更好的“性能-安全性”帕累托权衡（Pareto trade-off），同时避免了在单一策略训练中对多个互相竞争的奖励项（reward terms）进行繁琐调优的需要。我们证明了残差策略能够有效充当隐式安全过滤器的角色。
Safe control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to their high-dimensional dynamics, contact-rich interactions, and sensitivity to disturbances. Although reinforcement learning has enabled effective locomotion and motion tracking, learned policies can still generate unsafe actions that lead to instability or falls. In this work, we propose residual reinforcement learning as an implicit safety-filtering mechanism for safe humanoid control. Instead of relying on a single nominal policy to simultaneously balance performance, safety, and robustness, we decouple performance and safety. The nominal policy focuses solely on task performance, while a residual policy learns safety corrections. This decoupling leads to a better performance--safety Pareto trade-off and avoids the need for careful tuning of multiple competing reward terms within a single policy training. We show that the residual policy can act as an implicit safety filter.
Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
基于学习型可停止性值的仿人机器人安全停止
人形机器人响应紧急停止指令时通常会执行固定动作，而不会推断当前状态下实现安全停止是否真正可行。我们把紧急停止建模为一个达到-避障（reach-avoid）问题，并提出了 Safe-Stop——一个将学习到的停止策略与学习到的可停止性估计器（stoppability estimators）相结合的任务无关框架。
这两个估计器互相补充：一个是由固定停止策略实际结果监督的“停止概率估计器”，另一个是由基于物理状态的汉密尔顿-雅可比备份（Hamilton-Jacobi backup）监督的“到达-避障估计器”。前者捕捉学习控制器浮现出的停止行为，后者则提供互补的可恢复性信号。
由于停止策略与估计器均不依赖于停止指令发出前的行为策略，因此它们可以在多种不同的上游任务间直接迁移，而无需重新训练。在部署阶段，两个估计结果相融合：仅当两个估计器均表明停止仍然可行时，Safe-Stop 才会执行停止；否则将转交给跌倒策略（在本文中具体实现为阻尼退避控制）。这种双重一致性校验做出的决策，在保障鲁棒性的同时亦兼顾了响应速度。
Humanoid robots responding to emergency stop commands typically execute a fixed maneuver, without reasoning about whether a safe stop is actually feasible from the current state. We cast emergency stopping as a reach-avoid problem and propose Safe-Stop, a task-agnostic framework that pairs a learned stop policy with learned stoppability estimators. The estimators are complementary: a stop-probability estimator supervised by the actual outcomes of the fixed stop policy, and a reach-avoidance estimator supervised by a Hamilton-Jacobi backup over physical state. The first captures emergent stopping behavior of the learned controller; the second provides a complementary recoverability signal. Because the stop policy and estimators do not depend on the behavior policy that preceded the stop command, they transfer across diverse upstream tasks without retraining. At deployment, the two estimates are combined: Safe-Stop commits to the stop only when both estimators indicate that stopping remains feasible, otherwise it hands off to a fall policy, instantiated as a damping fallback. This agreement check yields decisions that are robust without sacrificing reactivity.
Echo in the Steps: Learning Perceptive Humanoid Parkour with Gated Memory
基于学习型可停止性值的仿人机器人安全停止
尽管感知移动技术（perceptive locomotion）的最新进展已使人形机器人能够穿越结构化地形，但在高度不连续的复杂环境中实现敏捷跑酷（agile parkour）仍是一个巨大的挑战。特别是穿越稀疏踏足点（sparse footholds）和狭窄支撑区域时，要求机器人具备精准的踏足点选择能力、对视觉观测的有效利用，以及在快速过渡期间保持一致的交替步态控制。
在本文中，我们提出了一个基于感知的双足/人形机器人跑酷框架。该框架仅依赖机载深度观测（onboard depth observations），即可实现在踏足点受限的复杂地形上的稳定穿越。该框架包含一个显著性引导的时间感知模块（saliency-guided temporal perception module），该模块将显著性先验（saliency prior）与门控记忆机制（gated memory）相结合，能够跨帧保留关键的深度特征，从而在仅有局部观测的条件下实现可靠的踏足点定位。此外，通过引入交替损失（alternation loss），我们的对称性正则化机制鼓励机器人的交替步态模式，显著提升了穿越过程的鲁棒性。
大量的仿真与真实世界实验表明，在具挑战性的地形条件下，我们的方法大幅提高了任务成功率以及踏足点的精准度。
While recent advances in perceptive locomotion have enabled humanoid robots to traverse structured terrains, agile parkour in highly discontinuous environments remains an open challenge. In particular, crossing sparse footholds and narrow support regions requires precise foothold selection, effective use of visual observations, and consistent alternating foot placement during fast transitions. In this paper, we present a perceptive humanoid parkour framework that enables stable traversal across terrains with limited foothold availability using only onboard depth observations. The framework features a saliency-guided temporal perception module that combines a saliency prior with gated memory. It retains informative depth features across frames, enabling reliable foot placement from partial observations. By introducing an alternation loss, our symmetry regularization encourages alternating gait patterns and improves traversal robustness. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly improves success rate and foothold accuracy on challenging terrains in both simulation and the real world.
ADAPT: Agile Diffusion Action Priors for Robust and Steerable Online Text-Driven Humanoid Control
ADAPT：用于鲁棒且可控的在线文本驱动人形机器人控制的敏捷扩散动作先验
现有的主流文本到动作（text-to-motion）管线通常为独立的跟踪器生成运动学动作，无法很好地应对人形机器人在保持平衡、自然运动和平滑过渡的同时，对不断变化的指令做出连续响应的需求。
为此，我们提出了 ADAPT——一个用于交互式、文本条件化人形机器人全身控制的端到端闭环控制框架。该框架从带有文本标签的人形机器人状态-动作轨迹中学习一个基于扩散的动作先验，从而能够直接根据语言指令执行多样化的运动技能。为了提升长时域的鲁棒性并实现平滑的提示词切换，我们在冻结的扩散控制器之上训练了一个轻量级的残差强化学习策略。此外，我们进一步证明了同一扩散策略可以重复利用作可操控的文本条件化运动先验，用于下游任务的自适应调整。
实验结果表明，ADAPT 实现了强鲁棒性的语言锚定技能执行、平滑的交互式过渡以及风格保持的下游控制。
We present ADAPT, an end-to-end framework for interactive, text-conditioned humanoid whole-body control. Unlike dominant text-to-motion pipelines that generate kinematic motions for a separate tracker, ADAPT solves language control with an end-to-end closed-loop control framework, where the robot must continuously respond to changing commands while maintaining balance, natural motion, and smooth transitions. ADAPT learns a diffusion-based action prior from text-labeled humanoid state-action trajectories, enabling diverse motion skills to be directly executed from language commands. To improve long-horizon robustness and smooth prompt switching, we train a lightweight residual reinforcement learning policy on top of the frozen diffusion controller. We further show that the same diffusion policy can be reused as a steerable text-conditioned motion prior for downstream task adaptation. Experiments demonstrate robust language-grounded skill execution, smooth interactive transitions, and style-preserving downstream control.
EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
EgoHumanoid-V2：面向移动操作任务的协同全身技能从人类到人形机器人的迁移
人类示教数据无需机器人遥操作（teleoperation）即可捕获多样的场景与丰富的全身技能。以往关于第一视角（egocentric）迁移的研究主要侧重于解耦控制下全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）的场景泛化，而对协调全身技能的直接迁移探讨较少。
为此，我们提出了 EgoHumanoid-V2，这是首个用于协调全身移动与操控的“第一视角人到人形机器人”技能迁移框架。其核心机制在于由粗到细的动作对齐（coarse-to-fine action alignment），该方法将运动学参考修正与感知动力学的精炼相结合，在保留全身协调性的同时提升了末端执行器（end-effector）的位姿精度。此外，我们利用机器人手臂渲染与训练阶段的图像增强技术，缩减了视觉躯体差异（visual embodiment gap）并增强了视角的鲁棒性。
在 4 项真实世界任务中，基于对齐的人类数据训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略展现出了零样本（zero-shot）技能迁移能力，无需目标任务的机器人示教数据。其任务得分与基于遥操作数据训练的策略相当，同时大幅降低了数据采集成本。这些结果证明了人类数据可以直接作为技能的监督信号。
Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.
Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
基于离散 VLA 模型的仿人机器人移动与操作
基于离散动作 Token 的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已被证明在控制机械臂执行操控任务方面非常有效。然而对于人形机器人而言，涵盖双腿、躯干、双臂和双手在内的全身动作空间维度要高得多，且具备显著的异构性（heterogeneous），这带来了先前的 VLA 模型未能解决的 Token 化、训练以及实时推理难题。
为此，我们提出了 Holo-M，据我们所知，这是首个通过将语言模型词表扩展至包含动作 Token、从而内在地利用语言模型的人形机器人全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）离散 VLA 模型。在该模型中，我们设计了一个统一的动作 Token 化器（unified action tokenizer），将人形机器人的动作空间分解为 4 个特定部位的 Token 化器——末端执行器、身体、双手以及运动学，从而支持在极具差异的躯体形态（embodiments）与数据源（包括人形机器人遥操作、第一视角人类视频与仿真数据）之间进行训练。通过将语言模型的词表扩展至这些动作 Token，我们避免了使用独立连续动作专家模型所固有的“知识孤岛/知识隔绝”（knowledge-insulation）问题。为了满足实时控制要求，我们通过分组离散扩散解码（grouped discrete diffusion decoding）来解码每个身体部位的动作 Token，而非在动作 Token 上使用自回归。
我们在 SIMPLE 人形机器人全身移动与操控基准测试中进行了广泛的实验，Holo-M 在通用型（generalist）和专家型（specialist）评估中均取得了最高的成功率，并以显著优势领先第二名。我们将开源所有的代码与模型权重。
Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.
HuGo: LLMs as Whole-Body Policy Code Designers for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
HuGo：面向人形机器人移动与操作任务的全身策略代码设计器（基于大语言模型）
为了使人形机器人能够在日常环境中发挥实际作用，它们必须具备执行将移动与操控深度耦合的丰富任务的能力。现有方法通常通过奖励工程（reward engineering）或示教数据结合针对具体任务的训练来获取全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）策略，这使得将策略拓展至新任务的成本非常高昂。
在本文中，我们提出了一套人形机器人全身移动与操控的分层控制方法，消除了这些对单项任务的特定依赖。我们提出的 HuGo（Humanoid policy code Generation）在冻结的低层全身控制策略（low-level whole-body policy）之上，利用大语言模型（LLM）根据任务描述自动生成可执行的闭环高层策略代码（high-level policy code）。在给定任务、观测信息与指令规范的前提下，LLM 负责在代码中构建任务逻辑。随后，HuGo 通过使用数值轨迹与精选视频帧对策略的 Rollout（轨迹展开）进行反馈与针对性的代码更新，从而对策略做出精炼。
在跨越 5 个仿真任务以及采用 2 种不同低层策略的实验中，HuGo 的性能大幅超越了高层强化学习基线，并接近了基于示教数据的基线性能。值得注意的是，我们是在无需针对特定任务进行奖励设计或采集示教数据的条件下取得这一性能水平的。我们进一步展示了仿真生成的策略在物理硬件上的零样本（zero-shot）迁移能力，并证明将相同的精炼循环应用于真实世界的 Rollout 过程，能够在不依赖专家示教或重新训练策略的前提下进一步提升迁移效果。
For humanoids to be useful in everyday environments, they must perform a wide range of tasks that couple locomotion and manipulation. Existing approaches commonly acquire a loco-manipulation policy through reward engineering or demonstrations followed by task-specific training, making it costly to scale to new tasks. In this work, we propose a hierarchical approach to humanoid loco-manipulation that eliminates these per-task requirements. HuGo, Humanoid policy code Generation, uses a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate executable, closed-loop high-level policy code from a task description on top of a frozen low-level whole-body policy. Given the task, observation, and command specifications, the LLM constructs the task logic in code. HuGo then refines the policy from its rollouts using numerical trajectories and selected video frames to produce feedback and targeted code updates. Across five simulation tasks, using two different low-level policies, HuGo substantially outperforms a high-level reinforcement learning baseline and approaches the performance of a demonstration-based baseline. We achieve this level of performance without task-specific reward design or demonstration collection. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer of simulation-generated policies to hardware and show that applying the same refinement loop to real-world rollouts can further improve transfer performance without expert demonstrations or policy retraining.
RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
RoboFoundry：面向自学习具身智能体的“系统即策略”演化方法
基础模型不应作为具身智能体孤立地发挥作用。然而，现有的方法往往只优化智能体技术栈中的单个组件（如记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口），而没有将支撑系统本身视为一个统一的策略。此外，单纯的交互并不能带来自我提升，除非执行经验能够转化为持久的、经过验证的系统变更。
为此，我们提出了 RoboFoundry，这是首个将这一过程构想为“自我演化系统即策略”（Self-Evolving System-as-Policy）的具身智能体框架。RoboFoundry 能够诊断决策和记忆管理中的能力短板，将执行轨迹转化为经过验证的任务特定系统更新，并推动对通用系统的持续改进。演化过程在两个互补的层面展开：一个是管理主动内部上下文和持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，另一个是组织原子技能、可复用组合以及故障条件恢复的分层技能系统。
共享的语义接口将与躯体无关的决策与躯体特定的执行隔离开来，从而使演化出的系统能力能够在异构机器人之间进行迁移。在 EmbodiedBench 上，RoboFoundry 取得了 SOTA（state-of-the-art）性能，显著将 GPT-5.5 的表现提升了 27.8%。它还使 Qwen3.7-Plus 接近了 GPT-5.5 的水平（70.3% 对 72.7%），展示了跨基础模型的系统即策略演化带来的持续收益。
在长时域记忆方面，RoboFoundry 在 RoboMemArena 上超越了所有基线方法至少 39.0%，甚至击败了有外部基础模型辅助的方法。在 LIBERO-PRO 上，它在所有扰动类型下进一步超越了 Cap-Agent0 达 243.8%–679.7%。在真实世界的部署中，RoboFoundry 展现出了跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移及在线演化能力，凸显了其实现完全自主具身智能体的巨大潜力。
A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8–679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.
SocioGesture: Real-Time and Adaptive Social Gesture Perception for Human-Robot Interaction
SocioGesture：面向人机交互的实时自适应社交手势感知
与人类交互的机器人不仅需要识别显式指令，还必须能够推断各种社交信号，例如邀请、拒绝和不可用状态。在实际部署中，这些信号必须在噪声极大的机载感知、局部遮挡、视角变换以及严格的延迟限制下进行推断。
为此，我们提出了 SocioGesture。该框架将紧凑的、具置信度感知的身体-手部骨骼表示与一个轻量级双流模型相结合，能够在单次前向传播中融合身体运动与手部关节动作。通过在刻意损坏的骨骼数据（如缺失手部、手臂被遮挡、关键点闪烁不定等）上进行训练，系统在不增加任何推理期开销的前提下获得了极高的鲁棒性。在混合室内与室外场景下收集的社交手势数据集上，该系统展现出了对未见（held-out）受试者的泛化能力，能够在结构化的关节遮挡下保持稳定，并可在机器人搭载的边缘设备上实时运行。
在部署期间，机器人会自动保存其不确定的交互片段。这些视频片段随后会在离线状态下进行标注并重新纳入训练，这使得手势词汇量能够在不侵蚀机器人原有分类能力的前提下实现持续增长。
Robots interacting with people must recognize not only explicit commands, but also social cues such as invitations, refusals, and unavailability. In real deployments these cues have to be inferred from noisy onboard perception, under partial occlusion, shifting viewpoints and a hard latency budget.
SocioGesture pairs a compact confidence-aware body-hand skeleton representation with a lightweight dual-stream model that fuses body motion and hand articulation in a single forward pass. Training on deliberately corrupted skeletons — missing hands, occluded arms, keypoints that flicker in and out — buys robustness without costing anything at inference time. On a social gesture dataset collected in mixed indoor and outdoor settings, the system generalizes to held-out subjects, holds up under structured joint occlusion, and runs in real time on a robot-mounted edge device.
During deployment the robot saves the interaction segments it was unsure about. Those clips are labeled offline and folded back in, which lets the gesture vocabulary grow without eroding the classes the robot already handled.
Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
反事实视频生成助力可扩展的人形机器人移动与操作
通过视觉模仿教授人形机器人全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）技能（如搬运多样化物体），是迈向通用机器人的极具前景的路径。然而，采集多样且高质量的交互视频（例如能够清晰展示人体全貌且物体交互无遮挡的片段），为该方法的规模化扩展带来了现实障碍。
为此，我们提出了 PRISM——一个 Real-to-Sim-to-Real 框架，通过将少量的真实视频扩增为庞大且多样化的训练集来克服这一限制。PRISM 首先利用视频到视频（V2V）生成技术，从极少数真实示例视频中生成数百个多样化的“反事实”（counterfactual）人物-物体交互视频。随后，我们基于接触锚定的 Real-to-Sim 管线重构人体与物体的运动，将这些不完美的视频数据重定向（retargeting）为符合物理规律的合理轨迹。
这些反事实视频中展现出的类内多样性（intra-class variability），使我们能够训练出单一策略，并泛化至每个类别中未见过的全新物体。我们通过在无需任何真实世界微调的条件下将该策略部署至真实机器人，验证了完整的管线流程。仅依靠机载深度观测，我们的人形机器人成功完成了对箱子、桶、垃圾桶和球体等不同实例、尺寸与初始配置物体的抓取、搬运与放置。
Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.
Betting for Sim-to-Real Performance Testing
针对“仿真到现实”（Sim-to-Real）性能测试的押注
机器人专家在某种意义上就像是“赌徒”：每一次 Sim-to-Real（仿真到真实世界）的部署，本质上都是在下注——赌仿真环境中所展现的性能能够在真实硬件上得到延续。本文将这种“下注”机制正式化，并应用于 Sim-to-Real 的性能测试中（即对于一个固定的策略、控制器或机器人系统，无论是基于模型的、基于学习的还是混合型的，测试其在特定真实环境下的性能，以用于验证、合规监管等目的）。具体而言，我们引入了可缩放的仿真器，从“博弈/下注”（betting）的视角来促进真实世界机器人性能的推断与认证，实现了仅需极少真实测试且可证明精准的性能评估。
在推断任务中，Sim-to-Real 下注机制诱导出一个“下注加权估计器”（bet-weighted estimator），该估计器被证明优于传统的蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）采样，并能与重要性采样（importance sampling）结合以处理罕见事件。在认证任务中，相同的下注过程累积生成一个 $e$-过程（$e$-process），其从未排除的候选集合构成了一个随时有效（anytime-valid）的证书——无论所使用的仿真器库质量如何，该证书均保持有效。
我们跨多种应用场景进行了广泛的实验，包括合成示例、机器人操控（manipulation）、移动（locomotion）以及导航（navigation）任务，充分验证了该方法的有效性与实用价值。
Roboticists are, in some sense, gamblers: every sim-to-real deployment is a wager that simulation-implied performance will carry over to real-world hardware. This paper formalizes that wager for sim-to-real performance testing (i.e., given a fixed policy, controller, or robotic system, whether model-based, learning-based, or hybrid, as it stands, one seeks to test its performance under a certain real-world environment for validation, regulation compliance, and other purposes). Specifically, we bring scaled simulators to facilitate real-world robot performance inference and certificate through the perspective of ``betting''. This allows practically efficient (i.e. with few real-world tests) and provably accurate (i.e. close to ground truth measure) performance tests of various robotic systems. Within the inference tasks, the sim-to-real bet induces a bet-weighted estimator that provably outperforms Monte Carlo and composes with importance sampling for rare events. Within the certificate tasks, the same bet accumulates an
-process, and the candidates it never rules out form an anytime-valid certificate, valid whether or not the bank of simulators is any good. Extended experiments are performed across a variety of applications including synthetic examples, robotic manipulation, locomotion, and navigation tasks.
EWAM: Emergent Depth-Wise Specialization in a Unified Embodied Model -- From Semantic Understanding through Visual Foresight to Action
EWAM：统一具身模型中涌现出的深度专用化——从语义理解、视觉预见到行动
视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略侧重于语义理解，而世界-动作模型（WAMs）则专注于学习环境动力学的预测性表征。然而，现有同时引入这两种来源的系统通常仍将动作计算集中在单一专家身上，未能实现真正的深度融合。为此，我们提出了 EWAM——一种以动作动作为核心的统一具身模型（action-centric unified embodied model）。
EWAM 采用了一种非对称联合注意力机制（asymmetric joint attention），使动作 Token 能够在每一层读取语义、当前视觉、预测未来以及动作信息，同时保持感知各专家的独特角色。在没有逐层监督的情况下，EWAM 展现出了自然涌现的深度方向特化（emergent depth-wise specialization）：动作查询在浅层主要关注视-语言特征，在中间层关注预测的未来帧，而在深层则聚焦于动作 Token 本身。这种职责交接在各项任务中具有高度复现性，且在去噪步骤中保持稳定。此外，EWAM 分别在跨具身机器人轨迹和人类第一视角视频两种机制下进行预训练，并借助子任务阶段监督来提升长时域任务的完成能力。
仿真与真实机器人实验表明，EWAM 的性能超越了现有的 VLA、WAM 以及混合基线模型。人类第一视角数据显著增强了跨具身迁移能力与真实机器人的鲁棒性，而检查点追踪与因果干预则证明了这种涌现特化是经学习获得的，且动作生成对该特化高度依赖。这些结果表明，统一的具身学习能够诱导出一个从语义理解、经由视觉前瞻、最终到动作形成的有序内部演进过程。
Vision-language-action (VLA) policies emphasize semantic understanding, whereas world-action models (WAMs) learn predictive representations of environment dynamics. Systems that expose a policy to both sources often still concentrate action computation on a single expert. We present EWAM, an action-centric unified embodied model whose asymmetric joint attention lets action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action information at every layer while the perceptual experts retain their distinct roles. Without layer-wise supervision, EWAM develops an emergent depth-wise specialization: action queries attend mainly to vision-language features in shallow layers, to predicted future frames in intermediate layers, and to action tokens themselves in deep layers. This handoff replicates across tasks and is stable across denoising steps. Checkpoint tracking and causal interventions show that it is learned and that action generation depends on it. EWAM is pretrained in two separate regimes, one on cross-embodiment robot trajectories and one on human egocentric video. In simulation and real-robot experiments, it surpasses existing VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines. Human egocentric data improve both cross-embodiment transfer and real-robot robustness, and subtask-phase supervision improves long-horizon completion. Together, these results suggest that unified embodied learning can induce an ordered internal progression from semantic understanding, through visual foresight, to action formation.
SAGE: Safety-Aligned Gradient Enforcement for Human--Robot Collaboration
SAGE：面向人机协作的安全对齐梯度强制机制
多方人机协作带来了双重挑战：机器人的决策需要具备可解释性和可审计性，同时在物理交互过程中执行的动作必须满足安全约束。将可解释的决策树策略与控制屏障函数（CBF）滤波相结合提供了一个有前景的架构，但在多智能体强化学习中却产生了两个学习不匹配问题。安全投影会改变应用到环境中的动作，同时耦合的提案图可能会导致独立优化的行动者更新与团队级更新产生偏差。
为此，我们提出了安全对齐梯度强化（safety-aligned gradient enforcement，简称 SAGE）来解决这两个不匹配问题。其盾牌退火内化层（SAIL）使用可微的有限惩罚提案映射，同时保留了用于执行的精确 CBF 二次规划，从而保持了对重复激活的安全约束的约束法向敏感性。团队平均李雅普诺夫策略优化（TALO）构建了团队感知更新参考，并应用李雅普诺夫半空间校正来调节独立的行动者更新。
两台人形机器人与人类伙伴进行的物理实验证明了该方案的部署可行性。在九个仿真场景中，SAGE 实现了 71.0% 的成功率，每千个环境步骤中的碰撞次数仅为 0.5 次。消融实验表明，直接的 CBF 滤波将碰撞频率降低了 98.5%，但将成功率从 67.3% 降至 59.3%。SAIL 将提案违例减少了 48.8%，提案-执行校正减少了 85.2%，而 TALO 将更新一致性差距缩小了 50.8%。
Multi-party human-robot collaboration poses a dual challenge: robot decisions should remain interpretable and auditable, while executed actions must satisfy safety constraints during physical interaction. Combining explainable decision-tree policies with control-barrier-function (CBF) filtering provides a promising architecture but creates two learning mismatches in multi-agent reinforcement learning. Safety projection changes the action applied to the environment, while the coupled proposal graph can misalign independently optimized actor updates with a team-level update. We present safety-aligned gradient enforcement (SAGE) to address both mismatches. Its shield-annealed internalization layer (SAIL) uses a differentiable finite-penalty proposal map while retaining the exact CBF quadratic program for execution, preserving constraint-normal sensitivity to internalize repeatedly active safety constraints. Team-averaged Lyapunov policy optimization (TALO) constructs a team-aware update reference and applies a Lyapunov half-space correction to regulate independent actor updates. Physical experiments with two humanoid robots and a human partner demonstrate deployment feasibility. Across nine simulation scenarios, SAGE achieves a 71.0% success rate with 0.5 collision steps per thousand environment steps. Ablations show that direct CBF filtering reduces collision frequency by 98.5% but decreases success from 67.3% to 59.3%. SAIL reduces proposal violation by 48.8% and proposal-execution correction by 85.2%, while TALO reduces the update-consistency gap by 50.8%.
Can People Distinguish Human and AI Agency in Humanoid Teleoperation? A Preliminary Study of Agency Perception
在人形机器人遥操作中，人们能否区分人类与人工智能的主体性？一项关于主体性感知的初步研究
在人形机器人遥操作（humanoid teleoperation）中，人们能否区分出人类与人工智能的代理权（agency）？为了探索这一问题，我们开发了 Ghost-in-the-Loop 框架。该遥操作框架能够在保持同一躯体形态（embodiment）的前提下，同时支持由人类操作员或 AI 生成控制机器人的语音、面部表情以及肢体手势。
我们开展了一项初步的线上研究（$N=50$），在此实验中，受试者观看了由“人类操作员”或“AI 控制”生成的短视频片段，并对所感知到的控制来源进行了判断。实验结果表明，受试者在简短的交互过程中往往难以区分这两种控制条件。定性分析的反馈进一步指出，受试者的判断主要受到感知到的自然度、时间协同性以及语音、面部表情与手势之间的一致性所影响。
这些发现为具身人机/人-AI 交互（embodied human-AI communication）中的代理权感知提供了初步见解，并为未来探索人机混合遥临场（blended human-AI telepresence）系统奠定了基础。
Can people distinguish between human and AI agency in humanoid teleoperation? To explore this question, we developed \textit{Ghost-in-the-Loop}, a teleoperation framework that supports both human-operated and AI-generated control of a robot's voice, facial expressions, and gestures while maintaining a consistent embodiment. We conducted a preliminary online study (N=50) in which participants viewed short interaction clips generated by either a Human Operator or an AI Control and judged the perceived source of control. Results suggest that participants often struggled to distinguish between the two conditions in brief interactions. Qualitative responses indicate that judgments were primarily influenced by perceived naturalness, temporal coordination, and consistency across speech, facial expression, and gesture. These findings provide initial insights into agency perception in embodied human--AI communication and motivate future investigations of blended human--AI telepresence systems.
WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination
WholeBodyWAM：通过基于全身控制（WBC）的协同，将预训练的“世界-动作”先验泛化至人形机器人的移动-操作任务
世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与动作，为通用机器人操控提供了一种极具前景的方法。然而，现有的大多数 WAM 研究主要聚焦于桌面级或以机械臂为中心的操控任务，对于人形机器人的全身移动与操控（loco-manipulation）探讨相对较少。
为此，我们提出了 WholeBodyWAM。该框架能够联合预测未来的视觉动态、操控动作以及全身控制意图，从而实现具泛化能力的人形机器人全身移动与操控。它在保留预训练世界-动作先验的同时，对异构的全身控制器（WBC）语义进行了基础化映射（grounding），并有效协调了整体的全身行为。
广泛的实验表明，WholeBodyWAM 在仿真任务中实现了 91.9% 的总体成功率，在真实世界的分布外（OOD）任务进展中提升了 0.23，且相较于各自的基线模型，跨 WBC 的成功率方差降低了 70%。这些结果表明，通过结构化的 WBC 基础化与协调来扩展预训练的世界-动作先验，而非从头重新学习全身行为，是实现可扩展人形机器人全身智能的一条有效路径。
World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to general-purpose robot manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. However, most WAM studies focus on tabletop or arm-centric manipulation, while humanoid loco-manipulation remains less explored. To address this gap, we introduce WholeBodyWAM, which jointly predicts future visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents for generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation. It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior. Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines. These results suggest a path toward scalable humanoid whole-body intelligence by extending pre-trained world-action priors through structured WBC grounding and coordination, rather than relearning whole-body behavior from scratch.
CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
CoDance：从视频中学习反应式且柔顺的人机（人与人形机器人）交互
伴侣式人机交互将机器人移动与持续的物理接触紧密耦合，要求人形机器人能够与人类运动进行协调，同时响应交互力并保持稳定自然的动作。为了解决这一挑战，本文提出了 CoDance——一个用于从视频中学习反应式且顺应式（reactive and compliant）人机交互的框架，并将双人舞蹈作为极具挑战性的实例来进行研究，此时机器人需要使自身的步伐与移动的搭档相协调，并保持持续的双手接触。
该框架的核心在于多连杆顺应性增强（multi-link compliance augmentation）。给定一段包含两名人类舞者的视频，CoDance 将其运动重定向为机器人参考轨迹与移动搭档；随后，通过在双手施加结构化力来调整机器人参考，将运动学示范转化为具备力意识（force-aware）的训练数据。基于此数据训练出的策略能够在遵循观测到的搭档的同时，保留示范的移动风格，并对物理交互做出顺应性的响应。
在仿真实验中，该策略能够根据搭档的变化自适应调整步伐，并复现增强示范中约 80% 的手腕位移。在物理人形机器人上的部署表明，CoDance 能够实现与人类搭档持续的双人舞蹈，包括在前进和后退运动之间进行重复平稳的过渡。
Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact. A humanoid needs to coordinate with a person's motion while responding to interaction forces and maintaining stable and natural movement. We present CoDance, a framework for learning reactive and compliant human-humanoid interaction from video. We study partnered dancing as a challenging instantiation, where a humanoid coordinates its footsteps with a moving partner and maintains continuous two-hand contact. Given a single video of two human dancers, CoDance retargets their motions into a robot reference and a moving partner. We introduce a multi-link compliance augmentation that transforms the kinematic demonstration into force-aware training data by adapting the robot reference under structured forces at both hands. Policies trained on this data follow the observed partner while preserving the demonstrated locomotion style and responding compliantly to physical interaction. In simulation, the policies adapt their footsteps to changes in the partner and reproduce approximately 80% of the wrist displacement encoded by the augmented demonstrations. On a physical humanoid, CoDance enables sustained two-hand dancing with a human partner including repeated transitions between forward and backward motions.
GM-Loco: Terrain-Adaptive Humanoid Locomotion on Granular Media
GM-Loco：颗粒介质上地形自适应的人形机器人运动
在颗粒状地形（granular terrain）上实现人形机器人的稳定移动仍然是一项重大挑战，这主要是因为其复杂的足部-地形交互动力学极难被准确建模。现有方法要么忽略颗粒接触动力学，要么仅结合简化的正向力模型与启发式的切向分量。
在本文中，我们提出了一个基于三维阻力理论（3D RFT）的符合物理规律的颗粒接触模型，并高效仿真了用于强化学习（RL）训练的颗粒地形。与传统的刚性接触模型以及依赖临时启发式方法的简化颗粒模型不同，我们的接触求解器无需借助启发式规则即可产生物理上准确的颗粒侵入动力学。它在训练过程中准确捕获了真实的穿透与切向阻力，从而使策略学会了在刚性接触模型失效的真实颗粒地形上依然能够可靠迁移的行为。为了适应多变的地形条件，我们通过教师-学生强化学习训练了一个地形自适应的移动控制器，并利用变分自编码器（VAE）将地形信息编码为紧凑的隐空间表示。
基于 NVIDIA Newton 的物质点法（MPM）仿真研究表明，该方法能够泛化至未见过的颗粒地形，取得了显著高于基线方法的成功率，并展现出了零样本的地形识别与自适应能力。我们进一步通过在玄武岩颗粒、干沙和海滩沙等多种真实世界颗粒地形上的广泛硬件实验验证了该方法。据我们所知，这是首次在真实颗粒地形上展现出敏捷的人形机器人移动能力。
Humanoid locomotion on granular terrain remains a significant challenge due to its complex foot-terrain interaction dynamics that are difficult to model. Existing approaches either ignore granular contact dynamics or incorporate simplified normal force models with heuristic tangential components. In this work, we present a physics-grounded granular contact model based on three-dimensional resistive force theory (3D RFT) and efficiently simulate granular terrain for reinforcement learning (RL) training. Unlike traditional rigid contact models and simplified granular contact models with ad-hoc heuristics, our contact solver produces physically accurate granular intrusion dynamics without resorting to heuristics. It captures realistic penetration and tangential drag during training, enabling the policy to learn behaviors that transfer reliably to real-world granular terrain where rigid contact models fail. To adapt to varying terrain conditions, we train a terrain-adaptive locomotion controller via teacher-student RL, using a variational autoencoder to encode terrain information into a compact latent representation. Simulation studies using material point method (MPM) with NVIDIA Newton demonstrate that our method generalizes to unseen granular terrains, achieves a significantly higher success rate than baselines, and demonstrates zero-shot terrain identification and adaptation. We further validate our approach through extensive hardware experiments across diverse real-world granular terrains including basalt, dry sand, and beach sand. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of agile humanoid locomotion on real-world granular terrain.
ViBe: Visual Behavior Adaptation for Perceptive Humanoid Whole-Body Control
ViBe：面向感知型人形机器人全身控制的视觉行为自适应
运动追踪（motion tracking）为人形机器人的全身控制提供了一种可扩展的方案。在架构设计上，由于生成的追踪器缺乏外感知（exteroceptive）反馈，因此应对环境变化的重任通常落在更高层级的规划器上。现有的感知控制器往往从头训练仅依赖几何特征的编码器，牺牲语义信息以换取 Sim-to-Real 的便捷性，且通常依赖针对特定任务的教师-学生蒸馏（teacher-student distillation）方法。
为此，我们提出了 ViBe——一个用于将运动追踪器适配至感知控制任务的后训练（post-training）框架。我们利用预训练的视觉编码器结合多查询提取器模块（multi-query extractor module）来学习与任务相关的感知反馈。该反馈通过低秩适配器（LoRA）接合至追踪器的输入端，从而实现了参数高效的微调（parameter-efficient fine-tuning）。在给定任务奖励与参考数据集的前提下，该模块化控制器可以直接通过策略优化进行适配。
在四大类任务的测试中，ViBe 展现出了零样本（zero-shot）的 Sim-to-Real 迁移能力，涵盖马路牙与跑酷（parkour）上的感知行走、立方体重构与重定向（Repose Cube）、全向物体移动与操控（omni-object loco-manipulation）以及闪避球（dodgeball）等。该系统在户外、暗光以及 RGB 干扰条件下均展现出了高度鲁棒的视觉表现。最后，我们利用一个极简规划器解决了目标导向的立方体重构任务，充分验证了基于该方法适配的感知控制器的卓越效能。
Motion tracking provides a scalable recipe for humanoid whole-body control. By design, the resulting trackers lack exteroceptive feedback hence reacting to the environment remains the responsibility of a higher-level planner. Existing perceptive controllers train geometry-only encoders from scratch, trading semantics for sim-to-real ease, and typically rely on teacher-student distillation for a task of interest. We present ViBe, a post-training framework for adapting motion trackers to perceptive control tasks. We leverage pre-trained visual encoders with a multi-query extractor module to learn task-relevant perceptive feedback. This feedback is grafted onto the tracker's input via low-rank adapters, enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Given a task reward and a reference dataset, this modular controller can be adapted directly via policy optimization. Across four tasks, ViBe shows zero-shot sim-to-real transfer spanning perceptive walking on curbs and parkour, Repose Cube, omni-object loco-manipulation, and dodgeball, with visually robust performance across outdoor, low-light, and RGB distractor conditions. Finally, we solve a goal-oriented Repose Cube task with a deliberately simple planner, demonstrating the efficacy of perceptive controllers, adapted by our approach.
Praxis: Distilling Physical Interaction Priors from Egocentric Videos for Generalizable Whole-Body Manipulation
Praxis：从第一人称视角视频中提炼物理交互先验，实现可泛化的全身操作
移动式人形机器人操控（mobile humanoid manipulation）要求机器人在面对物体位姿与接触条件的变化时，既能触及可操作的工作空间，又能保持精确的手-物交互。然而，仅从有限的特定任务数据中学习此类复杂行为依然面临着巨大的泛化与扩展挑战。
为此，我们提出了 Praxis——一个将单次第一视角（egocentric）视频示范中的物理交互先验与闭环姿态校准及在线感知相结合的全身操控框架。该框架协同了三个关键阶段：首先是利用视觉-语言引导向目标物体导航，其次是通过闭环姿态校准来对齐手臂与手部的工作空间，最后是结合上下身同步控制的灵巧操控。在此过程中，在线视觉反馈能够在全新的物体位姿与场景配置下重新对齐（re-grounds）示范的交互几何结构，而触觉反馈则根据实际接触条件自适应调整手部运动。每项操控技能仅需一次人类示范即可指定，从而彻底消除了针对具体任务重新训练操控策略的需求。
在跨越五个长时域（long-horizon）操控任务的广泛实验中，Praxis 展现出了出色的空间、视觉以及跨物体泛化能力，并证明了其在全部三个阶段中均具备从外部物理干扰中稳定恢复的鲁棒性。
Mobile humanoid manipulation requires both reaching a usable workspace and preserving precise hand-object interactions as object poses and contact conditions change. Learning these behaviors from limited task-specific data remains challenging. To bridge this gap, we introduce Praxis, a whole-body manipulation framework that combines physical interaction priors from one-shot egocentric video demonstrations with closed-loop posture calibration and online perception. The framework coordinates three stages: vision-language-guided navigation toward target objects, closed-loop posture calibration to align the arm-hand workspace, and dexterous manipulation with synchronized upper- and lower-body control. Online visual feedback re-grounds demonstrated interaction geometry under new object poses and scene configurations, while tactile feedback adapts hand motions to actual contact conditions. Each manipulation skill is specified by one human demonstration, without task-specific manipulation-policy retraining. Experiments across five long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate spatial, visual, and cross-object generalization, as well as recovery from external physical disturbances across all three stages.
Open-Set Ego-Noise Separation for Legged-Robot Audition via Annotation-Free Adaptation and Pretrained-Model Transfer
基于免标注自适应与预训练模型迁移的足式机器人开放集自身噪声分离
声学感知能够为机器人提供超出视觉范围的环境线索，然而，足式机器人在行走过程中由脚步冲击、关节反冲晃动以及电机运转所产生的自身噪声（ego-noise）严重污染了机载音频录音。为了使机器人能够在开放环境中进行准确的听觉感知，本论文提出了一种针对足式机器人听觉的开放集自身噪声分离框架，能够在不预先指定环境声音类别的前提下，有效去除机器人特定的自身噪声并完好保留环境声音。
该框架的核心创新在于其无标注的自适应流程。首先，系统利用 RecurGraph 通过将剪辑嵌入聚合成嵌入质心并在音频嵌入图上进行得分传播，从无标签的录音中自动筛选出自身噪声主导的音频片段；随后，将这些选定的片段与来自大规模声音事件数据集的多样化环境声音进行混合，从而为开放集分离提供成对的“混合-目标”监督信号。在此基础之上，框架引入了 Transfer-DiT，将通用的零样本神经分离器进行适配，从而为目标机器人实现高保真、开放集的自身噪声分离。
在双足和四足机器人上进行的实验表明，该框架能够实现可靠的片段选择，并在分离质量以及下游任务性能上显著优于现有的基线分离器。这些结果充分证明了在无需单独录制纯自身噪声数据或进行人工片段级标注的条件下，实现无标注自适应（annotation-free adaptation）的可行性，为具身机器人在复杂声学环境中的自主感知开辟了新途径。
This paper proposes an open-set ego-noise separation framework for legged-robot audition via annotation-free adaptation and pretrained-model transfer. The framework removes robot-specific ego-noise while preserving environmental sounds whose classes are not specified in advance. Acoustic sensing provides cues about a robot's surroundings beyond the visual field, but walking-induced ego-noise from footstep impacts, joint-backlash rattling, and motor noise severely contaminates the recordings. The framework first uses RecurGraph to select ego-noise-dominant clips from the unlabeled recordings by aggregating clip embeddings into an embedding centroid and propagating scores over an audio-embedding graph. The selected clips are mixed with diverse environmental sounds from a large-scale sound-event dataset to provide paired mixture--target supervision for open-set separation. Transfer-DiT then adapts a general-purpose zero-shot neural separator to achieve high-fidelity open-set ego-noise separation for the target robot. Experiments with bipedal and quadrupedal robots show reliable clip selection and improvements in separation quality and downstream task performance over baseline separators. These results demonstrate the feasibility of annotation-free adaptation without separately recorded ego-noise-only data or manual clip-level annotations.
HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control
HumanoidTTT：用于高效人形机器人控制的测试时能力复用
运动生成与全身追踪领域的最新进展使得人形机器人能够执行日益多样化的动作，然而在持续部署（continual deployment）过程中，相同的动作能力可能会被频繁请求。由于干预性动作会改变机器人的进入状态（entry state），盲目重放先前成功的动作往往会导致安全隐患，因此实现可靠的动作复用面临着巨大挑战。与此同时，随着部署的进行，验证过的情境能力不断累积，但在有限的存储空间下，系统必须决定哪些能力值得长期保留。
为此，我们提出了 HumanoidTTT——一个用于持续人形机器人控制中测试时能力复用（test-time capability reuse）的框架。具体而言，该框架引入了选择性全动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse）机制，仅从经认证适用的进入状态授权直接复用已验证的完整动作，从而允许被接受的复用跳过全新的生成过程。此外，我们还引入了测试时能力整合（Test-Time Capability Consolidation）机制，利用后续部署中的复用情况作为反馈，自适应地调整哪些合格能力能够持久保留在有界的“全动作存储”（Full-Motion Store）中。
实验结果表明，HumanoidTTT 实现了零次不安全接受（zero unsafe accepts），并实现了相较于全新生成高达 16.4 倍的端到端加速；同时，在线整合机制在每 200 次请求中使避免的生成器调用次数比冻结基线提升了 13.2 次。总体而言，HumanoidTTT 在持续部署过程中实现了经验证动作能力的可靠且高效复用，并能够自适应地保留有用的核心能力。
Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4× end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment.
Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data
人形机器人羽毛球：基于有限人类动作数据学习动态球拍技巧
高速度的球拍类运动为人形机器人提供了一个极具挑战性的测试平台，要求其在严苛的时间预算内做出及时的决策、精准的击球，并在广阔的三维击球工作空间内实现动态的全身协调。在羽毛球运动中，瞬息万变的球体轨迹需要及时的击球决策，而成功的击球回报则要求在短暂的接触窗口内保持精确的球拍位姿与速度。人类运动数据为这类运动技能提供了宝贵的先验知识，但可用的羽毛球动作参考往往既有限又存在缺陷。直接追踪无法为多样化的球体状态提供足够的、可执行的变化，而纯粹基于任务驱动的优化则容易产生不自然的动作。为此，本文提出了一种针对动态人形机器人羽毛球运动的三阶层级强化学习框架。
该框架的核心管线从任务随机化动作增强（task-randomized motion augmentation）开始，它将稀疏的带标注击球事件扩展为可执行的、以目标为条件的击球变化集合，从而形成一个连续的隐式技能空间。在此基础上，一个高层规划器根据观测到的羽毛球状态在线输出连续的隐式技能代码，以实现这些技能的组合。此外，系统还引入了一个条件对抗正则化器（context-conditioned adversarial regularizer），在保持击球性能的同时，鼓励规划器采用更自然、更具人性的技能使用方式。
当部署在真实的人形机器人上时，该系统成功实现了与人类玩家的持续多技能拉锯战，能够执行正手、反手以及高度动态的跳跃回球。值得注意的是，这是首个在现实世界中展现出包括高度动态跳跃回球在内的多技能人机拉锯战的人形机器人球拍运动系统。这一成果突显了将数据驱动的动作增强与分层强化学习相结合，以解决复杂运动控制问题的强大潜力。
High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion. To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human-robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.
EgoAlign: Bridging the Human-Humanoid Gap for Long-Range Loco-Manipulation
EgoAlign：弥合人类与人形机器人之间的差距，实现长距离移动与操作协同
第一视角（egocentric）人类示范虽然是获取任务经验的便捷途径，但由于身体尺度、控制器响应的差异以及机器人状态的缺失，直接将其作为人形机器人训练的监督信号面临巨大挑战。为此，本文提出了 EgoAlign——一个数据构建框架，能够在无需收集物理机器人示范的前提下，将这些人类示范转化为与通用连续全身控制器（whole-body controller）相兼容的动作与状态监督数据。
该框架利用目标机器人模型与仿真器，通过执行反馈来指导示范数据的采集。EgoAlign 在保留用于视觉引导周期性步行的移动参考的同时，通过尺度对齐与控制器闭环精炼（controller-in-the-loop refinement）来动态适应上肢的交互几何结构。最后的因果重放（causal replay）步骤则重构了相应的机器人状态与动作 Token 标签，从而支持结合人类观测数据进行高效训练。
通过仅使用适配后的人类示范微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型并将其零样本部署至物理人形机器人，研究团队充分验证了该方法的有效性。实验表明，所得策略能够稳定执行长距离物体搬运、导航至未见的目标位置以及独立的足部交互。与仅进行运动学对齐相比，闭环精炼显著提升了模拟的手部对齐度与物理抓取成功率，同时人类数据的采集方式也大幅缩短了现场获取时间。
Egocentric human demonstrations offer an accessible source of task experience, but differences in body scale and controller response, together with missing robot states, limit their value as humanoid training supervision. We present EgoAlign, a data-construction framework that converts these demonstrations into action and state supervision compatible with a general-purpose, continuous whole-body controller, without collecting physical-robot demonstrations. Using the target-robot model and simulator, EgoAlign guides demonstration collection through execution feedback. It preserves locomotion references for visually guided periodic stepping while adapting upper-body interaction geometry through scale alignment and controller-in-the-loop refinement. A final causal replay reconstructs the corresponding robot states and motion-token labels for training with the human observations. We assess the resulting supervision by fine-tuning a vision--language--action model solely on adapted human demonstrations and deploying it zero-shot on a physical humanoid. The resulting policies perform long-range object relocation, navigation to unseen goal positions, and independently evaluated foot interaction. Refinement improves simulated hand alignment and physical pickup success over kinematic alignment alone, while human collection reduces on-site acquisition time relative to teleoperation.
EMoG: Emotion-Modulated Gait Generation for Expressive Humanoid Locomotion
EMoG：用于富有表现力的人形机器人运动的情感调制步态生成
现有的人形机器人移动系统主要侧重于平衡稳定性与任务执行，而如何将表达性（expressiveness）与显式的移动控制无缝融合依然面临巨大挑战。为此，本文提出了 EMoG——一个用于具表达力的人形机器人步态生成的感情调制框架（emotion-modulated gait generation framework）。
EMoG 引入了一种强度可连续调节的感情风格代码（emotional-style code）。在该代码与物理指令的共同约束下，一个轻量级 MLP 能够实时生成兼具感情表达力与指令一致性的周期性步态轨迹，并由统一的强化学习（RL）策略进行下发执行与物理追踪。为了支持模型训练，研究团队收集了一个包含专业表演者动作的大规模感情标注步态数据集，并开发了自动化管线以提取物理一致的周期性步态周期；同时，系统还集成了基于大语言模型（LLM）的解析器，可将自由文本指令转化为感情风格与运动参数以进行交互式控制。
实验结果表明，EMoG 在保持精确指令追踪的同时，实现了具有可感知表达特征的连续步态风格调制。该框架为面向人机交互（HRI） 参数化感情风格行走提供了一种极具实用价值的解决方案。
Existing humanoid locomotion systems primarily focus on stability and task execution, while integrating expressiveness with explicit locomotion control remains challenging. We propose EMoG, an emotion-modulated gait generation framework for expressive humanoid locomotion. EMoG introduces an emotional-style code with continuously adjustable intensity. Conditioned on this code and physical commands, a lightweight MLP generates expressive, command-consistent periodic gait trajectories in real time, which are tracked by a unified reinforcement learning policy for physical execution. To support training, we collect a large-scale emotion-annotated gait dataset from professional performers and develop an automated pipeline to extract physically consistent periodic gait cycles. EMoG also integrates an LLM-based parser that converts free-form language into emotional style and motion parameters for interactive control. Experiments demonstrate that our system achieves continuous gait-style modulation with perceptible expressive cues while maintaining command tracking. EMoG provides a practical approach to parameterized emotional-style walking for human-robot interaction.
Bi-manual Stabilization of the Cervical Spine for Safe Physical Human-Robot Interaction in Rolling Maneuvers
翻身操作中实现安全人机物理交互的颈椎双手动稳定技术
颈部（特别是颈椎）是人体极度脆弱且活动度高的部位，遭受灾难性损伤的风险极高。无论伤者是在战场、自然灾害现场还是在体育赛事中受伤，在搬运、翻身或移动患者时，都必须对颈椎给予极大的保护。
针对这一医疗救援痛点，本文提出了一种针对双臂机器人的控制算法与适配方案，旨在对翻身过程中的颈椎进行有效稳定。研究重点探讨了在安全约束范围内最大化握力（grip strength）的技术，并提出了一种确保颈部正确旋转的精确控制方法。
实验结果表明，采用本文提出的方法后，双臂机器人在维持目标旋转对齐（target rotational alignments）方面能够达到人类水平的性能。在结合预测机制后，机器人的轴向对齐精度与人类初学者（human novices）之间的误差仅在 $0.21^\circ$ 以内，展现出了机器人在复杂医疗救援与患者护理任务中的巨大潜力。
The neck, specifically the cervical spine, is a highly fragile and mobile part of the body with a high risk of catastrophic injury. Whether someone is injured on a battlefield, in a natural disaster, or in an athletic event, great care is always taken with the cervical spine when transporting, rolling, or moving the patient. In this work, we present an algorithm and adaptations for bi-manual robots to stabilize the cervical spine during rolling maneuvers. We investigate techniques to maximize grip strength within safety bounds and present a control approach for proper neck rotation. We found that with our approach, a bi-manual robot is capable of achieving human-level performance in maintaining target rotational alignments. The axial alignment for the robot with prediction was within .21 degrees of human novices.
OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
OTRetarget：基于最优传输的机器人与物体运动重定向
将人类运动迁移至人形机器人需要将示范动作适配至机器人的形态结构（morphology），同时保留与周围环境的交互关系。这在移动操控（loco-manipulation）任务中尤为困难，因为尽管人体与机器人存在身体比例差异，但与地面及被操控物体的接触状态必须保持高度一致。然而，单纯的骨骼运动并不能完全描述这些复杂的交互作用，而固定物体轨迹又限制了向全新躯体形态适配的灵活性。
为此，本文提出了 OTR ETARGET——一种从人类示范中联合重定向（jointly retarget）机器人与多物体运动的统一方法。该方法通过符号距离（signed distances）、最近表面点以及相对方向来表征表面交互，并利用熵最优传输（entropic optimal transport）将这些物理量跨人类、机器人与物体的几何形状进行迁移。在此基础上，研究团队将生成的交互目标集成到一个受约束的逆运动学（IK）公式中，该公式在保持接触状态与维持运动风格之间取得了平衡，并在每一帧中联合优化机器人与物体的位姿，无需对场景或示范进行缩放即可适应“机器人-物体”及“物体-物体”之间的复杂交互。
在 OMOMO 数据集上的验证实验表明，该方法实现了 87% 的机器人-物体交互 Jaccard 得分以及 8.7 mm 的深度误差，显著优于传统基线 OmniRetarget（分别为 28% 与 29.3 mm）。最后，研究团队利用在重定向参考轨迹上通过强化学习训练的全身策略，在物理 G1 人形机器人上成功演示了包括双手将箱子搬运并摆放至桌上等一系列复杂动作，验证了该方法的现实部署能力。
Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment. This is particularly challenging for loco-manipulation tasks, where contacts with the ground and manipulated objects must remain consistent despite differences in body proportions.
