Yet, skeletal motion alone does not fully describe these interactions, and fixing object trajectories limits the adaptation to a new embodiment. In this paper, we introduce OTR ETARGET, a unified approach to jointly retarget robot and multi-object motion from human demonstrations. Our approach represents surface interactions through signed distances, closest surface points, and relative directions, and uses entropic optimal transport to transfer these quantities across human, robot, and object geometries. We incorporate the resulting interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics formulation that balances contact preservation with motion style and jointly optimizes robot and object poses at each frame. This formulation accommodates robot-object and object-object interactions without rescaling the scene or the demonstration. We validate the proposed approach on OMOMO, where it achieves a robot- object interaction Jaccard score of 87% and a depth error of 8.7 mm, compared with 28% and 29.3 mm for OmniRetarget. Finally, we demonstrate transfer to a physical G1 humanoid using whole-body policies trained with reinforcement learning on the retargeted references, across motions including two-handed box pick-and-place onto a table.
NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
NEXUS：面向地形自适应遥操作的感知型全身控制
全身遥操作要求人形机器人能够在操作员与机器人地形存在差异的情况下复现人类行为，这就要求机器人必须感知局部地形并相应地调整姿态与接触状态，而不是对操作员的动作进行盲目的逐帧复制。然而，连接平地与不同地形之间相同行为的成对动作数据极为匮乏，严重限制了学习地形自适应控制所需的监督信号来源。为此，本文引入了 NEXUS——一个将人类运动指令与机载感知反馈相结合的感知型全身控制框架，旨在解决跨不匹配地形的全身遥操作难题。
为克服成对数据稀缺的瓶颈，NEXUS 首先开发了一种可扩展的地形感知自适应算法，能够在无需针对每个具体动作或地形进行繁琐微调的前提下，高效生成跨运动与地形的高质量动作对。在此基础上，利用一个总计近 1,000 小时的成对动作语料库，该框架通过教师-学生学习（teacher-student learning）训练了一个感知型全身控制器，使其能够在各类复杂地形上准确复现指令行为，从而在保持广泛行为覆盖的同时，实现了地形适应性与追踪保真度的有机统一。
实验结果表明，NEXUS 实现了高质量动作数据的高效与可扩展生成，其综合性能在各项评估基准中均超越了现有的全身控制器。零样本的真实世界部署使机器人能够在多种未见过的复杂地形上进行实时的全身遥操作，进一步验证了该方法在跨地形具身交互中的强大泛化能力与实际应用价值。
Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method.
Banana Kick: Response-Informed Skill Evolution for Humanoid Soccer
Banana Kick：面向人形足球机器人的基于反馈的技能演化
人形机器人踢球任务需要高度协调的全身运动与精准的接触控制，而香蕉球（banana kick，即弧线球）则需要更具技巧性的接触力学机制，以产生足够的足球自旋及相应的空气动力学弧线。基于运动模仿的方法能够提供可靠的常规踢球先验，强化学习也可在不改变底层踢球技术的前提下提升射门速度与落点精度。然而，将这种先验适配到具有质的飞跃且富含接触的全新技能时，即便奖励函数设置密集且优化过程稳定，训练也可能会遭遇失败。这种失败的根源在于：在当前策略的响应空间内，任务目标处于局部平坦（locally flat）状态，我们将其称为“一阶学习饥饿”（first-order learning starvation）。
为了解决这一难题，本文提出了响应知情技能演化（Response-Informed Skill Evolution, RISE）——一种用于策略自适应的闭环目标连续（objective-continuation）方法。RISE 利用从缓存轨迹（cached rollouts）中估计出的响应敏感度对有界的目标变更进行排序，且仅当这些变更产生可验证的响应进展同时保持踢球可靠性时，才接受更新。系统理论分析表明，仅仅重新缩放饱和的自旋奖励无法在零自旋状态下恢复一阶敏感度，而自适应耦合接触响应则能够为自旋生成提供一条可学习的路径。我们将 RISE 集成到了包含精细标定接触力学与迈格纳斯效应（Magnus-force）空气动力学的人形机器人踢球管线中，并进行了 Sim-to-Real 的迁移研究。
实验结果表明，RISE 成功将常规踢球行为演化为具有高自旋的弧线球，使足球平均自旋达到 11.55 rad/s，相较于学习进展课程表（learning-progress curriculum）将平均评估得分提升了 19.8%，并将联合目标达成率从 15.2% 提高至 50.9%。消融实验与响应诊断进一步印证了该机制的有效性，同时 30 次基于动作捕捉记录的物理实体试验展示了学到的弧线球技能在硬件部署上的高度稳定性与可靠迁移。
Humanoid kicking requires coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact, while a banana kick demands contact mechanics that generate ball spin and aerodynamic curvature. Motion imitation provides a reliable ordinary-kick prior, but reinforcement learning may improve shot speed and placement accuracy without changing the underlying kicking technique. Adapting this prior to a qualitatively different contact-rich skill can fail even when the reward is dense and optimization remains stable. The failure occurs when the task objective is locally flat over the current policy's responses. We term this condition first-order learning starvation. To address it, we propose response-informed skill evolution (RISE), a closed-loop objective-continuation method for policy adaptation. RISE ranks bounded objective changes using response sensitivity estimated from cached rollouts and accepts updates only when they produce verified response progress while preserving kicking reliability. Our analysis shows that rescaling a saturated spin reward cannot recover first-order sensitivity at zero spin, whereas adapting coupled contact responses can provide a learnable path to spin generation. We integrate RISE into a humanoid kicking pipeline under calibrated contact and Magnus-force aerodynamics, and sim-to-real transfer. Experiments show that RISE evolves the ordinary kick into a high-spin curved kick with 11.55 rad/s mean ball spin, improves the mean evaluation score by 19.8% over a learning-progress curriculum, and raises joint target attainment from 15.2% to 50.9%. Ablations and response diagnostics support the mechanism, while 30 motion-capture-recorded physical trials demonstrate consistent hardware transfer of the learned curved kick.
CEER2: Directional and Tunable End-Effector and Root Compliance for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
CEER2：面向人形机器人移动与操作的定向可调末端执行器及根部柔顺性设计
通用的人形机器人运动追踪策略虽然能够复现多样化的行为，但通常无法规范对物理交互的动态响应，而现有的顺应性控制方法多局限于特定的连杆或末端执行器，难以实现轴向刚度与移动行为的联合控制。为此，本文提出了一种集成方向性与可调节末端执行器（EE）顺应性以及根节点阻抗与阻尼模式的全新控制框架，旨在赋予人形机器人在运动过程中对物理交互的精细自适应能力。
该系统采用两级分层强化学习控制器，将高刚度的底层全身追踪策略与修改共享 EE-根节点指令接口的高层残差策略有机结合。其中，分析型顺应空间混合专家（MoE）模型整合了 10 个专家网络，支持在 100 至 600 N/m 范围内沿各个笛卡尔坐标轴进行独立且连续的刚度指令调节，同时根节点模式指令可灵活选择单一根节点阻抗策略或两种阻尼策略之一。通过引入特权力信息，研究团队开发了基于教师-学生架构的联合训练管线与力估计器，从而在无需物理腕部力/力矩传感器的情况下实现了稳健的真实世界部署。
仿真评估结果表明，该方法实现了精确的全范围方向性 EE 顺应性、工作空间一致性以及清晰的根节点模式切换。在真实世界的任务验证中，该系统进一步展示了方向性 EE 顺应性、EE 刚度的在线调节能力，以及通过共享接口实现的 EE 与根节点并发顺应性控制，为人形机器人在复杂物理交互环境中的顺应式操作开辟了新途径。
General humanoid motion-tracking policies reproduce diverse behaviors but do not specify responses to physical interaction. Existing compliance methods mainly target selected links or end effectors, without jointly controlling axis-wise stiffness and locomotion behavior. We formulate directional and tunable end-effector (EE) compliance together with root resistance and damping modes. Our two-level hierarchical RL controller combines a stiff low-level whole-body tracking policy with high-level residual policies that modify its shared EE–root command interface. An analytical compliance-space mixture-of-experts (MoE) composes 10 experts, enabling independent, continuous stiffness commands along each Cartesian axis over 100–600 N/m. A root-mode command selects one root resistance policy or one of two root damping policies. Using privileged forces, a teacher–student pipeline jointly trains the high-level policies and a force estimator, enabling deployment without wrist force/torque sensors. Simulation evaluations show accurate full-range directional EE compliance, workspace consistency, and distinct root modes. Real-world tasks further demonstrate directional EE compliance, online adjustment of EE stiffness, and concurrent EE–root compliance through the shared interface.
Learning Distance-Conditioned Object Transport for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from a Single Motion Clip
基于单段动作片段学习用于人形机器人移动-操作任务的距离条件化物体搬运
动作追踪虽然能够通过单一的重定向运动片段来复现人形机器人的移动操控（loco-manipulation），但基于固定参考轨迹训练出的策略通常只能盲目复现其最终展示的物体搬运结果。尽管源轨迹在执行过程中会经历各种中间物体位移，但搬运的终止状态却仅仅在其终点处得到示范。这种现象被研究人员识别为“终止-过渡鸿沟”（termination-versus-passage gap）：即中间位移被策略视为单纯的过渡状态（passage states），而非可以随时终止并完成任务的目标结果，从而限制了机器人根据指令灵活调节搬运距离的能力。
为了克服这一局限，本文提出了距离条件参考重组（Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition, DCRR）框架。该方法的核心思想是将源运动中展示的终止片段重新定位并映射到任意的中间搬运状态上。在此基础上，利用一个冻结的追踪教师网络在闭环动力学下重放重组后的参考轨迹，并根据实际达成的物体放置位置对保留下来的轨迹进行重新标注，进而将其蒸馏为一个无需固定参考的策略。这一流程巧妙地从源运动所编码的交互行为中构建出了具备距离条件的监督信号，并通过行为克隆（DCRR-BC）与后续的强化学习（RL）微调，进一步增强了策略对控制指令的响应能力及在仿真与 sim-to-sim 迁移中的执行鲁棒性。
在涵盖搬运（Carry）、踢推（Kick-Push）、蹲推（Crouch-Push）以及拖拽（Drag）在内的四种交互模式实验中，DCRR-BC 表现出了卓越的性能，其整体归一化距离平均绝对误差（MAE）显著降至 0.15，而传统仅基于源数据的行为克隆则为 0.28。强化学习微调进一步优化了机器人的指令响应精度与动力学稳定性。最终的真实世界硬件实验成功验证了该方法在所有四种交互模式下对搬运距离的精准调节能力，为人形机器人在复杂动态环境中实现灵活、可控的移动操控开辟了新途径。
Motion tracking can reproduce humanoid loco-manipulation from a single retargeted motion clip, but a policy trained on a fixed reference primarily reproduces its demonstrated transport outcome. Although the source trajectory visits intermediate object displacements, transport termination is demonstrated only at its endpoint. We identify this mismatch as the termination-versus-passage gap: intermediate displacements are observed as passage states rather than termination-complete outcomes. We introduce Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition (DCRR), which relocates the demonstrated termination segment to intermediate transport states. A frozen tracking teacher replays the recomposed references under closed-loop dynamics, and the retained trajectories are relabeled by their achieved object placements and distilled into a reference-free policy. This procedure constructs distance-conditioned supervision from the interaction behavior encoded in the source motion. Across Carry, Kick-Push, Crouch-Push, and Drag, DCRR-BC produces command-dependent transport with an overall normalized distance mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.15, compared with 0.28 for source-only behavior cloning. RL fine-tuning further improves the command response and execution robustness in the training simulator and under sim-to-sim transfer. Finally, hardware experiments demonstrate transport-distance modulation across all four interaction modes.
Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
可追溯的人与类人机器人手语基准测试
手语数据的采集成本高昂且遥操作扩展性差，这促使研究人员转向复用大规模视频语料库来生成具身手语。然而，将视频提取的人类运动转换为机器人轨迹，同时完整保留微妙的语言学动作线索依然面临巨大挑战。由于缺乏透明的溯源机制，来自运动拟合、人类运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复以及底层控制的各种误差往往在最终轨迹中交织在一起，极难被独立分离与定位。
为突破这一技术瓶颈，本文引入了 HumanoidCSL-20K——一个包含 20,648 个句子级中国手语（CSL）序列的大规模数据集与基准测试。该数据集为每个序列精心构建了四个对齐版本：源运动、修复后的人类运动、直接机器人参考轨迹以及几何修复后的机器人参考轨迹，从而使观测支持的局部人类运动修复、全机器人几何修复及跨表征溯源变得完全透明可查。此外，该框架设计了一种专用的手语运动学参考协议，在整个规划动作周期内对手形、位置、手掌朝向以及双手间关系等核心语言学维度进行严格的定量评分。
全语料库评估结果表明，经过系统化的修复管线处理后，机器人表现出更少的手臂与手部异常步进，并大幅减少了双手之间以及手身之间的物理穿透现象。配套的控制实验成功将参考轨迹的可学习性与课程学习效应进行了有效解剖，而细粒度的组件评分则精准暴露了残余的执行误差，为未来高精度具身手语生成系统的演进提供了坚实的数据支撑与评测标准。
Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.
DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
DexForge：高保真、物理信息驱动的灵巧手动作重定向
人类示范为精准的灵巧操作（dexterous manipulation）提供了丰富的样本，是极具潜力的机器人训练数据来源。然而，在复杂的物理约束下，跨不同的机器人躯体形态（embodiments）高保真地复现示范动作及复杂的手-物交互（hand-object interactions）依然面临巨大挑战。
为此，本文提出了 DexForge——一个基于可微分物理（differentiable physics-grounded）的框架，旨在将人类视频示范高效转换为高保真的机器人控制轨迹。该框架首先从视觉观测中重建出球形高斯（spherical-Gaussian）物体模型与手-物运动，随后构建了一个结合了高效高斯碰撞检测与现有可微分动力学的新型可微分仿真器。在此基础之上，DexForge 将接触感知的运动学重定向（contact-aware kinematic retargeting）与力感知的动力学重定向（force-aware dynamics retargeting）有机结合：通过机器人适配的稳定接触来引导运动学参考轨迹的构建，并借助后续基于梯度的控制精炼实现精确的物理运动复现。
在涵盖 130 个 DexYCB 和 HOT3D 示范、跨越 7 种不同灵巧手（dexterous hands）的广泛实验中，DexForge 相比基线方法取得了约 35 至 53 个百分点的成功率提升，同时成功轨迹上的物体位置与姿态追踪误差分别显著降低了约 34–67% 和 71–78%。进一步的实验成功验证了该方法向 MuJoCo 仿真器及真实机器人硬件执行的开环迁移能力，为具身灵巧操作的高效数据转换开辟了新途径。
Human demonstrations offer rich examples of precise dexterous manipulation and a promising source of robot training data. However, high-fidelity reproduction of demonstrated motions and hand–object interactions across robot embodiments remains challenging under physical constraints. We present DexForge, a differentiable physics-grounded framework for converting human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories. We reconstruct spherical-Gaussian object models and hand–object motion from visual observations, then build a differentiable simulator combining efficient Gaussian collision detection with existing differentiable dynamics. Based on this simulator, DexForge combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting: robot-adapted stable contacts guide kinematic reference construction and subsequent gradient-based control refinement for precise physical motion reproduction. Experiments on 130 DexYCB and HOT3D demonstrations across seven dexterous hands show success-rate gains of approximately 35–53 percentage points over the baseline, with object position and orientation tracking errors on successful trajectories reduced by approximately 34–67% and 71–78%, respectively. Further experiments demonstrate open-loop transfer to MuJoCo and real-robot execution.
SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
SocialHumanoid：通过一步式伴随语音动作生成实现富有表现力的类人机器人行为
具身社交代理（embodied social agents）要求人形机器人能够通过面对面的交互与人类进行自然沟通，这就需要机器人具备与语音同步、情感丰富且适合实时执行的身体行为。然而，现有的共语音（co-speech）动作生成方法主要针对数字人（digital humans）开发，缺乏对物理机器人躯体上情感控制与低延迟连续生成的联合支持。为了弥合这一差距，本文提出了 SocialHumanoid——一个通过一步式共语音动作生成（one-step co-speech motion generation）来实现具表达力人形机器人行为的系统。
SocialHumanoid 在给定响应语音和指定情感条件的情况下，能够在单次前向传播中生成每个全身动作窗口，并通过动作历史条件反射将连续的窗口平滑连接。生成的动作随后被在线转换为与机器人形态相兼容的参考轨迹，并由全身控制器进行追踪以实现物理执行。为了提供明确的情感身体表达监督，研究团队进一步引入了 AffectMoCap——一个从两位专业演员处采集、包含 4 小时同步语音、全身及精细手部动作与情感标注的大规模数据集。
在 BEAT2 数据集上的评估表明，SocialHumanoid 实现了对比方法中最优的 FGD（Fréchet Gesture Distance）指标、极具竞争力的语音-动作同步性，且在相同协议下实现了比 GestureLSM 快约 6 倍的推理速度。感知评估进一步证实，使用 AffectMoCap 进行训练显著提升了生成身体动作的情感识别准确率，而真实机器人实验则成功展示了连续的情感条件行为与稳定的长周期执行能力，为具身社交机器人的自然交互开辟了新路径。
Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately 6× faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution.
RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
RoboSTAR：面向人形机器人的下一量级自回归手语翻译
公共传播中的手语翻译高度依赖于资质合格的专业翻译人员，在规模化部署上存在较大难度，这极大地推动了将机器人手语（robotic signing）作为补充性无障碍交互接口的研究。为此，本文提出了 RoBoSTAR——一个以文本为条件的手语生成（Sign Language Production, SLP）框架，旨在生成以人为中心的具身手语动作，并可成功重定向至人形机器人上执行，同时支持通过外部自动语音识别（ASR）前端灵活接入语音输入。
传统的自回归生成方法通常将运动扁平化为单一的全分辨率 Token 序列，这迫使系统在统一的时间粒度下同时建模长程依赖与局部细节。相比之下，RoBoSTAR 将分部件有限标量量化（part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization）与下一尺度自回归（next-scale autoregression）创新性地相结合，在逐渐变精细的时间分辨率上分层生成动作，并在每个步骤内并行预测同步的身体与手部 Token。这种由粗到精（coarse-to-fine）的架构设计不仅在逐步精炼运动细节之前提供了紧凑的长程上下文信息，还通过自我条件反射（self-conditioning）与上下文损坏（context corruption）机制增强了系统对跨尺度预测误差的鲁棒性。
生成的运动轨迹随后被重定向并适配至物理人形机器人上进行稳定执行。广泛的定性与定量评估充分证明了 RoBoSTAR 在高保真、多尺度手语生成方面的有效性，为自动化无障碍服务与人形机器人社交交互提供了强有力的技术支撑。
Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.
LIMBO: Learning and Internalizing Model-Free Barrier Objectives for Agile and Safe Whole-Body Control
LIMBO：用于敏捷且安全全身控制的无模型障碍目标学习与内化
安全的全身控制（safe whole-body control）要求人形机器人高维、非线性的动力学约束下，同时协调避障与身体平衡，这使得安全证明（safety certificates）极难针对多样化行为进行设计与复用。为此，本文提出了 LIMBO——一个用于合成状态-动作控制障碍函数（state-action control barrier function, Q-CBF）并将其安全结构蒸馏至任务策略中的全新控制框架。
LIMBO 建立在一个冻结的底层控制器之上，从黑盒状态转移与基于状态的失败规范中学习残差动作空间上的安全证明，这不仅使得 Q-CBF 在全控制维度上的合成变得易于处理，还将安全证明直接置于任务策略的控制空间内。在合成阶段，学到的安全值驱动风险引导采样（risk-guided sampling）聚焦于可恢复性边界附近；而在任务学习阶段，该安全证明充当教师角色，提供动作级的安全反馈，从而训练出鲁棒的任务策略，并在实际部署时免除了对在线安全过滤器（online safety filter）的依赖。
研究团队在拥有 29 个自由度的物理人形机器人上对 LIMBO 进行了验证，使其成功执行了闪避躲避球（dodgeball avoidance）以及在低矮障碍物下行走等高难度任务。除了将学到的 Q-CBF 扩展至全身控制外，实验还表明风险引导边界采样为探索可恢复性边缘提供了一种具备理论依据的方法：在相同的安全规范下，仅改变采样集中度即可产生从蹲下到创新性后仰“闪避”（limbo maneuver）等多种策略。在两种设定下，学到的策略均可直接迁移至硬件，证明了学习型安全合成在敏捷全身控制中的优异扩展性。
Safe whole-body control requires coordinating collision avoidance and balance under high-dimensional, nonlinear dynamics--making safety certificates difficult to design and reuse across behaviors. We present LIMBO, a framework for synthesizing a state-action control barrier function and distilling its safety structure into a task policy. LIMBO learns the safety certificate from black-box transitions and a state-based failure specification over residual actions around a frozen base controller, making Q-CBF synthesis tractable in the full control dimension while placing the certificate in the task policy's control space. During synthesis, the learned safety value drives risk-guided sampling near the estimated boundary of recoverability; during task learning, it serves as a teacher that provides action-level safety feedback, yielding a robust task policy and alleviating the need for an online safety filter at deployment. We demonstrate LIMBO on a 29-degree-of-freedom humanoid performing dodgeball avoidance and locomotion beneath low obstacles. Beyond scaling learned Q-CBFs to whole-body control, we show that risk-guided boundary sampling provides a theoretically grounded way to explore the edge of recoverability. Under the same safety specification, ceteris paribus, varying the sampling concentration produces strategies ranging from crouching to a novel backward-leaning limbo maneuver. In both settings, the learned policies transfer to hardware without online safety filtering, showing that learned safety synthesis scales to agile whole-body control.
ω -0: A Latent Predictive World Action Model for Concurrent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
ω-0：用于并发人形机器人移动操作的潜在预测世界动作模型
人形机器人在执行家庭日常任务时，往往需要进行并发的移动操控（concurrent loco-manipulation），即机器人必须将移动、姿态调整、平衡维持与物体操作有机融合成单一的协同行为。然而，现有的形体策略通常将移动与操作人为解耦，而近年来的世界-动作模型（world-action models）则多局限于纯手臂操作或以视频为中心，缺乏对全身实体协同的直接支持。
为此，本文提出了 $\omega$-0——一个专为真实世界人形机器人并发移动操控而设计的潜空间预测式全身世界-动作模型（latent predictive whole-body world-action model）。给定语言指令、当前视觉观测与机器人本体感受状态，$\omega$-0 能够直接预测与底层控制器相兼容的全身动作潜变量（action latents）以供真实机器人执行。不同于高开销的未来视频重建，$\omega$-0 采用紧凑的未来观测嵌入作为轻量级预测目标，将潜空间视觉预测与基于扩散模型（diffusion-based）的全身动作生成紧密耦合。该模型全面支持第一视角 RGB、外视角 RGB 及外视角深度输入，并借助基于控制器的仿真重放机制，将人类或公开的视觉-运动先验精准转化为可执行的机器人动作潜变量。
为了支撑大规模模型的训练，研究团队进一步采集并发布了 $\omega$-HOME——一个时长超过 40 小时的真实世界家庭人形机器人数据集，包含多视角同步观测、全身 SMPL 动作、机器人状态及动作潜变量。在涵盖 11 项家庭任务的真实世界实验中，单一的 $\omega$-0 模型成功展现出流畅的“边走边操作”（manipulate-while-moving）复合行为，并在性能上全面超越了现有的代表性模仿学习、视觉-语言-动作（VLA）、传统人形及世界-动作模型（WAM）基线，为具身智能在复杂家庭环境中的落地开辟了新途径。
Humanoid household tasks often require concurrent loco-manipulation, where the robot must move, adjust posture, maintain balance, and manipulate objects as a single coordinated behavior. Yet existing humanoid policies typically decompose locomotion and manipulation, while recent world-action models remain either arm-centric or video-centered. We present ω-0, a latent predictive whole-body world-action model for real-world humanoid concurrent loco-manipulation. Given a language instruction, current visual observation, and robot proprioceptive state, ω-0 directly predicts controller-compatible whole-body action latents for real-robot execution. Rather than reconstructing future videos, ω-0 learns compact future observation embeddings as a lightweight predictive objective, coupling latent visual foresight with diffusion-based whole-body action generation. The model supports egocentric RGB, exocentric RGB, and exocentric depth inputs, and leverages controller-based simulation replay to ground human/public visual-motion priors into robot-executable action latents. We further collect ω-HOME, a 40+ hour real-world household humanoid dataset with synchronized multi-view observations, whole-body SMPL motions, robot states, and action latents. Real-world experiments on 11 household tasks demonstrate that a single ω-0 model can produce smooth manipulate-while-moving behaviors and consistently outperform representative imitation learning, VLA, humanoid, and WAM baselines.
PFM-HR: Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots
PFM-HR：面向人形机器人的姿态流匹配
运动先验（motion priors）能够显著提升基于物理的人形机器人追踪任务中强化学习的训练效率。然而，传统的时间序列先验依赖于严格按序排列的运动片段，而简单的静态姿态先验则无法为策略诱导出的姿态转移过程提供足够的动态指导。为此，本文提出了 PFM-HR（Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots）——一个直接在无序大规模姿态数据上训练的、可跨任务复用的流匹配（flow matching）姿态先验框架。
PFM-HR 引入了姿态几何得分（Pose Geometry Score, PGS），用以定量评估机器人运行轨迹（rollouts）中关节坐标的变化与先验所捕获的姿态变化局部几何特征之间的对齐程度。在策略训练过程中，PGS 被用于动态调制追踪奖励（tracking reward），从而在保持姿态先验完全冻结的前提下，有效引导策略向结构化的姿态变化方向进行探索。
涵盖多种任务场景的对比实验表明，PFM-HR 在单运动追踪和通用运动追踪任务中均取得了显著的性能提升，尤其在面对高度动态、复杂的敏捷动作时，展现出了极强的自适应引导能力与动作表征鲁棒性。
Motion priors improve reinforcement learning for physics-based humanoid tracking, but temporal priors require ordered motion clips, while pose priors provide limited guidance for policy-induced pose transitions. We present Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots (PFM-HR), a reusable flow matching prior trained directly on large scale unordered pose data. PFM-HR introduces the Pose Geometry Score (PGS), which quantifies how joint coordinate changes during rollouts align with the local geometry of pose variation captured by the prior. Using PGS to modulate the tracking reward guides policy exploration toward structured pose changes while keeping the prior frozen across tracking tasks. Experiments demonstrate that PFM-HR improves both single-motion and general motion tracking, especially for highly dynamic motions.
Stay Seated: Learning Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on a Passive Mobile Chair with Casters
保持坐姿：学习全向人形机器人运动
采用准直驱驱动器的人形机器人在站立时需持续消耗转矩维持姿态，而人类在案头工作时则通过座椅分担体重。为了向“坐姿移动操控”迈出坚实的第一步，本文深入研究了人形机器人在被动移动座椅上的全向坐姿移动。该任务的核心挑战在于处理未固定的盆腔与座椅接触，以及机器人-座椅系统通过脚部与地面的间歇性推进。为此，研究团队在标准站立速度追踪环境中扩展引入了被动座椅模型、坐姿状态奖励、仅限评论家的座椅观测以及任务定制的接触设置，且整个策略在训练过程中完全不依赖运动模仿奖励，其执行器仅依靠本体感受与速度指令，无需直接获取接触感知或座椅状态。
在四组不同的随机种子下，研究人员对对称性正则化（SY）、脚底打滑正则化（FS）以及指令课程学习（CC）进行了全析因对比分析。实验表明，脚底打滑正则化虽然有效降低了运输成本（CoT），但会导致追踪误差增大，甚至使部分仅含该正则化的策略收敛至静止的局部最优解；而将其与对称性正则化或指令课程学习相结合则成功避免了这一缺陷，同时对称性正则化显著提升了纵向运动期间的双腿双边对称性。方向解析分析进一步揭示了运输成本呈后退小于侧向、侧向远小于前进的特征，其中后退和侧向运动表现为支撑腿伸展，而前进运动则在脚后跟触地后伴随膝关节屈曲。
在随机指令评估中，学习到的策略在几乎所有的 20 秒运行轨迹内均能稳定追踪全向指令，其中表现最优的坐姿策略在速度追踪性能上甚至超越了传统的站立策略。最终，该方法成功实现了向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的零样本 Sim-to-Real 迁移，并在真实硬件上生成了流畅、稳定的全向坐姿移动行为，为人形机器人在复杂办公与交互场景下的高效坐姿操作奠定了重要基础。
Humanoid robots with quasi-direct-drive actuators continuously generate joint torque while standing, whereas seated humans delegate weight support to chairs during desk work. As a first step toward seated loco-manipulation, we study omnidirectional seated locomotion on a passive mobile chair, requiring unfixed pelvis-seat contact and intermittent foot-floor propulsion of the robot-chair system. We extend a standard standing velocity-tracking environment with a passive-chair model, seated-state rewards, critic-only chair observations, and task-tailored contact settings. The policy is learned without motion-imitation rewards; its actor uses only proprioception and velocity commands, without contact sensing or chair states. In random-command evaluation, the policies tracked omnidirectional commands through nearly all 20-s rollouts, and the best seated policies could outperform the Standing policy in velocity tracking. Across four training seeds, a 23 full-factorial comparison of symmetry regularization (SY), foot-slip regularization (FS), and command curriculum (CC) showed that FS reduced CoT but increased tracking error and that some FS-only policies converged to stationary local optima. Combining FS with either SY or CC avoided this failure without retuning FS, while SY improved bilateral leg symmetry during longitudinal motion. Direction-resolved analysis showed CoT ordered backward < lateral ≪ forward, with planted-leg extension in backward and lateral motion and knee flexion following heel contact in forward motion. The learned policy achieved zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to a Unitree G1 and generated omnidirectional seated locomotion.
Locomotion-Grounded Humanoid Soccer: Task-Gated Reinforcement Learning of a Multi-Directional Kicking Library
基于运动控制的类人机器人足球：多向踢球动作库的任务门控强化学习
当前人形机器人足球系统通常将运动追踪作为底层基础，并主要通过向着球的方向引导运动参考锚点来派生出移动能力。尽管这种方法能够取得不错的射门效果，但其移动控制往往仅在由接近球的狭窄、确定性指令分布上进行训练，从未将其作为一项独立的通用能力进行全面评估。针对这一局限，本文颠覆了传统的技术堆栈，将一个通用的、以指令为条件的移动策略作为底层基础，并在其之上将多个由运动引导的踢球技能作为任务门控层（task-gated layers）进行叠加，从而使可达步态空间由移动课程而非任何单一的参考片段来决定。
在这种新架构中，由于每个技能都从相同的可控状态出发并最终返回该状态，移动策略自然演变为一个组合枢纽，将技能转换复杂度从二次方量级降为线性量级，且击球后的稳定化过程交由训练有素的控制器自动处理，而非针对每个动作片段进行脚本化编写。研究团队在拥有 29 个自由度的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实例化了该系统，集成了涵盖 259.5 度标称瞄准方向的 7 种重定向踢球技能（包括单一样本参考无法表达的侧向、后向以及弱势脚射门），并在挂载完整技能库的条件下，对射门准确性、指令追踪、地形适应性及抗推恢复能力进行了全面评估。
硬件实验验证了该技能库在前方、侧向、后向以及受控接近等多种路径下的卓越性能与稳定性，填补了人形机器人足球系统在全面评估移动基底指标方面的空白。通过将移动策略作为核心支撑，该方法不仅突破了传统面向特定射门动作的局限，还展现出高度鲁棒的动态适应能力，为构建具备多向、全方位战术动作的敏捷人形机器人控制系统提供了一条极具扩展性的新路径。
Recent humanoid soccer systems make motion tracking the substrate and derive locomotion from it, typically by steering a motion-reference anchor toward the ball. This yields strong shooting results, but locomotion is trained only on the narrow, deterministic command distribution ball approach induces, never evaluated as a capability in its own right. We invert the stack: a general, command-conditioned locomotion policy is trained first as the substrate, and N motion-guided kicking skills are added on top as task-gated layers, so the reachable gait space is set by the locomotion curriculum rather than any reference clip. Because every skill starts from and returns to this same commandable state, locomotion also becomes a composition hub (O(N) transitions rather than O(N^2)), and post-strike stabilisation is handed back to the trained controller rather than scripted per clip. We instantiate this on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 with seven retargeted kicking skills spanning 259.5 degrees of nominal aim direction, including lateral, rearward and weak-foot strikes a single forward-facing reference cannot express, and report shooting accuracy alongside command-tracking, terrain and push-recovery results with the full skill library attached, an axis prior humanoid soccer systems do not report. The library is validated on hardware across forward, lateral, rearward and commanded approaches.
PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
PAC-MAN：面向人形机器人躲避球全身安全、感知感知的 CBF-RL 方法
人形机器人在执行躲避球（dodgeball）等极具挑战性的敏捷避障任务时，不仅需要具备高动态的全身反应能力，还极度依赖在部署环境中对高速移动物体的真实感知能力。现有的控制障碍函数（CBF）与强化学习（RL）结合框架大多假设能够获取理想的特权状态，忽视了物理机载感知的局限性与观测不确定性，导致在真实世界部署时极易发生失效。
为此，本文提出了 PAC-MAN——一个感知感知的控制障碍函数与强化学习组合框架（perception-aware CBF-RL framework），旨在将控制障碍函数的安全性与适合部署的机载感知相结合，赋予人形机器人高度敏捷的全身躲避球能力。在训练阶段，PAC-MAN 利用高维 CBF 约束提供全身各个连杆与球之间的安全间距引导，并引入对抗性运动先验（adversarial motion prior）来正则化生成的避险反射姿态；而在部署阶段，策略仅通过头部深度相机获取带有语义分割掩码（segmentation-masked depth）的球体深度图像作为观测输入。
研究团队构建了一个受控的全连杆接触评估基准（controlled any-link contact benchmark），涵盖单次投掷与“完成避险后自主返回原位并恢复”的连续部署循环两种测试模式。评估结果表明，仅凭固定机载相机，PAC-MAN 的回避成功率即接近理想的特权状态预言机（privileged state oracle）。研究进一步揭示了安全障碍结构的有效性高度依赖于感知可观性（perceptual observability）：传统的联合控制障碍函数（Joint-CBF）在精准球体状态下表现最优，但在固定相机观测且仅作为训练引导时会出现性能退化；引入球体追踪云台或特权运行时过滤器可恢复其性能。基于此发现，研究团队将轻量化的连杆控制障碍函数（Link-CBF）策略零样本（zero-shot）部署于真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。该策略展现出了对不完美感知的强鲁棒性，在真实投掷测试中取得了高达 95% 的躲避成功率，并能通过语义分割实现对不同类型球体的精准闪避。
We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.
Motion Retargeting with Spatiotemporal Preferences for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
面向人形机器人移动-操作任务、融合时空偏好的动作重定向
人类运动重定向（human motion retargeting）通过将人类示范转换为全身控制与移动操控的参考轨迹，有效弥合了人类与人形机器人之间的躯体形态差异。然而，在涉及物体交互（object-interaction）的任务中，成功的执行高度依赖于在关键阶段精确保持身体与物体之间的空间几何关系。现有的均匀每帧迭代预算（uniform per-frame iteration budgets）未能针对这些局部精度需求进行自适应资源分配，从而限制了重定向的计算效率与关键接触点的保持质量。
为此，本文提出了时空重定向（Spatiotemporal Retargeting, STR）框架，通过引入关键帧与关键身体部位来动态分配优化计算资源。具体而言，该方法利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）筛选出相关的运动信号与关键身体部位，并根据所选信号的变化自动识别关键帧；在此基础上，STR 为关键帧分配额外的求解器迭代次数，并为选定部位赋予更高的交互权重。为了进一步提升接触保真度，研究团队引入了力学感知的接触锚定（Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring, MCA），利用近似的物体旋量（wrench）模型在保持选定表面方向的同时精炼物体-表面接触位置。在生成的优质参考轨迹基础之上，进一步开发了时空强化学习（STRL），结合自适应关键阶段采样与基于目标邻近度的接触位置奖励，用于下游控制策略的训练。
在 Unitree G1 仿真环境与 Unitree R1 真实机器人上的实验表明，STR 在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了几何接触覆盖率与轨迹连续性，而由此生成的参考轨迹则大幅增强了机器人跨多种复杂物体交互动作的下游任务完成率与泛化执行能力。
Human motion retargeting bridges the embodiment gap between humans and humanoid robots by converting human demonstrations into reference trajectories for whole-body control and loco-manipulation. For object-interaction tasks, successful execution depends on accurately preserving body--object relations at critical stages. However, uniform per-frame iteration budgets do not account for these localized accuracy requirements, limiting the computational efficiency of retargeting. To address this limitation, we present Spatiotemporal Retargeting (STR), which uses keyframes and key body parts to allocate optimization effort. Specifically, a vision-language model selects relevant motion signals and body parts, and keyframes are identified from changes in the selected signals. Based on these selections, STR assigns additional solver iterations to keyframes and higher interaction weights to the selected parts. To further improve contact fidelity, we introduce Mechanics-Aware Contact Anchoring (MCA) to refine object-surface contact positions using an approximate object-wrench model while retaining the selected surface directions. Building on the resulting references, we develop Spatiotemporal Reinforcement Learning (STRL), which combines adaptive key-stage sampling with a contact-position reward based on target proximity for downstream control. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 and real-world experiments on a Unitree R1 demonstrate that STR improves geometric contact coverage and continuity at lower computational cost, while the resulting references improve downstream task completion across diverse object-interaction motions.
HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
HumanoidNDM：通过类人神经动力学模型弥合运动追踪在训练与部署之间的差距
人形机器人在运动追踪领域取得了显著进展，但在真实世界部署时，往往会遭遇由物理扰动或仿真建模误差引起的动力学鸿沟（dynamics gap），从而导致明显的训练-部署差距。为了攻克这一实现鲁棒部署的关键“最后一公里”，本文提出了 HumanoidNDM——一个由真实世界训练的神经动力学模型驱动的人形机器人运动追踪在线微调框架。
HumanoidNDM 的核心架构主要包含三个关键阶段。首先在数据采集阶段，该框架引入了一种具有自适应强度机制的低频参考扰动方法，在保障部署可行性的同时兼顾了探索效率；其次在模型训练阶段，它在欧几里得空间内训练了一个基于历史状态的本体感受神经动力学模型，并通过融入可微分正向运动学（differentiable forward kinematics）彻底消除了对昂贵动作捕捉（MoCap）系统的依赖；最后在策略微调阶段，系统直接通过反向传播模型梯度对策略进行在线微调，实现了极高的数据利用效率。
在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的物理硬件验证表明，HumanoidNDM 能够使策略快速适应各种真实世界的突发扰动。作为首个面向人形机器人追踪策略的在线、无动捕（MoCap-free）微调框架，该研究为弥合具身智能从仿真到真实世界的动力学鸿沟提供了一条高效、可扩展且摆脱外部设备依赖的全新技术路径。
Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps—arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling—resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial ``last mile'' for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. First, in the data collection stage, we introduce a low-frequency reference perturbation method with an adaptive intensity mechanism, balancing deployment feasibility and exploration efficiency. Second, for the model training stage, we train a robust history-based, proprioceptive neural dynamics model in Euclidean space by incorporating differentiable forward kinematics, eliminating the reliance on costly motion capture systems. Finally, in the policy fine-tuning stage, we directly fine-tune the policy via backpropagated model gradients, achieving high data efficiency. Through physical validation on the Unitree G1 robot, we demonstrate that HumanoidNDM enables rapid real-world adaptation to various perturbations, representing the first online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid tracking policies.
KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation
KinoGen：通过运动学基础视频生成可定制的人形机车操纵参考
人形机器人在执行复杂的移动操控（loco-manipulation）任务时，往往需要高质量、符合运动学约束的参考轨迹。然而，现有的运动生成方法通常依赖于人类动作捕捉数据或复杂的人体代理（human body proxy）重定向，这在处理人形机器人与特定异构物体交互时常常导致严重的几何穿透与脚底滑动。
为此，本文提出了 KinoGen——一个通过运动学接地视频生成（kinematically grounded video generation）来合成可定制化人形移动操控参考轨迹的新颖框架。KinoGen 的核心思想在于：将预训练的视频生成器条件化输入目标机器人在模拟任务实例中的校准渲染图与物体状态，随后通过将相同的机器人与物体模型直接拟合到生成的双视角视频中来恢复参考轨迹。这种设计从根本上确保了生成的参考轨迹天然位于机器人的配置空间（configuration space）内，彻底摆脱了人类身体代理或传统重定向步骤的束缚。
在重建过程中，KinoGen 利用身体、手部与物体先验初始化优化，并通过针对多视角视频证据的直接优化进行轨迹精炼。此外，该框架具备极强的可定制性：由于编辑后的关键帧本质上只是另一幅渲染状态图，用户只需指定目标物体位姿并围绕该关键帧重新生成视频，即可获得精确满足该位姿要求的参考轨迹。
在涵盖 8 项移动操控任务的评估中，KinoGen 相比传统的基于视频的基线方法显著降低了几何穿透与脚底滑动，并成功保持了超过 90% 的标注接触点；其定制化参考轨迹在完美满足各项指定目标的同时，几何穿透率远低于直接插值方法。研究团队将基于这些合成参考轨迹训练出的追踪策略成功部署到了搭载灵巧手（dexterous hands）的 Unitree G1 人形机器人硬件上，展现出卓越的泛化能力与真实世界执行精度。
We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands.
TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
TRACE：面向人形机器人运动扩散的、感知类型引用的对话式编辑方法
基于自然语言的人形机器人运动生成使用户能够通过自然语言灵活创建和精炼机器人动作，但其核心挑战在于如何将含糊不清的语言请求转化为具体的运动结构，并支持基于已有参考动作的精确迭代修改。为此，本文提出了 TRACE——一个专为 Unitree G1 人形机器人打造的、围绕类型化且可量化的运动学量（typed, measurable kinematic quantities）构建的运动生成与编辑框架。
TRACE 的核心创新在于将生成条件根植于成对的训练动作中，并将编辑目标锚定于当前的运动状态之上。在生成阶段，框架利用专门的语言模型从运动导向的监督中预测支撑状态、根节点及手部事件，并将其时间对齐的编码与原始文本共同输入扩散生成器中，同时引入重力参考状态与轨迹-接触目标来保障整体运动学的物理一致性。在编辑阶段，类型化请求能够精确定义身体-时间作用域（body–time scopes）与源相对目标（source-relative goals），独立的参考条件扩散编辑器据此实现动态调整，而采样时投影机制（sampling-time projection）则确保了受保护状态坐标在修改过程中不被破坏。
广泛的定量评估与人类主观评测表明，相比现有方法，TRACE 在语义对齐度与动作生成质量上均实现了显著提升；多轮连续编辑评估进一步验证了该框架在共享保持约束下，能够极其可靠地执行连续、复杂的相对修改指令。
Language-conditioned humanoid motion generation enables users to create and refine robot movements through natural language. The central challenge is to connect an underspecified request to concrete motion structure that can subsequently be revised relative to an accepted reference. We present TRACE, a generation and editing framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot built around typed, measurable kinematic quantities. Our insight is to ground generation conditions in paired training motions and editing goals in the current motion. A language model learns to predict support, root, and hand events from motion-derived supervision; their time-aligned encodings complement the original text in a diffusion generator. Gravity-referenced states and trajectory--contact objectives improve kinematic consistency. For editing, typed requests define body--time scopes and source-relative goals. A separate reference-conditioned diffusion editor uses these goals and revised events to realize changes, while sampling-time projection preserves protected state coordinates. Quantitative evaluation and human assessment show improved semantic alignment and motion quality over the compared methods. Multi-turn editing evaluations demonstrate more reliable execution of successive relative requests under shared preservation constraints.
TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perceptionl
TAPNAV：通过触觉主动感知实现人形机器人导航
在缺乏视觉信息的恶劣环境（如浓烟、黑暗或视觉传感器失效场景）中，人形机器人的自主导航面临严峻挑战。纯靠本体感受里程计（proprioceptive odometry）会不可避免地产生漂移，导致定位不确定性快速累积，最终引发导航失败。
针对无视觉依赖的导航难题，本文提出了 TAPNAV——一个基于触觉主动感知（tactile active-perception）的人形机器人导航框架。TAPNAV 核心在于通过主动探测周围环境物理结构来纠正定位偏差，无需依赖任何视觉输入。在状态估计层面，该框架结合里程计、IMU 与触觉接触观测实时维护一个姿态信念（pose belief）；在规划层面，它将不确定性感知的全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测动作紧密耦合——全局规划器优先选择能够利用触觉修正来抑制定位误差增长的路径，而局部规划器则实时选择能够最大化预期信息增益的探测动作（probe actions）。最后，通过全身控制器（whole-body controller）协调机器人的双足移动与末端执行器接触，高精度执行规划的导航与探测行为。
研究团队在多种不同的平面户型图与障碍物几何形状下对 TAPNAV 进行了仿真评估与真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人硬件验证。实验结果表明，与对比基线方法相比，TAPNAV 实现了更低的状态估计误差与显著更高的导航任务完成率。该研究充分证明，主动规划与环境的物理交互能够为缺乏视觉的人形机器人提供可靠的定位纠偏信号，大幅拓展了具身智能在极端环境下的全天候自主作业能力。
Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.
HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors
HLO-AMP：基于物体感知运动先验的分层式移动操作
传统的人形机器人移动操控分层流水线通常将任务无关的全身控制器（WBC）与下游任务策略相结合。然而，现有的 WBC 大多通过人工奖励塑形训练，导致生成的动作呈现出明显的机械感；更重要的是，它们在训练时往往忽略了场景中的被操作物体，转而采用随机末端执行器力扰动来近似物体动力学。这种代理方法无法准确复现真实负载在双臂和躯干上施加的分布式多接触旋量（multi-contact wrench），当接近平台负载极限时，这种动力学鸿沟将变得尤为致命。
为此，本文提出将底层控制器本身训练为一个具备物体感知能力的运动先验（object-aware motion prior）。该单一策略通过在重定向的动作捕捉（MoCap）参考轨迹上进行运动模仿来训练——这些参考轨迹涵盖了下游任务的核心运动基元，且被操作物体在训练场景中真实存在。该底层策略直接从参考轨迹中继承了自然的人类协调性，并在源头处吸收了真实的接触旋量，同时暴露了与命令追踪型 WBC 相同的紧凑任务空间控制接口。在此基础之上，系统在其顶层训练了一个无参考的高层（HL）策略，其动作通道被锚定在底层训练数据的经验包络上，从而在将先验泛化至长视界多阶段任务的同时，结构性地防止了将底层推离分布（out-of-distribution）的无效查询。
研究团队将该框架在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了双臂纸箱抓取与放置（bimanual box pick-and-place）任务的物理验证。实验结果表明，部署的同一套策略能够鲁棒地泛化至不同的物体质量与尺寸、不同的初始和目标位姿，并且能够在搬运途中遭遇故意掉落时进行反应式的姿态恢复。该方法有效克服了传统分层控制中物体动力学缺失的局限，为人形机器人高载荷、长视界复杂双臂移动操控提供了一种高效且鲁棒的底层先验与高层决策协同架构。
Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. Object dynamics are instead approximated through randomized end-effector force disturbances, a proxy that fails to reproduce the distributed multi-contact wrench a real payload applies across the arms and torso, with the gap becoming critical near the platform's payload limit. In this work, we train the low-level (LL) controller itself as an object-aware motion prior: a single policy trained via motion imitation on retargeted motion-capture (MoCap) references that span the core motion primitives of the downstream task, with the manipulated object physically present in the scene. This single stage inherits natural human-like coordination from the references and absorbs the realistic contact wrench at its source, while exposing the same compact task-space command interface used by command-tracking WBCs. A reference-free high-level (HL) policy is then trained on top, with its action channel anchored to the empirical envelope of the low-level training data so that it generalizes the priors to a long-horizon multi-stage task while structurally preventing queries that would push the low level off-distribution. We instantiate the framework on a Unitree G1 for bimanual box pick-and-place: the same deployed policy generalizes across object masses and dimensions, initial and goal poses, and reactively recovers from intentional drops mid-carry.
EVOLVE: Egocentric Vision-based Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Demonstration Editing
EVOLVE：基于以自我为中心的视觉、通过演示编辑实现人形机器人移动与操作
人形机器人的移动操控（loco-manipulation）任务需要实现移动与物体交互之间的长视界协调，同时要求策略对多样化物体和充满噪声的真实世界观测具有强大的鲁棒性。然而，现有的基于参考动作或任务特定奖励的学习方法在面对形态各异的未知物体时，往往暴露出泛化能力不足的致命缺陷，难以适应真实场景中物体尺寸、形状与位姿的动态变化。
为此，本文提出了 Evolve——一个通过基于模拟的示范编辑与分层视觉运动策略训练（hierarchical visuomotor policy training）来实现以自我为中心的视觉人形移动操控框架。该方法的核心创新在于：仅给定单次成功的示范，即可通过对机器人关键点轨迹施加结构化变换，将其自适应扩展至多样化的物体变体中。随后，这些经过编辑的轨迹交由任务无关的底层全身控制器（WBC）执行，该控制器通过追踪稀疏身体关键点的未来目标位姿来驱动机器人；在此基础之上，系统利用成功编辑的运行轨迹（rollouts）训练高层视觉运动策略，从而赋能真实世界的无缝部署。
实验评估表明，在仿真环境中，Evolve 能够在大幅变化的物体尺寸、形状、位姿及初始状态下展现出卓越的泛化性能，显著优于主流的基于参考和免参考基线方法。更重要的是，研究团队将学到的视觉运动策略零样本（zero-shot）部署至真实世界硬件任务中，充分证明了将示范编辑与分层视觉控制相结合，是实现人形移动操控技能从单次示范向多样化真实物体高效迁移的可扩展有效策略。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires long-horizon coordination between locomotion and object interaction, as well as robust adaptation to diverse objects and noisy real-world observations. Recent approaches have shown promising results by learning loco-manipulation policies from reference motions or task-specific rewards, but they often struggle to generalize across objects. We propose \textbf{\textsc{Evolve}}, a framework for learning egocentric vision-based humanoid loco-manipulation through simulation-based demonstration editing and hierarchical visuomotor policy training. Given a single successful demonstration, our method adapts it to diverse objects by applying structured transformations to robot keypoint trajectories. These edited trajectories are executed by a task-agnostic low-level whole-body controller that tracks future target poses of sparse body keypoints. We then train a high-level visuomotor policy from the successful edited rollouts to enable real-world deployment. In simulation, our method generalizes across substantial object variations in size, shape, pose, and initialization, outperforming representative reference-based and reference-free baselines. We further deploy the learned policy zero-shot on real-world tasks. These results suggest that combining demonstration editing with hierarchical visuomotor control is a scalable strategy for transferring humanoid loco-manipulation skills from a single demonstration to diverse real-world objects.
RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
RFPO：用于具身控制的修正流策略优化
基于流的策略（Flow-based policies）为连续机器人控制提供了极具表现力的框架，然而其迭代式的常微分方程（ODE）数值积分带来了巨大的在线推理开销。如果在训练时未对粗粒度数值积分进行显式约束，直接减少积分步数会导致控制性能严重劣化。这种由于全步长优化策略在粗粒度积分下缺乏鲁棒性而产生的性能鸿沟，被称为“少步离散化鸿沟”（few-step discretization gap）。
为了攻克这一瓶颈，本文提出了 RFPO（流策略优化框架，flow-policy optimization framework），旨在实现可靠的少步数执行。该框架的核心创新在于引入了奖励感知的在线回流（Reward-aware online Reflow）机制，在在线策略学习过程中矫正学生策略诱导的传输路径，从而显著增强策略对粗粒度积分的容错能力；同时，辅以一个冻结的高斯 PPO 控制器，在全步长和中间积分预算下提供互补的动作空间监督，最终将部署策略精简为仅需单步欧拉步（one Euler step）执行的单流学生模型。
在 Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot、Unitree H1 以及 Unitree G1 等多种四足与人形机器人平台上的广泛评估表明，RFPO 能够在单步执行下完美保留全步长控制性能，其单步回报率在零初始化与随机初始化下均保持在对应 64 步数值的 2.4% 以内。具体以 Unitree Go2 为例，单步执行在保留 98.5% 的 64 步累积奖励的同时，将机载平均推理延迟从 4.39 ms 大幅降低至 0.08 ms，实现了高达 54.9 倍的加速比，并通过真实的机器人硬件实验充分验证了稳定可靠的单步移动控制能力。
Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion.
METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
先探索，后移动：视觉语言导航中基于证据搜寻的进展锚定
人形机器人控制器通常需要针对不同任务分别进行训练，尽管这些任务都具有保持身体平衡和协调全身运动的共同需求。本文提出Metatron，一种可通过提示进行控制的全身动作执行层，将生成式基础策略与可编程技能层相结合。基础策略接收统称为提示（Prompt）的部分目标信息，这些信息可以组合定时的身体部位目标、速度指令和动作风格提示，并据此生成符合目标要求的多样化全身运动。训练数据结合了动作捕捉数据、合成恢复轨迹以及经过重定向处理的场景交互动作。训练完成后，基础策略的参数将被冻结。
该框架通过具有状态记忆的程序（即技能，Skills）表达任务意图，并在每个控制步骤中生成相应提示。技能程序通过绘制粗略的几何动作示意，引导基础策略将其转化为协调的全身运动。这些技能采用普通代码实现，并可由编程智能体通过分析运动数据、拟合简洁的控制规则进行优化，无需针对特定任务重新训练策略。在真实的Unitree G1人形机器人上，同一个冻结的模型检查点即可支持行走、姿态恢复、遥操作物体拾取以及坐在家具上等多种行为。
对比实验表明，与所测试的参考轨迹跟踪控制流程相比，Metatron在目标触达成功率和抗推扰能力方面表现更优。此外，采用相同的训练方案，还能够使仿真角色实现攀爬和特技动作。Metatron使编程智能体能够通过编写代码，将已有的运动控制能力转化为新的机器人技能，而无需进一步训练基础策略。
Humanoid controllers often require task-specific training despite sharing the need for balance and whole-body coordination. We present Metatron, a promptable whole-body execution layer combining a generative base policy with a programmable skill layer. The base policy receives partial goals, collectively called a prompt, that can combine timed body-part targets, velocity commands, and style cues. It produces diverse whole-body motions consistent with these goals. Training combines motion capture, synthetic recovery trajectories, and retargeted scene-interaction motions. After training, the policy is frozen. Stateful programs called skills express task intent as prompts at each control step, drawing rough geometric sketches that the policy turns into coordinated movement. Skills are ordinary code, refined by coding agents that analyze motion data and fit compact rules without task-specific policy training. On the physical Unitree G1, one frozen checkpoint supports walking, recovery, teleoperated object pickup, and sitting on furniture. Comparative evaluations show higher reaching success and push robustness than the tested reference-tracking pipelines. The same recipe produces climbing and acrobatics on a simulated character. Metatron enables coding agents to turn learned motor capabilities into new skills through code, without further policy training.
ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
ViT-H：基于运动追踪反馈的视频转人形机器人控制生成方法
利用单目人类视频学习人形机器人控制，为机器人获取多样化的全身运动行为提供了一种可扩展的途径。然而，现有的“动作重建—动作重定向—运动跟踪”（Reconstruction-Retargeting-Tracking）流程通常需要对各个中间阶段进行独立优化，限制了整个系统的可扩展性。此外，这类方法无法直接利用下游运动跟踪的反馈，优化参考动作在真实机器人上的可执行性。
为此，本文提出ViT-H，一种采用“生成—跟踪”（Generation-and-Tracking）范式的视频到人形机器人控制框架。ViT-H利用扩散模型直接根据视频生成适用于人形机器人的参考动作，跳过传统的人体动作重建和动作重定向过程；同时，利用运动跟踪结果对生成模型进行后训练，并采用直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization，DPO）进一步提升生成动作的可执行性。此外，研究还提出一种自回归变体，实现了实时人形机器人视频遥操作，端到端延迟低于400毫秒。
在Unitree G1上的大量实验表明，与当前最先进的动作重建、重定向及跟踪流程相比，ViT-H在动作质量和可执行性方面均取得了更好的表现。进一步实验还表明，ViT-H能够从模型规模以及预训练和后训练数据规模的增加中持续获益。同时，来自不同运动跟踪器的反馈均能稳定提升生成动作的可执行性。
Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors. Yet, existing reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines are limited in system-level scalability by separately optimized intermediate stages and cannot directly optimize reference motion executability using downstream tracking feedback.
We present ViT-H, a video-to-humanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. ViT-H directly generates humanoid reference motions from videos with a diffusion model, bypassing human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and uses motion-tracking outcomes to post-train the generator with direct preference optimization. We further introduce an autoregressive variant that enables real-time humanoid video teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency.
Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines in both motion quality and executability. We further show that ViT-H scales favorably with model size and with both pre-training and post-training data scale, while motion-tracking feedback consistently improves executability across different motion trackers.
What Should a Navigator Remember? Spatiotemporal Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation
导航者应记住什么？面向“零样本”视觉-语言导航的时空记忆
零样本视觉语言导航（Zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation，VLN）要求智能体在未经导航任务专项训练的情况下，利用过去的环境观测完成导航任务。本文研究一个8B规模的导航系统应当保留哪些信息，以及如何组织这些信息以支持后续决策。所提出的智能体构建了三种互补的记忆机制，分别对应任务、时间和空间维度：任务记忆用于记录指令执行进度；时间记忆用于保存以机器人位姿为锚点、经过层次化压缩的历史观测信息；空间记忆则用于累积环境几何信息。
该系统由多个模块协同工作：一个8B规模的观测模型（Observer）负责总结环境观测，另一个8B规模的推理模型（Reasoner）利用上述记忆选择路径点意图，或请求获取额外视角；几何控制器则负责执行选定的目标。研究从语义信息的角度出发，阐明了三个关键环节之间的区别，即保留证据、使推理模型能够有效利用这些证据，以及主动获取更多观测信息。在R2R-CE数据集的Val-Unseen测试集上，完整系统在所评估的基于Qwen3的零样本基线方法中取得了最高性能。消融实验表明，移除时间记忆后，导航成功率（SR）下降，平均路径长度则从16.9米显著增加至39.1米；移除空间地图和规划模块同样会导致导航成功率下降。
在真实环境实验中，研究将该零样本方法部署于Unitree Go2机器人。结果表明，与经过后训练的基线方法相比，该方法在走廊和办公室两种环境中均取得了更高的导航成功率，说明其在所评估的真实场景中具有更好的迁移表现。此外，研究还采用LAW2作为补充评估基准，通过成对的指令干预考察智能体的行为响应，从而评估其导航终点成功率之外的指令遵循能力。上述结果表明，对于采用较小规模开放模型实现零样本导航的系统而言，通过结构化记忆保留任务进度、历史观测和环境几何信息，是提升导航能力的有效途径。
Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to use past observations without navigation-specific training. We study what information an 8B-scale navigation system should retain and how it should be organized for subsequent decisions. Our agent combines instruction progress, hierarchically compressed observation history anchored to poses, and accumulated geometry in complementary task, temporal, and spatial memories. An 8B observer summarizes observations, and an 8B reasoner uses the memories to select waypoint intents or request additional views, a geometric controller executes the selected targets. A semantic information perspective motivates the distinction between retaining evidence, making it accessible to the reasoner, and acquiring further observations. On R2R-CE val-unseen, the complete system achieves the highest among the evaluated Qwen3-based zero-shot baselines. Removing temporal memory reduces SR and sharply increases average path length from 16.9 to 39.1m, removing the spatial-map and planning component reduces SR as well. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 show that our zero-shot method achieves higher success rates than the post-trained baseline in both corridor and office environments, suggesting better transfer to the evaluated real-world settings. As a complementary evaluation, LAW2 uses paired instruction interventions to examine behavioral responses, instruction following ability beyond endpoint success. These results support preserving task progress, observation history, and geometry in structured memory for zero-shot navigation with smaller open models.
DiPLO: Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation
DiPLO：用于移动操作任务的自蒸馏扩散规划
人形机器人的移动操作（Loco-manipulation）具有较高的挑战性，因为该任务需要协调运动、身体平衡与物体交互，因此很难仅凭有限的示范数据进行学习，或通过从零开始的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning，RL）实现有效训练。本文提出 DiPLO（Self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation，自蒸馏扩散式移动操作规划框架），将自蒸馏扩散规划器与底层全身运动跟踪策略相结合。其中，规划器通过监督学习，利用人类动作重定向至人形机器人后得到的运动数据进行预训练；运动跟踪器则通过强化学习训练，以执行规划器生成的动作。
DiPLO 的核心包括两个相互补充的后训练阶段。首先，本文提出自蒸馏扩散策略优化（Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation，SD:DPO），用于降低规划器对强任务条件的依赖。研究发现，强任务条件是实现有效预训练的关键因素；如果预训练阶段缺少这一因素，后续微调也无法恢复同等水平的性能。随后，本文采用扩散增强近端策略优化（Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization，DA:PPO）对蒸馏后的模型进行微调。这是一种面向扩散模型的最大熵强化学习方法，旨在提升任务成功率，并使生成的规划结果与冻结的运动跟踪器的实际执行能力相匹配。
通过上述两个阶段，规划器仅依靠状态历史和目标条件即可生成运动轨迹。在拾取-搬运-放置任务中，其成功率达到 99%，而预训练模型仅为 45%。此外，该规划器还能够针对未见过的物体目标生成动作，并进一步在踢击、推和拉等任务中进行了评估。最后，研究团队将完整流程部署于真实硬件平台，在 Unitree G1 上运行 DA:PPO 规划器与运动跟踪器，实现了多次连续成功执行，且无需进行任何真实世界微调。
Humanoid loco-manipulation is particularly challenging because it requires coordinating locomotion, balance, and object interaction, making it difficult to learn from limited demonstrations or from scratch through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce DiPLO (self-distilled Diffusion Planning for Loco-manipulation), a framework that combines a self-distilled diffusion planner with a low-level whole-body tracking policy. Our planner is pretrained via supervised learning on motions derived from human-to-humanoid retargeting, while the tracker is trained via RL to execute them. DiPLO centers around two complementary post-training stages. First, we introduce Self-Distillation Diffusion Policy Optimisation (SD:DPO) to remove the planner's dependence on strong task conditioning, which we identify as a crucial ingredient for effective pretraining, as downstream fine-tuning does not recover comparable performance when it is omitted.. We then fine-tune this distilled model with Diffusion-Augmented Proximal Policy Optimization (DA:PPO), a maximum-entropy RL method for diffusion models, to improve task success and align generated plans with the frozen tracker's execution capabilities. Together, these stages enable motion generation through state-history and goal conditioning alone, enabling 99% task success in pick-carry-place tasks, compared to just 45% for the pretrained model. The resulting planner also generates motions for unseen object goals, with further evaluations on kicking and pushing/pulling tasks. Finally, we deploy our pipeline on the hardware, using our DA:PPO planner-tracker on a Unitree G1, achieving repeated successful executions without any real-world fine-tuning.
OmniInteract: Towards Unified Whole-Body Interaction Control for Dual Humanoids
OmniInteract：迈向双人形机器人统一的全身交互控制
物理交互是人形机器人实现协作的关键能力，需要协调全身运动并实现精确接触。然而，学习多样化的双人形机器人交互行为面临两大挑战：（1）人类与机器人之间的形态差异会在动作重定向过程中破坏接触界面及空间关系；（2）同时学习运动技能与协作对象之间的协调行为较为困难，随着交互技能多样性的增加，控制精度也难以得到保持。
为解决上述问题，本文提出 OmniInteract，通过表面感知建模与可扩展残差策略学习实现双人形机器人交互。首先，本文提出表面接触感知动作重定向方法（Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting），利用人类与机器人之间稠密的表面对应关系，对两台人形机器人的动作进行联合重定向，从而保留明确的交互接触界面及其近场几何环境。其次，本文提出基于可扩展流模型的交互策略（Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy），用于生成以协作对象为条件的残差动作。该方法将双人形机器人控制分解为可复用的运动基础能力和针对特定交互任务的适应能力：由具备协作对象感知能力的专家策略，在冻结的全身运动先验基础上学习动作修正；同时，利用条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）将这些修正统一到共享的残差动作空间中。
大量实验表明，OmniInteract 提高了动作重定向的保真度和双人形机器人的协调能力，并且在技能多样性不断增加的情况下，能够更好地保持交互性能。真实世界部署实验进一步验证了该方法在建立有效接触、实现稳定的全身协调，以及从外部扰动中恢复等方面的能力。
Physical interaction is a key capability for humanoid collaboration, requiring coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact. However, learning diverse dual-humanoid interactions faces two major challenges: (1) human-robot morphological differences disrupt contact interfaces and spatial relationships during retargeting, and (2) jointly learning motor skills and partner coordination makes it difficult to retain control fidelity as interaction diversity grows. In this paper, we propose OmniInteract to address these challenges through surface-aware modeling and scalable residual policy learning. First, we introduce Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting, which leverages dense human-robot surface correspondences to jointly retarget both humanoids, preserving explicit interaction contact interfaces and their near-field geometric context. Second, we propose a Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy for partner-conditioned residual generation. It factorizes dual-humanoid control into a reusable motor foundation and interaction-specific adaptations: partner-aware experts learn corrections over a frozen whole-body motion prior, while conditional flow matching unifies them in a shared residual action space. This enables scalable skill consolidation while retaining pretrained motor capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniInteract improves retargeting fidelity and dual-humanoid coordination while better retaining interaction performance as skill diversity grows. Real-world deployment further demonstrates successful contact establishment, stable whole-body coordination, and recovery from external perturbations.
InfiniDanceRobot: A Streaming and Closed-Loop Music-driven Dance Generation for Humanoid Robot
InfiniDanceRobot：面向人形机器人的、基于音乐驱动的流式闭环舞蹈生成系统
对节奏作出响应是人类的一种自然行为，但对于人形机器人而言，实现高动态全身控制仍是一项挑战。现有运动生成模型虽然能够生成富有表现力的动作，却往往无法保证轨迹在物理层面上的有效性。因此，即使采用专家数据训练的运动跟踪器，在执行长序列生成舞蹈动作时，也会逐渐累积运动可行性差距。
本文提出 InfiniDanceRobot，一种由潜在表征引导的闭环系统，能够根据音乐条件持续生成舞蹈动作，并直接驱动真实人形机器人执行。研究团队采集了约 50 小时的舞蹈数据，其中包括 30 小时的实验室可控动作捕捉数据，以及从公开数据集中筛选出的 20 小时数据。为实现连续运动生成，本文提出一种基于扩散强制（Diffusion Forcing）的规划器，并结合因果递进式噪声调度（Causal Receding Noise Schedule）和跨模态对齐机制。此外，研究设计了潜在表征引导的闭环优化框架，在训练和推理过程中，利用运动跟踪器的反馈对下一令牌预测结果进行修正。
实验结果表明，InfiniDanceRobot 能够将专家级人类舞蹈动作生成并迁移至机器人，使其在不同音乐风格和舞蹈类型下，持续产生具有物理合理性和高动态特征的运动。
Responding to rhythm is a natural human behaviour but a challenge of high-dynamic whole-body control for humanoid robots. Existing motion generation models produce expressive but physically invalid trajectories. As a result, even an expert-trained tracker accumulates a feasibility gap on long sequences of generated dance. In this work, we present InfiniDanceRobot, a latent-guided closed-loop system that streams music-conditioned dance directly to a physical humanoid robot. We collect about 50 hours of dance: 30 hours of lab-controlled motion capture data and 20 hours filtered from public datasets. To provide continuous motion generation ability, we propose a planner building on diffusion forcing with a causal receding noise schedule and cross-modal alignment. Then the latent-guided closed-loop optimization framework is designed to correct next-token predictions from tracker feedback during both training and inference. Experiments show that InfiniDanceRobot can generate expert human dance for the robot, producing continuous, physically plausible, and high-dynamic motion across diverse music styles and dance genres.
FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
FORGE：面向敏捷人形机器人运动的、可行的在线降阶参考生成与全身执行方法
本文提出了一种两阶段学习框架，用于实现人形机器人的多样化与敏捷运动，该框架将在线降阶模型（Reduced-Order Model，ROM）参考轨迹生成与全身跟踪控制相结合。第一阶段，利用单刚体动力学与完整人形机器人运动学相结合的方法，训练一个由指令条件驱动的全身参考轨迹生成器。第二阶段，将冻结后的 ROM 策略在线运行，生成参考轨迹，并在全阶动力学模型上训练全身运动跟踪策略。
通过在简化的 ROM 空间中学习运动学与动力学一致的参考轨迹生成器，该方法能够在统一框架下，利用单一策略覆盖广泛的运动指令空间，并生成多种运动策略。研究在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证了该方法，实现了纵向速度从 -2.0 m/s 到 2.8 m/s、横向速度最高达 ±1.0 m/s、角速度最高达 ±3.0 rad/s 的运动能力，同时支持单腿跳跃以及不同运动指令之间的连续切换。上述能力均由一个统一的参考策略和一个全身运动跟踪策略实现。
This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.
Adaptive Traversal Tubes for Posture-Aware Navigation of Bipedal Humanoids
用于双足人形机器人姿态感知导航的自适应通行管道
双足人形机器人可以通过调整身体偏航角（yaw）改变其有效占地范围，从而实现狭窄通道通行以及具有社交意识的避让行为。本文提出了一种姿态感知导航框架，主要由自适应通行管道（Adaptive Traversal Tubes，ATT）、区间速度-航向（Interval Velocity–Heading，IVH）控制以及融入侧步动作的 AMP 运动先验构成。ATT 用于表示参考路径上行为可行的通道宽度场，将几何通行间隙与社交舒适度统一为连续信号。IVH 则根据该宽度信息，生成从正面行走到侧步行走的连续姿态调整方案，并输出全向速度指令。
该框架采用速度条件驱动的 AMP 策略，并利用 GVHMR 重定向得到的正面行走与侧步动作，以及耦合的纵向和横向速度（\(v_x, v_y\)）跟踪奖励进行训练。该策略旨在提升不同姿态之间的转换稳定性，相较于通用运动控制器具有更好的过渡表现，同时能够与机器人默认的机载策略互换。本文以预印本形式介绍了完整方法，并概述了计划在 Unitree G1 上开展的评估方案，定量实验结果将在后续公布。
Bipedal humanoids can change their effective footprint by adjusting body yaw, enabling both narrow-passage traversal and socially aware yielding. This paper presents a posture-aware navigation framework centered on \emph{Adaptive Traversal Tubes} (ATT), \emph{Interval Velocity--Heading} (IVH) control, and a sidestep-enhanced AMP locomotion prior. ATT represents a behavior-feasible corridor width field along a reference path, unifying geometric clearance and social comfort into a continuous signal. IVH maps this width to a continuous frontal-to-sidestep posture schedule and omnidirectional velocity commands. A velocity-conditioned AMP policy, trained with GVHMR-retargeted frontal/sidestep motions and coupled \((v_x,v_y)\) tracking rewards, is designed to improve transition stability over a generic locomotion controller while remaining interchangeable with the default onboard policy. This preprint presents the full method; a planned evaluation protocol on a Unitree G1 is outlined, with quantitative results to follow.
Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture
无需数据集的类人机器人运动与操作：基于动态在线姿态生成
大多数人形机器人移动操作（loco-manipulation）控制器需要依赖人体运动数据来学习全身协调与姿态控制，因此其策略训练受到外部数据来源的限制。本文提出 OCLO（Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation，在线姿态自适应柔顺移动操作）系统，该系统无需人体运动数据进行训练，仅通过两个末端执行器目标进行指令控制。由于这两个目标无法唯一确定机器人的全身姿态，OCLO 利用解析式可达性先验在线生成骨盆高度和躯干朝向，并进一步通过策略在环采样（policy-in-the-loop sampling）结合与任务无关的代价函数进行优化。
此外，OCLO 通过柔顺性学习实现全身柔顺控制：根据测得的外力，利用弹簧-阻尼模型调整末端执行器参考位置，使腿部、腰部和骨盆能够在外部负载作用下产生适应性让步。在仿真实验中，采用可达性先验后，机器人成功达到指令参考姿态的成功率为 77.8%，显著高于未使用该先验时的 37.8%。此外，优化过程降低了所有评估任务中的末端执行器姿态误差。相同的姿态模块还使预训练的 SONIC 控制器在五项任务中的四项取得性能提升。未经过柔顺性训练的策略在受到外部扰动时，往往会因坚持轨迹跟踪而失去平衡，而不是主动让步。在 Unitree G1 实物机器人上的实验表明，OCLO 能够在末端执行器受到扰动时保持平衡，而消融版本则会因此失效；同时，该系统成功完成了七项移动操作任务，包括下蹲行走以及从低矮表面拾取箱子。
Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface.
Humanoid Rickshaw Pulling: Whole-Body Locomotion under Coupled Wheeled Loads
人形机器人拉人力车：耦合轮式负载下的全身运动
人形机器人可以通过牵引无动力轮式车辆，而非直接搬运负载，运输远超自身重量的货物。然而，这种能力也带来了耦合运动控制问题：机器人必须在持续保持上半身接触的同时，适应由负载、车辆及地形共同产生的未知且随构型变化的作用力。本文提出了一种用于人形机器人拉动人力车的全身控制框架，使机器人能够在不确定负载动力学条件下，跟踪预设的车辆运动指令，同时保持自身平衡和稳定抓握。
在训练过程中，利用特权信息的教师策略获取车辆状态、交互作用力及负载属性，并将其动作和潜在表征蒸馏至一个基于历史信息条件驱动的学生策略。该学生策略通过本体感知响应隐式推断机器人与车辆之间的耦合动力学，随后再通过强化学习进行微调。与“No History”和“Only History”两种基线方法相比，最终策略在实现精确车辆轨迹跟踪的同时，降低了车辆振荡、躯干倾斜以及驱动执行成本。行为分析表明，Unitree G1 能够通过自身步态驱动人力车，并产生与步态同步的全身反作用，以稳定车辆的横向运动和侧倾运动。此外，牵引过程重新分配了各关节的运动负荷，在大多数测试的负载与速度组合下，其机器人归一化运输成本代理指标（cost-of-transport proxy）低于空载行走时的水平。
在实物机器人实验中，单一策略无需针对特定负载进行重新调参，即可完成启动、持续牵引、转向和停止等动作，并能够牵引刚性货物及载有人类乘客的人力车，最大载荷人力车质量达到 115 kg。实验结果表明，通过协调且持续的人形机器人与车辆之间的交互，可以实现稳健的重载运输。
Humanoid robots could transport payloads substantially heavier than themselves by pulling passive wheeled vehicles instead of carrying the load. This capability, however, creates a coupled locomotion problem: the robot must maintain persistent upper-body contact while adapting to unknown, configuration-dependent forces arising from the payload, vehicle, and terrain. We present a whole-body control framework for humanoid rickshaw pulling that tracks commanded vehicle motion while preserving balance and stable grasps under uncertain load dynamics. During training, a privileged teacher exploits vehicle states, interaction forces, and load properties. Its actions and latent are distilled into a history-conditioned student that implicitly infers coupled dynamics from proprioceptive responses, followed by reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. Comparisons with \emph{No History} and \emph{Only History} baselines show that the resulting policy achieves accurate vehicle tracking while reducing vehicle oscillation, torso tilt, and actuation cost. Behavioral analysis shows that Unitree G1 propels the rickshaw and generates gait-synchronized whole-body reactions that stabilize its lateral and roll motions. Moreover, pulling redistributes joint effort and yields a lower robot-normalized cost-of-transport proxy than unloaded walking over most tested load--speed conditions. On hardware, a single policy performs starting, sustained pulling, turning, and stopping with both rigid payloads and human passengers, handling a loaded rickshaw mass of up to 115~kg without load-specific retuning. These results demonstrate robust heavy-load transportation through coordinated and persistent humanoid--vehicle interaction.
BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
BRACE：面向力与地形感知的人形机器人运动追踪——全身参考姿态的自适应调整
全身运动跟踪已成为操作人员控制人形机器人的重要接口，但其所使用的参考动作通常是在平坦地面、无负载条件下采集的，因此跟踪器既无法感知机器人需要与物体交换的作用力，也无法感知机器人实际需要行走的地形。现有控制器主要解决了这一问题的某一方面：具备力控制能力的策略能够控制末端执行器施加指定作用力，却无法同时规定全身姿态；而具备地形自适应能力的跟踪器则将负载视为需要抵消的扰动，而非需要主动施加的力与力矩。
本文提出 BRACE，一种全身运动跟踪器，使机器人能够在多种身体姿态下施加和补偿指定的手部作用力，同时在倾斜地形上跟踪基于平坦地面生成的参考动作。BRACE 并非简单地让跟踪器自行适应负载和坡度，而是将两者直接融入其跟踪的参考动作中：地形适应模块根据局部地形表面调整足部落点和机器人根部位置；力与力矩变换模块则计算产生目标作用力所需的手部位移，并同时考虑该位移引起的质心（CoM）和压力中心（CoP）偏移，且将手臂施力限制在教师策略特定的用力范围内。随后，分别用于施力和力补偿的教师策略通过数据集聚合（DAgger）蒸馏为一个基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的学生策略。该学生策略仅依赖本体感知信息运行，无需高度图或实测力与力矩数据。因此，即使在远程操作等场景下，操作人员也只需提供基于平坦地面生成的运动轨迹，机器人便能够在机载端自主处理坡度和负载带来的影响。
研究在 Unitree G1 上开展了大量实验，通过仿真和实物机器人实验验证了 BRACE 在施加作用力、补偿作用力以及适应多种地形方面的能力。
Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.
GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models
GRAIL：基于世界模型生成人形机器人的移动与操作行为
人形机器人移动操作能力的规模化发展，需要获取涵盖多种物体、全身运动和场景几何结构的机器人兼容演示数据。然而，遥操作和动作捕捉难以大规模推广，因为每次数据采集都依赖实体环境搭建、配备仪器的参与者以及机器人实际操作。本文提出 GRAIL，一种数字化数据生成流程，其整个过程在部署前均可完全在虚拟环境中完成。该方法结合三维资产、可用于仿真的场景，以及视频基础模型（Video Foundation Models，VFMs）提供的先验知识，在无需重新搭建物理环境或遥操作机器人的情况下合成交互数据。
与直接重建不受约束的真实场景视频不同，GRAIL 从完全明确的三维配置开始。在视频生成之前，物体几何形状、相机参数、度量尺度、环境深度以及按机器人比例构建的角色模型均已确定，并在后续重建过程中重复使用。这种具有特权信息的设置能够为四维（4D）重建提供更好的条件，使模型能够结合基于模型的物体跟踪、人体运动估计和交互感知优化，重建具有实际度量尺度的四维人-物交互（Human-Object Interaction，HOI）轨迹，同时减少深度歧义和形态不匹配问题。随后，研究将恢复的动作重定向至人形机器人，并训练两种互补的通用任务跟踪器：用于物体操作的物体感知潜在适配器，以及用于地形通行的场景感知跟踪器。
GRAIL 生成了超过 20,000 条动作序列，涵盖物体拾取、物体操作、坐姿动作和地形通行等任务。研究仅使用 GRAIL 生成的数据，通过仿真到现实（Sim-to-Real）流程训练第一人称视觉策略，并将其部署于 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。在真实环境中，该机器人在多种物体拾取任务中取得了 84% 的成功率，在楼梯攀爬任务中取得了 90% 的成功率。研究团队表示，相关代码和数据将向公众开放。
Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90% success on stair-climbing. Code and data will be publicly released.
REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal
REACH：一种基于强化学习的分层式人形机器人爬行框架，用于在受限空间内实现自适应通行
在狭窄空间中进行人形机器人运动控制需要跨多种运动模式进行连续的高度自适应，然而现有的绝大多数方法往往局限于高度可调节的双足步行，难以应对极低高度约束带来的严苛挑战。为此，本文推出了 REACH 框架——一个基于强化学习的分层框架，旨在使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够通过“变高双足步行”与“爬行”的高效结合，在高度受限的环境中实现卓越的复杂空间穿行能力。
该学习策略在互补的命令范围内对身体高度进行精细调节：在双足步行阶段实现 1.27 至 0.50 米的调节，而在爬行阶段则可进一步下探至 0.50 至 0.20 米，从而突破了传统蹲行模式的垂直空间清理极限。为了妥善应对触觉丰富的爬行动态学，该系统采用了一种历史条件化的潜在表征，能够从本体感受观测中准确捕捉地形与交互上下文；同时，引入了一个双向过渡策略，无缝连接了蹲式双足运动与爬行之间的巨大运动学和接触不连续性，并将其与一个将点云转换为无碰撞三维路径及前瞻性高度目标的 LiDAR 规划器紧密集成。
真实世界的实验结果表明，基于 REACH 管道的 Unitree G1 人形机器人展现出了高度精准的高度与速度跟踪能力、鲁棒的地形穿行性能、可靠的模式转换机制以及在复杂狭窄空间中的自主穿行实力。这一研究成果显著拓展了人形机器人在受限空间中的作业边界，为具身智能体在灾后救援、工业密闭空间巡检等复杂场景下的全地形适应提供了重要的技术支撑。
Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27–0.50 m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50–0.20 m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiDAR-based planner that converts point clouds into collision-free three-dimensional paths and locomotion commands, including proactive height targets. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate height and velocity tracking, robust terrain traversal, reliable mode transitions and confined-space traversal with the proposed pipeline.
Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
通过随机运动标记化实现全身人形机器人控制
尽管基于速度指令的强化学习策略在控制四足机器人方面表现出色，但对于需要执行复杂全身运动的人形机器人而言，这种低维控制接口显得过于单一且受限。此外，传统的全身运动强化学习跟踪策略通常缺乏关于期望未来运动的详细信息，这导致它们难以进行受控的偏差调整以实现长期的任务成功，特别是在控制器必须为不同行为之间的平滑转换做准备时，这种局限性尤为明显。
为了克服这些挑战，本研究提出了一种创新方法：利用高层控制器根据行为标签或文本命令生成简洁的运动表征，并将其直接输入跟踪策略以提供详细的运动参考。在此基础上，研究团队采用了一种随机运动标记器（stochastic motion tokenizer），在同等容量下，其对来自 Unitree G1 机器人的运动重建表现超越了有限标量量化（FSQ）和向量量化自编码器（VQ-VAE）等现有先进方法，从而生成能够精准条件化全身跟踪策略的离散接口。
该方法在执行诸如舞蹈、格斗或行走等现实世界机器人动作时展现出了极高的灵活性与表现力。在真实 Unitree G1 机器人上的物理实验表明，该系统能够成功执行持续时间达 16.8 秒的单项舞蹈、格斗与行走动作，以及长达 35 秒的“格斗转舞蹈”等高难度连贯切换序列，充分证明了该框架在人形机器人复杂全身行为生成与长程控制方面的卓越实用价值。
While velocity-commanded RL policies are effective for controlling quadrupeds, they are a limited interface for humanoids that need to perform complex whole-body motions. Furthermore, RL tracking policies for whole-body motions typically have limited information about the desired future motion, preventing them from performing controlled deviations to achieve long-term task success; such information is particularly relevant when a controller must prepare for transitions between behaviors. We address these challenges using concise motion representations that can be generated by a high-level controller, given a behavior label or text command. These representations can be fed directly into a tracking policy to provide a detailed motion reference. Our method exhibits a high degree of flexibility in performing real-world robot motions such as dancing, fighting, or walking based on conditional information.
