At matched capacity, our adopted stochastic motion tokenizer reconstructs motions from the Unitree G1 at a level that exceeds state-of-the-art approaches such as finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and the vector-quantized autoencoder (VQ-VAE). The resulting discrete interface conditions whole-body tracking policies that execute generated dance, fight, and walk motions lasting 16.8 s each and a 35 s fight-to-dance sequence on a physical Unitree G1.
Fast Motion Retargeting Pipeline for Scalable Humanoid Robot Learning
面向可扩展人形机器人学习的快速运动重定向流程
尽管大规模人体动作捕捉数据集为人形机器人学习提供了丰富的示范资源，但如何将多样化的动作高效重定向（retargeting）至不同的人形机器人仍然是一个非同寻常的挑战。现有的运动动力学轨迹优化流水线往往计算成本高昂，且针对每个动作通常都需要繁琐的手动调整，难以满足大规模、高效率的具身智能数据处理需求。
为此，本文推出了 FRDV（Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation，基于动力学验证的快速重定向） 框架，包含高效的约束运动学重定向与附加的动力学验证流水线。其运动学阶段创新性地集成了定制的序列二次规划（SQP）求解器、实时迭代（RTI）以及并行分块处理技术，最高可达每秒 9,156 帧的处理速度，比 GMR 和 ProtoMotions 快约 136 倍，同时将机器人特异性约束融入优化中以减少地面穿透和自碰撞等常见重定向伪影；对于需要额外验证的动作，系统采用接触隐式 iLQR 控制器在完整刚体动力学下测试重定向参考，从而精准识别动态不可行运动并修正足底悬空与滑移等接触相关伪影。
研究团队通过使用几种先进流水线训练动作跟踪强化学习策略，对重定向质量进行了深入评估，重点对比了它们的跟踪保真度与成功率。实验结果充分证明，FRDV 不仅在计算效率上实现了数量级的突破，还能确保重定向动作在物理真实性与轨迹跟踪性能上的卓越表现，为大规模人形机器人运动技能的高效学习与真机部署奠定了坚实的技术基石。
While large-scale human motion capture datasets provide a rich source of demonstrations for humanoid robot learning, retargeting the diverse motions to different humanoid robots remains a nontrivial challenge. Existing kinodynamic trajectory optimization pipelines are computationally expensive and often require manual adjustments per motion. We present FRDV (Fast Retargeting with Dynamics Validation), a scalable framework consisting of rapid constrained kinematic retargeting and an additional dynamics validation pipeline. Its kinematic stage integrates a custom Sequential Quadratic Programming solver, Real-Time Iteration, and parallel chunk-based processing, achieving up to 9,156 frames per second, approximately up to 136 times faster than GMR and ProtoMotions, while robot-specific constraints are incorporated into the optimization to reduce common retargeting artifacts, such as ground penetration and self-collision. For motions requiring additional verification, a contact implicit iLQR controller is utilized to test the retargeted reference under full rigid body dynamics. This dynamics-based validation identifies dynamically infeasible motions and refines contact-related artifacts such as foot floating and foot skating. We evaluate retargeting quality by training motion tracking reinforcement learning policies using several state-of-the-art pipelines and comparing their tracking fidelity and success rates.
Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
全身人形机器人控制中末端执行器的精确 SE(3) 跟踪
在人形机器人进行全身运动时，由于浮动基座振荡、重力、动态耦合以及运动引起的干扰，实现高精度的末端执行器（end-effector）轨迹跟踪一直是一项极具挑战性的任务。传统的控制方法往往难以在复杂的移动操作中平衡姿态稳定性与末端追踪精度，如何在动态干扰下实现鲁棒且精准的 $SE(3)$ 任务空间控制成为了具身操作领域的关键瓶颈。
为此，本文提出了 ResGAC 框架——一个将几何导纳控制（Geometric Admittance Control, GAC）与残余强化学习（residual reinforcement learning）有机结合的全身人形机器人控制器。其中，GAC 利用左不变几何公式提供结构化的 $SE(3)$ 任务空间反馈并生成标称手臂关节位置目标，同时创新性地引入了地面附着航向坐标系（ground-attached heading frame），在保持平面运动的同时移除了骨盆的横滚、俯仰和起伏运动，从而显著减少了运动过程中由参考系引起的末端误差；而残余强化学习则用于补偿未建模的动力学，并在共享的关节位置动作空间中协同处理运动与平衡。
在真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实验验证表明，ResGAC 在各项性能指标上均显著优于 SONIC 等代表性基线。在站立末端追踪基准测试中，ResGAC 实现了更低的平移与旋转误差；在极具挑战性的站立插孔（peg-in-hole）任务中，其成功率高达 90%（相比之下 SONIC 仅为 50%），并在下肢运动过程中实现了高精度的世界坐标系 $SE(3)$ 末端姿态跟踪，充分展现了其在复杂动态具身交互中的卓越实用价值。
Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves 90% success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with 50% for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion.
TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
TRACE：面向人形机器人不同形态的神经全身控制高效迁移学习
人形机器人行为基础模型（BFMs）虽然能够实现多样化的全身控制，但由于不同机器人本体之间存在显著的运动学与动力学不匹配，如何将预训练控制器高效适配至新本体仍然是一个极具挑战性的难题。传统的从头训练或直接微调方法往往计算成本高昂，且难以在跨形态迁移中有效保持原有的预训练运动表征与控制稳定性。
为此，本文提出了 TRACE 框架，旨在实现高效的跨形态人形机器人适应，在保留预训练运动表征的同时专门针对目标本体优化反馈控制。该框架首先将运动学先验注入输入与输出投影层并对齐标称关节动力学，从而有效减少本体不匹配并支持稳定微调；随后，通过将编码器蒸馏与低秩强化学习（low-rank RL）相结合，在紧凑、经过质量筛选的运动集上，利用两阶段课程（two-phase curriculum）在精细化微调困难动作之前率先建立起稳固的跟踪能力。
研究团队将 TRACE 应用于将 SONIC 从 Unitree G1 成功迁移至 Unitree H2，仅消耗了约 1000 万帧运动数据和单张 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 约 8 小时的训练时间，其计算成本不到从头训练 SONIC 的 0.1%。适应后的控制器在 67,953 个评估动作下取得了 96.08% 的高成功率，真实机器人演示亦成功涵盖了动态动作跟踪与全身遥操作，充分证明了该框架在跨不同身体尺度与动力学特性的机器人之间高效复用预训练控制器的巨大潜力。
Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target this http URL first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.
Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
基于人类数据，让主力型人形机器人习得稳健的全身移动与操作能力
尽管人形机器人在利用第一人称视角 RGB 图像与本体感受规划丰富接触的全身操作方面仍面临诸多挑战，但如何摆脱对昂贵机器人本体示范的依赖始终是具身智能领域的核心诉求。为此，本文推出了 Workhorse 框架，旨在直接从无需机器人的纯人类示范（robot-free human demonstrations）中高效学习复杂的接触密集型全身操作。
该系统核心创新在于解耦并协同了一个视觉规划器与一个强化学习（RL）全身跟踪器：其中，视觉规划器负责从机载观测中预测包含躯干、双腕和双足在内的五连杆目标位姿，而强化学习跟踪器则在机器人上精准跟踪这些目标；两项策略均基于相同的记录人类姿态独立训练，且完全无需复杂的重定向步骤。为了弥合仿真与现实的差距，该框架创新性地对各自的训练数据进行了增强，使其能够有效模拟并适应对方在实际部署中产生的误差。
在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上，Workhorse 成功执行了一系列极具挑战性的动态任务，包括用双手和踢击分拣箱子、接住抛掷而来的箱子、推倒并攀爬手提箱，并在遭遇人为推搡或物品被夺走时展现出稳健的恢复能力。在模拟环境中，该系统在箱子分拣任务中达到了 77% 的成功率（在 40 N·s 的强推搡下仍保持 64%），而通过对同一示范进行重新训练的第二个模拟人形机器人更是取得了 83% 的无推搡成功率，充分验证了该方法在跨形态泛化与鲁棒控制方面的卓越性能。
Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N·s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.
HuMiT: Low-Latency Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation via Compact Reference Tracking
HuMiT：基于紧凑参考轨迹跟踪的低延迟全身人形机器人遥操作
实时人形机器人全身遥操作面临着重大挑战，其主要瓶颈在于基于优化的重定向流水线（optimization-based retargeting）以及未来帧条件化（future-frame conditioning）所带来的高计算延迟。现有的运动跟踪策略通常依赖于密集的参考目标，包括全关节位置、多身体部位变换甚至未来帧信息，这种强耦合性使得底层控制器过度依赖高昂的上游处理模块，严重限制了系统对动态环境的实时反应速度。
为了解决上述延迟与解耦难题，本文提出了 HuMiT 框架——一个基于统一跟踪策略的高效全身遥操作系统。该系统的核心创新在于仅需要极度紧凑的参考目标（包含根节点高度、根节点速度以及当前帧四个稀疏关键点的 $SE(3)$ 位姿），便能在保持低延迟的同时，实现与依赖完整关节位置、密集身体变换乃至未来帧等复杂参考状态的高精尖方法相媲美的跟踪保真度。通过从在线循环中完全剔除在线重定向优化与未来帧预测，HuMiT 显著简化了遥操作信息流。
实验结果表明，从 VR 头显数据流传输到策略输出，HuMiT 实现了仅约 20 毫秒的通信与推理延迟，并在多种运动类型下达到了 65 毫秒（中位数）的基于视频的光流延迟。在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的部署验证显示，该系统具备极快的亚秒级反应能力（如精准接住抛出的皮球），并能在复杂的移动操作（loco-manipulation）任务中展现出卓越的全身协同控制性能。
Real-time whole-body humanoid teleoperation remains challenging due to the computational latency introduced by optimization-based retargeting pipelines and future-frame conditioning. Existing motion tracking policies typically require dense reference targets including full joint positions, body-part transformations, and even future frames, which tightly couples the controller to expensive upstream modules. In this work, we present HuMiT, a whole-body teleoperation system built on a unified tracking policy that requires only a compact reference target, consisting of root height, root velocity, and the SE(3) poses of four sparse keypoints at the current frame, yet achieves competitive tracking fidelity compared to methods relying on more diverse reference states including complete joint positions, dense body-part transformations, and even future frames. Experiments show that our policy achieves a communication-to-inference latency of ∼20 ms measured between headset streaming and policy output and a video-based optical flow latency of 65 ms (median) across different motion types. We validate the system on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showcasing split-second reactive responses such as catching a tossed ball, as well as coordinated loco-manipulation capabilities.
Watch Your Step: Anticipated Perception for Humanoid Locomotion
留意脚下：面向人形机器人运动的预期感知
传统基于视觉感知的具身机器人运动策略通常依赖于密集的机器人中心高程图输入，然而在实际控制决策中，真正起决定性作用的往往仅限于即将落脚点下方及周边的局部地形。复杂的全局高程图不仅会拖慢强化学习的训练进程，在缺乏高昂的注意力机制时更会严重限制模型对新地形的泛化能力；为了克服这种由视觉信息冗余带来的效率瓶颈，如何精准剥离无关地形干扰成为了提升感知运动策略的关键挑战。
为此，本文提出了一种新颖的轻量级高程图预处理与落脚点引导框架。该方法的核心在于引入了一个独立的轻量级落脚点预测模型（FPM），仅凭本体感受与速度指令便能超前预测未来的落脚位置，并据此仅在预测落脚点周围的小型局部区域内采样高程图；同时，该预测模型与运动策略进行联合训练，并随着机器人步态的成熟周期性地利用新策略的 rollout 数据进行微调，从而使感知模块能够主动前瞻策略的运动意图，引导策略高效聚焦于关键的局部地形信息。
在训练效率与泛化性能方面，实验结果表明，借助这种轻量级预处理机制，策略达到指定地形难度所需的训练迭代次数锐减至完整高程图的三分之一。在狭窄走廊等稀疏落脚点场景及未见地形中，该方法显著超越了全图观测基线，其性能甚至能够媲美计算成本高出数倍的注意力编码器；而在真实世界部署中，该策略成功实现了向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的零样本迁移，在室内外复杂环境中稳健穿行各种障碍、楼梯、沟壑与台阶，充分证明了其在具身智能全地形适应中的卓越实用价值。
Perceptive locomotion policies typically observe a dense robot-centric elevation map, although only the terrain beneath and around the next footsteps informs the control decision. Learned encoders compress the whole visual input, leaving the policy to work out which inputs matter while learning the baseline locomotion task. Learning both at once slows training and, without computationally expensive attention mechanisms, makes generalization to new terrain harder. We instead remove redundant inputs from the elevation map before the policy sees it. A lightweight foothold prediction model (FPM) predicts future footholds from proprioception and the velocity command alone, and we sample the elevation map only in small patches around these predicted footholds. We train the prediction model alongside the locomotion policy, periodically retraining it on new policy rollouts as the robot's gait matures. This allows the perception to anticipate where the policy will step, while the policy learns to leverage terrain information around those steps. With the proposed lightweight preprocessing, the policy reaches a given terrain difficulty in roughly a third of the training iterations required with the complete map. It outperforms policies that observe the complete map where footholds are sparse, including in narrow walled corridors, and on unseen terrain, and it matches an attention-based encoder trained at several times the cost. The policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 humanoid traversing various obstacles, stairs, gaps, and step-downs beyond the training distribution in both indoor and outdoor environments.
SMR: Learning streaming motion retargeting for humanoids from human semantic
SMR：从人类语义中学习人形机器人的流式运动重定向
将人类动作高效重定向至人形机器人，既需要完整保留动作的语义特征，又必须严格满足机器人的物理约束。传统的运动学流水线仅通过几何匹配来规划机器人轨迹，难以确保其在真实动力学下的可执行性；而先前的物理监督神经方法则往往依赖于预先确定的运动学解以及非因果的全序列上下文，在实时流式传输与动态适应性方面受到严重制约，突显了开发兼具因果性与物理真实性的流式重定向机制的迫切需求。
为此，本文提出了 SMR（Streaming Neural Motion Retargeter，流式神经动作重定向器） 框架，通过从语义条件化的物理专家（semantic-conditioned physics experts）中学习来实现高效的流式运动转换。该方法首先将人类动作转化为机器人感知的任务空间目标（涵盖身体标志点的位置、方向与速度），随后由物理专家在包含接触、动力学与执行器约束的仿真环境中直接跟踪这些目标；在此基础上，系统训练了一个严格因果关系的 Transformer 模型，使其能够仅利用当前及过去的人类观测数据，为下游全身控制器生成高保真的机器人运动参考。
实验结果表明，语义条件化的物理专家相较于传统的直接基于优化的重定向方法，能够生成具有更高语义保真度与物理有效性的动作；而经其训练出的流式重定向器在统一的全身控制器下，展现出超越传统运动学及物理精炼基线的闭环性能，为大规模、实时的异构动作重定向与具身智能学习开辟了全新的技术路径。
Retargeting human motion to humanoids requires preserving motion semantics while accounting for the robot's physical constraints. Kinematic pipelines prescribe a robot trajectory through geometric matching, without establishing whether it can be executed under the robot's dynamics. Prior physics-supervised neural methods train bidirectional full-sequence models on physics-refined kinematic trajectories, remaining tied to prescribed kinematic solutions and requiring noncausal context. We propose SMR, a streaming neural motion retargeter learned from semantic-conditioned physics experts. We convert human motion into robot-aware task-space targets for body landmark positions, orientations, and velocities. Physics experts track these targets directly in simulation under contact, dynamics, and actuator constraints. We train a single strictly causal Transformer on their executed state trajectories that complete the motion and pass semantic and physical validity checks. At each incoming frame, the student uses only current and past human observations to generate a robot motion reference for a downstream whole-body controller. Experiments demonstrate that semantic-conditioned physics experts generate motion with higher semantic fidelity and physical validity than direct optimization-based retargeting, while the resulting streaming retargeter achieves improved closed-loop performance over kinematic and physics-refined baselines under a common whole-body controller.
Whole-Body Dexterity
全身灵巧性
目前人形机器人的灵巧操作大多局限于末端执行器和简单的抓取动作，难以实现人类那样利用手臂、躯干等全身各部位对笨重物体进行支撑、滑动和挤压的高级交互能力。传统的控制方法在面对需要全身协同的复杂操纵时显得捉襟见肘，如何在保持稳定平衡的同时将整个身体作为接触面进行物体操控，成为了人形机器人具身智能领域亟待攻克的核心挑战。
为此，本文提出了 WBD（Whole-Body Dexterity，全方位灵巧操作） 框架，旨在利用机器人的身体和附属肢体作为接触面来抓取和操纵物体。该研究设计了一套高效的仿真到真实世界（sim-to-real）流水线：首先生成可行全身体抓取的丰富数据集，随后针对通用的任意到任意（any-to-any）重定位目标训练强化学习专家策略，并最终通过蒸馏将其转化为一个仅依赖本体感受与物体几何特征的统一策略，支持由人类遥操作员通过粗糙动作参考进行交互式实时引导。
在真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的广泛评估表明，该蒸馏策略能够实现出色的零样本迁移，不仅能够将篮球和纸箱稳健地重定位至躯干周围区域，还能顺利完成从货架取箱、夹在手臂下搬运到桌子放置的长周期复杂任务。在各项真实世界的全方位操纵基准测试中，该控制器取得了高达 90% 的成功率，远超直接重定向方法（18%）与通用全身控制器（4%），充分彰显了其在复杂动态具身交互中的卓越性能。
Current humanoid dexterous manipulation remains largely confined to end-effectors and simple grasps, falling short of humans' ability to engage the entire body by bracing and sliding bulky objects against the arms and torso. We introduce Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a general framework that uses the robot's body and appendages as contact surfaces to grasp and manipulate objects. Our sim-to-real pipeline first generates a dataset of feasible whole-body grasps, then trains reinforcement-learning experts on a general any-to-any repositioning objective by sampling initial and goal grasps from the dataset, and distills these experts into a single policy that uses proprioception and object geometry. We show that the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Unitree G1, where it repositions a basketball and a cardboard box to regions around the torso and completes a long-horizon task that stows a box under one arm, carries it from a shelf to a table, and places it. The controller operates interactively, steered by coarse motion references from a human teleoperator. Across real-world whole-body manipulation tasks, the distilled controller completes 90% of trials, compared with 18% for direct retargeting and 4% for a generalist whole-body controller.
Compositional Humanoid Manipulation through Isomorphic Teleoperation and Independent Skill Routing
通过同构遥操作与独立技能路由实现组合式人形机器人操作
人形机器人精细操作亟需具备高度可复用的手臂技能，然而穷举演示所有可能的技能组合在实际应用中极不现实。传统的端到端遥操作与单一策略往往难以平衡多臂协同与技能泛化，如何在保持独立手臂控制精度的同时实现模块化技能的灵活组合，成为了提升人形机器人具身智能通用性的核心痛点。
为此，本文提出了 HS-MoDP（Humanoid Semantic Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy，人形语义专家混合扩散策略） 框架，通过在共享专家池上进行独立的语义路由来组合单独演示的手臂技能，并配合语义调度器通过交替的操纵与重定位阶段将学习策略与底层运动控制器无缝集成，从而有效扩展了机器人的有效工作空间并支持跨位置的技能复用。同时，为了突破接触密集型操作的数据瓶颈，研究团队开发了 G1Exo——一种专为 Unitree G1 设计的同构外骨骼，能够提供直接的关节级手臂配置控制，获取高质量、高可靠性的接触操纵示范数据。
在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上的实验表明，相较于传统基线，HS-MoDP 展现出更强大的多技能组合与泛化能力；而采用 G1Exo 收集的示范数据在四种策略架构中均显著提升了接触技能的学习效果，在完整的橱柜工作流任务中将成功率从 35% 大幅提升至 65%，充分证明了同构外骨骼硬件与语义专家混合策略在复杂具身操作中的突破性价值。
Humanoid manipulation requires reusable arm skills, yet demonstrating every possible skill combination is impractical. We present Humanoid Semantic Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Policy (HS-MoDP), which composes separately demonstrated arm skills through independent semantic routing over a shared expert pool. This design preserves arm-specific skill control while sharing action-generation parameters across arms. A semantic scheduler integrates the learned policy with an existing locomotion controller through alternating manipulation and repositioning stages, extending the effective workspace and enabling skill reuse across location changes. To acquire demonstrations of whole-body contact manipulation, we develop G1Exo, an isomorphic exoskeleton that provides direct joint-level control of arm configurations. Experiments on a Unitree G1 show stronger skill composition than the baselines. G1Exo enables more reliable contact teleoperation than end-effector VR-IK, and its demonstrations improve contact-skill learning across four policy architectures. For HS-MoDP, switching from VR-IK to G1Exo demonstrations raises full cabinet workflow success from 35% to 65%. All project hardware designs and source code will be released as open source after the review process.
λ0: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
λ0：为人形机器人移动-操作任务扩展开放世界以人为中心的数据
人形机器人的全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）需要与物理世界进行高度协调的全身交互，然而大规模收集真实机器人示范的高昂成本严重制约了具身智能的发展；尽管人类示范提供了更具可扩展性的替代方案，但现有的第一人称人类监督往往缺失全身移动与姿态信息，且由于显著的本体形态与控制器动力学差异，极易导致末端执行器在实际部署中的执行精度严重受损。
为此，本文推出了 HumanVerse——一个包含 500 小时开放世界人类全身移动操作的大规模数据集，通过同步的第一人称视频与全身、手部运动数据，结合创新的人形转换流水线，在离线状态下实现相机视角对齐、手臂外观匹配以及运动参考与控制器输入的精确精炼，在最大限度保留全身协调性的同时有效减少了末端误差，并成功支持了向 Unitree G1 机器人的零样本迁移。
在此数据流水线的基础上，研究团队进一步开发了专为全身移动操作设计的人形机器人基础模型 $\lambda_0$，通过利用机器人对齐的人类示范进行中期训练监督，有效证实了大规模全身人类数据对提升下游任务进展的显著促进作用；实验表明，$\lambda_0$ 在 SIMPLE 基准上取得了 90.0% 的成功率，并在复杂的真实世界全身移动操作任务中达到了 62.5% 的成功率，为构建具备丰富物理交互能力的人形机器人基础模型开辟了极具前景的可扩展路径。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop λ0, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. λ0 achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world.
Test-Time Motion Steering for Perceptive Humanoid Fall Recovery
面向感知型人形机器人跌倒恢复的测试时运动引导
人形机器人在跌倒后恢复站立时，往往需要根据周围环境与具体任务选择合适的起身动作，因为相同的倒地姿势往往对应着多种不同的起身路径、支撑转换以及最终朝向。然而，传统的可靠恢复方法往往缺乏在推理时灵活控制机器人执行特定起身选项的能力，如何在充分预判物理后果的前提下实现任务导向的起身策略转向，成为了具身智能领域亟待突破的关键难题。
为此，本文提出了 RISE 框架——一种感知型人形机器人起身恢复方法，能够在推理阶段利用任务目标动态引导机器人以期望的方式恢复站立。该方法的核心建立在两大关键洞察之上：多样化的起身动作可以由共享的底层运动组合而成，且预判这些运动的演变过程能够实现朝向、速度与路径的精准控制；系统首先学习了一个将意图运动与感觉反馈通过电机动作相连的起身动作词汇表，并利用视觉扩散规划器从该词汇表的执行轨迹中学习预测未来身体状态的运动意图，借助任务成本函数引导预测朝向指定的目标，从而生成条件化的运动潜变量以塑造动作执行。
仿真实验充分验证了 RISE 框架在实现多样化起身、复杂地形适应以及无需重新训练的测试时转向方面的卓越性能，并通过在真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的成功部署，展示了其在开放现实环境中的强大陆基恢复能力与鲁棒性，为人形机器人在遭遇跌倒等突发状况时的自主安全作业提供了重要的技术支撑。
Humanoid fall recovery requires selecting a motion that suits both the surrounding scene and the task. The same fallen pose can admit several ways to stand, with different routes, support transitions, and final headings. Yet reliable recovery alone does not provide control over which of these alternatives the robot executes. Steering this choice requires anticipating the physical consequences of a requested movement. We present RISE, an approach to perceptive humanoid recovery that lets task objectives steer how the robot returns to standing at inference time. It builds on two insights: diverse recoveries can be composed from shared movements, and anticipating how these movements unfold allows recovery to be steered toward a task objective. We learn a recovery vocabulary that connects intended movements to motor actions through sensory feedback. A visual diffusion planner learns from executions of this vocabulary to predict motion intent as future body states. Task costs guide this prediction toward a desired heading, rise speed, or path. The planner then generates motion latents conditioned on the steered intent, allowing the requested movement to shape its execution. Simulation experiments demonstrate diverse recoveries, terrain adaptation, and test-time steering without retraining, complemented by real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1.
Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
利用扩散模型对人形机器人策略的神经权重进行建模与理解
随着机器人学习技术的迅速发展，人形机器人的控制性能取得了飞跃式的突破，能够在真实世界中展现出日益敏捷的动态行为。然而，传统的机器人控制网络通常完全依赖于标准的强化学习或模仿训练流程，学术界与工业界对于直接对其所学权重的分布进行建模、并在权重空间（weight space）中生成功能性控制网络的研究却鲜有涉足，这使得解析网络内部机理与突破端到端训练框架成为了具身智能领域的前沿探究方向。
为此，本文开展了一项开拓性研究，探索能否通过直接对权重进行生成式建模来获得高性能的人形机器人控制网络。该研究采用了一个将线性自编码器（Linear Autoencoder）与扩散 Transformer（Diffusion Transformer）相结合的隐扩散框架：自编码器首先将行动者网络（actor network）的参数压缩至紧凑的潜在空间，再由扩散 Transformer 学习并建模这些潜变量的概率分布。在利用从 Unitree G1 人形机器人强化学习训练中采集的大量网络权重进行训练后，该框架成功在权重空间中生成了可直接部署的控制网络，并在真实机器人上稳健完成了包括行走、舞蹈以及高难度的旋风踢（spin kick）在内的多种复杂运动。
除了权重生成之外，研究团队还深入探究了所学的权重空间，以揭示人形机器人控制网络内部编码的深层结构。研究发现，网络第一层的权重呈现出一种高度一致的结构化规律，极其明确地反映了机器人的运动学先验（kinematic prior）；令人瞩目的是，这种运动学先验在强化学习（RL）和模仿学习（IL）两种截然不同的训练范式下均会自发涌现，表明其并非特定优化过程的产物，而是与人形机器人本体高度相关的通用具身知识。这些结果不仅证明了在人形机器人网络权重空间中进行生成式建模的可行性，也为理解和解释具身控制网络内部表征提供了极其珍贵的物理与理论视角。
Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights.
PriMoRetarget: Humanoid Motion Transfer Through Prioritized Motion Retargeting
PriMoRetarget：通过优先级动作重定向实现人形动作迁移
动作重定向是将人类动作数据迁移至人形机器人的关键预处理步骤。然而，尽管现有方法对于单角色动作表现优异，但涉及多角色与物体的复杂交互时，会引入大量必须严格保持的额外接触和空间关系；传统的重定向通常被表述为一个加权多目标优化问题，其中相互冲突的目标往往需要极其繁琐的手动相对权重调整，且依然容易损害关键的动作特征。
为此，本文推出了 PriMoRetarget 框架——一个用显式优先级层次结构（explicit priority hierarchy）彻底取代传统相对目标加权的优先化动作重定向框架。该方法的核心在于通过数学约束限制低优先级的更新，从而确保高优先级目标不受干扰，使足底放置、关键接触以及任务相关的空间关系能够凌驾于低优先级姿态目标之上，从根本上保障了复杂交互动作的几何与物理合理性。
该方法在涵盖单角色运动、角色-物体操纵以及角色-角色交互的四个综合数据集上进行了严格评估。实验结果表明，由 PriMoRetarget 生成的重定向动作能够更完美地保持任务相关的交互特征，并为下游控制器提供比传统方法更稳定、更易跟踪的高质量参考轨迹，为多主体、强接触场景下的具身智能数据处理提供了强大的技术支撑。
Motion retargeting is a critical preprocessing step for transferring human motion data to humanoid robots. While existing methods are effective for single-character motions, interactions involving multiple characters and objects introduce additional contacts and spatial relationships that must be preserved. Retargeting is commonly formulated as a weighted multi-objective optimization problem, where conflicting objectives can require careful tuning of relative weights and can still compromise important motion characteristics. We introduce PriMoRetarget, a prioritized motion-retargeting framework that replaces relative objective weighting with an explicit priority hierarchy. Lower-priority updates are constrained to preserve higher-priority objectives, allowing critical characteristics such as foot placement and interaction contacts to take precedence over lower-priority pose objectives. The method is evaluated on four datasets spanning single-character motion, character-object manipulation, and character-character interactions. The resulting motions better preserve task-relevant interactions and provide reference trajectories that can be tracked more reliably than those produced by widely used retargeting methods.
SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
SuperMimic：利用单一可微世界模型扩展人形机器人全身控制
追踪大规模人类动作数据集已成为实现通用、富有表现力的人形机器人全身控制的主流路径，然而跨海量动作进行策略扩展往往面临着极其高昂的计算成本。传统的无模型强化学习方法要么通过有损蒸馏合并单一动作的专家模型，要么依赖集群级算力对单一策略进行暴力训练，这使得计算瓶颈严重制约了人形机器人运动控制向更大规模演进的可能性。
为此，本文推出了 SuperMimic 框架，通过引入一个基于标准刚体仿真器记录轨迹拟合而成的共享动力学可微分世界模型，在所有动作之间平摊学习成本。该世界模型与运动跟踪策略在统一循环中进行联合训练，并通过在简短的想象模拟轨迹上进行随时间反向传播（BPTT）为策略提供解析梯度，凭借高效的想象模拟与解析梯度大幅提升了策略学习的整体效率。
实验结果表明，SuperMimic 仅需单张 GPU 训练 3 小时，便超越了在 128 张 GPU 上训练 7 天的先进动作跟踪基线，将 GPU 小时数降低了 1000 倍以上，并在 129,514 个基准动作中仅出现 25 次失败（基线为 179 次），在双 GPU 训练 9.8 小时后更是实现了零失败。该策略成功实现了向物理 Unitree G1 机器人的稳健迁移，能够精准执行多样且高难度的杂技动作，彻底移除了阻碍人形机器人全身控制规模化扩展的算力瓶颈。
Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than 1000× and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.
HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
HumanoidNDM：通过人形神经动力学模型弥合运动追踪在训练与部署之间的差距
近年来，人形机器人在运动跟踪领域取得了显著成功。然而，在真实世界的部署中，机器人不可避免地会遭遇由附加物理扰动或不准确的仿真建模所引起的动力学鸿沟，从而导致显著的训练-部署差距。因此，有效利用真实世界数据来微调策略构成了实现鲁棒部署至关重要的“最后一公里”。
为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 HumanoidNDM，一个由在真实世界中训练的神经动力学模型驱动的人形机器人运动跟踪在线微调框架。首先，在数据收集阶段，我们引入了一种具有自适应强度机制的低频参考扰动方法，从而在部署可行性与探索效率之间取得了平衡；其次，在模型训练阶段，通过结合可微正向运动学，我们在欧几里得空间中训练了一个基于历史信息、且具备本体感受的鲁棒神经动力学模型，彻底摆脱了对高昂动捕系统的依赖；最后，在策略微调阶段，我们直接通过反向传播模型梯度来微调策略，从而实现了极高的数据利用效率。
通过在宇树 G1 机器人上的物理验证，我们证明了 HumanoidNDM 能够实现对各种扰动的快速现实世界适应，标志着首个针对人形机器人跟踪策略的在线、无动捕微调框架。
Humanoid robots have recently achieved remarkable success in motion tracking. However, during real-world deployment, robots inevitably encounter dynamics gaps arising from either extra physical disturbances or inaccurate simulation modeling, resulting in a significant training-deployment gap. Therefore, effectively leveraging real-world data to fine-tune policies represents the crucial last mile for robust deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose HumanoidNDM, an online fine-tuning framework for humanoid motion tracking driven by a real-world-trained neural dynamics model. First, in the data collection stage, we introduce a low-frequency reference perturbation method with an adaptive intensity mechanism, balancing deployment feasibility and exploration efficiency. Second, for the model training stage, we train a robust history-based, proprioceptive neural dynamics model in Euclidean space by incorporating differentiable forward kinematics, eliminating the reliance on costly motion capture systems. Finally, in the policy fine-tuning stage, we directly fine-tune the policy via backpropagated model gradients, achieving high data efficiency. Through physical validation on the Unitree G1 robot, we demonstrate that HumanoidNDM enables rapid real-world adaptation to various perturbations, representing the first online, MoCap-free fine-tuning framework for humanoid tracking policies.
SWAP: Test-Time Steerable Humanoid Whole-Body Collision Avoidance
SWAP：测试阶段可引导的人形机器人全身避障
运行于人居环境中的人形机器人必须协调全身，在保持平衡的同时穿梭于狭窄、杂乱的空间。现有方法往往难以从高维感知输入中联合考量动态稳定性与避障。此外，对于人形机器人而言，安全行为本质上具有多模态特性：面对同一障碍物，往往存在多种有效的通过方式，这使得单一的确定性策略极难对其进行有效表征。
为应对上述挑战，本文提出了 SWAP（Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy，可控全身避障策略），这是一个将具备碰撞感知能力的决策过程与稳定控制相解耦的分层框架。其中，高层采用受感知条件约束的扩散策略（diffusion policy）来生成多模态、具备避障意识的运动提议（motion proposals），底层则通过全身强化学习（RL）控制器来追踪这些提议并维持动态平衡。
为了高效训练高层策略，我们通过后见标记（hindsight labeling）获取了可扩展的监督信号：我们在随机指令下展开低层策略，仅在各次执行运动未曾扫过的空间中放置障碍物，从而在结构上保证运动的无碰撞性，并重新渲染机器人在该场景下所观察到的感知画面。在部署阶段，利用简单的代价信号进行蒙特卡罗采样（Monte Carlo sampling），能够引导扩散模型生成安全且贴合任务的行为，而无需进行繁重的奖励调优。
Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning.
Zero-HLM: Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation without Real Robot Data
Zero-HLM：无需真实机器人数据的通用型人形机器人移动操作
学习具备泛化能力的全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）策略，目前仍受限于高昂的真实世界示范数据成本。仿真虽提供了一种具备可扩展性的替代方案，但需要具备高度视觉逼真度、可直接用于物理模拟的场景，以及可执行的全身运动轨迹。为此，我们提出了 Zero-HLM，这是一个“真实-仿真-真实”（real-to-sim-to-real）框架，能够将智能手机拍摄的图像与仿真源示范转化为用于人形机器人全身操纵与移动的可扩展训练数据。
在该框架中，高斯引导的智能体化（agentic）真实-仿真重建实现了视觉场景与物理场景的对齐；运动-环境协同适应（motion-environment co-adaptation）则利用运行展开反馈（rollout feedback）修正全身参考动作与交互几何结构。我们生成了 4,800 条经过物理验证的示范数据，并在宇树 Unitree G1 的三项任务中实现了零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）。
实验表明，在仿真数据上训练的 GR00T N1.7 模型取得了 66.7% 的全任务平均成功率，相比之下，基于真实数据训练的模型成功率为 46.7%。在泛化配置下，扩展后的仿真训练将集合成功率（pooled success）从基于真实数据基础训练策略的 23% 提升至 69%，且期间未添加任何额外的真实示范数据。
Learning generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation remains bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but requires visually faithful, physics-ready scenes and executable whole-body motions. We present Zero-HLM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms smartphone captures and simulated source demonstrations into scalable training data for humanoid loco-manipulation. Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim reconstruction aligns visual and physical scenes; motion-environment co-adaptation uses rollout feedback to correct whole-body references and interaction geometry. We generate 4,800 physically validated demonstrations for zero-shot transfer across three Unitree G1 tasks. Simulation-trained GR00T N1.7 achieves 66.7% mean full-task success, versus 46.7% with real-data training. On generalized configurations, expanded simulation training raises pooled success from 23% for base-trained real-data policies to 69%, without additional real demonstrations.
PanTact: Teaching Whole-Body Dexterity with a Wearable Contact Interface
PanTact：通过可穿戴接触式界面实现全身灵巧性教学
人形机器人拥有众多自由度与接触表面，然而现有的全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）研究大多将操纵局限于双手的运用，并尽量避免身体其他部位与环境发生接触。为了将操纵能力拓展至双手之外，本文提出了 PanTact——一个直接从脱离机器人的采集端（robot-free）的人类示范中学习人形机器人全身灵巧性（即利用任意适宜的身体表面进行操纵的能力）的系统。我们的核心思想是将“接触”作为跨实体（embodiment）迁移的、以操纵为中心的信息：接触位置与时序明确了完成任务所需的交互逻辑，而机器人则根据自身物理约束，自主选择如何协调全身以实现这些接触。
具体而言，PanTact 通过以下三方面捕获、学习并执行全身接触：1）数据采集接口：一种可穿戴且脱离机器人的数据采集接口，该接口在自我中心视觉（egocentric vision）与双手 UMI 夹爪的基础上，融入了模块化全身接触贴片，用于记录身体接触的位置与状态；2）视觉运动策略（visuomotor policy）：该策略有效弥合了自我中心视角下的观测差距，并可预测全身接触目标；3）接触感知全身控制方案：利用适宜的机器人身体表面来实现主动接触目标。
我们将 PanTact 部署于宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上（无需额外安装身体接触传感器），成功展示了包含身体支撑、推挤、扫拂以及载荷分担（load-sharing）在内的全身灵巧操纵能力。
Humanoid robots have many degrees of freedom and contact surfaces, yet most loco-manipulation research restricts manipulation to the hands and avoids other body contacts with the environment. To extend manipulation beyond the hands, we present PanTact, a system that learns humanoid whole-body dexterity, the capability to manipulate with any suitable body surface, directly from robot-free human demonstrations. Our key idea is to use contact as manipulation-centric information that transfers across embodiments. Contact locations and timing specify the interactions needed to accomplish a task, while the robot chooses how to coordinate its body to realize them within its own physical constraints. Specifically, PanTact captures, learns, and executes whole-body contact via: 1) a wearable, robot-free data collection interface that augments egocentric vision and bimanual UMI grippers with whole-body modular contact patches to record body contact locations and states; 2) a visuomotor policy that mitigates the egocentric observation gap and predicts whole-body contact goals; and 3) contact-aware whole-body control formulations that realize active contact goals using suitable robot surfaces. We deploy PanTact on a Unitree G1 humanoid without additional body contact sensors, demonstrating whole-body dexterity involving body support, pushing, sweeping, and load-sharing.
What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
高程图所无法洞察之处：面向人形机器人的语义感知运动与执行感知导航
导航对于人形机器人至关重要，然而由于成本和安全隐患，在物理硬件上进行大规模评估往往不可行，这使得仿真基准（benchmarks）显得尤为必要。现有的视觉语言导航（VLN）基准虽能实现物理上可执行的导航，但仍基于以下假设：（1）所有危险源均可通过高程图（elevation maps）进行观测；（2）实际执行的运动与预期运动高度一致。然而在真实环境中，倒下的瓶子在高程图中可能难以准确分辨，而手机与积水则难以有效区分；此外，足式运动控制策略（locomotion policy）采用的避险动作可能导致机器人实际运动轨迹偏离 VLN 策略预期的路径。这种指令与执行之间的不匹配会不断累积，从而导致机器人偏离目标位置。
为了揭示这些失效模式（failure modes），我们提出了一个综合考量高程微细危险源（elevation-subtle hazards）与执行偏差的基准，同时构建了一个闭环的“VLN + 运动控制”框架，用以持续将高层导航策略与机器人的实际状态进行实时对齐。我们在仿真环境中评估了导航性能，并在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进一步验证了运动控制策略。
实验结果表明，语义信息的输入有效减少了机器人与高程图中表征不良的危险源发生接触的概率，而抗偏差机制（anti-deviation）则提升了导航成功率。这些发现强调了在评估人形机器人导航能力时，联合考量路线完成度与危险源避让的必要性。
Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.
Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
Reflex：基于视觉感知的类人机器人反应式控制
人类能毫不费力地对周围世界做出反应：他们能娴熟地击回网球、接住掉落的杯子、避开经过的推车，或是接住卸货时掷出的箱子。这些日常动作要求机器人在大约一秒的极其短暂的时间内预测运动目标，并运用全身进行反射式响应。这种基于视觉的反射式全身控制（visual reactive whole-body control）对人形机器人而言仍极具挑战，机器人必须同时具备：（1）协调全身控制的能力；（2）实时响应物体动态的能力；（3）基于自我中心视觉（egocentric vision）建立感知锚定的能力。我们将“接住投掷出的箱子”作为同时兼具这三项核心能力的代表性任务展开研究；而现有系统仅能涵盖其中一部分，且大多依赖末端执行器（end-effectors）、动作捕捉系统（motion capture）或特定标记物体。
为此，我们提出了 Reflex 框架——这是一个三阶段框架，能够逐阶段学习上述能力，并通过紧凑的物体动态表征将它们有机连接。首先，基于状态的策略利用强化学习（RL）学习全身接物能力；其次，该策略学习从存在延迟与不完整观测的信息中推断运动箱子的物理动态；最后，自我中心 RGB-D 编码器在固定全身控制器的前提下，学习直接从视觉观测中恢复这种动态表征。这种解耦设计为各项能力提供了直接的训练信号，并大幅提升了视觉学习的可扩展性。
在仿真实验中，Reflex 基于自我中心 RGB-D 观测实现了 85.7% 的接物成功率，与获得特权箱子观测（privileged box observations）时的 87.9% 相当。时序视觉历史信息（temporal visual history）至关重要：将其移除后，在中心投掷和侧向偏置投掷下的成功率分别下降了 35.6 与 39.8 个百分点。在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，Reflex 在 2.5 米和 5 米距离下接住人类投掷箱子的成功率分别为 65% 和 40%，达到了相同距离下人类接球者成功率的 76% 与 59%。
Humans effortlessly react to the world; they adeptly return a tennis shot, catch a falling cup, step aside from a passing cart, or pass a box tossed during truck unloading. These everyday actions require anticipating a moving target and reflexively responding with the whole body within about a second. Such visual reactive whole-body control remains challenging for humanoids, which must (1) coordinate whole-body control, (2) react to object dynamics in real time, and (3) ground perception in egocentric vision. We study catching thrown boxes as a representative task that demands all three capabilities; existing systems cover only part of it, relying on end-effectors, motion capture, or marked objects. We present Reflex, a three-stage framework that learns these capabilities stage by stage while connecting them through a compact representation of object dynamics. First, a state-based policy learns whole-body catching with reinforcement learning. Second, the policy learns to infer the dynamics of a moving box from delayed and incomplete observations. Third, an egocentric RGB-D encoder learns to recover this dynamics representation directly from visual observations while keeping the whole-body controller fixed. This decomposition provides each capability with a direct training signal and makes visual learning substantially more scalable. In simulation, Reflex achieves 85.7% catch success from egocentric RGB-D, compared with 87.9% when given privileged box observations. Temporal visual history is critical: removing it reduces success by 35.6 and 39.8 points on centered and laterally offset throws. On a real Unitree G1, Reflex catches human-thrown boxes with 65% and 40% success at 2.5 and 5 m, reaching 76% and 59% of human catchers' success at the same distances.
Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
演示：基于视觉-语言模型引导的电磁数字孪生在线校准
电磁（EM）数字孪生能够为移动机器人提供无线态势感知能力，但该技术依赖于会随环境改变的材料导电率。在线校准面临着对初始化敏感以及测量移动成本高的双重挑战。为此，我们展示了一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的框架，该框架基于宇树 Unitree G1 机器人与 NVIDIA Sionna，包含两次 VLM 调用：材料分类模块通过 ITU-R P.2040 标准将可见材料映射为导电率先验信息，用于 Sionna 在累积接收信号强度（RSS）测量值上进行梯度下降；路径点规划模块则利用残差 RSS 校准误差和图像覆盖率，在线选择下一个测量位置。
在真实室内场景中，该框架在 20 米的移动距离内实现了 $1.74 \times 10^{-4}$ 的归一化平均绝对导电率误差；相比之下，随机初始化方法无法收敛，而随机路径点采样方法所需花费的移动距离超过其两倍。
An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of 1.74×10−4 within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.
PartiGen: Part-Aware Representations for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
PartiGen：面向语言条件的人形机器人动作生成的“部位感知”表征
将语言翻译为人形机器人运动，需要协调各个身体部位、确定运动时长，并生成适合机器人执行的参考轨迹。为此，我们提出了 PartiGen——一个局部感知（part-aware）的潜在扩散框架，它将解剖学结构融入共享的全运动表征中。局部特定的注意力机制负责处理经过解剖掩膜约束的帧特征，其输出经过融合以将局部肢体信息与全身上下文相结合。在文本和历史运动信息的条件约束下，该模型以自回归的方式生成运动原语（motion primitives）。前向运动学（FK）监督促进了运动学一致性，而可学习的序列结束预测器（end-of-sequence predictor）则在生成后选择帧级别的终点。
在重定向至宇树 Unitree G1 的 HumanML3D 数据集上，PartiGen 实现了 3.165 的片段级 FID，相比 TextOp 降低了 16.8%，并将 R@1 提高了 1.4 个百分点。在采用 16 帧原语的时长研究中，与固定长度截断策略相比，终点预测将平均绝对时长误差从 12.471 帧降低至 3.080 帧.
我们利用预训练且参数冻结的 GRIT 跟踪器进一步评估了机器人执行效果：在 MuJoCo 仿真中，500 个生成的参考轨迹中有 409 个（81.8%）通过了基于姿态的稳定性筛选。经过仿真筛选与人工挑选后，在真实 G1 人形机器人上尝试的 27 个运动中有 26 个被判定为成功执行。
Translating language into humanoid motion requires coordinating body parts, determining motion duration, and producing references suitable for robot execution. We introduce PartiGen, a part-aware latent diffusion framework that incorporates anatomical structure into a shared whole-body motion representation. Part-specific attention processes anatomically masked frame features, and its outputs are fused to combine local limb information with whole-body context. Conditioned on text and motion history, the model generates motion primitives autoregressively. Forward-kinematics supervision encourages kinematic consistency, while a learned end-of-sequence predictor selects a frame-level endpoint after generation. On HumanML3D retargeted to the Unitree G1, PartiGen achieves a segment-level FID of 3.165, a 16.8% reduction over TextOp, and improves R@1 by 1.4 percentage points. In the duration study with 16-frame primitives, endpoint prediction reduces mean absolute duration error from 12.471 to 3.080 frames compared with a fixed-length cutoff. We further evaluate robot execution using a pretrained, frozen GRIT tracker: 409 of 500 generated references (81.8%) pass the posture-based stability screen in MuJoCo. Following simulation screening and manual selection, 26 of 27 attempted motions are judged successful on the real G1.
CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
CSF：面向运动生成器的情境化安全过滤
文本条件运动生成器（text-conditioned motion generators）能够产生可追踪的全身运动，但它们缺乏对场景依赖性安全的认知：同一个动作既可能针对物体，也可能针对人类。现有的安全防护机制要么仅审查文本提示（prompt），要么需要经过标注的运动数据，抑或是强制执行几何约束；因此，它们无法直接考量场景上下文如何改变运动的安全含义。为此，我们提出了上下文安全过滤（Contextual Safety Filtering, CSF）——一种无需训练的过滤器，能够将自然语言安全规则锚定（ground）在由生成器产生的安全与不安全参考轨迹上。对于每一项生效的规则，安全与不安全的参考轨迹共同定义了一个仿射安全值（affine safety value），并由跟踪安全参考轨迹的 CBF-QP（基于控制障碍函数二次规划）强制执行。
在具有不同架构的四种预训练生成器上，CSF 在所有显式及场景触发的不安全情况下均能激活预期的规则，并将危险事件发生率降低高达 90%，同时保留了 88% 至 100% 的良性（非危险）运动。
我们在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上演示了完整的系统，结果表明，该系统在包括与人类及物体交互在内的多种场景下，均成功阻止了不安全运动的发生。
Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.
iGPC: Generative Motion Priors for Object-Aware Humanoid Interaction
iGPC：面向物体感知型人形机器人交互的生成式运动先验
在非结构化环境中运行的人形机器人必须将鲁棒的全身控制能力与感知并物理交互周围物体的能力相结合。尽管大规模人类运动数据为实现自然且通用的人形机器人控制提供了强大的先验信息，但将此类先验有效迁移至感知驱动的物体交互仍面临重大挑战。为了解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了一个框架，将近期提出的生成式预训练控制器（Generative Pretrained Controller, GPC）从通用人类运动扩展至全身人形机器人-环境交互。
首先，我们将 GPC 改造为以场景可供性（affordance）线索和特权状态信息为条件约束的交互专家（interaction experts）。该改造始于在与支撑场景匹配的人类运动上进行的交互与可供性预训练。这些专家在学习特定任务的接触行为（包括伸手靠近物体、抓握环境支撑物以维持稳定以及推动可移动物体）的同时，充分利用了预训练的人类运动先验。
其次，我们引入了一个感知驱动的学生策略（student policy），该策略保留了预训练的 GPC 策略，并利用机载传感器观测从专家策略中蒸馏交互技能。为了弥合特权专家观测与传感器输入之间的差距，我们对学生策略的感知模块进行训练，使其不仅能够重建专家观测，还能保持专家的运动决策及产生的关节目标。值得注意的是，我们在多项全身交互任务上的实验表明，大规模生成式人类运动先验为在富接触（contact-rich）真实环境中学习可部署的人形机器人交互策略提供了有效的基石。
Humanoid robots operating in unstructured environments must combine robust whole-body control with the ability to perceive and physically interact with surrounding objects. While large-scale human motion data provides powerful priors for natural and versatile humanoid control, effectively transferring such priors to perception-driven object interaction remains challenging. To address this bottleneck, we propose a framework that extends the recently proposed Generative Pretrained Controller (GPC) from general human motion to full-body humanoid-environment interaction. First, we adapt GPC into interaction experts conditioned on scene affordance cues and privileged state information. This adaptation begins with interaction and affordance pre-training on human motions paired with support scenes. These experts leverage the pretrained human motion prior while learning task-specific contact behaviors, including reaching toward objects, grasping environmental supports for stabilization, and pushing movable objects. Second, we introduce a perception-driven student that retains the pretrained GPC policy and distills interaction skills from the experts using onboard sensory observations. To bridge the gap between privileged expert observations and sensory inputs, we train the student's perception not only to reconstruct expert observations, but also to preserve the expert's motion decisions and resulting joint targets. Notably, our experiments across multiple whole-body interaction tasks demonstrate that large-scale generative human motion priors provide an effective foundation for learning deployable policies for humanoid interactions in contact-rich real-world environments.
ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
ActiveAlign：通过主动感知实现以自我为中心的操作对齐
“真实-仿真-真实”（Real2Sim2Real）架构能够为规划、可解释性以及安全执行提供结构化的世界表征。然而，现有的大多数方法依赖于被动感知，这因观测的不完善而产生了真实与仿真之间的差距（real2sim gaps）。受到人类通过动作主动进行感知这一过程的启发，我们提出了 ActiveAlign——一个利用主动感知（active perception）通过交互来对齐 Real2Sim2Real 差距的框架。ActiveAlign 引入了两个互补的模块：（i）ActiveAlign-Waving：通过利用主动手部运动与可微渲染进行手眼标定；（ii）ActiveAlign-Touching：通过触觉反馈细化物体对齐，以达到毫米级精度。这两项能力共同实现了强健的 real2sim 对齐。
我们证明了 ActiveAlign-Waving 可用于为开源的未标定机器人操纵数据集构建仿真环境；并在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 机器人上展示了 ActiveAlign 能够对毫米级物体进行精细操纵，例如按压按钮和移动滑块。
Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.
HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
HuGe：利用第一视角经验扩展通用型人形机器人视觉-语言-动作模型
将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）扩展至人形机器人，需要协调全身控制以及丰富多样的示范数据，而这些数据在真实世界场景中采集成本极其高昂。尽管自我中心（egocentric）的人类示范数据提供了互补的任务经验来源，但视觉实体（visual embodiment）的差异以及机器人本体感觉（proprioception）的缺失，给向人形机器人策略的迁移带来了困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 HuGe——一系列在超过 2,000 小时自我中心人类与机器人数据上进行预训练的人形通用 VLA 模型。具体而言，HuGe 采用了三种现有的代表性 VLA 架构，用于预测预训练全身控制器的潜在运动标记（latent motion tokens）以及手部控制信号。在此基础上，我们引入了一个三阶段训练流程，将自我中心预训练、人形机器人适应以及下游微调相结合。
为了促进跨实体的迁移，我们在预训练期间通过仿真回放构建伪本体感觉状态（pseudo-proprioceptive states），并在下游微调期间通过重新渲染来修改自我中心观测中的手臂外观。通过该流程，HuGe 在仿真基准 HumanoidArena 上取得了当前最佳性能（SOTA）。
此外，在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 机器人上进行的实验表明，利用经过视觉适应的自我中心示范来增强机器人示范数据，能显著提高抓取与放置（pick-and-drop）任务的成功率。
Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.
HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids
HULK：面向人形机器人的全身强力移动与操作学习
人形机器人对大型重物进行全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）需要整个身体进行强力交互。然而，此类有效载荷会改变人形机器人的质心，并在上半身产生持续的负载，从而对平衡维持与指令跟踪提出严峻挑战。为此，我们提出了 HULK——一个用于强力全身操纵与移动的全身控制框架。该框架利用模型预测控制（MPC），结合对带载动态特性的预测来引导强化学习（RL），并训练了两个专家策略（teachers）：一个在手腕受力状态下跟踪手臂运动，另一个则在贴身抱持大尺寸物体时进行移动。在训练过程中，捕获点控制障碍函数（capture-point control barrier function）对手腕受力专家进行增强，以提升负载条件下的平衡性能。随后，我们将这两个专家策略蒸馏为一个统一的策略。
我们在仿真环境和真实宇树 Unitree G1 机器人上对系统进行了评估。在仿真中，带有障碍函数的专家策略在单臂负载 10 kg 的条件下，在所有评估的控制器中取得了最低的前向与侧向速度跟踪误差，且相比于仅由 MPC 引导的强化学习，将聚合发散运动分量（DCM）的偏移幅度降低了 35.7%。
我们的手腕受力专家策略能够承受高达 130 N 的躯干推力扰动。
Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.
VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
面向人形机器人与人类交互的、由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的接触重定向与生成式伙伴建模
人形机器人与人类的交互要求机器人能在严重的局部可观测性（partial observability）下运行：在近距离物理接触过程中，人类搭档常被遮挡、截断或处于机器人的视角之外，导致姿态估计失效，且往往需要依赖外部跟踪设备或特权的人类状态信息。同时，人与人之间严重的相互遮挡也会在用于学习的人-人运动捕捉数据中引入误差。为此，我们提出了 REACT——一个从人-人示范中学习可部署的人形机器人与人类交互策略的框架。REACT 将语义接触结构作为连接示范处理、交互学习和机载控制的核心监督信号。
首先，基于 VLM（视觉语言模型）引导的接触建模与重定向流程识别出具备语义价值的接触，并在保持交互结构的同时将其迁移至人形机器人与人类的几何结构上。利用这些标注信息，特权交互策略通过接触感知的交互奖励学习具备物理接地性（physically grounded）的行为，随后通过光照真实的人类深度渲染，被蒸馏为完全仅凭机载感知训练的可部署自我中心深度策略（egocentric depth policies）。为了解决严重的局部可观测性问题，我们引入了生成式搭档状态建模目标（generative partner-state modeling objectives），能够从受遮挡的自我中心视角预测搭档的运动。
我们在仿真环境以及真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，针对五项富接触（contact-rich）交互任务对 REACT 进行了评估。语义接触建模显著提升了对示范交互特征的保留度；而生成式搭档状态建模在五项交互中的四项中提升了接触召回率（contact recall），在严重遮挡条件下的提升最为显著。在真实硬件测试中，REACT 仅依靠机载感知即成功完成了全部五项交互任务。
Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.
Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
Being-M0.7：面向人形机器人的潜在世界-动作模型
人形机器人的全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）需要协调的足式运动与操纵能力，并结合对未来场景演化及全身运动的认知；然而，受限于稀缺的机器人示范数据，学习这些能力面临瓶颈。人类视频与运动数据集提供了可扩展的监督信号，但许多数据集仅包含单模态的视频或运动数据，而非成对的视频-运动数据；此外，人类运动并不能直接指定可执行的机器人动作。为此，我们提出了 Being-M0.7——一个潜在世界-动作模型（latent world-action model），该模型通过预训练（pre-training）、机器人中训练（robot mid-training）与动作后训练（action post-training），将从混合模态人类数据中学到的视觉-运动先验迁移至人形机器人控制中。
我们从超过 10,000 小时的人类中心原始数据中整理出一个语料库，整合了纯视频、纯运动以及成对的视频-运动流，用以学习互补的视觉动态与全身运动学结构。对未来潜在视觉状态与运动的联合预测，促使视觉表征能够编码未来的运动学特征。机器人中训练阶段将这种粗粒度先验适应至机器人的视角与身体动态；在动作后训练阶段，动作专家通过门控交叉注意力机制（gated cross-attention），将冻结且适应后的先验模型所输出的视觉预测表征与当前图像及本体感觉相结合，从而将预测上下文锚定（ground）至可执行的全身指令中。
在仿真基准 SIMPLE 上，Being-M0.7 在所有对比的基线模型中取得了最高的聚合成功率；并在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人全身操纵与移动任务中达到了与最强基线相媲美的性能。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.
Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
目标之前的记忆：既往记忆在人形机器人移动与操作中的作用
动态场景中的人形机器人全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）具有非马尔可夫（non-Markovian）特性：当物体发生变化、被遮挡，或者随着机器人转身和行走而离开视野时，相关线索便会消失；然而，现有的全身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略却只能看到“当前”的瞬间。为此，我们提出了 WholeBodyMem——一种基于物体的感知记忆模块，能够保留在机器人对其目标采取行动之前所观测到的物体事件历史。该系统利用 SAM3 跟踪任务物体，并通过物体事件在自适应预算内因果性地选择关键帧；随后，动作专家通过交叉注意力机制读取这些关键帧，并结合编码了外观、几何与时间信息的物体标记（object tokens）。
我们同时推出了 HuMeGo——一个包含 6 项仿真任务和 6 项真实世界宇树 Unitree G1 任务的人形机器人内存/记忆基准测试。实验证明，保留“正确的帧”而非单纯“保留更多帧”至关重要，WholeBodyMem 显著超越了无记忆以及均匀记忆的基线方法，在仿真环境中将基础策略的成功率从 29.1% 提升至 72.6%，在真实机器人上从 36.7% 提升至 88.3%，同时也将标准 SIMPLE 任务的成功率从 70.2% 提升至 86.9%。
Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).
P-BFM: Perceptive Behavioral Foundation Models for Humanoid Control via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
P-BFM：通过无监督强化学习实现人形机器人控制的感知型行为基础模型
行为基础模型（Behavioral Foundation Models, BFMs）为人形机器人提供了可重复使用的全身行为库；然而在真实世界的人形机器人控制中，相同的行为意图在不同的地形约束下可能需要根本不同的运动形态。若要通过匹配地形的示范数据覆盖此类变化，则需要穷举行为与地形几何构造组成的组合空间。为此，我们提出了 P-BFM——一种感知型行为基础模型，它将人形机器人控制解耦为地形无关的意图（terrain-invariant intent）与地形条件的实现（terrain-conditioned realization）。前向-后向表征在无需地形信息的情况下，将运动参考、目标状态和奖励函数映射至一个共享的意图空间，而感知策略则学习如何在周围地形几何约束下实现每一种意图。
我们进一步指出了纯潜在控制（purely latent control）的一个互补局限性：行为潜在变量在保留局部运动模式的同时，可能会丢失精确的全局推进信息。因此，我们引入了显式根节点指令（Explicit Root Instructions, ERI），将全局平移运动（如航向角与平面速度）与行为意图分离，同时将局部的全身适应留给感知策略去完成。这种解耦带来了传统 BFM 所不具备的特征能力：在没有任何特定地形示范的情况下，一个固定不变的意图能够诱导产生不同的、适应地形的行为（包括步高、步幅、姿态、落脚点选择以及接触状态的变化）。
在多种具挑战性的地形中，相比强基线方法，P-BFM 提高了运动保真度、根节点控制精度以及扰动恢复能力。单个冻结的策略模型即可进一步支持运动跟踪、目标到达、奖励推断、遥操作以及地形感知恢复，并能仅依靠机载深度感知零样本迁移至宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。
Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) provide humanoids with reusable repertoires of whole-body behaviors; in real-world humanoid control, the same behavioral intent may require fundamentally different motions under different terrain constraints. Covering such variation with terrain-matched demonstrations requires enumerating a combinatorial space of behaviors and terrain geometries. We introduce P-BFM, a perceptive behavioral foundation model that factorizes humanoid control into terrain-invariant intent and terrain-conditioned realization. A forward-backward representation maps motion references, target states, and reward functions into a shared intent space without terrain information, while a perceptive policy learns how to realize each intent under the surrounding terrain geometry. We further identify a complementary limitation of purely latent control: behavioral latents can preserve local motion patterns while losing precise global progress. We therefore introduce Explicit Root Instructions (ERI), which separates global transport (e.g., heading and planar velocity) from behavioral intent, while leaving local whole-body adaptation to the perceptive policy. This decomposition leads to a characteristic capability absent from conventional BFMs: one fixed intent induces different, terrain-appropriate behaviors, including changes in step height, stride, posture, foothold placement, and contacts, without terrain-specific demonstrations. Across challenging terrains, P-BFM improves motion fidelity, root-control precision, and perturbation recovery over strong baselines. A single frozen policy further supports motion tracking, goal reaching, reward inference, teleoperation, and terrain-aware recovery, and transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 using onboard depth sensing.
Active Reachability Learning for Humanoid Recoverability Monitoring
用于人形机器人恢复能力监测的主动可达性学习
部署人形机器人任务策略需要可靠的运行时监控器（runtime monitors），以便及时预测无法恢复的跌落并触发回退策略（fallback）。我们将这一任务建模为针对给定回退策略去学习随机的、有限时域（finite-horizon）的可恢复性包络（recoverability envelope）。合成此类监控器极具挑战性：现有方法通常假定训练数据自然涵盖了可恢复性包络，然而对于富接触（contact-rich）系统而言，获取此类数据仍是一个主要瓶颈。因此，现有方法仅能恢复真实包络的一小部分，使其在面对分布外（out-of-distribution, OOD）输入时容易产生乐观的幻觉预测。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个统一的框架，在价值学习（value learning）与主动探索（active exploration）之间不断迭代。
我们将数据探索重新构建为一个“可达-避障”（reach-avoid）问题，其中由不确定性引导的探索器在系统地揭示未观测状态的同时，避开高置信度下不可恢复的区域。这一闭环流程由组合的时间差分（Temporal Difference）与蒙特卡罗（Monte Carlo）目标函数提供支持，以实现准确的分布内价值预测和可靠的不确定性估计。通过将剩余的高不确定性区域显式地视为不可恢复区域，该监控器有效缓解了针对 OOD 输入的乐观幻觉。
在随机基准测试和拥有 29 个自由度的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的评估结果表明，我们的方法大幅提升了监控器的覆盖率与准确性，并成功零样本迁移（zero-shot transfer）至真实硬件。
Deploying humanoid task policies requires reliable runtime monitors that anticipate unrecoverable falls in time to trigger a fallback. We formulate this task as learning the stochastic, finite-horizon recoverability envelope of a given fallback policy. Synthesizing this monitor is challenging: existing methods assume training data naturally covers the recoverability envelope, yet acquiring such data remains a major bottleneck for contact-rich systems. Consequently, they recover only a fraction of the true envelope, leaving them prone to optimistic hallucinations for out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We resolve this via a unified framework that iterates between value learning and active exploration. Data exploration is reframed as a reach-avoid problem, where an uncertainty-guided explorer systematically uncovers unseen states while avoiding confidently unrecoverable regions. This loop is further supported by a combined Temporal Difference and Monte Carlo objective for accurate in-distribution value prediction and reliable uncertainty estimation. By explicitly treating the remaining high-uncertainty regions as unrecoverable, the monitor mitigates optimistic OOD hallucinations. Evaluated on stochastic benchmarks and a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid, our approach drastically improves monitor coverage and accuracy and successfully transfers zero-shot to real-world hardware.
Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation
解释导航决策：面向视觉-语言导航的阶段感知型视觉归因
随着视觉-语言模型（VLMs）日益使机器人具备遵循语言指令的能力，理解其导航决策对于可靠部署变得至关重要。现有的可解释性方法忽视了视觉-语言导航（VLN）中的一个核心挑战：当前动作的依据可能分布于历史与当前的观测中，并与不同的指令阶段（instruction stages）相关联。我们发现了“指令阶段不敏感性”（instruction-stage insensitivity）现象，即即使处于不同的导航阶段，现有方法也会产生相似的解释。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了用于 VLN 的阶段感知归因框架（stage-aware attribution framework）。
我们首先在跨观测维度上构建动作条件的时序指令-视觉归因（temporal instruction-visual attributions）。这些归因被投影至指令空间以估计阶段关联度，进而引导相关历史依据的聚合，以细化当前的解释。随后，指令引导的空间过滤器进一步抑制孤立响应，同时保留紧凑且与指令相关的区域。在多种 VLN 策略和基准测试上的实验表明，相比现有方法，该框架显著提升了归因质量。
我们进一步证明了该方法可作为分析失效案例的诊断工具，并在宇树 Unitree G1 机器人上验证了其在真实世界导航中的适用性。
As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.
Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
学习力交互式人形机器人移动与操作
许多日常任务要求同时控制接触力（contact force）与运动形态。对于人形机器人而言，这种力往往需要在双手及全身之间协同调控，无法仅凭运动学轨迹（kinematic trajectories）予以指定。因此，通过模仿学习来掌握此类任务，既需要记录接触力的示范数据，也需要能够精准输出相应力度的全身控制器。为此，我们提出了 FLoRe——一个用于学习具备力反馈响应（force-reactive）的人形机器人全身操纵与移动的框架。该框架配备了一个无需机器人的力标注数据采集系统，能够在记录手部、躯干与双足运动的同时，记录通过两个 UMI 风格手持夹爪施加的接触力矩（contact wrench）。
力响应扩散策略（force-reactive diffusion policy）将视觉、本体感觉与测得的力矩作为输入，进而预测动作及每只手部的力指令。具备力跟踪功能的混合顺应性全身控制器（hybrid compliance whole-body controller）在维持平衡的同时执行这些指令：由真实力/力矩（F/T）传感器测得的力误差积分，使每只手能够沿指定方向精确跟踪目标力，并在其他方向上保持顺应。
在仿真实验中，该控制器能够跟踪不同大小和方向的手部力指令，且几乎未损失全身运动精度。在实体机器人上开展的三项富接触（contact-rich）任务测试中，力响应策略在运动展开中取得了 80% 的成功率，而基于相同示范训练并在同一控制器上运行的纯位置（position-only）策略成功率仅为 26.7%。
Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Learning such tasks by imitation therefore needs demonstrations that record contact force, and a whole-body controller that can deliver it. We present FLoRe, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. Its robot-free force-annotated data collection system records the contact wrench applied through two UMI-style handheld grippers, together with hand, torso, and foot motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and comply along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller.
Beyond Retargeting: Low-Latency and Robust Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation with Learned Atomic Motion Primitives
超越重定向：基于学习型原子运动基元的低延迟、鲁棒人形机器人全身遥操作
人形机器人的全身遥操作（whole-body teleoperation）需要将人类动作实时转化为稳定的机器人行为。现有系统通常依赖在线动作重定向（motion retargeting）来弥合人与机器人之间的形态差异，但这一过程增加了延迟，且可能产生物理上不可行的目标姿态。同时，多样、带噪且不完整的人类动作观测往往超出训练分布，可能引发机器人行为的不稳定。为此，我们提出了一种无需重定向的策略（retargeting-free policy），该策略在单次前向传播中直接将原始人类动作映射为机器人关节指令，从而消除了在线运动学适应过程。
为了提升鲁棒性，我们学习了一个全身运动原语码本（codebook of full-body motion primitives），该码本能够将分布外（OOD）的观测投影至合理的运动原型上，并从局部/不完整输入中恢复出全身运动。
在仿真环境以及真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人硬件上，利用虚拟现实（VR）、光学动作捕捉、文本-运动生成以及单目视频输入开展的实验表明，我们的方法在延迟和鲁棒性方面均优于基线方法。
Humanoid whole-body teleoperation translates human motion into stable robot behavior in real time. Existing systems typically rely on online motion retargeting to bridge human--robot morphological differences, but this process adds latency and can produce physically infeasible targets. Meanwhile, diverse, noisy, and partial human-motion observations often fall outside the training distribution, potentially causing unstable robot behavior. We propose a retargeting-free policy that maps raw human motion directly to robot joint commands in a single forward pass, eliminating online kinematic adaptation. To improve robustness, we learn a codebook of full-body motion primitives that projects out-of-distribution observations onto plausible motion prototypes and recovers full-body motion from partial inputs. Experiments on a Unitree~G1 in simulation and on hardware, using virtual reality, optical mocap, text-to-motion generation, and monocular video inputs, show that our method outperforms baselines in latency and robustness.
MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots
MIND：面向机器人的指令条件式增量式基础映射
遵循持续语言指令（persistent language instructions）的机器人必须在环境发生变化时，判断哪些已缓存的房间决策依然有效。为此，我们提出了 MIND（基于指令条件依赖关系的维护机制，Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies）——一个用于维护目标房间决策的框架，无需在每次事件发生后对每一个房间进行重新评估。大语言模型（LLM）将每条指令编译为用于语义资格判定（semantic qualification）与目标选择的依赖关系。控制器将语义依赖关系与事件足迹（event footprints）求交集，仅更新受影响的判断，并分别更新可达性与目标选择状态。对于固定确定性的评估、规划与选择过程，保守的依赖关系与足迹覆盖能够完好保留完全重新计算（full recomputation）所作出的决策。
在包含 240 个五事件 ProcTHOR 序列且采用精确基准谓词（exact benchmark predicate）的测试中，MIND 将平均语义评估次数从 30.6 次降低至 11.2 次，同时保留了全部 1,200 个事件后的决策。在使用 Phi-4 与 Qwen3-14B 的冻结评估器（frozen-evaluator）实验中，系统同样保留了全部 1,200 个决策，且未对评估器的底层任务准确率产生负面影响。在 32 个采用精确谓词资格判定与元数据衍生足迹的闭环 AI2-THOR 幕（episodes）测试中，MIND 在每一幕中均达到了与完全重新计算完全一致的最终目标决策。
宇树 Unitree G1 机器人实验表明，在 MIND 机制下，机器人能够在跨房间转换过程中实现目标的复用与重新选择，且无需额外的语义评估；同时，在遇到障碍物及物体被移走后，系统仅通过 4 次评估即可做出放弃（abstention）决策，而对比方法则需要 15 至 18 次评估。
Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18.
FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
FAITH：面向高维系统的、具备可行性感知且经过安全过滤的强化学习
安全强化学习（Safe reinforcement learning）通常将安全性与任务性能置于同一个策略目标中，这可能会引发相互冲突的更新。安全过滤器（safety filters）在动作执行阶段将两者解耦，但古典过滤器设计需要显式的解析安全函数和动态模型，且标准的最小干预过滤器仅最小化瞬时动作偏离量，因而对长时域的任务回报（long-horizon task return）缺乏预见性。此外，当不存在安全动作时，硬投影（hard projections）也会面临无解（undefined）的问题。为此，我们提出了 FAITH——一个可行性感知（feasibility-aware）的无模型框架，该框架能够近似最优的状态-动作安全值（safety value），并通过前馈网络摊销（amortize）最小干预过滤计算。任务策略通过经过过滤的动态过程来优化任务回报，从而恢复可行约束问题，且在任务策略更新中无需引入相互竞争的安全项。当不存在满足所学安全条件的动作时，该过滤器会趋向于输出具有最小预测峰值危害的动作。
在双积分器（double integrator）示例和 Safety Gym 环境中，FAITH 在所有从可行起点出发无违规的方法中取得了最高的回报，并在从不可行起点出发时达到了最低的危害程度。在拥有 29 个自由度的人形机器人上，该方法在 Walking-Avoid 任务中达到了 99.95% 的安全率，同时保留了未过滤前 97% 的回报；在 Push-Avoid 任务中，通过学会牺牲平衡并向远离受保护区域的方向跌倒，获得了最高的实测安全率。
相同的策略也在真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上进行了演示。
Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.
AutodidactWAM: Cross-Modal Self-Distillation from Generated Video to Robot Actions
AutodidactWAM：从生成视频到机器人动作的跨模态自蒸馏
世界-动作模型（World-action models, WAMs，例如 Cosmos 3）能够基于观察图像与指令，联合生成未来的视频及机器人动作。通过轻量级的 LoRA 微调将此类模型迁移至此前未见过的机器人——配备五指 BrainCo 灵巧手的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人时，暴露出了“视频-动作不对称性”（video-action asymmetry）：模型生成的视频展现出了合理的任务执行过程，但协同生成的动作却存在系统性的目标偏差。我们在“预抓取”（pre-grasp）、“抓取”（grasp）和“抓取与放置”（pick-and-place）三个累进阶段评估了闭环真实机器人实验。原生生成的动作在各阶段的成功率分别仅约为 17%、10% 和 7%，且在未见过的保留物体（held-out objects）上表现更差。为此，我们提出了 AutodidactWAM——一个无需遥操作训练的手部姿态估计算法，随后结合逆运动学（IK），在模型生成的视频上运行以恢复动作估计。
与原生预测配对后，这些恢复出的动作通过对生成的视频进行教师强制（teacher-forcing），为仅微调与动作相关的层提供了优选目标。我们对比了监督式重标记（supervised relabeling）与整流流（rectified-flow）版本的 Diffusion-DPO。在完成一次性的实体适应后，这种自蒸馏（self-distillation）过程无需额外的特定任务遥操作数据。基于恢复动作的门控（recovered-action gate）在预抓取、抓取和抓取与放置阶段分别达到了约 75%、47% 和 42% 的成功率，远高于原生动作的 17%、10% 和 7%。
融合了偏好监督、监督目标拟合与笛卡尔轨迹锚定（DPO+SFT+DTW）的混合目标函数取得了最佳性能：在训练物体（Oreo）上，它达到了 90% 的预抓取成功率和 20% 的全任务成功率；在未见过的保留物体上，则达到了 80% 和 30% 的成功率。相比之下，纯 Flow-DPO 尽管验证偏好准确率达到 1.000，但成功率却为 0%，这表明是训练目标的有效组合而非单纯的对比目标推动了所观测到的性能提升。
World-action models (WAMs) such as Cosmos 3 jointly generate future video and robot actions from an observation and instruction. Adapting one such model with a lightweight LoRA fine-tune to a previously unseen robot, a Unitree G1 humanoid with five-fingered BrainCo hands, exposes a video-action asymmetry: the video renders plausible task executions, while the co-generated action is systematically mis-targeted. We evaluate closed-loop real-robot trials at three cumulative stages: pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place. The native action succeeds only approximately 17%, 10%, and 7% of the time, respectively, and performs worse on held-out objects. We propose AutodidactWAM, a hand-pose estimator trained without teleoperation, followed by inverse kinematics, that runs on the model's generated video to recover action estimates. Paired with the native prediction, these recovered actions provide preferred targets for fine-tuning only the action-related layers, while the generated video is teacher-forced.
