We compare supervised relabeling with a rectified-flow adaptation of Diffusion-DPO. After one-time embodiment adaptation, self-distillation requires no additional task-specific teleoperation. The recovered-action gate reaches approximately 75%, 47%, and 42% pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place success, compared with 17%, 10%, and 7% for the native action. A hybrid objective combining preference supervision, supervised target fitting, and Cartesian trajectory anchoring (DPO+SFT+DTW) performs best: on Oreo, the training object, it reaches 90% pre-grasp and 20% full-task success; on a held-out object, it reaches 80% and 30%. Plain Flow-DPO reaches 0% success despite 1.000 validation preference accuracy, indicating that the combination of training objectives, rather than the contrastive objective alone, drives the observed gains.
Action-Aligned Latent Planning for Versatile Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
面向通用人形机器人移动与操作的动作对齐潜在规划
为多样化的人形机器人全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）学习单一感知策略，需要统一高层任务决策，同时又不丢失使每次交互成功所需的依赖于状态的物理响应。这使得高层规划与全身控制之间的表征变得至关重要：运动学或接触目标虽然提供了紧凑的抽象，但并不直接编码特定于交互的控制响应；而直接预测低层动作则要求规划器去建模高频闭环反馈。为此，我们提出了 FIBER——一个将冻结的行为基础模型（BFM）的可执行潜在空间（executable latent space）用作异构交互技能共享规划表征的框架。我们的潜在策略投影（Latent Policy Projection, LPP）通过识别其诱导动作与局部控制响应相匹配的潜在指令，将独立获取的特定任务策略映射至该表征中，从而在保留 BFM 高频状态反馈的同时实现较低速率的规划。在完成投影后，我们聚合来自所有技能的闭环潜在展开（latent rollouts），并完全以离线方式训练单个感知流规划器（perceptive flow planner）。
我们进一步引入了 AH-BFM——一种采用多 gamma 前向-后向（FB）学习训练的自适应时域 BFM，以同时支持精确控制与时间跨度更长的全身行为。
我们在仿真环境以及真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上对 FIBER 进行了评估，任务涵盖箱子拾取、开门以及物体抓取。在仿真环境中每个任务的 128 种多样化变体测试中，FIBER 达到了 42.0% 的平均成功率，达到投影潜在重放（11.6%）的三倍以上，并大幅超越了运动学规划（3.5%）。真实世界实验进一步展示了通过该统一规划器实现的仿真到真实迁移（sim-to-real）、技能链式组合（skill chaining）以及条件引导（conditional steering）。
Learning a single perceptive policy for diverse humanoid loco-manipulation requires unifying high-level task decisions without losing the state-dependent physical responses that make each interaction succeed. This makes the representation between high-level planning and whole-body control critical: kinematic or contact targets provide compact abstractions but do not directly encode interaction-specific control responses, while directly predicting low-level actions requires the planner to model high-frequency closed-loop feedback. We propose FIBER, a framework that uses the executable latent space of a frozen behavioral foundation model (BFM) as a shared planning representation for heterogeneous interaction skills. Our latent policy projection (LPP) maps independently acquired task-specific policies into this representation by identifying latent commands whose induced actions match their local control responses, enabling lower-rate planning while retaining the BFM's high-frequency state feedback. After projection, we aggregate closed-loop latent rollouts from all skills and train a single perceptive flow planner entirely offline. We further introduce AH-BFM, an adaptive-horizon BFM trained with multi-gamma forward-backward (FB) learning to support both precise control and temporally extended whole-body behavior. We evaluate FIBER on box pickup, door opening, and object grasping in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across 128 diverse variations per task in simulation, FIBER achieves 42.0% mean success, more than tripling projected latent replay (11.6%) and substantially outperforming kinematic planning (3.5%). Real-world experiments further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer, skill chaining, and conditional steering through the same unified planner.
DUET: Decoupled Upper- and Lower-Body Execution for Task-Agnostic Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
DUET：面向任务无关型人形机器人移动与操作的上下肢解耦执行方案
更改人形机器人的操纵策略（manipulation policy）不应需要重新训练维持机器人平衡的控制器。本研究提出了 DUET——一个解耦执行框架（decoupled execution framework），通过仅在机器人接口处合并指令，使足式移动（locomotion）与操纵控制器能够同时运行。在拥有 23 个自由度的宇树 Unitree G1 机器人上，一个强化学习移动策略用于控制 12 个腿部关节和一个腰部偏航（waist yaw）关节，能够跟踪平面速度、转向角速度以及从深蹲到直立站立的骨盆高度变化。10 个手臂关节被排除在动作空间（action space）之外，其位置与速度仅作为观测值输入；因此，任何生成手臂关节目标位置的兼容操纵策略均可控制上半身，而移动策略则无需共享训练或直接协调即可保持下半身稳定。本研究通过将相同的移动策略 Checkpoint 与两种不同的视觉-语言-动作模型（GR00T N1.7 与 pi0.5）进行配对，在硬件上展示了该模块化方法。
在仿真评估中，移动控制器在跟踪指令平面速度、偏航角速度和骨盆高度时，误差分别为 0.186 m/s、0.142 rad/s 和 0.016 m，且下半身保持稳定、无跌落发生。消融实验表明，上半身姿态课程训练（upper-body pose curriculum）是核心主导组件，若移除该训练步骤，单幕存活时间（episode survival）将从 20.0 秒降至 7.4 秒，且跌落率上升至每环境分钟 6.06 次。
鲁棒性测试显示，在训练好的载荷范围内，面对高达 1.0 m/s 的推力扰动，系统无跌落发生；而在两倍于载荷极限的情况下，面对 0.7 m/s 以下的推力扰动同样无跌落发生。这些结果表明，无需重新训练、重启或变动维持机器人直立的控制层，即可实现操纵策略的无缝替换。
Changing a humanoid robot's manipulation policy should not require retraining the controller that maintains the robot's balance. This study introduces DUET, a decoupled execution framework that enables locomotion and manipulation controllers to operate simultaneously by combining their commands only at the robot interface. A reinforcement-learning locomotion policy controls the 12 leg joints and a waist yaw joint, tracking planar velocity, turning rate, and pelvis height from deep crouching to upright standing on a 23-degree-of-freedom Unitree G1. The 10 arm joints are excluded from the action space, while their positions and velocities are included only as observations, so that any compatible manipulation policy that generates arm-joint targets can control the upper body, and the locomotion policy keeps the lower body stable without requiring shared training or direct coordination. This study demonstrates the modular approach on hardware by pairing the same locomotion checkpoint with two different vision-language-action models, GR00T N1.7 and pi0.5. In simulation evaluation, the locomotion controller kept the robot's lower body stable with no falls while tracking the commanded planar velocity, yaw rate, and pelvis height with errors of 0.186 m/s, 0.142 rad/s, and 0.016 m, respectively. Ablation studies identify the upper-body pose curriculum as the dominant component, and removing this training step reduces episode survival from 20.0 to 7.4 seconds and increases the fall rate to 6.06 per environment minute. Robustness tests show no falls under pushes of up to 1.0 m/s within the trained payload range, and no falls at twice the payload limit for pushes below 0.7 m/s. These results show that a manipulation policy can be exchanged without retraining, restarting, or otherwise touching the layer that keeps the robot upright.
CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
CIRRA：面向交互式家庭任务中具身机器人智能体的双层持续指令协调与动态执行机制
家庭机器人必须在执行当前任务的同时适应新的用户指令。现有的智能体通常会重新生成或大幅修订剩余的任务序列，从而引入计划歧义（plan ambiguity）、逻辑不一致以及冗余执行问题。为此，我们将该任务形式化为持续指令调和（continual instruction reconciliation），并提出了 CIRRA（机器人智能体持续指令调和框架）——一个结合了基于 LLM 的语义推理与规则约束结构化集成（rule-constrained structural integration）的双层框架。CIRRA 首先将新输入的指令锚定至唯一的可执行技能，并解析未充分指定的动作与执行位置。随后，它将正在进行的子任务序列保留为“执行骨干”（execution backbone），并通过将新加入的子任务插入到位置匹配的区段中来生成集成候选方案。语义推理器仅评估被修改的区段，以识别依赖关系与冲突，并选择最具逻辑一致性的局部集成方案。这一保持结构（structure-preserving）的过程维持了与当前执行过程的一致性，缓解了歧义与不一致性，并复用了共享的子任务以减少冗余执行。
我们同时推出了 CHIRP（持续家庭指令调和与规划基准）——一个包含 120 个幕（episodes）的文本基准测试，涵盖 8 个家庭环境和 6 类日常活动。在 CHIRP 基准测试中，CIRRA 达到了 74.2% 的决策一致率（decision agreement），超越最强重规划基准方法 30 个百分点；每一个正确的融合决策均生成了位置准确且无冲突的调度计划。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，CIRRA 在每次试验中都能在正确的时机中断正在进行的技能，并在各项指标上均显著优于所有对比基线。
Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.
BeJEPA: A Goal-Conditioned Humanoid Behavior World Model via Unsupervised RL
BeJEPA：一种基于无监督强化学习、以目标为条件的人形机器人行为世界模型
人形机器人的控制需要将全身姿态与世界坐标系下的位置及航向进行协调。主流控制器在根节点坐标系（root frame）下模仿轨迹，但在受到位移干扰后，往往难以恢复目标世界位姿。为此，我们提出了 BeJEPA——一个通过人类运动先验与机器人交互的无监督强化学习所学得的目标条件行为世界模型（goal-conditioned Behavior World Model）。BeJEPA 通过联合嵌入预测架构（joint-embedding predictive architecture, JEPA）学习了身体构型与世界定位的共享表征。其中，动态预测器（Dynamic Predictor）根据动作预测下一个状态嵌入，而成功预测器（Successor Predictor）则在单个向量中总结了目标条件策略的期望折扣未来状态 embeddings。在联合训练期间，动态预测器将初始表征锚定在观测到的物理跃迁中，而成功预测器则逐渐将其围绕长期行为进行组织。它们的组合通过一次物理预测和一个行为摘要来指导策略改进，无需进行漫长的想象展开（imagined rollouts）。
在 20 秒的运动跟踪实验中，采用基于动态预测器进行在线动作精炼的 BeJEPA 在全局身体位置误差方面优于所有评估的基线方法：在 AMASS 数据集上，相比带世界位姿输入的 BFM-Zero 降低了 61.7%，相比 SONIC 降低了 58.7%。
在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的物理部署表明，该方法能够联合达成姿态、世界位置和航向目标，实现从地面的恢复，并在受到干扰和目标变更后进行闭环返回。
Humanoid control requires coordinating whole-body posture with position and heading in the world frame. Mainstream controllers imitate trajectories in the root frame, but struggle to regain the target world pose after displacement. We introduce BeJEPA, a goal-conditioned Behavior World Model learned through unsupervised reinforcement learning from human motion priors and robot interaction. BeJEPA learns a shared representation of body configuration and world placement through a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). A Dynamic Predictor predicts the next state embedding under an action, while a Successor Predictor summarizes a goal-conditioned policy's expected discounted future state embeddings in a single vector. During joint training, Dynamic grounds the initial representation in observed physical transitions, while Successor increasingly organizes it around long-term behavior. Their composition guides policy improvement through one physical prediction and one behavioral summary, without long imagined rollouts. In 20-second motion-tracking experiments, BeJEPA with online action refinement using Dynamic outperforms all evaluated baselines in global body-position error, reducing it on AMASS by 61.7% relative to BFM-Zero with world-pose inputs and 58.7% relative to SONIC. Physical deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates joint attainment of posture, world position, and heading goals, recovery from the ground, and closed-loop return after disturbances and goal changes.
Catch It All!: Generalizable Dynamic Catching with a Dexterous Hand
“全”能捕捉！——利用灵巧手实现可泛化的动态捕捉
物体的抓捕（catching）要求仅凭借带噪的视觉观测，就能泛化至新型抛体，并对不可预测的接触进行实时自适应。Catch It All! 是一个用于人形机器人的仿真到真实（sim-to-real）抓捕框架，仅依赖单个自我中心视角摄像头，即可在下手（underhand）和上手（overhand）抓捕场景中，泛化至具有不同几何形状、可形变性与弹性特征的未见过物体。
能够适应物体位姿与形状的抓取动作来源于指尖到表面距离的奖励函数（fingertip-to-surface distance reward）。安全感知的课程学习（safety-aware curricula）使策略能够在接近硬件极限的条件下高频运行，包括低至 5 N·m 的手腕扭矩限制。
该策略在仿真环境中进行训练，并零样本部署于配备 20 自由度灵巧手的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上。在实体测试中，机器人成功抓捕了 9 种训练中从未见过的物体，包括低反弹毛绒玩具、半可形变玩具与薯片袋，以及具备弹性的刚性物体。
Catching requires generalizing to novel projectiles and adapting in real time to unpredictable contact, from noisy visual observations alone. Catch It All! is a sim-to-real catching framework for humanoid robots that generalizes to unseen objects with different geometry, deformability, and elasticity, for both underhand and overhand catches, using only one egocentric camera.
Grasps that adapt to the object's pose and shape come from a fingertip-to-surface distance reward. Safety-aware curricula let the policy act at high frequency near hardware limits, including wrist torque limits as low as 5 N·m. The policy is trained in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a Unitree G1 with a 20-DoF dexterous hand, where it catches 9 objects it never saw in training: low-rebound plushes, semi-deformable toys and chip bags, and rigid-elastic objects that bounce.
VICAR: Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting for Humanoid Interactive Skills
VICAR：面向人形机器人交互技能的、具备接触感知重定向功能的视频模仿方法
第三人称视角的人类视频为人形机器人的全身操纵与移动（loco-manipulation）提供了一种具备扩展性的替代方案，可取代特定任务的奖励工程、遥操作以及手动编写脚本的示范数据。最近的“视频转人形机器人”（video-to-humanoid）系统表明，可以从无结构的视频中提取带噪的人类运动、物体轨迹与接触信息，并将其精炼为可部署的技能。然而，对于富接触（contact-rich）的模仿学习而言，仍存在一个关键空白：任务往往由世界坐标系下的接触所定义，其位姿、时序和速度必须在克服实体不匹配（embodiment mismatch）与运行时场景变化后得以保留。为此，我们提出了 VICAR（基于接触感知重定向的视频模仿，Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting）——一个从第三人称人类视频中学习人形机器人交互技能的流程。该系统首先恢复人类运动，从单目视频中重建与任务相关的障碍物，随后在保留全局接触位姿、运动速度与避障间隙（collision clearance）的同时，将运动重定向至人形机器人。
与仅消除穿透或保留局部交互几何结构的重定向方法不同，我们的公式将用户指定的接触位姿与避障间隙表示为高优先级的拉格朗日惩罚项（Lagrangian penalty terms），并优化全运动轨迹，使其在富接触转换过程中保持平滑。生成的运动被用于训练一个接触条件运动生成器（contact-conditioned motion generator），其输入包含可移动的接触点，从而支持在运行时对新的接触位置进行自适应调整。
我们在包含六种乒乓球发球、三种物体拾取任务以及爬梯在内的十种多样化第三人称视频技能上演示了该框架，并将学到的技能部署于硬件上。这些结果表明，保留接触的重定向是迈向“通过观察人类来学习实用交互行为”的人形机器人的切实可行的一步。
Third-person human videos offer a scalable alternative to task-specific reward engineering, teleoperation, and manually scripted demonstrations for humanoid loco-manipulation. Recent video-to-humanoid systems have shown that noisy human motion, object trajectories, and contacts can be extracted from unstructured videos and refined into deployable skills. However, a key gap remains for contact-rich imitation: the task is often defined by world-frame contacts whose poses, timing, and speed must survive embodiment mismatch and runtime scene changes. Towards this, we present VICAR (Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting), a pipeline for learning humanoid interactive skills from third-person human videos. The system first recovers human motion, reconstructs task-relevant obstacles from monocular video, and then retargets the motion to a humanoid while preserving global contact poses, motion speed, and collision clearance. Unlike retargeting methods that only remove penetration or preserve local interaction geometry, our formulation represents user-specified contact poses and collision clearance as high-priority Lagrangian penalty terms and optimizes the full motion to remain smooth through contact-rich transitions. The resulting motions are used to train a contact-conditioned motion generator whose inputs include movable contact points enabling runtime adaptation to new contact positions. We demonstrate the framework on ten diverse third-person video skills, including six table-tennis serves, three object-pickup tasks, and ladder climbing, and deploy the learned skills on hardware. These results suggest that contact-preserving retargeting is a practical step toward humanoids that learn useful interactive behavior by watching humans.
KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
KODA：基于人类第一视角演示的仿人机器人学习——运动学与观测数据对齐
训练人形机器人全身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略需要高昂的机器人示范数据，这些数据包含对齐的机器人视角观测以及与控制器兼容的全身状态-动作标签。第一视角的人类示范提供了可扩展的监督信号，但存在视角不对齐与运动线索稀疏的问题。现有的方法要么预训练策略但仍需机器人数据进行自适应，要么生成限制了复用性的特定控制器指令。此外，数据转换还需要与生成的全身运动相对齐的机器人视角观测。为此，我们提出了 KODA（运动学-观测数据对齐，Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment），它使用可复用的规范轨迹（canonical trajectory）来引导机器人视角合成，并生成特定控制器的全身状态-动作监督，从而将第一视角 RGB 人类示范转换为全身 VLA 训练数据。
KODA 首先利用带基于采样指令优化的稀疏跟踪器生成经仿真器校验的全身轨迹。这一生成的轨迹直接决定了用于合成对应机器人视角观测的机载摄像头位姿。运动、观测与任务指令共同构成了规范记录。针对每个部署的控制器，KODA 优化指令以跟踪存储的运动，并记录相应的动作标签与本体感觉状态。当切换控制器时，KODA 保留该规范记录，并重新生成全身状态-动作监督，以便与匹配的机器人示范进行联合训练（co-training）。
我们在拥有两种全身控制器（SONIC 和 HEFT）的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，针对四项全身操纵与移动任务评估了 KODA。在固定机器人数据量的前提下，在人类示范所覆盖但机器人数据缺失的测试条件下，宏平均（macro-average）成功率分别提升了 45.0 和 46.25 个百分点。在这两种控制器下，该指标在评估的人类数据预算范围内均呈现上升趋势，表明其具备进一步扩展的潜力。
Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.
Evaluating Lightweight Contact Feedback in Dual-Operator Collaborative Humanoid Teleoperation
评估双操作员协作式人形机器人遥操作中的轻量级接触反馈
双操作员人形机器人遥操作系统（dual-operator humanoid teleoperation）能够通过两台独立的机器人实现协同操纵，但操作员缺乏在物理交互中通常可获得的对机器人-物体接触的直接感知。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了扩展现实遥操作（eXtended Reality Teleoperation, XRT）——一个通过轻量级触觉振动和/或听觉反馈传回机器人指尖接触状态的扩展现实遥操作框架，以及基于该框架构建的面向两名操作员的同步双人形机器人实验平台。16 组双人搭档（dyads）在仅靠视觉以及三种不同的反馈条件下，完成了协同抬起与翻转木箱的实验；实验采用了平衡被试内设计（counterbalanced within-subject design），并对反馈通道的交付进行了验证。
实验得出了三个主要结论：首先，操作员对指尖局部触觉振动显示（vibrotactile display）的有效性评价高于开放式听觉音化（open-ear sonification）：全部 32 名被试均认为触觉反馈比听觉反馈更有效，其中 18 名将其评为最有效，且其提示信号被认为比听觉提示更容易感知与解读。其次，完成时间、失败率、工作负荷、不适感以及对搭档的感知度在不同反馈条件之间未表现出可检测到的显著差异，其中完成时间存在较宽的区间，且较小的实质性效应仍未得到明确分辨。
任务性能随着练习显着提升，在难度较高的翻转任务中尤为明显：完成时间跨实验组块（blocks）不断缩短，且同一组搭档内部的尝试间变异度（标准差为 1.51 倍）大于最大的条件对比变异度（1.16 倍）。探索性分析未检测到不同反馈条件之间在即时抓握或运动响应上的差异。对于新手协同遥操作而言，指尖触觉振动提示被评定为比听觉提示更有效且更容易解读，但其对任务性能的具体影响仍有待进一步澄清。
Dual-operator humanoid teleoperation enables collaborative manipulation through two separate robots, but operators lack direct awareness of robot-object contact that is normally available during physical interaction. To address this, we present eXtended Reality Teleoperation (XRT), an extended reality teleoperation framework that returns a robot's fingertip contact through lightweight vibrotactile and/or auditory feedback, and a synchronized dual-humanoid testbed built on it for two operators. Sixteen dyads performed a collaborative crate lift-and-flip under vision only and the three feedback conditions in a counterbalanced within-subject design with verified feedback-channel delivery. Three results follow. First, operators rated our finger-localized vibrotactile display as more effective than our open-ear sonification: all 32 ranked it above the sonification, 18 ranked it most effective, and its cues were rated far easier to perceive and interpret than the auditory cues. Second, completion time, failures, workload, discomfort, and partner awareness showed no detected condition differences, with wide completion-time intervals and smaller meaningful effects unresolved. Third, performance changed substantially with practice, especially on the harder flip-over task: completion time improved across blocks, and attempt-to-attempt variation within a dyad (SD x1.51) was larger than the largest condition contrast (x1.16). Exploratory analyses detected no difference in immediate grip or motion responses between feedback conditions. For novice collaborative teleoperation, our fingertip vibrotactile cues were rated more effective and easier to interpret than our auditory cues, while their effect on task performance remains unresolved.
HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour
HC2Robot：具备预测性前瞻能力的超连接 Transformer，用于多地形人形机器人跑酷
人形机器人跑酷（humanoid parkour）要求机器人能够在高度不连续的地形上对未来的落脚点与全身运动进行推理。我们重新审视了用于感知型人形机器人移动的非对称 Actor-Critic 学习中的信息不对称问题：Critic 在训练阶段利用特权仿真信号，而可部署的 Actor 则仅依赖机载感知进行运行。我们认为，关键不在于将特权信息暴露给 Actor，而在于学习特权信息的可部署近似，以此缩小训练与部署之间的信息鸿沟。为此，我们提出了 HC2Robot——一个由预测前瞻模块（Predicted Foresight Module, PFM）与超连接 Transformer（Hyper-Connection Transformer, HC Transformer）组成的可部署感知型人形机器人跑酷框架。
PFM 从可部署的观测数据中预测由策略条件决定的各足下一次触地事件的时序、位置与支撑质量，将特权监督转化为可部署的潜在表征，从而在无需运行时特权感知的条件下，为 Actor 提供预测的触地信息。HC Transformer 则通过可学习的多流路由（multi-stream routing）进一步增强时序推理能力，同时一个未来运动预测头为正则化提供了短时域的运动先验。
在楼梯、间隙、高台和斜坡等多种复杂地形下，HC2Robot 达到了 97.60% 的平均仿真越障成功率，且相比强感知移动基线方法展现出了持续更高的安全落脚点率，在可部署感知条件下支持了提升的越障性能与几何落脚点支撑能力。
Humanoid parkour requires robots to reason about future footholds and whole-body motions over highly discontinuous terrain. We revisit the information asymmetry in asymmetric actor-critic learning for perceptive humanoid locomotion: the critic exploits privileged simulator signals during training, whereas the deployable actor operates solely from onboard perception. We argue that the key is not exposing privileged information to the actor, but learning a deployable approximation of it to narrow the information gap between training and deployment. We present HC2Robot, a deployable perceptive humanoid parkour framework consisting of a Predicted Foresight Module (PFM) and a Hyper-Connection (HC) Transformer. PFM predicts from deployable observations the policy-conditioned timing, location, and support quality of each foot's next touchdown event, converting privileged supervision into a deployable latent representation that provides the actor with predicted touchdown information without privileged runtime sensing. The HC Transformer further enhances temporal reasoning through learnable multi-stream routing, while a future motion prediction head provides short-horizon motion priors for regularization. Across stairs, gaps, high platforms, and slopes, HC2Robot achieves a mean simulated traversal success rate of 97.60% and consistently higher safe foothold rates than strong perceptive locomotion baselines, supporting improved traversal performance and geometric foothold support under deployable sensing.
Warping the Workspace: Expanding Visual Access with Adjustable Reach Mapping for Humanoid Teleoperation
扭曲工作空间：通过可调节的触及映射扩展人形机器人遥操作中的视觉可达范围
第一视角人形机器人遥操作（first-person humanoid teleoperation）将对侧向及后方目标的获取与操作员的身体旋转绑定在一起。为此，我们提出了耦合视-动重映射（coupled visual-motor remapping）技术，将全景方位角扭曲（panoramic azimuth warp）与其逆上肢偏航变换（inverse upper-limb yaw transform）相配对。
一个可运行的原型实现了全局缩放（Global Zoom, GZ）与焦点+上下文（Focus+Context, F+C）两种模式。在一项被试内研究（N=8，共 72 次试验）中，GZ 取得了最高的完成次数（23/24；固定模式为 20/24；F+C 模式为 21/24），而 F+C 模式则获得了 8 名参与者中 6 名的偏好。因此，在该样本中，任务完成度与用户偏好分别倾斜于不同的映射模式。
First-person humanoid teleoperation ties access to side and rear targets to operator rotation. We present coupled visual--motor remapping, pairing a panoramic azimuth warp with its inverse upper-limb yaw transform. A working prototype implements Global Zoom (GZ) and Focus+Context (F+C). In a within-subject study (N=8); 72 trials), GZ had the largest completion count (23/24; Fixed: 20/24; F+C: 21/24), whereas F+C was preferred by 6/8 participants. Therefore, completion and preference favored different mappings in this sample.
Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
迈向路径创造型导航：基于具身交互的机器人导航
在拥挤且受限环境中的自主导航通常假定环境是固定的，仅在现有的自由空间内搜索路径。然而，路线可能会被铰接结构（articulated structure）、可移动物体或行人阻挡，因此到达目标点可能需要与环境进行适当的具身交互（embodied interaction）。本文提出了路径创造型导航（Path-Creative Navigation, PCN）这一导航范式，在此范式中，机器人通过协调移动（locomotion）与具身交互来恢复自由空间，并利用无地图框架解决了一类 PCN 任务。该视觉-激光雷达-里程计（vision-LiDAR-odometry）框架通过统一的导航系统整合了局部观测、障碍物几何形状以及机器人状态估计，为导航与交互提供了稳定的语义和几何信息。
可通行性感知决策方法利用视觉和激光雷达距离信息，判断阻塞物是否可操作以及是否可以安全绕过，使机器人仅在必要时才进行交互，同时支持对铰接结构的推拉、可移动物体的推送、障碍物规避以及对行人的避让请求。
我们设计了仿真场景，并在仿真环境以及两项仅靠传统导航而无具身交互便无法完成的真实世界任务中评估了不同方法。实验结果表明，通过在拥挤且受限的环境中协调导航与交互，我们的框架达到了比基线方法更高的任务完成率。
Autonomous navigation in cluttered and constrained environments typically assumes a fixed environment and searches only for paths within existing free space. However, a route can be blocked by an articulated structure, a movable object, or a pedestrian, and reaching the goal may therefore require appropriate embodied interaction with the environment. This paper formulates Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), a navigation paradigm in which the robot recovers free space by coordinating locomotion and embodied interaction, and addresses one class of PCN tasks with a mapless framework. The vision-LiDAR-odometry framework integrates local observations, obstacle geometry, and robot-state estimates through a unified navigation system, providing stable semantic and geometric information for navigation and interaction. The traversability-aware decision method utilizes visual and LiDAR distance information to determine whether a blockage is actionable and whether it can be safely bypassed, enabling the robot to interact only when necessary while supporting articulated structure pushing, movable object pushing, obstacle avoidance, and pedestrian requests. We design simulation scenarios and evaluate different methods in both simulation and two real-world tasks that cannot be completed by conventional navigation alone without embodied interaction. These results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher task completion than the baseline methods by coordinating navigation and interaction in cluttered and constrained environments.
GentleHumanoid: Learning Upper-Body Compliance for Contact-Rich Human and Object Interaction
GentleHumanoid：学习上半身柔顺性，以实现人与物体间高接触交互
人形机器人预计将在以人为中心的环境中运行，在这些环境中，安全且物理柔顺（physically gentle）的交互至关重要。然而，近期大多数强化学习（RL）策略侧重于刚性跟踪（rigid tracking）并抑制外力。现有的结合阻抗的方法通常局限于基座或末端执行器控制，且侧重于抵抗极端外力，而非实现柔顺性（compliance）。为此，我们提出了 GentleHumanoid——一个将阻抗控制（impedance control）集成至全身运动跟踪策略中以实现上半身柔顺性的框架。其核心是一个统一的基于弹簧的公式化表达（unified spring-based formulation），该公式同时对抵抗性接触（按压表面时的恢复力）与引导性接触（从人类运动数据中采样的推力或拉力）进行建模。这一公式确保了跨肩部、肘部与手部的运动学一致力，同时使策略暴露于多样化的交互场景中。交互力进一步通过任务可调的力阈值（task-adjustable force thresholds）进行调节。
我们在仿真环境和真实人形机器人上评估了我们的方法，覆盖需要不同柔顺性水平的任务，包括拥抱、坐立辅助（sit-to-stand assistance）以及安全物体操纵。与基线方法相比，我们的策略在成功执行各项任务的同时，持续降低了峰值接触力，并将接触压力分散至多个传感器单元上。这些结果彰显了迈向能够安全柔顺且高效地与人类协同并在真实世界环境中处理物体的机器人的一步。
Humanoid robots are expected to operate in human-centered environments where safe and physically gentle interaction is essential. However, most recent reinforcement learning (RL) policies emphasize rigid tracking and suppress external forces. Existing impedance-augmented approaches are typically restricted to base or end-effector control and focus on resisting extreme forces rather than enabling compliance. We introduce GentleHumanoid, a framework that integrates impedance control into a whole-body motion tracking policy to achieve upper-body compliance. At its core is a unified spring-based formulation that models both resistive contacts (restoring forces when pressing against surfaces) and guiding contacts (pushes or pulls sampled from human motion data). This formulation ensures kinematically consistent forces across the shoulders, elbows, and hands, while exposing the policy to diverse interaction scenarios. Interaction forces are further regulated through task-adjustable force thresholds. We evaluate our approach in both simulation and real humanoid across tasks requiring different levels of compliance, including hugging, sit-to-stand assistance, and safe object manipulation. Compared to baselines, our policy consistently reduces peak contact forces and distributes contact pressure across multiple sensor cells while successfully performing each task. These results highlight a step toward humanoid robots that can gently and effectively collaborate with humans and handle objects in real-world environments.
Compliant GMT: Making General Motion Tracking Compliant via Residual Reference Adaptation
柔顺化GMT：通过残差参考自适应实现通用运动跟踪的柔顺性
为此，我们提出了 Compliant GMT (C-GMT)——一个用于在通用运动跟踪中实现全身柔顺响应（full-body compliant responses）的模块化框架。随着人形机器人步入真实世界的部署应用，它们不仅需要能够执行任意动作，还需要对交互力做出安全且鲁棒的响应。现有的通用运动跟踪策略虽然可以模仿多样化的运动，但在训练中往往偏向于刚性（stiff），这会在受到干扰时导致意外且不安全的行为。此前在柔顺人形机器人控制方面的研究则在柔顺性（compliance）与通用性（generality）之间做出了权衡。虽然存在全身柔顺响应的案例，但这些方法严重依赖于针对单参考动作策略（single-reference policies）的精细调校。另一方面，通用运动跟踪器（GMT）则旨在刚性地模仿海量的动作捕捉数据集。
我们的核心见解在于：充分利用预训练 GMT 在运动跟踪方面的通用性，同时通过一个以本体感觉历史数据（history of proprioception）为条件的残差适配器（residual adapter）来引入柔顺性。这使得我们的 C-GMT 方法能够同时兼顾通用运动跟踪能力与全身柔顺响应能力。
与最先进的通用运动跟踪器及单动作柔顺策略相比，C-GMT 在运动跟踪精度和柔顺性遵循度方面均展现出了极具竞争力的性能。我们在仿真环境以及真实的宇树 Unitree G1 机器人实验中，进一步验证了该方法在安全性、鲁棒性以及容错能力上的显著提升。
We propose Compliant GMT (C-GMT), a modular framework for full-body compliant responses in general motion tracking. As humanoid robots move into real world deployment, they not only need to perform any motion but also respond safely and robustly to interaction forces. Existing general motion tracking policies can imitate diverse motions but are trained to be stiff, leading to unexpected and unsafe behaviors under disturbance. Prior work in compliant humanoid control trades off compliance and generality. There exist examples of full-body compliant responses, but these are heavily curated to single-reference policies. On the other hand, general motion trackers (GMT) are trained to rigidly imitate massive motion capture datasets. Our key insight is to leverage the generality of pretrained GMTs for motion tracking while introducing compliance from a residual adapter that conditions on a history of proprioception. This enables our approach, C-GMT, to achieve both general motion tracking and whole-body compliant responses. Compared to state-of-the-art general motion trackers and single-motion compliant policies, C-GMT demonstrates competitive performance in both motion tracking accuracy and compliance adherence. We further demonstrate improved safety, robustness, and error tolerance in simulation and real-world G1 experiments.
VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
VioLA：从人类数据中学习通用型人形机器人控制策略
指导人形机器人运用全身遵循指令面临着两大障碍。首先，其动作空间庞大且高度耦合：双腿、双臂与手指必须在机器人维持平衡的同时协调运动，这使得关节层面的动作极难学习。其次，人形机器人的示范数据十分稀缺，导致现有的通用人形机器人策略无法直接开箱即用（out of the box）地遵循新指令，必须在部署前对每项任务的遥操作示范数据进行微调。虽然人类示范数据的数量远为庞大，但人类的运动模式并不能直接转化为机器人的控制指令。我们通过改变通用策略所预测的内容，同时消除了这两大障碍。我们提出了 VioLA——一个预测身体与手部运动潜在表征（motion latents）而非关节指令的通用人形机器人策略。
预训练的身体与手部控制器在机器人上执行这些潜在表征。其对应的运动编码器将人类与机器人的运动映射至相同的潜在空间中。因此，一段人类视频记录即可在策略的动作空间内被直接标注，训练示范数据集包含了 1.406 亿帧数据，其中 93.2% 来自人类数据。结果表明，VioLA 在真实机器人上实现了零样本（zero-shot）遵循移动指令而无需特定任务的微调，达到了 100% 的成功率，而 GR00T N1.7 和 $\Psi_0$ 的成功率分别为 16.7% 和 0%。在无需特定任务微调的情况下，它还达到了 88.6% 的操纵成功率。
相同的机制在两种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和一个世界-动作模型（WAM）骨干网络上均能有效运行。仅在人类示范数据上训练的通用策略，即可在真实机器人上零样本执行移动任务。代码与 Checkpoints 将予以开源。
Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and Ψ0 reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.
QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
QF3：采用经滤波 Q 梯度的快速流强化学习
流策略（flow policies）已成为从示范数据中学习机器人行为的标准策略类别，但强化学习（RL）对于改进预训练流策略或通过交互从头开始（from scratch）学习流策略仍至关重要。为此，我们提出了 QF3（基于过滤 Q-梯度的快速流强化学习，Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients）——一个在线离策略（off-policy）强化学习算法，它结合流匹配（flow matching）与 Critic 的动作梯度，并通过流输出的单步预测反向传播来训练流策略。为了将更新限制在 Critic 和该预测均可靠的区域，QF3 仅将 Critic 梯度作用于接近重放动作（replay action）的动作维度上。据我们所知，QF3 是首个从头开始训练人形机器人移动策略并将其零样本（zero-shot）迁移至硬件的离策略流强化学习方法。
结合高吞吐量的离策略训练范式，QF3 在训练人形机器人移动与运动跟踪策略时，相比最近的在策略（on-policy）流强化学习方法 FPO++ 实现了 10 倍的实际时间（wall-clock）加速。
我们进一步将 QF3 应用于在 ABC-Sim 与 Robomimic 任务上微调预训练的基于流的操纵策略。这些结果表明，QF3 既能从头开始学习机器人策略，又能精炼从示范数据中获取的策略。
Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations.
CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
CoHuB：面向多类人机器人协作的仿真基准
人类环境中的许多物理任务都需要协同合作，从协助搭档到共同操纵物体皆是如此。然而，现有的人形机器人基准测试大部分侧重于单人形机器人的技能，缺乏在自我中心视角（egocentric visual observations）下对多人形机器人协同合作的评估。为此，我们推出了 COHUB（多人形机器人协同基准，Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark）——一个用于在自我中心视觉观测下进行多人形机器人协同合作的仿真基准测试。COHUB 提供了 10 项任务（其中 8 项由两台人形机器人协同，2 项由三台人形机器人协同），涵盖了多样化的协同模式。
我们还提供了通过多操作员 VR 遥操作流程收集的同步示范数据，在此流程中，每位操作员均从单台人形机器人的自我中心视角对其进行独立控制。
使用代表性视觉运动策略（visuomotor policies）进行的实验表明，在不同形式的协调感知与控制方面仍存在巨大挑战。COHUB 为开发和评估多人形机器人协同策略奠定了坚实基础。
Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multihumanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce COHUB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. COHUB provides 10 tasks—eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids—spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. COHUB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.
From Hitter to Player: Separating Motor Execution and Strategy in Competitive Humanoid Table Tennis
从“击球者”到“选手”：在竞技类人形机器人乒乓球运动中区分动作执行与策略
竞争性人形机器人乒乓球运动需要两项截然不同的能力：执行期望的回球以及决定将球回击至何处。我们将这两个问题进行解耦，以球的落点目标（landing target）作为运动控制与战术策略之间的接口。具体而言，我们首先训练一个以期望落点目标为条件的全身运动策略，通过基于模型的击球规划器（model-based strike planner）与学习型控制器，将落点目标映射为可执行的人形机器人击球动作。随后，我们在闭环多拍对打（closed-loop rallies）中通过自我对弈（self-play）改进运动策略，使机器人学会处理由另一名玩家产生的来球，而不仅是预设来球；在此阶段，落点目标仍不考虑对手进行采样，从而在不学习战术策略的同时提升了执行性能。最后，我们冻结整个运动栈（motor stack），并通过竞争性自我对弈训练一个击球级别的战术策略来选择落点目标。
运动自我对弈在多拍对打过程中同时提升了落点准确率与合法回球率。更重要的是，在整个运动栈保持固定的情况下，仅改变目标选择策略便会导致比赛结果产生显著差异：所学策略对阵击打中心、随机以及远离对手等基线方法时，分别赢得了 89%、82% 和 73% 的分数。该策略还会根据对手的位置与前一个落点动态调整击球位置，这表明自我对弈学到的不仅是简单地瞄准固定的“优势”位置。
在硬件实体上，相同的冻结执行栈与战术接口成功支持了与业余人类对手（recreational human opponent）展开完整的 11 分制比赛，其中涵盖了结合正手（forehand）与反手（backhand）回球的多拍对打。
Competitive humanoid table tennis requires two distinct abilities: executing a desired return and deciding where to return the ball. We separate these two problems, with the ball landing target serving as an interface between motor control and strategy. (1) We first train a whole-body motor policy conditioned on the desired landing target, which maps the target to an executable humanoid stroke through a model-based strike planner and a learned controller. (2) We then improve the motor policy through self-play in closed-loop rallies, where the robot learns to handle incoming balls generated by another player rather than only prescribed incoming balls. At this stage, the landing targets are still sampled without considering the opponent, so the policy improves its execution without learning game strategy. (3) Finally, we freeze the entire motor stack and train a stroke-level strategic policy to choose landing targets through competitive self-play.
Motor self-play improves both landing accuracy and legal-return rate during rallies. More importantly, with the entire motor stack fixed, changing only the target-selection policy leads to large differences in game outcomes: the learned strategy wins 89%, 82%, and 73% of points against center, random, and away-from-opponent baselines, respectively. The learned strategy also changes where it sends the ball according to the opponent's position and the previous target, showing that self-play learns more than simply aiming at fixed "good" locations. On hardware, the same frozen execution stack and strategic interface support complete 11-point games against a recreational human opponent, including multi-stroke rallies with both forehand and backhand returns.
DEX-PHD: A Dexterous Portable Handheld Device for Multimodal Data Collection
DEX-PHD：一种用于多模态数据采集的灵巧型便携手持设备
现有的操纵数据收集方法通常要么通过基于运动学链的遥操作提供精准的机器人状态获取，要么通过基于视觉的方法实现便捷且便携的操作。为此，我们提出了 DEX-PHD——一个便携式手持设备（portable handheld device），它通过集成灵巧机器人手、连续的单指控制（continuous per-finger control）以及多模态日志记录，将上述两者的优势结合用于灵巧操纵。该系统在操作员通过关节级映射直接控制机器人手的同时，记录本体感觉信息、指尖接触数据以及腕部摄像头视频。其无绳化设计（untethered design）支持在多样化环境中进行数据收集。
我们在需要协调多指操纵的富接触任务上演示了 DEX-PHD，并通过开环重放（open-loop replay）将收集到的示范数据部署于实体人形机器人上。
结果表明，开环重放保留了手指运动与任务相关接触的主要时序模式。因此，DEX-PHD 为便携式、多模态灵巧操纵数据的收集提供了一个实用的平台。
Existing manipulation data collection methods typically offer either accurate robot-state acquisition through kinematic-chain-based teleoperation or convenient, portable operation through vision-based approaches. We present DEX-PHD, a portable handheld device that combines these advantages for dexterous manipulation by integrating a dexterous robot hand, continuous per-finger control, and multimodal logging. The system records proprioceptive information, fingertip contact data, and wrist-camera video, while the operator directly controls the robot hand through joint-level mapping. Its untethered design enables data collection across diverse environments. We demonstrate DEX-PHD on contact-rich tasks requiring coordinated multi-finger manipulation and deploy the collected demonstrations through open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot. The results show that open-loop replay preserves the main temporal patterns of finger motion and task-relevant contact. Therefore, DEX-PHD provides a practical platform for portable, multimodal dexterous manipulation data collection.
Not an Accident: Exploiting Safety Filter Inadequacy in Humanoid Robots
并非意外：利用人形机器人安全过滤机制的缺陷
随着人形机器人从研究实验室走向家庭、医院和仓库等以人为中心的环境中部署应用，在附近的人类与物体周围进行安全运行已成为一项根本性要求。安全过滤器（safety filters）已成为应对这一挑战的一项具备前景的技术，它通过提供数学保证，确保所生成的控制动作不会导致碰撞。本文表明，这些保证仅在安全参数配置正确时方能成立。然而，正确的参数配置取决于特定任务与特定环境，且目前尚无通用方法能在多样化的部署场景中予以确定。因此，人形机器人出厂配备的安全过滤器在特定场景部署后可能会发生失效。我们展示了攻击者仅通过正常的用户交互、无需任何额外权限或能力，即可利用这些失效点。
为了展示这种风险，我们提出了目标插入攻击（goal insertion attacks），并开发了自动化工具 SIREN，用于针对给定任务和环境识别易受攻击的插入目标。
实验结果表明，SIREN 成功识别了 SPARK 数据集中所有易受攻击场景下的攻击。与基线方法相比，SIREN 发现的攻击数量达到了后者的三倍。我们还表明，SIREN 能够针对真实的人形机器人生成攻击，并使其在执行任务时发生碰撞。这些结果表明，现有的安全过滤器引入了可被利用的漏洞并引发安全违规，揭示了现有的安全机制本身可能会成为人形机器人安全风险的来源。
As humanoid robots move from research laboratories toward deployment in human-centered environments such as homes, hospitals, and warehouses, safe operation around nearby people and objects becomes a fundamental requirement. Safety filters have emerged as a promising technique to address this challenge by providing mathematical guarantees that generated control actions do not result in collisions.
This paper shows that these guarantees hold only when the safety parameters are configured correctly. However, correct parameter configurations are task- and environment-specific, and no general method exists to determine them across diverse deployments. As a result, safety filters shipped with humanoid robots can fail after deployment in specific scenarios. We show that attackers can exploit these failures through only normal user interactions without any additional privileges or capabilities. To demonstrate this risk, we present goal insertion attacks and develop SIREN, an automated tool that identifies vulnerable inserting goals for a given task and environment. Experimental results show that SIREN identifies attacks in all vulnerable scenarios in the SPARK dataset. Compared with a baseline approach, SIREN discovers three times as many attacks. We also show that SIREN is able to generate attacks against a real humanoid and cause it to collide while executing tasks. These results demonstrate that current safety filters introduce exploitable vulnerabilities that can cause safety violations, which reveals that existing safety mechanisms can themselves become a source of safety risk for humanoid robots.
Humanoid Mobility via Attention-based Contacts
基于接触注意力的类人机器人移动
复杂地形下的人形机器人移动需要精确的落脚点选择与具备强大自适应能力的协调全身运动。无需运动参考训练的强化学习（RL）策略在各类地形上具有良好的泛化能力，但仅通过奖励设计与探索来诱导有效的全身协调仍然充满挑战。相比之下，基于参考的方法虽然能产生自然的运动，却难以适应其训练数据中预定义轨迹之外的场景。为此，我们引入了一个学习框架，该框架将运动数据严格用作训练先验（training prior），从而将这两种方法桥接起来。
一个显式的、自监督的、基于注意力的接触规划器（attention-based contact planner）负责预测未来的身体-环境接触，而接触条件下的跟踪器（contact-conditioned tracker）则将这些规划转化为协调的全身运动。它们共同将“接触”（contact）确立为感官观测与控制动作之间的接口。这种抽象使策略能够内化移动的接触感知结构，而非直接复制运动学。因此，单一策略既能利用数据驱动的运动先验来实现自然的全身协调，又能保留通过强化学习发现环境依赖行为的灵活性。在此基础上，随后的微调阶段利用已学习到的接触规划器和跟踪器的能力，探索超出原始运动数据覆盖范围的环境变化。
该框架在部署时完全依托机载观测运行，无需任何参考输入，从而在具有挑战性的环境中实现了多功能的人形机器人移动能力。
Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained without motion references generalize well across terrains, yet eliciting effective whole-body coordination through reward design and exploration alone remains challenging. In contrast, reference-based methods yield natural motions but struggle to adapt beyond the predefined trajectories in their training data. We introduce a learning framework that bridges these two approaches by using motion data strictly as a training prior. An explicit, self-supervised, attention-based contact planner predicts future body-environment contacts, while a contact-conditioned tracker translates these plans into coordinated whole-body motion. Together, they establish contact as an interface between sensory observations and control actions. This abstraction allows the policy to internalize the contact-aware structure of locomotion rather than directly replicating kinematics. Consequently, a single policy can exploit data-driven motion priors for natural whole-body coordination while retaining the flexibility to discover environment-dependent behaviors through reinforcement learning. Building on the learned contact planner and tracker, a subsequent fine-tuning stage bootstraps their acquired capabilities to explore environment variations beyond those covered by the original motion data. Operating entirely from onboard observations without any reference inputs at deployment, this framework enables versatile humanoid mobility in challenging environments.
Learning Tactile-Aware Hand Representations from Human Hand-Object Interaction Data
从人类手与物体交互数据中学习具备触觉感知能力的手部表征
灵巧操纵（dexterous manipulation）的触觉表征学习通常需要大量的机器人端数据收集，这限制了其在不同手部和传感器之间的可扩展性。我们探讨了大规模人类手-物交互（Hand-Object Interaction, HOI）数据是否能为机器人触觉学习提供有用的先验。为此，我们提出了 HuTact——一个从人类 HOI 数据中预训练触觉感知手部表征的框架，且在预训练过程中无需真实的触觉信号。
HuTact 将从人类手部运动中学到的交互结构迁移至机器人的触觉观测中，并且可以通过少量的未标记机器人交互数据进行进一步的自适应调整。我们在触觉感知与操纵任务（包括抓取预测、滑移检测、物体分类以及触觉条件策略学习）上对 HuTact 进行了评估。
在这些任务中，人类 HOI 预训练提升了数据效率，并为下游学习提供了强有力的初始化。值得注意的是，在经过 HOI 预训练以及在未标记机器人试玩数据上进行中期训练（midtraining）后，HuTact 仅使用 25% 的标记下游数据就在抓取预测上达到了 88.26% 的 Macro-F1 分数，这与使用完整标记数据集从头训练的结果（88.23%）相当。这些结果表明，人类交互数据可以作为机器人触觉表征学习的一种可扩展的互补来源。
Tactile representation learning for dexterous manipulation often requires substantial robot-side data collection, limiting its scalability across different hands and sensors. We explore whether large-scale human hand-object interaction (HOI) data can provide a useful prior for robotic tactile learning. To this end, we propose HuTact, a framework that pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from human HOI data without requiring real tactile signals during pretraining. HuTact transfers the interaction structure learned from human hand motions to robotic tactile observations and can be further adapted with a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data. We evaluate HuTact on tactile perception and manipulation tasks, including grasp prediction, slip detection, object classification, and tactile-conditioned policy learning. Across these tasks, human HOI pretraining improves data efficiency and provides a strong initialization for downstream learning. Notably, with HOI pretraining followed by midtraining on unlabeled robot play data, HuTact achieves 88.26% Macro-F1 on grasp prediction using only 25\% of the labeled downstream data, comparable to training from scratch on the full labeled dataset (88.23%). These results suggest that human interaction data can serve as a scalable complementary source for robotic tactile representation learning.
SP-HLM: Sparse-Pose-Driven Motion Generation and Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
SP-HLM：面向人形机器人移动操作的稀疏姿态驱动运动生成与全身控制
人形机器人移动操纵（humanoid loco-manipulation）需要在高层任务策略与全身控制之间建立有效的接口。现有的接口通常依赖单一的动作表征来同时兼顾任务意图与全身协调，这可能会加重高层策略的负担，或导致其中某一方面无法被充分指定。为此，我们提出了 SP-HLM——一个基于稀疏姿态驱动接口（sparse-pose-driven interface）构建的框架。该接口将五个任务关键的身体姿态与学习到的隐空间运动先验结合，以互补的形式来表征空间意图与全身协调。
作为视觉-语言-动作模型，SP-VLA 首先通过异步动作块推理（asynchronous action-chunk inference），从多模态观测与语言指令中预测任务相关的稀疏姿态以及手指关节位置。给定这些稀疏目标后，通过两阶段蒸馏训练的运动生成模型 SP-MGM 能够实时重建出协调的全身运动。预训练的运动编码器将该运动映射为紧凑的潜在表征。通用运动跟踪器 SP-GMT 随后将显式稀疏目标与该隐式运动先验相集成，用于全身控制。
在仿真环境以及真实人形机器人上进行的实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在运动跟踪、全身协调以及移动操纵成功率方面均取得了显著提升。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches.
HIPC: Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control via Goal-Conditioned Motion Closure
HIPC：基于目标条件运动闭合的类人机器人迭代规划与控制
近期，生成式模型已被广泛用于为人形机器人跟踪提供全身运动。当前的方法采用开环范式将运动生成器与控制器相结合，这导致了关键问题：跟踪误差会累积为空间漂移，且在没有物理执行反馈的情况下，规划器无法适应未预料到的物理干扰。然而，如果在闭环中将实际执行状态（realized states）直接反馈给规划器，则可能导致不连续性，从而引起物理抖动甚至跌倒，因为此类状态在训练期间属于分布外（out-of-distribution）数据。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了 HIPC（实时人形机器人迭代规划与控制，Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control）——一个将生成式模型与运动跟踪耦合为统一规划控制范式的实时框架。
HIPC 引入了一种目标条件下的运动规划，该规划采用规范运动表征（canonical motion representation）进行训练，从而在极端朝向下避免万向节死锁（gimbal-lock）奇点，并支持在多样化几何与语义条件下进行运动生成。随后，HIPC 采用了偏差衰减恢复（deviation-decayed recovery）和历史重新锚定（history re-anchoring）两种策略，以减轻由实际状态反馈引起的分布外偏移。最后，HIPC 运行一个实时的异步规划与控制系统，并配备延迟补偿（latency compensation）机制，以减少推理延迟所带来的时间错配。
广泛的实验证实了 HIPC 在多样化条件的切换与组合下的有效性。结果表明，在现有方法中，HIPC 实现了最先进的目标到达准确率，同时展示了对物理扰动的鲁棒性以及从跌倒中恢复的能力。
Recent generative models are widely used to provide whole-body motion for humanoid tracking. Current methods combine motion generators with controllers in an open-loop paradigm, which leads to critical issues: tracking errors can accumulate into spatial drift, and the planner cannot adapt to unexpected physical disturbances without feedback from physical execution. However, directly feeding realized states back to the planner in a closed loop can cause discontinuities, resulting in physical jitter and even falls, since such states are out of distribution during training. To bridge this gap, we propose HIPC, a real-time Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control framework that couples a generative model with motion tracking into a unified planning-and-control paradigm. HIPC introduces a goal-conditioned motion planning trained with a canonical motion representation that avoids gimbal-lock singularities under extreme orientations and supports motion generation on diverse geometric and semantic conditions. Then, HIPC adopts two strategies, deviation-decayed recovery and history re-anchoring, to mitigate the out-of-distribution shift caused by realized-state feedback. Finally, HIPC operates a real-time asynchronous planning-and-control system, with latency compensation to reduce temporal mismatch for inference delay. Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness of HIPC under switching and composition of diverse conditions. Results show that HIPC achieves state-of-the-art goal-reaching accuracy among existing methods while simultaneously demonstrating robustness to physical perturbations and the ability to recover from falls.
MAPO: Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization for Universal Humanoid Motion Tracking
MAPO：用于通用人形机器人运动追踪的“专家混合模型与交替策略优化”方法
通用人形机器人运动跟踪（universal humanoid motion tracking）对于使人形机器人能够在人类环境中执行多样化任务至关重要。为了捕捉人类运动的广泛多样性，混合专家（Mixture of Experts, MoE）策略已被广泛采用，其利用动态路由（dynamic routing）来增强策略的表现力。然而，我们发现，由于 MoE 策略的动态路由特性，在策略梯度更新过程中，新旧策略之间的散度（divergence）可能会被错误估计。由于大多数策略梯度算法都是基于散度来调节策略更新的，这种错误估计会导致更新过于保守或过大，进而产生亚优策略。
为此，我们提出了 MAPO（交替策略优化的混合专家，Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization）——该方法通过交替优化路由器（router）与专家（experts）来有效避免散度错误估计。
实验表明，MAPO 稳定地跟踪了 182 个集成 MoE 的 PPO（PPO with MoE）无法跟踪的动作，而集成 MoE 的 PPO 仅跟踪了一个 MAPO 无法跟踪的动作。在对比方法中，MAPO 还取得了最高的跟踪成功率以及在绝大多数误差指标上的最低跟踪误差，充分证明了其优越的性能。
Universal humanoid motion tracking is essential for enabling humanoid robots to perform diverse tasks in human environments. To capture the wide diversity of human motions, mixture-of-experts (MoE) policies have been widely adopted, leveraging dynamic routing to enhance policy expressiveness. However, we identify that divergence between old and updated policies can be misestimated during policy-gradient updates of MoE policies, due to their dynamic routing. Because most policy-gradient algorithms regulate policy updates based on the divergence, this misestimation can lead to either overly conservative or excessively large updates, which can yield a suboptimal policy. In this paper, we propose Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization (MAPO), which alternately optimizes the router and the experts to avoid the divergence misestimation. MAPO consistently tracks 182 motions that PPO with MoE fails to track, whereas PPO with MoE tracks only one motion that MAPO fails to track. MAPO also attains the highest tracking success rate among the compared methods and the lowest tracking error across most error metrics, demonstrating its superior performance.
Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
像这样行走：通过基于示例的扩散实现物理驱动角色的风格化运动
我们提出了一种用于具表达力的腿式运动（expressive legged locomotion）的实时框架，该框架能够实现对速度和风格的独立控制。与通常需要显式风格标签进行训练的现有数据驱动控制器不同，我们的方法能够高效利用大规模非结构化运动数据（large-scale unstructured motion data），并泛化至未见过的风格。
我们通过一种定制的采样策略将风格与功能性运动解耦，该采样策略用于训练一个风格编码器，其输出进而条件化一个自回归扩散模型（autoregressive diffusion model）。在推断（inference）过程中，用户提供一个风格参考片段和一个操纵杆速度指令。随后，扩散模型生成一个由强化学习控制器进行跟踪的运动学参考。为了提高用户的可控性与风格化强度，我们提出了一种注意力偏置机制（attention biasing mechanism）和速度指令校正策略。
我们在仿真环境中的基于物理的人形角色以及实体机器人上验证了我们的方法，展示了强大的实时控制能力与连续的风格调制（continuous style modulation）。
We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation.
Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
不混溶扩散策略：通过无标签噪声分配保留多模态机器人动作
当扩散策略（diffusion policies）首次被提出时，人们期望它们能够恢复多模态的动作分布。然而，我们发现这种期望并不总能成立，因为即使在保证数据集模态平衡和批内严格对称性的情况下，扩散策略也经常发生坍缩至单一模态的现象。我们的分析表明，独立的动作-噪声配对（independent action-noise pairing）通过增加扩散路径之间的混合与交叉，导致了这一失效，进而产生平均化的去噪响应并抑制了模态特定的行为。在机器人规划中，这一问题尤为严重，因为其动作空间密集且低维，从而显著加剧了这种混合与交叉。
为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了 Immiscible Diffusion Policy（不相混溶扩散策略）——这是一种针对扩散策略的、无需标签的训练阶段附加组件（training-time add-on），它通过动作-噪声分配（action-noise assignment）来保持相对独特的噪声到动作路径（noise-to-action routes），同时无需修改策略架构或推理过程。在涵盖状态、RGB 以及点云观测的五项仿真与两项真实世界人形机器人操纵任务中，我们的方法在维持强大任务性能的同时，显著提升了策略对动作多模态的保持能力。
它在三个双模态任务中将非主导模态的比例提高了 6.0 倍至 14.6 倍，并且在两个四模态任务中恢复了在常规（vanilla）策略推理中完全缺失的示范模态。这些结果表明，Immiscible Diffusion Policy 为在通用机器人学习任务中保持动作多模态提供了一种简单而鲁棒的方法。
When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.
HumiMimic: Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos
HumiMimic：从真实场景视频中实现人与人形机器人交互的具身模仿迁移
使人形机器人能够与人类伙伴进行自然交互，不仅需要保留个体动作，还需要保留交互背后所隐含的空间、语义和接触关系（如拥抱、跳舞、握手等）。此外，一个实用的解决方案应当能够跨越具有不同形态学和运动学约束的各种人形机器人具身（embodiments）实现泛化。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 HumiTransfer——一个拟态具身迁移框架（mimetic embodiment transfer framework），它能够将野外采集的人-人交互视频转换为物理上合理的人-人形机器人交互（human-humanoid interactions）。
HumiTransfer 首先重建出具有一致性足地接触（foot-ground contact）的三维人类运动，随后通过交互建模将其中一名参与者迁移至目标人形机器人具身，利用加权关节相对方向和解剖学偏移来优先考虑对交互至关重要的身体间关系，同时通过重定向后优化（post-retargeting optimization）来强制实现平衡、接触和碰撞避免。随后，我们将 HumiTransfer 应用于 1,200 个野外视频，针对 26 自由度的宇树 R1 Edu（Unitree R1 Edu）和 23 自由度的 HighTorque Mini-hi 人形机器人生成了约 500,000 帧的多样化交互数据，从而构建了我们的 HumiMimic 数据集。
在这两种机器人上，与现有基线方法相比，HumiTransfer 实现了卓越的运动保真度，保留了身体间关系，并保持了接触准确性。此外，我们证明了 HumiMimic 支持用于合成跟随人类伙伴的交互式人形机器人运动的运动生成方法。最后，我们在真实机器人上的部署证实了所迁移运动在现实世界环境中的物理可执行性。
Enabling a humanoid to interact naturally with human partners requires preserving not only individual motions but also the spatial, semantic, and contact relationships underlying the interaction (i.e., hugging, dancing, hand-shaking, etc.). Furthermore, a practical solution should generalize across various humanoid embodiments with distinct morphologies and kinematic constraints. To tackle this challenge, we propose HumiTransfer, a mimetic embodiment transfer framework that converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions. HumiTransfer first reconstructs 3D human motion with consistent foot-ground contact, then transfers one participant to a target humanoid embodiment via interaction modeling, using weighted joint-relative directions and anatomical offsets to prioritize interaction-critical inter-body relationships, while post-retargeting optimization enforces balance, contact, and collision avoidance. Subsequently, we apply HumiTransfer to 1,200 in-the-wild videos, producing approximately 500,000 frames of diverse interactions for the 26-DoF Unitree R1 Edu and the 23-DoF HighTorque Mini-hi humanoid robot, resulting in our HumiMimic dataset. Across both robots, HumiTransfer achieves superior motion fidelity, preserves inter-body relationships, and maintains contact accuracy compared with existing baselines. Moreover, we demonstrate that HumiMimic supports motion generation methods for synthesizing interactive humanoid motions following a human partner. Finally, our real robot deployments confirm the physical executability of the transferred motions in real-world settings.
ReGATE: Recurrent Gated Visual Fusion for Reactive Humanoid-Object Interaction
ReGATE：用于响应式人形机器人-物体交互的循环门控视觉融合方法
人形机器人移动操纵（humanoid loco-manipulation）需要基于机载感知协调物体的获取、运输与释放，同时对用户指令和不完整的视觉观测作出响应。为此，我们推出了 ReGATE——一个结合了自我中心深度信息、本体感觉以及在线移动与接触指令的全身控制器。ReGATE 基于教师-学生（teacher-student）框架构建，通过一个无需外部物体姿态估计器的循环适配器（recurrent adapter）预测物体几何形状与物理接触，从而整合了交互状态估计。
头部级（head-wise）与全局门控机制调节着针对本体感觉通路的视觉更新。视觉接地（visual-grounding）与损坏课程（corruption curriculum）用于训练该适配器，而相位感知初始化（phase-aware initialization）则扩大了对短暂接触过渡过程的覆盖率。
在仿真环境中，ReGATE 在 330 次静态物体获取实验中达到了 85.2% 的成功率（在相同协议下 VisualMimic 仅为 48.5%），并在 440 次动态物体获取实验中达到了 85.9% 的成功率。在宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上的实际部署展示了受控的“抓取-运输-释放”序列以及对侧向偏移方盒的成功获取。一项定性的硬件实验进一步证实，在初始观测之后、发出接触指令之前将摄像头遮挡的情况下，机器人仍能成功完成方盒获取。据我们所知，这是首个将机载深度信息与本体感觉的循环门控融合（recurrent gated fusion）从感知移动扩展至视觉感知受中断条件下的人形机器人移动操纵的研究工作。
Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating object acquisition, transport, and release from onboard sensing while responding to user commands and incomplete visual observations. We present ReGATE, a whole-body controller that combines egocentric depth, proprioception, and online locomotion and contact commands. Built on a teacher-student framework, ReGATE integrates interaction-state estimation through a recurrent adapter that predicts object geometry and physical contact without an external object-pose estimator. Head-wise and global gates regulate visual updates to a proprioceptive pathway. A visual-grounding and corruption curriculum trains the adapter, while phase-aware initialization increases coverage of brief contact transitions. In simulation, ReGATE achieves 85.2% success across 330 static-object acquisition trials, compared with 48.5% for VisualMimic under the same protocol, and 85.9% across 440 moving-object acquisition trials. Deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates commanded grasp-transport-release sequences and acquisition of laterally displaced boxes. A qualitative hardware experiment further demonstrates successful box acquisition when the camera is occluded after an initial observation and before the contact command. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to extend recurrent gated fusion of onboard depth and proprioception from perceptive locomotion to humanoid loco-manipulation under interrupted visual sensing.
HuG: Learning Humanoid Whole-Body Affordance-Aware Grasping with Active Perception
HuG：通过主动感知学习拟人化全身“可供性”感知抓取
在人类环境中获取物体对人形机器人而言极具挑战性：在自我中心视角下，目标物体往往受到部分遮挡，而触及这些物体则需要协调的全身运动，以便在保持基座稳定的同时，确保目标既可见又可触及。为此，我们提出了 HuG——一个通过“感知-对齐-抓取”（Perceive-Align-Grasp）流水线将感知与动作耦合的全身可供性感知与主动感知（affordance-aware grasping with active perception）框架。该框架的核心机制包括：基于信念的主动感知通过将视点作为显式决策变量来解决遮挡问题；点云条件化的可供性策略提出全身抓取方案；以及一个可供性感知对齐阶段，将机器人躯体重新定位至最具可执行性的构型。一个关键的洞察是，在浮动基座上，运动学有效性是远远不够的：我们利用控制器闭环动力学仿真来精选训练数据，拒绝了 73% 会使部署控制器不稳定的运动学有效抓取，从而使策略能够学习到具有动力学可行性的可供性（kinodynamically feasible affordances）。
HuG 完全在仿真中进行训练，无需任何真实世界示范，便在多层货架任务上实现了 87.5% 的真实世界成功率，能够泛化至新颖物体，并在所有测试高度下保持至少 73% 的成功率。除了在训练分布内进行泛化外，该策略还能进行空间外推：在仿真中进行规模化测试时，它成功应对了训练期间未曾见过的远低于常规高度的桌面场景，这表明经动力学过滤的合成数据将可供性根植于物体几何形状与全身可行性之中，而非依赖于记忆的构型。
Acquiring objects in human environments is hard for humanoids: targets are partially occluded under egocentric viewpoints, and reaching them demands coordinated whole-body motion that keeps the target visible and reachable while the base stays stable. We present HuG, a framework for whole-body affordance-aware grasping with active perception that couples perception and action through a Perceive-Align-Grasp pipeline: belief-driven active perception resolves occlusion by treating viewpoint as an explicit decision variable; a point-cloud-conditioned affordance policy proposes whole-body grasps; and an affordance-aware alignment stage repositions the body to the most executable configuration. A key insight is that, on a floating base, kinematic validity is not enough: we curate training data with controller-in-the-loop dynamics simulation, rejecting 73% of kinematically valid grasps that would destabilize the deployment controller, so the policy learns kinodynamically feasible affordances. Trained entirely in simulation with zero real demonstrations, HuG attains 87.5% real-world success on a multi-level shelf task, generalizes to novel objects, and holds at least 73% success at every tested height. Beyond generalizing within its training distribution, the policy extrapolates spatially: at scale in simulation it succeeds at table heights well below any seen during training, indicating that kinodynamically filtered synthetic data grounds affordances in object geometry and whole-body feasibility rather than in memorized configurations.
Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
基于仿真的感知型类人运动
随着人形机器人有望自动化广泛的物理任务，朝着通用人形机器人自主性（generalist humanoid autonomy）的进展仍然受到数据瓶颈的制约：将像素和自由形式的语言映射到底层关节指令需要配对监督（paired supervision），而足够大规模的此类数据语料库目前并不存在。一些方法依赖于人类遥操作和可穿戴捕捉设备，这需要至少一小时的人工时间来产生一小时的数据。为此，我们提出了 HALO——一个由数据合成流水线驱动的人形机器人自主系统，该流水线能够在数千个程序化生成的家庭环境中合成视觉-语言-运动数据，从而使语料库规模能够随计算资源而非人工劳动而扩展.
HALO 获取了一系列丰富的物理技能，包括坐在椅子上、导航至命名物体、侧向穿过半开的门、在桌子下方蹲伏和爬行以及推动方盒，并通过编排这些技能来解决复合的长视距（long-horizon）任务。在训练过程中从未见过真实家庭环境的情况下，HALO 实现了向物理世界的零样本（zero-shot）迁移.
在对六个未映射的真实世界环境中的 360 次试验进行评估时，HALO 取得了 91% 的成功率。这些结果表明，基于程序化生成环境的大规模合成数据流水线能够有效克服数据瓶颈，实现人形机器人在真实世界复杂场景中的通用自主性与稳健部署。
Humanoid robots have the potential to automate a wide range of physical tasks. Progress toward generalist humanoid autonomy, however, remains constrained by a data bottleneck: mapping pixels and free-form language to low-level joint commands requires paired supervision, and no corpus of such data exists at sufficiently large scale. Some approaches rely on human teleoperation and wearable capture devices, which require at least an hour of human time to produce an hour of data. We present HALO, a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes. The corpus scales with compute rather than human labor. HALO acquires a repertoire of physical skills, including sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. It orchestrates these skills to solve composite, long-horizon tasks. Without ever seeing a real home during training, HALO transfers zero-shot to the physical world, achieving a 91% success rate across 360 trials in six unmapped real-world environments.
Learning Versatile Humanoid Manipulation with Touch Dreaming
通过“触觉畅想”（Touch Dreaming）学习通用人形机器人操作技能
人形机器人有望提供通用型协助，然而现实世界中的人形机器人移动操纵（loco-manipulation）依然充满挑战，因为它在频繁的接触变化下需要全身稳定性、灵巧手以及接触感知的感知能力。在这项工作中，我们研究了灵巧的、富含接触的人形机器人移动操纵。我们首先开发了一个基于强化学习（RL）的全身控制器，它在复杂操纵过程中提供稳定的下半身与躯干执行能力。在此控制器的基础上，我们开发了一个结合了基于 VR 的遥操作与人-人形机器人运动映射（human-to-humanoid motion mapping）的全身人形机器人数据收集系统，从而能够高效收集真实世界的示范数据。随后，我们提出了 HTD（具有触觉梦想的人形机器人变压器，Humanoid Transformer with Touch Dreaming）——一个多模态编码器-解码器 Transformer，它将触觉建模为与多视角视觉和本体感觉并列的核心模态。HTD 在单个阶段中通过通过触觉梦想增强的行为克隆进行训练：除了预测动作块（action chunks）外，该策略还预测未来的手部关节力和未来的触觉潜在变量（tactile latents），从而鼓励共享的 Transformer 主干网络学习用于灵巧交互的接触感知表征。
在五项富含接触的任务（Insert-T、图书整理、毛巾折叠、猫砂清理和茶水服务）中，HTD 的平均成功率比更强的基线方法实现了 90.9% 的相对提升。消融实验结果进一步表明，潜在空间触觉预测（latent-space tactile prediction）比原始触觉预测更具成效，使成功率获得了 30% 的相对增益。
这些结果表明，将鲁棒的全身执行、可扩展的人形机器人数据收集以及预测性的以触觉为中心学习相结合，能够在真实世界中实现通用、高灵巧性的人形机器人操纵。
Humanoid robots promise general-purpose assistance, yet real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging because it requires whole-body stability, dexterous hands, and contact-aware perception under frequent contact changes. In this work, we study dexterous, contact-rich humanoid loco-manipulation. We first develop an RL-based whole-body controller that provides stable lower-body and torso execution during complex manipulation. Built on this controller, we develop a whole-body humanoid data collection system that combines VR-based teleoperation with human-to-humanoid motion mapping, enabling efficient collection of real-world demonstrations. We then propose Humanoid Transformer with Touch Dreaming (HTD), a multimodal encoder–decoder Transformer that models touch as a core modality alongside multi-view vision and proprioception. HTD is trained in a single stage with behavioral cloning augmented by touch dreaming: in addition to predicting action chunks, the policy predicts future hand-joint forces and future tactile latents, encouraging the shared Transformer trunk to learn contact-aware representations for dexterous interaction. Across five contact-rich tasks, Insert-T, Book Organization, Towel Folding, Cat Litter Scooping, and Tea Serving, HTD achieves a 90.9% relative improvement in average success rate over the stronger baseline. Ablation results further show that latent-space tactile prediction is more effective than raw tactile prediction, yielding a 30% relative gain in success rate. These results demonstrate that combining robust whole-body execution, scalable humanoid data collection, and predictive touch-centered learning enables versatile, high-dexterity humanoid manipulation in the real world.
